A few seconds later, the expression on Watson's face began to change. His face was filled with shock.
This folder contained all the evidence of his crimes that Rachel had painstakingly collected. Once this evidence was handed over to the police, even if Yamino Gomez was backing him up, he would still die.
Watson couldn't figure out where Connor got all this information. His right hand kept trembling, and fine beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.
Everyone present seemed to be able to sense that something was wrong.
"This... Where did you get these?"
Watson shouted.
"Do you think you still need to care about these questions now?"
Connor replied calmly.
Watson looked at him without saying anything.
"Watson, I'll give you one last chance on account of your father. I hope you can seize it!" Connor said.
Watson took a deep breath, then gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, "What exactly do you want?"
Connor could feel that Watson should have already given in, or he would definitely not have said this.
"Back then, when our Stormbound Corporation's factory exploded, this matter had something to do with you, right?"
Connor asked.
"..."
Watson looked up at Connor with an unnatural expression.
"As I said just now, if you cooperate with me honestly, I can let you live!" Connor reminded.
Watson took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "That's right, that explosion is indeed related to me…"
"You should have some evidence in your hands that can save my people, right?"
Connor pressed.
"Yes!"
Watson nodded again.
"Give me the evidence!"
"As long as I give you the evidence, will you destroy this information?" Watson asked.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "You are really naive. Do you think that just a piece of evidence will make me let you go? Even if you don't give me the evidence now, I have many ways to save my people…"
Watson hesitated for two seconds, then stood up and walked out of the meeting room.
Everyone looked at Watson's back with puzzled expressions. They couldn't understand what Connor had shown him. Why did his attitude change so much?
A few minutes later, Watson returned and placed a hard disk in front of Connor. "This is what you want!"
Connor picked up the hard drive and glanced at it briefly, then handed it directly to Mr. Solana behind him.
Mr. Solana plugged the hard drive into the computer and checked it carefully. He found that there was only one video on the hard drive. However, this video was enough because it recorded the entire process of the other party installing the explosives.
Now, as long as Connor handed this video to the police, the police could use this video to help Queta clear her name.
"I've already given you what you want. What else do you want?"
Watson no longer had the confidence he had just now because his most fatal weapon was now in Connor's hands. He was not qualified to play with Connor at all.
"You should have 30% of the Zook Corporation's shares, right?" Connor asked.
Before coming to the Zook Corporation, Connor had also investigated the distribution of shares in the Zook Corporation. Hudson held 51% of the shares, while Watson held 30%. The remaining shares were distributed among the minority shareholders.
"You want my shares?"
Watson seemed to have realized what Connor wanted to do in an instant.
Connor nodded. "That's right, I just want the shares in your hands!"
Everyone present was dumbfounded and looked at Watson in shock.
If Watson really agreed to Connor's conditions and gave his shares to Connor, then Connor would hold 80% of the shares.
With so many shares in Connor's hands, even if all the remaining minority shareholders joined forces, they only held less than 20% of the shares. These people could not pressure Connor at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1908: Compensation?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1908: Compensation?
When Connor saw that everyone was defecting one after another, he could not help but smile faintly.
He glanced at everyone and said, "Alright, since you all intend to stay, I will naturally not mistreat you all…"
After everyone saw Connor agree, their originally nervous mood instantly relaxed a lot.
Connor had already considered this problem. The Zook Corporation had many branches, and the business scope of the Zook Corporation was also very terrifying. If he really chased all these people out now, it would be impossible for him to find suitable candidates to replace these people in a short period of time. Moreover, these people had worked in the Zook Corporation for many years and were very familiar with their work.
Leaving these people behind was the best choice for Connor.
Now that Watson no longer had any shares, these small shareholders could not cause any waves at all.
Connor narrowed his eyes and said to everyone, "Since you all want to stay, then I'll announce a few things!"
After everyone heard Connor's words, they instantly fell silent.
"From now on, I'm the largest shareholder of the Zook Corporation, so I'll be the Chairman. Do you have any objections to this?"
Connor said.
"No objections…"
"Of course I have none…"
At this moment, the people from the Zook family seemed to have changed. They hurriedly shook their heads and did not object at all.
"Peyton Zook will be the general manager of the Zook Corporation, and Queta Juve will be the deputy general manager of the Zook Corporation!" Connor continued.
When the people of the Zook family heard this, they looked at Peyton with ugly expressions. After all, they did not expect the position of general manager to fall into his hands in the end.
One had to know that these people had bullied Peyton many times!
If Peyton really became the general manager of the Zook Corporation, they would definitely not have a good ending.
However, even if they were worried, they did not dare to make any objections. After all, Connor was the only one who had the final say in the Zook Corporation.
Peyton looked at the expressions on everyone's faces, proud. He was secretly glad that he had chosen to cooperate with Connor back then. If not for Connor, he would never have been able to reach the position of the general manager in his lifetime.
Connor could naturally feel the worry in the hearts of the Zook family. However, this was the result that he wanted to see; he hoped that the Zook family would not be able to band together. This way, it would be convenient for Connor to control the Zook Corporation.
Moreover, Peyton's position as the general manager was just a decoration. In the future, the real controller of the Zook Corporation would still be Queta.
"Next, I still have one more thing to say…" Connor said.
When everyone heard this, they hurriedly looked up at him.
"From today onwards, our Zook Corporation will stop all cooperation with the Gomez family!"
Connor said slowly.
"..."
Everyone looked at Connor with shocked expressions.
"Mr. McDonald, isn't this a little inappropriate?" a middle-aged man muttered.
"What's wrong with it?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, you might not know much about the Zook Corporation. Most of our businesses are in cooperation with the Gomez family. If we suspend all our collaborations with the Gomez family now, it will have a huge impact on the corporation…"
This middle-aged man was called Morton Zook, the cousin of Watson. He also held a very important position in the Zook Corporation.
"It doesn't matter. Suspending all cooperation with the Gomez family will have some impact on our company, but it will also have a huge impact on them. I'll get Stormbound Corporation to develop new projects as soon as possible and then cooperate with the Zook Corporation!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"But if we stop the cooperation now, what if the Gomez family asks for compensation from us? After all, they signed contracts for all these projects!" Morton hurriedly asked.
"Compensation?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "If they want compensation, then let's just drag it out. I feel that the Gomez family might not be able to last until the day we have to compensate them…"
"..."
Morton looked at Connor helplessly.
After all, in the entirety of Oprana, only Connor had the courage to say this.
Everyone finally understood that Connor had spent so much effort to take down the Zook Corporation just to deal with the Gomez family.
To put it bluntly, it didn't matter to Connor whether the Zook Corporation made money or not. What Connor really cared about was to use the Zook Corporation to drag down the Gomez family.
"Do you have any objections?"
Connor asked the crowd expressionlessly after seeing that Morton had stopped talking.
"No…"
Everyone did not dare to disobey Connor's wishes and shook their heads one after another.
"Alright, since no one has any objections, then do as I say!"
Connor nodded gently, then stood up and walked out of the conference room.
After seeing Connor leave, Peyton hurriedly followed him out of the meeting room.
"Mr. McDonald…"
Peyton shouted anxiously after catching up to Connor.
"Is there anything else?"
Connor asked.
"Mr. McDonald, you've just taken over the Zook Corporation. I think it's a little too urgent to deal with the Gomez family. Why don't we stabilize it for a period of time? It won't be too late to deal with the Gomez family after we really take control of the Zook Corporation!"
Peyton said carefully.
"Now that the Zook Corporation is already under my control, there's no need to continue waiting…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"But…"
Peyton opened his mouth to speak.
"These things are not for you to consider. You should now think of how to stabilize your position as the general manager!" Connor interrupted.
Peyton saw that Connor's expression was a little strange, but he did not continue to say anything.
Connor left the Zook Corporation with Mr. Solana.
After leaving the Zook Corporation headquarters, Connor brought Mr. Solana to the police station and handed the video that Watson had given him to the police station's director.
After checking the video and confirming that there were no problems, the police station chief released Queta in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1909: The Simplest Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 1909: The Simplest Method
When Queta saw Connor, she was very excited.
She knew that since Connor could bail her out, it meant that he must have already settled the Zook family.
Although she had been locked up in the police station for a long time, Queta still looked beautiful, and her mental state was also very good.
After all, Connor had already informed the leaders there not to mistreat her, so Queta didn't suffer there. On the contrary, she was very relaxed.
Even during the time she was detained, Queta was still allowed to use her phone and computer. This ensured that Stormbound Corporation could continue to operate normally.
"Queta, it's been hard on you during this period of time!"
Connor muttered to her.
Queta smiled faintly. "Mr. McDonald, you don't have to be so polite with me!"
"Get in the car!"
Connor also smiled and then reached out to open the car door.
"Mr. McDonald, what's the situation with the Zook family now?"
Queta asked after they got into the car.
"Now that the entire Zook Corporation is under my control, you need to focus on the Zook Corporation for the next period of time and try to stop all cooperation between the Zook family and the Gomez family as soon as possible!"
Connor said.
After Queta heard Connor's words, she was obviously stunned for a moment, disbelief on her face. She widened her eyes and said, "Mr. McDonald, it's only been less than a week and you've already taken control of the entire Zook family?"
"Yes…"
Connor nodded.
Queta did not know how to describe her feelings. She felt that all of this was too unbelievable. No matter what, the Zook family was still one of the four great families of Yarlford!
"Mr. McDonald, what did you do?"
Queta asked curiously.
Connor was stunned for a moment, but he told her what he had done over the past few days.
When Queta realized what was going on, she was even more shocked.
After all, although Connor said these things very casually, it was definitely not that easy to do what he did.
"Then what are your plans, Mr. McDonald?"
"Now that the Zook family has stopped cooperating with the Gomez family, I will also ask the Lee family to stop cooperating with the Gomez family. In this way, the Gomez family will lose two capable helpers. The Levine family and the Zacek family are the only ones left among the four families. As long as I get rid of those two, the Gomez family will be truly isolated and helpless in Yarlford!"
"I've investigated the situation of the Levine and Zacek families. Although they are also part of the four great families, the strength of the Levine family and the Zacek family is obviously weaker than the Lee and Zook families," Queta said.
"Yes, I think we can use the simplest method to deal with these two families. There's no need to waste time with them!" Connor muttered.
"The simplest method?"
Queta was stunned when she heard Connor's words.
"That's right!"
Connor nodded.
Queta hesitated for a moment before asking, "Mr. McDonald, when do you plan to make your move? Do you need my help?"
"No need, I can solve it myself!"
Connor said lightly.
"Alright then!"
Queta nodded thoughtfully and did not say anything else.
Since she had just come out, there were still many things she needed to settle at Stormbound Corporation and the Zook Corporation. Connor sent her back to Stormbound Tower and returned home alone.
After reaching home, Connor started cultivating his Chi again.
This period of time was still quite important to Connor because Yamino Gomez was not in Yarlford and was instead at the Rockefeller headquarters for a meeting.
Therefore, Juan Gomez was the only one managing the affairs of the Gomez family.
Although Juan was a rich heir with a high IQ and EQ and was also very capable in managing the company, he was not on the same level as his father in terms of strategy and courage.
Connor planned to take advantage of the time when Yamino Gomez was not in Yarlford to turn all four great clans into his own. In this way, even if Yamino returned, he would be powerless to turn the situation around.
In the blink of an eye, the afternoon passed.
At six o'clock in the afternoon, Connor left the villa alone.
Now that the Zook family and the Lee family were both under Connor's control, only the Zacek and Levine families were left among the four families.
Previously, Connor had asked Yama to monitor the people of these two families, so Connor was very familiar with their movements.
The news of the change in the Zook Corporation had already reached the ears of the two families. After all, the Zook Corporation had already announced that it would stop all cooperation with the Gomez family. It was impossible for the two families not to know of such big news.
Kaiser Zacek, the head of the Zacek family, seemed to be unable to sit still, so he had immediately contacted Camilo, the head of the Levine family. The two of them were ready to meet again to discuss how to deal with Connor.
…
8 PM.
In the Zacek family villa.
Kaiser, Camilo, and the other important figures of the two families were gathered here. There were all kinds of delicious dishes on the table, but no one was in the mood to eat.
At this moment, everyone in the restaurant had an ugly expression on their faces.
"Brother Levine, you should have heard about the Zook family, right?"
Kaiser muttered to Camilo.
"How could I not have heard of such a big thing?"
Camilo lit a cigar and continued, "Connor, that brat, is actually so capable. In just a few months, he has already developed Stormbound Corporation to such an extent. Not only is the Zook family under Connor's control, but even the Lee family is under his control."
"Brother Levine, I won't beat around the bush with you. Now that President Gomez is not in Yarlford, Connor was brazen in dealing with the Zook family. His next plan must be to deal with our two families," Kaiser said.
After hearing this, Camilo hesitated for a moment, then said expressionlessly, "Do you have any good ideas?"
"If I had any, I wouldn't have called you over…"
Kaiser smiled awkwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1910: A Superior Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 1910: A Superior Move
"As far as I know, Connor McDonald's skill is very outstanding."
"Even an ancient martial arts grandmaster is not a match for him, so if Connor really wants to deal with us, the two of us won't stand a chance at all!" Camilo said slowly.
"Then you mean that we can only sit and wait for death now?" Kaiser shouted excitedly.
"Not necessarily…"
Camilo waved his hand and continued, "Isn't Connor only daring to be so arrogant now because President Gomez isn't in Yarlford? If he was, then Connor definitely wouldn't dare to deal with us so brazenly!"
"But I've already called President Gomez. I can't contact him!"
Kaiser said in despair.
"Don't you know what kind of person President Gomez is? Every year, President Gomez will disappear for a month during the Rockefeller meeting. During this period of time, not even Mr. Gomez Jr. can't contact President Gomez!" Camilo exclaimed.
"Brother Levine, don't beat around the bush with me. Since you're so confident now, it means that you must have some way."
Kaiser knew that Camilo had the best brain. He felt that Camilo must have thought of a way to deal with Connor, or he would not be so calm.
"Brother Zacek, it is actually very easy to deal with Connor…"
Camilo smiled faintly and continued, "Why did Connor deal with our four great clans?"
"What else could it be? They definitely want to use our four great families to deal with President Gomez. I still understand the logic of this!" Kaiser replied.
"That's right. Since Connor intends to use us to deal with President Gomez, it means that the two of us are not in any danger. Because the two of us have no enmity with Connor, he just wants to use us!"
Camilo said with a smile.
Kaiser looked at Camilo's expression in confusion. He didn't know what Camilo was trying to say.
"Kaiser, I've already said this much. Don't tell me you still don't understand what I mean?"
"Not really…" Kaiser shook his head.
Camilo sighed and said in a low voice, "Since that kid Connor wants to use the two of us, then the two of us might as well let him use us. Not only that, we don't have to wait for him to come for the two of us."
"Brother Levine, are you planning to betray President Gomez?"
"Of course not. I'm just stalling for time. The two of us will pretend to defect to Connor first. Then, when President Gomez returns, we'll work together with him to get rid of Connor. This way, not only will the two of us not suffer any losses, but we can also help President Gomez deal with Connor…"
Camilo smiled proudly and continued, "Once the two of us really help President Gomez get rid of Connor, the businesses of the Lee and Zook families will definitely be divided between the two of us. At that time, Yarlford might not be ruled by four great families, but two great families instead!"
Kaiser finally understood Camilo's real intentions. He looked a little excited and said to Camilo with a smile, "Brother Levine, your move is really brilliant! Why didn't I think of that!"
"Hahaha…"
Camilo smiled proudly, then picked up his chopsticks and started eating.
"If the two of us pretend to join Connor, not only will we be able to solve the problem in front of us, but we can also cooperate with President Gomez from the inside and outside. At that time, the two of us will become great meritorious deeds. This method is really too wonderful…"
Kaiser's mood instantly improved as he spoke to Camilo excitedly.
"Brother Zacek, do you still have anything to worry about?"
Camilo asked with a smile.
"Nothing else…"
Kaiser waved his hand and raised his wine glass. "Brother Levine, luckily you were smart enough to think of this method. If it were me, I definitely wouldn't have thought of such a good method! This glass of wine is a toast to you…"
"Brother Zacek, we are all in the same boat. You are being too polite…"
Camilo also slowly raised his glass.
"Your plan is indeed good, but Connor doesn't seem to be a fool, right? How can you guarantee that he will believe the two of you 100%?"
Just as Kaiser and Camilo were clinking glasses, a voice rang out in the dining room.
Everyone turned to look at the entrance of the dining room when they heard the voice.
A young man slowly walked in.
Camilo looked at the young man's face, puzzled. Then he asked Kaiser in a low voice, "Brother Zacek, is this person a junior of your Zacek family?"
"No, I don't know this person…"
Kaiser was also confused.
After all, Camilo and Kaiser had never seen Connor before since they didn't even attend Watson's birthday banquet. Instead, they'd asked their juniors to go.
Everyone turned to look at the young man.
The young man's expression was very calm as he slowly walked in front of everyone. He stretched out his hand and pulled out a chair, sitting quietly in front of everyone.
Kaiser's son, Teo Zacek, stood up and asked the young man, "Who are you? What are you doing here?"
"I'm the person you want to deal with!"
The young man picked up his chopsticks and casually picked up a mouthful of food, then put it in his mouth and tasted it.
"Are you Connor McDonald?"
Camilo reacted in an instant. He widened his eyes and shouted in disbelief.
Connor slowly raised his head and glanced at Camilo, then said lightly, "You guessed right!"
For a moment, the originally lively dining hall fell silent, and the atmosphere grew strange. No one had expected Connor to be so bold as to barge into the Zacek family alone.
What made these people even more surprised was that Connor had just finished dealing with the Zook family today, and yet he actually made a move on the Zacek family so quickly.
"You are Connor McDonald?"
Kaiser tried his best to control the fear in his heart.
"Right. I've already heard your plan just now. I have to say that this plan is indeed very good, but you two don't seem to have considered that I, Connor, am not a fool. Even if you two take the initiative to come to me, I won't really believe you two!"
Connor said calmly as he ate.

chapters.title: Chapter 1911: Not to be Bullied
chapters.content:
Chapter 1911: Not to be Bullied
"Why are you here?"
Teo hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
"I'm here because I want to convince the Zacek family to help me deal with the Gomez family!"
Connor replied.
"Since you heard our conversation just now, I'll tell you the truth! Our families will never betray Yamino Gomez. You'd better give up!"
Camilo gritted his teeth and said to Connor.
"Why do you think the Zook family betrayed Yamino Gomez?"
Connor asked Camilo.
"Why?"
Camilo was stunned for a moment before asking.
"Because they had no other choice. They had two options: one was to die, the other was to listen to me. You only have these two options as well."
Connor was eating as he spoke. He was so calm that it made people feel a little scared.
Camilo and Kaiser both gasped with complicated expressions on their faces. They didn't expect Connor to come to them so quickly.
Moreover, Connor did not seem to have any intention of discussing with the two of them at all. It was obviously a blatant threat.
Camilo and Kaiser looked at each other and didn't know what to do. The others there were also very nervous.
Connor took out two pills from his clothes and placed them on the table. Then, he said indifferently, "Eat this medicinal pill. Then, the two of you will do whatever I ask you to do in the future. This way, I can guarantee that the two of you will still be able to enjoy your current glory and wealth in the future. Moreover, no one will be able to harm the two of you…"
"What is this?"
Camilo looked at the pills on the table and asked in confusion.
"Poison!"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "However, you don't have to worry too much. Although it's poison, it won't kill you immediately. This poison will exist in your body for a lifetime until you die!"
When Camilo and Kaiser heard this, their expressions changed drastically. They didn't expect Connor to come prepared.
"After eating this poison, you must take the antidote every month to suppress the poison's effect. In this world, only I can provide you with the antidote, so as long as you listen to me, I will get someone to send you the antidote every month."
Connor looked at Camilo and explained with a smile.
Camilo's expression changed drastically when he heard Connor's words. He shouted, "Connor, you are really vicious!"
"Vicious?"
Connor smiled disdainfully and then said indifferently, "If I had not heard the conversation between the two of you, I would not have thought of using such a method to deal with the two of you…"
"Just give up. I will never eat this pill!"
Kaiser finally couldn't take it anymore and shouted at Connor.
Connor slowly turned to look at Kaiser with a murderous look on his face. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Do you think you can decide whether to eat it or not?"
Crash!
At this moment, Kaiser's son, Teo, suddenly stood up and took out his pistol. He pointed it at Connor and shouted in a low voice, "Connor, don't think that the Zacek family is like the Zook family. We're not that easy to bully!"
For a moment, the situation seemed to have been reversed.
No one had expected Teo to be so bold. When Connor's attention was on Kaiser and Camilo, Teo pulled out his gun and aimed it at Connor.
Kaiser looked a little proud seeing what Teo was doing. He then asked Connor with a smile, "Connor, you're an ancient martial arts grandmaster, and you're very powerful. The Zacek family is not your match, but don't you think too little of the Zacek family? Do you really think that the Zacek family has not made any preparations?"
Whoosh!
After Kaiser finished his sentence, more than ten bodyguards with submachine guns rushed into the restaurant and aimed their guns at Connor.
Camilo eased up a little because he didn't expect Kaiser to be so prepared.
Although they all knew that Connor was an ancient martial arts grandmaster and his strength was terrifying, the Zacek and Levine family weren't in the ancient martial arts world, after all. Most of the martial artists they could come into contact with were only black ranks, so they did not know how strong an ancient martial arts grandmaster was.
Kaiser believed that no matter how terrifying Connor's strength was, he was just a human being. He would definitely not be able to withstand so many bullets.
At this time, Connor was very calm, as if he didn't care about these bodyguards at all. He was still eating quietly.
"How are you still eating?"
Teo pointed his gun at Connor's head and asked in a low voice.
"Don't tell me you think you can kill me with these things?"
Connor glanced at Teo and asked expressionlessly.
"Are you saying you have bones of steel? Not even bullets can kill you?"
Teo asked disdainfully.
"Haha…"
Connor laughed but didn't say anything.
Kaiser had a strange look on his face. He immediately shouted in a low voice, "Don't waste your breath on him. Just kill him!"
Teo understood what Kaiser meant and pulled the trigger without hesitation.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
The bullet flew toward Connor's head.
However, to everyone's surprise, after the gunshot, Connor was still sitting on the spot, safe and sound, while Teo was lying in front of everyone.
Teo's head was pierced by a bullet, and blood was flowing out slowly.
For a moment, everyone was stunned. They were in shock. The few women of the Zacek family could not help but scream.
After all, these people from the Zacek family were just ordinary people. The speed of the bullets was too fast. They did not see what had happened.
Just as the bullet was about to hit Connor, it suddenly changed direction and flew toward Teo.
Teo did not understand what was going on even when he died.
Everything happened too suddenly. Everyone in the restaurant fell into chaos, and screams could be heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 1912: Control
chapters.content:
Chapter 1912: Control
At this moment, Connor was in stark contrast to the Zacek family.
Connor was eating quietly as if nothing had happened.
The Zacek family was hiding at the side of the dining room.
Kaiser was not in the mood to find out how Teo died. He shouted at the bodyguards, "What are you all still standing there for? Hurry up and kill this person!"
After hearing Kaiser's words, all the bodyguards raised their submachine guns without any hesitation and pulled the trigger.
Bang bang bang…
Countless bullets rained down on Connor.
At this moment, everyone revealed a terrified expression because they knew in their hearts that no matter how great Connor's ability was, it was absolutely impossible for him to block so many bullets.
However, something unexpected happened.
Connor, who had been sitting quietly and eating, was still unharmed. On the contrary, the gunshots had stopped.
The bodyguards had all been shot multiple times and had died on the spot.
Blood instantly dyed the floor of the restaurant red.
This scene was too strange for the Zacek family. They felt as if they had seen a ghost. Connor did not move at all from the beginning to the end. He did not even look at those bodyguards.
Moreover, it was clearly the bodyguards who fired at Connor just now, but nothing happened to him. Even the dining table in front of Connor was not damaged at all. On the contrary, those bodyguards who fired were all dead.
"What..."
Kaiser looked at the blood under his feet, and his face was filled with fear. He didn't even know how to express his emotions.
At this moment, Connor suddenly put down his chopsticks and looked back at Kaiser.
When Kaiser saw Connor's gaze, his entire body began to tremble violently. If he wasn't leaning against the wall, he might have fallen to the ground.
In Kaiser's eyes, Connor's gaze was as terrifying as the devil's.
"Are there any tricks the Zacek family hasn't used yet?"
Connor asked Kaiser softly.
"..."
Kaiser looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, "What... What do you want to do?"
"If you don't have any more tricks up your sleeves, then sit here. I have something to tell the two of you…"
Connor said to Kaiser and Camilo.
Kaiser and Camilo already realized how terrifying Connor was. They knew that if they continued to resist, they might end up like the bodyguards lying on the ground.
Therefore, after hesitating for a moment, Kaiser and Camilo walked shakily to Connor.
"Mr... Mr. McDonald, what do you want?"
Camilo was now completely scared out of his wits by Connor. He asked Connor nervously.
"Didn't I already tell you what I want just now?"
Connor poured himself a glass of red wine and took a sip.
Kaiser and Camilo looked at the two pills on the table almost at the same time.
"If the two of you take these two pills and listen to me, I guarantee that your lives will not be affected in any way. However, if the two of you don't take them, then everyone in this room can forget about leaving alive today!"
Connor put down the wine glass in his hand and said softly.
"Mr. McDonald, we have agreed to all your conditions, but can we not eat the pill?"
Camilo took a deep breath and asked Connor in a low voice.
"Do you think you have the right to bargain with me now?"
Connor replied calmly.
When Camilo heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across his face. For a moment, he didn't know what to do.
Kaiser was also terrified.
"I'll give you two five minutes to consider!"
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the expensive Quartz Clock on the wall.
Camilo also looked up at the time, his face filled with despair.
Although this was the first time he had come into contact with Connor, he could clearly feel Connor's strength. This unprecedented pressure made him feel a little suffocated.
Even when he was facing Yamino Gomez, Camilo had never felt this way.
Previously, Camilo still couldn't understand how Connor, who was just a young guy in his early twenties, could cause such a big wave in Yarlford. At this time, he seemed to have an answer in his heart.
Tick tock...
Time ticked by as the clock ticked.
Kaiser finally couldn't hold on any longer, because he knew that if he didn't do as Connor said, then all the people of the Zacek family would die in Connor's hands. He had no other choice now.
"As long as I eat this poison, you'll let the Zacek family off, right?"
Kaiser picked up the pill and asked Connor expressionlessly.
"If you are obedient!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I hope you will do what you said you would do!"
Kaiser gritted his teeth and threw the pill into his mouth.
Meanwhile, Camilo was observing Kaiser. After all, he was not sure what would happen after taking this pill, so he had been waiting for Kaiser to lose his patience first.
However, after Kaiser ate the pill, he did not seem to have any reaction. He looked very normal.
"What about you?"
Connor asked Camilo.
Camilo hesitated for a moment before picking up the pill and throwing it into his mouth.
Connor saw the two of them eat the pill and gently stretched his back. Then, he said indifferently, "The two of you don't have to worry. This medicinal pill won't have any effect on your bodies. You only need to take the antidote once a month. Therefore, from now on, my life is tied to your lives. If nothing happens to me, nothing will happen to the two of you…"
"Alright…"
Camilo and Kaiser nodded almost at the same time.
"Next, I need your families to stop all business cooperation with the Gomez family. This shouldn't be difficult for you, right?"
Connor continued.
After hearing Connor's words, a strange look flashed across Camilo's eyes. After all, if the
Levine family stopped cooperating with the Gomez family now, there would be a huge impact on the Levine family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1913: Leaving it to Fate
chapters.content:
Chapter 1913: Leaving it to Fate
"Mr. McDonald, if the Levine family really stops working with the Gomez family, then our family will most probably go bankrupt!"
Camilo said through gritted teeth.
"You don't have to worry about these problems. Now that the four great families of Yarlford are under my control, I will try my best to arrange for cooperation between the four families and strive to minimize your losses!"
Connor replied indifferently.
In fact, the situation in Yarlford was relatively simple. Basically, most of the businesses were in the hands of the Gomez family. The Gomez family chose to cooperate with the four big families and let the four big families help the Gomez family earn money from these businesses.
To put it bluntly, most of the money-making projects in Yarlford were controlled by the Gomez family. The four big families were just working for the Gomez family.
Once the four families stopped cooperating with the Gomez family, the Gomez family would lose its employees, and the four families would face an even greater crisis.
The Gomez family and the four families had always had a boss and subordinate type relationship. What Connor was doing now was to make the Gomez family, the behind-the-scenes boss, a boss without any subordinates.
Then, he would use Stormbound Corporation to replace the Gomez family as the boss.
"Then, Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to cooperate with us?"
Kaiser asked Connor.
"I don't care about the specifics of the cooperation. The two of you go and discuss these matters with Queta Juve. I know that your two families have many companies and factories. Although temporarily leaving the Gomez family will affect you, as long as these companies and factories are still there, we can completely replace the Gomez family!"
Connor said calmly.
"I... I understand…"
Kaiser looked at Connor and nodded.
Although Connor's actions would definitely make the four families suffer in the end, they had no other choice now. They could only do as Connor said.
"I know what the two of you are worried about now, but Yamino and the Gomez family won't be able to hold on for long in Yarlford. So, when Yamino falls, I guarantee that your lives will be much better than it is now!"
Connor comforted the two of them.
"..."
Kaiser and Camilo looked at Connor helplessly but didn't say anything.
"Alright, I'm almost done with today's meal. Thank you for your hospitality, Mr. Zacek. If I need anything, I'll contact the two of you!"
Connor picked up the napkin beside him and wiped his mouth. Then, he walked out of the restaurant.
Kaiser and Camilo stood rooted to the ground with a dazed look in their eyes. They were feeling very vexed.
It had only been less than an hour since Connor appeared, but the Zacek family and the Levine family had already become Connor's possessions.
In just one day, three out of the four big families of Yarlford were now under Connor's control.
This might not have much of an impact on the ordinary people of Yarlford, but it would definitely cause a huge earthquake to the upper class of Yarlford.
"Connor McDonald is really terrifying…"
After Connor disappeared, Kaiser sighed.
"Back then, when he wanted to deal with Mr. Gomez, I thought that he was just crazy."
Camilo also sighed.
"Camilo, what do you plan to do next?"
Kaiser asked Camilo helplessly.
"What else can we do? Now that our lives are in Connor's hands, we can only do as he says. As for who will win or lose in the end between Connor and Mr. Gomez, it's not up to us. We will have to leave it to fate."
Camilo sighed helplessly and then walked out of the restaurant.
Kaiser looked at Camilo's back with a helpless expression.
...
On the other side, Connor returned home after leaving the Zacek family's villa.
At this time, Rachel Wallace had already returned home. She was still sitting on the sofa watching a boring TV series.
Sometimes, Connor was quite curious. Why was Rachel so obsessed with TV dramas? It was as if there were only two things in Rachel's world: attending classes and watching TV dramas.
Connor had never even seen Rachel do anything else.
"You're back?"
Rachel heard the commotion and turned to look at Connor.
"Yes…"
Connor nodded tiredly.
"What happened today? I heard that the Zook Corporation is under your control now..."
Rachel asked.
"It's not just the Zook family. The Zacek family and the Levine family are also under my control now. The four big families of Yarlford have already switched sides. All that's left is to wait for Yamino to return!"
Connor sat beside Rachel and softly said.
"You think you can deal with Yamino just like that?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but frown slightly.
"It's definitely not enough to depend on the defection of the four big families. After all, if Yamino was so easy to deal with, I wouldn't have had to put in so much effort."
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "Right now, I'm just using the four big families to weaken Yamino's power. At that time, Rockefeller will definitely put pressure on Yamino. I understand how Rockefeller operates. This organization has no sense of humanity to speak of. They only look at how much value a person can create for Rockefeller. Once Yamino has no value in Rockefeller's eyes, Rockefeller will give up on Yamino and let someone else take over his position!"
"And then?"
Rachel changed to a more comfortable position and placed her slender and fair legs on the sofa as she asked softly.
"When Rockefeller completely gives up on Yamino, he will lose his greatest backer. It will be much easier for me to deal with him then…"
Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "The four big families have all stopped cooperating with the Gomez family. The Gomez family will suffer a great loss, but this does not mean that I can shake the foundation of the Gomez family. Once Yamino returns to Yarlford, he will quickly find other families to replace the four big families."
"You still need to find a way to make the Gomez family fall into chaos, right?"
Rachel blinked and asked Connor softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1914: Your Strength is Far from Enough
chapters.content:
Chapter 1914: Your Strength is Far from Enough
"That's right. Now I know how to throw the Gomez family into chaos!"
Connor nodded lightly and continued, "According to the information I have now, there was someone called grandmaster by Yamino's side back then. This person had been by Yamino's side since he started from scratch. He knew everything that Yamino had done like the back of his hand. However, it was precisely because this person knew too much that Yamino felt that this person was a threat to him, so he wanted to kill this person. This grandmaster discovered Yamino's goal in advance, so he left Yarlford…
"Yamino has been searching for this grandmaster for many years. As long as I can find this grandmaster before Yamino and make him tell me what Yamino has done all these years, the higher ups will definitely investigate Yamino immediately!"
"You're underestimating Rockefeller. They can use their connections to suppress this matter!"
Rachel couldn't help but remind Connor when she heard this.
"If someone else reports Yamino, I believe that Rockefeller has the ability to suppress this. But if it's me, no one can suppress this!"
Connor said confidently to Rachel.
"Are you really that capable?"
Rachel pouted.
"Don't forget my relationship with Yuna Winston, and I have you. Your family has a lot of influence in York. As long as the two of you take action, no one can suppress this!"
Connor said with a smile.
Rachel seemed somewhat helpless.
"As long as the higher-ups start investigating Yamino, no matter what the final outcome of the investigation is, Rockefeller will lose trust in Yamino. The influence of the Gomez family in Yarlford will also be greatly weakened. I will take this opportunity to get rid of Yamino and control the entire Yarlford!"
Connor told Rachel all his plans.
"Aren't you worried that Rockefeller will send someone else to replace Yamino?"
Rachel asked with a smile.
"I'll kill every one of them until Rockefeller doesn't dare to send anyone over!"
Connor said lightly.
Rachel heard Connor's words and smiled but didn't say anything.
"By the way, didn't your parents die at the hands of Rockefeller? Did you find out how your parents died back then?"
Connor suddenly remembered the grudge between Rachel and Rockefeller.
"I didn't find out who killed my parents back then, but I know that the person who killed my parents might have a much higher position in Rockefeller than Yamino. So, if you want to avenge me, your current strength is far from enough…"
Rachel said dejectedly.
"..."
Connor looked at Rachel and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "Don't worry. Since I promised to help you get revenge back then, I will fulfill my promise to you no matter what position your enemy holds in Rockefeller or how terrifying his strength is…"
"You should deal with Yamino first. My revenge is not urgent…"
Rachel replied softly, but there was a look of gratitude on her face.
Because Rachel was the one who could feel the change in Connor the most. At the beginning, when Connor inherited the inheritance, it was as if he was immersed in the fact that he had become rich, so he did not think about dealing with Rockefeller at all.
At this point, Connor regarded Rockefeller as his greatest enemy.
It could be said that Rachel had witnessed Connor's growth, while Rockefeller had forced Connor to continue growing.
If it wasn't for Rockefeller trying to get rid of Connor, how could he have the ambition to deal with Rockefeller?
Connor didn't continue chatting with Rachel. Instead, he turned around and returned to his room. Then, he dialed Freya Phillips's number and briefly explained the situation to her.
...
The next day, 9 AM.
"Mr. Gomez Jr., what is going on?"
"Mr. Gomez Jr., why did the Zook family suddenly end the contract? What about the project I'm working on?"
"That's right, Mr. Gomez Jr.. The Zacek family has also stopped all communications with me. All the factories have stopped operating…"
"Mr. Gomez Jr., what is going on?"
Juan Gomez had just arrived at the headquarters of the Gomez family when he was surrounded by a large group of people. Everyone was shouting at Juan.
Juan too had just heard about this, so he was very frustrated.
At this moment, the people around him were all in charge of the various projects with the four big families.
These people had come to the headquarters of Gomez Corporation to look for Juan for one thing, and that was that the four big families had stopped cooperating with them.
This meant that nearly 80% of the projects in the hands of the Gomez family had been halted, and the entire Gomez Corporation was also in an unprecedented crisis.
"Everyone, please stay calm. I know about the situation you're all facing. Now, all of you should return to your respective positions. I'll hold a board meeting as soon as possible to discuss how to deal with these problems!"
Juan shouted at the crowd in frustration.
After hearing Juan's words, everyone instantly fell silent.
Juan took a deep breath and walked into his office.
Bang!
After entering the office, Juan punched his desk with an extremely angry expression.
After all, this was the first time Juan had the opportunity to take charge of the company's affairs. Previously, when Yamino went to Rockefeller for a meeting, the company's matters were all handed over to the vice president to manage.
Juan wanted to make use of this opportunity to show off, but before he could do anything, such a big thing happened. The four big families chose to terminate their cooperation with the Gomez family at around the same time.
"Are these people f*cking crazy? They betrayed the Gomez family with just a few words from Connor McDonald. Am I nothing to them?! If my dad were here, they would never dare to do this!"
Juan shouted through gritted teeth.
Bang! Bang!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
"Come in!"
Juan shouted expressionlessly.
A middle-aged man walked into the office. This middle-aged man was Stuart Little, the vice president of Gomez Corporation. He had been with Yamino for many years and was the second-in-command of Gomez Corporation.
"Uncle Little, what's the situation like?"
Juan's expression softened a little after seeing Stuart, and he quickly asked Stuart.
"Watson Zook and Hudson Zook of the Zook Corporation have already transferred all their shares to Connor. Moreover, Watson Zook also left Yarlford overnight, so now the Zook Corporation is indeed under Connor's control. That's why the Zook Corporation stopped their cooperation with us!"
Stuart said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1915: A New Partner
chapters.content:
Chapter 1915: A New Partner
"What the hell is Watson Zook doing? Why did he give his shares to Connor McDonald?"
Juan gritted his teeth and exclaimed.
"He must have been threatened by Connor McDonald!"
Stuart said helplessly.
Juan took a deep breath and continued, "What about the other three families?"
"The Lee family has betrayed us a long time ago. As for the Zacek family and the Levine Family, I don't know much about them. I tried to contact Kaiser Zacek and Camilo Levine, but I couldn't get in touch with them!"
Stuart said helplessly.
"..."
Juan's face was filled with despair when he heard this. He thought Stuart would bring him some good news, but it seemed that Stuart hadn't found anything.
"Uncle Little, what do you think I should do now?"
Juan asked anxiously.
"Find a suitable company to replace the four families as soon as possible, and then resume our company's projects!"
Stuart then continued, "The four big families are just employees to our company. Since these people are on strike now, we can find new partners…"
"But our company has been working with the four families for so many years. Now that I'm suddenly asked to find new partners, where can I find a suitable one? Besides, Uncle Little, you know that I'm not worried about the projects that are on the surface. Those projects that can't be made known are the most important ones…"
Juan said helplessly.
"Mr. Gomez Jr., I've accumulated some connections over the years. I can help you find new partners for a small number of projects, but most of the projects will need the connections of Mr. Gomez!"
Stuart replied.
After all, Rockefeller's sphere of influence had spread all over the country. If Yamino Gomez wanted to find new companies to replace the four big families, it would be very easy. Moreover, these companies could be completely trusted.
"I don't know when my father will come back. I can't contact my father at all!" Juan gritted his teeth.
"Well…"
Stuart was stumped as well.
Creak!
However, at this moment, the office door was pushed open from the outside.
Aida Collier, who was dressed beautifully, walked into the office in her high heels.
"Aida, why are you here?"
Juan's mood lifted slightly when he saw Aida.
"I came to Yarlford to discuss a project. I have nothing to do now, so I came to see you!"
Aida replied with a smile.
Aida needed to help Connor investigate about the grandmaster, so she had been in contact with Juan. Juan had also been pursuing Aida, but she had not said yes to him.
However, Juan could feel that Aida had feelings for him. Otherwise, she wouldn't have come to Yarlford to look for him from time to time. She was probably testing him now.
Poor Juan didn't know that Aida had a motive for approaching him.
"Uncle Little, go and contact the companies you can contact first. Try to recover the projects as soon as possible. I'll think of other ways!"
Juan whispered to Stuart.
"Alright!"
Stuart then left the office.
Aida already knew that Juan was troubled by the four families, but she asked, "What kind of trouble have you encountered?"
"Sigh. It's all because of that Connor McDonald. Now that the four big families are already siding with Connor, many of our company's projects have also stopped running…"
Juan sighed lightly and said in a frustrated tone.
"Are you worried about the projects?"
Aida continued to ask.
"Yeah. Before my father went abroad, he specifically told me that there were a few important projects that I had to make good progress on. Now, all the four families have stopped working for us, and I can't find suitable companies to replace them in a short period of time…"
Juan didn't hide anything from Aida and told her what was happening.
"What are these projects you're talking about?"
Aida blinked and asked gently.
"..."
Juan was stunned for a moment before he asked vigilantly, "Aida, why are you asking?"
"Have you forgotten? I'm now the head of the Collier family. I have the final say in the matters of the Collier family. I'm asking to see if there's anything I can help you with. If you don't believe me, then just pretend that I didn't ask!"
Aida pretended to be angry and pouted.
"Oh right, how could I forget about you?"
Juan was a little excited, and then he hurriedly took out some documents from his drawer.
"Aida, these projects are the most important ones to me. Do you think the Collier family can help?"
Juan looked at Aida and asked.
Aida sat on the sofa and read the documents carefully. Then, she fell into a state of shock.
This was because these projects included smuggling, drug trafficking, and firearms. To put it bluntly, none of these projects were legal business at all. All of them were illegal.
'I didn't expect that the four big families would actually help the Gomez family do so many inhumane things over the years…'
Aida couldn't help but sigh deep down.
At this time, Aida finally understood why Juan said that he could not find suitable companies to replace the four big families. After all, these businesses were all shady ones. If he found someone that could not be trusted, it would very likely bring big trouble to the Gomez family.
"Aida, do you think the Collier family can help?"
Juan seemed to feel that it was a little hasty of him to suddenly show these projects to Aida, so he asked softly.
"The Collier family can take over these projects of yours!"
Aida raised her head and said to Juan.
"Aida, are you serious? Can the Collier family do all these projects?"
Juan said in surprise.
"The Collier family has been running these businesses for so many years, but the scale is not as big as the Gomez family. If you don't believe me, you can discuss it with your subordinates. As long as you think it's fine, the Collier family is willing to cooperate with the Gomez family on these projects!"
Aida said confidently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1916: Bruce Janco
chapters.content:
Chapter 1916: Bruce Janco
Juan hesitated for a moment, but he didn't make a decision right on the spot.
After all, he did not know much about the Collier family's situation, so he hurriedly said, "Aida, wait for me here. I'll go and discuss with the people in the company now!"
"Alright!"
Aida nodded.
Juan turned around and walked out of the office without any hesitation.
However, after taking two steps, Juan returned to Aida and took the documents on the table.
Aida looked at Juan and smiled but didn't say anything.
Ten minutes later, Juan returned to his office.
Just now, he had found out from his subordinates that the Collier family had been running these businesses for many years, but the scale was not very large. At least the Collier family had experience in this field. If Juan was really in a hurry to recover these projects, it was a good option to cooperate with the Collier family.
After all, the Collier family and the Gomez family had already formed an alliance. Juan had also heard about the relationship between Beau Collier and Connor. The two of them were irreconcilable. The Collier family would never betray the Gomez family.
Juan thought for a moment and felt that it was the wisest option to cooperate with Aida.
"Aida, I just discussed with the people in my company. If you are really willing to help, the Gomez family can cooperate with your Collier family!"
Juan said after seeing Aida.
"Alright, then I'll get the people in charge of these projects from our company to connect with the people in charge in your company!"
Aida nodded gently.
Juan was excited to see Aida agree so readily. He took a step forward and held Aida's hand, saying in a low voice, "Aida, you've done me a great favor this time. I really don't know how to thank you. Before this, we've always split the profits 9 to 1 with the four big families. This time, I've decided to split the profits 8 to 2 with the Collier family. If everything goes well, I'll convince my father to continue working with the Collier family!"
"You don't have to be so polite with me. Our two families are allies. Now that you're in trouble, I definitely won't stand by and watch!"
Aida pulled her hand away from Juan's and continued, "Besides, I'm also a businessman. It just so happens that the Collier family also runs this kind of business. Of course, I have to earn money!"
"You've truly done me a great favor. You've helped me so much. Why don't I buy you a meal today?"
Juan was getting more and more mesmerized by Aida.
"It might be a little late for that. I still have to return to York tonight…"
Aida turned him down without hesitation. Then, she hesitated for a moment and was about to ask about the grandmaster.
Previously, Juan had brought up the grandmaster on his own so that she could find the grandmaster in York. Therefore, Aida would ask Juan about the situation from time to time, so he would not suspect anything.
Juan didn't know that the woman he trusted the most had always been Connor's woman.
Bang! Bang!
But before Aida could say anything, there were a few knocks on the door.
"Who is it?"
Juan frowned and asked.
"Mr. Gomez Jr., it's me!"
A deep voice sounded.
"Come in!"
Juan said lightly.
The office door was pushed open and a middle-aged man with a scar on his face walked into the office.
"Uncle Janco, do you have any news for me?"
Juan asked softly.
When the middle-aged man heard Juan's words, he instinctively looked at Aida.
"Uncle Janco, this is the head of the Collier family, Aida. She already knows about the grandmaster, so you don't have to worry."
Juan didn't treat Aida as an outsider and said casually.
When Aida heard Juan's words, she realized that this person was the expert of the Gomez family, Bruce Janco!
...
The Gomez family had many ancient martial arts experts. There were four ancient martial arts grandmasters alone, and one was an earth-level ancient martial arts grandmaster.
However, these people didn't usually appear around Juan, Yamino, and the others. They would only appear if something big were to happen to the Gomez family. Otherwise, ordinary situations would be solved by Bruce.
Although Bruce was a black rank, he was already an advanced black rank, only one step away from becoming a grandmaster.
Aida knew very well that the Gomez family had never given up on searching for the grandmaster all these years, but she never expected that the Gomez family would send Bruce to search for him.
Bruce hesitated for a couple of seconds after hearing Juan's words, then said softly, "Mr. Gomez Jr., my men have just gotten some news about the grandmaster!"
"Really?"
Juan looked excited.
After all, he had just solved the problem of the four families bailing out on them. Now that he had good news, Juan's mood instantly improved.
"Yes, according to the information gathered by my people, it is very likely that the grandmaster went to Cameron after leaving Yarlford back then and lived there for a period of time…"
Bruce said expressionlessly.
Aida was also shocked when she heard Bruce's words. After all, she came here today to ask about this.
"The Cameron province?"
A strange look flashed across Juan's face.
"Yes, it seems that he stayed in the Misty Sect in Cameron for a period of time. As for where he went after that, I haven't found out yet, so I would like to request for permission to head over there to investigate!"
Bruce said slowly.
"What kind of place is the Misty Sect?"
Juan hurriedly asked.
"The Misty Sect is located in Solsby in the Cameron province. It's an ancient martial arts sect, but it's not a big sect!"
Bruce answered.
"Uncle Janco, you have probably heard about what happened to the four big families. My father won't be around Yarlford for some time, and there are many things waiting for me to deal with at the company, so I might not be able to go with you!"
Juan thought for a moment and said.
"Mr. Gomez Jr., I can go alone. After all, I can't be sure if this news is true. I'm only going there to get more information!"
Bruce seemed to have said this on purpose. After all, Bruce couldn't trust Aida 100% at this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1917: A Reminder
chapters.content:
Chapter 1917: A Reminder
"Alright, Uncle Janco. Thank you for your hard work!
"If you can find any clues, you must contact me immediately!"
Juan said excitedly.
"Don't worry!"
Bruce nodded lightly and didn't say anything else. He then turned around and left.
After Bruce left, Juan turned to look at Aida and said excitedly, "Aida, you really are my savior. Not only did you help me solve the problem of the four big families, but now your luck even brought me news about the grandmaster. If these two things can be resolved, my father will definitely be very happy when he returns!"
"I should congratulate you in advance, then!"
Aida replied with a smile.
"Aida, why don't you stay in Yarlford for the night instead of going back today?"
Juan hesitated for a moment and then whispered to Aida.
"Aren't you worried about your business? I'll contact the person in charge of our company as soon as I get back. That way, the Gomez family's projects can be restored as soon as possible!"
Aida said lightly.
"Then, have you thought about what I told you back then?"
Juan asked Aida sincerely.
"What did you tell me?"
Aida was stunned.
"About the two of us being together!"
Juan hurriedly said.
Aida smiled helplessly when she heard this. She then said softly, "Juan, you know that the current situation is not very stable. Whether it is the Gomez family or the Collier family, we are all facing a very powerful enemy, so for the time being, I have no mood to consider these things!"
"So as long as I get rid of Connor McDonald, you'll be with me?"
Juan asked.
"If you really get rid of Connor McDonald, I might consider that!"
Aida replied.
"Alright, I got it!"
Juan's expression was firm.
Aida didn't say anything more to Juan and walked out of the office.
A few minutes later, Aida left the headquarters of Gomez Corporation and returned to her car.
After getting into the car, Aida took out her phone and found Connor's number. After all, she had already found clues about the grandmaster, so she wanted to inform Connor as soon as possible. Otherwise, if Bruce found the grandmaster in advance, all her previous efforts would be in vain.
But before Aida could find Connor's number, her car door was pulled open from the outside.
Aida instinctively turned around and saw that it was Bruce who had gotten into the car.
"Is there something you need?"
Aida was very unhappy with Bruce's unreasonable behavior, so she frowned and asked.
"Miss Collier, right?"
Bruce asked softly.
"That's right!"
Aida nodded.
"You heard the conversation between me and Mr. Gomez Jr. just now. I don't know who you are. Although he trusts you, I don't. The matter regarding the grandmaster is something that Mr. Gomez places great importance on. I'm here to give you a reminder."
Bruce said calmly.
"Remind me of what?" Aida asked with a frown.
"Now, only you, me, and Mr. Gomez Jr. know about the grandmaster's clues. Mr. Gomez Jr. will definitely not tell anyone about this. Therefore, if this news gets leaked, Miss Collier, you will have to be responsible for it!"
Bruce said slowly.
"Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about this. Moreover, this news is of no value to anyone. After all, only the Gomez family is looking for grandmaster!"
Aida said coldly.
"The enemies of the old man are also looking for the grandmaster!"
Bruce replied indifferently.
"What do you mean by that? Do you think that I'm going to leak this information to Mr. Gomez's enemies? Don't you know that Mr. Gomez's enemy is also the Collier family's enemy?"
Aida shouted angrily.
"I told you, I don't know who you are. I just want to tell you that if anyone else finds out about this, I'll find you immediately!"
After saying that, Bruce pushed open the car door and got out.
When Aida saw Bruce get out of the car, a strange look flashed across her face. She looked thoughtfully at the seat where Bruce had just sat.
Aida was a very smart woman. She knew that Bruce was definitely not here to give her a reminder.
Bruce must have planted a bug in her car.
If Aida were to look for the listening device now, it would only arouse Bruce's suspicion, so she didn't do that. Instead, she called Juan and complained to him.
Juan tried to appease Aida for quite some time before she pretended to calm down.
After Aida hung up the phone, she took out her phone and found Connor's number. She then sent a message to Connor.
On the other side, just as he was at Stormbound Corporation discussing with Queta Juve on how to make good use of the resources of the four families, he received a text message from Aida.
The content of the message was very simple. There was only one location.
Connor knew that Aida must have something important to tell him. Otherwise, she wouldn't have just sent him a location.
Therefore, after receiving the text message, he left the Stormbound Tower and got to the location on the text message.
Aida had invited Connor to a tearoom. The environment in the tearoom was very nice, but there were very few people there.
"Are you here to see Miss Collier?"
The waiter walked up to Connor and asked him softly.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"Please follow me!"
The waiter brought Connor into a private room.
After entering the private room, Connor found Aida inside. At this time, Aida was fiddling with the tea set in her hand.
Aida was very beautiful, and her dress today was very dignified and elegant. She was wearing a white long dress like a fairy, and the environment in the private room gave people a dreamy feeling.
Connor walked to Aida and picked up the teacup to have a sip.
"It's not done yet…"
Aida reminded him helplessly.
"What's so good about this? It's the same in my eyes!"
Connor replied casually, then drank the tea in the teacup.
"..."
Aida sighed softly and didn't say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1918: Misty Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1918: Misty Sect
"You're in such a hurry to see me. Did you encounter some trouble again?"
Connor asked Aida.
"This time, I'm going to provide you with an extremely important piece of news…"
Aida said slowly.
"What news?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Just now, I got some clues about the grandmaster from Juan!"
"Really?"
Connor was a little excited because he had already dealt with the four families. As long as he could find the grandmaster, everything could go according to Connor's plan.
"Yes!"
Aida nodded and continued, "I heard that after the grandmaster left Yarlford, he went to Cameron and stayed with the Misty Sect for a period of time. If you follow this clue, you might be able to find this grandmaster!"
"This information of yours is really important…"
Connor was so excited that he did not know what to say. After all, the grandmaster was the most important part of Connor's plan.
"Back then, you helped me so much. This time, it can be considered as me repaying you. I also hope that you can get rid of Yamino Gomez as soon as possible."
Aida said lightly.
"Don't worry, I've always been a man of my word. Since I've chosen to cooperate with you, I'll definitely do what I promised you!"
Connor said seriously.
"By the way, the Gomez family has already begun to take action, so you must make haste and try to find the grandmaster before the Gomez family!"
Aida paused for a moment before continuing, "Bruce Janco of the Gomez family seems to have some doubts about me. If you meet this person, you must kill him. Otherwise, my identity will be exposed!"
"What realm is Bruce Janco at?"
Connor asked.
"I'm not very sure…"
Aida shook her head.
"Alright. If I meet this person, I will kill him!"
Connor replied indifferently.
After all, Aida's identity could not be exposed yet, so Connor agreed readily.
"One more thing. Because of the four big families, many of the Gomez family's businesses can't continue to operate. I've asked Juan to cooperate with me."
Aida looked at Connor and asked.
"I spent so much effort to deal with the four big families just to cause chaos in the Gomez family. If you help them, all my previous efforts will be in vain…"
Connor frowned and replied.
"But I've already promised Juan. I can't find any reason to go back on my word."
Aida seemed to realize that her decision was a little inappropriate.
At that time, Aida merely wanted to get closer to Juan. She didn't consider Connor's situation.
"You don't need to go back on your word!"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"I don't?"
Aida was a little confused, as if she didn't quite understand what Connor meant.
"You can try your best to help me stall for time. In the early stages, you should try your best to cooperate with Juan and make him trust you 100%. When the critical moment comes, stop all cooperation with the Gomez family."
Connor said with a smile.
"Then, when is the critical moment?"
Aida asked with a frown.
"After I find the grandmaster!"
Connor said lightly.
"But if I do this, I might be exposed!"
Aida seemed to disagree with Connor's approach.
"By that time, Yamino is probably not far from his death. It doesn't matter even if your identity gets exposed. As long as I deal with Yamino, I will deal with those people from the Collier family…"
Connor said.
"Really?"
When Aida heard that Connor was going to deal with the Collier family, she became a little excited.
"Of course!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Alright, then I'll do as you say!"
Aida agreed without any hesitation.
"If that's all, I'll be leaving now!"
Connor whispered to Aida.
"Alright!"
Aida nodded.
Connor didn't waste any time and got up to leave the private room.
After all, finding the grandmaster was very important to Connor. If the Gomez family found him first, all of Connor's plans would be disrupted.
As for the cooperation between Aida and the Gomez family, not only would it not affect Connor, but it would also help Connor buy more time.
Now, Connor didn't know when Yamino would return. Once Yamino returned, then he would definitely solve the problem of the four big families at the first possible moment.
However, if the Gomez family cooperated with Aida, Yamino would not be in a hurry to deal with this matter. This way, Connor could wait for a while more before asking Aida to halt the cooperation with the Gomez family. Then, he would use the grandmaster as a witness to make the higher-ups of Rockefeller lose their trust in Yamino.
Connor called Thomas Morgan and asked him to book a flight ticket to Solsby in Cameron.
However, because Solsby was quite far from Yarlford, there were no more flights on the same day. They could only take the flight the next morning.
Helpless, Connor drove home.
When he got home, Connor told Rachel Wallace about his plan to go to Solsby, but he never expected Rachel to have the intention to go with him.
"I'm not going to Solsby for a vacation. I'm going to find someone. Why are you following me?"
Connor asked Rachel helplessly.
"Do you know anything about the situation in Solsby? If you go alone, can you find the Misty Sect?"
Rachel pouted and replied.
"..."
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and asked, "What do you mean? Are you very familiar with Solsby?"
"Yeah. My mother is from Solsby. My grandparents are both in Solsby, so I want to go with you to see them. After all, I haven't seen them for many years…"
Rachel responded.
"I see!"
Connor nodded thoughtfully. He did not expect Rachel's mother to be from Solsby.

chapters.title: Chapter 1919: Heading to Solsby
chapters.content:
Chapter 1919: Heading to Solsby
"I remember going to Solsby once when I was very young.
"But after that, my mother and father were killed by Rockefeller's people. My grandparents believe that these things had something to do with the Wallace family, so after my mother passed away, they never contacted the Wallace family again. I haven't seen them since either. Since you plan to go to Solsby this time, I can go with you to take a look…"
Rachel softly said to Connor.
"Don't you have to go to class?"
At this time, Connor was still unwilling to bring Rachel to Solsby because he felt that he might encounter some danger in Solsby this time. It was better to go alone.
"I'll just ask for leave from the school…"
Rachel said indifferently.
"Alright, then!"
Connor knew that he could not convince Rachel, so he could only nod helplessly.
Rachel didn't seem to be all that excited after Connor agreed to it. Instead, she turned around and sat on the sofa to watch TV.
Connor then returned to his room.
...
The next day, 7 AM.
Connor and Rachel arrived at Yarlford International Airport and boarded the flight to Solsby, Cameron.
After boarding the plane, Rachel closed her eyes to get some rest.
Connor took advantage of this time to cultivate.
In the blink of an eye, a day had passed. The plane finally arrived at Solsby, Cameron.
After Connor and Rachel got off the plane, Rachel wanted to go to a hotel to rest, but Connor didn't want to waste time and wanted to go directly to the Misty Sect to investigate.
After all, he had already wasted an entire night last night. The Gomez family might have already arrived in Solsby one step ahead of time, so Connor did not want to waste any more time.
Although Rachel was unwilling, she knew that Connor was here for serious matters, so she didn't say anything and followed Connor into the taxi.
"Where are you two going?"
After getting into the car, the taxi driver asked Connor with a smile.
"Master, do you know about the Misty Sect?"
Connor asked softly.
"You want to go to the Misty Sect? The Misty Sect is on the Green Mountain and is quite far from here. Moreover, it's all mountain roads that might not be easy to navigate…"
The taxi driver had a strange look on his face. It seemed that he was unwilling to go.
"As long as you send us to that place, you will be handsomely rewarded!"
Connor replied.
"Hehe, then it's settled!"
The taxi driver smiled and replied after seeing Connor's generosity. Then, he started the car.
Along the way, Connor looked at the scenery outside the car window.
In the beginning, there were still some streetlamps, but after the taxi entered the mountain, there were fewer lamps on the street.
After more than two hours, the taxi driver stopped the car and said to Connor, "Young man, if you follow this road, you will reach the Misty Sect. The people of the Misty Sect don't allow cars from outside to enter…"
"Alright, I got it!"
Connor nodded gently, then pushed open the door and got out of the car.
Rachel hesitated for a moment before following Connor.
"Connor, are you sure the Misty Sect is here? Why do I feel like this is a barren mountain?"
Rachel frowned and said softly.
"Didn't you say that you know the situation in Solsby very well? Don't you know where the most famous Misty Sect is?"
Connor helplessly replied to Rachel.
"I was only five years old when I came to Solsby. After so many years, I have no impression of many things…"
Rachel pouted and said.
"The Misty Sect should be nearby!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"How do you know that?"
Rachel asked in confusion.
"I can sense the auras of many martial artists in front of me…"
Connor explained.
Rachel didn't say anything when she heard Connor's words. She knew that Connor was now an ancient martial arts grandmaster, so there were some things that Connor could feel, but she couldn't.
Connor and Rachel were both martial artists, so this mountain road was not difficult for the two of them at all. Ordinary people needed an hour to travel, but the two of them used less than ten minutes.
A moment later, Connor and Rachel finally arrived at the entrance of the Misty Sect.
It was still a little different from what Connor had imagined the Misty Sect to look like. This was because the Misty Sect that appeared in front of Connor was not an ancient building, but a very luxurious manor.
There were many detached villas in the manor, as well as two high-rise buildings that were more than ten stories high. Almost all of them were modern buildings.
If it wasn't for the words "Misty Sect" written on the gate of the manor, Connor would have thought that he had found the wrong place.
At this moment, the Misty Sect was brightly lit. Connor also found a few cars parked at the entrance of the Misty Sect.
"Looks like we are still a step too late…"
Connor turned to glance at Rachel and softly said to her.
"The Gomez family has already arrived?"
Rachel asked.
"I think so!"
Connor nodded and continued, "But we're not too late. As long as the Gomez family hasn't left the Misty Sect, we can catch them all!"
After saying that, Connor walked into the Misty Sect's manor.
...
At the same time, in the meeting hall of the Misty Sect.
The sect leader and several elders of the Misty Sect were all gathered here. Bruce and another middle-aged man were also in the hall.
The sect leader was an old man in his sixties, and his ancient martial arts realm was only a level three black rank. After all, the sect wasn't a big sect, and it was already very good to have a level three black rank.
As for the other elders, they were all black rank.
Moreover, the number of disciples in the Misty Sect now exceeded a thousand. Just the entrance fee alone for one person was 100,000 dollars per year. Therefore, the Misty Sect had earned a lot of money in the name of accepting disciples over the years. That was why they had built such a magnificent manor. The villas in the manor were all for the elders, and the two tall buildings were for the disciples.
Although the entrance fee of the Misty Sect was very expensive, it could allow ordinary people to become martial artists. Even those with poor aptitude could strengthen their bodies. As long as they became a disciple of the Misty Sect, they could obtain the protection of the Misty Sect.
Therefore, every year, there would be people who would fight to join the Misty Sect.
"Mr. Janco, why have you come to the Misty Sect?"
At this moment, the sect leader of the Misty Sect, Noel Farlow, asked Bruce.

chapters.title: Chapter 1920: Six Elders
chapters.content:
Chapter 1920: Six Elders
"Sect Leader Farlow, I, Bruce Janco, have always been a boorish person. I like to be straightforward when I speak. The main reason I came this time is to ask you about a person…"
Bruce said frankly.
When Noel heard that, a strange look flashed across his face.
Because he could vaguely guess who Bruce wanted to ask about.
"Who does Mr. Janco want to ask about?"
Noel asked in a low voice.
"Twenty years ago, a person came to the Misty Sect from Yarlford. His original name was Taran Saber, but everyone who knew him called him the grandmaster…"
Bruce replied.
Noel smiled faintly when he heard Bruce's words. Then, he slowly said, "Mr. Janco, I think you've come to the wrong place. I don't know the person you're talking about!"
"Sect Leader Farlow sure knows how to joke. Taran Saber and the Misty Sect's fourth elder Kali Waterman are lovers."
As Bruce spoke, he slowly turned to look at a beautiful young woman not far away.
Although the beautiful young woman was already in her forties, her figure and skin were very well maintained. She gave people the feeling that she was only in her thirties. She was also very beautiful.
When the beautiful young woman heard Bruce's words, she looked a little angry. She shouted softly, "Mr. Janco, how would you know if I was that person's lover? You're obviously slandering me!"
"Elder Waterman, you should know very well whether I'm slandering you or not!"
Bruce replied indifferently.
"Mr. Janco, there are some things you shouldn't say!"
At this moment, another elder of the Misty Sect couldn't help but remind him.
"That's right, Mr. Janco, the Misty Sect is only being so polite because of your master. But if you humiliate our sect's elder for no reason, then don't blame us for being rude!"
A brawny man said.
"Alright, stop arguing!"
Noel frowned and barked.
Everyone quieted down after hearing Noel's reprimand.
Noel turned and glanced at Bruce, then said lightly, "Mr. Janco, we really don't know who that person you've mentioned is, and we've never seen him before. If there's nothing else, please leave!"
"Sect Leader Farlow, since I'm here, it means that I have evidence to prove that the person was here!"
Bruce paused for a moment and then continued, "I'll give the Misty Sect two choices now. The first is to tell me where this person is. The Gomez family will give the Misty Sect a large sum of money. This money is enough for the Misty Sect to take in disciples for a hundred years…"
"What about the second option?"
Noel narrowed his eyes and asked.
"The second option is that if you are unwilling to tell me the whereabouts of this person, then I can only choose to use some other methods to make you tell me!"
Bruce said slowly.
"Hahaha…"
Noel couldn't help but laugh when he heard Bruce's words. Then, he narrowed his eyes and said, "Mr. Janco, are you threatening me?"
"That's right, I'm threatening you. You can think about what you should do!"
Bruce didn't waste any time and nodded.
