"Bruce, aren't you being a little too arrogant? If your master said those words today, the Misty Sect might be a little afraid, but what right do you have? You don't think you can deal with all of us, do you?"
The third elder shouted.
"Don't waste your breath on this person. Let's just attack him!"
The hot-tempered Second Elder roared, then stood up and rushed toward Bruce.
Bang!
However, before Second Elder could rush up to Bruce, the middle-aged man who had been sitting quietly beside Bruce stood up and slapped the Second Elder in the chest.
The Second Elder took three to four steps back before he stabilized his body.
At this moment, everyone realized that the middle-aged man beside Bruce was also a black rank, and his realm was quite high.
Bruce looked at the people from the Misty Sect and smiled. Then, he said softly, "I forgot to introduce you to my junior brother Waylon Jowers. He's at the same level as me. We're both advanced black ranks!"
"What?!"
Noel's expression changed when he heard this.
The strongest person in the Misty Sect was Noel. He was an advanced level black rank. If they had the help of the other elders, they would still have the strength to fight Bruce.
But who would have thought that Bruce would have an advanced black rank helping him?
In that case, it would not be easy for the Misty Sect to deal with Bruce.
"It seems like Mr. Janco is already prepared to deal with the Misty Sect?"
Noel said in a low voice.
"Deal with you?"
When Bruce heard that, he couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said lightly, "Sect Leader Farlow, do you think I would sit here and tell you this if I came here today to deal with the Misty Sect? I just hope that we can settle this matter peacefully!"
"I don't know the person you're talking about. The Misty Sect has never seen this person before. What do you want me to say? Do you think we're lying to you?"
Noel gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice.
"It's easy to find out if you really know him!"
Bruce didn't intend to waste any more time talking to Noel. He turned and looked at Waylon, who was beside him.
Waylon did not hesitate at all. He stood up and rushed toward Second Elder who had been forced back by him just now. Then, he punched Second Elder in the chest.
"Pfft!"
Waylon's speed was really fast. Noel did not even have time to react to what was going on. Second Elder died in front of everyone just like that.
"Bruce, how dare you kill an elder of the Misty Sect?"
Noel roared.
"Sect Leader Farlow, I don't like to talk nonsense. I'll give you one minute to think about it. If you still don't tell me where the grandmaster is after one minute, I'll kill the second person!"
Bruce paused for a moment, then glanced at the others in the room and said softly, "The Misty Sect still has six elders left, so you still have six minutes!"
"Bruce, you're going too far!"
Noel finally couldn't take it anymore. He stood up and rushed toward Bruce.

chapters.title: Chapter 1921: Who Did He Offend?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1921: Who Did He Offend?
However, Noel was not Bruce's match at all. In less than two moves, Noel was knocked to the ground.
After all, there was still a huge gap between an advanced black rank and an advanced black rank at his peak.
"Bruce, if you dare to kill the Misty Sect's people today, aren't you afraid of being ridiculed by your peers?"
Noel shouted through gritted teeth.
"Ridiculed?"
When Bruce heard that, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Only the weak would consider these things…"
"Why you…"
Noel looked at Bruce, not knowing what to say.
"Time's up! Kill another one!"
At this moment, Bruce suddenly shouted.
As soon as he finished speaking, another elder of the Misty Sect also died in Waylon's hands.
At this moment, the elders of the Misty Sect were very afraid because Waylon and Bruce's strength was too terrifying. They knew that they were no match for the two of them.
Noel was extremely angry. She shouted loudly, "Kali, how long are you going to stay quiet this for that person? Are you really going to watch the Misty Sect get destroyed?"
When Kali heard that, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she bit her lip and said, "You want to know where Taran Saber is? I'll tell you now, but even if you know where Taran Saber is, you won't be able to find him…"
"Whether I can find him or not is my business. You just need to tell me where Taran Saber is!"
Bruce said lightly.
"Alright…"
Kali took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "You're right. Taran Saber did come to the Misty Sect twenty years ago, but after that…"
Bang!
However, at this moment, the door of the room was suddenly kicked open from the outside.
A loud noise interrupted Kali.
Kali was stunned for a moment and quickly looked at the door.
A young man and a beautiful woman who was sexy to the bone slowly walked into the hall.
Everyone was stunned when they saw the two of them.
"How lively!"
Connor walked into the hall and said to everyone with a smile.
"Who are you? What are you doing here?"
Noel hesitated for a moment before shouting at Connor in a low voice.
"Who am I?"
Connor smiled faintly, then slowly looked up at Bruce and said softly, "You know who I am, right?"
"Are you Connor McDonald?"
Bruce asked with a frown.
"That's right, I'm Connor McDonald!"
Connor nodded.
"Haha…"
Bruce looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he said indifferently, "It seems that my guess was right. That woman, Aida Collier, is indeed in cahoots with you. Are you here to die?"
"I'm here to kill you!"
Connor said softly.
"I've always heard that Mr. McDonald has extraordinary skills. Today, I want to see how capable you are to make Mr. Gomez value you so much!"
Bruce didn't say anything to Connor. He quickly rushed toward Connor.
If it was the previous Connor, he might not be a match for Bruce. However, the current Bruce was like a three-year-old child to Connor.
Bruce was indeed very fast. In the blink of an eye, he had rushed up to Connor.
Bruce raised his fist and smashed it at Connor.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Everyone's eyes widened in disbelief.
Because Bruce's menacing punch was blocked by Connor with one hand.
Connor was holding Bruce's fist with his right hand. His expression was very calm. This might be the true difference in strength.
Rachel Wallace stood behind Connor with a surprised expression on her face. After all, it had been a long time since she had seen Connor fight. The last time she saw Connor fight was at the Wallace family.
Thinking back, Connor was also just an ordinary martial artist. Even Rachel could easily defeat him.
But in less than a year, Connor had such astonishing progress.
"Even if your master were here, he wouldn't be my match!"
Connor looked at Bruce and said calmly.
Bruce seemed to want to pull his fist out from Connor's grip, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not move at all.
Bruce looked at Connor with a very shocked expression on his face because he had never thought that Connor would be so strong.
Crack!
However, at this moment, Connor exerted strength on his right arm and broke Bruce's arm.
"Ah…"
Bruce could not help but scream.
Connor raised his leg and kicked Bruce in the stomach. Bruce was instantly sent flying and slammed into the wall.
"Pfft!"
Bruce spat out a mouthful of blood. His face was twisted in pain.
No one expected Bruce to be so vulnerable in front of Connor. Even Noel was stunned.
In the end, Bruce was in great pain. Although Bruce had heard a lot about Connor and knew how terrifying Connor's strength was, he never expected Connor's strength to be so much higher than his.
When Bruce saw Connor, he thought that he was at most a black rank at such a young age, but now he realized that the rumors about Connor weren't false. Connor's strength was very likely above that of an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
When the people of the Misty Sect saw this scene, they were also very shocked. After all, in their eyes, Bruce's strength was already terrifying enough, but who would have thought that Connor's strength was even more terrifying than Bruce's?
"Who did Taran Saber offend?"
Noel could not help but sigh softly.
At this time, Kali's expression was also very ugly. She secretly regretted taking Taran Saber in back then. If it was not because she took Taran Saber in, then these things would not have happened today.
Although Bruce had taken a punch from Connor, he did not seem to have lost his fighting ability. He struggled for a bit and slowly stood up.
Connor looked at Bruce from head to toe with a strange expression on his face.
This was because Connor did not hold back in that punch just now. It was a full-strength punch.
Bruce was still able to stand up after that, which meant that Bruce was quite strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 1922: Died on the Spot
chapters.content:
Chapter 1922: Died on the Spot
"Connor, I've underestimated you. Your strength is indeed comparable to an ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
Bruce looked at Connor and sighed softly. Then, he took off his clothes.
When Connor saw Bruce take off his clothes, he realized what was going on.
This was because Bruce was actually wearing a set of armor. This armor was similar to the armor Wadi Jimenez wore when Connor faced Wadi. It was most probably a divine artifact.
"Waylon, this kid's strong. If the two of us join forces, we might still have a chance of winning!"
Bruce turned to look at Waylon Jowers and said expressionlessly.
"Understood!"
Waylon nodded slightly when he heard this, and then released the aura in his body.
In the next second, Waylon's body actually began to change. Waylon, who was originally only about 1.75 meters tall, instantly turned into a strong man nearly two meters tall. Moreover, the color of Waylon's skin also changed, emitting a dazzling green light.
Not only Waylon, but Bruce's body had also changed. Bruce's body was completely red, giving people the feeling that he was made out of lava. He was also more than two meters tall.
When the Misty Sect people saw this scene, they seemed to be even more shocked.
This was because they knew in their hearts that Bruce and Waylon had not used their full strength against them at all. The current appearance of the two was most probably their full strength.
Connor narrowed his eyes and sized up the two of them, a strange look on his face.
Connor could feel the changes in their bodies, and their strength seemed to have increased a lot. Originally, they were only black rank at the peak, but now they seemed to have touched the threshold of ancient martial arts grandmasters.
'No wonder the two of them chose to fight me despite knowing that I'm an ancient martial arts grandmaster!'
Connor could not help but sigh softly in his heart.
Rachel seemed to have sensed the danger and asked Connor softly, "Do you need my help?"
"You can't help me much. Just watch the show from the side…"
Connor lightly replied.
When Rachel heard this, she was obviously a little speechless, but she did not say anything.
Because she knew that Connor was right. She, a beginner black rank, really couldn't help much in this kind of battle.
"Attack!"
At this moment, Bruce suddenly shouted and rushed toward Connor.
Bruce and Waylon attacked Connor from two different directions. Moreover, the way these two people fought was different from ordinary martial artists.
Ordinary martial artists used their aura to attack during battle, but Bruce and Waylon chose to fight in close combat because their body refining techniques were very powerful. This also led to their close combat strength being more terrifying than when using their aura.
Connor was fighting one against two, but he was still very calm.
At this moment, Bruce's figure flashed, and he threw a punch at Connor.
Bruce's punch contained a very powerful power of fire. When Connor felt Bruce approaching him, it was as if the surrounding temperature had risen.
"Ice wall!"
Connor growled.
An ice wall appeared in front of Connor.
Bang!
Bruce's fist slammed into the ice wall.
Bruce's expression changed slightly because he did not expect Connor to be so skilled in controlling the power of the five elements.
When Connor broke through to the realm of ancient martial arts grandmaster, even without the help of the Five Elements Dagger, he could still easily use the power of the five elements.
This was also the reason why Connor gave the Five Elements Dagger to Carlos Lane.
In the next second, Waylon's attack followed.
Waylon came behind Connor and raised his leg to kick Connor's back.
However, Connor's reaction speed was very fast. He turned around and grabbed Waylon's ankle.
"..."
Waylon seemed to be a little shocked. He did not expect Connor's reaction to be so fast.
Right at this time, Connor exerted force in his right hand, throwing Waylon to the side.
Waylon's body smashed into Bruce like a cannonball. Both of their bodies smashed into the wall of the conference room at the same time.
However, this was only the beginning.
After Connor sent the two of them flying, he did not give the two of them any chance to react at all. His figure flashed and appeared in front of the two of them.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor raised his leg and stepped on Waylon's head.
What people did not expect was that Connor's foot actually crushing Waylon's head.
Waylon instantly died on the spot.
Even Rachel was so frightened that she took two steps back when she saw this scene. Then, she forcefully calmed herself down.
After all, in Rachel's eyes, Connor's style of doing things was not like this at all. Unless it was the last resort, Connor would not kill.
However, at this moment, Connor seemed to have changed into a different person. Connor did not hesitate at all when he killed Waylon.
Rachel's beautiful eyes widened, as if she couldn't believe that the young man standing in front of her was really the Connor she had met at the Porthampton University.
When the people of the Misty Sect saw this scene, they were terrified. They could feel that this thin and weak young man was even more terrifying than Bruce.
"Waylon!"
Bruce shouted at the top of his lungs, extremely furious.
"I came here today to kill you!"
Connor looked at Bruce and said calmly.
"You... You can't kill me, I'm..."
Bruce opened his mouth to speak.
However, Connor didn't give Bruce a chance to speak at all. He gently tapped with his right hand.
A cold light flashed and pierced through Bruce's head.
Just like that, Bruce didn't even have the chance to say his last words before he died in front of Connor.
When Connor saw that Bruce was dead, he reached out and pulled off Bruce's armor. Then, he threw it to Rachel and said softly, "Put on this armor…"
Although Connor didn't know what Bruce's armor was, he felt that since this armor could help Bruce block his punch, it must be a treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1923: Blood Moon Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1923: Blood Moon Sect
Rachel did not reach out to take the armor. Instead, she said with a disdainful expression, "I don't dare to wear a dead person's things…"
"At a critical moment, this armor can save you…"
Connor reminded helplessly.
Rachel looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds. In the end, she reached out and picked up the armor on the ground.
However, she was not in a hurry to put it on because she knew that all the danger had been removed.
After Connor killed Bruce and Waylon, he sat on the chair. He was very calm, as if everything that had happened had nothing to do with him.
After hesitating for a moment, Rachel walked to Connor's side.
The people from the Misty Sect looked at the corpses on the ground in fear. They knew that Connor would deal with them after dealing with Bruce and Waylon.
"I wonder why... why you have graced the Misty Sect today."
Noel Farlow suppressed the fear in his heart and asked Connor with trepidation.
"I want to find the grandmaster. Tell me where he is now!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Hearing Connor's words, a strange look flashed across Noel's face. Then, he slowly turned to look at Kali.
After all, Connor's strength was much more terrifying than Bruce's. Therefore, they had no intention of resisting Connor at all. They only hoped that they could send Connor, the demon who killed without blinking, away as soon as possible.
Kali took a deep breath and whispered to Connor, "The grandmaster you are looking for is the Taran Saber that those two people were looking for, right?"
"That's right!"
Connor looked at Kali and nodded.
"Back then, Taran came to the Misty Sect to avoid the Gomez family's pursuit and begged me to take him in. I was with Taran for a period of time when I was young. I still had feelings for him, so I couldn't bear to see him die, so I took him in the Misty Sect…"
Kali said slowly.
"And then?"
Connor asked softly.
"Taran was in the Misty Sect for more than a year. However, due to a coincidence, Taran met the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect and was accepted as a disciple by the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect…"
Kali looked at Connor and continued.
"Netherworld Sect?"
Connor couldn't help but frown when he heard this.
"That's right. The Netherworld Sect is a very famous sect in the province of Cameron. This sect's strength is much more terrifying than the Misty Sect, and they have an ancient martial arts grandmaster. Of course, that's not the most terrifying thing about the Netherworld Sect. The most terrifying thing about the Netherworld Sect is that it's a branch of the Blood Moon Sect in Oprana!" Kali looked at Connor and continued.
Connor looked at the expression on Kali's face and seemed to be even more puzzled. This was because he did not expect that his grandmaster's matter would actually involve so many ancient martial arts sects.
Moreover, Connor had never heard of most of these ancient martial arts sects.
Although Connor was already an ancient martial arts grandmaster, he did not know much about the ancient martial arts sects in Oprana. The only ones he could come into contact with were the four major sects like the Heavenly Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect.
"What is this Blood Moon Sect that you're talking about?"
Connor frowned and asked Kali.
When Kali heard Connor's words, she was a little shocked. Then, she said softly, "You don't even know about the Blood Moon Sect?"
"I don't…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
Kali looked at Connor with an incredulous expression, as if she was shocked speechless by him.
"May I know how I should address you?"
When Noel saw that Connor didn't seem to have any ill intentions toward them, his expression softened a little as he asked Connor softly.
"My surname is McDonald!"
Connor said lightly.
"Grandmaster McDonald, the Blood Moon Sect is considered a relatively famous sect in Oprana back then…"
Noel looked at Connor and told him.
"Then, why have I never heard of it?"
Connor asked.
"Back then, the Blood Moon Sect developed very quickly in Oprana. However, their cultivation method was different from ordinary martial artists. They would absorb the energy of other martial artists to increase their realm. This also led to the Blood Moon Sect taking in many disciples in Oprana. However, these disciples would eventually become sacrifices for the Blood Moon Sect Leader to increase his strength…"
Noel said slowly.
"What sorcery is this?"
Rachel was a little shocked when she heard Noel's words.
"That's right. In the beginning, the other ancient martial arts sects in Oprana didn't know about it. Later on, a traitor appeared in the Blood Moon Sect, so the secret of the Blood Moon Sect was revealed to the public…"
Noel sighed softly and continued, "Grandmaster McDonald, have you heard of the four great sects of Oprana?"
"I have…"
Connor was about to nod.
"Connor is the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, one of the four great sects!"
Rachel said before Connor could.
Connor turned back to glance at Rachel and didn't say anything.
When Noel found out about Connor's identity, he was even more shocked. He quickly stood up and shouted, "Grandmaster McDonald! Please forgive my ignorance!"
The other elders of the Misty Sect were also in disbelief because they had never thought that Connor's background would be so terrifying.
"It's alright. You don't have to be so polite with me. Continue talking about the Blood Moon Sect!"
Connor waved his hand at Noel.
Noel took a deep breath, then looked at Connor and continued, "After the four great sects learned that the Blood Moon Sect had brutally killed tens of thousands of disciples almost every year, the four sect leaders joined forces to besiege the Blood Moon Sect and finally eradicated this scourge of Oprana's ancient martial arts…"
"My master was actually involved in this matter?"
Connor was stunned.
"Not your master, but your grand master!"
Noel shook his head.
"I see!"
Connor nodded and did not continue speaking.
"However, the sect leader of the Blood Moon Sect did not die in the hands of the four sects. Instead, he fled overseas to Winam, the country next to Cameron. He even established a new Blood Moon Sect in the country!"
Noel looked at Connor and said slowly.
"I didn't expect the Blood Moon Sect to have such a powerful background…"
Rachel sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1924: Once-in-A-Lifetime Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1924: Once-in-A-Lifetime Opportunity
"The new Blood Moon Sect is in Winam, so the four sects did not continue to eradicate the Blood Moon Sect.
"So many years have passed. It's said that the Blood Moon Sect's sect leader's strength has greatly increased, and he even has the ruler of Winam under his control. Even the members of the royal family will pay tribute to the Blood Moon Sect every year…"
Noel continued.
"Even the royal family is afraid of the Blood Moon Sect. This means that the Blood Moon Sect is indeed capable!"
Connor said lightly.
"After all, the development of ancient martial arts in Winam is far inferior to that in Oprana. There are very few ancient martial arts sects, so the Blood Moon Sect naturally has the status of being the strongest one in Winam!"
Noel paused for a moment, then continued, "Although so many years have passed and the Blood Moon Sect is at its peak in Winam, the Blood Moon Sect's sect leader has always been brooding over the fact that he was chased out of Oprana by the four major sects back then. He has always been looking for an opportunity to return to Oprana. However, the name of the Blood Moon Sect has long been familiar to us Oprana martial artists. He could only let a small number of people come to Oprana first and establish a branch of the Blood Moon Sect. When the opportunity is ripe, he will bring the Blood Moon Sect back to Oprana!"
"The Netherworld Sect you mentioned before is a branch of the Blood Moon Sect, right?"
Connor turned to look at Kali and asked softly.
"That's right!"
Kali hurriedly nodded.
"Since you clearly know that the Netherworld Sect is a branch of the Blood Moon Sect, why didn't you seek help from the four sects?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Well…"
Noel frowned when he heard Connor's words.
"If you have anything to say, just say it…"
Connor felt that Noel was a little hesitant.
"..."
Noel took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, you're from the four great sects. You should know the situation of the four great sects better than I do!"
"What do you mean by that?"
Connor frowned slightly.
"The current four great sects are no longer the four great sects of the past. The Heavenly Sect's Collier family is focused on their own business. The Snow Moon Sect and the Profound Sect have been living in seclusion in the mountains after the old sect leader passed away. As for the Purple Cloud Sect… Sect Leader Yarrell is not even bothered about ancient martial arts, so even if we small sects seek out the four great sects, it might not be effective…"
Noel said expressionlessly.
After hearing Noel's words, a strange look flashed across Connor's face, but he didn't say anything.
"For so many years, the Netherworld Sect has been using their relationship with the Blood Moon Sect to commit crimes in Cameron. Small sects like ours have to pay a large sum of money to the Netherworld Sect almost every year to ensure the safety of our sect…"
At this moment, Kali suddenly said.
"I understand what you mean…"
Connor nodded at Kali.
"Taran Saber threatened me when he left the Misty Sect. No matter who came looking for him, I couldn't tell anyone. Otherwise, he would have the Netherworld Sect wipe out the Misty Sect. The Misty Sect is just a small sect, and we don't have the ability to deal with the Netherworld Sect. Moreover, the Netherworld Sect has a terrifying existence like the Blood Moon Sect behind it…"
Noel quickly added.
"Taran Saber is in the Netherworld Sect now, right?"
Connor had already figured out the ins and outs of all this.
"I'm not sure either…"
Noel shook her head and added, "That's all I know. After all, so many years have passed. I'm not sure if Taran is still in the Netherworld Sect…"
"Then, do you know where the Netherworld Sect is?"
Connor looked at Noel and asked.
"Mr. McDonald, what are your plans?"
Noel had a strange look on his face.
"I'm not very familiar with the situation in Cameron, so I need your people to lead the way for me…"
Connor replied.
When Noel heard that, he looked troubled. After all, he did not dare to provoke the Netherworld Sect and the Blood Moon Sect.
"You don't have to worry. You already know my identity. If you are willing to help me, I will have the Purple Cloud Sect protect the Misty Sect…"
Connor said slowly.
"Grandmaster McDonald, are you serious?"
Noel was a little excited.
After all, it was the dream of countless Oprana sects to be able to have the Purple Cloud Sect behind them. Noel naturally would not give up such a good opportunity.
If the Misty Sect could have a relationship with the Purple Cloud Sect, it would be a great thing for the Misty Sect.
"I don't have to lie to you!"
Connor replied indifferently.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Noel said in a low voice, "Alright, Mr. McDonald, I'll personally take you to the Netherworld Sect tomorrow. However, the Netherworld Sect is still some distance away from the Misty Sect, so you have to be prepared!"
"It's alright!"
Connor said lightly.
"Then, Mr. McDonald, are you planning to stay here today?"
Noel asked.
"I'll stay here today. We'll set off tomorrow morning!"
Connor said after thinking for a moment.
"Alright, I'll get someone to prepare some rooms now!"
Noel hurriedly nodded and then got someone to prepare the rooms.
Noel thought that today would be a great disaster for the Misty Sect. However, he didn't expect to have the chance to get on the Purple Cloud Sect's ship in the end. This was considered a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for the Misty Sect.
Furthermore, Connor was only going to deal with the Netherworld Sect this time, not the Blood Moon Sect.
Noel knew how terrifying Connor's strength was. Although the Netherworld Sect also had an ancient martial arts grandmaster, Connor should have the strength to fight. That was why he agreed so readily.
Soon, the people from the Misty Sect arranged rooms for Connor and Rachel.
Rachel was beautiful and had a great figure. Noel thought that she was Connor's lover, so he specially arranged for the two of them to stay in a villa.
After entering the villa, Rachel went straight to the master bedroom, while Connor went to the second bedroom helplessly.
Perhaps it was because it's been a long day, Rachel was a little tired. She didn't chat with Connor at all. After a quick shower, she went to get some rest.
Connor started cultivating in the guest bedroom.
Although Connor already knew the whereabouts of Taran Saber, he also knew that finding Taran wasn't an easy task. He wasn't willing to waste a minute or a second. Right now, the most important thing for Connor was to increase his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1925: Turning Against Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 1925: Turning Against Them
In the blink of an eye, a night had passed.
Connor went to Rachel's room and woke her up.
Although Rachel was also a martial artist, she was not an ancient martial arts grandmaster after all, so her living habits were similar to that of a normal person.
After a day of torment yesterday, Rachel only rested for less than five hours before she had to set off again. She was not in the best of moods.
However, Rachel was different from ordinary girls. She knew what was important, so she didn't waste much time. She quickly washed up and put on makeup before leaving the villa with Connor.
"I came with you to see my grandfather. I didn't expect to be so busy. I don't even have time to rest, let alone visit my grandfather…"
Rachel pouted and said to Connor softly.
"I told you not to come with me. You insisted on coming…"
Connor replied helplessly.
"If I knew it was so urgent, I wouldn't have come even if you beat me to death!"
Rachel turned her head and glared at Connor.
Connor hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Actually, you don't have to go to the Netherworld Sect with me. Wouldn't you have time to see your grandfather then?"
"Forget it. I don't feel at ease letting you go alone!"
Rachel shook her head.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Rachel's words. He didn't say anything.
"What are you laughing at? Don't think that I can't help you just because you're powerful now. You don't even know when you have been played by someone. If I am by your side, I can at least remind you!"
Rachel understood what Connor was laughing at and shouted at him.
"Alright, alright. I know you're very powerful, okay?"
Connor replied perfunctorily.
Rachel glared fiercely at Connor and didn't continue to speak.
A moment later, Connor and Rachel arrived at the entrance of the Misty Sect.
At this moment, everyone from the Misty Sect was already ready to go. Dozens of cars were parked neatly in front of the door.
When Noel saw Connor come out, she quickly walked up to him and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, you're here?"
"We don't need to bring so many people to the Netherworld Sect, right?"
Connor looked at the people behind Noel. At this moment, not only were all the elders of the Misty Sect here, but there were also dozens of disciples behind them.
Connor felt that it was enough to deal with the Misty Sect alone. Bringing so many people with him would be a burden.
"These people are all elites that I picked out overnight. Their cultivation levels are quite high…"
Noel hurriedly explained.
"But it doesn't seem like these people can help even if they go, right?"
Connor said with a frown.
"Mr. McDonald, you might not know this, but the Netherworld Sect is a few days away from the Misty Sect. Most of it are mountainy roads, so we can only drive there. These people can take turns driving along the way to save us a lot of time. Moreover, the Blood Moon Sect doesn't only have the Netherworld Sect as a branch in Oprana. There are other branches. Once these sects know that the Netherworld Sect is in danger, they will definitely help. Our people can also help you share some of the pressure, Mr. McDonald…"
Noel said very carefully.
Connor looked at Noel indifferently. He knew that Noel had brought so many people over not for Connor, but to protect himself.
Connor felt that it was normal for Noel to be worried, so he didn't say much. He nodded and said, "Alright, then let's set off!"
"Alright…"
Noel smiled happily seeing that Connor had agreed. Then, he gestured for everyone to get into the car.
A few minutes later, the motorcade drove toward the location of the Netherworld Sect.
The biggest feature of Cameron was that there were fewer plains and more mountains. Moreover, the land was vast and sparsely populated. Therefore, nearly 80% of the journey was mountain roads, and it was difficult to find a suitable foothold.
This led Noel to prepare a large amount of materials before setting off. Even if there were no supplies along the way, they would definitely be able to last until the Netherworld Sect.
Moreover, Noel had brought enough people with him this time, so they didn't need to stop at all.
Connor and Rachel were in a separate car. The interior of the car was very luxurious and spacious. There were two beds, a sofa, a TV, and other things. It felt like a mobile room, even more spacious than an ordinary RV.
Moreover, the driver's seat was separated from Connor's carriage. They could only communicate with each other through walkie-talkies. This could also ensure the privacy of Connor and Rachel.
Rachel was very satisfied with the car. After getting in the car, she started to catch up on some sleep.
Connor knew that it would take a few days to reach the Netherworld Sect, so he did not waste any time. He sat on the bed and started cultivating.
On the other side, in the carriage of the elders of the Misty Sect.
"Sect Leader, are we really going to deal with the Netherworld Sect this time?"
The fifth elder hesitated for a moment and asked uneasily.
"It depends on the situation!"
Noel replied expressionlessly.
"Sect Leader, what do you mean by that?"
Kali could not help but be stunned.
"Sigh…"
Noel couldn't help but sigh softly. Then, he said expressionlessly, "The Misty Sect is too weak. Whether it's Connor or the Netherworld Sect, they are existences that we can't afford to provoke. If I didn't agree to Connor's request yesterday, he would definitely force me to bring him to the Netherworld Sect. Therefore, I might as well pretend to agree first. As for the Netherworld Sect, let's observe the situation. It would be best if Connor could really defeat the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect…"
"What if Connor isn't a match for the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect?"
Kali hurriedly asked.
"Then we can only seize the opportunity to change sides. This way, we can give the Netherworld Sect an explanation!"
Noel said in a low voice.
"Things might not be as simple as we think…"
Kali replied helplessly.
Noel was a little helpless when he heard that. He said softly,"Now, we can only take it one step at a time. After all, the Misty Sect is only an ant-like existence in the eyes of these people. I hope that the heavens will bless the Misty Sect and allow us to escape this calamity…"
After hearing Noel's words, everyone's expressions turned ugly. They didn't know what to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 1926: Netherworld Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1926: Netherworld Sect
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
In these three days, Connor had been sitting in the car cultivating. He hadn't even eaten.
Other than sleep, Rachel would watch TV.
Fortunately, there was a TV in the RV. Otherwise, Rachel would not know how to pass the boring three days.
"Mr. McDonald…"
At this moment, the walkie-talkie in the RV suddenly sounded.
Connor slowly opened his eyes, then picked up the walkie-talkie and asked, "What's wrong?"
"Mr. McDonald, we've arrived at the Netherworld Mountain where the Netherworld Sect is located. However, the road ahead is very narrow. I'm afraid cars can't pass through. We will have to walk from now on…"
Noel said slowly.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor replied, then put down the walkie-talkie and said to Rachel, "The cars can't get through the road ahead, so we have to walk!"
"Okay!"
Rachel nodded. She pushed open the door and followed Connor out of the car.
After getting out of the car, Rachel gently stretched her back, and her twin peaks outlined a very charming arc.
"I'm so tired after having sit in the car for 3 days. I can finally exercise!"
Rachel turned and said to Connor.
"You watch TV every day. What's there to be tired of…"
Connor replied speechlessly.
"Is watching TV in the car the same as watching TV on the sofa?"
Rachel pouted and exclaimed.
Connor ignored Rachel and walked to Noel.
"Mr. McDonald…"
Noel greeted Connor respectfully. He then pointed at the mountain road ahead and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, as long as we cross this mountain road, we can reach the Netherworld Sect!"
"How long will it take?"
Connor looked at the mountain road in front of him and asked.
"I'm not too sure about that. I've never been to the Netherworld Sect!"
Noel replied.
"Then, let's go!"
Connor didn't waste any more time and started walking.
The people from the Misty Sect hurriedly followed Connor.
The location of the Netherworld Sect was indeed very remote, and the terrain was very dangerous. At this moment, the mountain road that Connor and the others were taking was very narrow, as if it could only allow three people to walk side by side at one time.
Moreover, there was a bottomless abyss on the left side of the mountain road, and there were no guardrails, so one might fall off the cliff if they were not careful.
It might be because of the relationship between the Netherworld Sect and the Blood Moon Sect that they chose such a dangerous place as their base.
As Connor and the others were all martial artists, they were walking rather fast. It only took them less than half a day to complete the mountain path.
After the group finished walking the mountain path, they saw a large expanse of flat land.
At the far end of the flat ground was a building that looked like an ancient city. There were tall walls around the city. The height of the walls was probably about five to six meters, and the words 'Netherworld Sect' were written on the top of the walls. The walls were very high, so Connor and the others could not see what was behind the walls.
Connor used the Chi Observation Technique and sensed that there were at least a hundred martial artists behind the walls, and there were also many black rank martial artists.
"Mr. McDonald, this should be the Netherworld Sect…"
Noel said to Connor nervously.
After all, Noel knew Connor's character very well. He knew that a war could break out at any moment.
"Let's go in and take a look…"
Connor replied to Noel indifferently, then walked toward the city gate of the Netherworld Sect.
A moment later, everyone arrived in front of the Netherworld Sect.
The Netherworld Sect disciples standing guard on the city wall seemed to have noticed Connor and the others. They shouted, "Who are you? What are you doing here?"
Connor looked at the people on the city wall and said expressionlessly, "I'm here to see the Netherworld Sect's sect leader. Open the gates!"
"Who are you?"
The disciple repeated.
At this moment, Connor could not be bothered to talk nonsense with the disciple of the Netherworld Sect. He took a step forward and raised his hand to punch the gates.
Boom!
There was a loud bang, and the entire Netherworld Sect base slightly quaked along with it.
In the next second, the sect gate collapsed.
It felt as if the sect gates had been blown up by explosives.
When the disciples who were standing on the city wall saw this scene, they were shocked.
The Netherworld Sect gates were nearly five meters tall and weighed a thousand pounds.
If it wasn't for the mechanism, it would be very difficult for ordinary martial artists to move the sect gate even a little. However, at this moment, Connor had actually smashed the sect gates with a punch. They were in utter disbelief.
After Connor blasted open the sect gates, he then walked into the Netherworld Sect grounds.
When the people from the Misty Sect saw this scene, they were hesitant. They didn't know what to do.
"Follow me in!"
Noel gritted her teeth and followed Connor.
The people from the Misty Sect also hurriedly followed him into the Netherworld Sect.
When the disciples of the Netherworld Sect learned that someone had broken into the Netherworld Sect, they rushed toward the city gates as if a battle was about to break out.
Connor was very calm, as if he did not put these disciples of the Netherworld Sect in his eyes at all.
Over the years, the Netherworld Sect had nurtured many sacrifices for the Blood Moon Sect. This resulted in and extremely terrifying number of Netherworld Sect disciples. Currently, there were more than 1,000 disciples who had broken through to level five and above.
For so many years, there had never been a situation where someone had trespassed into the Netherworld Sect grounds.
Therefore, the disciples of the Netherworld Sect rushed toward Connor crazily.
In just a moment, Connor was surrounded by hundreds of disciples.
"Can you deal with so many people alone?"
Rachel seemed to be a little worried about Connor and could not help but ask him softly.
"Stay behind me and protect yourself!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Don't forget. You can't count on those people from the Misty Sect. If you feel that it's getting tough, escape!"
Rachel continued.
"I've never counted on those people!"
Connor responded.
Rachel looked at Connor and didn't say anything.
"Who are you? Why did you barge into the Netherworld Sect grounds!"
A black rank middle aged man stepped forward and shouted at Connor.
"Tell your sect leader to come out and see me!"
Connor shouted expressionlessly.
"What arrogant words. You actually dare to humiliate the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect? Looks like you don't want to live anymore…"
The middle-aged man was a little angry. Then, he shouted at the people behind him, "Kill this person!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1927: The Walking Dead
chapters.content:
Chapter 1927: The Walking Dead
Thump thump thump…
When everyone heard the middle-aged man's words, they then rushed toward Connor.
Almost instantly, Connor fell under everyone's siege.
Noel saw so many people attacking Connor at the same time. He looked a little worried and didn't know what to do.
However, in the next second, Connor released the aura in his body.
An extremely powerful force rippled through the entire Netherworld Sect.
The disciples who were charging at Connor seemed to be swept away by his aura for a moment, and then they flew backward.
"What…"
When the middle-aged man saw this scene, he was instantly dumbfounded because he did not expect Connor to be so terrifyingly strong at such a young age.
Noel and the people from the Misty Sect were also dumbfounded. Although they had seen Connor fight a few days ago, they did not know his true strength.
Only now did they know how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"Assist Mr. McDonald with all your might!"
Noel seemed to have seen hope in Connor, so he completely gave up on the idea of changing sides. He turned and shouted at the people from the Misty Sect.
"Yes, sir!"
Everyone then rushed toward the disciples of the Netherworld Sect.
Connor and Rachel then continued walking forward.
On the other side, in the main hall of the Netherworld Sect.
Thaddeus Tidwell, the Netherworld Sect's sect leader, was discussing with the elders about the offerings that they needed to give to the Blood Moon Sect this year.
"Cult Leader is only one step away from breaking through to become a three-star ancient martial arts grandmaster. Therefore, the number of offerings required this year is very large. We have to gather the offerings before the sacrificial ceremony begins!"
Thaddeus said expressionlessly.
"Sect Leader, how many disciples do you need this year?"
A white-haired old man frowned and asked.
"Five thousand!"
Thaddeus said lightly.
When the elders heard this number, they were all stunned. They were in disbelief. After all, the number of sacrifices in previous years was only 1,000.
"Sect Leader, there are less than ten days left until the sacrificial ceremony. There are less than two thousand level five and above martial artists in our sect. Where are we going to find so many martial artists in such a short period of time?"
The white-haired old man said excitedly.
"The number of martial artists in our sect is naturally insufficient. We have to focus our attention on the other sects in Cameron!"
Thaddeus said coldly.
"Sect Leader, we can get those sects to give us money, but if we want their people, I'm afraid it won't be that easy!"
At this moment, a middle-aged man spoke.
"It's not up to them to decide whether to give them to us or not. Cult Leader is about to break through to become a three-star ancient martial arts grandmaster. As long as Cult Leader can successfully break through this time, it won't be long before the Blood Moon Sect returns to Oprana. At that time, the Netherworld Sect will be the greatest contributor. Cult Leader will definitely not treat us unfairly…"
Thaddeus said slowly.
"..."
When everyone heard that, they became a little excited.
After all, they were able to reach their current state because of the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader's reward. That was why they were so loyal to the Cult Leader.
"No matter what, we have to gather the offerings before the sacrificial ceremony begins. At that time, I will ask the Cult Leader to reward you for your merit!"
Thaddeus looked at everyone and continued.
"Understood!"
The elders hurriedly nodded.
"Sect Leader, something bad is happening…"
However, at this moment, a young man rushed into the hall in a panic.
Thaddeus couldn't help but turn to look at the young man after hearing this. He frowned and asked, "What's the matter?"
"Some... someone broke into the Netherworld Sect grounds and injured our disciples!"
The young man stuttered.
"What?!"
Thaddeus's eyes widened when he heard this.
After all, the disciples of the Netherworld Sect were the offerings he wanted to give to the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader. There was already an insufficient number of disciples for the offering. That was why Thaddeus was so angry.
"How many people are injured?"
The white-haired elder asked.
"About a hundred people… There might be more now!"
The young man said carefully.
"Who dares to injure the disciples of the Netherworld Sect at such a crucial point? I want to see this bastard for myself!"
Thaddeus shouted and immediately stood up and walked out of the hall.
Meanwhile, in the Netherworld Sect.
Connor was like a ghost. No matter where he went, there were casualties. The disciples of the Netherworld Sect seemed to be under a curse. Even though they knew that they were not Connor's match, they still rushed toward him crazily.
The people from the Misty Sect followed behind Connor. At this moment, they realized that even without their help, Connor could easily deal with the disciples of the Netherworld Sect.
Noel was secretly glad that he had made the right decision.
At this moment, the Netherworld Sect was filled with wails. Countless disciples were lying hurt on the ground.
"Charge!"
However, even so, the disciples of the Netherworld Sect did not choose to escape. Instead, they charged at Connor one after another.
When Connor saw another large group of disciples rushing up, he was somewhat helpless. He then waved his right hand gently.
Countless fireballs flew across the sky and smashed toward the disciples of the Netherworld Sect.
At this moment, it was as if countless disciples of the Netherworld Sect had fallen to the ground.
When Rachel saw this scene, she couldn't help but whispered to Connor, "Aren't these people afraid of death?"
"It's not that they're not afraid of death, but their minds have been controlled by the Netherworld Sect!"
Connor replied indifferently.
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she seemed to be even more puzzled. She frowned and said, "What do you mean by being controlled?"
"I'm not sure either…"
Connor shook his head and continued, "Although I don't know what method the people of the Netherworld Sect are using, I can feel that these people don't have their own souls. They're just walking corpses…"
"Could it be related to the Blood Moon Sect's sacrifice?"
Rachel hesitated for a moment before asking.
"Yes, it's related to the Blood Moon Sect!"
At this moment, Noel nodded gently and continued, "I've heard that the Blood Moon Sect has some method to control people's hearts. This is the only way to make those disciples willingly become sacrifices…"
"Why is this Blood Moon Sect so detestable!"
Rachel seemed somewhat angry.

chapters.title: Chapter 1928: To Find Someone
chapters.content:
Chapter 1928: To Find Someone
After all, these people were all living people.
However, they were like ants to the Blood Moon Sect.
While Connor was talking to Rachel, another large group of disciples rushed toward him.
Connor waved his right hand, and another powerful energy attack flew toward those disciples.
Countless disciples of the Netherworld Sect were sent flying and smashed onto the ground.
"I'm now trying my best to control my strength. I'm trying to keep these people alive!"
After Connor sent those disciples in front of him flying, he softly said to Rachel.
Rachel took a deep breath, and her face was still filled with anger.
However, at this moment, Thaddeus walked out of the hall with the elders of the Netherworld Sect.
When Thaddeus saw the scene in front of him, he was stunned and shouted with a trembling voice, "Who is it? How dare you injure so many disciples of the Netherworld Sect!"
"Sect Leader, you should stop the array. These disciples are being affected by the array, which is why they are charging forward without caring about their lives. The other party is clearly extremely strong. If this continues, our losses might be even greater…"
The white-haired elder hurriedly shouted at Thaddeus.
"Yes, it must be because of the array!"
Thaddeus nodded and then waved his right hand.
A black gem slowly flew into Thaddeus's hand.
When Thaddeus grabbed the black gem, the disciples of the Netherworld Sect stopped their action of throwing their lives away recklessly. They seemed to have regained their senses and looked at Connor with fear.
Connor could also feel that these disciples had already recovered their rationality, so he did not continue to attack these people.
"Why did they suddenly stop?"
Rachel asked Connor with a frown.
"I'm not sure, but it must have something to do with the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect!"
Connor replied indifferently.
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to find out what happened to the disciples of the Netherworld Sect. He continued to walk toward the main hall of the Netherworld Sect.
Thaddeus was filled with anger. After all, he was still worried about the offerings. Now that Connor had injured so many disciples, it was simply adding insult to injury.
A moment later, Thaddeus finally brought the three elders of the Netherworld Sect to Connor.
When Thaddeus saw Noel, he was a little angry. He then shouted, "Noel Farlow, what the hell are you doing? How dare you bring people to injure so many disciples of the Netherworld Sect? I'll make you pay with blood today!"
"Sect Leader Tidwell, the person who injured the Netherworld Sect's disciples is not me, but Mr. McDonald!"
Noel did not dare to offend Thaddeus, so he hurriedly explained.
"Mr. McDonald?"
Thaddeus couldn't help but be stunned for a moment after hearing this. He then frowned and asked, "Who is this Mr. McDonald you're talking about?"
"That's me!"
Connor took a step forward and asked Thaddeus, "You're the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect, right?"
"That's right, I'm the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect!"
Thaddeus nodded and said in a cold voice, "Did you injure all the disciples of the Netherworld Sect?"
Obviously, Thaddeus saw that Connor was young, so he believed that Connor did not have the strength to fight against a hundred alone.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
After a moment of hesitation, Noel stepped forward and said with a smile, "Sect Leader Tidwell, let me make the introductions. Mr. McDonald is the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, Master Yarrell's personal disciple!"
"Purple Cloud Sect?"
Thaddeus couldn't help but take a deep breath after hearing this. He then sized up Connor and said in a low voice, "So what if this person is from the Purple Cloud Sect?
"The Netherworld Sect has no grudges with the Purple Cloud Sect. Moreover, I have never met this Mr. McDonald before. I don't know why you trespassed into the Netherworld Sect grounds."
Thaddeus restrained himself after knowing Connor's identity, suppressing the anger in his heart.
"I didn't plan to attack the disciples of the Netherworld Sect, but they insisted on rushing forward to attack me. I had no choice!"
Connor lightly explained, then continued, "I'm not in the mood to talk nonsense with you now. I came to the Netherworld Sect to find someone…"
"Who?"
Thaddeus frowned and asked.
"Taran Saber!"
Hearing this name, a strange look flashed across Thaddeus's face, but he quickly shook his head and said, "I'm sorry, I don't know the person you're talking about!"
"Sect Leader Tidwell, what are you saying? Back then, Taran Saber left the Misty Sect with you!"
Noel hurriedly shouted.
Thaddeus hesitated for a moment before he said in a low voice, "That was many years ago. I don't remember this person anymore. You broke into the Netherworld Sect and injured so many people. Today, you have to give an explanation to the Netherworld Sect even though you're from the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Connor knew that Thaddeus was intentionally hiding something and thus changed the topic.
"What kind of compensation do you want?"
Connor looked at Thaddeus and asked.
"Gather 5,000 yellow rank and above martial artists in three days, or you won't be able to leave our sect!"
Thaddeus said confidently.
"Gather 5,000 martial artists in three days?"
When Connor heard Thaddeus's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Sect Leader Tidwell, you don't even know what kind of situation you're in right now, do you?"
"Mr. McDonald, even if your master was here today, he wouldn't be able to leave the Netherworld Sect. I only offered this condition because of your master. I advise you take this offer while it's available!"
Thaddeus said coldly.
"Then, let me tell you this. If you tell me where Taran Saber is now, I might spare your life. Otherwise, I'll find Taran Saber even if I have to wipe out the Netherworld Sect today!"
Connor responded.
"If you want to wipe out the Netherworld Sect, you need the ability to do so!"
However, at this moment, a middle-aged man roared and said to Thaddeus, "Sect Leader, don't waste your breath on this person. Just attack him. This kind of person doesn't know the immensity of heaven and earth!"
"Keep him alive. There is something about him. If he's given to the cult leader as a sacrifice, he is probably worth 3,000 martial artists!"
Thaddeus said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1929: Severus Woodward
chapters.content:
Chapter 1929: Severus Woodward
"Understood!"
The middle-aged man smiled and walked toward Connor.
"Mr. McDonald, this person is the third elder of the Netherworld Sect, Severus Woodward. He is an ancient martial arts grandmaster. You must be careful!"
Noel quickly reminded Connor.
"They're just ants. There's nothing to be afraid of!"
Connor replied confidently.
Noel didn't say anything else after seeing how confident Connor was.
Severus rushed up to Connor in an instant. Then, he waved the long sword in his hand and a bolt of heavenly lightning struck Connor.
Back when Connor was at the Crimson Peak, he had seen someone use the power of lightning.
At that time, Connor's opponent was weaker, so the power of lightning was incomparable to Severus's.
The longsword in Severus's hand was most probably a divine weapon.
A bolt of heavenly lightning shot toward Connor. It was as if the sky had brightened up a little at this moment.
Rachel was a little shocked when she saw this scene because she had never seen such a shocking power of lightning before.
Connor, on the other hand, had a calm expression on his face. He gently waved his right hand, and a golden light flew out, forming a golden protective barrier around Connor and the others.
When the heavenly lightning collided with the protective shield, Connor's light shield trembled slightly, but the people inside the light shield were not hurt.
When Severus saw this scene, he was somewhat shocked. He realized that he might have underestimated Connor. He did not expect Connor to be able to disperse his lightning attack so easily.
"Third Elder, this kid seems strong. Since he dared to barge into the Netherworld Sect base, it means that he must have made the necessary preparations."
Thaddeus also faintly felt that something was not right, so he frowned and reminded Severus.
"I understand, Sect Leader!"
Severus replied in a low voice.
Connor looked at Thaddeus and said expressionlessly, "Today, even if all of you from the Netherworld Sect attack together, you won't be my match. If you give up resisting now, you might still be able to live. Otherwise, don't blame me for mercilessly wiping out the Netherworld Sect!"
"Brat, you really are arrogant. Don't think that I can't do anything to you just because you blocked one of my lightning bolts just now!"
Hearing Connor's words, Severus couldn't help but let out a furious roar, then once again brandished the sword in his hand.
Rumble!
Then, another bolt of lightning struck Connor.
But this time, Severus had clearly used his full strength. Moreover, the speed and scale of this lightning bolt far exceeded that of the previous lightning bolt. Moreover, this lightning bolt was not white, but black!
This attack was extremely shocking in terms of both momentum and speed.
It was as if the entire Netherworld Sect had fallen into a violent tremor.
When Thaddeus saw this bolt of heavenly lightning, he could not help but laugh coldly and said indifferently, "Looks like the third elder's realm has advanced a little. It probably won't be long before I am no match for the third elder…"
"The Lightning Guiding Sword that Cult Leader gave to Third Elder back then is indeed a treasure. If it wasn't for this Lightning Guiding Sword, Third Elder wouldn't have such terrifying combat strength!"
The white-haired old man said with some envy.
At this moment, Connor was already a dead man in the eyes of the people from the Netherworld Sect.
Facing such an enemy like Connor, Thaddeus did not deem him worthy of personally making a move.
"How arrogant!"
When Connor saw the black lightning bolt, he appeared to be somewhat disdainful.
In the next second, Connor waved his right hand, and a golden light flew toward the location of the lightning bolt.
Rachel was somewhat shocked after seeing this scene. At this moment, Rachel realized how terrifying Connor's combat strength was.
Connor's golden light collided with Severus's lightning bolt, instantly erupting with an extremely terrifying sound. This feeling was like countless bolts of lightning striking down at the same time, and even the sky had a visible crack from the powerful impact of the two.
"Is... Is this is a fight between immortals?"
Noel couldn't help but stutter and sigh after seeing this scene.
As Thaddeus looked at the crack in the sky, his expression changed because he could feel that Connor was likely an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
But what Thaddeus couldn't understand was how Connor could break through to the ancient martial arts grandmaster level at such a young age.
At this moment, Connor waved his right hand, and another golden light flew toward Severus.
Severus was somewhat nervous as he hurriedly waved the Lightning Guiding Sword in his hand.
A black bolt of lightning struck the golden light. Initially, everyone thought that Severus's lightning would be able to block Connor's bolt of light.
However, who would have thought that Connor's light would actually pierce through the lightning bolt and fly toward Severus.
At this moment, everyone was dumbfounded.
After all, they knew very well how terrifying Severus's lightning bolt was.
But even so, he still could not block Connor's attack.
Severus also realized that something was wrong with the situation, and he hurriedly placed the Lightning Guiding Sword in front of him.
Clang!
A crisp sound rang out.
The golden light collided with the Lightning Guiding Sword. Severus was forced to take a few steps back before he managed to stabilize his body.
No one had expected Severus to block Connor's attack in such a pathetic manner.
Although the battle between Connor and Severus had happened in an instant, everyone could feel that even with the help of the Lightning Guiding Sword, Severus was still not Connor's match.
"Who is this Connor McDonald? If he is at this realm at such a young age, he's really way too terrifying…"
The white-haired old man beside Thaddeus couldn't help but sigh.
At this moment, Thaddeus's expression was also very solemn. He knew that the Netherworld Sect had probably encountered a difficult opponent this time.
Just as everyone was still shocked by Connor's terrifying strength, his figure flashed and charged toward Severus.
Severus was filled with fear. After all, he had already used up most of his aura to block Connor's light. If Connor were to attack him now, Severus might not be able to withstand it.
"Third Elder is in danger!"
The white-haired old man hurriedly shouted.
"I'll help him!"
At this moment, another elder of the Netherworld Sect stood in front of Severus.

chapters.title: Chapter 1930: Taking Action Personally
chapters.content:
Chapter 1930: Taking Action Personally
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's punch did not hit Severus, but instead landed on another elder.
After the elder took a few steps back, he managed to stabilize himself.
He lowered his head to look at his chest, and he was in disbelief.
Connor's punch just now had actually smashed a fist-sized deep hole in his chest.
"Mr. McDonald's strength is too terrifying. He can actually hurt the fourth elder of the Netherworld Sect!"
When Noel saw this scene, he was a little shocked as he shouted excitedly.
"Is there anything special about this person?"
Rachel asked with a puzzled tone.
"Miss Wallace, you might not know this, but this person is the fourth elder of the Netherworld Sect, Giuseppe Shaffer. It is said that Giuseppe has a divine weapon, and this divine weapon is the Eight Trigrams Tattoo on his body!"
Noel quickly said.
"Tattoo?"
Rachel could not help but frown slightly when she heard this.
"That's right, a tattoo!"
Noel nodded and continued, "The tattoo on Giuseppe's body is not an ordinary tattoo. It is drawn with the blood essence of an ancient divine beast, which can make his body extremely strong. Just now, Mr. McDonald's punch smashed a deep hole in his body, which is enough to prove how amazing Mr. McDonald's punch is!"
On the other side, Giuseppe looked at the fist mark on his chest with a shocked expression. He said in a low voice, "This person can actually leave a fist mark on my body. How terrifying is his strength?"
Giuseppe had never encountered such a situation since the day he stepped into the ancient martial arts world.
"Now is not the time for you to be shocked!"
However, at this moment, the white-haired old man beside Thaddeus let out a low growl. Then, he waved his right hand gently and a brocade box flew out.
In the next second, the brocade box burst out with an extremely dazzling light.
Rachel and the others closed their eyes. Connor looked at the brocade box expressionlessly.
Immediately after, countless silver needles flew out of the brocade box and headed straight for Connor.
When Connor saw these silver needles flying over, he hurriedly released another light barrier.
The light barrier enveloped Rachel, Noel, and the others.
Although the number of silver needles was shocking and their power was terrifying, they were still unable to break through Connor's light barrier.
"Sect Leader, this kid is really strong. You have to personally kill him!"
When the white-haired old man saw that his attack did not injure Connor, he shouted at Thaddeus.
Thaddeus took a deep breath and waved his right hand. A long black blade appeared in his hand.
This long sword was almost two meters long. The black blade was engraved with patterns that Connor had never seen before. From time to time, it would emit a terrifying light.
"Let me end you today!"
Thaddeus finally couldn't take it anymore. He held his long blade and slashed at Connor.
For a moment, an extremely terrifying black sword Chi was headed toward Connor.
Thaddeus was a genuine two-star ancient martial arts grandmaster, so his combat power was naturally not something that the other elders of the Netherworld Sect could compare with. Just from Thaddeus's sword Chi alone, one could feel how terrifying his strength was.
This sword Chi seemed to be able to devour everything in the world, leaving behind a terrifying ravine wherever it passed. Moreover, Connor could feel the terrifying aura contained in the sword Chi.
Rachel, Noel, and the others could no longer withstand the terrifying aura even before the sword Chi flew over. If it wasn't for Connor standing in front of them and helping them block a portion of the aura, Rachel and the others would have fallen under that terrifying aura.
"Today, I want to see how you're going to block my sword!"
Thaddeus shouted at Connor with disdain in his eyes.
"You want to kill me with just this sword move? Aren't you a little too naive?"
Connor replied coldly.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Return of the Myriad Chi!"
Connor growled.
In the next second, everyone could clearly feel that Connor's fist was like a black hole, crazily devouring all the aura around him.
In just a moment, the power contained in Connor's punch seemed to be even more astonishing than Thaddeus's sword Chi.
"What fist technique is this?"
When Thaddeus saw this scene, a trace of shock flashed across his face.
This was because he had never seen an opponent who could unleash such a stunning punch.
Boom!
Connor's fist finally collided with Thaddeus's sword Chi.
When the two collided, the powerful aura that erupted rippled through the Netherworld Sect. The people behind Connor were protected from the energy impact, but the disciples of the Netherworld Sect were not so lucky.
The few elders of the Netherworld Sect were trying their best to resist the attack of the aura. They had no way to care about others.
Thaddeus also felt as if his chest had been heavily punched by someone. He retreated continuously, and the black long blade in his hand trembled continuously as if it had received a violent impact, emitting waves of sorrowful cries.
However, Thaddeus's black sword Chi had actually been shattered by Connor's punch!
The sword Chi instantly exploded and dissipated between heaven and earth.
Connor did not seem to be affected by the sword Chi at all. He stood on the spot expressionlessly.
The moment the sword Chi was shattered, Thaddeus took a few steps back and finally steadied his body.
At this moment, Thaddeus felt that his body had suffered heavy injuries, and his chest was aching faintly.
"How... How was this possible? How could he be so terrifyingly strong?"
Thaddeus looked at Connor in disbelief.
Because in this exchange just now, Connor clearly had the upper hand.
Thaddeus was a genuine two-star ancient martial arts grandmaster. However, he seemed to be weaker than Connor. This was enough to prove that Connor's strength was above his.
Initially, Thaddeus thought that in the entire Oprana, only the people from the four major sects were stronger than him. However, he never expected that a random young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect could defeat him!
"This is impossible. You must have used some divine artifact to make yourself so strong!"
Thaddeus shouted.
"Sect Leader, there is something abnormal about this person's abilities. Let's kill him together!"
However, at this moment, Severus shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1931: Courting Death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1931: Courting Death!
"Alright! Everyone, attack together!"
Thaddeus gritted his teeth and fiercely exclaimed.
After all, killing Connor was the most important thing right now. He was not in the mood to consider the problem of losing face.
When Noel saw that Thaddeus was planning to attack together, a trace of nervousness flashed across his face. After all, these people from the Netherworld Sect were all genuine ancient martial arts grandmasters. If they attacked together, Connor would probably be in trouble!
Severus lightly waved the Lightning Guiding Sword in his hand, and three bolts of lightning flew toward Connor almost at the same time.
Connor also released three golden lights.
The lightning bolts and the golden lights collided fiercely, but the lightning bolts were still unable to block Connor's light.
Severus hurriedly raised the Lightning Guiding Sword in his hand again, as if he was planning to block Connor's light.
However, at this moment, the white-haired old man also seized the opportunity to attack Connor. Countless silver needles flew straight toward Connor's back.
Connor hurriedly released a light barrier.
"Go to hell!"
Giuseppe roared angrily, then raised his fist and smashed it toward Connor like a mountain.
At this time, Connor needed to face the attacks of the three people.
However, Connor was very calm.
The light first struck Severus's Lightning Guiding Sword. This time, Severus was unable to withstand the powerful attack of the light. His body was forced back dozens of steps before he finally stabilized himself. Then, he spat out a mouthful of blood.
The silver needles of the white-haired old man changed directions just as they were about to pierce through Connor's body, and then flew straight toward the white-haired old man.
The white-haired old man was shocked when he saw this scene. He hurriedly dodged the silver needles, but unfortunately, his speed was still a little slower than the silver needles. Therefore, although he dodged most of the silver needles, a small portion of the silver needles still pierced his body.
The white-haired old man was in pain. In all these years, countless martial artists had died under his silver needles. This was the first time he had tasted the feeling of being pierced by a silver needle.
However, Giuseppe's fist was the last to hit him.
Connor directly raised his hands to block in front of him.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Giuseppe's fist landed on Connor's palm.
However, Connor stood where he was without moving, while Giuseppe's face flashed with a trace of pain.
He felt as if he had smashed into a rock with that punch. Not only did it not shatter the rock, but the pain rebounded back on his arm.
Thaddeus was shocked when he saw this scene. He did not expect Connor to be able to handle the simultaneous attacks of the three elders of the Netherworld Sect.
"We have to get rid of this person today. Otherwise, the Netherworld Sect will really be wiped out by him!"
Thaddeus roared and then waved the black long blade in his hand again.
Another black sword Chi flew straight toward Connor.
But this time, the speed of the sword Chi was still very fast. Moreover, Connor had used most of his energy to deal with the other three people, so he didn't pay attention to Thaddeus at all.
More importantly, Giuseppe was standing in front of Connor, blocking most of his vision.
"Giuseppe, get out of the way!"
Thaddeus shouted.
When Giuseppe heard this, his figure flashed and disappeared in front of Connor.
By the time Connor reacted, the sword Chi had already rushed up to Connor.
At this moment, it was already too late for Connor to react, so he could only instinctively raise his arm to block his chest.
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
The incomparably powerful sword Chi directly collided with Connor's body.
When Rachel saw this scene, she was stunned. She was scared because she could clearly feel how amazing the power of this sword Chi was.
With Connor as the center, an extremely powerful energy shockwave swept in all directions.
In an instant, the entire Netherworld Sect fell into a violent tremor. Countless flying sand formed a huge ball, making it impossible for people to see what was going on with Connor.
"Miss Wallace, take cover!"
Noel was worried that the huge ball might explode at any time, so he quickly reached out and pulled Rachel.
When Thaddeus saw this scene, he was somewhat shocked.
He knew very well that if Connor had used all his strength to block his sword Chi just now, the worst outcome would be that Connor was seriously injured.
But what he did not expect Connor to use the dumbest method in the world.
When the sword Chi came into contact with Connor's body, a powerful energy impact swept in all directions. Rachel, who was standing beside Connor, was also in danger. Therefore, Connor used his own Chi to form a protective shield around his body, which was the ball that everyone was seeing now.
In this case, the people around Connor might not be in danger.
However, the powerful power contained in the sword Chi would fill the ball, and Connor would need to withstand all the impact in order to survive.
To put it simply, the sword Chi that Thaddeus released just now was a bomb.
In order to prevent Rachel from being hurt, Connor chose to put the bomb under his body. Although this could protect Rachel, the damage Connor received was also doubled.
"You're courting death!"
Thaddeus could not help but sneer.
Rachel looked at the round ball in front of her with a very nervous expression. She was also a martial artist, so she naturally knew why Connor would do this.
"Connor, why are you such a fool? Will the people of the Netherworld Sect let me go just because you saved me?"
Rachel could not help but shout at Connor.
At this moment, the people of the Netherworld Sect also let out a long sigh. After all, if it wasn't for Thaddeus's critical slash, it would probably not be easy for them to defeat Connor today. Even if they defeated Connor, they would probably be seriously injured.
Thaddeus's expression was still very solemn. Although he knew that Connor was in danger, he still did not dare to be careless. After all, the battle had not ended.
Almost at the same time, everyone focused their attention on the ball around Connor.
Time seemed to have stopped.
Bang!
However, at this moment, a loud sound came from between heaven and earth.
The sphere around Connor's body instantly exploded, and an extremely shocking aura flew in all directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 1932: Six Grandmasters
chapters.content:
Chapter 1932: Six Grandmasters
However, the aura that spread out was a hundred times weaker than Thaddeus's sword Chi.
Therefore, his aura would not affect the martial artists there at all.
Countless sand and stones flew in the air. After this loud noise, a figure suddenly rushed forward and flew toward Thaddeus.
Bang!
There was another loud bang.
Before Thaddeus could react, his body was sent flying for nearly a hundred meters. Finally, he smashed into the city wall of the Netherworld Sect.
When everyone came to, they realized that the one who had sent Thaddeus flying was none other than Connor.
At this moment, Connor was still very calm. However, through his clothes, everyone could feel that Connor had suffered a lot in the ball just now.
"Even so, it didn't kill you…"
Thaddeus broke free from the city wall and shouted with a cold voice.
"It's not that easy to kill me!"
Connor exclaimed.
"Who exactly are you?"
Thaddeus looked at Connor and roared.
"It doesn't matter who I am!"
After saying that, Connor's figure flashed and then rushed toward Thaddeus's position again.
Connor knew that Thaddeus was the strongest person in the Netherworld Sect. Therefore, he only needed to kill Thaddeus, and the rest would be easy to deal with.
When Thaddeus saw Connor rushing over, he seemed rather scared.
Bang!
Connor turned and punched Thaddeus in the chest again.
Thaddeus's figure retreated explosively. Connor intended to continue chasing.
However, at this moment, a figure suddenly rushed out and slapped Connor on the shoulder.
Connor's body trembled slightly and then stopped.
A middle-aged man in a black robe appeared in front of Connor.
"Isn't the Purple Cloud Sect's style of doing things too overbearing? How dare you bully us in our own home!"
The middle-aged man looked at Connor and exclaimed.
Connor sized up the middle-aged man and asked expressionlessly, "Who are you?"
"I am Brantley Ledesma, the leader of the North Island Sect!"
The middle-aged man said proudly.
"What?"
Noel, who was not far away, was even more shocked when he heard the middle-aged man's words.
Rachel turned to look at Noel and asked softly, "You know this person?"
"The North Island Sect is a branch of the Blood Moon Sect just like the Netherworld Sect. I didn't expect the North Island Sect to come here as well. Brantley is also an earth rank ancient martial arts grandmaster like Thaddeus."
Noel exclaimed.
Although Connor had some advantage against the people from the Netherworld Sect just now, if Brantley joined the battle, the situation would be very disadvantageous to Connor.
"That's right. Is the Purple Cloud Sect underestimating the sects in Cameron? Do you really think that the martial artists of Cameron are easy to bully?"
However, at this moment, a woman's voice slowly sounded.
Connor looked over and saw a beautiful young woman in a green dress walking over.
The beautiful young woman was very outstanding, and her figure was top-notch. Her breasts trembled slightly with her graceful steps. She was probably the goddess of many men's dreams when she was young.
"And who are you?"
Connor looked at the beautiful young woman and asked.
"I'm Heather Clarke, the sect leader of the Abyss Sect!"
The beautiful young woman calmly replied.
Noel could not help but suck in a breath of cold air when he heard this because he never expected that even the Abyss Sect's people would be here.
The situation was already very disadvantageous with the addition of Brantley. If Heather was added into the equation, Connor's chances of winning would be nearly zero.
"It's over. It's all my fault for being careless. I forgot to remind Mr. McDonald about the relationship between the Netherworld Sect, the North Island Sect and the Abyss Sect. They are all branches of the Blood Moon Sect. If something happens to the Netherworld Sect, the other two sects will definitely do something about it…"
Noel said.
"Did you forget to remind me, or did you not remind me on purpose?"
Rachel glanced at Noel indifferently.
"I…"
Noel looked a little awkward, and he didn't know how to answer.
After all, he hadn't thought about whether he should stand on Connor's side or the Netherworld Sect's side.
Just now, he had also seen Connor's true strength, which was why he had made up his mind to stand on Connor's side.
However, Noel was already regretting it, but it was too late.
"This guy is strong. Let's get him together!"
Severus already knew Connor's strength. Therefore, even with the help of Heather Brantley, he did not dare to be careless.
"Alright…"
The white-haired old man and Giuseppe agreed almost at the same time. Then, they rushed straight toward Connor.
Thaddeus, Brantley, and Heather were all earth rank ancient martial arts grandmasters, while Severus and the other two were advanced black rank ancient martial arts grandmasters.
The six of them immediately surrounded Connor.
Almost everyone present felt that this battle would be even more tragic.
Even Rachel was very worried about Connor.
However, Connor was very calm. He knew that the number of black rank martial artists the Gomez family had was comparable to the enemies he was facing now. If he couldn't defeat these people today, then he wouldn't be able to deal with Yamino Gomez.
Thinking of this, Connor's face appeared somewhat murderous.
"Connor, be careful!"
Rachel reminded Connor after hesitating for a moment.
"Protect yourself!"
Connor said softly.
Rachel couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. She knew that Connor had no intention of running away at this moment, so she could only nod helplessly.
"Sect Leader Tidwell, I didn't expect that you would have such a day. You were actually bullied by a young brat to such an extent!"
