Heather said to Thaddeus with a smile.
"Don't underestimate this person. His strength is far above yours and mine. If we don't work together today, it will probably be very difficult to get rid of this person!"
Thaddeus was deeply aware of Connor's abilities. Therefore, he did not dare to be the slightest bit careless at this moment.
"Aren't you being a little too nervous?"
Brantley said with a smile.
"Stop talking nonsense and hurry up!"
Thaddeus wasn't being courteous just because the two of them were helping him. Instead, he scolded them coldly.
After all, the status of the Netherworld Sect was the highest among the three sects. Thaddeus was in a bad mood after losing face.
Brantley and Heather merely smiled and did not dare to continue joking.

chapters.title: Chapter 1933: Overestimating Your Own Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 1933: Overestimating Your Own Strength
Almost at this moment, the six ancient martial arts grandmasters attacked Connor at the same time.
Six powerful auras were headed toward Connor.
Under such circumstances, even immortals would not be able to escape death!
Rachel's pretty face was filled with nervousness because she didn't know what would happen next. She could only silently pray for Connor in her heart.
It was unknown when Connor, who needed the help of others everywhere, had grown to a level where he could stand shoulder to shoulder with the strongest martial artists in the world.
Rachel secretly marveled at the changes in Connor. At this time, she also saw the hope of revenge from Connor, but the premise was that Connor could survive today.
When the six lights all hit Connor, an extremely dazzling light suddenly erupted around Connor's body, and then canceled out all six auras.
"Mr. McDonald might still have a chance!"
Noel was a little excited when she saw this scene.
"If Connor wants to live alone, he can abandon us. These six people can't stop him at all!"
Rachel said softly.
Noel instinctively glanced at Rachel after hearing this.
Rachel sighed softly and said expressionlessly, "It seems that Connor was right before. I have indeed become his burden!"
Rachel knew that Connor didn't care about the life and death of the Misty Sect. The reason why Connor didn't choose to escape was probably because of her.
When Brantley saw that Connor was able to block the auras of the six of them by himself, he was a little shocked. Then, he said in a low voice, "Looks like this person does have some skills…"
"World Destroying Ghost Palm!"
Brantley growled, then stretched out his hand and slapped toward Connor.
A black palm flew out, bringing with it an endless amount of Ghostly Yin Chi as it headed straight for Connor. The power of this palm was extremely terrifying, as if it could instantly destroy the world.
Everyone present could not withstand the powerful pressure brought by this palm, so they fell to the ground one after another.
In the beginning, Rachel was barely able to hold on for a while. However, as the aura of the palm became stronger and stronger, Rachel's delicate body began to sway.
However, at this moment, a ray of light enveloped Rachel's body.
Rachel instantly felt much more relaxed.
At this moment, Connor needed to deal with six ancient martial arts grandmasters by himself, so he couldn't be distracted at all. Helping Rachel was already his limit. As for those people from the Misty Sect, Connor really didn't have the time to consider protecting time.
Rachel looked at the light around her body. She was touched and worried.
Brantley's World Destroying Ghost Palm was the Blood Moon Sect Cult Leader's famous ultimate skill. Brantley was able to unleash about 60 - 70% of the power of this move, so Thaddeus was very surprised when he saw this palm.
"I didn't expect Brantley's Ghost Palm to have reached such a level!"
Thaddeus could not help but sigh.
"There's still a huge gap compared to Cult Leader!"
Brantley replied indifferently.
However, at this moment, Connor calmly faced Brantley's ghost palm and released a punch.
A golden fist mark flew toward the ghost palm like a cannonball.
"You overestimate yourself!"
When Brantley saw Connor's punch, his expression was somewhat disdainful. He believed that Connor's punch could not block the ghost palm.
However, in the next second, Brantley's expression began to change because the power of Connor's fist print was gradually increasing. The size of the fist print was also obviously increasing. In almost an instant, the aura of Connor's fist print suppressed the ghost palm.
"What's going on? Why is there such a strange fist technique?"
Brantley could not help but growl when he realized that something was wrong.
Boom!
Following that, Connor's fist collided with the ghost palm.
The ghost palm was like paper in front of Connor's fist. It was instantly pierced through by the fist which finally smashed into Brantley's body.
Brantley retreated hundreds of meters away. If Thaddeus hadn't grabbed him, he would have flown out of the Netherworld Sect grounds.
"This kid is indeed strong. He actually broke my ghost palm so easily!"
After Brantley had stabilized himself, he gritted his teeth and sighed softly.
"I've already warned you. Connor is strong, so you can't be careless!"
Thaddeus said helplessly.
Brantley looked a little awkward, but he did not refute.
After all, there was a huge gap between Connor's age and his strength. It was indeed easy for people to underestimate Connor.
"Let's attack together!"
At this moment, Heather also realized how difficult it was to deal with Connor, so she shouted softly.
Everyone took out their trump cards and attacked Connor relentlessly.
At this moment, six ancient martial arts grandmasters were attacking together. This scene was way too shocking. Everyone was secretly amazed by Connor's combat strength.
At this moment, although Connor did not have the upper hand when facing these six people, and it was not as easy as before, he did not fall into a complete disadvantage. He could even vaguely achieve a state where he could be evenly matched with these six people.
Connor could be considered to have exhausted all the strength in his body. On one hand, he used the Chi Circulation Technique to crazily devour the aura between heaven and earth, while on the other hand, he continuously released his aura to block the attacks of these six people.
Thaddeus looked at Connor and slashed down fiercely. Then, he shouted, "Connor, I admit that your strength is indeed a little terrifying. Among the many ancient martial arts experts I know, only the Cult Leader can fight you. It's a pity that you're facing the six of us today. Even if we exhaust ourselves, we can exhaust you to death. You'd better admit defeat quickly."
"That's right. It's not easy for you to have such achievements at such a young age. As long as you admit defeat now, I can ask the cult leader to take you in as a disciple."
Brantley shouted at Connor while attacking him.
"A mere Blood Moon Sect cult leader is not qualified to be my master!"
Connor replied coldly.
"Hey handsome, if you don't want to be Cult Leader's disciple, you can be my man. I guarantee that I can make you wish you were dead!"
Heather said with a smile.
When Rachel heard what everyone said to Connor, she became even more nervous.
After all, Connor was currently facing six people alone. In such a situation, he had to maintain a high level of concentration at all times. He could not be distracted at all.
And these people talking to Connor was obviously a distraction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1934: Yama Chi
chapters.content:
Chapter 1934: Yama Chi
Connor seemed to have noticed this, so he ignored these people.
Connor knew very well that these six people were constantly trying to exhaust him.
They were planning to exhaust the Chi in his body before launching a fatal blow.
However, Connor was not in a hurry because he was waiting for an opportunity.
Severus and the others were already injured, and the three of them were one-star ancient martial arts grandmasters. If this continued on, one of them would definitely not be able to hold on.
As long as Connor seized this opportunity, he could easily break the siege of these six people.
Reality proved that Connor's guess was correct.
In less than five minutes, Severus, who was already heavily injured, had expended too much energy, causing his movements to slow down.
Connor was keenly aware of this, so he said in a low voice, "Let's start with you!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Connor's body was like a bolt of lightning, directly charging toward Severus.
Previously, these six people continuously attacked Connor from six different directions. This also caused Connor to have no chance to attack at all. He could only constantly deal with the attacks of these six people.
However, Severus's speed had slowed down because he had used up too much of his aura. It was obvious that he was not at the same speed as the others.
At this moment, Connor wanted to seize this opportunity to break out of the encirclement.
Before anyone could react, Connor had already arrived in front of Severus. He raised his fist and smashed it straight at Severus's chest.
"No!"
Heather hurriedly waved her hand.
A green light surrounded Severus's body. At this moment, Heather had already noticed that Severus was not doing that well. If Severus were to take Connor's punch head-on, he would probably die.
Heather had no choice but to use her aura to help Severus block this punch.
"Yama Chi!"
Noel frowned when she saw the green aura on Severus's body.
"What is Yama Chi?"
Rachel hurriedly asked.
"Yama Chi is also a unique skill of the Blood Moon Sect's Sect Leader. It's said that this kind of aura is extremely powerful and tougher than ordinary auras. Back then, the Blood Moon Sect's Sect Leader relied on this Yama Chi to withstand three joint attacks from the four great sect leaders when he was besieged. Unfortunately, he still lost in the end…"
Noel said in a low voice.
Rachel appeared to be somewhat shocked.
After all, he could withstand the joint attack of the sect leaders of the four sects with just one type of Chi. How terrifying was this Chi?
Bang!
At this moment, Connor's fist smashed into Severus's chest.
Although the Yama Chi helped Severus block most of the power, it was still unable to completely block Connor's punch. It instantly exploded and turned into a cloud of green smoke that dissipated between heaven and earth.
"How... How is this possible?"
Heather's beautiful eyes widened when she saw this scene. She was in disbelief.
Then, Severus spat out a mouthful of blood and was sent flying. He smashed into the city wall of the Netherworld Sect.
Everyone turned to look at Severus. Severus's face was pale, and there was a fist-sized hole in his chest.
"He killed Severus with a single punch?"
Thaddeus responded with a low growl.
"What…"
Brantley's face was also filled with shock.
It wasn't difficult for Connor to kill the heavily injured Severus with a single punch. After all, Severus's cultivation level was lower than Connor's. However, what was inconceivable was that Severus's body was surrounded by the Yama Chi.
Connor had forcefully withstood the Yama Chi and killed Severus. This was the most terrifying thing about what he did.
"If it wasn't for that Yama Chi, Severus would have been blown up by Connor's punch!"
The white-haired elder could not help but stutter and sigh.
When everyone heard the white-haired elder's words, they were all stunned. They could not understand why Connor's fist had such shocking power.
"I wonder how many more times you can use your Yama Chi!"
Connor raised his head and glanced at Heather indifferently.
When Heather heard Connor's words, she was a little afraid.
"Everyone, don't let your guard down. We have to suppress him!"
Thaddeus felt that the situation was not quite right and hurriedly shouted.
Everyone attacked Connor again.
However, they were already short of a Severus who could use lightning bolts, so it was no longer easy to suppress Connor again.
Connor's figure flashed, and he rushed toward the white-haired old man.
He knew very well that the weakest among them was Severus, followed by this white-haired elder.
Connor had to ensure that every time he attacked, he could instantly kill his opponent. Otherwise, he would be in an even more dangerous situation.
Therefore, Connor could only choose the weaker ones to start with.
Before the white-haired old man could react, Connor had already rushed up to him. Then, he raised his fist and smashed it toward the white-haired old man's chest.
"Be careful!"
Giuseppe saw that something was wrong and rushed to the white-haired old man.
Heather also waved her right hand, and a Yama Chi enveloped Giuseppe's body.
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's punch did not hit the white-haired old man. Instead, Giuseppe blocked the punch for the old man.
Giuseppe's body was very strong, and he was protected by the Yama Chi. Therefore, Giuseppe was not killed by Connor's punch. He only took a few steps back and stopped.
"He can actually block my punch?"
Connor was surprised.
Giuseppe looked at Connor and did not speak. He felt an extremely powerful aura churning in his body. He wanted to suppress it as soon as possible.
But at this moment, Connor once again rushed toward Giuseppe.
"No!"
Thaddeus's expression changed drastically when he saw this scene.
However, it was already too late. Heather's Yama Chi could not be used indefinitely. Just the two times had already consumed most of the Chi in her body. She still needed some time.
How could Connor give Heather a chance to recover? After rushing up to Giuseppe, he punched Giuseppe's chest three times in a row.
After three punches, Giuseppe's body flew out and smashed into the white-haired old man.

chapters.title: Chapter 1935: What Do You Want to Talk About?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1935: What Do You Want to Talk About?
Almost at the same time, the two of them lost their breath.
There were originally six ancient martial arts grandmasters, but at this moment, three of them had been killed by Connor.
At this moment, the situation took a shocking turn.
Brantley looked at Connor with an expression of disbelief. He really couldn't imagine how terrifying Connor's strength was.
Heather was also dumbfounded because she had never met such an expert.
"The three of us still have a chance!"
Thaddeus was angry that Connor had killed the three elders of the Netherworld Sect, so he roared and rushed toward Connor.
Connor and Thaddeus started fighting in the air.
However, everyone could feel that Connor had a very obvious advantage. In less than half a minute, Thaddeus could not hold on any longer. Because Connor's fist technique was way too terrifying, and each punch was almost fatal. If he was not careful, he would die under Connor's fist.
"Be careful!"
At this moment, Heather suddenly shouted and hurriedly waved her right hand.
Once again, a Yama Chi surrounded Thaddeus's body.
Connor punched Thaddeus in the chest.
Thaddeus was smashed to the ground by Connor's punch, leaving a huge pit on the ground.
However, Thaddeus was still an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. His strength was obviously much stronger than Severus, Giuseppe, and the others. In addition to the protection of the Yama Chi, this punch did not cause him much damage.
However, Connor's figure flashed, and he rushed up to Thaddeus once again. Then, he lifted his leg and stepped on Thaddeus's head.
Thaddeus was afraid. He knew that once he was stepped on by Connor, he would definitely lose his life.
Unfortunately, because he had used all his strength to block Connor's punch, he was unable to react at all.
Heather could not continue to release the Yama Chi.
At this critical moment, Brantley slapped Connor from behind.
Connor's body jerked in response. Thaddeus hurriedly took advantage of this opportunity to dodge Connor's kick.
After Thaddeus dodged, Connor was not in a hurry to attack him. Instead, he slowly turned to look at Brantley behind him and said expressionlessly, "You're courting death!"
After saying that, Connor rushed toward Brantley.
Brantley's face was filled with fear, and his first reaction was not to attack Connor, but to turn around and flee.
At this moment, Brantley was regretting his decisions. He felt that he should not have come here today.
However, Brantley's speed was incomparable to Connor's. Connor caught up to Brantley in an instant, then raised his fist and smashed it fiercely on Brantley's back.
Brantley staggered two steps back, but he did not fall. Instead, he continued to run.
When Thaddeus saw this scene from afar, he could not help but laugh bitterly. He knew very well that they might all die in Connor's hands today.
Brantley, an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, the dignified North Island Sect Leader, was actually being chased by Connor at this moment. This was simply a joke!
Moreover, Brantley was unable to shake off Connor. In the end, he took three punches from Connor and fell to the ground.
Connor lifted his leg and stomped on Brantley's head.
Rachel instinctively closed her eyes when she saw this scene because she had already guessed what was going to happen next.
The ancient martial arts grandmaster, Brantley Ledesma, died in Connor's hands.
After Connor had finished dealing with Brantley, he slowly turned to look at Heather, who was not far away.
At this moment, Heather was already scared silly by Connor. She looked at him in a daze, not knowing what to do.
"Connor…"
Heather opened her mouth to speak, but Connor did not give her the chance to do so at all. With a gentle wave of his right hand, a golden light flew toward Heather.
"Pfft!"
Heather spat out a mouthful of blood and fell in front of Thaddeus.
Thaddeus looked at the corpses in front of him in a daze. His face was filled with despair. He originally thought that with the help of Brantley and Heather, killing Connor would not be a problem.
However, he never expected that even with the help of these two people, they were still not Connor's match.
Currently, the Blood Moon Sect only had three branches in Oprana. However, two of the Sect Leaders of these three branches had died in Connor's hands. Thaddeus probably would not live for long.
Noel looked at everything that was happening in front of him and felt as if he was dreaming.
After all, he had only known Connor for a short period of time and did not know how strong he truly was.
Originally, he thought that Connor was just an ordinary ancient martial arts grandmaster, but now he realized that Connor's strength was so terrifying that it could not be described as an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
Rachel looked at Connor and didn't know how to describe her feelings.
"Perhaps this is your true strength!"
After a long time, Rachel sighed softly.
After Connor killed Heather, he walked toward Thaddeus.
At this moment, Thaddeus looked at Connor with a face filled with fear. It was the kind of fear that came from the bottom of his heart. He did not even have the intention to escape because he knew that he could not escape at all.
"Can the two of us have a proper conversation now?"
Connor asked Thaddeus expressionlessly.
"What... What do you want to talk about?"
Thaddeus hesitated for a moment and stuttered.
"You should know very well why I came here. Stop talking nonsense. Where is Taran Saber?"
Connor asked.
"Taran Saber?"
A strange look flashed across Thaddeus's face. Then, he said in a low voice, "If I tell you where Taran Saber is now, will you let me go?"
"No!"
Connor shook his head lightly.
"Then, why should I tell you?"
Thaddeus gritted his teeth and asked.
"I can make your death a little easier. Otherwise, I'll let you know what it means to live a life worse than death!"
Connor said lightly.
Thaddeus looked at Connor and took a deep breath. Then, he gritted his teeth and said, "You can't kill me. If you kill me, Cult Leader won't let you off…"
"Where is Taran Saber?"
Connor asked.
Thaddeus looked at Connor without saying anything.
"Your wife and children are also in the Netherworld Sect, right? Do you want to see them die in my hands like you?"
Although Connor wouldn't really implicate Thaddeus's family because of these things, since such methods were shameful to him, but at this moment, he could only use this method to threaten Thaddeus. Otherwise, Thaddeus wouldn't tell the truth.
"If you dare to touch my family, I won't let you off even if I become a ghost!"
Thaddeus gritted his teeth and shouted after hearing Connor's words.

chapters.title: Chapter 1936: Yin Demon Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 1936: Yin Demon Body
"Do you think you can threaten me?"
"As long as you cooperate with me, I won't touch your family!"
Connor said lightly.
"..."
Thaddeus hesitated for a moment and then said in a low voice, "Taran is actually no longer in the Netherworld Sect. He has already been taken away by the Cult Leader…"
"Blood Moon Sect?"
Connor frowned slightly.
"That's right!"
Thaddeus nodded.
"Why did the Blood Moon Sect Cult Leader take Taran away?"
Connor was rather doubtful. At this moment, he did not believe Thaddeus's words one hundred percent.
"Back then, I went to the Misty Sect and met Taran. I discovered that his physique was very special. It was the Yin Demon Body…"
Thaddeus explained.
"What is a Yin Demon Body?"
Connor interrupted.
"There's not much difference between the Yin Demon Body and a normal person's body. However, it's a very precious thing to the Blood Moon Sect because the Yin Demon Body can greatly increase the strength of the martial artists who practice the Sky Ghost Technique. However, before that, we need to train the Yin Demon Body into a martial artist. The stronger the Yin Demon Body, the greater the improvement in strength of the martial artists who practice the Sky Ghost Technique!"
"And then?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"After I brought Taran to our sect, I took him in as a disciple and even made him a martial artist. I was going to give him to the cult leader after he became a black rank, but Taran's talent was low. He didn't break through to the black rank for more than ten years. In the end, the cult leader couldn't wait any longer, so he took Taran away and said he wanted to train him personally!"
Thaddeus said slowly.
"You mean Taran is already dead? Was he devoured by that cult leader of yours?"
When Connor heard this, he could not help but frown slightly.
"I don't think so…"
Thaddeus hurriedly shook his head and then continued, "I've heard the cult leader talk about Taran. Taran's physique is very special, and it's very difficult to find another physique like this. He's prepared to sacrifice Taran when he breaks through to the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster..."
"A heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
Connor was somewhat surprised.
This was because Connor had never met a three-star ancient martial arts grandmaster before. The most powerful one was only Jorge Yarrell, a peak earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster.
"Right now, the cult leader's realm is at the peak of the earth rank. As long as he succeeds in this sacrificial ceremony, he should be able to break through to the heaven rank!"
Thaddeus said in a low voice.
"It means that Taran is in the hands of the Blood Moon Sect's Sect Leader?"
Connor asked.
"Yes!"
Thaddeus hurriedly nodded.
"If you dare to lie to me, I will kill your whole family!"
Connor looked at Thaddeus and threatened.
"Do you think I need to lie to you at a time like this?"
Thaddeus gritted his teeth and said.
"Where is the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
Connor asked.
"It's in a city called Willborough in the neighboring country, Winam. When you reach Willborough, you can ask around and find out the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect. However, you might not be able to meet the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader!"
Thaddeus said in a low voice.
"Why?"
Connor frowned slightly.
"The identity of the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader is very mysterious. I usually rely on the Elders of the Blood Moon Sect to contact the cult leader. If you really want to find the cult leader, there's only one way!"
Thaddeus paused for a moment and then raised his head to look at Connor.
"What is it?"
Connor asked.
"The Blood Moon Sect's most important sacrificial ceremony will be in ten days. The cult leader will definitely appear at that time. If you want to find Taran, you must meet the cult leader. This might be your only chance because the cult leader might break through to become a heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster after the sacrificial ceremony ends. At that time, even you won't be a match for the cult leader, and Taran might become the cult leader's sacrifice!"
Thaddeus said slowly.
Connor hesitated for a moment but didn't say anything.
This was because Connor did not expect that finding Taran would be so troublesome. The Blood Moon Sect's cult leader's strength was probably above Thaddeus's, and Connor was already heavily injured after the battle. It would probably be difficult for him to recover within ten days.
However, if Connor missed this opportunity, it would be impossible for him to find Taran. Moreover, Connor would have to face the cult leader's pursuit.
"Is there anything else you want to ask?"
Thaddeus looked at Connor and said.
"How strong is the Blood Moon Sect?"
Connor asked.
"I'm not too sure about that, but it's definitely stronger than the Netherworld Sect!"
Thaddeus answered truthfully.
Connor took a deep breath and said softly, "You can die now!"
After saying that, Connor waved his right hand lightly, and a ray of light directly pierced through Thaddeus's forehead.
Connor knew that Thaddeus must have helped the Blood Moon Sect do many heartless things for many years. Therefore, he was doing the people a favor by killing Thaddeus and the others.
After Thaddeus died, Connor felt that his aura was very unstable.
Although Connor's strength had greatly increased after obtaining the power of the remnant soul.
However, this strength was actually a very big burden for Connor, especially after he used the energy excessively. His body would not be able to withstand this energy, and he would faint.
After Connor followed Rachel into the main hall of the Netherworld Sect, he fainted.
Rachel knew that Connor must have fallen into a coma because of the battle just now, so she quickly found a quiet room and placed Connor on the bed. She sat beside Connor and waited for him to wake up.
Connor did not know how long he had been unconscious. When he woke up, it was already late at night.
When Rachel saw the look on Connor's face when he woke up, she quickly said, "Connor, you're finally awake. How are you feeling now?"
"I'm fine…"
Connor replied in a low voice and then asked Rachel, "How long was I unconscious?"
"For about a day and a night!"
Rachel replied after thinking for a moment.
"That's not too bad!"
Connor let out a long sigh. After all, if he was unconscious for too long, it might affect Connor's search for Taran.
"Did anything happen?"
Connor looked at Rachel and asked.
"No, I told Noel and the others that you needed to rest, but they didn't know that you were unconscious, so they were very obedient!"
Rachel hurriedly shook her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1937: I'll Go With You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1937: I'll Go With You!
Connor hesitated for a moment. He looked at Rachel and said, "I'm going to leave tomorrow for Willborough in Winam. Do you plan to stay here or go back to Yarlford?"
"Are you really going to Willborough?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she appeared somewhat helpless.
"This is the last chance to find Taran. I don't want to lose this chance!"
Connor said seriously.
"..."
Rachel looked at Connor and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying in a low voice, "I think it's too dangerous for you to go to Willborough in your current state. You'd better not go…"
"It's alright…"
Connor smiled faintly.
"If you really want to go to Willborough, then I want to go with you!"
Rachel said in an unusually serious tone.
"You just advised that Willborough is dangerous. Why are you going with me now?"
Connor smiled helplessly and asked softly.
"Of course, I know that it's dangerous. But if you go alone, it might be even more dangerous. I can be at ease by your side…"
Rachel softly explained.
Connor looked at Rachel and didn't say anything.
In fact, Connor didn't want to take Rachel to Willborough. After all, Connor's condition wasn't very good now. He might not be able to recover completely even after ten days. Therefore, it was quite risky for Connor to go to Willborough this time.
But now Connor was unable to find any suitable reason to refuse Rachel to follow him.
"If you don't want to bring me there, then you shouldn't go too. We'll think of other ways when we return to Yarlford. Anyway, there are so many experts in the Purple Cloud Sect."
Rachel softly said to Connor.
When Connor heard Rachel's words, he shook his head and said expressionlessly, "We can't drag the Purple Cloud Sect into this matter!"
"Why?"
Rachel blinked and asked with a puzzled expression.
"The Blood Moon Sect's strength is extremely terrifying. Just the three branches of the Blood Moon Sect already have so many experts. If it's the cult leader of the Blood Moon Sect, he'll probably be even more powerful. If I drag the Purple Cloud Sect into this, I'll be sending them to their deaths!"
Connor explained in a low voice.
"Then, wouldn't you be courting death if you go there yourself?"
Rachel asked.
"The person who wants to deal with Yamino Gomez is me, not those people from the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Connor said firmly.
"..."
Rachel couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. She took a deep breath and didn't say anything more.
In fact, Rachel also knew that Connor felt that Rockefeller's matter had nothing to do with the Purple Cloud Sect. Connor did not want the Purple Cloud Sect's people to risk their lives.
"Anyway, I'll go wherever you go now. I definitely won't go back to Yarlford alone. Besides, you're unfamiliar with Willborough and you don't know how to speak the language in Winam. How will you be able to find the Blood Moon Sect by yourself?"
Rachel said with a firm tone.
"You know the Winam Language?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"Of course, I'm proficient in eight languages. Otherwise, how could I be qualified to be a university lecturer?"
Rachel said proudly.
"Alright, since you want to go to Willborough with me, then follow me!"
Connor agreed after thinking for a moment.
"That's more like it…"
Rachel smiled with satisfaction after seeing Connor agree.
"Let's go meet Noel and the others!"
Connor did not want to waste any more time, so he stood up and walked out of the room.
Before Connor set off for Willborough, he had some things to ask Noel.
Although Connor already knew that Taran was in the hands of the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader, Thaddeus did not tell Connor the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect's sacrificial ceremony. In other words, even Thaddeus did not know where the ceremony was held because the Blood Moon Sect chose a different location every year.
If Connor went to Willborough just like that, he would be like a headless fly. He might not even be able to find the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader within ten days, let alone rescue Taran.
When Noel and the others saw Connor, they were very nervous. At this moment, the way they looked at Connor was very different from before.
After experiencing the battle between Connor and Thaddeus, they finally understood how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"Mr. McDonald!"
Noel stepped forward and greeted Connor nervously.
"You don't have to be so nervous. I'm only going to ask you something!"
Connor said softly.
"What is it?"
Noel hurriedly asked.
"How much do you know about Willborough?"
Connor asked softly.
"Mr. McDonald, are you really going to Willborough?"
Noel asked in surprise.
"Of course, I need to find Taran!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Mr. McDonald, the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader is very powerful. Although you're not weak, there are other experts in the Blood Moon Sect. If you go to Willborough alone, I'm worried that you might be in danger!"
Noel advised kindly.
"You don't have to worry about it!"
Connor replied. After all, Connor had already made up his mind to go to Willborough. No one could dissuade him.
"Alright… Fine!"
Noel nodded helplessly, then looked at Connor and said, "Mr. McDonald, actually, I don't know much about the Blood Moon Sect. I've only heard some rumors…"
"Then, do you know how I can find the place where the Blood Moon Sect holds the sacrificial ceremony?"
Connor asked.
"Well…"
Noel hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, the Blood Moon Sect has many branches in Willborough. These branches are all there to help the cult leader of the Blood Moon Sect search for sacrifices. Furthermore, their strength isn't very strong to begin with. They're even inferior to the Netherworld Sect. When you arrive at Willborough, you can find a branch first and see if you can get the exact location of the sacrificial ceremony from them…"
"That's a good idea!"
Connor nodded slightly when he heard Noel's words.
The Netherworld Sect was in Oprana, and they rarely contacted the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader. Even Thaddeus could not contact the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader directly.
Therefore, the information that Thaddeus had was very limited, and the branches of the Blood Moon Sect were all in Willborough, so they definitely knew more than Thaddeus.

chapters.title: Chapter 1938: Heading to Willborough
chapters.content:
Chapter 1938: Heading to Willborough
"Mr. McDonald, I suggest that you don't go to Willborough!"
Noel said softly to Connor after hesitating for a moment.
Connor looked at Noel indifferently and didn't continue discussing this matter. Instead, he said softly, "Don't worry, I won't bring you with me to Willborough this time. As long as you bring us out of this mountain, you'll be free!"
"Alright, alright…"
Noel quickly nodded in agreement.
In fact, Noel had been persuading Connor not to go to Willborough because he was worried that Connor would bring him along.
Noel was fine with helping Connor deal with Thaddeus.
However, if he were to follow Connor to deal with those people from the Blood Moon Sect, he would not dare to go even if he had ten thousand guts!
"Mr. McDonald, when do you plan to leave this place?"
Noel hesitated for a moment before asking Connor.
"Let's go now!"
Connor replied without thinking and then walked out of the hall.
After Connor walked out of the hall, he realized that the corpses of the Netherworld Sect's people had been removed. The other disciples of the Netherworld Sect had naturally regained their freedom and left the Netherworld Sect.
Although Connor had injured many people in the Netherworld Sect, he was like a savior in the eyes of those people. If it weren't for Connor, they wouldn't have been able to escape the fate of becoming sacrifices.
...
On the other side, at the headquarters of the Gomez Corporation in Yarlford.
The cooperation between Aida Collier and Juan Gomez was going on smoothly. This was definitely a great thing for Juan.
Otherwise, he wouldn't know how to deal with the follow-up trouble of all the four families terminating their contracts.
However, as soon as this matter was resolved, new problems came one after another.
That was, Bruce Janco and Waylon Jowers had inexplicably disappeared.
Juan had been busy working with Aida, so he didn't pay attention to Bruce's situation at all.
By the time he realized what was going on, Bruce and Waylon was already uncontactable.
"Uncle Liu, do you think Bruce and the others have encountered any danger?"
Juan frowned and asked the middle-aged man in front of him.
"Master Janco's skills are very terrifying. Moreover, he has the help of his senior brother. I don't think there would be any danger..."
The middle-aged man shook his head lightly.
"Then, why haven't I been able to contact them for the past few days? Do you need me to personally go to Cameron to see what's going on?"
Juan frowned.
"Master Janco might have encountered some kind of trouble, so he didn't contact you. Moreover, we should focus on the cooperation with the Collier family. It would be best if the grandmaster can be found. If he can't be found, you aren't to be blamed. If you leave Yarlford now, who's going to take care of the business with the Collier family?"
The middle-aged man reminded him.
"You're right. The grandmaster's matter is not part of the plan. All I need to do now is to settle the matter at hand…"
Juan seemed to agree with the middle-aged man, so he gave up on the idea of going to Cameron.
...
Accompanied by Noel and the others, Connor and Rachel left the Netherworld Sect and took a bus to the nearest airport.
This time, they planned to fly directly to Willborough.
Noel and the others naturally did not have the courage to follow Connor to Willborough, so when they arrived at the airport, their motorcade left in a hurry.
The next day, 8 AM.
Connor and Rachel's flight arrived at Willborough.
There was a huge gap between Willborough and the cities in Oprana because the economic development in Winam had always been very slow. This caused Connor and Rachel to feel as if they had traveled 30 years back in time when they arrived at Willborough. Some cities in Oprana 50 years ago might look even more prosperous than Willborough.
Willborough was connected to Cameron in Oprana, so there were many people from Oprana in Willborough.
After leaving the airport, Connor saw many people from Oprana. He could even see some shops with English words on the streets.
"The living standards of the residents of Willborough are very low, so they are still very enthusiastic about people from Oprana. In their eyes, English people are like Gods of wealth!"
Rachel softly said to Connor.
"I'm afraid it's very difficult to find a decent five-star hotel in Willborough. Moreover, the television is not very popular here."
Connor asked Rachel with a smile.
"I didn't come here with you to watch TV. I'm here to do something serious!"
Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor.
Connor smiled and didn't say anything.
After the two of them left the Willborough Airport, they found a random hotel and booked a room.
As there were many people from Oprana in Willborough, the hotel staff could speak English and accepted dollars. This made it a lot more convenient for Connor and Rachel.
Although this hotel was considered the best hotel in Willborough, it was rather plain. The only thing that Rachel felt relieved about was that the room was clean.
In order to prevent some unexpected situations from happening, Connor and Rachel stayed together.
Moreover, the two of them had lived together for a long time, so it was not inconvenient.
After such a long time, they finally arrived at Willborough. Rachel was already exhausted, so she went to rest after entering her room.
Connor sat on the sofa and started cultivating.
The battle with the Netherworld Sect and the others had put a far greater burden on Connor's body than the battle with Draco Felton. Therefore, even though Connor was conscious, the aura in his body was still very unstable.
Connor knew that he still had to face many powerful opponents in Willborough, so he had to ensure his body was at its peak condition as soon as possible.
The night passed quickly.
When Rachel opened her eyes, it was already past eight o'clock in the morning the next day.
Rachel gently stretched her back and walked out of the bedroom with sleepy eyes. She saw that Connor was still sitting on the sofa cultivating. She couldn't help but say softly, "You didn't cultivate here for the entire night, did you?"
"I did…"
Connor slowly opened his eyes and turned to look at Rachel.
Rachel couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she walked up to Connor and asked, "What do you plan to do next?"
"Go and inquire about the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect branch first!"
Connor replied.
"Then, wait for me. I'll take a shower and put on my makeup before setting off…"
Rachel replied indifferently, then turned around and walked into the bedroom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1939: Looking For Someone?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1939: Looking For Someone?
Half an hour later, Rachel finally finished her shower and put on her makeup. Then, she left the hotel with Connor.
After the two of them left the hotel, they found a random restaurant and ate something.
Then, he began to inquire about the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect branch.
The Blood Moon Sect was very famous in Willborough, so it was not difficult to find out the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect branch.
Bang! Bang!
However, before Connor and Rachel could find someone to ask for the location of the Blood Moon Sect branch, gunshots suddenly rang out on the street.
When Rachel heard the gunshots, she looked shocked. After all, such a situation would not happen in any city in Oprana.
Connor was calm. After all, bullets were no threat to him now.
Connor slowly looked into the distance and saw a group of masked militants attacking ordinary people with guns. In an instant, screams and cries for help could be heard.
"I didn't expect the situation in Willborough to be so chaotic…"
Rachel instinctively hid behind Connor and whispered.
"Not all countries are as safe as Oprana. The current situation in Winam is not stable. It is normal for some terrorists to want to change the situation!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Help, help!"
At this moment, a girl's voice attracted Connor's attention.
Connor instinctively looked up and saw a girl who was about the same age as him running toward him while shouting. Behind the girl was a masked terrorist who was chasing after the girl relentlessly.
"Please, save me!"
At this moment, the girl looked very desperate as she kept shouting at Connor.
Although Connor felt sorry for her, he had come to Willborough this time to do more important things, so he did not want to complicate things.
However, he had forgotten about Rachel who was beside him.
Rachel did not hesitate at all and rushed up to the girl.
When the terrorist saw Rachel, he seemed to become even more excited.
Connor looked at Rachel with a helpless expression. Then, he waved his right hand gently, and a flash of light directly pierced through the terrorist's head.
In the next second, Connor dragged Rachel and the girl to hide in a small alley.
After the girl entered the alley, she still looked terrified, as if she was still reeling from what happened.
Connor couldn't help but size up the girl. The girl's looks were very good, and her figure was very sexy. The girl seemed to be well-to-do because all the clothes she was wearing were international brands. Any one of them probably cost hundreds of thousands.
People from Willborough definitely couldn't afford such clothes. In addition, the girl had been speaking English, so she should be from Oprana.
After some time, the gunshots on the street finally stopped.
Then, the police shouted, telling everyone that the terrorists had been subdued.
Rachel turned to the girl and said, "You don't have to be afraid. You are safe now…"
"Thank... Thank you…"
The girl suppressed the fear in her heart and stammered.
"You're not from Winam, right?"
Rachel asked.
"Yeah…"
The girl nodded and continued, "I'm from Oprana!"
"We're also Oprana!"
Rachel said with a smile.
"..."
The girl looked at Rachel and hesitated for a couple of seconds before saying softly, "My name is Jada Leone. What are your names?"
"I'm Rachel Wallace, and he's Connor McDonald!"
Rachel replied.
Jada subconsciously glanced at Connor and said softly, "I really have to thank the two of you for what you did just now. If not for the two of you, I might have already been captured by those people…"
"What are you doing in Willborough?"
Connor asked softly.
"My family is in the jade business. I came to Willborough to discuss business, but I didn't expect to encounter such a thing!"
Jada felt that Connor and Rachel weren't bad people, so she didn't hide anything and answered the question.
"Oh, I see!"
Connor nodded and did not continue asking any questions.
"What about you guys? What are you two doing in Willborough? Traveling?"
Jada seemed to be less nervous after talking to Connor for a while, so she took the initiative to ask.
"No, we're here to look for someone!"
Connor shook his head.
"Looking for someone?"
Jada was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly said, "Who are you looking for? I know a lot of locals in Willborough. I can help you."
"Are you familiar with Willborough?"
Connor was immediately interested after hearing Jada's words and hurriedly asked.
"My family is in the jade business, so I often come to Willborough with my father. But this time, I came here alone. I also know some locals in Willborough. If you want to find someone, I think my friends can help you!"
Jada said softly.
"Then, do you know where the branch of the Blood Moon Sect is?"
Connor asked after thinking for a moment.
"Blood Moon Sect?"
Jada instinctively took two steps back when she heard those three words. She then asked cautiously, "Why are you asking about it?"
"The person I'm looking for is in the Blood Moon Sect!"
Connor said lightly.
"But my father said that the people of the Blood Moon Sect are extremely dangerous…"
Jada looked at Connor with a strange expression on her face. She also became more vigilant.
"Don't worry, the two of us have nothing to do with the Blood Moon Sect. We just want to go to the Blood Moon Sect to look for someone!"
Rachel piped up.
"I see!"
Jada then looked more at ease. She then said softly, "If you're really planning to look for the Blood Moon Sect, you don't need my help at all. Just hail a taxi on the street and tell the driver that you're going to the Blood Moon Sect's branch. He'll take you there…"
"Really?"
Rachel was surprised.
"This isn't Oprana. The existence of the Blood Moon Sect isn't a secret. Moreover, there are many ordinary people who pay their respects to the Blood Moon Sect every day. It's naturally easy to find the Blood Moon Sect!"
Jada said slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1940: A Guest
chapters.content:
Chapter 1940: A Guest
Connor then understood what she meant after hearing Jada's words.
The situation in Winam was different from that in Oprana.
Back then, the Blood Moon Sect was hated by everyone, but the situation was different in Winam.
The Blood Moon Sect colluded with the big shots of Winam, which led to the Blood Moon Sect's special status in Winam. They could even openly open up to the outside world and publicize it everywhere.
"Thank you!"
Connor looked at Jada and said.
Jada hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Although I don't know why you want to find the Blood Moon Sect, the Blood Moon Sect is really, really dangerous. You must be careful!"
"I got it…"
Connor smiled and did not continue to say anything else. Instead, he pulled Rachel and left.
Jada stood in place and looked at Connor's back. A little strange flashed across her face because she could feel that Connor, who looked about the same age as her, seemed different. However, she couldn't tell what was different. In short, it gave her a very strange feeling.
Ring, ring, ring…
At this moment, Jada's phone rang.
When she realized that it was her father calling, she quickly picked up the phone and told him about the situation on her side.
A few minutes later, a black Mercedes stopped in front of Jada.
Jada opened the car door and got in.
...
On the other side, after Connor and Rachel parted ways with Jada, they wanted to hail a taxi on the street.
However, because of the terrorist attack on this street, they waited for almost an hour before they finally got a taxi.
The taxi driver was not from Oprana, so Connor could only ask Rachel to communicate with the taxi driver.
When the taxi driver knew that Connor and Rachel were going to the Blood Moon Sect, he was not surprised. Instead, he started the car as if he had heard a very ordinary place name.
"Looks like Jada was right. The Blood Moon Sect is not a secret in Willborough!"
Rachel softly said to Connor.
"Isn't that good? It can save me a lot of time…"
Connor replied indifferently.
"But I feel that something is off. The more upright the Blood Moon Sect is, the scarier they are. If they did not have 100% confidence, how could they appear so brazenly in front of the people of Willborough?"
Rachel slowly said.
Connor hesitated for a moment when he heard Rachel's words, but he did not say anything.
About an hour later, the taxi driver stopped the car at a place that looked like the entrance of a village. He turned to Rachel and said, "Miss, this is the Blood Moon Sect, but my car can't enter. You can only walk in!"
"Alright, thank you!"
Rachel nodded, paid the fare, and followed Connor out of the car.
After Connor got out of the car, he narrowed his eyes and observed the village in front of him.
From the outside, there was nothing special about this village. It was just like a small village in Oprana, but Connor could feel the aura of many martial artists in the village.
"Are we going to go in just like that?"
Rachel looked at Connor and asked.
"Yeah!"
Connor lightly nodded.
A moment later, Connor and Rachel arrived at the entrance of the branch.
However, before Connor could enter the village, two people stopped him and said expressionlessly, "There are some important matters to discuss in the sect these few days, so it's not open to the public. Please go back!"
These two people seemed to be from Oprana as they spoke English.
Connor knew that the important matter these two people were talking about was regarding the sacrificial ceremony.
At this moment, Connor's body had not fully recovered. He did not want to waste his energy on these people, so he said, "I'm a guest invited by the Blood Moon Sect. Am I not qualified to enter?"
"Are you a guest of the Blood Moon Sect?"
A strange look appeared on the man's face upon hearing Connor's words.
Connor then released his aura.
When the man felt the terrifying aura on Connor's body, his expression instantly changed.
Because he was a black rank martial artist, but the aura Connor displayed was clearly more terrifying than his seniors and juniors. This was enough to prove how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"May I know who you are?"
The man asked Connor with trepidation.
"I can't reveal my identity!"
Connor said lightly.
After hesitating for a moment, the man felt that Connor was not lying. After all, according to Connor's strength, if he really wanted to barge in, he would not be able to stop Connor. Therefore, he hurriedly made way for him and then said in a low voice, "Expert, please forgive me for being ignorant!"
Connor looked at the man indifferently and did not say anything. He then walked into the village.
A moment later, Connor and Rachel disappeared from the man's sight.
The man's companion looked very puzzled and asked in a low voice, "You haven't even figured out the identities of these two people, so why did you let them in? What if these two people are not from the Blood Moon Sect?"
"Are you stupid?"
The man scolded in a low voice and then continued, "That young man's aura was very terrifying, even more terrifying than our branch's elders. This means that if he wanted to barge in, the two of us wouldn't have been able to stop him at all. However, he didn't have the intention to barge in just now, which means that he must be an expert from the Blood Moon Sect!"
"I see!"
His companion nodded thoughtfully when he heard this.
"Besides, you know how strong our branch is. It's impossible for someone to be bold enough to come and provoke our branch alone!"
The man added.
"You're right. Even if this person isn't from the Blood Moon Sect, he'll be courting death if he goes in. The two of us aren't his match anyway, so we might as well let him go in first!"
His companion nodded lightly in agreement.
After Rachel and Connor entered the village, they noticed that things seemed odd. This was because one could not sense the existence of the Blood Moon Sect in this village at all. Everyone here was an ordinary person.
"Is the Blood Moon Sect's branch really here?"
Rachel seemed hesitant as she asked Connor softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1941: Entering the Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 1941: Entering the Valley
"This village is only here to confuse people. Their headquarters should be in the valley!"
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the valley in the distance.
"I see!"
Rachel nodded thoughtfully.
"I haven't fully recovered my strength yet. If a battle happens, it might be bad on my body, so let's not complicate things for the time being. It's not too late to attack after we find the branch's sect leader!"
Connor could feel the aura of a large number of martial artists in the valley. The number of martial artists this time was probably a hundred times that of the Netherworld Sect. Moreover, there were many experts among them. Therefore, once Connor's identity was exposed, these martial artists would definitely attack him at the first moment.
Although it was not difficult for Connor to get rid of these martial artists, his current situation was not stable. He did not want to waste too much time on these people.
"I understand!"
Rachel agreed.
Connor walked straight into the village.
A moment later, Connor stopped in front of a temple.
The words "Blood Moon Sect" were written on the top of the temple, and there were several statues placed inside the temple. Although Connor had never seen these statues before, he knew that they were the totems of the Blood Moon Sect.
Under normal circumstances, the Blood Moon Sect that the people of Willborough could come into contact with was this temple. They would come to worship in this temple, but they did not know that this was built by the Blood Moon Sect to hide from the public. The real Blood Moon Sect branch was hidden behind the temple.
Connor then brought Rachel into the temple. At this moment, there was only one branch disciple chatting in the temple.
When they saw Connor, they immediately stood up and shouted at Connor, "Who are you? Who let you in?"
Connor could feel that the level of these disciples was obviously much higher than the two people at the door, so he could not use the previous method to fool them.
Since there was no way to fool them, Connor could only choose to attack.
Connor waved his right hand, sending his aura flying.
Several disciples instantly fell to the ground.
When Connor saw all of them fall, he whispered to Rachel, "Hurry up and find the entrance to the branch. Someone will soon discover that something has happened to them…"
"Okay!"
Rachel nodded and then split up with Connor to find the entrance to the branch.
A few minutes later, Rachel pushed open a door.
When the door opened, valley appeared in her sight.
"Connor, this should be the entrance!"
Rachel hurriedly shouted.
Connor quickly ran to Rachel's side and saw that there was a road behind the door, and this road just happened to lead to the valley in front.
"Yeah, this is the entrance. Let's go in!"
Connor whispered back to Rachel and then walked through the door.
About ten minutes later, Connor and Rachel arrived in front of the valley.
Those who could come to this valley were disciples of the branch, so there was no barrier at the entrance of the valley. Connor and Rachel entered the valley very easily.
After entering the valley, the true appearance of the branch was also exposed to Connor.
The scale of the Blood Moon Sect's branch was indeed much larger than the Netherworld Sect. Almost everyone inside was a martial artist, and black-rank martial artists could be seen everywhere.
Moreover, this valley had been developed into a modern urban living environment. Connor could see all kinds of shops and services in this valley.
"I didn't expect the Blood Moon Sect's branch to be at such a terrifying scale!"
Rachel turned to glance at Connor and sighed softly.
"These people are probably disciples of the Blood Moon Sect. They've probably lived here for generations to reproduce for the cult leader of the Blood Moon Sect!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"If that's the case, why aren't they fighting back?"
Rachel seemed to be somewhat puzzled as she asked Connor.
"Fight back?"
When Connor heard this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "In the face of true strength, they don't have the courage to fight back at all. They can only choose to leave it to fate!"
"These people are so pitiful!"
Rachel frowned and said.
Connor was not in the mood to pity these people because he had more important things to do, which was to find the person in charge of the branch and ask for the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader.
The scale of the valley where the branch was located was very large, and there were constantly disciples joining the sect. As such, even though Connor and Rachel were unfamiliar faces, it did not rouse any suspicion.
However, Rachel was really beautiful, and her figure was very sexy, plus Connor looked thin and weak, so many martial artists greedily sized up Rachel.
In this valley, there was no order at all.
After all, they all knew that they were only sacrifices to the cult leader. As long as they did not do anything to threaten the branch, the branch manager would sit idly by and do nothing.
This also led to the martial artists in this valley being very rough and barbaric.
Connor could feel that since he and Rachel entered this valley, there were already no less than ten martial artists who had set their eyes on Rachel. However, for some reason, these people did not choose to make a move.
In the valley of the Blood Moon Sect branch.
Connor brought Rachel to stroll around the valley. After all, the valley was very large, and the buildings inside were also complicated. Therefore, it was not easy to find the person in charge of the branch.
In order to preserve his strength, Connor didn't choose the same method as he did in the Netherworld Sect where he started a massacre and lured out the person in charge of the branch.
At the same time, a group of people had already set their eyes on Connor and Rachel.
There were three people in this group, and all of them were black rank.
Previously, after Connor and Rachel entered the valley, they were also targeted by many martial artists. However, in the end, they all chose to give up because of the threat of these three people.
After all, there was only one piece of fat meat. It was definitely something that someone who was strong was qualified to eat.
The three of them were considered quite strong among the many disciples in the valley. In addition, the three of them were the disciples of the branch sect leader, so ordinary disciples did not dare to provoke them.
"Eldest Senior Brother, when exactly do you plan to make a move?"
At this moment, a skinny man finally couldn't take it anymore.
A top-grade stunner like Rachel was very tempting to a lecherous person like him.
"Don't be anxious. Don't you think that something is off about them?"
A middle-aged man said in a low voice.
"What's off about them?"
The skinny man was stunned for a moment and asked with a puzzled expression.
"I know that woman is a black rank martial artist, but that guy doesn't have any aura of a martial artist, and no one recommended them to the sect, so how did they get in?"
The middle-aged man said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1942: Heavenly Demon Altar
chapters.content:
Chapter 1942: Heavenly Demon Altar
"I also feel that something is wrong. Let's just wait and see!
"If these two people have some kind of background and we rashly make a move and anger Master, then it will be troublesome!"
At this moment, another fatty also said.
"Second Senior Brother, when did you become so timid? How long has it been since we last touched a woman? It's not easy to get a beautiful woman. Are you going to give up just like that?"
The skinny man shouted in dissatisfaction.
"It's precisely because this woman is too beautiful and that guy gives me an indescribable feeling that I'm so cautious!"
The middle-aged man explained in a low voice.
"I don't care anymore. I have to properly enjoy myself with this woman today…"
The skinny man shouted and chased after Connor and Rachel.
The middle-aged man and the fat man looked a little helpless when they saw the skinny man chasing after them, but they also hurriedly followed the skinny man.
On the other side, Connor noticed that someone was running toward him. He smiled faintly and immediately reached out to grab Rachel's hand. Then, he turned around and walked into an alley.
This alley was a dead end. There was no one there at all.
Connor had obviously lured those people in on purpose. This way, Connor could get rid of these people without anyone knowing.
When the thin man saw Connor enter a dead end, he seemed a little smug. Then, he hurriedly followed Connor and ran in.
However, in the next second, his vision turned black.
Connor's aura instantly killed the thin man.
The pitiful skinny man did not even know what had happened just now. How did he die in Connor's hands?
Rachel saw the skinny man fall and understood why Connor had suddenly dragged her into this alley.
The middle-aged man and the fat man followed the skinny man, but they found the skinny man's body as soon as they entered the alley.
"You killed my junior brother?"
Fatty was a little angry. He immediately rushed toward Connor and Rachel.
"Second brother, be careful!"
The middle-aged man realized that something was wrong and hurriedly shouted.
However, it was already too late. Connor waved his right hand gently, and Fatty also fell on his face.
The middle-aged man looked at the two corpses on the ground with extreme despair because he knew that his guess was correct. Connor was indeed not an ordinary person.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at the middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment before kneeling down in front of Connor with a bang. Then, he stuttered and shouted, "Sir, please spare my life. I'm sorry…"
"You're a Blood Moon Sect disciple?"
Connor asked.
"Yes…"
The middle-aged man nodded.
"Then, do you know where the leader of this branch is?"
Connor continued to ask.
"Are you here to find the branch leader?"
The middle-aged man was stunned for a moment and asked in a puzzled tone.
"Yes…"
Connor nodded slowly.
"The branch sect leader should be at the Heavenly Demon Altar now…"
The middle-aged man knew how terrifying Connor's strength was, so he did not dare to hide anything from Connor.
"Can anyone enter the Heavenly Demon Altar?"
Connor knew that there were many guards in the branch, so some places could not be accessed that easily. At this time, Connor wanted to preserve his strength and was not willing to waste too much energy.
"The Blood Moon Sect's sacrificial ceremony will begin in a few days, so there are people guarding the Heavenly Demon Altar. Not everyone can enter…"
The middle-aged man hurriedly said.
"I know…"
Connor lightly nodded and slowly raised his right hand.
The middle-aged man knew that Connor was planning to kill him, so he hurriedly shouted, "Sir, if you want to enter the Heavenly Demon Altar, I can bring you in. If you kill me now, you won't be able to enter…"
"You can bring me into the Heavenly Demon Altar?"
Connor tilted his head in response, and then he stopped what he was doing.
"Yes, I can bring you in!"
The middle-aged man nodded without thinking.
"Why should I believe you?"
Connor frowned and asked.
The middle-aged man took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Sir, I am a disciple of the branch leader. I am qualified to see my master. The guards will not stop me. However, if you go over by yourself, they will definitely not let you in!"
Connor looked at the middle-aged man and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said expressionlessly, "You should know very well what the consequences of lying to me are, right?"
"Sir, even if you gave me ten thousand guts, I wouldn't dare lie to you!"
The middle-aged man said with trepidation.
"What's your name?"
Connor asked.
"My name is Luis Witt!"
The middle-aged man replied.
"Alright, bring me to the Heavenly Demon Altar now. If I find out that you're not being honest, I'll kill you immediately."
Connor said softly.
"Yes, sir…"
Luis hurriedly nodded.
Connor and Rachel then followed behind Luis. Under Luis's lead, they slowly walked toward the Heavenly Demon Altar.
Connor could feel that Luis's position in this branch was indeed quite high. Many martial artists would greet Luis when they saw him. Luis also knew that his life was in Connor's hands. Now, Connor only needed to move his finger to kill him. He did not dare to do anything suspicious.
A moment later, Luis brought Connor to a large door.
"Sir, the Heavenly Demon Altar is behind this door. The branch leader should be here!"
Luis turned and whispered to Connor.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded at Luis.
After hesitating for a moment, Luis walked toward the guards at the door and said with a smile, "Senior Brothers, I'm here to see Master!"
"Junior Brother Witt. Master is inside. Go on in!"
The two guards knew Luis and opened the door for him without any hesitation.
Connor and Rachel wanted to follow Luis in.
However, at this moment, the two guards stopped Connor and asked expressionlessly, "Who are you two?"
"Senior Brother, these two are the people Master wants to see!"
Luis hurriedly explained.
"..."
One of the guards did not say anything after hearing Luis's words.
Another person said expressionlessly, "Master has already instructed that no one else is allowed to enter the Heavenly Demon Altar other than the disciples of the branch. If the two of them are the people Master wants to see, then let them wait!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1943: Besieged
chapters.content:
Chapter 1943: Besieged
"But…"
Luis was a little nervous, and then he whispered, "Senior Brother, can you make an exception?"
"No, this is a special occasion. If anything happens, I can't bear the responsibility!"
The guard said with a very serious expression.
"But…"
For a moment, Luis didn't know what to do. He turned and looked at Connor.
However, Connor knew that he could not enter the Heavenly Demon Altar without being noticed, so he could only choose to attack.
Without any hesitation, Connor waved his right hand and two rays of light flashed.
The two guards instantly fell in front of Luis.
When Luis saw this scene, he was completely dumbfounded. He was extremely shocked.
He never thought that Connor would be so bold as to directly kill these two guards at the door.
"It's over…"
Luis shouted exasperatedly.
As expected, someone soon discovered that these two guards had died in Connor's hands.
More than ten people rushed toward Connor.
The one who was in front was a young man. The young man was wearing a black tight-fitting suit, and his face had a trace of anger. He shouted at Connor, "Who dares to come to our branch to cause trouble?"
Luis subconsciously turned to look at the young man. He knew that this young man was the disciple of the branch elder, and he was a level two black rank.
"It's these two people. Not only did they kill my two junior brothers, but they also killed the guards!"
Luis seized this opportunity and hurriedly shouted at the top of his voice, as if he was planning to cut ties with Connor.
When Connor heard Luis's words, he slowly turned to look at Luis. Then, he suddenly waved his right hand, and an aura pierced through Luis's forehead like a bullet.
Luis's body slowly fell to the ground.
The young man seemed even angrier after seeing this scene. He then rushed toward Connor.
But before the youth could reach Connor, a dazzling golden light flew past.
The young man subconsciously looked down at his own body, and then his eyes widened.
Just a ray of light had beheaded the young man, and blood instantly spurted out.
At this moment, there was already quite a number of disciples rushing over. When they saw this scene, they were in disbelief. After all, the young man was considered outstanding among these disciples. However, who would have thought that the young man would not have any chance to fight back in front of Connor?
"Who is this person?"
"I've never seen this person before. How can this person's strength be so terrifying?"
"No wonder he dared to barge into our branch. It seems that he's really capable!"
The disciples of the branch could not help but discuss in a low voice. However, no one dared to make a move because they knew that if they did, they would die.
Moreover, this was not the first time such a situation had happened. In the end, it was always resolved by the core experts of the branch. It was not up to them at all.
Seeing that these people did not seem to have any intention of attacking him, Connor wasted no time and stretched out his hand, pushing open the door of the Heavenly Demon Altar. Then, he walked into the Heavenly Demon Altar.
However, in the next second, more than ten martial artists rushed toward Connor.
The strength of these martial artists was about the same as that young man from before. They felt that if they attacked together, they would be able to easily kill Connor.
In an instant, everyone used their own skills to attack Connor.
However, Connor could escape unscathed when facing six ancient martial arts grandmasters alone. Moreover, he killed six ancient martial arts grandmasters one after another. In front of Connor, they would not even be able to withstand a single blow.
Connor waved his right hand, and a golden light burst forth.
This golden light was accompanied by a powerful energy impact, sending those martial artists surrounding Connor flying.
For a moment, everyone was sent flying and then smashed onto the ground, moaning in pain.
When the disciples of the branch saw this scene, they were all stunned. They were dumbstruck because they felt that this was really too shocking.
Ten black rank martial artists had teamed up, but Connor killed them all in one move.
This was no longer just a difference in strength.
In fact, it was not even considered a battle.
"Who is this person?"
"Yeah. Those martial artists just now are all the elites of our branch. They couldn't even block a single aura from this person…"
"He's really terrifying. Our branch is in trouble this time!"
"I think only the branch leader can stop this person!"
Everyone was discussing in fear.
From the time the Blood Moon Sect branch was established until now, although there were many people who came to cause trouble, they all ended up in a miserable state. They had never encountered such a powerful martial artist like Connor.
Furthermore, some of the Blood Moon Sect disciples knew that they would become sacrifices, so they had no loyalty to the Blood Moon Sect. They were just too weak to resist. If someone could really free them from this hell-like valley, they would be very excited.
This was also why there were so many disciples paying attention to Connor.
They seemed to have seen a faint glimmer of hope in Connor.
Although this hope was very slim, it was still better than nothing.
Right at this moment, Connor and Rachel walked toward the center of the Heavenly Demon Altar.
When everyone saw Connor walk in, they were vexed.
This was because they knew that the branch's sect leader and elders were currently in the Heavenly Demon Altar. If Connor barged in, he might have to face the joint attack of all the experts in the branch.
"Dealing with the entire branch by himself? Is this kid crazy?"
"Yeah, I've never seen such a crazy person before."
"Maybe this person can really help us escape from this sea of suffering!"
"Stop dreaming. It's impossible for him to defeat so many experts by himself!"
At this moment, everyone felt that the hope that had just appeared was about to be shattered.
At the same time.
A sacrificial ritual was currently being carried out in the Heaven Demon Altar.
However, the sacrifice for this ritual was not the disciples of the branch, but an elder of the branch.
There were seven chairs in front of the Heavenly Demon Altar, and these seven people were the seven most powerful elders in the branch.
At this moment, there were over a thousand branch disciples sitting in the Heaven Demon Altar. All of them had their eyes tightly shut. Streams of black aura were slowly flowing into the bodies of these disciples at a speed visible to the naked eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1944: Killing Each Other
chapters.content:
Chapter 1944: Killing Each Other
A long-haired elder sat right above the Heavenly Demon Altar.
The old man was bound with iron chains, and his face was twisted in pain. From time to time, he would let out a few wails.
His body seemed to be shrinking.
The most mysterious and insane sacrificial ritual of the Blood Moon Sect was being carried out on him.
However, the sacrifice for this sacrificial ritual was the elder directly above the Heavenly Demon Altar.
The disciples below were crazily devouring the elder's aura.
The Blood Moon Sect cult leader's final sacrificial ritual was about to begin, and the branch needed ten thousand disciples as sacrifice before the ritual began. Unfortunately, even after so many years, the branch was still unable to gather such a large number of top-grade sacrifices.
That was why Dexter Monroe thought of this method in the end.
That was to let two thousand disciples devour an elder. That way, their branch would have two thousand more yellow rank martial artists.
From this sacrificial ceremony, one could see how crazy the Blood Moon Sect people were. They would not even let their own people off.
After an unknown period of time, the elder who was used as a sacrifice stopped screaming, and the aura on his body became weaker and weaker.
At this moment, an old man in a black robe slowly walked in.
This old man was Dexter, the leader of the branch.
When the seven elders saw Dexter, they hurriedly stood up.
"How is everything?"
Dexter asked calmly.
"Sect Leader Monroe, the sacrificial ceremony is about to end…"
An elder replied.
"Alright!"
Dexter nodded lightly.
"With these two thousand people, our branch can hand over a total of ten thousand sacrifices. The cult leader will definitely be very happy when he learns of this news…"
Another elder added.
"I'm afraid 10,000 people isn't enough!"
Dexter said slowly.
"What? 10,000 people isn't enough?"
When the elders heard Dexter's words, they were all stunned. Their faces were filled with shock.
"Yeah, I just got the news. Something happened to the Netherworld Sect in Oprana. A person named Connor McDonald killed the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect, Thaddeus Tidwell, the sect leader of the North Island Sect, Brantley Ledesma, and the sect leader of the Abyss Sect, Heather Clarke!"
Dexter whispered.
When everyone heard Dexter's words, they were all stunned. They were in disbelief.
After all, they knew very well how strong Thaddeus, Brantley and Heather were.
"Were they killed separately?"
An elder asked in a low voice.
"No, they were killed together!"
Dexter shook his head and continued, "These three people and the three elders of the Netherworld Sect joined forces, but they were still no match for him…"
"Who is this Connor McDonald? How could he have such terrifying strength?"
Everyone was shocked and hurriedly asked.
"I don't know who this person is. I just received the news from the chief elder. Connor's matter has nothing to do with our branch. After all, we are in Winam, not Oprana. He wouldn't be bold enough to come to Winam…"
Dexter said slowly.
"That's good news…"
The few elders eased up a little after knowing that they would not be in any danger.
"The North Island Sect and the Abyss Sect still have elders in charge, so their offerings won't be affected too much. However, the offerings of the Netherworld Sect have been set free by Connor, so our branch needs to offer an additional 5,000 offerings to the cult leader!"
Dexter continued.
"Sect Leader Monroe, that's just absurd. It was already very difficult for us to gather 10,000 sacrifices. Now that we need another 5,000, where are we going to find them?"
"That's right. These last two thousand sacrifices were only obtained by sacrificing the eighth elder…"
"Can we discuss this with Cult Leader? This is impossible!"
The elders exclaimed one after another.
Dexter was also helpless. He said softly, "I've already told them that we can't possibly do it, but the chief told me that I have to hand over 15,000 sacrifices no matter what…"
"Then, what do you plan to do?"
At this moment, an elder suddenly asked.
"I just had someone do a count. We have about 5,000 disciples left, but they're all below yellow rank, so we still need two elders to sacrifice themselves!"
Dexter said expressionlessly.
Everyone then realized what Dexter meant after hearing his words. Dexter was planning to sacrifice two more elders to complete the mission given by the chief elder.
The seven elders looked at each other, and there was tension in the air.
After all, no one was willing to sacrifice themselves to help others.
"I have already told you the current situation. As for who will make the sacrifice, it is up to you. I need an answer before tomorrow!"
Dexter said slowly.
"Sect Leader Monroe, is there no other way?"
First Elder gritted his teeth and asked.
"There isn't…"
Dexter shook his head without thinking.
"Sect Leader Monroe, aren't you just asking us to kill each other?"
Another elder shouted.
"Sigh…"
Dexter sighed softly, then said expressionlessly, "Everyone, I have no choice…"
Bang!
However, just as Dexter finished speaking, a loud bang suddenly came from the entrance of Heavenly Demon Altar.
Dexter quickly turned and saw that someone had kicked the door open.
"Who has the guts to barge into the branch's forbidden area?"
One of the elders roared.
In the next second, Connor and Rachel slowly walked into the Heavenly Demon Altar.
Connor sized up the situation in the Heavenly Demon Altar and instantly understood what was going on.
The elder on the altar was already as thin as a stick with no aura left at all.
Dexter looked at Connor expressionlessly, his face filled with confusion.
Dexter had never seen Connor before.
"Who is the sect leader of this branch?"
Connor looked at everyone and asked calmly.
"Who are you? Why did you barge into the Heavenly Demon Altar?"
Dexter asked in a low voice.
"..."
Connor looked at Dexter and asked, "Are you the sect leader of the branch?"
"That's right!"
Dexter nodded.
"Where is the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
Connor asked.
"You haven't answered my question!"
When Dexter found out that Connor was here to look for the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader, a strange look flashed across his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1945: You Better Surrender
chapters.content:
Chapter 1945: You Better Surrender
"Sect Leader Monroe, this brat is here to find trouble. Let me deal with him!"
At this moment, an elder shouted angrily and then rushed toward Connor.
In an instant, fireballs surrounded the elder's body.
Connor knew that this elder was only a beginner heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, so he was a bit disdainful.
"Fourth Elder, be careful!"
Dexter suddenly thought of something and shouted.
Unfortunately, it was too late.
Fourth Elder rushed up to Connor and then struck with his palm.
If the fourth elder's palm was placed in front of an ordinary person, it would be very terrifying. As long as it touched someone, they would be instantly burned to ashes.
However, the person standing in front of Fourth Elder was not an ordinary person, but Connor.
