Connor seemed somewhat disdainful. He easily dodged the fourth elder's palm and then turned to punch Fourth Elder in the chest.
"Pfft!"
The fourth elder spat out a mouthful of blood, and his body smashed into the wall.
Although Connor's punch did not kill the fourth elder, it had broken all of his meridians. Even if he recovered in the future, he would become a cripple.
"Why is Fourth Elder so impulsive!"
Dexter couldn't help but shout.
The other elders present were also dumbfounded at this moment. After all, Connor could instantly kill the fourth elder with a single punch, so he could definitely kill them in an instant.
This meant that Connor's strength was far above theirs!
"Who exactly are you?"
Dexter shouted at Connor.
"My name is Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied calmly.
For a moment, everyone was dumbfounded as they looked at Connor in a daze.
After all, they had just heard that Connor had faced six ancient martial arts grandmasters alone. They were very afraid of Connor. However, they never expected Connor to come to Winam so quickly.
"You... You're Connor McDonald?"
Dexter stammered.
"You know me?"
Connor asked.
"The Netherworld Sect was destroyed by you?"
Dexter continued to shout.
"Yes!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Dexter was so frightened by Connor that he took two steps back. He knew that since Thaddeus and the others couldn't defeat Connor even when they joined forces, then these people were definitely not a match for Connor. So at this moment, he had no intention of resisting.
However, this made Connor feel much more relaxed. After all, he had just been through a big battle. If Dexter and the others attacked Connor now, even if Connor won, his body would be severely injured in the end, making it impossible for him to deal with the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader.
"We... We don't even know each other. Why... why are you here?"
Dexter exclaimed with a terrified expression.
"Like I said earlier. I want to know where the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader is!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"..."
When Dexter heard Connor's words, he was filled with fear. If he revealed the position of the cult leader now, it would be equivalent to betraying the Blood Moon Sect. He would definitely die in the end.
However, if he didn't say anything, then Connor definitely wouldn't let him live.
Dexter frowned, and he was trembling in fear. He did not know what to do.
"You don't want to answer me?"
Connor said softly.
"I don't know…"
Dexter replied through gritted teeth.
"You don't know?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Then, I want to see if you really don't know or if you're pretending to not know…"
"What... What do you want to do?"
Dexter hurriedly asked.
"Kill someone!"
Connor replied indifferently. Then, he waved his right hand, and a bolt of lightning struck an elder not far away.
The elder lost his breath before he could even react to what was going on.
"Third Elder!"
Everyone hurriedly shouted.
"If you don't tell me where the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader is, I can only start with the elders of your branch and kill them one by one until you tell me the truth!"
Connor knew that these Blood Moon Sect elders were not good people, so he did not mind doing justice for the people.
If the elders of the branch were ordinary people, then Connor would not have used such an extreme method.
"Connor, don't think that the Blood Moon Sect is so easy to bully. You'll regret it sooner or later."
Dexter shouted at Connor.
"Since I can wipe out the entire Netherworld Sect, I can wipe out your small branch today. If you don't believe me, you can try!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I'll fight it out with you!"
Dexter roared and then rushed toward Connor.
However, Dexter's strength was similar to Thaddeus's, and he might even be slightly weaker than Thaddeus. After all, Winam had a true cult leader overseeing it, so the true experts of the Blood Moon Sect were all in Oprana.
After Dexter made the first move, the elders knew that they couldn't sit still and wait for death. They all wanted to attack Connor.
For a moment, everyone used all their strength, and countless moves were headed for Connor.
When Rachel saw this scene, she couldn't help but feel a little worried for Connor. Of course, Rachel wasn't worried that Connor would lose to these people, but she was worried that Connor's body wouldn't be able to take it.
Connor knew that he couldn't take the attacks head-on, so he dodged all the attacks.
These people from the branch sect was obviously inferior to those from the Netherworld Sect. Therefore, Connor seized the opportunity while dodging and sent an elder flying with a punch.
This elder's heart was instantly ripped apart by Connor, and he died on the spot.
After seeing another elder die, everyone stopped what they were doing because they knew that Connor was too strong. Even if they joined forces, they would not be Connor's match.
If they attacked now, it would only be a waste of energy.
These people could not take a single attack from Connor.
When Connor saw that everyone had stopped, he looked at Dexter expressionlessly and asked him in a low voice, "Where is the cult leader?"
"The Blood Moon Sect's power is something you can't possibly imagine. Even if I tell you where the cult leader is, you'll still die. You better surrender now!"
Dexter shouted frantically.

chapters.title: Chapter 1946: Sect Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 1946: Sect Leader
"Hehe, surrender? Don't you think that your words are very funny?"
"I dared to come to the land of the Winam, which means I'm not afraid of your Blood Moon Sect!"
Connor replied casually.
Upon hearing his words, Dexter's expression appeared somewhat desperate.
Because he knew very well that his threats against Connor were completely ineffective.
"Sect Leader Dexter, you better tell him quickly, or else we'll all die here today!"
"Yeah, Sect Leader Dexter, it's already gotten to this point. Are you really going to watch all of us die here?"
Several elders from the sect were highly agitated as they shouted at Dexter.
He took a deep breath and whispered to Connor, "I really don't know the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect headquarters."
"You, as the sect leader of the Blood Moon Sect, don't even know where the headquarters is?" Connor couldn't help but furrow his brow.
"When the Four Great Sects of Oprana besieged our sect leader back then, he learned his lesson and became cautious. He never revealed his location, so it's normal that I don't know where the headquarters is. But..."
He paused, seeming hesitant.
"But what?" Connor asked.
"But I have a way to find the headquarters..." Dexter said in a low voice.
"What way?" he inquired.
Dexter looked at him for a moment, then took a compass-like device from his clothing and said in a low voice, "Every year, I use this compass to find the location of the headquarters during the ritual. This compass is very unique; it only shows the direction on the day the ritual begins and remains inactive otherwise."
"So you mean, as long as we wait for the day of the ritual, we can use this compass to find the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect?" After receiving the compass, Connor asked softly.
"Yes, that's right..." Dexter nodded hurriedly.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then reached out and grabbed Dexter's head.
In an instant, Dexter felt an immensely powerful force surging into his body, followed by excruciating pain tormenting him like a raging fire.
"Did you lie to me with what you said just now?" Connor asked softly, his voice directed at Dexter.
"No, everything I said was the truth. I really didn't lie to you. Please spare me..." Dexter cried out in great pain.
Connor understood that under this kind of torment, Dexter would never lie to him, so he slowly said, "Since you didn't lie to me, then prepare to die!"
"You..." Dexter suddenly raised his head to look at Connor.
The next moment, Connor was about to kill Dexter completely.
But at that moment, a dark figure rushed toward his position.
"Connor, be careful!" Rachel shouted urgently.
Upon hearing her words, he instinctively turned to look, and the dark figure slapped him in the chest. He staggered back two steps to stabilize himself.
Seeing this dark figure, Dexter was overwhelmed with excitement. He fell to the ground with a loud crash and cried out emotionally, "I pay my respects to the Sect Leader!"
"What? The Sect Leader has come?"
"The Sect Leader has come to save us!"
The other elders who had never seen the real Sect Leader before also knelt down and shouted loudly, "We pay our respects to the Sect Leader!"
"Is this person the Sect Leader of the Blood Moon Sect?" she asked, her expression puzzled.
At this moment, Connor was also observing the dark figure in front of him. He couldn't clearly see the figure's appearance, but he could sense that the figure in front of him was not just one person, because he couldn't feel any breath from the figure.
"Could this dark figure also be a remnant soul?" A bold idea flashed through Connor's mind.
Others might not be able to discern what this dark figure really was, but Connor could. After all, he had gained his current strength through the power of an old man's remnant soul.
So he believed that the dark figure in front of him was not the actual Sect Leader but a remnant soul of the Sect Leader.
...
After learning that the dark figure in front of him was just a remnant soul of the Blood Moon Sect's leader, Connor's expression visibly relaxed. He knew that the power of a remnant soul couldn't compare to the real thing, so this remnant soul wouldn't pose much of a threat.
The dark figure was also observing Connor. "Who are you, and why are you looking for me?" The figure spoke with a chilling and terrifying voice.
"I want to find someone in your possession," Connor replied calmly.
"Taran Saber, is it?" The dark figure seemed surprisingly human and even capable of thinking.
"Yes," Connor nodded.
"I advise you to leave the land of the Winam quickly, or I will make you suffer a gruesome death. I can overlook the fact that you destroyed my Yellow Springs Sect, but if you dare to harm my sect members further, I will hunt you down even if it means invading Oprana myself!" The dark figure issued a warning.
Connor couldn't help but sneer at this moment and then said indifferently, "Since I dared to come to the land of the Winam, I'm not afraid of your retaliation. You're just a remnant soul now, yet you still want to threaten me. It's laughable!"
"You can tell that I'm just a remnant soul?" The dark figure's tone sounded surprised.
"Of course, I can." Connor replied nonchalantly, then rushed towards the dark figure.
"Don't kill him!" But at that moment, a voice suddenly echoed in Connor's mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1947: A Thousand Year Old Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 1947: A Thousand Year Old Soul
After Connor heard this voice, he could not help but be stunned for a moment.
He hurriedly stopped and asked in a low voice,"Who is it? Who is speaking?"
When everyone heard Connor's words, their expressions were very puzzled.
They didn't know what he meant.
"There's no need to look for me. I'm in your mind. Only you can hear what I say. You don't need to make a sound."
The other party explained calmly.
"Are you in my mind?"
After he heard this, the expression on his face seemed to be even more puzzled.
"Do you still remember the person who gave you strength at the bottom of the cliff?"
The other party said.
"I remember…" Connor replied.
"I am that person. However, my power has been completely absorbed by you. When I fused my power into your body, I left behind a few pieces of consciousness!"
The other party said slowly.
"Are you saying that you've been in my mind for so long?" He could not help but frown.
"Not really. That remnant soul of mine has long been absorbed by you. However, I have left behind a few strands of consciousness for you in advance. As long as you encounter something related to me when I was alive or if I sense some special aura, my consciousness will awaken. After which, I will tell you how to find my soul…"
The other party continued to explain.
"You mean, as long as I encounter something or someone related to you when you were alive, your consciousness will be activated to talk to me. I can't talk to you normally, right?"
Connor seemed to have understood the old man's meaning.
"Something like that. The reason why my consciousness can be activated now is because you met someone who can use soul power like me!"
"Someone who uses soul force like you?"
He was stunned.
"Yes, I can feel that the strength of the owner of this remnant soul should be very terrifying. He can even compete with me at my peak. His soul has existed in this world for at least a thousand years. However, he seems to have lost his physical body. In addition, the consumption of these thousand years has caused his strength to be far inferior to before."
"No wonder he needs so many sacrifices every year. It turns out that he's devouring other people's souls to keep his own soul alive!" he sighed in his heart.
"That's not the most important thing. The most important thing is that he seems to have found a way to revive himself. He's prepared to use someone else's body to revive himself. Once he succeeds in reviving, although he can't recover his full strength, he can at least recover half of it. Even if it's half, no one can be his match according to the current Ancient Martial Arts realm..."
The old man continued.
When Connor heard the old man's words, he instantly understood what was going on.
The Blood Moon Sect's Sect Leader was not a person at all. Instead, he was a soul that had lived in this world for thousands of years, or rather, a ghost!
Taran's body was very special. It could resurrect the Blood Moon Sect Leader's soul. If this person was resurrected successfully, the entire ancient martial arts world would probably be under his control.
After all, no ancient martial art practitioner could resist a powerhouse from a thousand years ago.
Connor only obtained the power of a remnant soul and already possessed such terrifying strength. If it was this old man's main body, how terrifying would his combat strength be!
He felt a chill down his spine when he thought of this, because he never thought that he would accidentally discover such a big secret.
If it wasn't for Connor wanting to find Taran, it was estimated that there would be less than ten days left before the world of ancient martial arts was ruled by this person.
"You're right. This is what I want to tell you. Therefore, you must stop this person from reviving no matter what!"
The old man knew that he had understood his meaning.
"Don't worry, Taran is very important to me. Even if it's not for others, but for myself, I will never let him succeed!"
Connor directly replied to the old man and then continued to ask,"Right, why did you stop me from killing this remnant soul just now?"
"Killing this remnant soul won't do you any good, but if you absorb its power, it will be of great help to your strength!"
the old man said.
"Absorb the power of this remnant soul?"
Connor's expression was a little shocked when he heard this because he didn't know how to absorb this remnant soul.
"It is very normal that you do not know how to absorb this soul fragment now. After all, you have not learned how to control Spiritual Strength. I can help you absorb this soul fragment now. The prerequisite is that you have to let me control your body…"
The old man continued.
"Let you control my body?"
When Connor heard the old man's words, his expression seemed to be a little hesitant.
After all, he didn't know who this old man was. He didn't trust this old man. If he really let this person control his body, wouldn't it be troublesome if the other party didn't return his body?
"Don't worry, if I really wanted your body, I could have controlled it at the bottom of the cliff. I'm just a consciousness, I can only control your body for a part of the time. At that time, even if I wanted to occupy your body, I couldn't!"
Because the old man knew all of his thoughts, he took the initiative to explain.
Connor felt that what the old man said was actually very reasonable. Moreover, this person could be considered his savior. If it wasn't for this person who saved him at the bottom of the cliff, he would have died long ago.
"Alright, I believe you. What should I do?"
He said happily.
"Follow my method…"
The old man began to let Connor's soul gradually break free from the control of his body.
A few seconds later, he realized that his soul was really leaving his body bit by bit.
A moment later, his soul completely broke free from the shackles of his body. At this moment, he was even looking at himself from the perspective of a bystander. This feeling made him feel very strange.
Although the amount of information in the conversation between Connor and the old man was very large, because it was a communication between consciousness, all of this happened in less than a second.
It gave Rachel the feeling that Connor's body suddenly stopped.
His soul seemed to want to communicate with Rachel, but no matter what sound he made, she didn't have any reaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1948: Absorbing the Remnant Soul
chapters.content:
Chapter 1948: Absorbing the Remnant Soul
And at that moment, Connor's body underwent a significant transformation.
His eyes turned blood-red, and dazzling light radiated from within him.
He knew the old man had regained control of his body.
"This... How was this possible? It was the power of the soul!"
The shadow, upon witnessing this scene, appeared somewhat shocked.
Yet the old man remained silent, directly starting to channel his breath.
"What's going on? You were just a mortal; how could you use the power of the soul? Who are you, really?"
The shadow's voice screeched with a menacing tone.
However, those present had no idea what was happening; they didn't understand what had just occurred, or why the previously composed shadow had now gone insane.
After a moment, a vortex-like black hole formed in front of Connor.
Upon seeing this vortex, the shadow screamed and tried to escape.
"Cult Leader, you can't just leave us like this!"
Dexter saw the shadow attempting to flee and became even more excited. He shouted at the top of his lungs.
But the shadow didn't care at this point. Although the remnant soul was just a part of his actual soul, if it were swallowed by Connor like this, it would still have a significant impact on the Cult Leader himself.
The shadow madly rushed towards the outside of the Heavenly Demon Altar.
In the eyes of the onlookers, this scene was exceedingly bizarre. The once formidable leader of the Blood Moon Sect, who had just been attacking fiercely, was now running away like a madman. No one knew what exactly had transpired.
However, this vortex seemed to possess immense power and continuously pulled the shadow.
"Connor, you dare to consume my remnant soul; I won't let you off!"
The shadow screamed.
And in the next moment, it was pulled directly into the vortex.
Seeing this scene, everyone remained frozen in place, their expressions filled with disbelief.
Because no one expected the sudden appearance of the Blood Moon Sect's leader to be devoured by Connor.
Dexter, at this moment, didn't know how to describe his feelings. He thought Connor had just devoured the actual Blood Moon Sect leader. The leader, who he considered incredibly powerful, had now been consumed like this, which was a massive blow to him.
The other elders were equally perplexed, staring blankly at Connor's position, not knowing how to describe their own feelings. Everything was just too strange.
"Cult Leader... Did the Cult Leader just... die like this?"
Dexter couldn't help but stammer.
Meanwhile, the old man indeed had no intention of taking control of Connor's body. Instead, after devouring the remnant soul of the leader, he directly returned Connor's body to him.
After regaining control of his body, Connor's eyes returned to normal.
"Now I've helped you absorb the power of this remnant soul, but it will take some time to assimilate it."
The old man slowly spoke.
Connor could feel a force not belonging to him now filling his body.
"Thank you."
Connor replied.
"I did this to help you grow stronger quickly. That way, you can help me find my true soul."
The old man said.
"By the way, I don't even know your name. Can you tell me your name? That way, I can have someone investigate your situation."
Connor hastily asked.
"I am Carl Benjamin."
The old man answered.
"Carl Benjamin?"
Connor paused upon hearing this and continued, "What era are you from? Do you remember where your family lived?"
Although he asked several questions in a row, the old man's voice remained silent.
He realized that the old man's consciousness had disappeared.
Previously, he was curious about why the old man had shown him how to find him but hadn't left any clues. Even if he wanted to find him, he wouldn't know where to start.
Now, he understood that Carl was not a fool. The situation was urgent, so he left a message in Connor's mind. When the right time comes, his consciousness will be activated to remind Connor how to find his true soul.
In any case, Connor's visit to the Blood Moon Sect's branch had not been in vain. He not only discovered a method to locate the Sect's leader but also inexplicably devoured a remnant soul of the leader, which would make him even stronger. Most importantly, Connor now knows the secret of the Blood Moon Sect leader.
"Connor, are you alright?"
Just at this moment, Rachel's voice reached Connor's ears.
He hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at her and softly said, "Don't worry. I'm fine."
"It's good that you're okay."
She nodded upon hearing his words, her expression visibly relieved.
Although he is unharmed, Dexter and the others were still in shock. They believe that Connor had just killed the leader of the Blood Moon Sect.
"Mr. Connor, I've already told you everything I know. Please, I beg you, spare us!"
Dexter knelt on the ground, his expression highly emotional as he pleaded with Connor.
"Yes, Mr. Connor, I'm willing to follow you. Whatever you ask us to do, we'll do it. Please, spare us!"
The remaining elders were also kneeling on the ground, shouting towards Connor.
"Do you think we should spare these people?" He turned his head and asked her softly.
Rachel, in turn, looked at the disciples inside the Heavenly Demon Altar, her face expressionless, and said, "It's because of these people that countless innocent lives were offered as sacrifices to the Blood Moon Sect. Even if they die ten thousand times, it's well-deserved!"
"I think the same." Connor nodded gently, then turned to Dexter and the others, saying, "Now go and repay the lives of those innocent common people!"
After saying this, a cold light flashed.
Dexter and the elders all lost their heads.
After eliminating them, Connor walked over to Rachel.
She hesitated for a moment, then softly asked, "What's your plan now?"
At this moment, she believed that the leader of the Blood Moon Sect had been eliminated.
"I'm going to find the leader of the Blood Moon Sect and rescue Taran," he calmly stated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1949: The Cult Leader Is Dead?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1949: The Cult Leader Is Dead?
"Didn't you destroy the Blood Moon Sect Master?"
Rachel's expression seemed even more puzzled when she heard Connor's words. She had just witnessed him devouring that shadow!
"That wasn't the real Blood Moon Cult Leader!" He shook his head and continued, "I just devoured a remnant soul, not the actual soul of the Blood Moon Cult Leader. His true soul should be hidden somewhere else in Willborough!"
"Remnant soul?" She was momentarily confused and asked, "What is a remnant soul?"
"A remnant soul can be understood as a part of a person's soul," he explained, though he himself didn't have a deep understanding of remnant souls.
"A part of a soul?" Her eyes widened in astonishment. Despite being a martial artist, she found the concept of souls quite incredible and had difficulty grasping the meaning of remnant souls.
"Earlier, you were curious about why I suddenly became so powerful, right? It's because I inadvertently absorbed a person's remnant soul, granting me this immense strength. But honestly, I don't fully understand what remnant souls are either. You can think of remnant souls as a substitute for a person's soul. The one I killed earlier was merely a substitute for the Blood Moon Cult Leader!" he continued.
"If someone can control their own soul, does that mean there are gods and ghosts in this world?" she hastily asked.
"It's possible." He nodded.
She looked at him, her face filled with shock. This journey with Connor had certainly broadened her horizons.
Meanwhile, outside the Heavenly Demon Altar, many disciples of the Blood Moon Sect had gathered. They seemed to be awaiting an outcome.
For years, no one had dared to openly enter the Heavenly Demon Altar like Connor and Rachel did. They were the first.
So, they were curious about whether Connor and Rachel would make it out of the Heavenly Demon Altar.
Moreover, this could determine their freedom. If Connor and Rachel emerged from the Heavenly Demon Altar, it meant that Dexter and the others were dead at Connor's hands. In that case, they would no longer be under the control of the Blood Moon Sect and wouldn't have to serve as sacrifices.
Their emotions were quite complex, and they were silently hoping for a miracle.
"Why hasn't anyone come out yet?" A middle-aged man seemed to be growing impatient, furrowing his brow.
"Yeah, it's been quite a while. Shouldn't the outcome have been decided by now?" another person chimed in.
"I wonder if those two actually managed to kill the Cult Leader," a young man mused.
"This..." Just then, a middle-aged man who had been with the Blood Moon Sect for a long time spoke up.
Upon hearing his words, the people there wore expressions of resignation and sighed.
After all, the words of that middle-aged man made sense. The Cult Leader of the branch and the other elders were simply not comparable to the average disciples in terms of strength.
"It seems that even if gods came, we still wouldn't have a chance!" someone sighed.
"The door is opening..." At that moment, a young man suddenly exclaimed.
Although their hearts were heavy, the crowd still looked towards the entrance.
Moments later, the doors swung open, and two figures slowly walked out of the Heavenly Demon Altar. Those two were none other than Connor and Rachel.
"They actually survived..."
"How is this possible?"
"Could it be that they really killed the Cult Leader?"
At that moment, everyone present was left dumbfounded. Their expressions conveyed their shock, and they couldn't believe what they were seeing.
After stepping out of the Demon Altar, Connor stared expressionlessly at the people outside.
Rachel softly asked him, "What do you plan to do with these people?"
"These people are just unfortunate commoners who were used as tools for the Sect Leader's revival. Let them go," he calmly replied.
"Agreed!" She shared the same sentiment. She stepped forward and called out, "The Sect Leader of the Blood Moon Sect and the other elders are all dead!"
"What? Is the Sect Leader really dead?"
"Is it true or not? Could there really be someone in this world who can kill our Sect Leader..."
"Who are these two, exactly?"
Hearing her words, the crowd started whispering among themselves, seemingly unable to believe her.
"If you don't believe it, you can go inside and see for yourself!" she replied, expressionless.
However, the disciples of the Blood Moon Sect, who had been enslaved for so long, didn't dare to enter the Heavenly Demon Altar.
"We have regained our freedom from now on. If you want to stay here, then stay. If you want to leave, you should do so quickly!" she continued.
"Is what you're saying really true?" a middle-aged man shouted.
She glanced at the middle-aged man and calmly said, "We've been out here for quite some time. If your Cult Leader were still alive, why hasn't he come out?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1950: Headquarters
chapters.content:
Chapter 1950: Headquarters
After everyone heard her words, they felt that what Rachel said made sense.
Hence, they began to shout one after another, their expressions extremely excited.
After all, after being trapped here for so many years, they could finally see the light of day again. How could they not be happy?
The middle-aged man who spoke to Rachel earlier could not help but hesitate for a moment.
Then, he directly knelt in front of her and Connor and shouted, "Thank you for saving my life!"
After the other disciples heard the middle-aged man's words, they finally reacted. The reason why they were able to regain their freedom was all because of Connor and Rachel.
Therefore, all the disciples knelt in front of them and shouted in unison, "Thank you for saving my life!"
At this moment, the scene was actually very shocking.
Rachel also revealed a rare smile. She turned her head to look at Connor and softly said, "This time, the two of us can be considered to have done something meaningful!"
"Let's go back!"
Connor was not in the mood to accept the admiration and adoration of these people, because he had more important things to do next.
Rachel didn't say much either and directly followed him as they walked towards the outside of the valley.
Meanwhile, the people in the valley began to frantically plunder the belongings inside the sub-sect's main hall. It's worth noting that over the years, the sub-sect had accumulated quite a wealth. Even if these things were distributed among these people, it would be enough for them to live a lifetime in Willborough.
This time, Connor and Rachel had saved countless innocent ordinary people. After leaving the Blood Moon Sect, the two returned to Willborough.
He had just absorbed a fragment of the Blood Moon Sect's leader's soul, so he planned to absorb the power of the fragment in the next few days.
Because the compass could only work when the ritual began, they had to wait in Willborough for the next few days, with nothing to do.
In fact, the Blood Moon Sect had existed in this world for over a thousand years. However, it had disappeared for a period for unknown reasons, only to reappear in people's sights a hundred years ago when the leaders of the four major sects jointly drove the Blood Moon Sect away.
But the leader of the Blood Moon Sect did not die; instead, he came to Winam and established a new Blood Moon Sect there.
Over the years, the scale of the Blood Moon Sect in Winam had developed to a terrifying extent. Many high-ranking figures and wealthy merchants in Winam seemed to have close ties with the Blood Moon Sect, conducting secretive transactions continuously.
Some even said that the highest-ranking individuals in the Winam were disciples of the Cult Leader.
Whether in the business world, politics, or the military, the Blood Moon Sect possessed a terrifying influence.
It could even be said that the true controllers of Winam were the Blood Moon Sect.
Such a situation was simply unimaginable here!
And the headquarters of the Blood Moon Sect was actually hidden in the suburbs of Willborough on Sutie Mountain!
However, the leader of the Blood Moon Sect had always been very cautious. He changed the location of the main sect almost every year to ensure that no one could find him.
This was a reluctant act to prevent a repeat of the past before his resurrection.
Sutie Mountain was also a famous tourist destination in Willborough. However, for some unknown reason, it had been sealed off last year. Soldiers guarded it year-round, and it was rumored to have become a military zone. Anyone who dared to trespass would be killed without hesitation.
What puzzled the ordinary people of Willborough was why such a military zone often had businessmen and even high-ranking officials appearing.
They didn't know that this was actually the headquarters of the Blood Moon Sect.
And the leader of the Blood Moon Sect lived here.
At this moment, in a luxurious hall on Sutie Mountain, a shadow was seated at the front, and countless disciples and elders of the Blood Moon Sect knelt below.
This shadow was none other than the leader of the Blood Moon Sect.
As Carl had said, the leader of the Blood Moon Sect had existed in this world for over a thousand years, but he wasn't human; he was a ghost.
Unfortunately, the sect had no way of knowing this because very few people could get close enough to see the leader in person. Even some important elders had to stand ten meters away when speaking to the leader.
"Why? Why?"
"Why can an ordinary person use the power of the soul? Who is he, exactly? Could he be like me?"
Because he had just absorbed a fragment of the leader's soul, the leader of the Blood Moon Sect's aura was extremely unstable at the moment, and even his soul had been affected, giving a sense of elusiveness.
Looking at the expression on the leader's face, everyone was filled with fear. They knew that the leader was extremely angry at the moment.
"I must personally kill this person and let him know the consequences of offending me!"
At this moment, the leader suddenly roared and then stood up, intending to leave.
"Leader, please don't!"
At this moment, an elder hastily shouted.
"What's wrong?"
The leader's expression looked somewhat angry as he asked in a cold voice.
"Leader, the ritual is about to begin. This Connor is quite skilled, and his cultivation should be at the level of a Two-Star Ancient Martial Master. If you kill him now, it may delay the ritual!"
The elder hurriedly replied.
"Yes, Leader, the ritual is of the utmost importance. We've worked so hard for so many years, and we're finally about to see this day. You can't give up just because of this person!"
"As long as you break through to the Celestial Ancient Martial Master level, what can a mere Connor amount to?"
"We absolutely cannot let him affect the grand plan!"
Others also joined in to persuade.
After hearing these words, the leader's expression slightly eased, and he stopped in his tracks, saying in a low voice, "You're not wrong. I can't let Connor disrupt our plans. As long as I complete the ritual, there will be no one in this world who can rival me. What is Connor compared to that?"
"Right, right..."
Everyone quickly nodded in agreement.
After hesitating for a moment, the leader spoke in a low voice, "Connor seems to be targeting Taran. I can't let him interfere with my ritual..."
"Leader, what do you plan to do?"
The Chief Elder hastily asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1951: Nine Deaths and One Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 1951: Nine Deaths and One Life
"Notify the securities to strengthen their vigilance!"
"I think on the day of the sacrificial ceremony, Connor will definitely come to cause trouble. We need to be prepared so that he can't leave alive!"
The leader said expressionlessly.
"Leader, are you planning to use the securities to deal with Connor?"
The Grand Elder paused for a moment, then asked in a hushed tone.
"Yes, given the current situation, if we act rashly, we will definitely incur some losses."
"So, we might as well use firepower directly, a preemptive strike! This Connor, even if he's a Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master, he won't have any chance of survival against large-scale weapons!"
The leader nodded lightly.
"Alright, I understand. I'll inform them right away!"
The Grand Elder agreed and then left.
The leader remained seated in silence. He had just realized that if he went to confront Connor now, it would certainly affect the sacrificial ceremony. If the special forces of the Winam were to take action, it would be much simpler. This would not only reduce the damage to their Blood Moon Sect but also not disrupt the normal conduct of the ceremony.
Of course, if they waited until after the ceremony, by then, he might have fully resurrected, and he wouldn't even consider someone like Connor.
At that time, Connor would be like an ant in his eyes.
A while later, the Grand Elder returned to the leader and whispered, "Leader, I've communicated with the troops. They said they can increase their vigilance during this time, and if Connor dares to enter Sutie Mountain, they will handle it as an intrusion into a military restricted area and eliminate Connor at all costs!"
"Good, I understand!"
The leader, upon hearing this, nodded in satisfaction.
...
On the other side.
After Connor and Rachel returned to Willborough, he chose to go into seclusion.
Seven days later, he finally completely absorbed the residual power of the leader's soul. At this moment, he felt that he had reached the peak of the local-tier ancient martial master realm. With this level of strength, he was more confident in dealing with the leader of the Blood Moon Sect.
He got up and walked out of his room, intending to see what Rachel was doing.
"You've finally come out!"
She let out a long sigh of relief upon seeing Connor come out, then continued, "If you didn't come out, I was starting to think you might have died in your room..."
"Can't you say something more pleasant?"
His expression appeared somewhat helpless as he asked, "By the way, how have you been these past few days?"
"What else could I do? Most of the time, I've been watching TV here, but the TV shows here are so boring, not enjoyable at all!"
She shrugged and continued, "I also had my people investigate the details of the Blood Moon Sect."
"What did you find out?" he asked.
"The Blood Moon Sect is indeed very powerful. The leader is said to be a local-tier ancient martial master, and there are over a dozen elders, most of them in the early stages of the Heaven-tier ancient martial master realm. The sect has thousands of disciples, and their strength is not weak either," she explained slowly.
"It sounds like their overall strength is similar to that of the factions here, but they have a much larger number of disciples," he commented.
"Yes, although it sounds similar, the leader of the Blood Moon Sect is not an ordinary person. He not only has terrifying strength but also controls many high-ranking individuals in the Winam. Even the Yamen is under his influence. These people all obey his orders and provide a significant amount of offerings every year, which are essentially martial artists!" she continued.
"I never expected their influence to extend into the military." He couldn't help but sigh.
"Yes, when I first heard this news, I found it hard to believe as well. This leader practically controls the entire Winam!" she said.
"So, are you saying that if we try to confront the Blood Moon Sect now, Winam might use military force against us?" he asked.
"That's right. I mean exactly that. Although Winam's strength isn't very formidable, I think it would be relatively easy for them to deal with you alone. So, you don't need to think too hard about it. If you walk into their trap, you might really be in a life-or-death situation!"
"A life-or-death situation?"
Connor couldn't help but smile when he heard Rachel's words.
"Why are you laughing? It's already this serious, and you're still in the mood to laugh?" Rachel exclaimed in exasperation.
"If I don't rescue Taran now, that would be a true life-or-death situation!" he said to her.
Upon hearing Connor's words, Rachel was taken aback, her expression filled with shock. For a moment, she didn't know what to say.
"What do you mean by that?" she finally asked, her eyebrows furrowed in confusion.
Originally, Connor had no intention of revealing the truth about the Blood Moon Sect's leader's plan to use someone else's body for resurrection. After all, it would be difficult for Rachel to understand such concepts without further explanation. However, the situation had changed, and if Connor didn't reveal the truth, Rachel might try to stop him from taking action against the Blood Moon Sect's leader.
So, Connor had no choice but to use the simplest and most easily understandable words to explain the situation to Rachel.
Rachel's expression was filled with astonishment as she listened to Connor's words. She stuttered in response, "Connor, are you... are you saying all of this is true?"
"Of course, it's true..."
Connor nodded gently.
"So, if what you're saying is accurate, then once the leader of the Blood Moon Sect resurrects, won't all martial artists in the world be in danger?"
Rachel continued to speak, her expression showing her shock.
"Yes..."
Connor nodded again, his expression devoid of emotion. "Although it sounded unbelievable to me when I first heard about it, it's the truth. The Blood Moon Sect leader's true goal isn't just to enhance his own strength. He intends to use these offerings to complete his own rebirth."
Her face displayed a mixture of shock and disbelief. For a moment, she didn't know what to say.
"Before, I only wanted to find Taran, which is why I decided to take action against the Blood Moon Sect. But now the situation has changed. If the Blood Moon Sect leader manages to resurrect, he will definitely come after me first. At that point, I may not have the opportunity to defeat him!"
Connor looked at Rachel and explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 1952: A Warrior
chapters.content:
Chapter 1952: A Warrior
At this moment, the Blood Moon Cult Leader was still a wisp of soul and had yet to be truly resurrected.
His strength had not fully recovered, so Connor still had a glimmer of hope.
However, once the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader was resurrected, he might not even have any hope left.
When Rachel heard this, she could not help but take a deep breath. Then, she said softly," But even if you attack those people from the Blood Moon Sect now, you'll still be in great danger. Is there no other way?"
"There's nothing else…"
Connor shook his head.
Rachel looked at him and did not know how to persuade him to give up. After all, this matter might affect the development of ancient martial arts in the world. Furthermore, if the Blood Moon Sect Cult Leader was really resurrected, Connor's situation would only become more dangerous.
"Tomorrow should be the day of the sacrificial ceremony, right?" he asked her softly.
"Yes, sir!"
She nodded.
"I might encounter a lot of danger when I go over this time. At that time, I won't have the energy to protect you at all, so you just have to stay in the hotel and wait for me to come back!" he said to her in a serious tone.
This time, she didn't choose to argue with him because she knew how dangerous his operation was. Even if she went with him, she would only be a burden to him.
"Can I really wait until you come back?" she asked him softly.
"Of course…"
Connor looked at Rachel and smiled faintly.
She took a deep breath and didn't say anything else. She couldn't help much at this time and could only pray for him in her heart, hoping that he could come back safely.
"It's getting late. Go and rest!"
He looked at her and said.
She hesitated for two seconds before turning around and returning to the bedroom.
He sat quietly on the sofa and waited for dawn.
According to Dexter, the sacrificial ceremony would officially begin at dawn.
At that time, all the Blood Moon Sect disciples would bring their offerings to the Blood Moon Sect headquarters and then give the offerings to the Cult Leader.
During this period of time, the compass could show the location of the Blood Moon Sect's headquarters. He only needed to follow the direction on the compass.
Connor sat on the sofa expressionlessly. At this moment, his mood was also very heavy because he knew that this battle would be a very big challenge for him. At this moment, Connor was not only facing the Blood Moon Sect Master, but also the obstruction of Winam. If he was not careful, he might be consigned to eternal damnation!
However, Connor still had no intention of giving up, because he had no way out now.
As time passed, the sky finally lit up.
Connor looked at the morning sun outside and took a deep breath. Then, he resolutely walked out of the room.
After Rachel heard the sound of him opening the door, she slowly walked out of the bedroom and stood there quietly. Her eyes seemed to be a little complicated.
She didn't know when it started, but she realized that she couldn't help him anymore. The current Connor seemed to be different from the one she knew before.
It seemed that no one had ever thought that his growth would be so shocking, even those from Rockferri.
After leaving the hotel, Connor took out Dexter's compass.
As expected, the compass really reacted at this time. The needle pointed to the northwest.
He walked towards the northwest direction.
The westernmost part of Willborough was where Suthep Mountain was located.
..
On the other side, within Sutie Mountain.
At this moment, Sutie Mountain was surrounded by the special forces.
Although it looked no different from the past from the outside, there were special forces hidden in every corner of the mountain. These people were quietly waiting for Connor's arrival.
From this point, one could see how influential the Blood Moon Sect was. They could directly mobilize the power of Winam. It was absolutely impossible for an ordinary ancient martial arts sect to have such influence.
However, the soldiers hiding in Sutie Mountain were not wearing military uniforms. If they wore military uniforms, their identities would change, and it might cause more unnecessary trouble.
At this moment, these people were all wearing the same black uniform, but almost everyone was equipped with weapons.
The order given to these people by the higher-ups was that as long as they found any suspicious person entering the mountain, they would immediately open fire and kill without mercy.
"Who is it? They actually needed to make such a big scene?"
"That's right, they actually brought us here and they didn't even say clearly who they were going to deal with!"
At this moment, two people were chatting softly, as if they did not know what was going to happen.
"I heard that this time we're dealing with a practitioner who came from the hot summer!"
At this moment, another middle-aged man spoke.
"A warrior?"
When the two young men heard this, they almost laughed at the same time, and the expression on their faces seemed to be a little disdainful.
"Just for one martial artist, you actually mobilized so many people and so many weapons. I even saw tanks drive in."
A young man laughed.
"Don't underestimate this martial artist. I heard that this martial artist's strength is very terrifying. The Blood Moon Sect's branch has already been wiped out by this person."
The middle-aged man reminded him kindly.
The other two young men were stunned when they heard this. Their expressions seemed to be a little shocked.
"He actually managed to wipe out the Blood Moon Sect's branch. Isn't this too ruthless?"
"That's right. I heard that the Blood Moon Sect's branch is quite strong…"
"No wonder they brought us here. It turns out that we really met a ruthless person this time!"
Everyone sighed softly.
"But you don't have to worry too much. Although that person is powerful, he's just a martial artist. A barrage of bullets will definitely turn him into a sieve!"
"That's true. No matter how powerful a martial artist is, they can't be compared to modern weapons!"
At this moment, these people were just ordinary people. They had no idea how terrifying the strength of an ancient martial arts grandmaster was.
"I heard that the people who came to carry out the mission this time are all elites from various places. As long as we can complete the mission this time, we will be rewarded very well when we return."
At this moment, a young man asked.
"It seems so. The higher-ups seem to attach great importance to this mission!"
The middle-aged man nodded lightly.
The young man's expression was a little excited when he heard this.
After all, he had thought that he would have to carry out a difficult mission. Now, he realized that it was just to deal with a martial artist. In their eyes, it was very easy to get rid of a martial artist.

chapters.title: Chapter 1953: Entering Sutie Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 1953: Entering Sutie Mountain
On the other side, following the compass's guidance, Connor finally found Sutie Mountain.
He circled around Sutie Mountain and noticed that all entrances were fenced off and guarded by soldiers. This confirmed that he was in the right place, and the headquarters of the Blood Moon Sect should be inside Sutie Mountain.
He could also sense a strange aura emanating from within the mountain. This aura didn't belong to martial artists; he had never felt such an aura in anyone else before.
"This should be the place." He took a deep breath and then turned to look at the nearest checkpoint.
He knew there was no other way to enter the mountain; he had to choose the direct approach. Although this would immediately alert the Blood Moon Sect to his presence, he had no other choice.
After some hesitation, he walked towards the checkpoint.
The guards at the checkpoint aimed their guns at him when they saw him approaching and shouted loudly in the local language, which he couldn't understand.
"Retreat! Quickly retreat!" One of the guards, realizing that Connor might not understand the local language, yelled in broken English.
These guards had not realized that the young man who looked frail standing before them was their target. They simply mistook him for a regular tourist, and since he hadn't entered Sutie Mountain yet, they didn't open fire immediately.
He glanced at the guards, then casually waved his right hand.
A powerful force immediately swept over the guards standing at the checkpoint, sending them flying through the air before crashing to the ground. They all lost their ability to move and lay on the ground, groaning in pain.
Connor walked directly to the young man who had communicated with him earlier and softly asked, "Is the headquarters of the Blood Moon Sect inside this mountain?"
The young man, who now realized his terrifying power, had a fearful expression on his face and stammered, "I... I don't know. I'm just here on a mission..."
Connor understood that these were just innocent soldiers with low ranks who were unaware of many details. He chose not to harm them further and didn't continue to press them for information. Instead, he walked straight into Sutie Mountain.
The injured guards could only watch helplessly as Connor entered, powerless to stop him.
Inside Sutie Mountain, Connor took out the compass once more.
Now, the compass's pointer pointed south.
Without hesitation, he began walking in the direction indicated by the compass.
After a while, his figure disappeared from the sight of the guards.
One of the guards who had suffered the least injury struggled to get up and helped his comrades to their feet.
The expressions on their faces were grim; they had been tasked with guarding the checkpoint, and now, someone had easily broken through. They realized their failure.
"Captain, what should we do now?" a young man asked in a low voice.
"What else can we do? We have to report this," a middle-aged man said through gritted teeth.
"But if we report it, and they investigate, how do we explain this?" the young man hurriedly asked.
"We can't just pretend nothing happened!" the middle-aged man shouted, then took out a walkie-talkie and spoke into it, "Report, there's been a breach at Checkpoint Three. The intruder seems to be our target!"
"Received!" a voice came through the walkie-talkie.
News of Connor's entry into Sutie Mountain quickly spread to everyone involved in the operation. The atmosphere inside Sutie Mountain turned eerie, as even those who had been carefree and casual began to realize that this mission might not be as straightforward as they had thought.
In a corner of Sutie Mountain, several trucks were parked, and in the center, a tent had been set up. This makeshift tent served as the command center for the operation.
Inside the tent, various devices were arranged, and in the center, there was a large screen divided into many smaller screens, monitoring several key locations in Sutie Mountain.
Due to the vastness of Sutie Mountain, it was impossible to monitor the entire area. Therefore, they had installed cameras at several important points.
However, the technology in Winam was not highly advanced, and they lacked drones. If they had drones, it would have been much easier to address this situation.
At this moment, a young man rushed into the tent and shouted, "Report!"
"What's going on?" A middle-aged man with a goatee turned to look at the young man, his expression stoic.
This middle-aged man was Tony Lockwood, the overall commander of this operation.
Tony played a significant role in Wanfo Nation, and the fact that he had been appointed as the commander for this operation showed how seriously the Wanfo Nation regarded it. It also demonstrated the formidable influence of the Blood Moon Sect.
"We just received information that someone forcibly entered Checkpoint Three. We suspect that this person is our target," the young man said in a serious tone.
Upon hearing this, Tony's expression turned somewhat unusual. He furrowed his brows and asked, "Have you located the intruder?"
"The intruder is incredibly fast. We haven't pinpointed their exact location yet," the young man replied.
"Damn it!" Tony exclaimed and clenched his fists. He then muttered, "I told you all before, as soon as you notice any suspicious individuals approaching Sutie Mountain, open fire immediately. Why did you let someone break in?"
"The person was too fast. Our people couldn't react in time, and they were taken down before we knew it," the young man explained with a distressed expression.
Tony took a deep breath and muttered under his breath, "Spread the word. From now on, everyone is on high alert. If you spot the target, report it immediately, and at any cost, ensure that person is eliminated. We cannot allow the intruder to get close to the headquarters. The consequences would be disastrous!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1954: The Battle Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 1954: The Battle Begins
"Roger!"
The young man replied and then hurriedly turned around to leave.
Tony's expression remained angry after the young man's departure. He clenched his teeth and muttered, "A bunch of useless people. How could so many of them fail to stop a single person? If the Sect Leader finds out, how will I explain this?"
"Tony, there's no need to be so anxious. This Connor is genuinely terrifying in strength. It's normal that your men couldn't stop him. The Sect Leader will never blame you for that," a voice calmly spoke.
At that moment, an elderly man entered the tent, smiling as he addressed Tony.
Tony, upon hearing the words, hesitated for a moment, then quickly stood up and approached the elderly man respectfully. He said with a smile, "Third Elder, why have you come?"
"The Sect Leader had already anticipated that your people might not be able to stop Connor, so he sent me here to assist you," the Third Elder replied casually.
"Third Elder, please rest assured. It was my people's negligence earlier, and I will definitely deal with this person. I won't let him get anywhere near the headquarters, no matter what," Tony assured.
"Hehe..." The Third Elder laughed and added, "Tony, you may not be aware, but Connor is not an ordinary martial artist. Just a few days ago, he wiped out one of our Blood Moon Sect's branches. So don't blame yourself. It's normal for ordinary people to be unable to stop him. Moreover, letting him enter Sutie Mountain is in line with the Sect Leader's intentions."
Tony hesitated upon hearing this and asked with a furrowed brow, "Third Elder, what do you mean by that?"
"Connor may have entered Sutie Mountain easily, but getting out might not be as simple. We can take advantage of this opportunity to close the trap," the Third Elder replied calmly.
"I see," Tony finally understood. He realized that letting Connor enter Sutie Mountain might have been a calculated move to set a trap for him.
"Report!" Another young man entered the tent.
Tony turned to look at him and asked with a neutral expression, "What's going on now?"
"We've now located the target. He's approaching our headquarters, and our people can't stop him. His strength is too terrifying..." the young man reported in a hushed tone.
"He's really heading toward our headquarters?" Tony's expression turned somewhat shocked upon hearing this. He then turned to the Third Elder and asked, "What should we do now, Third Elder?"
"We must intercept him at all costs. We cannot allow this person to get close to the headquarters!" the Third Elder replied, his expression changing subtly.
"Very well, I'll go myself," Tony declared, realizing that Connor's speed was far too great for his subordinates to handle. He had to take matters into his own hands to prevent Connor from reaching the headquarters.
"I'll go with you, Tony," the Third Elder added.
Without further ado, Tony led his team into action. They drove heavily armed vehicles, including tanks, towards Connor's location, preparing for what seemed like an impending battle.
Meanwhile, on the other side, Connor, following the compass's guidance, continued to approach the Blood Moon Sect's headquarters.
As he got closer to the headquarters, he felt the strange aura growing stronger. He had a vague sense that this unique aura belonged to the Blood Moon Sect's leader, who was not a martial artist but a soul, hence the distinctiveness of the aura.
On his way, Connor encountered many of Tony's men, but they didn't even have a chance to open fire before he swiftly took them down.
Tony had deployed many subordinates within Sutie Mountain, but they were currently scattered and couldn't have any significant impact on his progress. He made no attempt to hide his presence, knowing that Tony's group was already aware of his intrusion into Sutie Mountain.
Tony and his team had reached a higher ground, preparing to intercept him when he appeared.
Sitting in a vehicle, Tony's expression remained tense. He knew that if Connor managed to break into the headquarters, he would undoubtedly face the Sect Leader's wrath, and the consequences would be dire.
Approximately five minutes later, Tony's walkie-talkie crackled with a message.
"Report, the target may enter our firing range in three minutes. Should we open fire?"
Upon hearing this, his expression turned excited. He picked up his walkie-talkie and shouted, "When the target enters the firing range, eliminate him at all costs!"
"Received!" Came the swift response.
Tony squinted his eyes, staring intently ahead, patiently awaiting Connor's arrival.
As expected, three minutes later, Connor indeed appeared within the sight of the group. Though he was a mere blurry figure at first, it became evident to everyone that he was their target.
"He's finally here!" Tony took a deep breath and picked up his walkie-talkie, shouting, "Prepare to open fire!"
"Boom!"
Following his command, a deafening roar erupted within Sutie Mountain. Countless bullets were fired, all aimed at Connor.
Although the strength of Winam was not particularly formidable, they did possess conventional weaponry. These weapons carried an astonishing amount of firepower. A single bullet had the capacity to easily eliminate a Black-rank martial artist.
Despite the terrifying power of martial artists, they were still not invulnerable. Their bodies were naturally more robust than those of ordinary people, but without using body refinement techniques or qi to protect themselves, their endurance was not significantly greater.
The hail of bullets rained down upon him, creating a wall of fire and metal as the group unleashed their firepower in a concerted effort to stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1955: What Kind of Monster Is This?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1955: What Kind of Monster Is This?
In the midst of this intense standoff, it became apparent that martial artists derived their strength from enhancing their bodies using their internal energy, known as chi, to fortify their physical forms. However, no matter how robust their bodies became, they could never evolve them into steel and iron.
This was precisely why many martial artists turned to body refinement techniques to compensate for this inherent limitation. Regardless of how powerful these techniques were, they still couldn't stand up to modern weapons.
Connor, with his formidable power, dared not rely solely on his physical body to withstand the barrage of bullets. Instead, he chose to employ his qi to resist the attacks or redirect the bullets.
In a moment, the battlefield resembled a war zone, with bullets flying in all directions. The relentless assault was awe-inspiring.
"Third Elder, you can rest assured. This Connor will surely meet his end today. I can't believe anyone could survive this relentless assault!" Tony appeared quite satisfied with the situation and turned to address the Third Elder with a triumphant smile.
The Third Elder, however, gazed calmly ahead, his expression unwavering.
"Report, the attack is complete!" Tony's walkie-talkie crackled with an update.
"Very well!" Tony nodded in satisfaction. He then looked at the devastated area ahead, wearing a smug expression. "Third Elder, it seems our previous concerns were unnecessary. While Connor possesses extraordinary strength, he is now nothing more than a lifeless body beneath my barrage of bullets!"
"How can you be sure Connor is dead?" The Third Elder asked in a low voice.
Tony was momentarily taken aback by the question and replied, "Don't joke with me! Look at what's ahead! It's practically turned into a hellish landscape. Who could possibly survive such an onslaught? Even a fly wouldn't make it!"
"Look again," the Third Elder instructed, pointing ahead.
Tony followed the Third Elder's gaze and was left in disbelief. Connor appeared unscathed and continued approaching them. Not a scratch on him, not even his clothes were damaged.
This scene defied belief, leaving everyone stunned. They couldn't fathom what kind of creature Connor was, as he had survived their relentless attack seemingly unharmed.
"What... What is he?" Tony shouted in shock. He then picked up his walkie-talkie and ordered, "Where are the heavy armored vehicles? Send them in now!"
"Report, the heavy armored vehicles will arrive in two minutes!" came the response.
"What are you all waiting for? Stop this man immediately! Buy time for the heavy armored vehicles!" Tony shouted at his men.
His subordinates snapped out of their shock and began firing their weapons at Connor once more. While they remained at a relatively safe distance, they believed this was their best course of action.
Countless bullets were unleashed toward him, but he merely raised his hand and conjured a golden barrier of chi that effortlessly blocked the projectiles. It seemed as if nothing could harm him.
Tony stared at Connor in shock, his face filled with fear. He muttered, "What kind of monster is he? How can bullets not harm him?"
As Connor continued to advance, seemingly impervious to their gunfire, Tony received an update on the heavy armored vehicles' arrival time.
"Report, the heavy armored vehicles will arrive in two minutes!" the voice on the other end of the walkie-talkie relayed.
Tony immediately shouted at his men, "What are you all waiting for? Stop this man immediately! Buy time for the heavy armored vehicles!"
His subordinates, finally snapping out of their initial shock, raised their weapons and opened fire on Connor's position. They believed that by maintaining a safe distance, they could still pose a threat.
Countless bullets rained down upon him, but with a wave of his hand, he summoned a golden barrier of qi, protecting himself effortlessly. To the onlookers, it appeared as if he had the world's most impenetrable shield. No matter how much they fired, they couldn't harm him.
Tony stared in disbelief at him, his face filled with terror. He muttered, "What kind of monster is he? How can bullets not harm him?"
Meanwhile, the Third Elder remained deep in thought, his expression grave. As the situation grew more desperate, they needed to find a way to stop Connor's advance.
Suddenly, a series of thunderous roars pierced the air. Five to six massive vehicles emerged into view, and Tony's face lit up with excitement. These were the heavy armored vehicles he had been eagerly waiting for. In normal circumstances, deploying these vehicles would require approval from the highest authorities, but the dire circumstances had pushed them to act.
The heavy armored vehicles, designed to withstand formidable threats, had now joined the battle. However, with Connor's mysterious abilities and his unyielding progress, it remained to be seen whether even these vehicles could stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1956: Capture the Ringleader First
chapters.content:
Chapter 1956: Capture the Ringleader First
As for other heavy weapons, Winam had even fewer.
Moreover, the terrain here was extremely complex, filled with towering trees that seemed to reach the sky. Even with fighter jets, it was challenging to lock onto a target.
So, in the current situation, heavy armored vehicles were their best choice.
"Fire!" Tony grabbed the radio and shouted, his expression unusually excited.
"Boom!"
At that moment, four or five heavy armored vehicles almost simultaneously opened fire at his position.
Yet he easily evaded the attacks of the heavy armored vehicles with a simple dodge, then waved his right hand, sending a bolt of lightning down.
"Bang!"
The heavy armored vehicle seemed unable to withstand the immense energy contained in the lightning and instantly exploded.
However, this was just the beginning; several more bolts of lightning followed.
In the eyes of Tony, the lifeline he had grasped seemed to have been scrapped in an instant.
This scene was incredibly shocking to the ordinary people watching, as they couldn't fathom how Connor could control the power of lightning. In their eyes, he was no different from a deity in a television drama.
All these heavy armored vehicles had been obtained by Tony through official channels. The entire Winam had less than two hundred such vehicles of this scale, and now Connor had casually destroyed five of them. He had no idea how to explain this to his superiors.
Of course, what struck him even more was the sheer power of Connor. He could effortlessly destroy heavy armored vehicles that seemed like invincible juggernauts to ordinary people. This level of power was beyond human comprehension.
Tony's subordinates were all frightened into submission, laying down their weapons one by one as if they were preparing to flee.
"What are you all doing? Pick up your weapons quickly!" he shouted into the radio.
Upon hearing his words, the expressions on their faces showed hesitation, but none of them dared to pick up their weapons and attack Connor.
"If anyone dares to run away now, you'll be deserters, and your families and friends will be implicated by your actions!" he continued to shout.
Upon hearing this, the crowd reluctantly picked up their weapons. They knew that if they fled now, their families would suffer, so they had no choice but to take up arms and fight.
Connor looked at the people in front of him, wearing a very helpless expression because he knew that these people were also forced into this situation.
So, when facing these people, he tried to control his power as much as possible, making them lose their combat effectiveness at most, without directly killing them.
He felt that if he killed these ordinary people, his actions would be no different from those of the Blood Moon Sect.
In just a few minutes, most of Tony's subordinates were already lying on the ground.
Connor's strength was something these people couldn't resist, not even a single breath from him.
He stared at his fallen subordinates, his face showing anger and fear. He didn't know what to do.
"Third Elder, my people may not hold out much longer. You need to think of a solution quickly!" After hesitating for a moment, Tony turned to the Third Elder and shouted.
Upon hearing his words, the Third Elder's expression also became very troubled because he knew that even if he intervened, he would definitely not be Connor's match.
"We can only seek help from the Grand Master now..." The Third Elder said in a low voice.
"Can we make it in time?" Tony asked in a daze.
"Tony, if you let your people delay some time, I'll go call for reinforcements now..." After saying this, the Third Elder turned to leave.
However, at that moment, he suddenly grabbed the Third Elder, then stammered, "Third Elder, my people may not hold out much longer..."
Because his subordinates had all given up resistance, they knelt on the ground with fearful expressions.
Connor didn't waste any time on these people. He walked directly towards Tony.
Tony never expected that Connor would subdue his men so quickly. He had invested so much effort and even brought heavy armored vehicles, but in the end, he couldn't stop Connor.
"Th-Third Elder, what should we do now?" Tony stammered as he turned to the Third Elder.
The Third Elder's face showed a hint of despair upon hearing this question. He had no idea how to proceed.
A few seconds later, Connor approached the two of them.
"Did you command these people to attack me just now?" he asked Tony with a blank expression.
"I... I..." Tony didn't know how to answer his question and quickly turned to look at the Third Elder beside him.
The Third Elder hesitated for a moment and hurriedly spoke, "Connor, I am the Third Elder of the Blood Moon Sect. Our leader has a message: if you surrender now and cooperate, he can..."
Before he could finish his sentence, Connor lightly waved his right hand, and a cold light flashed.
His head instantly fell to the ground, splattering blood all over Tony's face.
"At a time like this, you still think you can threaten me with your so-called Cult Leader? It's truly laughable!" Connor said indifferently.
Tony was completely dumbfounded. After hesitating for two seconds, he knelt on the ground and stuttered, "Great Master, please spare my life!"
"You can speak Opranian English?" Connor asked, surprised.
"I lived in Yansha for a few years before. Please, I beg you, spare my life!" Tony replied with a trembling voice.
"Spare your life?" Connor chuckled upon hearing this.
"Let me tell you, I'm a general of Wanfoguo. If you kill me now, the high-ranking officials of Wanfoguo will not let you off. Do you want to provoke a larger-scale war? You can't afford the consequences!" Tony continued to shout.
"Did you ever think about the consequences when you gathered firepower and attacked me earlier?" Connor asked with narrowed eyes.
"You..." Tony was momentarily stunned.
"If I dare to come here, then there are no consequences I can't bear!" Connor said.
With that, Connor waved his hand, and a cold light flashed again.
The next moment, Tony fell to the ground in front of Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1957: Stalling for Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 1957: Stalling for Time
In Mount Sutie.
Tony and his subordinates, armed with modern weapons, had failed to kill Connor. Instead, they were soundly defeated by him, and Tony himself met his end at Connor's hands.
After Tony's death, the people on the scene looked towards the direction where Connor had gone with expressions of increased fear. They had not anticipated that he would actually dare to lay hands on the Third Elder and Tony.
"This person actually killed Tony. Does he intend to become our enemy in Winam?" a middle-aged man trembled as he sighed.
"He doesn't even care about the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader. It seems perfectly normal for him not to care about Winam," another person stammered.
"Ah..." The people couldn't help but sigh, not knowing what to do.
As Connor eliminated Tony and the Third Elder, he turned to face Tony's remaining subordinates. Seeing his gaze, they all lowered their heads and knelt on the ground, too afraid to meet his eyes. After all, he had just killed Tony, and in their eyes, they were less than ants before him.
After a moment of hesitation, he asked with a blank expression, "Which of you can speak Opranian English?"
Even after hearing his question, they kept their heads low and didn't dare to respond.
"I'm asking you, who among you can speak Opranian English?" he repeated, his tone calm.
A young man hesitated for a moment, then tremblingly stood up and whispered to Connor, "I lived in Oprana for a while..."
"Come here." He motioned to the young man.
Taking a deep breath, the young man summoned the courage to walk up to him. It was evident that he was still very fearful when facing Connor, as his body continued to tremble.
"From now on, when I ask you something, you answer me. Do you understand?" he said in a low voice.
"I understand, I understand!" The young man quickly nodded.
"Other than you people here, are there any others hiding in this mountain to ambush me?" Connor asked.
"No, there aren't," the young man shook his head.
Initially, Tony and the others didn't anticipate Connor's terrifying strength. They believed that their forces would be enough to deal with him.
"Is that the Blood Moon Sect's headquarters up ahead?" he continued to inquire.
"I'm not very sure about that. I'm not from the Blood Moon Sect!" the young man replied.
Connor knew that the young man probably wouldn't dare to lie to him now. After a moment's hesitation, he said softly, "You can all leave now, but do not return to this place. Do you understand?"
"We understand, we understand," the young man replied with great excitement. He hadn't expected Connor to spare them, and his expression was very moved.
Connor didn't pay any more attention to these people. He turned and continued walking forward. Tony's subordinates, on the other hand, ran out of the mountain like madmen after seeing him leave. They probably never wanted to return to this place in their lives.
Meanwhile, the news of Tony and the Third Elder's deaths at Connor's hands quickly reached the headquarters of the Blood Moon Sect.
"Worthless! They couldn't even stop a single Connor with so many people!" the Cult Leader roared, then stood up. "I'll personally meet this Connor now. I want to see just how capable he really is!"
"Cult Leader, the sacrificial ritual is set to begin in an hour. You must stay calm. If you miss the timing, you may have to wait another year!" the Grand Elder hurriedly advised.
The Blood Moon Sect's choice of today for the sacrificial ritual was not random. Resurrecting a soul required a very specific and rare timing, and there was only one chance each year. If they missed today, they would have to wait for another year, which was why the Grand Elder strongly advised against the Cult Leader personally confronting Connor.
The Cult Leader took a deep breath upon hearing this, then whispered, "Based on Connor's current speed of advance, how long will it take him to reach the Cult headquarters?"
"Approximately half an hour," the Grand Elder answered.
"Half an hour?" The Cult Leader's face showed some anger upon hearing this, then he said in a low voice, "The sacrificial ritual is scheduled to start in an hour and will take at least two hours to complete. What if Connor breaks in before the ritual is over?"
The Grand Elder's expression appeared somewhat unusual because once the Cult Leader started the ritual, he couldn't be distracted to engage in battle with Connor. Interrupting the ritual midway would have severe consequences for the Cult Leader.
So, when the Cult Leader spoke those words, everyone seemed caught in a dilemma, unsure of what to do.
"I have dozens of Cult Elders. Isn't there a single one who can step up and help me deal with this trouble?" the Cult Leader asked in a low voice.
At this moment, a middle-aged man stepped forward and said in a hushed tone, "Cult Leader, give me three hundred elite disciples. I'm willing to go and delay Connor!"
"Cult Leader, I may not be his match, but I can help you buy some time!" the Fifth Elder quickly responded.
"Cult Leader, count me in!"
Other cult members immediately followed suit, volunteering to help.
However, they all understood that even if they joined forces, they might not be able to defeat Connor. The information they had indicated that, apart from the Cult Leader, Connor was beyond their league. But they also knew that this was a crucial moment for the Blood Moon Sect, and everyone wanted to show their worth to the Cult Leader.
After a moment of hesitation, the Cult Leader spoke softly, "Although you are not Connor's match, you can help me buy some time. Very well!"
The Cult Leader paused for a moment and then said calmly, "Fifth Elder, lead three hundred elite disciples quickly to intercept Connor. Don't aim to kill him, just delay him for half an hour."
"No problem!" The Fifth Elder quickly agreed.
"Eighth Elder, you take another three hundred elite disciples. Wait until he breaks through Fifth Elder's defenses, then make your move. Strive to delay him for another half an hour," the Cult Leader instructed another Elder.
"Understood, Cult Leader!" The Eighth Elder nodded in acknowledgment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1958: The Last Trump Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 1958: The Last Trump Card
After a moment, the Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect set up five defensive lines. He did this primarily to delay Connor and buy himself time to complete the ritual. As soon as the ritual was over, the following events would be easier to handle.
Upon receiving the orders, the disciples hurriedly rushed towards Connor's location.
On the other side, Connor was still steadily approaching the Blood Moon Sect's headquarters. The Five Elder, along with numerous disciples, had already laid an ambush on his path.
"Elders, Connor is coming!" whispered one disciple.
"Get everyone ready. As soon as he enters our ambush circle, we strike together. We must buy time for the Cult Leader at all costs!" said one of the Five Elder with an emotionless face.
"Understood!" The disciple nodded quickly.
A few seconds later, Connor walked into the ambush circle of the Five Elder and their disciples. In an instant, countless people with weapons charged toward him, their formation terrifying.
But he seemed to have already sensed the ambush nearby. A burst of energy swept out, and all the disciples who had charged toward him were struck down, none of them escaping the onslaught. In just a moment, the three hundred disciples led by the Five Elder lay writhing on the ground, their cries echoing.
Seeing this scene, the Five Elder were dumbfounded. They had thought that delaying Connor with their three hundred disciples for half an hour would be an easy task. However, they never anticipated that Connor would eliminate them in an instant.
The Five Elder knew they were no match for him, so they tried to retreat. But he didn't give them a chance. In an instant, he reached the Five Elder and delivered a powerful punch to the chest of one of them.
With this, he broke through the carefully laid first line of defense of the Blood Moon Sect in less than half a minute.
The second and subsequent lines of defense were met with the same fate. These people couldn't even pose a slight threat to him; they were mere ants in his presence.
As predicted by the Grand Elder and others, after half an hour, Connor finally arrived at the headquarters of the Blood Moon Sect.
