The so-called headquarters was actually a massive fortress with walls at least five meters high. At this moment, numerous Blood Moon Sect disciples stood atop the walls, all prepared for battle.
Several Blood Moon Sect elders also stood on the walls, observing his approach.
Truth be told, these people were deeply fearful of him at this moment. They had not expected him to reach their headquarters so quickly and appear completely unharmed. They couldn't fathom how a young man in his twenties possessed such terrifying power.
On the other hand, news of Connor breaking through all the ambushes and reaching the headquarters under the city wall had reached the ears of the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader.
The Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect was also shocked by this news. "The Five Elder and the Eighth Elder couldn't stop this Connor?"
He stared at the Grand Elder and asked, his expression incredulous.
"Connor's strength is simply too terrifying. They couldn't possibly stop him," the Grand Elder replied, his expression also grim.
"Connor single-handedly broke through our entire Blood Moon Sect?" The Cult Leader's expression was filled with disbelief.
"That's right," the Grand Elder reluctantly nodded, continuing, "What should we do now?"
The Cult Leader clenched his teeth, his expression filled with anger as he shouted.
The Grand Elder lowered his head, looking rather uneasy.
"I've said before that I wanted to deal with Connor personally. If it weren't for you constantly obstructing me, I might have already killed him by now. Now, the ritual is about to begin. If you let him break in, can you bear the responsibility?" the Cult Leader angrily questioned.
"Cult Leader, please rest assured. I will absolutely not let him interfere with your ritual!" the Grand Elder said cautiously.
"You won't let him interfere with my ritual?" The Cult Leader sneered upon hearing the Grand Elder's words, then asked with a cold expression, "How can you guarantee that?"
"Cult Leader, you can prepare for the ritual with peace of mind. I will lead all the elders and disciples of our Blood Moon Sect to face Connor in battle. Until the ritual is completed, I will not allow him to step into our headquarters!" the Grand Elder said slowly.
"Can you and these useless people stop him?" The Cult Leader furrowed his brow.
"While we may not be a match for him, it won't be so easy for him to defeat us. Moreover, I still have one last trump card!" the Grand Elder said hastily.
"One last trump card?" The Cult Leader was momentarily stunned.
"Yes..." The Grand Elder nodded and continued, "Cult Leader, please rest assured. He will absolutely not delay your ritual!"
Upon hearing these words, the Cult Leader gave the Grand Elder a cold glance, took a deep breath, and said nothing more. He knew that there was no other choice now but to trust the Grand Elder to stop Connor.
After taking a deep breath, the Cult Leader began preparing for the ritual. This ritual was incredibly important to him. He had waited for a thousand years for this moment, and it was the best chance he had for his resurrection. He was unwilling to let go of this opportunity.
On the other side, when Connor arrived under the city walls of the headquarters, he showed no hesitation. He walked directly towards the main gate.
But at that moment, the city gate suddenly opened from the inside. More than ten Blood Moon Sect elders, accompanied by numerous disciples, rushed out with a tremendous aura.
When confronted by these people, he didn't display a hint of fear. He continued to move forward slowly.
"Stop!" one of the elders shouted at Connor, his expression filled with excitement.
However, he seemed as if he hadn't heard the warning and continued to advance.
"I warn you, this is a forbidden area of our Blood Moon Sect. Without the permission of our Cult Leader, no one is allowed to approach. If you continue to advance, don't blame us for being ruthless!" Threatened another elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1959: Surrender
chapters.content:
Chapter 1959: Surrender
At this moment, all the disciples of the Blood Moon Sect stared wide-eyed, watching Connor's position. Their expressions were tense because they had heard about Connor's deeds, and they had some knowledge of his strength, which filled them with fear.
Connor seemed as though he hadn't heard the Elder's threat, continuing to move forward expressionlessly.
"Does this person not understand our language? Should we find someone who can speak the Sommer language to communicate with him?" another elder whispered upon seeing Connor approaching.
"No need," a robed elder replied with resignation. He continued, "Even if he doesn't understand the language, he should have understood the meaning of our earlier words. He's not stopping because he simply doesn't care about us."
"What should we do then?" The group exchanged glances, their faces displaying concern.
"There's no other choice; we have to take action!" the robed elder said in a low voice. He then turned to the disciples behind him and shouted, "The leader has given orders. If we can stop this person today, there will be rich rewards in the future!"
Upon hearing this, the disciples rushed towards Connor as if they had gone mad.
The elders did not stand idle and joined the fray, attempting to block him.
In an instant, countless people launched attacks against him. Various techniques and maneuvers were unleashed. Faced with this situation, an ordinary martial artist would have been overwhelmed by the terrifying assault before even having a chance to react.
However, he had faced such situations before. He displayed no fear and remained calm. He knew he was about to confront the Blood Moon Sect's leader, and the battle was about to begin. So, facing these people, he chose not to overexert himself, conserving his energy for the confrontation with the Cult Leader.
Connor created a golden shield around himself, capable of deflecting all attacks. After all, the people he faced were of much lower cultivation levels, even the elders were only at the early-stage of Celestial Ancient Martial Master. Combined with his incredible speed, they had no way of surrounding him.
He moved like lightning through the crowd, but he didn't choose to engage the ordinary disciples. Dealing with them one by one would take too much time, and using his energy to deal with them was unnecessary.
He knew that once he defeated the Blood Moon Sect's elders, the disciples would naturally give up their assault.
He continuously weaved through the crowd, searching for his targets. Meanwhile, the Blood Moon Sect disciples were becoming increasingly panicked. His speed was simply too fast, and they couldn't even touch him. The situation was descending into chaos.
But at that moment, he finally found an elder, and he charged directly towards the elder, delivering a powerful punch to the elder's chest.
The elder didn't even realize what had happened and was sent flying.
After dealing with the first elder, he sought out his next target. One by one, the elders fell before him.
The Blood Moon Sect disciples were at a loss, unable to understand what to do as their elders were being defeated.
"What should we do? It seems like all the elders have been defeated by this person!" one disciple exclaimed in panic.
"Yes, if this continues, we might all die at his hands!" another disciple added.
"He says that if we surrender now, he will spare us!" a disciple who understood the common language shouted in trembling voice.
Upon hearing his offer, the disciples exchanged glances, not knowing what to do.
"Since you don't want to surrender, don't blame me for going on a killing spree!" Connor's voice suddenly echoed.
"Don't kill me, I surrender!" one disciple shouted, kneeling on the ground.
Others followed suit, and in an instant, all the Blood Moon Sect disciples were kneeling before him, begging for mercy.
Although these disciples feared the Blood Moon Sect's leader, they had no other choice in this situation. They could only use this method to ensure their survival.
Upon seeing the disciples give up their resistance, Connor chose not to attack them. Instead, he continued walking towards the Blood Moon Sect's headquarters.
The Blood Moon Sect disciples watched his departing figure with fear and awe in their hearts.
After a while, he finally crossed the entrance of the Blood Moon Sect's headquarters and entered.
Inside the headquarters, the strange aura became even more intense. He didn't want to waste any time and began using the Chi Observation Technique to locate the Cult Leader.
However, the Cult Leader was not a martial artist; he was a soul. Therefore, he couldn't use the Chi Observation Technique to locate him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1960: Rachel Is Captured
chapters.content:
Chapter 1960: Rachel Is Captured
"It seems I'll have to search slowly," Connor sighed in resignation and continued walking forward.
At that moment, he suddenly heard a series of hurried footsteps. He could sense that a large group of martial artists was approaching his location.
His expression turned puzzled because he had already killed several Blood Moon Sect elders outside the sect moments ago, and the disciples had given up resistance. There shouldn't be anyone daring to stop him now.
After a while, an elder appeared in front of him, accompanied by nearly a hundred disciples. This elder was none other than the Blood Moon Sect's Grand Elder, the only one who knew the true secret of the Cult Leader.
"Do you still dare to obstruct me?" Connor asked, looking the Grand Elder up and down with an expressionless face.
"Mr. Connor, you truly possess remarkable skills. We mobilized so many elders and disciples, even resorting to modern weapons from the Blood Moon Sect's arsenal, yet we couldn't stop your progress. I must say I'm impressed!" The Grand Elder, being of the same Sommervile ethnicity as Connor, had no trouble communicating.
"Who are you? Where is the Cult Leader?" Connor asked him with an expressionless face.
"Mr. Connor, I am the Grand Elder of the Blood Moon Sect. Our leader is currently occupied with important matters. I hope you can wait here for three hours, and after that, the leader will come to see you," the Grand Elder replied in a soft tone.
"Three hours?" Connor sneered. "If I wait here for three hours, I bet your Cult Leader will have completed his resurrection, and by then, he'll come to kill me!"
"Resurrection?" The Grand Elder's expression changed instantly, and he stared at Connor, asking, "What do you mean by that?"
"You know what I mean. Why pretend not to understand?" he replied indifferently.
The Grand Elder looked at him with complex emotions and then said softly, "It seems you know the secret of our leader."
"Don't waste time. Bring out your Cult Leader. I won't allow his success!" Connor scolded, knowing that the Grand Elder was just trying to stall for time.
"Mr. Connor, as I mentioned before, you need to wait here for three hours," the Grand Elder said in a hushed tone.
"What if I don't want to wait?" Connor asked.
The Grand Elder couldn't help but chuckle and said calmly, "Mr. Connor, you have no choice. Whether you want to wait or not, you must stay here for three hours. Afterward, I won't interfere with whatever you wish to do."
"Do you not fear that I will kill you?" Connor felt that the Grand Elder's confidence was a bit strange.
"Mr. Connor, I know your abilities, and I know I'm no match for you. But even if you want to kill me, you still have to wait for three hours. Whether you like it or not, you must wait here for three hours. After that, I won't interfere with your actions," the Grand Elder replied with a smile.
"Why?" Connor asked softly.
"Because your woman is in my hands," the Grand Elder said with a grin.
"What did you say?" Connor's eyes widened.
"Mr. Connor, look over there!" The Grand Elder pointed behind him, and a young woman, somewhat disheveled but otherwise unharmed, was brought out from the crowd.
Although Rachel appeared somewhat ragged, her hair disheveled, she seemed to be in good shape and hadn't been injured.
Connor had been worried about Rachel following him to the Blood Moon Sect, fearing for her safety. He had refused to let her come with him. However, he had forgotten that she had been following him all along, and everyone knew that he had a beautiful woman by his side.
The Grand Elder had naturally learned of this as well. However, today, Connor had come alone, so the Grand Elder had ordered an investigation to find Rachel's whereabouts. The Blood Moon Sect was a formidable force, making it easy to trace her to a hotel.
While Rachel was also a Black-level martial artist, there was still a significant gap in strength compared to the Blood Moon Sect members. The Grand Elder had seized the opportunity to capture her.
And it appeared that she had become the last card in the Grand Elder's hand.
Of course, the Cult Leader was unaware of this situation. If he found out, he would be furious because he considered the Grand Elder's actions disgraceful.
This might be the difference between martial artists from thousands of years ago and modern martial artists. In the past, martial artists valued strength above all else and didn't resort to such tactics.
"Connor, don't mind me. Hurry up and stop the Cult Leader from resurrecting!" Rachel, upon seeing Connor, couldn't hide her emotions and shouted loudly.
Connor squinted his eyes as he looked at the Grand Elder, his emotions complex. He had always avoided involving those around him in his battles, but no matter how careful he was, his enemies always found a way to draw his friends and loved ones into the conflict. This was what angered him the most.
Rachel had known about Connor's true purpose in coming here. He wasn't just rescuing Taran; he was also stopping the resurrection of the Cult Leader. If the Cult Leader succeeded in resurrecting, the consequences would be unimaginable.
"Mr. Connor, your woman is in my hands. If you dare to take a single step forward, I will have her killed!" The Grand Elder, sensing his hesitation, smiled smugly.
He stared at the Grand Elder, deep in thought, contemplating how to handle the situation. The person holding Rachel hostage was likely a Martial Master, so even if he attacked suddenly, they would have time to react and kill her. If not, the Grand Elder would certainly order her execution.

chapters.title: Chapter 1961: Phantom Parade
chapters.content:
Chapter 1961: Phantom Parade
Seeing the situation unfold, Connor didn't dare to act rashly. He couldn't risk Rachel's life in this situation.
"But rest assured, Mr. Connor. As long as you cooperate with us and wait here for three hours, I will release this woman. After that, if you wish to resolve the conflict between you and our Blood Moon Sect's leader, I won't stand in your way," the Grand Elder continued.
"So, if I wait here for three hours, you'll let Rachel go?" he asked softly.
"Yes." the Grand Elder nodded.
"Connor, are you crazy? Don't listen to this person's nonsense. If that leader truly resurrects, we will both die here today. It's better for one person to die than both of us. Don't mind me, hurry up and stop him," Rachel shouted, her expression highly agitated.
Connor cast a brief glance at her, then said softly, "It's okay. I'll wait here for three hours. Even if that leader is resurrected, I still have a way to kill him."
"Hehe..." The Grand Elder sneered, feeling contemptuous of his overconfidence.
If the Blood Moon Sect's leader were to truly resurrect, his power would likely surpass even a Three-Star Martial Master. How could Connor, a mere Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master, be his match?
However, the Grand Elder didn't say much because he had already achieved his goal. As long as he could buy enough time for the leader, it was enough.
Connor pretended to prepare to sit down, and the Grand Elder and his followers relaxed, thinking that he had given up resistance.
However, just as everyone believed that he was about to sit down, he suddenly moved. His figure flashed, and he rushed to the middle-aged man holding Rachel.
Everything happened so suddenly that even she didn't react in time.
"Bang!"
Connor reached out and grabbed the middle-aged man's arm, then twisted it forcefully.
"Ah..."
A miserable scream followed, and the middle-aged man's arm was broken, ending his life as Connor kicked him in the chest.
Rachel, now free from her restraints, hurriedly stepped behind Connor.
The Grand Elder stared at his position with an expression of disbelief, and his face showed utter astonishment. He had never expected him to be so audacious, knowing full well that intervening would endanger Rachel's life.
Moreover, his speed was beyond anyone's imagination. Everything had happened in the blink of an eye. If an ordinary person were present, they might not have even comprehended what had occurred.
"Mr. Connor, indeed your skills are extraordinary!" The Grand Elder finally spoke, his expression still incredulous.
Despite his anger, the Grand Elder knew he had underestimated Connor's power. If he had known how fast Connor was, he would not have brought her here. Without her, his presence would be ineffective.
Now, there was no turning back.
Taking a deep breath, the Grand Elder pulled out a box from his pocket and shouted at Connor, "Connor, today I'll let you taste the horrors of the Phantom Parade!"
"What? Phantom Parade?"
"We're finished! The Grand Elder is about to use that move. Let's run!"
"Hurry, run!"
For some reason, upon hearing the Grand Elder's words, the Blood Moon Sect members' faces turned pale. Then, as if they had gone mad, they fled into the distance.
In just an instant, the area behind the Grand Elder was empty.
However, he didn't seem to mind. He continued muttering as if reciting a spell and opened the box he had taken from his pocket.
As the box was opened, the world seemed to change instantly, shrouded in endless darkness. Simultaneously, countless ghostly figures emitted mournful cries and swarmed toward Connor and Rachel.
Seeing this, she was utterly shocked. It was the first time she had witnessed the existence of these undead creatures.
Previously, she couldn't comprehend the concept of souls and spirits because she believed there were no ghosts or gods in the world. Now, she realized that he had been telling the truth.
These undead creatures seemed to devour souls instantly and attacked him while emitting miserable cries.
The Grand Elder's face turned pale as well. He hadn't expected his last resort, the Phantom Parade, to have no effect on Connor.
Connor faced these undead creatures for the first time and didn't know what to do. He released his aura in an attempt to keep the undead away from him and Rachel.
To his surprise, the moment his aura enveloped him and Rachel, the undead creatures reacted as if they had encountered something terrifying. They quickly scattered and fled in all directions.
"What... what just happened?" The Grand Elder was also taken aback, his expression filled with incredulity.
He hadn't anticipated that his ultimate move would have no effect on Connor. The Phantom Parade was his most potent technique, and its ability to release malevolent spirits that devoured souls was formidable. Yet, Connor's aura seemed to repel them effortlessly.
The Grand Elder's face was ashen. He knew that using this technique had taken a toll on him, but now, it seemed all his efforts had been in vain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1962: Resurrection
chapters.content:
Chapter 1962: Resurrection
However, nobody expected that the Grand Elder's move had no effect on Connor. On the contrary, those undead creatures seemed to fear him greatly.
The Grand Elder might not have known, but these malevolent spirits were not afraid of Connor himself; they were actually afraid of the Cult Leader. Just a few days ago, Connor had devoured a fragment of the Cult Leader's soul, and these malevolent spirits could sense his presence in him. That's why they were terrified of him.
With the undead creatures fleeing in all directions, the sky gradually brightened. Connor hesitated for a moment before rushing toward the Grand Elder's location.
Upon realizing this, the Grand Elder quickly surrounded himself with the energy of Lucifer, the devil.
"Bang!"
A loud noise rang out as Connor's fist struck the Grand Elder's chest.
The Grand Elder staggered back two steps, his expression showing some discomfort but no injury.
"I wonder how many punches your devil energy can withstand!" Connor roared at the Grand Elder and continued to rain blows on his chest.
After five punches, Connor shattered the devil energy surrounding the Grand Elder's body. Without this protection, the Grand Elder's body couldn't withstand Connor's attacks, and he was hit in the heart, causing him to lose consciousness.
Seeing his body fall to the ground, Connor breathed a sigh of relief. He knew he had removed the final obstacle and now had to face the Cult Leader.
Connor walked up to Rachel and asked softly, "Are you okay? Did they do anything to you?"
"No," she replied, shaking her head.
"That's good," he said with a faint smile.
After a moment of hesitation, she spoke softly to him, "Connor, I should have listened to you and not come with you in the first place. I never thought I would bring so much trouble to you."
"Trouble?" He paused for a moment, then said, "I don't think you've caused me any trouble. If it weren't for you saving my life, I might not have made it this far. My companions have been protecting me all along, and now it's time for me to protect all of you."
She felt touched by his words and didn't say anything more.
"Let's go. We need to confront the leader of the Blood Moon Sect," he said as he took her hand and headed toward the inner sanctum.
Meanwhile, in another part of the sect, inside the Blood Moon Sect's shrine:
The Cult Leader remained unaware of what was happening outside. However, he was confident that the Grand Elder's plan would buy him the three hours he needed.
The sacrificial ritual was divided into two parts. The first part involved the Cult Leader devouring the souls of all the sacrifices to gather enough energy for his resurrection. The second part was the crucial resurrection itself.
For a soul to be reborn in another person's body, the conditions were extremely strict. The Cult Leader, having lived for nearly a thousand years in this world, had attempted resurrection many times before discovering that only a particular type of person's constitution could meet the conditions required for his revival.
And that person was Taran.
However, even if a suitable host was found, there was no guarantee of a successful resurrection; it depended on the compatibility between the leader's soul and the host.
To ensure his success, the Cult Leader had spent thirty years preparing, selecting ten individuals whose constitutions met the criteria for his revival. This meant that the sect had not only targeted Taran but nine others as well.
If one person failed, the leader would immediately move on to the next candidate until he successfully revived himself.
At this moment, these ten individuals were all imprisoned in cages, awaiting the start of the sacrificial ritual. Although they didn't know what was about to happen, fear was evident on their faces.
Among them was a middle-aged man who kept his eyes closed from beginning to end, his expression markedly different from the others. He appeared extremely calm, as though he had no fear.
This man was the person Connor sought, the master, Taran.
"Do you know why we've been brought here?" A young man spoke up, addressing Taran.
Hearing this, he slowly opened his eyes and calmly replied, "Do you want to know what's going to happen next?"
"Yes, I'm just an ordinary person. I've never harmed anyone from the Blood Moon Sect. Why have they captured me? And every day, they feed us strange things..." the young man said with a furrowed brow.
"Indeed, why have they captured me?" a young and beautiful girl chimed in.
Taran sighed softly and then said in an expressionless tone, "Since we're all going to die, I'll let you understand everything clearly. When I first arrived here, I wasn't imprisoned. On the contrary, the Cult Leader took me as his disciple and made me an Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master. Everyone in the sect was kind to me, and I couldn't understand why the leader treated me so well. But later, I overheard a conversation between him and the Grand Elder, and that's when I realized the truth."
"What happened?" the young man asked, his voice filled with curiosity.
Taran took a deep breath and then spoke quietly, "The reason the leader treated me so well is that he wants to use my body to resurrect himself. The Cult Leader isn't a living person; he's a spirit. He needs to possess someone else's body to revive himself."
"What?!" The others were stunned, their expressions full of disbelief.
"Are you trying to trick us?" the young man asked, sounding skeptical.

chapters.title: Chapter 1963: Success?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1963: Success?
"At this point, do you think I have any reason to deceive you?" Taran replied coldly.
Hearing this, the group exchanged glances. Though they found it hard to comprehend what he had told them, they also knew that he had no reason to lie to them at this point.
"When I learned of the true intentions of the Cult Leader, I immediately wanted to escape. However, the strength of the Blood Moon Sect is terrifying, and I had no chance against them. Eventually, I was locked up, and then you all came in, one by one," Taran continued.
"Why did the Cult Leader choose us then?" the young man with a furrowed brow asked.
"Because your bodies all meet the conditions for the Cult Leader's resurrection," Taran replied.
The young man hesitated for a couple of seconds, then loudly exclaimed, "You must be lying! If the Cult Leader really intends to use our bodies for his resurrection, why did he wait until now to take action?"
"Yeah, if what you're saying is true, you should have been with the Blood Moon Sect for a long time. Why wait until this moment to start the resurrection?" others chimed in, voicing their doubts.
"He waited for so many years because his previous strength didn't allow him to resurrect. Now he has gained the power he needs for the resurrection," Taran calmly explained in response to their skepticism.
The group's expressions turned desperate upon hearing his explanation. They realized that everything he had said was indeed true.
Inside the sacrificial chamber, the Blood Moon Sect's leader finally entered. An elderly disciple rushed forward to greet him, saying in a low voice, "Master, the ritual preparations are complete. We can start when you're ready."
"Good," the Cult Leader nodded and slowly ascended the altar.
Beneath the altar were nearly tens of thousands of innocent sacrifices. Although some of the disciples of the Blood Moon Sect and the followers of the Netherworld Sect had been released by Connor, the Blood Moon Sect's influence in Winam was still immense. Additionally, many smaller, unknown sects were branches of the Blood Moon Sect, so they could easily gather the required number of sacrifices.
These sacrifices were enough to provide the Cult Leader with the energy needed for the resurrection.
The Blood Moon Sect's several elders began the ritual, chanting incantations in unison. After a few minutes, a massive black array appeared beneath the feet of the sacrifices.
The expressions of those who had been chosen as sacrifices turned to fear as the array absorbed their souls, causing them intense suffering.
Taran and the others trapped in the cage could see everything happening below. At this moment, they understood that everything Taran had told them was true.
The array absorbed the souls of those sacrifices, converting them into dark energy that would be absorbed by the Cult Leader. It seemed as if everything was proceeding according to the Cult Leader's plan.
Inside the cage, the onlookers watched in horror as the array continued to drain the life force from the sacrifices, turning them into withered corpses. Their faces went from fear to despair and eventually became numb because they knew that they might face the same fate.
After an unknown amount of time, the array finally ceased its operation. The Cult Leader stood up from his seat, his expression filled with satisfaction.
"Congratulations, Master!"
"Congratulations, Master!"
The members of the Blood Moon Sect knelt down and hailed their leader.
"Prepare for the resurrection ceremony!" the Cult Leader ordered.
"Yes!"
One of the elders responded and then walked toward Taran and the others' cage. When they saw the elder approaching, fear gripped their hearts. They knew that if they stepped out of the cage now, they would surely be used by the Cult Leader for his resurrection.
The elder's face displayed impatience, and he reached into the cage, grabbing a middle-aged man without any regard for his pleas. He dragged the man out of the cage.
The man, terrified, knelt on the ground and begged, his voice trembling, "Please, don't kill me, I beg you..."
The Cult Leader, hearing the man's pleas, couldn't help but chuckle. He then placed his right hand on the man's head, and in the next moment, the man's face twisted into a grotesque expression, emitting screams of agony.
Inside the cage, the onlookers witnessed this horrifying scene, their expressions filled with despair.
After a while, the Cult Leader vanished from their sight. The man who had been taken out of the cage stood up slowly, his face now a mask of emptiness.
"Success?" one of the Blood Moon Sect's elders asked with excitement when he saw this.
The man who had been possessed by the Cult Leader nodded in response, and the elder's face showed a sense of triumph.

chapters.title: Chapter 1964: I'm Here to Save You
chapters.content:
Chapter 1964: I'm Here to Save You
"Pfftt!"
But the next moment, the middle-aged man suddenly spewed a mouthful of blood.
Immediately after, he collapsed heavily to the ground, losing his breath.
The Cult Leader reappeared in the middle-aged man's field of vision.
"It's useless!" he muttered under his breath. Then, he turned to his companions and said, "Next one!"
"Alright... alright!" The elder knew the first person had already failed, so he quickly ran to the cage's location, not wasting any time, and pulled out the second person.
However, the second person met the same fate as the first one, coughing up blood and dying in the end.
As time passed, there were fewer and fewer people inside the cage, with seven people having died at the hands of the Cult Leader.
At this moment, the Cult Leader's mood became very restless. After all, he had tried seven times, but he had not succeeded yet. He was genuinely worried that his resurrection might fail this time. If it did fail, he might have to wait for several decades again.
After all, gathering so many people with the right constitution for resurrection was not an easy task.
Just then, the elder once again walked up to the cage and frowned when he saw that there were only three people left inside. He said, "All three of you come out!"
The young man and the little girl sat still, their bodies trembling uncontrollably, as if they dared not leave the cage.
Taran hesitated for a moment, then stood up and walked out without a word.
When the Cult Leader saw that Taran was the one who came out, his expression became somewhat strange. After all, among so many people, he only knew Taran. The others were all meeting the Cult Leader for the first time.
"It seems we can only place our hopes on you now!" the Cult Leader said in a low voice to him.
After hearing his words, Taran hesitated for a moment and then said softly, "If you can really use my body for your resurrection, I hope you can promise me one thing."
"What is it?" the Cult Leader asked.
"Help me kill someone."
"Who?"
"Someone named Yamino Gomez. Everything I have become today is because of him. I hope you can help me kill him," he said in a low voice.
After hearing this, the Cult Leader couldn't help but laugh out loud, then nodded lightly and said, "Don't worry, if I can really use your body to complete my resurrection, I will help you kill that person."
"Good."
Taran replied with a simple word and then closed his eyes without any hesitation.
The Cult Leader took a deep breath and slowly raised his right hand.
"Bang!" But just as he was about to make his move, there was a sudden loud noise at the entrance of the altar.
The Cult Leader instinctively stopped his actions and turned to look at the entrance of the altar.
There, a young man and a woman were walking slowly to the altar.
When he saw the young man, his eyes widened in disbelief, and his expression became very strange.
Taran also opened his eyes and looked in the direction of Connor and Rachel, his expression seeming somewhat puzzled. He couldn't understand who would have the audacity to enter the Blood Moon Sect's altar like this!
"Who are you two? How dare you enter the altar? Are you tired of living?"
An elder shouted angrily at Connor.
"I am Connor McDonald."
Connor calmly replied to the elder.
Upon hearing his words, everyone was dumbfounded, as they never expected him to actually enter the altar.
"Could it be that the Grand Elder has failed?"
"How is that possible?"
People couldn't help but whisper to each other.
Connor, however, led Rachel toward the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader without saying anything to the elder.
The Cult Leader scrutinized him from head to toe, but he couldn't read his expression.
After a moment, Connor, still without speaking to the Cult Leader, turned to Taran and asked softly, "Were you the master by Yamino's side?"
"Who are you?" Taran's expression appeared somewhat unusual upon hearing Yamino's name.
"Don't worry, I'm not with Yamino. I'm here to save you," he explained calmly.
"What kind of person are you?"
At this moment, he didn't seem to fully trust Connor.
"Who I am doesn't matter. You just need to tell me, were you Yamino's master?"
Connor asked directly.
"I was."
Taran nodded, seemingly convinced that Connor was not a bad person.
"Good."
Connor breathed a sigh of relief upon confirming that he was not too late. Then, he focused his attention on the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader and asked without any emotion, "Were you the Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect?"
"Yes, I was."
The Cult Leader nodded and continued, "I didn't expect you to break into the altar at the last moment. You disrupted our thousands of years of preparations. Today, I had to kill you and reduce you to ashes, subject you to endless torment until you died!"
"Kill me?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer, then calmly said, "Now, you were just a mere evil spirit. Did you think you could kill me?"
"You were really arrogant!"
The Cult Leader didn't seem to get angry because of Connor's words. Instead, he remained calm.
"Enough talk. If you wanted to kill me, let's get to it!"
Connor said softly.
The Cult Leader looked at the altar next to him. He spent hundreds of years building this altar, and the array inside it was his careful design. If he fought Connor here, the entire altar might be destroyed. Then, even if he killed Connor, rebuilding the altar wouldn't be easy.
"I couldn't use my full power here. Were you willing to fight me outside?"
The Cult Leader asked quietly.
"Alright."
Connor agreed with a nod.
This suggestion from the Cult Leader aligned with Connor's intentions. He was concerned that if they fought inside the altar, Taran and Rachel might be in danger. So, he'd rather face the Cult Leader outside.
"Watch over these people for me while I was gone..."
The Cult Leader instructed his elders, then rushed towards the altar's exit.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then glanced at Rachel and said softly, "Stay here, I'll be back soon!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1965: A Terrifying Punch
chapters.content:
Chapter 1965: A Terrifying Punch
"Alright..."
Rachel nodded gently.
In the place where Rachel stood, Connor set up a protective barrier to prevent the Blood Moon Sect members from targeting her. Then, he followed the Cult Leader's steps and chased after him.
A few minutes later, Connor and the Cult Leader finally reached the outside of the altar.
At this point, many of the disciples had not yet left. When they saw the Cult Leader, their expressions were filled with excitement, and they all knelt on the ground.
"Connor, today I will definitely kill you to avenge the elders and disciples of my Blood Moon Sect!"
When the Cult Leader saw that many of the elders had died, he shouted in anger.
He had worked tirelessly for decades to build the Blood Moon Sect to its current scale, and now, everything was ruined by Connor. What made him even angrier was that the time for the resurrection ritual had passed, so he would have to wait for several decades to have another chance to perform the ritual. By then, Taran might already be dead.
All of this was solely Connor's fault.
Regardless, he would not let Connor go.
At this moment, Connor appeared before everyone.
Everyone knew that the real battle was about to begin.
Although they had witnessed how terrifying his strength was, most of the disciples still believed that he couldn't possibly be a match for the Cult Leader. In their eyes, the Cult Leader was a divine presence, and no one could defeat their god.
"Connor, my Blood Moon Sect has no grudge against you. Why did you come here and attack my sect like this?" The Cult Leader had been puzzled by this question all along—why he had done what he did and what he stood to gain from it.
"I'm here to find someone," he replied calmly.
"Taran?" the Cult Leader asked.
"Yes, that's him." Connor nodded lightly.
"Just one Taran made you go to such great lengths and infiltrate my Blood Moon Sect. What's your relationship with him?" The Cult Leader was even more puzzled now.
"I have no personal connection with him, but this person is important to me. You intend to kill him, so that's why I'm here..." Connor continued.
The Cult Leader took a deep breath and then said calmly, "If I hand Taran over to you, would you be willing to leave Winam, and we'll have no further conflicts?"
Clearly, the Cult Leader now recognized his terrifying strength. He wasn't completely confident in defeating him anymore.
He was employing a delaying tactic. By letting Connor leave first and waiting for several decades after successfully resurrecting, he would find it much easier to deal with him then.
This Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect had always been a clever person; otherwise, he wouldn't have survived for thousands of years in this world.
However, when the disciples heard these words, they were all stunned, wearing expressions of disbelief. All the elders and disciples had died at Connor's hands, yet now their Cult Leader was actively seeking peace with him. This was something they couldn't accept.
"If I leave with Taran now, do you plan to kill me as soon as you successfully resurrect?" he replied softly.
"I didn't expect you to know the secret of my resurrection. Who are you, and why do you understand how to use soul power?" The Cult Leader continued to question him.
"I don't know how to use soul power." Connor shook his head gently.
"Impossible!" The Cult Leader roared, then continued, "If you don't know how to use soul power, how did you devour my remnant soul?"
Connor didn't explain this issue because he couldn't even understand it himself.
"Never mind. After I beat you to a pulp, I'll make you tell the truth!" The Cult Leader seemed unwilling to waste any more time on him. He waved his right hand lightly.
Instantly, the sky became overcast with dark clouds, and thunder and lightning filled the air.
Following that, a gigantic hand descended from the heavens, aiming directly for Connor.
He could feel the terrifying aura of Ghostly Yin Chi within this hand. Even a slight touch of it would probably be enough to be devoured by the Ghostly Yin Chi.
Although Ghostly Yin Chi and the chi Connor cultivated were not the same, their effects were quite similar.
He didn't dare to be careless when he saw the Cult Leader making his move, as he knew that this Blood Moon Sect Cult Leader was most likely at the peak of Earth-tier Ancient Martial Masters, similar to Jorge. Such individuals possessed terrifying strength, and this battle would be a significant challenge for him.
Seeing the massive hand gradually approaching him, Connor roared, "Break!"
Then, he punched towards the location of the hand.
A massive fist imprint appeared in the air and flew straight towards the hand.
"Boom!"
A deafening sound echoed through the heavens and the earth.
Connor's fist imprint collided with the Cult Leader's hand, causing the entire world to tremble.
The first exchange between the two ended in a draw.
The Cult Leader squinted at Connor's position, his expression somewhat surprised. He had not expected Connor's aura to be so terrifying, and now, even though he looked at the whole world, there were few who could strike such a terrifying blow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1966: Could It Be Over Just Like This?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1966: Could It Be Over Just Like This?
"I'm Sect Leader McDonald of the Purple Sky Sect!"
Connor calmly declared.
"Hahaha..."
The Cult Leader couldn't help but burst into laughter and continued, "Since that's the case, I must kill you today to avenge the past!"
"You're not capable of doing that!"
Connor replied calmly, then waved his right hand gently.
In an instant, countless bolts of lightning shot directly toward the Cult Leader's position.
But the Cult Leader stood still, letting the lightning strike him as if it couldn't harm him at all.
...
Connor's face showed a hint of surprise, then he waved his hand again and shouted softly, "Thunder Dragon!"
Next moment, numerous lightning bolts formed a giant dragon in the sky, carrying immense thunderous power and charging toward the Cult Leader.
The Cult Leader's expression changed slightly upon seeing this lightning dragon, and he muttered, "You dare to use the skills of a mere amateur?"
Immediately after, he waved his right hand vigorously, releasing a powerful black aura straight at the lightning dragon's location.
The lightning dragon instantly disintegrated, vanishing into thin air.
The black aura, however, slammed into Connor, who couldn't dodge in time and had to use his body to withstand the attack.
Connor was pushed back nearly dozens of meters and left a deep trench on the ground before finally stabilizing himself.
The disciples present saw the Cult Leader gaining the upper hand and erupted in cheers. Some of them who had wanted to leave the Blood Moon Sect wore expressions of resignation, realizing that there was still a gap in strength between Connor and the Cult Leader.
"You are no match for me," the Cult Leader sneered.
"Is that so?" Connor replied coldly, then vanished from sight, leaving everyone baffled.
When he reappeared, he was already behind the Cult Leader, raising his fist to strike.
However, the Cult Leader's reaction was incredibly swift, and he dodged Connor's punch directly.
"Darkfire!"
The Cult Leader bellowed. Over a dozen green-glowing fireballs appeared in front of him.
These fireballs weren't ordinary; they had scorching temperatures that could instantly incinerate a person upon contact. Moreover, they contained a terrifying malevolent force capable of corrupting one's soul.
As these fireballs materialized, fear gripped the faces of the Blood Moon Sect disciples. They were worried about being caught in the crossfire.
With a slight wave of the Cult Leader's hand, all these fireballs hurtled toward Connor's position.
He felt the power of this darkfire and decided not to confront it head-on. Instead, he relied on his speed to evade.
His agility allowed him to effortlessly dodge the fireballs, but the Blood Moon Sect disciples were not as quick.
In an instant, numerous disciples met their gruesome end beneath the onslaught of the fireballs.
The Cult Leader, despite knowing that this might harm his own followers, showed no mercy. He continued relentlessly attacking Connor with the darkfire.
Connor continued evading in the air, but he realized that the Cult Leader was gradually depleting his own energy. He couldn't let this continue.
"Earth Shield!"
Connor roared.
In an instant, the ground beneath his feet shook violently, and a massive earthen wall appeared in front of him.
Several fireballs struck the earth wall in rapid succession, but they were all blocked, unable to harm Connor behind it.
The Cult Leader's expression turned even stranger upon witnessing this scene. He seemed to lose control, unleashing even more darkfire.
In just a moment, nearly a hundred fireballs fiercely struck the earth wall.
But the shield finally crumbled under the relentless assault.
The Cult Leader, seeing the earth wall collapse in front of Connor, grew excited and shouted, "Connor, let's see where you can hide now!"
Following that, a multitude of darkfire clusters, like missiles, aimed straight at Connor's location.
The spot where Connor stood became an instant sea of fire, consumed by the darkfire.
However, what no one expected was that Connor had already moved away from behind the earth wall.
When the Cult Leader realized this, he had already appeared behind him.
This time, he didn't give him any reaction time. He roared, "Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dharma World!"
In an instant, countless golden rays of light shone upon Connor's body.
His punch seemed to carry the power to annihilate heaven and earth, directly striking the Cult Leader's body.
A deafening roar echoed.
The Cult Leader's soul exploded instantly, transforming into countless faint traces of energy that dissipated into the heavens and the earth.
"What?"
"How is this possible?"
The few surviving Blood Moon Sect disciples were now dumbfounded. They couldn't believe that he had defeated their Cult Leader with a single punch.
"Is it over?" one disciple stammered.
"It can't be possible! How could the Cult Leader lose so quickly? I don't believe the Cult Leader would lose..."
"The Cult Leader must still be alive!"
In an instant, the Blood Moon Sect members couldn't accept the cruel reality and started shouting in disbelief.
As for Connor, he stood still, his expression somewhat grave. He hadn't anticipated that the Cult Leader would be defeated so easily and wondered how he had managed to survive in this world for so many years.
"Connor, do you think I've lost?"
However, at that moment, a voice rang in his ears.
Startled, he turned his head, only to see a massive ball of sinister flames hurtling toward him.
Caught off guard, he had no time to react or defend against the sudden attack of the sinister flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 1967: Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1967: Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts
"Boom!"
A deafening roar!
Connor's body was sent flying in an instant, crashing heavily onto the walls.
The walls were smashed through immediately.
Upon witnessing this scene, the onlookers erupted in cheers and jubilation.
The disciples supporting the Cult Leader had expressions filled with excitement. In their eyes, their Cult Leader was a god from the heavens, unbeatable by anyone.
But the next moment, their smiles froze.
Because Connor had returned unscathed.
Countless people had already perished under the darkfire just moments ago, so these people were acutely aware of its terror. No one had expected him to withstand the darkfire so resolutely. Notably, his clothes showed no signs of damage.
"What kind of person is he?" The crowd couldn't help but exclaim.
Even the Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect, upon witnessing his unharmed return, displayed a hint of astonishment. He had been extremely confident in the power of his darkfire, doubting anyone could withstand it.
Though he seemed unaffected now, the moment the darkfire touched him, he had nearly exhausted all his spiritual energy to resist it, barely managing to endure.
If not for that, he would likely have been seriously injured by now.
However, this had a significant impact on Connor. Suddenly depleting all the spiritual energy within his body was not something he could easily replenish in a short time, making the upcoming battle much more challenging for him.
"I never expected you to still be alive," the Cult Leader remarked, his expression one of mild surprise.
"I never expected you to still be alive either. My punch clearly shattered your soul," Connor said softly.
Upon hearing his words, the Cult Leader couldn't help but burst into laughter, then said calmly, "Connor, you are too naive. Do you really think that after living in this world for so many years, I would be killed by you so easily?"
"Did I only destroy a fragment of your soul just now?" he inquired softly.
"You're quite clever," the Cult Leader nodded lightly, then his figure flickered, and he created four clones.
Connor squinted, observing his surroundings. At this point, all four of the Cult Leader's clones emitted the same aura, making it impossible to discern the original from the remnants.
This was why the Cult Leader had survived when facing the siege of the four major sects. Most warriors in this world were unaware of the ability to separate one's soul, which was one of the Cult Leader's most terrifying aspects.
Unless you could completely kill his soul's core, you couldn't kill him. Several decades later, he could return to his peak state by devouring others' souls. That was why he had managed to live for so many years in this world.
"Your soul is already strong enough. Even without a body, there are few in this world who can truly threaten you. Why do you still need to seize others' bodies?" Connor hesitated for a moment before asking softly.
"Do you think my current strength is formidable?" The Cult Leader looked at Connor with a hint of sarcasm. "Your understanding of power is shallow. The most powerful warriors in this world are considered Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts. But in reality, they are nothing more than the equivalent of Nascent Soul Realm cultivators from thousands of years ago. Nascent Soul Realm was insignificant back then!"
"Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts?" Connor frowned, looking somewhat puzzled.
"Don't you know that in this world, there are Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts?" The Cult Leader seemed to detect his confusion.
"I didn't know..." Connor shook his head lightly. After all, he had only been in contact with martial cultivation for two years. Although his strength was terrifying, there was much about martial cultivation that he didn't understand.
"In any case, you're about to die soon. I might as well tell you the biggest secret of the martial world," the Cult Leader paused before continuing. "In the eyes of most martial practitioners, the most powerful warriors in this world are Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts, and no one can break through to become a Celestial Ancient Martial Master !"
"Isn't that the case?" Connor asked inquisitively.
"Of course not!" the Cult Leader shook his head and continued, "Not only do Celestial Ancient Martial Master exist in this world, but there are also many Ancient Martial Arts who have reached the pinnacle. However, once they break through to become Celestial Ancient Martial Master, they enter the realm of Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts!"
"Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts?" Connor's astonishment grew as he listened, for this was something Jorge had never mentioned before, indicating that he might not have known these secrets either.
"Do Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts truly exist in this world?" Connor asked.
"Of course, they do, and as far as I know, the highest level attainable by humans is the rank of Eightfold Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts. No one has been able to reach beyond that, which means that there are no known martial practitioners who have surpassed the realm," the Cult Leader said calmly.
"Since there are Eightfold Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts in this world, why have I never seen them before?" Connor furrowed his brow, his expression growing increasingly puzzled. Initially, he had doubted the Cult Leader's words, but now it seemed as if the Cult Leader was not lying to him.
"You haven't seen them because they wouldn't let ordinary martial practitioners discover their existence. Even Celestial Ancient Martial Master hide their tracks and don't participate in ordinary affairs. They only want to focus on cultivating and breaking through to higher realms to gain more power," the Cult Leader replied. "The reason you believe that the highest level for martial practitioners is Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts is due to a conspiracy created by higher-level martial practitioners!"
"What do you mean by that?" Connor's unease continued to mount as he listened, and he began to sense that something was not quite right.

chapters.title: Chapter 1968: A Lie
chapters.content:
Chapter 1968: A Lie
"Now, the Earth is in the Age of Dharma Decline, and the spiritual energy is exceedingly scarce. This has led to a very small number of martial practitioners, and the number of high-level martial practitioners is even rarer."
"But if we were to go back several thousand years, at that time, Earth's spiritual energy was abundant. At that time, almost everyone could become a martial practitioner. Even if they didn't cultivate, they could reach the Foundation Realm just by nurturing themselves with the natural spiritual energy."
The Cult Leader continued to speak.
"What is the Foundation Realm?" Connor asked.
"The so-called Foundation Realm is what you call Black-ranked Martial Practitioners. The initial stage is the Chi Refining Realm, which you call Yellow-ranked Martial Practitioners. After the Foundation Realm comes the Golden Realm, which is the current stage you are at as a martial arts grandmaster. Beyond the Golden Realm is the Nascent Soul Realm, which is what I mentioned earlier as the peak of ancient martial arts. Do you understand what I mean?" The Cult Leader explained.
Connor remained silent, looking at him.
"Once humans reach the Golden Realm, the peak of ancient martial arts, they can achieve immortality of the flesh, indestructibility of the core, and eternal existence of the soul. With just a thought, they can control the spiritual energy of heaven and earth within a thousand miles, causing clouds to move and snow to fall. They can manipulate the spiritual energy of heaven and earth at will, possessing the power to destroy the heavens and the earth. Moreover, as their strength in the Golden Realm increases, they gradually gain control over spatial and temporal forces. These are the ultimate powers martial practitioners can attain!" The Cult Leader exclaimed with excitement.
Connor was shocked by his words.
He hurriedly asked, "If Golden Realm martial practitioners are so powerful, why do they hide their presence?"
"Because they want to seek even greater power. They want to become the rulers of this world, to have their consciousness cover the entire Earth. They want to become true gods!" The Cult Leader shouted, then continued, "But as I mentioned earlier, Earth's spiritual energy is now too scarce."
"If they want to break through to the Nascent Soul Realm, they must absorb a vast amount of spiritual energy. So, they fabricated a lie that the highest level a martial practitioner can reach is the Heaven-ranked martial arts grandmaster realm, making most of the martial practitioners on Earth believe that they can only reach this level. Otherwise, if there are more martial practitioners who break through to the peak of ancient martial arts, there will be more competitors for absorbing spiritual energy, making it more difficult for them to break through to the next stage!"
After listening to the Cult Leader, he finally understood the truth of the matter.
Originally, the ancient martial world as it was now was nothing more than a fabrication by those powerful martial practitioners to protect their interests. This was because on Earth, spiritual energy was limited, and anyone who absorbed more would leave less for others.
Nature was fair to everyone. Even if these powerful martial practitioners were stronger than others, they couldn't deprive others of their right to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
Martial practitioners below the Earth-ranked martial arts grandmaster stage needed to absorb very little spiritual energy, which wouldn't affect the others significantly. This led to the creation of such a lie.
Connor even thought that the reason there were no martial practitioners surpassing Earth-ranked martial arts grandmasters in this world was that they had likely been killed by those peak ancient martial practitioners.
Thinking about it, he couldn't help but shudder.
Although he couldn't confirm whether what the Cult Leader said was true or false, he could sense that the words made sense, and the Cult Leader didn't seem to have a reason to lie to him.
"Now, do you understand why I want to resurrect?" At this moment, the Cult Leader spoke again, looking at him.
"Do you think that with your current strength and level, you can't compete with the most powerful martial practitioners in this world?" Connor asked.
"That's right. I was in the Soul Formation Realm in my previous life. If I can successfully resurrect, my strength will be restored to at least the Nascent Soul Realm. By then, those peak ancient martial practitioners will have no way to stop me. I might even return to the Soul Formation Realm. However, if I don't have a body, I can only have my current level at most!"
The Cult Leader's face showed some anger as he continued, "I was about to succeed earlier, but you ruined everything. Today, I must kill you no matter what to vent my frustrations!"
Connor took a deep breath and then looked at the Cult Leader.
In fact, he had intentionally spoken so much to the Cult Leader just now because he had been using that time to recover his internal energy.
As for whether what the Cult Leader said was true or false, Connor didn't really care. He hadn't considered martial cultivation as the most important thing, and he didn't aspire to become the most powerful martial practitioner in the world.
He just wanted to protect the people around him and seek revenge for himself.
After recovering for a while, Connor's internal energy had already been restored by more than half. Although it wasn't at his peak state, it was much stronger than before.
If the Cult Leader had attacked him right away, Connor might have already been killed by him.
Connor didn't give the Cult Leader a chance to attack first and charged towards the Cult Leader's position, then threw a punch.
A loud sound echoed as one of the Cult Leader's remnant souls was once again shattered by Connor.
But immediately, he formed another remnant soul.
"Connor, you can't possibly kill me. Even if you can shatter my remnant souls, I can create new ones!"
At this moment, his voice rang out again.
However, he seemed to be more cautious now, as all four remnant souls spoke at once, making it impossible for Connor to distinguish the true soul from the remnants.
"Is that so?" Connor heard this and couldn't help but sneer.
At that moment, he launched an attack on Connor once again.
The four remnant souls almost simultaneously made their moves, surrounding Connor. He could only barely defend himself and couldn't find any opportunity to counterattack.
Moreover, Connor noticed that these four remnant souls seemed to be identical, with no differences in speed or strength. This puzzled Connor.
"Since I can't distinguish which one is the true soul, I'll just have to kill them all!" Connor shouted and broke through the Cult Leader's encirclement.
Then, in an instant, Connor rushed to one of the remnant souls and raised his fist to strike.
A thunderous crash sounded!
In an instant, the remnant soul dissipated into thin air.

chapters.title: Chapter 1969: Connor, Wake Up!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1969: Connor, Wake Up!
"Is it all fake?!"
Connor, after seeing the remnants disappear, launched another attack.
In just a moment, he used all his strength and threw four punches.
The four remnants that had surrounded him had all been shattered by his strikes.
But what shocked him was that all four of them were just remnants, and there was no trace of the Cult Leader's true soul.
"Hahaha..."
The Cult Leader's mocking laughter echoed once more.
Connor, with a vigilant expression, looked around at his surroundings, preparing to face the Cult Leader's next attack.
"Connor, you are truly foolish. Did you think I didn't know you were recovering your strength while I was talking? In fact, I was intentionally buying time, and those four remnants were just there to delay you!"
At that moment, the Cult Leader reappeared before Connor.
Connor glanced at him and asked in a low voice, "Why did you want to buy time?"
"I already told you, I want you to suffer until you die!"
The Cult Leader laughed and suddenly threw a black silk box into the sky.
When the box reached halfway, it erupted into an incredibly blinding light.
"The Fivefold Wound Formation is finally complete!"
The Cult Leader laughed triumphantly.
Following this, Connor suddenly saw a massive formation appear beneath his feet, divided into five parts.
"Connor, it has been many years since anyone has forced me to use this formation. You are the first in nearly a century, and even in death, you should consider yourself fortunate!"
The Cult Leader said as he watched Connor.
Connor stared at the formation beneath him, hesitating about how to deal with it.
This was the first time he had encountered something like this, and he couldn't find a way to break it.
The Cult Leader began chanting an incantation.
After a few seconds, the formation finally responded.
First, a chilling wind howled, followed by thunder striking down, flames engulfing him, bone-chilling cold, and a thousand poisons invading his body!
The so-called Fivefold Wound Formation simultaneously attacked with the world's most ferocious five elements.
Due to the existence of the formation, these five forces complemented each other, causing tremendous damage.
Under this horrifying formation, even Heaven-ranked Martial Masters would need to take a step back. Connor was no exception.
For a moment, he was attacked by these five different forces, and his body emitted various dazzling lights. At first, he could barely resist using his chi, but since chi was finite, he eventually ran out. Connor's expression turned grim.
As the Cult Leader had said, he wanted to torment Connor to death.
Connor was experiencing a level of pain that ordinary people could not imagine. Five different forces were simultaneously ravaging his body, as if they could tear him apart at any moment.
Moreover, the formation seemed to continuously provide spiritual energy to Connor, not to save him but to keep him conscious while enduring the torment.
Watching him being tormented relentlessly, the onlookers felt a deep admiration for the Cult Leader.
Although his strength was indeed terrifying, in their eyes, the Cult Leader was still superior.
The Cult Leader, looking at his suffering, had a somewhat triumphant expression, as if he were appreciating the most exquisite artwork in the world.
"Ah..."
At that moment, his body seemed to have reached its limit, and he let out a deafening scream.
Even Rachel, who was inside the altar, heard Connor's agonized cry.
"Connor!"
She realized something was wrong and hurriedly stepped outside the altar.
However, the Blood Moon Sect's elders directly stopped her, saying in a low voice, "Until the Cult Leader returns, no one is allowed to leave this altar!"
"Get out of my way! I need to save Connor!"
She shouted as if she had lost her mind.
But the elders of the Blood Moon Sect, with their strength surpassing her, easily subdued her.
Kneeling on the ground, tears streamed down her face. She knew what was happening outside, but she couldn't do anything. This feeling was unbearable.
On the other side, an unknown amount of time had passed.
Connor's agonizing screams had finally stopped, but the Fivefold Wound Formation seemed to continue without end.
This indicated that he hadn't died yet; his body was still enduring the torment.
"How boring!"
The Cult Leader, looking at his location, let out a sigh and turned to return to the altar.
At this point, the Cult Leader seemed to have already confirmed that Connor would be tormented to death by the Fivefold Wound Formation, so he didn't plan to watch any longer.
"Connor, wake up!"
But at that moment, a voice suddenly echoed in Connor's mind, reawakening his consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1970: Save Yourself!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1970: Save Yourself!
"Carl, is that you?"
Connor weakly responded.
"Yes, it's me!"
"Back then, I left a divine consciousness in your mind. If you were ever fatally injured, this divine consciousness would activate to save your life," explained Carl.
"In this situation, can you save me?" Connor asked, while still struggling against the torment of the Fivefold Wound Formation.
"I cannot save you, but you can save yourself!" Carl whispered.
"What do you mean?" Connor asked.
"The crucial part of this formation is the silk box in the sky. If you can destroy it, the formation will disappear with it!" Carl said directly.
"I can't move at all right now, let alone go and destroy that box..." Connor felt helpless.
"I can help you..." Carl replied faintly, and Connor suddenly felt a mysterious energy within his body.
"I didn't expect you to have an ace up your sleeve!" Connor couldn't help but smile when he sensed the mysterious energy.
"There's no other choice. You are the only hope for finding my true soul. I absolutely won't allow you to die like this!" Carl answered softly.
The next moment, Connor's body suddenly erupted in a blinding golden light.
The Cult Leader, who had thought it was all over, suddenly felt something amiss and turned to look.
He saw Connor's body soaring into the sky, heading straight for the silk box above.
At this moment, the Cult Leader realized that something was wrong and tried to intervene to stop Connor.
But it was too late. Connor, with the help of Carl's energy, reached the sky and shattered the silk box with a single punch.
As the box exploded, the Fivefold Wound Formation also disappeared.
The Cult Leader's expression turned terrifying because this formation was supported by the power of his soul. Now that Connor had destroyed the formation, the Cult Leader's soul was affected as well.
After destroying the Fivefold Wound Formation, Connor rushed towards the Cult Leader.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, TInfinite Paths!"
He roared, and his fist struck directly at the Cult Leader's soul.
The Cult Leader was instantly sent flying and crashed to the ground.
At this point, the Cult Leader's soul had become extremely weak. While he hadn't been directly obliterated by Connor's punch, he had begun to blur and fade.
Previously, the Cult Leader's soul was virtually indistinguishable from a human body. It was impossible to see any differences with the naked eye.
But now, everyone could feel that the Cult Leader was no longer truly human.
"This person actually defeated the Cult Leader?"
"How is this possible? How could the Cult Leader be defeated?"
For a moment, everyone was in deep shock. Just a moment ago, they believed Connor had lost, but in the next moment, he had broken free from the Fivefold Wound Formation and severely injured the Cult Leader.
After destroying the Fivefold Wound Formation, the Cult Leader's soul had been seriously damaged. Later, he was hit hard by Connor's punch, which left him unable to release his remnants. Even normal movement was impossible.
Finally, a look of fear flashed across the Cult Leader's face.
He had lived for thousands of years in this world, but this was undoubtedly the most dangerous moment he had ever faced. He was constantly thinking about how to escape from this predicament.
Connor continued to approach the Cult Leader step by step.
"Connor, spare me, and I'll do anything you want. I know many secrets of the martial world. If you spare me, I'll tell you all of these secrets, how about that?" the Cult Leader stammered, pleading with Connor.
However, Connor seemed to pay no attention to his pleas and continued to advance.
"I'm a ghost. You can't kill me. I will come back for revenge sooner or later!" the Cult Leader shouted, trying to get up and escape.
But the next moment, Carl took control of Connor's body.
His eyes turned crimson, and a massive vortex formed in front of him.
When the Cult Leader saw this vortex, he was left dumbfounded and screamed in terror.
But no matter how hard he tried, this time, he was undeniably doomed.
Despite the Cult Leader's threats and pleas for mercy, his soul was gradually devoured by the vortex.
Everyone present was left in shock at the sight. Their expressions were filled with astonishment, as they had never expected the Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect to be defeated by Connor.
After helping him consume the Cult Leader's soul, Carl returned his body.
"I've helped you devour his soul, but his soul energy is extremely unstable. You need to absorb this energy as soon as possible," Carl kindly reminded Connor.
"Are you in a hurry?" Connor felt that he had many things to do and didn't want to waste time on these matters.
"His soul energy is incredibly powerful, and until you've fully absorbed it, his divine consciousness might appear in your brain. At that point, he might try to seize control of your body. Although the probability of this happening is small, you should still be cautious because your soul power is vastly inferior to his," Carl said before his voice gradually weakened and disappeared completely from Connor's mind.
"I understand..." Connor hesitated for a moment, then continued, "One more question. The Cult Leader mentioned that there are martial artists in this world even more powerful than Grandmasters. Do you think that's true?"
"It's definitely true. Although the spiritual energy on Earth is no longer as abundant as it was thousands of years ago, it's still sufficient to give rise to martial artists at the Nascent Soul Realm. So, I believe there are martial artists in this world with higher realms than you," Carl said, sounding like he knew his time was limited.
"I see. Do you think it's possible for me to break through to the peak of Grandmaster?" Connor continued to inquire.
"If you absorb all of this person's soul energy, you should be able to become a Heaven-ranked Grandmaster. As for you..." Carl's voice grew weaker until it disappeared completely from Connor's mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1971: The Blood Moon Sect's Destruction
chapters.content:
Chapter 1971: The Blood Moon Sect's Destruction
Connor knew that Carl's divine sense should have already disappeared.
Therefore, he did not continue asking. Instead, he turned to look at the disciples not far away.
"From now on, the Blood Moon Sect no longer exists. If you want to live, get out of Sutie Mountain immediately!" Connor said expressionlessly.
The crowd did not expect Connor to let them go, so when they heard his words, they walked out of the headquarters like crazy.
After Connor saw these people run away, he walked towards the altar.
At this moment, the elders in the altar did not know that their Cult Leader had already been killed by Connor. They had to wait for their Cult Leader to return with anticipation.
"Creak!"
The door of the altar was slowly pushed open from the outside.
When the Blood Moon Sect Elders saw someone walk in, they knelt on the ground almost at the same time and shouted, "Congratulations, Cult Leader!"
"Congratulations, Cult Leader?"
After Connor heard everyone's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Where did you guys get your joy from?"
"We're congratulating you, Cult Leader..." One of the elders slowly raised his head and looked up. When he realized that the person who walked in was not the Cult Leader, but rather Connor, he was dumbfounded. He looked at Connor in a daze with an expression of disbelief.
"This... How is that possible?"
The others seemed to have noticed something was wrong and looked up as well.
"He's alive?"
When Taran saw Connor, he also looked incredulous.
Only Rachel had fainted from crying.
Connor looked at the elder in front of him and asked calmly, "Answer me? Where did you get your joy from?"
"Impossible, this is absolutely impossible. I must be seeing things. Where's the Cult Leader? Where's our Cult Leader?" the elder shouted excitedly at Connor.
"Your Cult Leader is already dead!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Dead?"
Everyone's expression changed drastically.
Connor slowly turned his head to look at Rachel. He found that Rachel had already fainted at this time, and she was also injured.
"Did you do it?"
Connor pointed at the wound on Rachel's body.
"I…"
For a moment, everyone seemed to not know how to answer Connor.
his face was filled with anger. Without any hesitation, he waved his right hand, and a cold light flashed.
Instantly, the few remaining Elders of the Blood Moon Sect were beheaded.
From then on, the Blood Moon Sect, which had existed in Sommerville for almost a thousand years, was completely destroyed.
Other than the disciples that Connor had let go, none of the core members of the Blood Moon Sect were spared. All of them had died at his hands.
Connor seemed to have unintentionally helped all the martial artists solve a big problem, but there was an even bigger problem that had appeared now.
That was the peak of ancient martial arts that the cult leader had told Connor about before. If those people really existed and were really as the cult leader had said, then these people were very likely the greatest enemies of the world's ancient martial arts.
However, Connor was not in the mood to care about those people at the moment. After all, he had always been in a state of never offending others if they did not offend him. As long as these people did not take the initiative to provoke Connor, he would not choose to deal with them just because these people controlled ancient martial arts.
Taran looked at Connor in front of him and was so excited that he did not know what to say. He did not expect Connor to be able to defeat the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader.
At this moment, Taran knew that he could finally survive.
The other two people were also very excited, as if Connor was the hero who saved the world in their eyes.
Connor was not in the mood to bother with these people at all. He directly walked to Rachel's side.
"She... She's fine. She fainted just now because she was too agitated…" Taran whispered.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Taran, then used his own Chi to help Rachel wake up.
A moment later, Rachel finally opened her eyes.
When Rachel saw Connor, she was so excited that she reached out and hugged Connor. Then, tears kept flowing out.
At this moment, Rachel didn't know if she was dreaming or if Connor was alive. She didn't even dare to speak, because she was worried that if she spoke, he would disappear.
"How long are you planning to hug me?"
Connor asked exasperatedly.
Rachel was stunned for a moment when she heard his words. Then, she slowly let go of Connor and asked carefully, "Connor, are you alive? Am I dreaming right now?"
"That's right, you're not dreaming. You're indeed alive!"
Connor said helplessly.
"You bastard, do you know how worried I was just now? I thought you were dead!"
It was as if Rachel had suddenly changed into a different person. She began to beat his chest.
"No, why are you hitting me? Why do you make it seem like you really want me to die?" Connor asked exasperatedly.
"Since you didn't die, why did you scream so miserably?"
Rachel shouted.
"I almost died at the hands of that cult leader. I just got lucky and survived!"
Rachel calmed down a little and asked, "Where's that Cult Leader? Have you killed him?"
"Yes, I've already killed him!"
Connor nodded.
After Taran and the others heard his words, they were all stunned, disbelief on their faces. After all, in their eyes, the Cult Leader was an invincible existence. Of course, they were more excited because as long as he was dead, the few of them could live.
"Benefactor, thank you for saving my life!"
A young man who survived knelt on the ground and shouted at Connor with an excited expression.
The little girl quickly knelt on the ground and said, "Thank you big brother, for saving us…"
Connor was a little embarrassed by these two people and replied, "You two don't have to be so polite. I didn't kill the Cult Leader to save the two of you!"
"Although you didn't come to save me, you're my savior no matter what. I'll repay your kindness even if I have to work like a cow or a horse for the rest of my life!" the young man said excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1972: Help Me Deal With Yamino Gomez!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1972: Help Me Deal With Yamino Gomez!
Connor looked at the young man with a helpless expression. However, he did not continue to say anything. Instead, he turned his head to look at Taran.
Although Taran was close to fifty years old, he was imprisoned in the Blood Moon Sect all year round, so he had to let Taran consume all kinds of precious medicinal herbs every day.
This also caused Taran to look much younger than his actual age, looking like he was about 30 years old.
Connor had gone through so much to find this man.
However, at this moment, this man was standing in front of Connor. He looked at Taran with an indescribable feeling in his heart.
He felt like after everything was finally over, the stone weighing his heart down had finally shattered.
Taran was also looking at Connor. He didn't know who Connor was, nor did he know why he would come looking for him, so even if the Cult Leader was dead, Taran was very nervous. He was worried that if Connor had come for his body, he would be unable to escape his fate.
Connor slowly raised his head to look at Taran and said to Taran, "You're that Grand Master by Yamino Gomez's side, right?"
"Yes!"
Taran was very clear about how terrifying his strength was, so he did not dare to lie when facing Connor.
"I went through so much trouble to find you just for one thing: I hope you can help me deal with Yamino!" Connor continued.
"Help you deal with Yamino Gomez?"
When Taran heard his words, he was stunned again, and the expression on his face seemed to be even more puzzled.
Connor lightly nodded. "That's right. I know that you've been by Yamino Gomez's side for many years and must have grasped quite a few secrets about him."
Taran hesitated for a moment before saying, "Your strength is so terrifying. If you want to kill Yamino, it should be a very simple matter. You don't need my help at all, right?"
"Of course it's easy for me to kill him, but if I want to overthrow Rockefeller's control in Yarlford, I need your help. Just killing Yamino Gomez alone won't completely cut off Rockefeller's control in Yarlford!"
Taran's face was filled with shock when he heard Connor's words. He had never thought that his ambition would be so great; his real target wasn't Yamino, but the entirety of Rockefeller.
This made Taran even more curious about his background. First, he had dealt with the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader, and now, he was dealing with the even more terrifying giant called Rockefeller.
Either of these two organizations was a very terrifying existence. How could ordinary people be free to deal with them?
"Who exactly are you?" Taran asked.
