Connor raised his head. He opened his mouth to explain, but he suddenly realized that the aura in his body had become very unstable. He was very likely to faint immediately.
Once Connor fainted at this time, then Taran would likely take this opportunity to escape.
At that time, Connor would have to waste a lot of time to find him again.
He immediately said to Rachel, "Rachel, bring them out now and wait for me outside. I need to go into seclusion immediately. If I don't come out, no one can come in!"
"Got it!"
Rachel also seemed to know that his current condition wasn't very good, so she hurriedly nodded.
"Watch this person too!"
Connor instructed.
"I know!"
"Wait, you haven't answered me. Who are you?" Taran shouted excitedly at Connor.
"I don't have time to explain too much to you now, but you can rest assured that I'm not a bad person to you. If I really wanted to harm you, you would have been dead by now!"
Connor suppressed the aura in his body and replied in a low voice.
Taran was stunned for a moment. Although Connor did not answer his question directly, he knew that what Connor said just now was very reasonable.
If Connor really wanted to kill him, then he would have died long ago.
Rachel could feel that Connor's condition seemed to be getting worse and worse. She frowned and urged, "Come out with me!"
Taran hesitated for a moment before following Rachel out of the altar. As for the young man and the little girl who survived, they also followed him out.
When everyone walked out of the altar, Connor finally could not suppress the violent aura in his body. He closed his eyes and fainted.
…
When Connor opened his eyes again, he didn't know how much time had passed. Rachel just happened to come in to see his situation.
"Connor, you're awake?"
Rachel saw that he had woken up and shouted excitedly.
"Yes…"
Connor nodded lightly and asked again, "What's the situation outside now?"
"Most of the Blood Moon Sect's disciples have already left the main sect, so we're relatively safe now. As for the situation inside Sutie Mountain, I'm not very sure because I haven't left either!" Rachel hurriedly replied.
"Where's Taran?"
"I was worried that Taran would run away, so I locked him in the room. Donnie and I took turns to watch him."
Rachel replied.
"Donnie?"
When Connor heard this name, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. The expression on his face was a little puzzled.
"Donnie is the young man you saved before. His proper name is Donald Hackett. I was worried that he might be in danger after going out with that little girl, so I left the two of them behind. Donnie was very grateful to you for saving him, so he is very loyal to you!" Rachel explained.
"I see!"
Connor lightly nodded before continuing, "I might need to continue my seclusion for a while. I devoured the Cult Leader's soul before, but I haven't completely absorbed his power. I need some time to absorb it all, so I'll have to trouble you to keep an eye on Taran during this period of time."
"Don't worry, Taran's strength is inferior to mine. He has no chance to escape at all!"
Rachel said confidently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1973: The Alliance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1973: The Alliance
"That's good!"
After Connor knew that Rachel could keep Taran under control, he felt more at ease.
After all, what Connor was most worried about was Taran.
Rachel hesitated for a moment before asking, "How long will you be in seclusion this time?"
"I'm not too sure either. This remnant soul is extremely powerful. It won't be easy to absorb all of its power!"
"Then you can stay here in seclusion. Leave the matters outside to me!"
Rachel said seriously.
After all, she could finally do something to help Connor, so her mood was very good. At the very least, her trip with Connor was not useless.
"Thank you for your hard work!"
Connor said.
"You're the one who's really working hard!"
After experiencing so many things, Rachel knew how difficult it was for Connor now, so she was obviously much gentler in her treatment of him.
"I'm not used to you talking to me like this!" Connor said with a smile.
"Why are you like this? I'm only treating you a little better because it's not easy for you. Do you want me to scold you so that you can feel better?" Rachel shouted exasperatedly.
"If you're like this, I'll feel much more normal…"
"Get lost!"
Rachel fiercely glared at Connor and immediately walked out of the altar.
After seeing Rachel leave, Connor prepared to absorb the power of the Cult Leader.
Carl had reminded him that the Cult Leader's soul power was very terrifying; although Connor had already devoured his soul, this did not mean that the Cult Leader was really dead. His consciousness would continue to exist in Connor's mind. Only when this soul's power was completely absorbed by Connor would the Cult Leader truly die.
Otherwise, once his consciousness weakened, he would fight with Connor for control of his body. At that time, the Cult Leader might use Connor's body to revive himself.
Of course, this kind of resurrection was different from using the corpses of Taran and the others. The Cult Leader could only control Connor's body at most by using his body to resurrect himself. However, by using Taran's body to resurrect, he could recover most of his strength when he was alive.
Therefore, absorbing the Cult Leader's power was the most important thing for Connor. He didn't want to leave such a huge hidden danger in his body.
Connor slowly closed his eyes and began to absorb the Cult Leader's soul power bit by bit.
Because the Cult Leader's soul power was extremely terrifying, this process was very long. It was far from being as easy as absorbing the other remnant soul's power.
…
At the same time, the news of a Sommervillan martial artist razing the entire Blood Moon Sect and killing its Cult Leader spread like a virus to every corner of the world.
Nothing could be done about it. The influence of this matter was too terrifying. Furthermore, Connor did not hide anything when he entered the Blood Moon Sect. Countless Blood Moon Sect disciples had escaped death from his hands, so it was very normal for this news to spread.
This matter was big news for martial artists all over the world.
After all, the Blood Moon Sect had been famous in Winam for many years. Who would have thought that it would be destroyed so easily by a single Sommervillan warrior? Even the famous Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect had died in the hands of this person. This was simply unbelievable.
Of course, because the Blood Moon Sect disciples did not know Connor and had never seen him before, the outside world did not know that this expert who easily wiped out the entire Blood Moon Sect was Jorge Yarrell's disciple, the Young Sect Leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, Connor McDonald
If these people knew his true identity, they would probably be even more shocked.
In the end, Winam gave Connor a nickname: Soul Eater!
Many Blood Moon Sect disciples had seen Connor devour the Blood Moon Cult Leader's soul with their own eyes.
The Blood Moon Cult Leader was a god-like existence in the hearts of Winam back then. Therefore, in order to better address the expert who killed the leader, they gave Connor such a name.
The outside world didn't know much about the Soul Eater. They only knew that the Soul Eater was about 20 years old, was handsome, and was from Sommerville. Moreover, there was an extremely beautiful woman beside him.
Other than that, there was no other clear information.
However, the fact that the Soul Eater had killed the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader had caused a huge uproar internationally!
No one knew why the Soul Eaters would attack the Blood Moon Sect. This was also the reason why the other sects felt uneasy.
There were even many foreign ancient martial arts sect leaders gathered together to discuss the matter of the Soul Eater.
"Who is this Soul Eater? Could it be that there's no news from Sommerville?"
"We don't have any specific information about the Soul Eater yet, and we don't know when such a terrifying martial artist appeared…"
"I think what we should be concerned about now is not the identity of this Soul Eater, but rather why would he attack the Blood Moon Sect!"
"I've also asked my men to investigate, but they couldn't find out who the Blood Moon Sect had offended!"
"That's right. The Blood Moon Sect has been in Winam all these years and has never had any conflicts with other sects!"
At this moment, an elderly man said expressionlessly, "What if this Soul Eater attacks us after dealing with the Blood Moon Sect?"
"This…"
Everyone was stunned when they heard this, and their expressions seemed a little ugly.
The old man looked at everyone and said in a very serious tone, "I think we need to form an alliance now. Once the Soul Eaters attack any of our sects, the other sects must support them unconditionally. This way, the Soul Eater will be afraid of our strength. If we let him attack us one by one, we might end up like the Blood Moon Sect!"
"That's right, I agree with this suggestion!"
"I agree too!"
Although these people did not even know who the Soul Eater was or why they were dealing with the Blood Moon Sect, they chose to prepare for the worst.
After all, the ancient martial arts world was like this: the strong were respected.
Sometimes, some truly powerful people didn't need a clear reason to do anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1974: Peaceful Settlement
chapters.content:
Chapter 1974: Peaceful Settlement
The Soul Eater's strength was truly too terrifying.
Even the Blood Moon Cult Leader was no match for him. His existence had already threatened the original balance of the ancient martial arts world.
This might very well lead to the destruction of the ancient martial arts world!
The ancient martial arts world had been silent for too many years. It was rare for a single Soul Eater to wipe out an entire sect with his own strength.
Most of the ancient martial arts sects were used to a stable life.
But this time, the Soul Eater incident made them realize that there was no such thing as stability in the world of martial artists.
The foreign martial artists fell into an endless state of unease, while the martial artists of Sommerville were instantly in an uproar after learning about the Soul Eater.
This was because they had no idea when such an expert had appeared in Sommerville!
"I heard that the Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect was besieged by the Cult Leaders of the four sects. He survived and escaped to Winam!"
"That's right. The Blood Moon Cult Leader's strength is very terrifying…"
"I didn't expect that the Soul Eater of Sommerville would be even more terrifying. He actually wiped out the entire Blood Moon Sect single-handedly. It's unbelievable…"
"It seems that the martial artists of our Sommerville are more powerful than the martial artists of other places!"
"I wonder who this Soul Eater is? He really wanted to see this expert with his own eyes!"
Similar discussions appeared among the various sects. It was as if everyone admired this legendary Soul Eater in their hearts.
Although most people didn't know the true identity of the Soul Eater, some people knew that this so-called Soul Eater was none other than Connor McDonald.
..
Although the outside world was talking about the Soul Eaters, the leaders of Winam were probably the most affected.
After all, Winam had also sent out a team of elites to stop Connor at Sutie Mountain. However, they never expected that the Cult Leader of the Blood Moon Sect would die in the hands of the Soul Eater. This made the leaders of Winam anxious all day long because they were worried that the Soul Eater would attack them next.
One had to know that these leaders' greatest backup was probably the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader. Now that the Cult Leader had died at the hands of the Soul Eater, they had no way of dealing with this powerful enemy should he come for them.
Therefore, the leaders of Winam gathered together for a full three days, trying to find the most suitable way to solve this problem.
However, three days had passed, and they hadn't come up with a suitable solution.
…
In a building in Willborough.
Almost all the leaders of Winam had gathered together. At this moment, everyone's expression was very ugly because they did not know how to deal with the problem of the Soul Eaters.
As the leader of these people, Black Tiger's expression was very solemn. He had been in power for so many years, but this was the first time he had encountered such trouble.
At this moment, a middle-aged man asked in a low voice, "Sir, what should we do next?"
"..."
When Black Tiger heard this, he could not help but take a deep breath. Then, he said in a low voice, "Are you all trash? After discussing for so long, you still can't come up with a suitable solution?"
"The Soul Eater's strength is really too terrifying. Even if we use our full strength, it'll probably be very difficult for us to contend with him!" the middle-aged man replied helplessly.
"You can't even fight him with all your strength?"
The expression on Black Tiger's face was somewhat shocked.
The middle-aged man nodded lightly. "Yes, we've already done the calculations. Even if we mobilize all our forces, it'll be very difficult to kill this Soul Eater!"
Black Tiger's body trembled slightly. How could he have imagined that the enemy this time would be so terrifying?
If Winam's combat strength was slightly higher, they might be able to compete with the new enemy. However, their combat strength was too weak.
After hesitating for a moment, Black Tiger gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice, "Can this matter be resolved peacefully?"
"We're not very sure about that. After all, no one knows what the Soul Eater wants!"
"Where is the Soul Eater now?" Black Tiger asked.
"He never came out after entering Sutie Mountain. Our people have been monitoring the vicinity of Sutie Mountain this whole time!" the middle-aged man continued.
After hesitating for a moment, Black Tiger said in a low voice, "Since our strength is inferior to the Soul Eater, we can only choose to lower our heads and admit our mistakes. Let's see if we can obtain the Soul Eater's forgiveness!"
The middle-aged man's expression changed drastically when he heard this, and he hurriedly shouted, "Sir, you must not do this!"
"That's right, Your Excellency. If you really bow your head, then Winam might never be able to regain its pride!"
"With your status, how can you lower your head to a mere martial artist?"
The expressions on everyone's faces were extremely ugly. Clearly, their pride made it impossible for them to accept such an outcome.
"If I don't bow to the Soul Eater, do you have any better ideas?" Black Tiger asked coldly.
When everyone heard his words, they were all stunned. The expressions on their faces were very awkward because they really could not think of any other better way.
"It is unexpected that we have actually reached this stage…" the middle-aged man could not help but sigh.
"The strong are respected. There's nothing embarrassing about bowing to the strong and admitting your mistakes!" Black Tiger calmly consoled everyone and then continued, "Come with me tomorrow to pay a visit to this god slayer!"
"Yes, sir!"
Everyone hurriedly nodded after hearing Black Tiger's words.
However, at this moment, these people were very afraid. After all, they all knew how terrifying the Soul Eater's strength was. They were worried that if the Soul Eater started a massacre, they might lose their lives.
However, Black Tiger had already given the order. Even if these people had an endless well of courage, they would definitely not dare to disobey his will!
…
The next day, Black Tiger brought the people of Winam into Sutie Mountain.
Of course, Black Tiger himself was also very afraid of the Soul Eater's strength, so he deliberately took a heavy armored vehicle into Sutie Mountain, and there were countless soldiers following him.
Perhaps this was the only way to give Black Tiger a sense of security. However, he did not know that these people were just like ants in front of Connor. If Connor really wanted to kill him, these people would not be able to stop him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1975: Breaking Through to the Heaven Rank
chapters.content:
Chapter 1975: Breaking Through to the Heaven Rank
This was because Black Tiger and the rest were disciples of the Blood Moon Sect.
It was not their first time entering Sutie Mountain; naturally, they knew the exact location of the Blood Moon Sect headquarters.
Therefore, they quickly found the location.
When Rachel saw so many people driving into the headquarters in heavy armored vehicles, she was very nervous because she didn't know what these people wanted to do.
However, Connor was in closed-door cultivation at this time. Rachel did not dare to enter the altar to wake Connor up, so for a moment, she did not know what to do.
Donald and the other little girl had never seen such a scene before. When they saw the mighty army, their expressions were extremely nervous.
The little girl, Linnie, raised her head and looked at Rachel. She asked Rachel nervously, "Miss Wallace, are these people here to deal with Brother Connor?"
Rachel said helplessly, "I'm not sure either…"
Donald hesitated for a moment before asking, "Miss Wallace, should we wake Mr. McDonald up?"
"Don't disturb Connor for the time being. I'll ask these people what they want to do. If they really want to deal with him, then I'll wake him up!" Rachel replied in a low voice.
Donald didn't say anything else after hearing Rachel's words.
A moment later, Black Tiger and the others finally arrived in front of the altar.
After Black Tiger saw that Connor did not appear for a long time, he directly got out of the heavy armored vehicle and stood quietly in place. The other leaders of Winam naturally also got out of the heavy armored vehicles.
When Rachel saw that these people were all standing there quietly, the expression on her face grew a little puzzled. She felt that if these people really came to deal with Connor, they could have just opened fire and declared war. There was no need to stand there and wait!
Rachel turned to Donald and Linnie.
"The two of you wait here. If I'm in any danger later, go and wake Connor up immediately!"
"Miss Wallace, why don't I go out and you stay here?" Donald hastily said.
"No need…"
Rachel refused without thinking and then walked out of the room.
At this moment, she was very nervous because she did not know what the other party's goal was. However, she tried her best to control her emotions and try not to let others see her nervousness.
A moment later, Rachel finally walked in front of Black Tiger and the others. Then, she shouted, "Who are you? What are you doing here?"
"Hello, respected lady. My name is Black Tiger. I've specially come to visit Lord Soul Eater today!"
Black Tiger had already grasped the situation on his side. He also knew that the beautiful woman who appeared in front of him was the Soul Eater's woman, so his attitude towards Rachel was very polite.
Rachel had been paying attention to the situation outside these days, so she knew very well that the Soul Eater mentioned by Black Tiger was referring to Connor. However, what Rachel never expected was that Black Tiger, the most powerful figure in Winam, had actually come to pay a visit to Connor personally, and his attitude was so respectful!
However, Rachel knew that since the other party's attitude was so respectful, it meant that they had no intention of starting a war. This also made Rachel relax a lot.
"Mr. McDonald is in closed-door cultivation. If you want to see him, you should come back another day!" Rachel shouted expressionlessly.
Black Tiger hesitated for a moment when he heard this. Then, he asked, "Ma'am, when will the Soul Eater come out of seclusion?"
Rachel gently shook her head. "I'm not very sure about this…"
"Then we'll just stand here and wait for the Soul Eater to come out!"
In order to express his sincerity, Black Tiger actually planned to stand here and wait for Connor.
Rachel looked at the expression on Black Tiger's face, shocked. She never thought that this guy would be so afraid of Connor.
"I'm not sure when Mr. McDonald will come out. If you're willing to wait, you don't have to stand here all the time. The Blood Moon Sect has many places to stay now," Rachel shouted, then turned around and walked into the room.
After everyone saw her leave, they surrounded Black Tiger.
"Sir, we don't know when the Soul Eater will come out. We can't wait like this!"
"Yes, sir. There are many things waiting for you to deal with. It's not right for you to wait here all the time!"
"Why don't you go back first? We'll just wait here…"
Everyone began to persuade him.
"Now is the time for the survival of our Winam. Do you think there is anything else more important than this?" Black Tiger shouted expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Black Tiger's words, they were all stunned on the spot. Their expressions were very awkward, and they did not know how to answer for a moment.
"If you don't want to wait here, then you can go back now!"
Black Tiger continued.
Everyone looked at each other awkwardly, but they did not dare to leave.
…
In the blink of an eye, seven days passed.
Connor, who had been in closed-door cultivation all this time, had no idea what was happening outside at all. He also did not know that Black Tiger and the others had been standing outside waiting for him all this time.
Connor had used these seven days to absorb more than half of the Cult Leader's soul power. However, if he wanted to fully absorb all of it, he might need at least a few months.
Connor didn't want to waste any more time on this. Besides, the Cult Leader's consciousness was already very weak and wouldn't pose any threat to Connor at all. Therefore, Connor ended his seclusion ahead of time and prepared to deal with the following matters.
After Connor absorbed most of the Cult Leader's soul power, his strength had also broken through from the peak of the Earth Realm to the Heaven Realm.
At this moment, Connor felt that what the Cult Leader had said to him was true. THis realm advancement did not take much effort; as long as there was enough spiritual energy to support it, an Earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster could actually become a Heaven-ranked one. It was not as difficult as the rumors said.
After Connor ended his seclusion, he walked straight out of the altar. However, it was already late at night, so Black Tiger and the others had returned to their rooms to rest and did not wait for Connor immediately.
Rachel had not slept yet because she needed to look after Taran.

chapters.title: Chapter 1976: Compensation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1976: Compensation
"It's so late. Why are you still here?"
Connor asked
Rachel couldn't help but be stunned when she heard him. Then, she suddenly raised her head and looked at Connor before saying, "You're out?"
"Yes, I just came out!" Connor nodded lightly and continued, "Did anything happen while I was in seclusion?"
Rachel thought for a while and told him about what happened recently and the discussion about Connor killing the Cult Leader.
"Soul Eater?" Connor couldn't help but smile lightly when he heard the way the people outside addressed him. Then, he sighed, "That Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader isn't a god at all, and I'm not a Soul Eater!"
"Although that Cult Leader isn't a god in your heart, he's a god-like existence in the hearts of the cultivators of Winam!" Rachel explained.
"What a bunch of stupid guys. They probably don't know that the god in their hearts is actually a monster that consumes other people's souls to extend his life!" Connor said lightly.
"Ordinary people probably don't understand these things!" Rachel nodded and continued, "Right, Black Tiger's men have been waiting for you outside for a few days. They seem to want to see you!"
"Black Tiger?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this name.
"Black Tiger is the core leader of Winam. He's probably here to apologize for opening fire on you at Sutie Mountain!" Rachel explained.
"The core leader of Winam?"
Connor smiled faintly, then sighed. "I never expected that the matter between me and the Cult Leader would actually cause such a huge commotion for even such a person to be alarmed…"
"There's nothing we can do about it. They're very weak to begin with, and they were only able to get to where they are today because they has the Blood Moon Sect backing them. Now that you've killed the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader, they're naturally worried that you'll attack them next!" Rachel slowly said.
"They're thinking too much. I'm not in the mood to deal with them, but since these people are already here, let's meet them," Connor said with a smile.
"You want to meet them now?" Rachel asked in surprise.
"Yes, I have a lot of things to do, so I don't want to waste any more time here. I'd better hurry up and finish everything!"
"Alright, I'll call them in now!"
Rachel replied, then turned and walked out of the room.
A few minutes later, Rachel brought Black Tiger and the others back to his room.
At this time, Black Tiger and the others had just been woken up by Rachel, but these people did not dare to show the slightest dissatisfaction on their faces because they were very aware of how terrifying the Soul Eater was. Although Black Tiger also brought many people this time, these people were not an opponent for Connor at all.
When Black Tiger saw Connor, the expression on his face was somewhat shocked.
Although Black Tiger already knew that the Soul Eater was not old, he did not expect him to be so young.
After hesitating for a moment, Black Tiger walked in front of Connor and gently bowed. "Greetings, Lord Soul Eater!"
Although Black Tiger was their core, Winam was too weak. It might not even be as strong as the head of a big family in Sommerville. Therefore, his attitude towards Connor was very humble.
The others also took the initiative to bow to Connor.
The expressions on these people's faces were very frightened because they were very worried that if Connor suddenly attacked them, they might not even have the chance to escape.
"You are Black Tiger?" Connor asked.
"That's right!" Black Tiger hurriedly nodded.
"Let's sit down and talk!"
Connor pointed at the chair at the side.
Black Tiger took a deep breath and said, "Lord Soul Eater, I can stand and speak…"
"Haha!" Connor couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said expressionlessly, "If I had known this would happen, I wouldn't have done so. I didn't come to your Winam to make an enemy of you. I just wanted to get someone out of the Blood Moon Sect, but you actually helped the Blood Moon Sect and even attacked me."
Connor's expression was very calm when he said this, but after Black Tiger heard his words, his expression became very afraid, and his body could not help but tremble slightly.
"Your Excellency, the Blood Moon Sect has existed in this place for many years. You should know the strength of their cult leader better than I do. I'm just an ordinary person, and I can't go against important figures like you. That's why when the Cult Leader threatened me to attack you, I didn't dare to disobey his orders!" Black Tiger said with a trembling voice.
Although Connor didn't know what the relationship between Black Tiger and Cult Leader was, Connor could believe his words. He really didn't have the guts to go against the Cult Leader.
"I see!"
Connor looked at Black Tiger and smiled, then said lightly, "Are you planning to push all the responsibility to the dead Cult Leader? If you had insisted on stopping him back then, I don't think he would have done anything to you, right?"
"He would kill me!"
It could be seen from this that Black Tiger was indeed terrified of the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader.
"Aren't you afraid that I'll kill you?" Connor asked coldly.
"I…"
When Black Tiger heard his words, he was scared silly. He hurriedly bent his knees and knelt in front of Connor. He stuttered, "Sir, as long as you let me go, I can compensate you!"
When the others in the room saw this scene, their expressions were abnormally desperate.
Who would have thought that Black Tiger would choose to kneel down to Connor?
Connor looked at Black Tiger indifferently. In fact, what he said just now was just to scare Black Tiger so that he would remember this interaction. This way, if Connor wanted to do something in Winam in the future, it would be much more convenient.
However, he did not expect Black Tiger to be so excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 1977: A Treasure Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 1977: A Treasure Map
Of course, Connor did not really want to kill Black Tiger. After all, if Connor really attacked him, it would definitely bring a lot of trouble.
Rockefeller alone had already made Connor extremely busy. He did not want to provoke other forces at this time.
"Connor, I think he was forced to do so. You should let him go!"
Rachel also didn't seem to suggest that Connor make things too big, so she took the initiative to help Black Tiger. She was now very worried that Connor would really attack Black Tiger in a fit of anger.
"That's right, Lord Soul Eater. We were really forced into this!"
The other people in the room all knelt on the ground and shouted at Connor.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor said softly, "All of you, get up!"
Black Tiger slowly raised its head and glanced at Connor, but it still seemed to not dare to stand up.
"I told you all to get up. Didn't you hear me?"
Connor shouted, exasperated. How could he have thought that a person like Black Tiger would actually be so spineless?
Black Tiger stood up in fear.
"Just now, you said that you can compensate me. How do you plan to do that?" Connor asked.
"Soul Eater, I'm willing to take out two billion US dollars as compensation!"
"Two billion?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard this.
Two billion dollars was not worth mentioning to Connor, but it was an astronomical figure for a place like Winam. After all, they weren't very developed yet.
"Lord Soul Eater, two billion may not be a lot to you, but it's really the limit for us. I hope you can be lenient!" Black Tiger said in fear.
"I'm not short of money!"
Connor shook his head.
"Lord Soul Eater, if you don't lack money, I can give you land. No matter where it is, as long as it's within the boundaries of Winam, I can give it to you."
Black Tiger hurriedly continued.
"Your land doesn't seem to be very valuable, right? Besides, it's meaningless to me unless you're willing to give me all the land in your Winam. I might consider it then!" Connor said lightly.
When Rachel heard his words, she couldn't help but suck in a breath of cold air. She secretly thought that Connor's appetite was really not small for him to want all the land of Winam.
Black Tiger's expression was also very ugly. After all, he could not really give all the land of Winam to Connor. He did not have the right to do so.
"I can't satisfy your request!" Black Tiger replied in a low voice.
Connor turned to look at Black Tiger.
"But I can serve you as our new god, and I will also listen to your orders. At that time, you can replace the position of the Cult Master in our Winam. This is more suitable than you owning all our land!" Black Tiger hurriedly said.
"I'm not interested in this kind of thing!"
Connor shook his head again.
"This…"
Black Tiger was a little dumbfounded. His expression was very nervous, and fine sweat appeared on his forehead. How could he have thought that Connor would be so difficult to deal with? He had already made the biggest concessions, but Connor still seemed to be dissatisfied.
"Is there nothing else in this big place that can move me?"
Connor asked.
"..."
Black Tiger hesitated for a moment, then said, "Lord Soul Eater, I have another thing here, but I'm not sure if you're interested in it. If you're still not interested, then I can only die to atone for my sins!"
"What is it?"
"It's a treasure map!"
"A treasure map?"
Connor's expression was a little disappointed because he didn't lack money at all, so he didn't seem to be very interested in treasures.
"Lord Soul Eater, the treasure map I'm talking about isn't an ordinary treasure map. It's a secret treasure left behind by a Black-ranked practitioner a few hundred years ago. Even the cult master is very interested in this treasure map of mine…" Black Tiger hurriedly explained.
"A Black-rank from a few hundred years ago?"
Connor was slightly interested after hearing this.
"That's right!" Black Tiger nodded and continued, "I accidentally found this treasure map. I've looked for a lot of people to study it, and they all think that this treasure map should be the tomb of a Black-rank warrior who died a few hundred years ago. There are also many divine artifacts, magic treasures, and spiritual medicines inside…"
"Then have you searched for this tomb?"
Connor asked softly.
"No…" Black Tiger shook his head and continued, "Back then, I showed this treasure map to the Cult Master. He also brought people to search for it, but in the end, they didn't find it. Until now, no one has been able to unlock the secret of this treasure map!"
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then said indifferently, "Do you think I'm a fool? You just said that no one can unravel the secret of this treasure map, so how can you prove that what you just told me is true? How do you prove that this treasure is the tomb of a Black-rank warrior from a few hundred years ago?"
"Lord Soul Eater, I definitely wouldn't dare to lie to you about this!"
Black Tiger hurriedly replied and then continued, "The Cult Master said that there should be an ancient martial arts sect in Sommerville that could unlock the secret of this treasure map. He originally planned to search for this treasure after he was resurrected, but he didn't expect to die in your hands in the end. If this treasure map was fake, then the Cult Master wouldn't value it so much!"
Connor looked at Black Tiger and hesitated for a moment, then asked softly, "Then do you know which ancient martial arts sect in Sommerville can unlock the secret of this treasure map?"
"I'm not sure about that!"
Black Tiger shook his head at Connor.
"Alright, since you say that this treasure map is so powerful, then give it to me. I won't pursue your previous mistakes!"
Connor muttered.
"Lord Soul Eater, is what you said true?" Black Tiger asked excitedly.
"Of course!" Connor nodded and continued, "But you have to remember that your life is mine. If I need you to do anything in the future, you have to do it immediately, understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1978: What Are Your Conditions?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1978: What Are Your Conditions?
"Understood…"
Black Tiger felt as if his life had just been saved and nodded excitedly.
"When will the treasure map be delivered?" Connor asked.
"I'll get someone to bring it over for you now!"
Black Tiger hurriedly took out his phone and made a call.
Connor didn't say anything.
In fact, he was not interested in the conditions that Black Tiger proposed to him. Whether it was money or land, they were meaningless to him.
Therefore, he felt that it was better to have this treasure map. Perhaps he could really find some treasures.
Right now, he was still very interested in things like divine artifacts; after all, Freya had relied on the power of the phoenix bracelet to survive. If he could really find this treasure and find some even more powerful divine artifacts for Freya, then she might be even safer.
Of course, if Connor could not find this treasure, then he wouldn't lose too much. He didn't come to Winam to rob them blind, after all; he only wanted to find Taran. Now that Taran had been found, Connor had completed his goal.
He waited for about half an hour before Black Tiger's people finally sent the treasure map over.
Connor opened the treasure map and studied it carefully, but didn't see any clues, so he handed the treasure map to Rachel to see if she could see anything.
However, Rachel did not gain anything from the map either.
In the end, Connor could only put away the treasure map, planning to study it when he had time.
As for Black Tiger and the others, they did not have much value to Connor, so Connor said, "Alright, I've already obtained the treasure map. You can all leave now…"
Black Tiger was stunned for a moment and asked Connor softly, "Sir, are you letting us go?"
"I guess so!"
"Thank you, my lord!"
Black Tiger shouted excitedly after knowing that Connor had let him go. Then, he led his men out of the room.
After walking out of the room, Black Tiger did not dare to stay in Sutie Mountain for more than half a second. He directly left in a tank.
After Connor felt that Black Tiger and the others had already left, he turned his head and smiled at Rachel. He said softly, "I didn't expect this Black Tiger to be so timid. I originally didn't plan to fuss about these things with them, but I didn't expect them to take the initiative to come to my door!"
"There's nothing they can do about it. The people they've come into contact with before are people like the Blood Moon Cult Leader. They'll naturally think that you won't let them off easily just like the Cult Leader. Besides, who would have thought that you came to Winam just to save one person!"
Rachel replied indifferently.
"That's true!"
Connor felt that what Rachel said was reasonable, so he nodded lightly and continued to ask, "What do you think of this treasure map?"
"I don't understand. I've never come into contact with these things before. I think you can go and ask Master Yarrell. He's very knowledgeable and should be able to understand!" Rachel said softly.
Connor was stunned for a moment after hearing Rachel's words. Then, he frowned and said, "If you didn't mention it, I would have forgotten. There seems to have been no news of that old man for a long time. The people from the Purple Cloud Sect don't know where he went either."
"Maybe he's in seclusion to cultivate!" Rachel said softly.
"It's also possible…"
Connor nodded and did not continue.
He felt that Jorge Yarrell's strength was very terrifying. Even now, he did not have a hundred percent confidence in defeating Jorge, so Jorge should not be in any danger.
"What do you plan to do next?" Rachel asked.
"I've already wasted some time in my closed-door cultivation. Yamino's probably already received the news and will return to Yarlford soon, so you should prepare yourself," Connor said softly.
"Are you going back tomorrow?"
Rachel asked.
"Yes, tomorrow we will bring Taran to Solsby in Cameron. Haven't you always wanted to meet your grandparents? I can give you one day to meet them before you return to Yarlford!" Connor said lightly.
"If you're in a hurry to go back, I don't have to go to Solsby!"
Rachel was not willing to affect Connor's plan because of her.
"There's no hurry…" Connor shook his head lightly and continued, "There's still time for you to meet your grandparents!"
"Alright then, I'll book the plane tickets later!"
Rachel was very satisfied with this arrangement.
Connor stood up. "Which room is Taran in? I'll go talk to him…"
"I'll take you there!"
Rachel took the initiative to bring Connor to the place where Taran was being held.
After unlocking the door, she left without following Connor in.
After Connor entered the room, he found that Taran was already asleep on the bed, so he directly reached out and pushed his shoulder.
"Who is it?"
Taran woke up from his sleep.
"Don't be afraid, it's me!"
Connor smiled at Taran and sat on the chair beside the bed.
After Taran saw Connor, the expression on his face eased a little, and then he asked Connor softly, "You're out already?"
"Yes!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Why were you looking for me?" Taran asked warily.
"I wanted to talk to you!"
"..."
Taran hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice, "You told me before that you wanted to find me to deal with Yamino Gomez, but you still haven't told me who you are!"
"My name is Connor McDonald. You might not know me, but I'm Yamino's enemy!" Connor briefly introduced himself.
"The fact that you can become Yamino's enemy shows that you're quite capable!"
Taran sighed softly, then smiled and said, "What I said is nonsense. You can kill the Cult Leader and wipe out the entire Blood Moon Sect with your own strength. You must be quite capable…"
"I spent so much effort to find you and save you because I want you to help me deal with Yamino. Tell me, what are your conditions?" Connor asked.
"Conditions?"
When Taran heard his words, he couldn't help but be stunned.
"The conditions for you helping me deal with Yamino!" Connor said lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1979: A Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1979: A Woman!
Taran raised his head and glanced at Connor, the expression on his face appearing somewhat shocked.
He did not expect that Connor would actually be so polite to him. His strength was so terrifying that Taran felt that Connor could completely threaten him. However, he didn't seem to have this intention. On the contrary, he even asked Taran what conditions he had.
"My life was saved by you, and Yamino is also my enemy. If it weren't for him, I wouldn't have to hide everywhere, and my life wouldn't have become like this!" Taran gritted his teeth, then continued, "So if you really want to deal with Yamino, I have no conditions. I'm fully willing to help you!"
"Alright…"
Connor nodded.
Taran hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "You seem to be a little different from what I thought. With your strength, there's no need for you to discuss these things with me, right?"
"Of course I can threaten you to help me deal with Yamino, but I don't like doing that. If I can solve the problem the normal way, I will choose the normal way!" Connor explained.
"I see!"
Taran nodded and continued, "Actually, if you are really able to get rid of Yamino, then you will be doing me a great favor. Not only will I not make any requests of you, but I will also thank you properly. After all, I have been hiding everywhere for so many years in order to avoid Yamino's pursuit of me…However, it is not that easy to deal with Yamino. Do you know that there is a very terrifying organization behind him?"
Taran suddenly asked.
"It's Rockefeller, isn't it!"
"That's right, it's Rockefeller. This organization is very terrifying. If you really make a move on Yamino, you need to be prepared to receive Rockefeller's revenge!"
Taran said bluntly.
"Actually, what I really want to deal with is Rockefeller. Yamino is just the beginning of it all!" Connor said softly.
After Taran heard his words, he was stunned, disbelief on his face. He stuttered and asked, "Who exactly are you? Why do you want to deal with Rockefeller? There are also many ancient martial arts grandmasters in Rockefeller, and their strength may not be weaker than the Cult Leader. Don't think that you can deal with Rockefeller just because you can kill the Cult Leader!"
It was very obvious that Taran did not show excessive shock regarding Connor wanting to deal with Yamino because he felt that Connor had the strength to deal with Yamino.
However, when he found out that Connor was planning to deal with the entirety of Rockefeller, his expression changed. He felt that this idea was too crazy.
"You'll know who I am in a moment. You have to tell me everything you know about Yamino and Rockefeller now, and then I'll tell you about me!" Connor said expressionlessly.
Taran hesitated for two seconds. Then, he began to recall the time when he had just met Yamino.
"When I first met Yamino, he was just an ordinary businessman, and I was the vice president of his company. At that time, Yamino treated me very well, and our companies were also doing very well..."
Taran paused for a moment. "But all of this changed because of the appearance of a woman!"
"A woman?"
Connor was stunned.
"That's right, this woman is Yamino's wife, Madeline Lee!" Taran said in a low voice.
This was the first time Connor had heard of this name. Although he had investigated some matters regarding Yamino before, he had never heard of his wife.
"Madeline Lee is not a simple woman. Her father was from Rockefeller, but the scale of Rockefeller at that time was far from what it was later on. It was also a world of difference compared to now. However, it was because Yamino married her that he joined Rockefeller in the first place. Yamino and my company also received a lot of help from Rockefeller, but Yamino did not tell me about Rockefeller at the beginning. It was I who discovered that the company's accounts were wrong, and that's the only reason why he told me about Rockefeller's situation!"
"How much do you know about Rockefeller?" Connor asked.
"How much do I know about Rockefeller?" Taran was stunned for a moment and then said lightly, "Although I'm not one of Rockefeller's people, Yamino still believed me at that time. Therefore, he told me everything he knew about Rockefeller…"
"Tell me about Rockefeller's situation…"
Connor said softly.
"In the beginning, Rockefeller was just an ordinary investment company, and the founder of this investment company was called Steven Lee!"
Taran said slowly.
Connor's expression was a little strange after hearing Taran's words. He also knew that the founder of Rockefeller was actually Steven, but if Taran also knew about this, it meant that Taran really knew about Rockefeller's situation.
Of course, there was an even more important point: Connor had never told Taran about his identity, and Taran didn't know about the relationship between Connor and Steven.
This was because Connor was worried that Taran would hide something from him because he knew his true identity.
"Steven founded Rockefeller and quickly developed Rockefeller into the largest investment company in the world. However, at this time, a vice president under Steven had a disagreement with him on the management of Rockefeller. You might not know this Steven, but at that time, he was a very famous wealthy businessman and had many industries under him, not just Rockefeller. Therefore, most of the matters at Rockefeller were managed by Steven's vice president!" Taran said slowly.
"And then?"
"Back then, Steven only wanted Rockefeller to start an investment company to help him earn money, but the vice president under him was more ambitious. He hoped to control these companies through investment and gradually control all the businesses in certain areas.," Taran said. "Steven naturally opposed the vice president's idea and even wanted to fire this person from the company, but the vice president caught wind of Steven's plan, so he installed a bomb on Steven's private plane!"
"After the plane crash, everyone thought that Steven must have died, and this vice president got someone to forge a will and obtained all of Steven's assets as well as Rockefeller. In the end, he became the real owner of Rockefeller and developed it to its current scale!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1980: The Four Vajras
chapters.content:
Chapter 1980: The Four Vajras
Taran's description of Rockefeller's establishment process was almost the same as what Thomas Morgan had told Connor. This was enough to prove that Taran wasn't lying, and that he knew Rockefeller very well.
"Yamino Gomez told you all of this?" Connor asked softly.
"That's right, Yamino told me all this, and it seems like this matter isn't a secret in Rockefeller!"
"Then do you know the name of the person who founded Rockefeller?" Connor asked.
"I'm not very sure about this, but Yamino Gomez usually calls this person Mr. Long!"
Taran shook his head.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Taran without saying anything.
"The real master of Rockefeller is actually this Mr. Long, and under Mr. Long are the Four Great Vajras of Rockefeller. There are a total of four people in the Four Great Vajras, and they are called Asya, Auro, Afri and Ame!"
"These four people control the powers of the four continents, and their levels are the same. There is no distinction between superior and subordinate, and they are in a competitive relationship with each other. Below the four Guardian Deities are the eight guardians. Yamino is one of them!" Taran continued.
"According to what you said, Yamino's position in Rockefeller isn't low!" Connor said softly.
"Mhm, after all, Yamino's father-in-law was one of the eight great guardians. Yamino was merely replacing his father-in-law's position. Furthermore, all of Rockfeller's forces in Sommerville are under Yamino's control. It's normal for him to become one of the eight great guardians!" Taran said.
"Is this all the information you have about Rockefeller?" Connor asked.
"That's about it. Rockefeller is a very big organization. I only know a rough idea of the situation. I don't know much about the real internal affairs!" Taran said slowly.
"Then why did you leave Yamino?"
"According to Yamino, I left Yarlford because I knew too many of his secrets. Therefore, he was worried that I would leak these secrets and wanted to kill me to prevent future trouble," Taran said expressionlessly.
"Isn't that the truth?"
Connor frowned slightly. He could feel that there should be something else hidden in this matter.
"Of course not!" Taran sneered and continued, "That's right, I do know a lot of secrets about Yamino. It can even be said that I know everything that Yamino has done. However, these secrets are not enough to take Yamino's life, because Rockefeller can easily help him settle those things."
"What secrets?"
Connor asked excitedly.
"..."
Taran turned his head and looked at Connor, then smiled and said, "I can't tell you yet!"
Connor was stunned. "Why?"
"Because you never told me who you are from the beginning to the end. Why do you want to deal with Yamino and Rockefeller? I can't trust you 100% now. You spent so much effort just to get this secret out of my mouth, but what should I do?" Taran smiled and continued, "So before I can confirm your identity, I won't tell you this secret!"
When Connor heard Taran's words, he suddenly realized that the person he was facing right now was not an ordinary person. For Taran to be able to stay by Yamino's side for so many years and even become his advisor, this point was enough to prove that Taran was very smart.
"Aren't you afraid that I'll kill you?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"Oh, of course!" Taran nodded and continued, "But I've already made preparations. As long as I die, Yamino's secret will be made public to the world."
"You've been imprisoned in the Blood Moon Sect for so many years. Who knows if you're still alive?" Connor asked.
"The person who helped me was an ancient martial arts grandmaster. He left a mark in my body. As long as this mark is still there, it proves that I am still alive. If the mark disappears, he will announce this secret to the public!" Taran said slowly.
"I see!"
Connor nodded.
"If you really want me to help you, then you have to prove your identity. Otherwise, I can't tell you this secret now, but I can guarantee that the secret I know is enough to take Yamino's life!" Taran continued.
Connor looked at Taran and took a deep breath, then asked in a low voice, "Do you know a man named Dawson McDonald?"
Connor knew that according to the current situation, if he did not tell Taran the truth, Taran would definitely not believe him.
"Why are you asking about this person?"
After Taran heard his words, the expression on his face grew a little strange, and his tone of speaking seemed a little unnatural.
Connor didn't answer Taran's question. "From your reaction, you should know this person!"
"You know Dawson McDonald?" Taran asked excitedly.
"Dawson McDonald is my father!"
"..."
Taran was dumbfounded. Then, he shook his head and said, "No, that's impossible. You must be lying to me. You can't be Dawson's son!"
"Why?"
Connor felt that Taran's reaction was a bit off.
"If you were Dawson's son, why would Yamino let you live until now?" Taran said with his eyes wide open.
"That's because Yamino doesn't have the ability to kill me!"
"According to Yamino's personality, he definitely won't let you off. This is impossible!"
Taran still seemed unable to believe his words.
Connor wasn't in the mood to explain these things now. "It doesn't matter whether I'm Dawson's son or not. How much do you know about the relationship between Yamino and Dawson?"
"Dawson was killed by Yamino. He had his subordinate, Yaakov Ward, run over Dawson and his wife!" Taran said expressionlessly.
Connor suddenly realized that his father had died ten years ago, and Taran should have already left Yamino at that time.
"You should have left the Gomez family by then, right?"
"That's right. I had indeed left Yamino at that time, but Yamino's plan to kill Dawson didn't happen after I left. On the contrary, he had discussed with me a long time ago how to get rid of Dawson. It was just that he couldn't find a suitable opportunity at that time, so he didn't make a move!" Taran said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1981: The True Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1981: The True Identity
When Connor heard this, he was instantly stunned on the spot, face frozen with disbelief.
He had never expected Yamino to have planned to murder his father a long time ago.
However, he still did not quite believe what Taran said. "Since you said that Yamino had already started planning this a long time ago, then what was the reason for him wanting to kill my father?" he asked softly.
Back then, Yaakov Ward had told Connor that Yamino had killed Dawson because Dawson threatened Yamino's position in Sommerville's Rockefeller branch.
However, if Yamino had been planning this for a long time, then Yaakov's explanation didn't make sense. At that time, Dawson was probably just the person in charge of Rockefeller in a certain city.
"Yamino killed Dawson not because there was any conflict between the two of them, nor because Dawson threatened Yamino's position. Yamino relied on his father-in-law to get to where he is today, and Yamino's father-in-law had a very good relationship with Asya, one of the Four Vajra Warriors. It is said that Yamino's father-in-law even saved Asya before, so as long as Yamino doesn't do anything too out of line or betray Rockefeller, he will be able to kill Dawson. Then his position would be very stable!" Taran said.
"Then why do you think Yamino killed my father?"
Connor shouted excitedly with red eyes.
"Did you know that Dawson isn't from the McDonald family?" Taran asked.
"I know…" Connor nodded because his grandfather had told him about it when he returned to the McDonald family.
Dawson and Connor were not related by blood to the McDonald family. This was why his parents had chased him out of the McDonald family.
"Yamino wanted to kill Dawson because Rockefeller's people had already found out that Dawson was a mole. His identity was all fake, and his real identity was actually the son of Rockefeller's founder, Steven. His real name was Dawson Lee!"
Taran said expressionlessly.
"You... What did you say?"
After Connor heard Taran's words, he was instantly dumbfounded.
Taran had unintentionally told him a shocking secret: that he was actually related to Steven by blood. His biological grandfather was Steven Lee himself!
For a moment, Connor was somewhat unable to accept this fact.
"Dawson Lee is Steven's biological son. In order to recapture Rockefeller, Steven sent him to be a spy in Rockefeller. This way, the father and son could work together from the inside. However, Rockefeller's boss, Mr. Long, had already known about this, and asked Asya to get rid of Dawson without anyone knowing. He also couldn't let Steven find out that they were the ones who did it. In the end, Asya handed this task to Yamino. Yamino had planned for many years before finally getting an opportunity to use Yaakov to get rid of Dawson. Now you can understand how Dawson died, right?" Taran said.
Connor took a deep breath. "How can you prove that everything you said is true?"
"Do you think I need to prove these things?" Taran replied indifferently.
Connor looked at Taran's face full of disbelief, because he never thought that the truth of these things would be like this.
"My grandfather is actually Steven Lee?"
Connor muttered to himself, as if he couldn't accept this fact in a short period of time.
Previously, Thomas had told Connor that the reason why Steven chose him as his successor was because Connor had saved Steven's life back then.
However, no matter how Connor thought about it, he felt that all of this was somewhat unreal.
If it was really just because he saved Steven's life, then Steven had no reason to leave all his assets to Connor. He only needed to give Connor a large sum of money.
Moreover, Thomas had been intentionally or unintentionally guiding Connor to deal with Rockefeller and recover it. Now that Connor thought about it, he felt that everything was a little strange.
Of course, if things were really as Taran said, then everything would make sense.
Steven was his grandfather. Although Dawson was killed by Yamino, Yamino was just a pawn in this series of events. The real mastermind behind the scenes was still Rockefeller.
This was also the reason why Steven left these things for Connor and lured him to take revenge: Connor and Rockefeller already had a blood feud, but Connor himself had never known about it.
After Taran saw that Connor had not said anything, the expression on his face seemed to be somewhat puzzled. Then, he asked in a low voice, "Why aren't you saying anything? Is Dawson Lee really your father?"
"Dawson is indeed my father. My name is Connor McDonald. If you don't believe me, you can investigate now. My background is not a secret in Yarlford!" Connor said expressionlessly.
Taran's expression was very shocked, and it took a moment for him to react.
"If you really are Dawson's son, then you are Steven's grandson. Is that why you want to go against Yamino and Rockefeller?"
"Is what you told me just now true?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"I heard all this from Yamino himself. I think it shouldn't be wrong!"
Taran hurriedly replied.
"Hah…"
Connor took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Wait for me here. I'll make a call!"
"Alright!" Taran nodded.
Connor stood up and walked out of the room without any hesitation.
Rachel, who had been waiting outside, saw Connor come out and quickly took the initiative to say, "Connor, what Taran said just now might not be true. You can't completely believe him!"
"I only need to make a phone call to find out if what he said is true or not!"
Connor replied in a low voice. Then, he took out his phone and dialed Thomas Morgan's number.

chapters.title: Chapter 1982: Pay the Price!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1982: Pay the Price!
"Ding, ding, ding…"
After a few rings, Thomas picked up the phone.
"Mr. McDonald, it's so late. Why are you calling me?"
Thomas was probably asleep, so his tone sounded rather groggy.
"Thomas, what exactly is my relationship with Steven Lee?"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense, so he got straight to the point.
One had to know that Thomas had been by Steven's side for the longest time, so Connor was sure that he definitely knew what had happened back then.
If what Thomas and Taran said was the same, then it could prove that Connor was really Steven's grandson.
Thomas seemed to immediately wake up. "Mr. McDonald, why are you suddenly asking me about this?"
"Cut the crap. Let me ask you, what is my relationship with Steven Lee?"
"Mr. McDonald, did you hear something?"
Thomas continued to ask.
"Thomas, you haven't answered my question!"
Connor did not give Thomas any chance to change the topic.
Thomas, who was on the other end of the phone, was silent for a few seconds before he said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, since you asked me this question, it means that you might already know what happened back then. That's right, you're indeed the grandson of the old Chairman!"
After Connor heard Thomas's words, he felt like he was struck by lightning.
Although he already had a feeling that Taran wasn't lying, when Thomas admitted it personally, Connor still found it hard to accept.
"Since you already knew what happened back then, and you also knew about my relationship with Steven Lee, why didn't you tell me? Why did you lie to me?" Connor shouted.
"The old Chairman himself told me not to tell you!"
Thomas replied in a low voice and then continued, "The old Chairman's original intention was to let you make your own choice. After you inherited his wealth, you could choose to use this money to live the life you liked without having to think about Rockefeller's problems. If you knew the whole truth, it was equivalent to forcing the hatred between the old chairman and Rockefeller onto you. This would be unfair to you…"
"..."
Connor gripped his phone. He didn't know how to answer.
What Thomas said made sense. After all, when Connor didn't know about these things, he still had the right to choose. However, once he knew about these things, Connor might not even have the right to choose his own life.
Thomas seemed to feel very guilty about this matter as he said in a low voice, "Mr. McDonald, I'm sorry for hiding it from you for so long!"
Connor calmed down a little. "President Morgan, I was too emotional just now. You are an outsider, and you did it according to Steven Lee's instructions. It's not your fault!"
"Mr. McDonald, since you already know what happened that year, you have one last chance to choose. If you don't want to bear these things, I can help you get rid of Rockefeller and live the life you want. If you still want to deal with Rockefeller, I will fully support you," Thomas said slowly.
"Things have already come to this. Do you think I still have a choice?"
Connor asked.
"The old Chairman has already arranged a way out for you. He has a way to get you out of everything now, as long as you can let go!" Thomas hurriedly said.
"Steven Lee, that old thing, is deliberately using me!"
"The old Chairman is your grandfather. You shouldn't say that about him!"
"What kind of grandfather would lie to his grandson like this?" Connor shouted.
"Even so, you shouldn't speak ill of the dead!" Thomas said helplessly.
"That's right. Mr. Lee is already dead. I'll talk about the matter between me and him in the future. Anyway, he's already dead now. It's useless for me to complain about this. I won't give up on revenge," Connor said lightly.
"Mr. McDonald, have you made your choice?" Thomas asked in surprise.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded. "Is there anything else you're hiding from me?"
"There's nothing else…"
"If I find out that you're still hiding something from me, I won't let you off. I'm hanging up!"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Thomas, so he hung up the phone and turned back to Taran's room.
The current Connor was no longer the same Connor from before. It was impossible for him to give up the plan that he had worked so hard for for so long because of these things. Moreover, his heart seemed to be much stronger than before.
Even if it was not for revenge, in order to protect the safety of the people around him, Connor would still choose to continue dealing with Rockefeller.
As for the backup plan that Thomas mentioned, Connor knew that it was likely just giving him a new identity to live. However, in that case, Connor would have to give up everything he had now.
Connor was still unwilling to give up.
After all, he had not lost yet.
When Connor returned to Taran's room, Taran could feel that his mental state seemed to be much better.
"Thank you for telling me all this. I finally know my background now!"
Connor muttered.
After saying this, Connor could not help but laugh bitterly. He did not expect that his background would be told to him by someone who had nothing to do with him.
"Are you really Dawson McDonald's son?"
Taran clearly was still skeptical of Connor's words.
"I told you, you just need to ask around in Yarlford and you will know my identity. I have no reason to lie to you!" Connor frowned and replied.
"I didn't expect Rockefeller's people to let Dawson McDonald's grandson live until now. It's unbelievable..." Taran said in shock.
"Maybe it's because I'm lucky!"
Connor smiled helplessly. Then, he suddenly remembered that he had been chased out of the house by the McDonald family and lived alone outside for so many years. It was very likely that it was a form of protection for him.
Connor was not in the mood to care about these things. He directly asked Taran, "Just now, you told me that you know a very important secret about Yamino. I have already told you my identity. Can you tell me this secret now?"
Taran hesitated for a moment and said in a low voice, "I told you about Yamino's wife, Madeline Lee, before. Do you still remember?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1983: Do You Have Evidence?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1983: Do You Have Evidence?
"Yes!"
Connor nodded.
"Madeline's father was also one of the eight guardians of Rockefeller. However, both Madeline and her father passed away in an accident—an explosion in a shopping mall. It caused quite a stir in the local area at that time."
"But what was unexpected was that the murderer was found on the day of the crime. It was said that this person's motive was that he bore a grudge against the owner of the mall. Later, this person was sentenced to death!"
Taran paused for a moment and then continued, "Back then, I also thought that this matter was just an accident. However, Yamino's son was kidnapped once, and Yamino happened to be overseas at that time, so I helped deal with this matter in his stead."
"After the kidnapper saw me, he told me a shocking secret. It turned out that the explosion in the shopping mall was not an accident. The real mastermind was Yamino. That kidnapper was also involved in the operation. However, because the amount of money he received at that time was relatively small, it did not take long for him to squander it. The reason why he kidnapped Yamino's son was because he felt that he had something on Yamino. He thought that Yamino would not dare to call the police and would just give him the money!"
"You mean Yamino killed his father-in-law and his wife?"
Connor asked Taran in shock.
"That's right…"
Yamino nodded.
After Connor learned of this news, he was also extremely shocked.
How could he have imagined that Yamino would be so ruthless as to even kill his own wife?
"Why would Yamino do this?" he asked in a low voice.
"Because he wanted to replace his father-in-law!" Taran replied.
"..."
Connor didn't speak. He simply couldn't understand that there would be someone in this world who would go so far just to get a position.
"I told you before that Yamino's father-in-law, Tatum Lee, had a very good relationship with Asya of Rockefeller. That's why Yamino was able to have a smooth life in Rockefeller. If it wasn't for Asya's help to Yamino, he would never have achieved what he has today. However, if Asya knew that Yamino killed Tatum, then even if you didn't plan to make a move on Yamino, Asya would!" Taran continued.
After hearing these words, Connor knew that he didn't waste his energy. The secret that Taran grasped was indeed enough to kill Yamino.
"No wonder Yamino has been chasing after you for so many years!" Connor muttered.
"Yeah, if I didn't know this secret, I might not have to hide my entire life. When I first found out about this, I thought that I could use this matter to restrain Yamino, but I didn't expect that I would get myself into such big trouble in the end!" Taran said with a bitter smile.
"Do you have any evidence?"
Connor understood that words had no basis. If there was no evidence, even if Connor believed that what Taran said was true, other people would not believe it.
If there was no evidence, it would not be easy to completely defeat Yamino. At most, it would only cause some estrangement between him and Asya.
"If I didn't have any evidence in my hands, would Yamino be so crazy as to chase after me?" Taran asked bluntly.
"So you do have evidence?"
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat excited.
"Of course. I spent a lot of money to buy this evidence from the kidnapper. There were not only videos of Yamino meeting and talking with these people, but also recordings of phone calls. There were five kidnappers who were involved in this incident, and four of them died at Yamino's hands. This kidnapper was the only one who survived. However, not long after I made a deal with him, he came to threaten Yamino again and was killed in the end. I know that this secret came from this kidnapper…"
Taran paused for a moment and then continued, "Actually, there was no conflict between Yamino and me back then. My initial thought was to give him the evidence, but later on, I felt that I should leave a way out for myself, so I hid it!"
"Where is the evidence now? Can you still find it?"
Connor asked excitedly.
This evidence was very crucial to him.
"Now, this evidence is in the hands of the ancient martial arts grandmaster I told you about before. I think we should be able to find it!"
Taran nodded.
"Then where is this ancient martial arts grandmaster you mentioned?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"In Solsby!"
"That's great. Rachel and I will be returning to Solsby tomorrow. You can go and get the evidence back, then follow me to Yarlford!" Connor said.
"Alright!"
Taran nodded at Connor.
…
After Connor figured out everything, he returned to his room alone.
At this time, Rachel had already gone to rest.
Connor looked at the time and realized that it was already past four in the morning. It was probably going to be dawn soon.
After breaking through to the Heaven Rank, Connor didn't need to rest at all. Moreover, he wasn't in the mood to cultivate at the moment. After all, the information that Taran had told him today was too much.
Connor never would've thought that Steven was actually his grandfather.
Back then, when Steven was in trouble, he had indeed seen Connor. Connor had also helped Steven, but Connor knew that it should not be a coincidence. Steven felt that he was very likely to die in the hot summer, so he wanted to see Connor before he died.
But who would have thought that Connor had unintentionally helped Steven, which helped Steven make a comeback.
However, even if Steven died, he would not be able to complete his revenge on Rockefeller.
But now, this courage had landed on Connor's shoulders. Connor felt that although he had been deceived—no matter what, this was his fate. These things had been destined a long time ago. Even if he wanted to escape, the people of Rockefeller would not let him off.
Unknowingly, the sky finally brightened.
Connor asked Black Tiger to send a helicopter over, sending Connor, Taran, Rachel, Linnie, Donald and the others from Sutie Mountain to Solsby.
Because the helicopters in Winam were old, they were very slow. It took them almost half a day to arrive at Solsby.
Linnie and Donald were originally from Cameron, so when they arrived at Solsby, they separated from Connor and the others. Connor gave them a sum of money as a travel fee to go home. The two of them were naturally very grateful to Connor.
Taran planned to retrieve the evidence alone.
Connor thought for a moment and agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1984: Returning to the Misty Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 1984: Returning to the Misty Sect
After Taran left, the expression on Rachel's face seemed to be somewhat puzzled when she saw that Connor wasn't following Taran.
She could not help but ask, "How can you be so at ease as to let him get the evidence alone? What if he runs away?"
"He can't escape…"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Just now, I left a trace of aura on his body. No one else can get rid of this aura, so no matter where he is, I can accurately find him!"
"I see!"
Rachel nodded.
"The reason why he doesn't want the two of us to follow him is because he doesn't trust me. Now that I'm letting him go alone to get the evidence, I can also let him know that I'm not working for Yamino," Connor explained.
Rachel seemed to be relieved after hearing Connor's words. "In any case, it's fine as long as he can't run away. After all, it was not easy to find him. If he runs away, we will have worked hard for so many days in vain…"
"Haha…"
Connor smiled, then continued to ask, "Didn't you come to Solsby to see your grandparents? When do you plan to visit them?"
"It's a little late today. Moreover, I haven't taken a good shower or put on makeup since we were in Sutie Mountain. I can't greet anyone while looking like this. I'll wait until tomorrow to see them!" Rachel said.
Connor turned his head and looked at Rachel. Although Rachel really didn't dress up much recently, she still looked very beautiful. Some women seemed to be born to be stunners—even if they didn't dress up, they would still be thousands of times more beautiful than ordinary women, and Rachel happened to be such a woman.
"Since that's the case, then you can go over tomorrow. Besides, Taran should need a few days to get back the evidence!" Connor said lightly.
"Then where are we going now?"
Rachel asked.
"This place shouldn't be far from the Misty Sect. Let's stay there tonight!" Connor said after thinking for a moment.
"Good!"
Rachel nodded and followed Connor towards the Misty Sect.
…
When Noel Farlow and the elders of the Misty Sect saw Connor and Rachel, they immediately led all the disciples of the Misty Sect out to welcome them. Then, they all knelt on the ground and shouted at Connor, "Welcome, Mr. McDonald and Miss Wallace!"
It was obvious that Noel and the others already knew that Connor had defeated the Blood Moon Sect Leader. Otherwise, they would not have treated Connor with such an attitude.
The disciples of the Misty Sect were also secretly sizing up the legendary Soul Eater.
After all, in their eyes, a person who could defeat the Blood Moon Sect's Patriarch was definitely a god-like existence.
But who would have thought that Connor would be so young? He was even younger than most of the disciples in the Misty Sect.
"I didn't expect the legendary Soul Eater to be so young!"
"Yeah, he looks about the same age as me. Why is he so powerful?"
"It would be great if I could have the ability of a Soul Eater!"
"The woman beside the Soul Eater is also so beautiful. If I can find such a beautiful girlfriend, I could die happy!"
"If you had the ability of the Soul Eaters, you could get ten thousand of them!"
Ignoring the whispers and mutterings around him, Connor walked up to Noel and said expressionlessly, "Sect Leader Farlow, there's no need to be so polite."
Noel slowly stood up when he heard Connor's words. Then, he asked Connor with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, what orders do you have for me this time?"
"Nothing much. I need to do something in Solsby these next few days and happened to pass by your Misty Sect, so I plan to stay for a night!" Connor said lightly as he walked forward.
Noel let out a long sigh of relief after knowing Connor's intentions. A smile instantly appeared on his face. "That's great. I got some people to clean the villa that you and Miss Wallace stayed in. We're waiting for your triumphant return, Mr. McDonald!"
"Alright, stop flattering me. Let your people do what they should do. Don't kneel here!"
Connor said to Noel exasperatedly.
Noel hurriedly waved at the disciples kneeling on the ground, and everyone dispersed.
A moment later, Connor and Rachel arrived at the villa.
The first thing Rachel did after entering the villa was to take a shower.
Connor went to his room and started cultivating.
After taking a shower, Rachel planned to go to the mall to buy some clothes and some bits for her grandparents. Connor was naturally not in the mood to go shopping with Rachel, so he did not go shopping with Rachel.
Noel helped to arranged a car for Rachel and also arranged for a bodyguard and a driver.
After sending Rachel off, Noel went to Connor's villa alone.
Noel stood at the door and asked with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, is it convenient for you now?"
"Come in!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Noel hurriedly walked up to Connor.
"Is there anything you needed?" Connor asked.
"Mr. McDonald, back then, you told me to let our Misty Sect rely on your Purple Cloud Sect. Do you still remember?" Noel asked with a smile.
"I remember…"
Connor nodded.
"Mr. McDonald, I know that our Misty Sect is a small sect and definitely doesn't have the qualifications to become a branch of your Purple Cloud Sect, so I won't ask for this kind of thing, but I have a small request that I hope you can agree to!"
"Why are you talking so much nonsense? Can't you just say it directly?"
Connor said exasperatedly.
"Alright, Mr. McDonald, I'll get straight to the point. I plan to hold a banquet tonight where I'll invite all the forces in Solsby. The main purpose of this banquet is to celebrate you defeating the Blood Moon Sect's Sect Leader. What do you think?"
Noel asked with a smile.
Connor slowly turned his head to look at Noel after hearing his words.
He knew that Noel was planning to use his relationship with him to intimidate the rest of the forces in Solsby. As long as these people knew that the Misty Sect was related to the famous Soul Eater, then the Misty Sect would be able to be considered an overlord in Solsby and even Cameron in the future. No one would dare to provoke them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1985: Deal!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1985: Deal!
"Mr. McDonald, when the time comes, you only need to show your face…"
Noel saw that Connor didn't agree immediately, so he quickly continued.
"Forget it. You played a part in me finding Taran this time, so sure. Let's do as you say!" Connor muttered.
He felt that Noel's request was not too much. He just wanted to let the people of Solsby know about his relationship with Connor.
As long as Noel didn't do anything bad under Connor's name, he was willing to give Noel some benefits because many people from the Misty Sect had died when he wiped out the Netherworld Sect. Connor didn't want to owe Noel a favor.
"Mr. McDonald, you…Does that mean you agree?"
Noel didn't expect Connor to agree so readily.
"Yes, but the banquet shouldn't be too long!" Connor said lightly.
"Understood, understood. I'll get someone to make preparations now!"
Noel's expression was a little excited. Then, she turned around and walked out of the room.
After Noel left Connor's villa, a guard hurriedly ran to Noel and asked, "Sect Leader Farlow, did Mr. McDonald agree?"
"He did! Go book a hotel now and send out invitations. As long as it's a famous family of our Misty Sect, invite them over. Especially those who have conflicts with our Misty Sect…" Noel said excitedly.
"Alright, I'll do it now!"
The guard nodded and turned to leave.
Noel stood on the spot with an excited expression. He sighed and said, "Fortunately, I didn't choose the wrong side."
..
Meanwhile, Rachel went out for about three hours before coming back. She bought a lot of clothes and gifts.
Moreover, not only did she buy clothes for herself, she also bought several sets of clothes for Connor.
"Why did you think of buying clothes for me?" Connor asked.
"You should change your clothes too. Besides, you're going to accompany me to see my grandparents tomorrow. Of course you have to dress decently!" Rachel said indifferently.
"..."
Connor couldn't help but be stunned after hearing Rachel's words. He then frowned and asked, "Are you planning to make me pretend to be your boyfriend again?"
"Bingo. Anyway, you've already pretended to be my boyfriend in front of my grandfather. It shouldn't be a problem for you to pretend again this time, right?" Rachel said with a smile.
