"When did I promise to do that?"
Connor shouted exasperatedly.
"I am just going over to show my face and say a few words. It shouldn't be difficult for you…"
"No—" Connor opened his mouth and was about to speak when he heard a knock on the door.
"Who is it?"
He asked.
"Mr. McDonald, it's me. The banquet will start in an hour. I've already prepared a car for you. When do you and Miss Wallace plan to go?" Noel asked with a smile.
"We'll go over later. Tell the driver to wait for us!" Connor said lightly.
"Then, Mr. McDonald, I'll go over first. After all, there are still many guests at the banquet that need to be entertained!"
"By all means!" Connor agreed.
Rachel turned to Connor. Her expression seemed to be a little puzzled. "What banquet are you going to attend?"
Connor helplessly told her what Noel had told him.
"This Noel is really scheming. He still plans to use you at this time…" Rachel grumbled.
"It's not just Noel. Aren't you using me too?"
Connor said helplessly.
After Rachel heard Connor's words, her expression became a little angry and she shouted loudly, "What do you mean by that? How can I be the same as Noel?"
"In my eyes, you're all the same. You'll accompany me to the banquet later, and I'll accompany you to see your grandparents tomorrow," Connor said/
"Deal!"
Rachel agreed without thinking.
Connor felt that if he went to the banquet alone, it would be too boring for him since he didn't know anyone in Solsby. At least if Rachel went, she could accompany him and talk with him. It would not be too boring.
…
At eight o'clock in the evening, in front of a five-star hotel in Solsby.
Although Noel's banquet was very sudden, the Misty Sect still had some influence in Solsby, so most of the guests they invited took time out to attend the banquet.
Moreover, Noel had also spread the news that today's banquet was prepared for a big shot. As for who this big shot was, Noel didn't say it out loud, which made many people curious about what big shot the Misty Sect had made friends with.
Those who had conflicts with the Misty Sect were naturally even more curious.
Therefore, at this moment, the hotel entrance was bustling with people and all kinds of luxury cars gathered.
"Mr. John, you're here for the Misty Sect's banquet too?"
After the two middle-aged men got out of the car, they took the initiative to exchange pleasantries.
"That's right, I don't know what Sect Leader Farlow is up to. Today's banquet was held and he only sent me an invitation an hour ago."
Another middle-aged man hurriedly replied.
"Who isn't? I just received the invitation, but I heard that the Misty Sect is going to introduce a big shot to us. I wonder who this big shot is to make the Misty Sect pay so much attention to him!"
"We will know what kind of big shot he is in a moment…"
The two of them chatted as they walked into the hotel.
At the same time, Connor and Rachel also arrived at the entrance of the hotel.
When Connor saw the luxury cars parked at the entrance of the hotel, he smiled helplessly and whispered to Rachel, "Looks like Noel has invited quite a few people this time. There are actually so many people here…"
"It wasn't easy for Noel to find such a powerful backer like you. Of course he has to make good use of you…" Rachel commented.
"Forget it, he helped us this time. Without him, we wouldn't have found Taran so easily, so I'll consider this as returning his favor. Although Noel is a bit of a profiteer, he's not a bad person!"
Connor smiled and brought Rachel into the hotel.
Noel, who was standing at the entrance of the hotel lobby to welcome the guests, was a little excited when she saw Connor and Rachel walk in. He quickly walked up to Connor and said with a smile, "Mr. McDonald and Miss Wallace, you two are here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1986: Ungrateful
chapters.content:
Chapter 1986: Ungrateful
"How are the arrangements for the banquet?" Connor asked.
"Mr. McDonald, I've already prepared a private room for you on the second floor. You don't have to worry about the rest. Just rest in the private room. When I need you to appear, I'll call for you. You just have to show your face and say a few words," Noel said with a smile.
"Since we're all here to attend the banquet, it'll be so boring to stay in the private room. Let's just stroll around the hall!" Rachel said.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded, then moved to bring Rachel into the hall.
"Mr. McDonald, do you need me to accompany you?"
Noel hurriedly asked.
"No need!"
Connor waved his hand and walked inside.
Noel only knew how to suck up to him. Connor didn't want such a person to follow him around.
Moreover, there were very few people in Solsby who knew Connor, so he and Rachel were relatively free and could do whatever they wanted.
After the two of them entered the hall, they realized that Noel had indeed invited many guests today. At this moment, there were at least a few hundred people in the hall. Everyone was dressed in luxurious dresses and were chatting elegantly in groups of three to five.
"Connor, there are pastries over there. I'm a little hungry. Let's go and try them!"
"Sure." Connor nodded and followed Rachel to the corner where the pastries were placed.
One had to know that those who could attend such banquets were usually big shots with status. They were very disdainful of pastries, so naturally no one would eat them.
However, Connor and Rachel were indeed exceptions. After all, the two of them didn't know anyone. Even if they did, Rachel, with her confident personality, wouldn't care about other people's gazes.
"Connor, try this. It tastes good!"
Rachel picked up a piece of cake and handed it to Connor, who put it in his mouth and tasted it. He found that the taste was indeed not bad.
"There's still steak over there. Let's go eat it!"
Connor hadn't finished the cake in his mouth when Rachel pulled him in another direction.
The people in the hall looked at Connor with disdain.
However, at this moment, a girl suddenly shouted at Rachel excitedly.
"Rachel?"
Rachel couldn't help but turn around when she heard this. Then, she smiled and said, "Oh, it's you!"
"That's right, Rachel, what a coincidence! I didn't expect to meet you here!" The girl quickly ran to Rachel.
When the girl saw Connor, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she covered her small mouth and said, "Connor, you're actually here too!"
"I didn't expect that we would meet again…"
Connor looked at the girl in front of him and smiled.
The girl who appeared in front of Connor and Rachel was none other than Jada Leone, whom Connor had saved in Willborough.
"After the two of you saved me last time, I never had the chance to properly thank the two of you. Moreover, you left in a hurry at that time, so I didn't leave behind your contact information. I'm really sorry…"
Jada said guiltily to Connor and Rachel.
"It's okay. The two of us actually didn't do anything. You don't have to take this matter to heart!"
Connor said.
"No matter what, the two of you are my saviors!"
Jada replied seriously, then continued, "What are you two doing in Solsby?"
"I came to Solsby to settle some matters!"
Connor said lightly.
"Oh, I see!"
Jada nodded and continued to ask, "Then are you two free tomorrow? Let me treat you two to a meal!"
"Tomorrow, the two of us might…"
Rachel instinctively wanted to refuse, but at this moment, a middle-aged couple walked up to Jada.
"Jada, who are you talking to?"
"Dad, these two people are the ones I mentioned to you before. They saved me in Willborough. His name is Connor McDonald, and her name is Rachel Wallace!"
Jada hurried to the middle-aged man's side and introduced him to Connor and Rachel.
"Hello!"
Jada's father glanced at them before continuing, "Thank you very much for saving my daughter previously. My name is Beauford Leone. If you need my help, you can look for me at the Mountain Gaze Corporation at any time…"
"Dad…"
Jada seemed to have sensed that something was wrong and could not help but shout.
After Beauford said that, he did not bother with Connor and Rachel anymore. Instead, he said to Jada, "Jada, come with me quickly. I'll bring you to meet the three guardians of the Misty Sect and see if they can take you in as a disciple!"
"Dad, I haven't finished talking to Connor and the others!" Jada shouted exasperatedly.
"What's there to say to such a person? Your father finally got you a chance to meet the three guardians."
Jada's mother scolded in a low voice. Then, she turned to the young man behind her and said, "Give them my business card!"
After saying that, Jada's mother dragged Jada away.
"Mom, let go of me!"
Jada struggled in agitation. However, her parents couldn't care less and dragged her away.
The young man took out a name card and handed it to Connor. He said to Connor with disdain, "This is Mrs. Leone's business card. If you need anything, you can call her directly!"
Connor glanced at the name card in the young man's hand and said expressionlessly, "I don't need it!"
"Ungrateful things. I've seen many people like you who want to rely on Miss Leone to get to the top!"
The young man frowned before turning around and leaving.
After Rachel heard the young man's words, her expression became a little angry. She took a step forward and was about to speak, but Connor stretched out his hand to stop her, indicating that Rachel did not need to pay attention to this kind of person at all.
The young man turned around and left with a disdainful expression.
"Why did you stop me?"
Rachel asked angrily.
"There's no need to bother with such a person!"
Connor replied.
"Then what he said just now was too unpleasant, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1987: Someone Is Fighting!
chapters.content:
Chapter 1987: Someone Is Fighting!
"He's just looking down on me!" Connor didn't seem to take the matter seriously at all. He continued, "After I obtained Steven's inheritance, I've seen too many people like this. They will only judge whether a person is valuable to them based on their clothes. Beauford seems to think that the two of us are of no value to him. That's why he chose to treat the two of us in such a way!"
"They're really pissing me off…" Rachel took a deep breath and continued, "I originally thought that Jada's character was quite good and that her parents should not be too bad. I did not expect them to be like that…"
"Beauford would even suspect that the two of us are in cahoots with those kidnappers. The reason why we contacted Jada was just to get close to the Leone family!"
Connor said.
"Who does the Leone family think they are? Not to mention you, even our Qin family doesn't care about a small Leone family, okay?"
Rachel said somewhat exasperatedly.
"You know this, but they don't. It seems that in their eyes, the two of us are not even as high as the three guardians of the Misty Sect!"
Connor said with a smile.
"..."
After Rachel saw Connor smile, she couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she frowned and asked Connor, "Aren't you angry at all after what happened?"
"I've already said it just now. I've experienced this kind of thing too many times. I've long forgotten about it!"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Moreover, small fries like them are not worthy of me wasting my time on them!"
"It's such a pity for Jada. I didn't expect him to have such snobbish parents!"
Rachel said in a low voice.
"The two of us have only met Jada twice!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
Rachel hesitated for a moment after hearing Connor's words. After taking a deep breath, she did not continue to say anything.
"Alright, there's no need to be angry over such a person. Go and eat your steak!"
Connor saw that Rachel seemed to be still angry because of what happened just now, so he gently advised Rachel.
"That's true. There's no need to be angry because of such a person!"
Rachel nodded at Connor and followed him to the corner.
…
On the other side, Jada was dragged by her mother to the three guardians of the Misty Sect.
"Three Guardian, please see if my daughter has the fortune to become your last disciple!"
Beauford humbly asked.
At this moment, Beauford's attitude towards the three guardians was completely different from his attitude towards Connor and Rachel.
However, he didn't know that the three guardians of the Misty Sect didn't even have the right to talk to Connor. When he knelt in front of Connor to welcome him, Connor didn't even notice this person.
If Beauford's attitude towards Connor had been slightly better, the three Guardians would have cried and begged him to take Jada as his disciple.
Beauford had no idea that he had inadvertently missed an opportunity that could change the fate of the Leone family.
The three guardians of the Misty Sect casually sized Jada up and said, "Mr. Leone, your daughter's aptitude is a little lacking. I'm afraid she can't become a disciple of our Misty Sect!"
Beauford seemed to be unwilling to give up. "Third Guardian, my daughter's aptitude is a little lacking. Can you help me train her?"
"Mr. Leone, there are some things that I can't change!"
The three guardians did not even look at Beauford. After saying this, they started chatting with the others.
Beauford stood rooted to the ground, his expression extremely awkward.
"Useless thing!"
Jada's mother also turned her head and scolded Jada in a low voice.
Jada felt wronged. She pouted and said, "I never wanted to become a disciple of the Misty Sect. All of you forced me to do this…"
"Child, what are you saying? Aren't we doing this for your sake?" Jada's mother shouted and continued, "You're the only daughter we have. Don't we need you to inherit our companies in the future? If you don't have a strong backer, how are you going to manage these businesses in the future?"
"I can do it myself. I don't need any help!"
Jada said stubbornly.
"You…"
Jada's mother was so angry that she didn't know what else to say.
"Forget it, stop arguing. Since the path of the Misty Sect is not going to work, then arrange a blind date for her as soon as possible and see if she can build a relationship with a few big families in our Misty Sect!" Beauford said expressionlessly.
"I don't want to go on a blind date!"
Jada shouted excitedly. She then turned around and walked into the crowd, as if she wanted to find Connor and apologize to him and Rachel for Beauford's rudeness.
Jada walked around the hall and finally saw Connor and Rachel eating steak. She quickly ran towards them.
"Ah!"
However, Jada was too focused on them to notice a woman holding a wine glass passing by her. The two of them bumped into each other.
The woman instantly fell to the ground, and the wine glass in her hand shattered.
…
At the same time, Connor and Rachel drank some red wine after eating the steak.
Rachel's mood seemed to have improved a lot. She said to Connor, "I didn't expect the steak here to taste quite good…"
"I don't really like the food here. I still think our Opranian food is more delicious!" Connor replied indifferently.
When Rachel heard Connor's words, her expression was somewhat helpless. She pouted and said, "You really don't know what enjoyment is!"
"Eating steak is enjoyment?"
"Forget it. I don't understand people like you. When can the two of us leave this place?" Rachel asked.
Connor glanced at the people in the hall. He and Rachel had been here for more than an hour, but the banquet had not started yet, so Connor planned to ask Noel when it would end.
However, he had only taken two steps when he heard a commotion in the hall, followed by a woman's scream.
"It sounds like someone is fighting, right?"
Rachel seemed to have heard the noise.

chapters.title: Chapter 1988: Gone Too Far
chapters.content:
Chapter 1988: Gone Too Far
"I didn't expect that there would be people fighting on such an occasion!"
Connor smiled helplessly. It seemed that he did not take this matter to heart and continued to walk forward.
Rachel also seemed to be curious about who was fighting.
After all, those who could attend the banquet today were basically all big shots in Solsby. The big shots of the upper class would not hit people under normal circumstances, except for some very special circumstances.
A moment later, Connor and Rachel passed by the noisy crowd.
Connor did not pay attention to those people at all, while Rachel took a glance at them intentionally or unintentionally.
When Rachel saw Jada being beaten up, she immediately stopped and reached out to pull Connor.
"What's wrong?"
"Jada's being beaten up!" Rachel whispered.
Connor turned his head to take a look and realized that the person who was beaten up just now was really Jada.
Jada was still in a very sorry state. Her meticulously tied hair was now pulled into a mess, and her expensive gown had a few large holes in it. Her fair skin was faintly discernible, and Connor noticed that Jada's palm was bleeding. She was like a frightened deer hiding behind Beauford.
Standing opposite Beauford was a middle-aged man in a black suit. The middle-aged man looked very valiant and had a big beard. Although he was wearing a suit, he still gave off the feeling of sloppiness. Behind him stood a few bodyguards with big waists and a foxy woman with a sexy figure.
"Gaetano, what do you mean by this?"
Beauford angrily asked the middle-aged man in front of him.
"What do I mean?"
Gaetano heard Beauford's cold tone and said indifferently, "Your daughter bumped into my woman just now, and my woman taught her a lesson. Is there anything wrong with that?"
Beauford gritted his teeth and shouted, "Is it just a simple matter of teaching him a lesson? What did you do to my daughter?"
Just now, when Jada was looking for Connor, she accidentally knocked down the foxy woman behind Gaetano. After Jada helped the woman up, she hurriedly apologized. However, for some reason, the foxy woman did not intend to let Jada go at all. Instead, she asked her bodyguards to attack her.
Jada was just a petite girl. How could she be a match for those bodyguards?
And that was why Connor and Rachel saw this scene.
"I'm just giving her a small lesson!"
The fox-like woman pretended to be innocent as she spoke in a sweet voice.
"I've already apologized to you before!" Jada cried as she shouted.
"Is there any use in apologizing?" Gaetano shouted.
Beauford took a deep breath, not knowing what to do.
At this moment, Jada's mother suddenly stood up and shouted, "Gaetano, I admit that there is indeed some competition in the business between our two families, but business matters are business matters. I have no objections no matter what means you use to compete with me. But now you are actually venting your anger on my daughter."
When Gaetano heard this, his expression changed and he said in a low voice, "Mrs. Leone, what do you mean by that? There are so many people here. You're airing out my dirty laundry!"
Although Gaetano and Beauford were indeed competing in business, Gaetano was using this opportunity to make a big deal out of it.
However, if this matter was said in front of so many people, the perspectives would change. The problem that could be solved privately was not so easy to solve now.
Even Beauford's expression was extremely ugly at this moment. He had never expected his wife to be so muddle-headed as to say such words.
Gaetano's influence in Solsby far exceeded Beauford's. During this period of time, Gaetano had been looking for trouble with Beauford. However, Beauford knew that he was no match for Gaetano, so he had chosen to tolerate it.
This was also the reason why Beauford wanted Jada to become the third guardian disciple of the Misty Sect.
After all, as long as Jada became the disciple of the three guardians, Beauford would have the support of the Misty Sect.
But today, his plan had failed.
"If Jada had been able to work harder and get the attention of the three guardians, we wouldn't have been bullied like this!" Beauford could not help but think.
"What's going on? Why did a fight break out at a banquet?"
At this moment, a voice called out.
When everyone heard this voice, they all turned around and looked at who had spoken. A guardian of the Misty Sect walked up to Beauford and Gaetano.
"Fifth Guardian, you must help me in this matter!"
Beauford's expression was a little agitated. He hurriedly took the initiative to explain the entire situation to the fifth guardian.
After hearing Beauford's words, the fifth guardian looked up at Gaetano and whispered, "Mr. Leone, I know what happened, but no matter what, it's wrong for your daughter to hit someone. I think you should get your daughter to apologize as soon as possible!"
Beauford was instantly stunned on the spot. The expression on his face was very incredulous because he had never thought that the Fifth Guardian would also be on Gaetano's side.
At this moment, Gaetano's expression seemed to have become even more arrogant. He chuckled and said to Beauford, "Mr. Leone, we've known each other for a while, and today is the Misty Sect's banquet. I don't want to make a big deal out of this. How about this, you kneel down and apologize to me on behalf of your daughter and I won't hold it against you?"
"Your men beat my daughter up like this, and now you want me to kneel down and apologize to you. Are you still being reasonable?" Beauford shouted.
"If you don't agree with my suggestion just now, then we can use other methods to resolve this matter!"
The expression on Gaetano's face seemed a little cold.
"Gaetano, don't go too far!"
Beauford shouted.
"I've already gone too far today. I want to see what you can do to me!"
Gaetano laughed loudly and turned to look at the bodyguards behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1989: The Consequences of Threatening Me
chapters.content:
Chapter 1989: The Consequences of Threatening Me
A few bodyguards strode towards Beauford, as if they wanted to make a move on him.
At this moment, everyone was watching with folded arms. It was as if no one was willing to stand up for Beauford at this moment.
"Fifth Guardian, you don't care about this kind of thing?"
Beauford gritted his teeth.
"..."
The relationship between the Fifth Guardian and Gaetano was not ordinary. At this moment, he only hoped that this matter could end as soon as possible and not let Noel find out.
When Beauford saw that the Fifth Guardian had not said a word, his expression became a little desperate.
He knew that if the Fifth Guardian didn't stand up for him, then no one would be able to help him.
Beauford hesitated for a moment before gritting his teeth and shouting at Gaetano.
"Don't hurt my daughter. I'll kneel down and apologize to you, okay?"
Gaetano couldn't help but laugh when he heard Beauford's words. Then, he said arrogantly, "You want to apologize to me now? Alright, kneel down and kowtow to me, then take your daughter and get lost!"
Beauford took a deep breath and walked toward Gaetano.
After Rachel saw this scene, she finally couldn't hold it in anymore. She turned her head and said to Connor, "Isn't this Gaetano a little too much of a bully? Jada has already been beaten up by him to such a state, and now he actually wants Jada's father to kneel down and apologize. What's going on?"
"..."
Connor turned his head and glanced at Rachel indifferently. He then asked with a smile, "Are you meddling in other people's business again?"
"What do you mean I'm meddling in other people's business? No matter what, the two of us are at least acquainted with Jada. Although Jada's parents 'attitude towards the two of us was indeed not good, Jada herself is a good person. I can't just watch her be bullied!"
Rachel said bluntly.
"Since you want to interfere in this matter, then go!"
Connor smiled helplessly.
After all, Gaetano, Beauford, and the others were just some small figures in Connor's eyes. Therefore, he felt that even if Rachel interfered in this matter, it would not affect him.
After Rachel saw that Connor had agreed, she smiled in satisfaction and walked directly to Gaetano. She called out softly, "You're really unreasonable. You were the one who hit him first, but now you're asking him to kneel down and apologize to you. I think you're the one who should apologize!"
Beauford had never expected that someone would take the initiative to speak up for him at this point.
However, when he saw that the person who spoke up for him was Rachel, the expression on his face became even more desperate. After all, in his eyes, Rachel was just an ordinary person. At this time, not only would she not be able to help him, but she would also make things more complicated.
"Rachel…"
Jada also raised her head to look at Rachel. Her expression seemed to be a little surprised.
Gaetano sized up Rachel with a wretched gaze as he asked in a low voice, "Who are you? What does this have to do with you?"
"Jada is my friend. Of course this matter has something to do with me!"
"Alright, since you want to stand up for the Leone family, why don't we do this? You accompany me for a night, and I'll let them off?"
Gaetano asked with a smile.
Regardless of whether it was her appearance or figure, Rachel could be considered the top existence in this hall. Therefore, at this moment, Gaetano obviously had some other thoughts about her.
After hearing Gaetano's words, Rachel's expression grew a little angry.
Before Rachel could continue speaking, Connor's voice rang out.
"Kneel down and apologize, then get out of this hall. I'll spare your life if you do!"
Jada and Beauford were stunned when they heard Connor's words.
Everyone present was also shocked.
No one had expected Connor and Rachel to be so arrogant. Just now, Rachel took the initiative to stand up for the Leone family, which was already unbelievable to many people. And Connor's words were even more shocking. He actually said that he would spare Gaetano!
Gaetano slowly turned his head to look at Connor, the expression on his face angry.
Beauford also realized that something was wrong and hurriedly said, "Gaetano, this is a conflict between our two families. I'll kneel down and apologize to you immediately!"
Although Beauford had not treated Connor and Rachel very well before, he was still very grateful that these two people had stood up for him. Therefore, he did not want to involve others because of this matter.
"Get lost!"
Gaetano pushed Beauford to the side and walked up to Connor. After sizing him up, he asked Connor in a low voice, "You were the one who said you wanted to kill me just now, weren't you?"
"That's right, I did!"
Connor nodded.
"Brat, do you know who you are talking to right now? Do you know what will happen if you say that?" Gaetano asked coldly.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the banquet hall was very strange. It was as if everyone had quieted down, waiting to see what would happen next.
"Do you know what will happen if you tell me these words?" Connor replied indifferently.
"I, Gaetano Ray, have been in Solsby for so many years, but I've never met anyone who dared to threaten me like this. You're the first, kid. Today, I'll let you know the consequences of threatening me!"
After saying this, Gaetano turned around and shouted at the bodyguards behind him, "Break this person's legs and throw him out!"
"Yes, sir!"
The bodyguards rushed towards Connor.
"Hey, do you think this kid is tired of living? Of all the people he could offend, he actually offended Gaetano!"
"That's right, Gaetano's relationship with the Fifth Guardian of the Misty Sect isn't simple. Offending someone like him won't end well!"
"Originally, it could have been resolved by kneeling and apologizing. But now it's turned out like this…"
Everyone present seemed to have already thought of Connor's fate and began to discuss amongst themselves in low voices.
The Fifth Guardian, who had just left not long ago, were shocked when he suddenly realized that Gaetano's bodyguards were about to attack Connor.
Others might not know what Connor was, but how could the Fifth Guardian not know?
Just now, the Fifth Guardian had deliberately left because he wanted Gaetano to settle this matter as soon as possible. However, he had never expected that Gaetano would actually provoke the most important person he should not have provoked in his life less than a minute after he left.

chapters.title: Chapter 1990: Kneel Down and Apologize
chapters.content:
Chapter 1990: Kneel Down and Apologize
"Gaetano, stop!"
The Fifth Guardian stood in the distance and shouted with a terrified expression.
But unfortunately, he was quite far away from Gaetano, so Gaetano did not hear the Fifth Guardian 'words at all.
Several bodyguards instantly rushed in front of Connor and were about to attack him.
However, in the next second, everyone present was stunned on the spot.
Ordinary people like them didn't even see what Connor had done, but several bodyguards actually fell to the ground at the same time, hugging their thighs and moaning in pain.
In the eyes of ordinary people, all of this happened in an instant. It was as if Connor had stood there from the beginning to the end and had not moved at all.
"What... What's going on?"
Gaetano seemed to be a little dumbfounded, and the expression on his face was very puzzled.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Gaetano.
However, at this moment, the Fifth Guardian suddenly rushed in front of Connor and said excitedly, "Mr. McDonald, please calm down. With your status, don't lower yourself to the level of these small figures. Leave the rest to me!"
Connor looked at the Fifth Guardian indifferently, then turned around and left without saying a word.
Rachel knew that the Fifth Guardian should be able to handle the rest, so she left with Connor.
This scene made everyone even more puzzled because they could not understand what was going on.
"Fifth Guardian, why did you let that kid leave? I haven't settled my score with him yet!"
Gaetano shouted with his eyes wide open.
The Fifth Guardian took a deep breath, took a step forward, and slapped Gaetano's face fiercely. Then, he widened his eyes and shouted, "What do you want to settle? I'll settle it with you now!"
Gaetano was dumbfounded, and so was Beauford.
Everyone present was stunned. No one could understand what was going on. It was as if the Fifth Guardian had changed into a different person. Previously, he was still protecting Gaetano in every possible way, but he had just hit Gaetano.
This change caught everyone off guard.
"Fifth Guardian, you…What do you mean by this?"
Gaetano covered his big face with a puzzled expression.
"What do I mean by this?" When the Fifth Guardian heard this, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said in a low voice, "Kneel down and apologize to Jada and Beauford right now!"
"I... Should I apologize to them? Fifth Guardian, are you joking with me?" Gaetano asked with a puzzled expression.
"Do you think I'm in the mood to joke with you now? If you obediently apologize now and scram far away, I can still spare your life. Otherwise, you might not even know how you died!"
Gaetano looked at the Fifth Guardian's expression and was very puzzled because he still had not figured out what was going on.
The others present were naturally also dumbfounded. No one could understand why the Fifth Guardian's attitude had such a huge change!
Of course, Beauford was the most shocked.
He was not a fool. He knew very well that Connor's identity was not simple. It was because of Connor's appearance that the attitude of the Fifth Guardian changed so much.
Beauford hesitated for a moment before turning to ask Jada.
"Jada, who is this Connor?"
Jada shook her head in confusion and said softly, "I've only met Connor and the others twice. I... I don't know who he is either!"
Beauford couldn't help but gasp when he heard Jada's words. He felt that he might have missed an opportunity to befriend a noble person.
After all, it could be seen from the Fifth Guardian 'current attitude that Connor's status was definitely above the Fifth Guardian's.
"Could it be that this Connor has some relationship with the Misty Sect's leader?" Beauford couldn't help but ask in his heart.
On the other side, Gaetano felt that the Fifth Guardian did not seem to be joking with him at this time, so he asked softly, "Fifth Guardian, are you really planning to make me kneel down and apologize to the Leone family?"
"Nonsense. Do you think I'm still in the mood to joke with you at a time like this?"
The Fifth Guardian berated him coldly and continued, "Let me tell you, if you don't kneel down and apologize today, then you will die. Not only will you die, but I will also die with you. Do you understand what I mean?"
"..."
When Gaetano heard the Fifth Guardian 'words, he was slightly stunned. Then, he stuttered, "Fifth Guardian, even if I die, you have to let me die with some understanding. Can you tell me who this Connor is?"
The Fifth Guardian saw that Gaetano would not yield unless absolutely necessary, so he whispered into Gaetano's ear.
When Gaetano found out Connor's true identity, he was dumbfounded. He knelt on the ground with a bang and shouted with an excited expression, "Mr. Leone, I know I was wrong. It was all my fault before. I've apologized to you. If you're not satisfied, you can beat me up now…"
When everyone saw this scene, they instantly revealed an expression of disbelief. Who would have thought that Gaetano would actually kneel down and apologize to Beauford?
Even Beauford couldn't believe it.
"Mr. Leone, Gaetano already knows his mistake and has even knelt down to apologize to you."
The Fifth Guardian stepped forward. It was obvious that he was speaking to Beauford with great respect.
Beauford was already overjoyed at this result. After all, if it wasn't for Connor's appearance, he would be the one kneeling on the ground. Moreover, he didn't know what was going on, so he naturally didn't dare to continue making a fuss. Therefore, he said softly, "Fifth Guardian, you have the final say in this matter…"
"Thank you, Mr. Leone, for letting me off!"
When the Fifth Guardian heard Beauford's words, they smiled happily. Then, they hurriedly said to Gaetano, who was kneeling on the ground, "What are you still standing there for? Hurry up and get lost!"
"Yes, yes, I'll get lost now, immediately!"
Gaetano hurriedly nodded, then stood up and walked out of the hall.
Everyone present looked at Gaetano's back, shock on their faces. After all, no one had expected that this matter would end up like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 1991: Who Is He?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1991: Who Is He?
Gaetano was obviously shooting himself in the foot.
Not only did he not embarrass Beauford, but he had also humiliated himself.
But he couldn't think about so many things at the moment. There was only one thought in his mind, and that was that he had to hurry up and leave this place. Otherwise, if Connor went back on his word, he might really die.
After Gaetano left, the Fifth Guardian took the initiative to exchange a few more pleasantries before leaving in a hurry.
At this moment, it seemed as though everyone was sizing up Beauford. The way they looked at him had also undergone a huge change.
Jada's mother hesitated for a moment before asking softly, "Beauford, what's going on?"
"I don't know what's going on either, but I think it must have something to do with that Connor!" Beauford said in a low voice.
"Is it related to him?"
Jada's mother had a complicated expression on her face as she muttered, "Could it be that this Connor is some big shot?"
Jada seemed to have realized what was going on and said bluntly, "So what if he's a big shot? Have you forgotten how the two of you treated Connor before? If it wasn't for his help today, we would have been chased out long ago!"
Beauford's expression was filled with regret when he heard this.
…
Connor and Rachel were resting in the private room at this time. They didn't know what had happened next. Of course, Connor didn't care much because if it wasn't for Rachel's soft heart, he might not have cared about these small things.
In Connor's eyes, bullying the weak was a common problem in this society. He alone could not change anything at all.
Moreover, Beauford's attitude towards Connor was essentially the same as Gaetano's attitude towards Beauford. It was just that Gaetano might have gone a little too overboard.
About half an hour after Gaetano left, Noel saw that most of the guests had arrived, so he planned to start the banquet.
Noel led the few guardians of the Misty Sect to the stage at the front of the hall.
When everyone saw Noel's appearance, they knew that the real show was about to begin, so they stopped discussing the conflict between Beauford and Gaetano.
At this moment, among the guests present, some of them had a good relationship with the Misty Sect, and some of them were just here to watch the show. Of course, most of them had a competitive relationship with the Misty Sect. Some of them even had conflicts with the ancient martial arts sects.
"I'm really sorry to have made everyone wait for so long today. Actually, I already mentioned to everyone that the reason why our Misty Sect organized this banquet today is to welcome an extremely distinguished guest and introduce him to everyone!" Noel said to everyone with a smile.
When everyone heard Noel's words, they all looked puzzled. They had been trying to guess who the guest of the Misty Sect was for the entire night, but could not guess who it was.
"Hehe, I want to see what kind of big shot the Misty Sect can invite this time!"
A middle-aged man below the stage could not help but sneer when he heard Noel's words.
"Yeah, recently, our sect has been in constant conflict with the Misty Sect. The Misty Sect doesn't have the protection of the Netherworld Sect anymore, so they probably won't be able to hold on for much longer. So, they want to invite a big shot to come out and hold the fort."
"I think so too. It is only a matter of time before our Cloudy Sect absorbs their Misty Sect!"
The few people who were speaking at this moment were the protectors of the Cloudy Sect in Solsby.
Previously, the Misty Sect had always been the only sect in Solsby. However, in recent years, they suddenly got an Ancient Martial Grandmaster to hold down the fort. Moreover, the Misty Sect's leader, Noel, had not reached the Ancient Martial Grandmaster level yet, which caused the Cloudy Sect to have some fame in Solsby.
However, because the Misty Sect had the protection of the Netherworld Sect previously, the Cloudy Sect naturally did not dare to easily offend the Misty Sect.
However, after the news of the sect leader of the Netherworld Sect being killed by the Soul Eater spread out some time ago, the Cloudy Sect no longer feared the Misty Sect. They even had thoughts of attacking the Misty Sect.
The most important reason why Noel organized this banquet was to let the people of the Cloudy Sect know of his relationship with Connor. Only then would the Cloudy Sect restrain themselves.
"It is only a matter of time for our Cloudy Sect to annex his Misty Sect. In this current situation, it is useless no matter who comes!"
A protector from the Cloudy Sect said expressionlessly.
"Not necessarily. If the Misty Sect can find an ancient martial arts grandmaster to help, then the situation will be hard to say!"
Another person said very cautiously.
"There is nothing to be afraid of if it is just an ancient martial arts grandmaster. Unless Noel is able to invite the Soul Eater over, my Cloudy Sect will definitely not dare to offend the Misty Sect in the future. As for the others, I do not think that they have much meaning…"
"How could Noel invite the Soul Eater? Is this a joke?"
Everyone from the Cloudy Sect discussed in an extremely arrogant manner.
At this moment, Connor and Rachel slowly walked onto the stage.
When Beauford saw Connor walk onto the stage, his expression was a little strange. At this moment, he knew that his guess was right. Connor's identity was not simple.
When the crowd below the stage saw Connor, they also revealed a puzzled expression. They had seen Connor before and could feel that the Fifth Guardian were very respectful to Connor. However, no one expected Connor to be the distinguished guest of the Misty Sect.
"Hahaha…"
The expressions on the faces of the Cloudy Sect's people seemed to have become even happier. This was because they had never expected that the final trump card of the Cloudy Sect would actually be a young man.
"Noel, I didn't expect your Misty Sect to have reached this stage!"
A middle-aged man from the Cloudy Sect shook his head and sighed.
"This is the most distinguished guest of our Misty Sect, Mr. Connor McDonald!"
Noel said slowly.
"Connor?"
When everyone heard this name, they all had puzzled expressions because they felt as if they had heard this name somewhere before.
"Why does the name Connor sound so familiar?"
"That's right. I seem to have heard of this name somewhere…"
"Who is this Connor?"
Everyone present began to whisper, but it seemed that no one could accurately say Connor's identity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1992: Suspicious Identity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1992: Suspicious Identity
Noel seemed to have noticed the confusion on everyone's faces, so she smiled and said, "Everyone may not know Mr. Connor, so let me briefly introduce him to everyone!"
"Mr. McDonald is from Porthampton, Davenport. He is the Chairman of the Empire World Corporation!" Noel said slowly.
"The Chairman of the Empire World Corporation?"
When everyone heard this, their expressions became a little strange.
"Of course, that's not the most important thing. Mr. McDonald's most important identity is the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, which is also the disciple of the sect leader, Master Jorge Yarrell!"
Noel continued.
After he finished speaking, almost everyone present was stunned on the spot. The expressions on their faces were very incredulous.
This was because these people did not expect Connor's background to be so terrifying. Connor was actually the young sect master of the Purple Cloud Sect.
At this moment, the expressions of the Cloudy Sect's people had also begun to become ugly. This was because they did not have Noel's ability to be so great. This side had just lost such a large backer like the Netherworld Sect, and now, they had actually found the Purple Cloud Sect as their backer.
One had to know that there was still a huge gap between the strength of the Netherworld Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect.
"Is Noel lying to us?"
Those people from the Cloudy Sect did not quite believe Connor's identity.
"Impossible…"
A protector shook his head and said expressionlessly, "Noel doesn't have the guts to lie about this. Otherwise, if the Purple Cloud Sect finds out, their Misty Sect will be in big trouble!"
"That's true. If Noel only wanted to scare our Cloudy Sect, there was no need to create such a huge formation!" another person hurriedly added.
At this moment, Noel spoke again.
"Right, Mr. McDonald has another identity that everyone is very familiar with!"
When everyone heard Noel's words, they could not help but be stunned for a moment because they did not expect Connor to have such a status.
Previously, when they found out that Connor was the sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, they were already very shocked.
"Could it be that this Connor has an even more terrifying identity?"
The expression of the guardian of the Cloudy Sect was extremely ugly as he softly asked in a puzzled manner.
"I won't keep you in suspense. Not only is Mr. McDonald the Young Sect Leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, but he's also the Soul Eater who killed the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader in Winam some time ago!"
Noel shouted proudly.
For a moment, everyone present was dumbfounded. Other than shock, there was also shock on their faces.
"This person is the Soul Eater?"
"How is that possible? Why is the Soul Eater so young?"
"Sect Leader Farlow, there are some things that cannot be said casually. How can you prove that this person is the Soul Eater?"
For a moment, Noel's words were like a huge rock thrown into a calm lake, causing waves to rise. Everyone's expressions were very excited, as if they could not believe what Noel had just said, nor could they accept the fact that Connor was the Soul Eater.
In their eyes, a terrifying figure like the Soul Eater would never be related to a small sect like the Misty Sect. Even if he was related to them, the Soul Eater would definitely not be so young.
Even Beauford, Jada, and the others were dumbfounded. They did not know how to describe their feelings.
"Is this Connor really the Soul Eater?"
Beauford asked with a puzzled expression.
Jada turned to look at Beauford and said softly, "I'm not sure if Connor is the Soul Eater, but I did see Connor in Winam a few days ago!"
Beauford's expression changed again when he heard that. He knew very well that the Soul Eater had killed the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader in Winam.
The guardian of the Cloudy Sect suddenly opened his mouth and shouted at this moment.
"Noel, we believe that Mr. McDonald is the leader of the Purple Cloud Sect since you wouldn't dare to lie about such a big matter. But isn't it a little too much to say that this person is the Soul Eater? They are all ancient martial arts practitioners, and this Mr. McDonald is only twenty years old. How could he possibly have the ability to kill an existence like the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader?"
"That's right. Sect Leader Farlow, how do you prove that this person is the Soul Eater?"
"If you say that Master Yarrell is the Soul Eater, we can still believe it. But if you say that this person is the Soul Eater, we can't believe it at all!"
Solsby was located in Cameron, which was very close to Winam. This led to many people in Cameron hearing about the Soul Eater, but no one had ever seen the Soul Eater before, nor did they know what he looked like.
Facing everyone's doubts, Noel opened his mouth to explain, but Connor reached out his hand to stop him, then stepped forward and said softly, "Are you questioning my identity now?"
"That's right. How could you kill the Blood Moon Sect's Cult Leader at such a young age?"
Connor merely smiled faintly and then directly released his aura.
In an instant, his terrifying aura filled the entire hall.
Everyone quieted down and looked at Connor with fear. At this moment, they could all feel how terrifying his strength was.
In just a few seconds, the people present seemed to be unable to withstand Connor's aura. They felt as if they could die at any time. They had never experienced such fear before.
Connor did not continue to make things difficult for these people. He retracted his aura and asked everyone softly, "Do any of you still doubt my identity?"
Everyone looked at Connor with fear on their faces. Although they didn't know if Connor was the Soul Eater, they knew that his strength was very terrifying. At the very least, if Connor wanted to kill them, it would be very easy.
The guardian from the Cloudy Sect hesitated for a moment before speaking loudly, "Mr. McDonald, I admit that your strength is indeed very terrifying, but this alone can't prove that you're the Soul Eater!"
"That's right. Most of us are ordinary people. We can't judge your strength!"
Everyone shouted.
"..."
After Connor heard what everyone said, the expression on his face seemed a little irritated. At this time, he did not know how to explain to these people.
Moreover, he was too lazy to explain these things. After all, he did not need to prove that he was the Soul Eater.
The only reason why he appeared here today was to help Noel.

chapters.title: Chapter 1993: Proof
chapters.content:
Chapter 1993: Proof
However, just as Connor was about to turn around and leave, someone suddenly shouted, "Mr. McDonald is the Soul Eater!"
After hearing this, everyone turned to look at this person.
A young man walked out from the crowd and knelt in front of Connor, shouting, "Mr. McDonald, thank you for not killing me back then. If it weren't for your appearance, I might never have been able to return to my family!"
"Who are you?"
Connor looked at the young man in front of him and in confusion.
"I'm a disciple of the Netherworld Sect. You might not remember me, but I know that you killed the sect master of the Netherworld Sect and released us who were trapped by them," the young man shouted excitedly at Connor.
Everyone fell into shock again when they heard the young man's words.
Although they might not have seen the Soul Eater before, they were still very familiar with his deeds.
Connor had first destroyed the Netherworld Sect and then went to Winam to destroy the Blood Moon Sect.
At this time, the young man kneeling in front of Connor was a disciple of a big family in Solsby. His words carried some weight, and many people knew that this person was indeed a disciple of the Netherworld Sect.
For a moment, it was as if everyone believed the fact that Connor was the Soul Eater.
The way everyone looked at Connor had also undergone a huge change.
"I didn't expect the Misty Sect to be so powerful, even being able to invite a big shot like the Soul Eater!"
"Yeah, the Misty Sect finally found a true backer this time!"
"It is our honor to be able to see the Soul Eater in our lifetime…"
The expressions on everyone's faces began to become excited as they walked towards Connor, as if they were planning to get close to him.
Those people from the Cloudy Sect were already dumbfounded at this moment. The expressions on their faces were of disbelief.
"Connor is actually the Soul Eater?"
Beauford looked at Connor on the stage and didn't know how to describe his feelings.
He originally had the best opportunity to get in touch with Connor, but he had missed it in order to please the third guardian of the Misty Sect. Beauford was filled with regret.
What could the Third Guardian of the Misty Sect do in front of the Soul Eater?
However, even if Beauford managed to react, it would be too late.
Everyone present surrounded Connor like crazy, but Connor himself was not in the mood to pay attention to these people. He directly brought Rachel to the private room.
After seeing Connor leave, the crowd did not dare to stop him, so they could only focus their attention on Noel and begin to curry favor with him.
Noel's smile was very bright in the face of such a situation, because this was the effect he wanted to see.
Right now, Noel was surrounded by people. Some people could not get close to him at all, so they focused their attention on Beauford instead; after all, Connor had helped Beauford before. These people felt that there should be some relationship between him and Connor.
"Mr. Leone, what is your relationship with the Soul Eater, Mr. McDonald?"
The people who had previously looked down on Beauford were all smiling and speaking to him in a very polite tone.
"Mr. McDonald is my daughter's friend!" Beauford replied with a smile.
"Mr. Leone, why didn't you tell me earlier that you know a big shot like Mr. McDonald?"
"Yeah, if you had told me about your relationship with Mr. McDonald earlier, then no one in the whole of Sommerville would dare to provoke you!"
"That's right, that's right. That brat Gaetano is really tired of living. He actually dared to provoke you!"
Although Beauford had a smile on his face as he listened to them, he was in despair.
He did have a chance to change the fate of the Leone family, but he did not seize it. At this moment, Beauford did not dare to ask Connor to help him. He only hoped that Connor would not hold it against him.
…
While Noel was dealing with the influential people in Solsby, Connor and Rachel had already returned to the Misty Sect.
After all, Connor didn't know most of these people in Solsby. Even if he did, he didn't want to waste time on them.
After returning to the villa, Rachel went straight to sleep, while Connor cultivated alone in the bedroom.
The next day, at seven o'clock in the morning.
Rachel unexpectedly woke up early, then began to wash up and put on makeup. After more than an hour, she walked out of her room very satisfied.
Connor was a little surprised when he saw Rachel. He asked softly, "Why are you up so early today?"
"You're going to meet my grandparents with me today. Have you forgotten about this?"
Rachel shouted exasperatedly.
"..."
Connor was stunned when he heard this, and then he said with an awkward expression, "I really forgot about this…"
"Then what are you still doing here? Hurry up and change your clothes!"
Connor had no choice but to stop cultivating and walk into his room.
After entering the room, Connor changed into the new clothes that Rachel bought for him and then walked out.
When Rachel saw that Connor had changed into new clothes, the expression on her face seemed a little strange. She could not help but say,, "I didn't expect you to have a good frame. After changing into the clothes I bought, you look much more handsome!"
"This has nothing to do with the clothes you bought. It's just that I'm very handsome to begin with!" Connor replied indifferently.
"Alright, don't be narcissistic here. Hurry up and set off!"
Rachel rolled her eyes at Connor helplessly, then dragged him out of the villa.
However, just as Connor and Rachel walked out of the villa, they saw Noel walking towards them.
Noel quickly stepped forward and asked with a smile, "Mr. McDonald, Miss Wallace, are you two planning to go out?"
"I'm going out to do something!" Connor replied indifferently.
"Then why didn't you tell me in advance? I'll arrange a car for you now!"
Noel quickly took out his phone and dialed a number.
Connor glanced at Noel and didn't refuse.
After all, if Noel could get a driver for Connor, it would be much more convenient for them.
A few minutes later, a black Mercedes stopped beside them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1994: Passed Away
chapters.content:
Chapter 1994: Passed Away
"Sect Leader Farlow, thank you!"
Rachel said to Noel with a smile when she saw the car arrive.
"Miss Wallace, please don't say that. I should be the one thanking you!" Noel quickly said.
Rachel was not in the mood to be polite with Noel, so she directly dragged Connor into the car.
A moment later, the Mercedes-Benz started and drove out of the Misty Sect.
Noel hesitated for two seconds before she took out her phone and made a call.
..
At the same time, in the Mercedes-Benz.
Rachel's expression seemed to be a little nervous as she kept looking at the scenery outside the car window.
Connor turned his head to look at Rachel and asked Rachel softly, "You seem very nervous!"
"Why would I be?" Rachel didn't even think about it and directly retorted. "I'm just a little worried!"
"Worried?"
Connor was stunned when he heard this. He frowned and asked, "What are you worried about?"
"I haven't seen my grandparents for many years. I don't know if they still remember me, nor do I know if they will be angry with me. What if they don't recognize me at all when they see me?" Rachel muttered.
"Don't worry. No matter what, you're still their grandchild. They'll definitely acknowledge you!" Connor comforted..
Rachel turned her head to look at Connor, then said softly, "I hope it's as you say!"
Connor smiled and didn't say anything else.
About an hour later, they finally arrived at a courtyard house.
Rachel looked at the red door in front of her, and her face revealed a trace of gentleness. She said to Connor softly, "I didn't expect that after so many years, this place still hasn't changed. I remember that it was like this when I was very young, and it's still like this now!"
"Knock on the door!"
Connor said softly.
Rachel hesitated for a moment before walking to the front of the door and gently knocking on it.
However, after she knocked on the door, there was no movement inside for a long time.
Rachel's expression changed as she frowned and shouted, "Is anyone there?"
"Who is it?"
A few seconds later, the person behind the door finally responded.
The door slowly opened, and a middle-aged woman walked out. Then, she sized up Rachel and Connor with a puzzled expression and asked cautiously, "Who are you looking for?"
Rachel looked at the middle-aged woman in front of her and hesitated for a moment. Then, she asked softly, "Aunt, is that you?"
When the woman heard Rachel's words, she suddenly raised her head and looked at Rachel. After observing for a long time, she asked with a trembling voice, "Rae, is that you?"
"That's right, Aunt. You finally recognized me?"
Rachel shouted happily.
"Rachel, it really is you!"
The woman's expression was also very excited. She hurriedly pulled Rachel's hand and said, "Rachel, we haven't seen each other for so many years. The last time you came, you were still a child. Now, you're already a big girl. You're really too beautiful."
"Aunt, so many years have passed, but you're still so beautiful!"
Rachel replied with a smile.
"I'm already so old, how can I still be pretty? You really know how to talk!"
Her aunt smiled, then turned to look at Connor and asked softly, "Rachel, who is this?"
"Aunt Fiona, this is my boyfriend, Connor!"
Rachel hurriedly introduced him and then said to Connor, "Connor, this is my uncle's wife, Fiona!"
"Hello!"
Connor took the initiative to greet her.
"Hello, hello. This young man looks like a talented person. He is really too compatible with our Rachel…" Fiona smiled and replied to Connor.
At this moment, Rachel's mood did not seem to be so nervous anymore. She asked Fiona softly, "Aunt, are Grandpa and Grandma at home? I specially came to see them…"
Fiona's expression grew a little strange when she heard this. She said softly, "Um, Rachel, come in with your boyfriend first. Don't just stand here!"
"Good!"
Rachel didn't seem to think too much and followed Fiona into the courtyard.
After entering the courtyard, Rachel suddenly felt that something was not right because this courtyard seemed to have not been cleaned for a long time.
However, in Rachel's memories, her grandfather, Lawrence Strickland, was a very clean person. He also liked to raise some flowers and plants in the courtyard. However, there were no flowers and plants in the courtyard at all. It gave off the feeling of death.
"Grandpa, Grandma, I'm here to see you!"
Rachel didn't think too much about it and directly shouted into the house.
However, no one responded at all.
At this moment, Fiona, who was standing behind Rachel, suddenly spoke.
"Rachel, I have something to tell you!"
Rachel turned to look at Fiona and asked softly, "Aunt, where are my grandparents? Could it be that they no longer live here?"
"It's not that you don't want to live here anymore. Your grandparents passed away a year ago!"
Fiona said in a low voice.
"What?"
After Rachel heard Fiona's words, she was stunned on the spot, disbelief on her face.
"Rachel, come in with me!"
Fiona brought Rachel into a room.
Connor hesitated for a moment before following them in. After entering the room, Connor found a table in front of the room, and on the table was the memorial tablet of the Strickland family.
Not only were there the memorial tablets of Rachel's grandparents, but also Rachel's other two uncles.
This also meant that other than Rachel's uncle, the rest of the Strickland family were all dead.
Rachel looked at the memorial tablet in front of her as tears fell. Then, she knelt in front of the memorial tablet and said with a choked voice, "Grandpa, grandma, it's my fault for being unfilial. I didn't even know that the two of you had passed away…"
"Rachel, it's not your fault. After all, we didn't contact you at that time!"
Fiona comforted softly.
Rachel turned her head and asked, "Aunt, can I be alone with my grandparents for a while?"
"Alright, alright…"
Fiona hurriedly nodded, then turned around and walked out of the room.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor followed her out.
Rachel stayed alone in the mourning hall for about an hour before walking out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1995: I'll Give You Some Money
chapters.content:
Chapter 1995: I'll Give You Some Money
Connor saw that Rachel's expression was a little strange and could not help but ask softly, "Are you alright?"
"My grandparents and my uncle are all dead. This can't be a coincidence! I feel that there must be some conspiracy behind this!" Rachel said in a low voice.
"I will help you settle this matter!"
Connor replied after hearing her words.
Rachel raised her head and glanced at Connor indifferently. She did not continue to speak, but walked directly to Fiona's room.
After entering the room, Connor found a middle-aged man lying on the bed. However, this middle-aged man seemed to have become a vegetable and wasn't conscious at all.
"Aunt, what's wrong with my uncle?"
Rachel looked at the middle-aged man on the bed with a very surprised expression.
"Your uncle became a vegetable a year ago!"
Fiona replied softly.
"Aunt Fiona, what happened to the Strickland family all these years? Why did their status become like this? How did my grandparents, second uncle, and third uncle die? And why did my uncle suddenly become a vegetable?"
In Rachel's memories, the Strickland family could definitely be considered a big family in Solsby. Although it could not be compared to the existence of the Wallace family, it was still very influential.
Rachel also knew that her grandfather had always been the Chairman of a large group, and her uncles all worked in this group.
Even a few years ago, Rachel had asked someone to inquire about the Strickland family's situation, and the answer she received was that the Strickland family's company was in good condition.
However, Rachel could not understand how it had only been a few years, but the Strickland family had been destroyed. The only surviving uncle had become a vegetable.
"Rae, I don't know what happened either!" Fiona's tears instantly fell. Then, she choked and said, " A year ago, your grandfather was killed, and your grandmother passed away due to grief. Then, your third uncle and second uncle were killed. Although your eldest uncle survived, he became a vegetable…"
"Aunt Fiona, are you saying that my grandfather was killed by someone?"
Rachel was stunned for a moment before asking.
"Yes, he was killed. Not only your grandfather, but your third uncle, second uncle, and eldest uncle were also assassinated. It's just that your eldest uncle's luck was better and he survived!"
After Rachel heard this, her expression was very incredulous. She hurriedly continued to ask, "Then, Aunt Fiona, do you know who the murderer is?"
"I don't know…" Fiona shook her head.
"Then do you know who our Strickland family has offended?"
Rachel pressed.
"Rae, I'm just a normal woman. I usually take care of your uncle's daily life at home. I don't know anything about the company. Even if the Strickland family offended someone, I don't know about it!" Fiona replied.
Rachel looked at Fiona and was in despair because she couldn't get any useful information from her.
Rachel's uncle might know some inside information, but at this time, he was in a vegetative state, so he could not do anything.
"What about your company? Who's managing the Strickland Corporation now?"
Rachel felt that since there was no way to find the enemy of the Strickland family, she could also see who had benefited from this matter.
Moreover, Rachel felt that all of this should be related to the Strickland family's business. Otherwise, under normal circumstances, the other party would not have had to kill so many people from the Strickland family.
"After your grandfather died, the Strickland Corporation's business situation was not very good. When it was in the hands of your uncle, it was already heavily in debt. After your uncle's accident, it was your second uncle who managed it. Unfortunately, it did not last long before the Strickland Corporation went bankrupt…"
Fiona said to Rachel helplessly.
After Rachel heard Fiona's words, she fell into despair. The expression on her face was also very broken because there was no useful information at all. Moreover, this matter had passed for so many years, and Rachel knew very few people in Solsby, so it would be very difficult to investigate again.
"Rae, I know you want to avenge your grandfather, but it's been so long. Why don't you forget about it? Don't drag yourself down because of this!"
Fiona kindly advised.
"Aunt Fiona, don't worry. I will definitely get justice for my uncle and grandfather. I definitely won't let them die in vain!"
Rachel said firmly.
"Rae, I know your intentions, but since those people were able to destroy our Strickland family without anyone knowing, it means that these people are very capable. You really don't have to fight with them!"
Fiona said with a frown.
"Do you think you they can kill people just because they're apable?" Rachel replied coldly. Then, she looked at Fiona and asked, "Aunt Fiona, you're taking care of my uncle alone now. What do you usually rely on to survive?"
"I usually go out to work to earn some living expenses!" Fiona replied.
"Give me your bank account number later, and I'll transfer some money to you!"
Rachel said softly.
"Rae, how could I take your money?"
Fiona refused without thinking.
"Aunt Fiona, it's already like this. You don't have to be polite with me. You know that my grandfather is very rich. The money I'm giving you is nothing to me, but it can solve a lot of your problems!"
Rachel replied in a low voice.
After Fiona heard Rachel's words, she hesitated for two seconds and did not continue to refuse. After all, she was really short of money now.
After Rachel got Fiona's bank card number, she followed Connor and left the Strickland family's courtyard house.
Along the way, Rachel didn't say a word, and her expression was very solemn.
She had never thought that the Strickland family would encounter such a big change. Other than her uncle, everyone else was dead.
According to the other party's style of doing things, the enemy of the Strickland family should be very influential in Solsby and Cameron. Otherwise, ordinary people would not dare to do things so ruthlessly.
"Connor…"
Rachel suddenly shouted.
Connor turned his head and glanced at her, then asked softly, "What's wrong?"
"You might have to go back to Yarlford by yourself. I want to stay in Solsby for a while longer!" she said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1996: Just Friends?
chapters.content:
Chapter 1996: Just Friends?
"I'll help you deal with this matter. You don't have many connections in Solsby, so it won't be easy to investigate the murderer who framed your grandfather. If I stay and help you, it should be much easier…"
Connor paused and then continued, "Moreover, there are many ancient martial arts sects in Solsby. If the person who killed your grandfather was a martial artist, you might not be able to deal with it yourself…"
"Then what about the matter in Yarlford?"
Rachel knew that Connor was in a hurry to return to Yarlford to deal with the Gomez family.
"There's no rush. Taran Saber hasn't returned yet anyway, and it doesn't matter if we spend a few extra days on this!"
Connor said lightly.
After Rachel heard Connor's words, she was very touched. "Connor, thank you!"
"Don't be so polite with me. I'm not used to you being like this…"
Rachel was not in the mood to joke with Connor, so she did not continue to pay attention to him.
An hour later, Connor and Rachel returned to the Misty Sect.
After entering the villa, Rachel locked herself in her room. Connor could hear that Rachel was probably calling people to use her connections to find the murderer who killed her grandfather.
If they were anywhere apart from Solsby, Connor felt that Rachel would be able to find out soon. However, Solsby was too far away from York. Rachel had a lot of connections, but they didn't cover the whole of Sommerville. Therefore, she needed to constantly find connections to investigate this matter.
Connor still pitied her.
After all, Rachel's parents were killed by Rockefeller, but she didn't have the ability to take revenge for them, and now, her grandfather had also been murdered. The only difference was that this time, Rachel might have the ability to take revenge.
Connor felt that he should do something at this time, but he only knew Noel in Solsby.
Fortunately, Connor had helped Noel's status in Solsby rise last night. It should not be too difficult to investigate the Strickland family.
Connor took out his phone and dialed Noel's number.
"Mr. McDonald, what can I do for you?" Noel asked respectfully after he picked up the call.
"I need you to help me investigate something!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Mr. McDonald, you should be planning to ask me to help you investigate the Strickland family, right?" Noel asked directly.
"How did you know?"
After Connor heard this, the expression on his face seemed to be a little shocked.
"Mr. McDonald, don't misunderstand. I didn't follow you. It was our Misty Sect's driver who told me about this. That's why I knew. I've already helped you to investigate…" Noel said with a smile.
"You've already investigated it for me?"
The expression on Connor's face seemed to be somewhat puzzled.
"Mr. McDonald, let me tell you this personally!" Noel said carefully.
"Then come to the villa!"
Connor replied indifferently and then hung up the phone.
After hanging up the phone, Connor walked to Rachel's room and knocked on the door.
"The door isn't locked. Come in!" she called.
Connor entered the room. At this time, Rachel was lying on the bed. Her condition was not very good, and it seemed that she had just cried.
Connor couldn't help but feel a little heartache when he saw her like this. After all, a woman like Rachel rarely exposed her fragile side. She had always lived in a big family like the Wallace family, so she learned to be independent and self-reliant from a very young age. This also led to Rachel looking very strong, but she was actually a woman, and she also had her own fragile side.
"How's the investigation going?" Connor asked softly.
"My connections are temporarily unable to reach Solsby. I can only see if they can help me investigate some things…"
Rachel said in a hoarse voice.
"Just now, Noel said that he seemed to have found some clues. Do you want to hear them?" Connor continued.
"Really?"
After Rachel heard Connor's words, the expression on her face seemed to be a little excited. She hurriedly stood up and shouted at Connor.
"Of course. You don't have to shoulder everything by yourself. After all, you still have me by your side!"
Connor lsaid seriously.
After Rachel heard Connor's words, she couldn't help but feel a trace of warmth in her heart. It seemed that she hadn't experienced the feeling of being truly cared for by someone for a very, very long time.
In this world, it was as if no one else really cared about her other than her grandfather.
However, at this moment, Rachel once again found such a feeling from Connor.
After Connor realized that Rachel had been staring at him, the expression on his face seemed a little awkward. "What are you looking at?"
"I'm not looking at anything. I'm just a little curious why you're so good to me!"
Rachel was not an ordinary woman. She would bluntly say whatever she thought and would not hide it at all.
"Because we're friends!" Connor replied.
"Is it as simple as being friends?" Rachel asked.
"What else would it be?"
Connor was speechless.
"Little Connor, are you in love with me? That's why you're so good to me, trying to move me, isn't it?"
Rachel questioned.
"Ma'am, can you not be so narcissistic? Why did I fall in love with you? The two of us live together every day. If I really fell in love with you, I would have done it to you long ago!" Connor shouted in despair.
When Rachel heard Connor's words, the expression on her face was a bit strange. She then frowned and said, "Little Connor, what do you mean by that? Are you saying that I'm not charming enough?"
"You're charming enough, but I look at you every day. Maybe I'm tired of looking at you, so I really only treat you as a friend. I don't have any thoughts about you!"
Connor said confidently while sizing up Rachel's figure.
But in fact, Connor's words were obviously a lie. Rachel was the best among the sexy stunners. Even if you looked at her every day, it was absolutely impossible to get tired of her.
However, Connor really didn't have any other thoughts about Rachel because he knew that she was very terrifying. If something really happened between him and Rachel, the consequences would be unimaginable!

chapters.title: Chapter 1997: Eliminate All of Them
chapters.content:
Chapter 1997: Eliminate All of Them
"Ding, ding, ding…"
At this moment, Connor's phone suddenly rang, interrupting their conversation.
Connor took out his phone and saw that it was Noel calling him
"Mr. McDonald, I'm already at the entrance of the villa, but no one answered the door!"
"The door shouldn't be locked. Just come in!"
Connor replied lightly and then hung up the phone.
"Noel is here. Let's see if he has any clues!" he said to Rachel.
"Yes…"
Rachel nodded and followed Connor out of the room.
After arriving at the living room, Noel first greeted Connor and Rachel, then took the initiative to explain, "Mr. McDonald, this is what happened. When my driver came back today, he told me that you went to the Strickland family. At that time, I was a little curious about who the Strickland family was to make you go there personally, so I investigated them..."
"You don't have to explain these things to me. Just tell me what you found out…"
Connor interrupted Noel.
"Alright, alright…"
Noel nodded and continued, "I found out that the Strickland family seemed to have provoked some people they shouldn't have provoked a few years ago. That's why the head of the Strickland family was killed, followed by the other members. In the end, there was only one person left, and he also became a vegetable!"
"Then do you know who attacked the Strickland family?"
Rachel asked.
Noel looked up at Rachel and asked carefully, "Miss Wallace, what is your relationship with the Strickland family?"
"The head of the Strickland family, Lawrence Strickland, is my grandfather!" Rachel said bluntly.
"So that's how it is!"
Noel nodded thoughtfully, then said with a smile, "Miss Wallace, since you have such a relationship with the Strickland family, I won't hide anything from you. I didn't find out who did this to the Strickland family, but I can provide you with a list of names. You can narrow down the scope according to my list!"
"Where is the list?"
Rachel hurriedly asked.
"here…"
Noel handed Rachel the name list that he had prepared beforehand.
Rachel took the list and looked at it confidently. She found that there were about seven or eight names on the list, but she didn't know these people.
"These people might have attacked my grandfather?" she asked.
"That's right, these people are all suspects, but because this incident happened a long time ago, it won't be easy to investigate if we want to determine which one of them did it!" Noel said slowly.
Rachel's expression was a little heavy after hearing this. Although Noel had narrowed down the scope, it was still quite large. It was not easy to determine who the murderer was.
Moreover, Connor had more important things to do in Yarlford. Rachel didn't want to waste his time because of this.
"Can you find information on these people?"
Connor suddenly asked Noel.
"I should be able to!" Noel nodded.
"Help me collect information on these people now. I also need a recent photo of them, the clearer the better!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"Mr. McDonald, what are your plans?"
Noel's expression was a little strange.
"Just do as I say!"
Connor didn't have the intention to explain to Noel at all.
"Alright, I'll go and prepare the information and photos of these people for you now!"
Noel left in a hurry after that.
After Noel left, Rachel turned her head to look at Connor, then whispered, "Connor, there are too many targets now. If we investigate them one by one, it will probably take a long time to find out who killed my grandfather. Therefore, you should return to Yarlford first. I will handle this matter myself…"
"There's no need to investigate these people!" Connor said.
"What do you mean by that?" Rachel asked with a puzzled tone.
"I've already asked Noel to collect information on these people. I think that since these people can appear on Noel's list, it means that they are definitely not good people. After all, a good person wouldn't do something like exterminating a family. Anyway, they are all suspects."
Connor explained.
"Are you planning to kill all these people?" Rachel asked.
"Not necessarily. If these people didn't do anything immoral, then I might spare their lives. But I also need to use some methods to get the truth out of their mouths and see if they are the murderers. If they aren't good people, then it's better to kill these people directly so that they won't continue to harm others in the future!" Connor continued to explain.
Rachel glanced at Connor. She didn't object to his actions.
She felt that Connor's method was the fastest and most effective one. Moreover, Connor wasn't going to kill the innocent and would only choose to kill those who should be killed. This way, he could save more ordinary people who were living in hot water.
Rachel hesitated for a moment before looking at Connor. "With so many people, it should be easy to find them, right?"
"Don't worry. As long as Noel can find these people's photos, I'll have a way to find them!"
"What is it?"
Rachel asked curiously.
"You will know when the time comes…"
Connor didn't explain too much to Rachel because he had never used such a method before, so he couldn't be sure if it would succeed for the time being. However, he could give it a try.
More than an hour later, Noel finally sent the information and photos to Connor.
Connor and Rachel looked at the information of these people very carefully. Just as Connor said, these people were all heinous people who were notorious in Solsby. They all relied on stepping on other people's corpses to get to where they were today. The things that these people did were outrageous.

chapters.title: Chapter 1998: Divine Sense
chapters.content:
Chapter 1998: Divine Sense
However, these people all had one thing in common.
That was, they had conflicts with the Strickland family.
The Strickland family had a business, so it was very normal for them to compete with or have conflicts with other companies.
However, only the people on Noel's list had the courage and strength to destroy the entire Strickland family.
"The list that Noel provided us with is full of famous underworld figures in Solsby. Some of them are even martial artists. Their hands are full of blood and they are unpardonable. So tonight, the two of us will execute justice on behalf of the heavens and get rid of all these people."
Connor said softly.
"Are you sure that the information Noel provided you is true?" Rachel asked hesitantly.
"Do you think Noel would dare to lie to me?"
Connor replied with a smile.
"I don't think so…"
Rachel shook her head.
"Then do as I say. This is the fastest way to avenge your grandfather!"
"But you haven't told me how you'll find these people!" Rachel exclaimed.
"Come with me…"
Connor didn't explain anything to Rachel. Instead, he took her hand and walked out of the villa.
Rachel was puzzled, but she didn't say anything and could only follow closely behind.
A few minutes later, Connor brought Rachel to the peak of Green Mountain.
From this position, one could see the entirety of Solsby.
"Connor, why did you bring me here?"
Rachel asked Connor in confusion.
"You'll know later!"
Connor took out the photos of the seven people on the list and memorized their faces.
He took a deep breath and then directly released his aura.
