When Rachel sensed Connor's aura, the expression on her face appeared somewhat shocked.
The aura instantly turned into countless threads that flew straight to every corner of Solsby.
For a moment, it was as if the entire Solsby was enveloped by Connor's aura.
When Rachel saw this scene, the expression on her face was other than shock.
The scenes of every corner and every room in Solsby crazily surged into Connor's mind. Facing so much information, Connor seemed to be a little uncomfortable for a moment, and the expression on his face began to become painful.
A few seconds later, Connor could only stop because he could not withstand the overly large amount of information.
Rachel saw Connor stop and quickly ran to his side. "Connor, are you alright?"
"I'm fine…"
Connor waved his hand at Rachel and said in a low voice, "This is just my first time using such a thing, so I feel a little uncomfortable…"
"What were you doing just now?"
Rachel asked Connor with a puzzled expression.
"Previously, when I absorbed the Cult Master's soul power, I had already broken through to the realm of a Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Moreover, I discovered that my aura seemed to be able to fuse with the aura of heaven and earth. What I found even more unbelievable was that as long as my aura fused with the aura of heaven and earth, these auras could transmit the surrounding situation to my mind. It was like I had a thousand miles of vision. I could see many things that normal people cannot!" Connor explained.
After Rachel heard Connor's words, she was stunned on the spot. Then, she asked, "Are you saying that you already have divine sense?"
"What is divine sense?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"I've only heard my grandfather mention this thing before. My grandfather said that in this world, there is a very, very powerful warrior who can have divine sense. Moreover, the range of the divine sense will also change according to the level of the warrior's realm. The most important function of the divine sense is that it can know everything that happens outside without you needing to leave the house!"
Rachel paused for a moment before continuing, "When I first heard my grandfather mention this, I thought he was lying to me. I didn't expect that there would really be someone in this world who could have such an ability!"
"So this thing is called divine sense!" Connor sighed softly and then continued, "Let me try again and see if I can find those seven people this time!"
"Just do what you can. If this method doesn't work, we can use other methods!" Rachel reminded him.
"I know…"
Connor nodded lightly and released his aura again.
This time, he learned from his previous experience, so he filtered out most of the useless information, which helped narrow down the useful information.
Rachel looked at Connor worriedly.
At this moment, Connor felt very strange because he was like the god of this city. He could observe everything that happened in every part of the city, and no one could feel that he was observing them.
Connor had seen many people and many things in Solsby.
He began to think about the appearance of those seven people in his mind.
A few minutes later, his gaze focused on a very luxurious villa.
At this moment, in the bedroom of this villa, a man and a woman were doing something indescribable, and this man happened to be one of the seven people.
Connor retracted his aura and turned to Rachel. "Found one!"
"You found it so quickly?"
When Rachel heard Connor's words, her expression was a bit shocked.
"Follow me!"
Connor was worried that his target might change his position in a while, so he didn't want to waste time. He directly carried Rachel and jumped.
Rachel couldn't help but scream when he jumped down from the top of the mountain.
Although Rachel was also a martial artist, she did not have the guts to jump down from such a high place either!
However, she might have forgotten that Connor wasn't an ordinary martial artist, but rather a Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, so this height was nothing to him.
Connor used his aura to let his body fly in the sky, and Rachel also slowly opened her eyes. When she realized that she was actually flying in the sky, the expression on her face seemed to be even more shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1999: The Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 1999: The Target
"Connor, how did you do it?"
Rachel asked in surprise.
"Now that my cultivation has reached the Heaven Rank, the aura in my body is strong enough to support me flying in the sky. Although it can't last for too long, flying dozens of kilometers shouldn't be a problem!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Just as Rachel was about to speak, she realized that Connor was slowly descending.
A few seconds later, he arrived in front of the villa where he had found his target.
"The target is in this villa!"
Connor softly said.
"Then how are the two of us going in?"
Rachel hurriedly asked.
"We'll just walk in, of course." After Connor replied indifferently, he raised his leg and kicked open the door of the villa before slowly walking in..
Perhaps it was because Connor pushed the door open loudly that it startled the man in the bedroom.
The man rushed out in his pajamas and shouted, "Who has the guts to barge into my villa?"
"You must be Channer Doyle?"
Connor took out a photo and compared it very seriously.
Channer stared at Connor. "That's right, I'm Channer. Who are the two of you? Why did you barge into my house?"
"Do you have anything to do with the death of the Strickland family?" Connor asked, ignoring him.
"The Strickland family?"
Channer could not help but be stunned when he heard this. The expression on his face was somewhat puzzled.
"Did you kill Lawrence Strickland?"
Rachel shouted loudly.
Channer finally understood what was going on and hurriedly shook his head. "I did have some conflicts with the Strickland family before, but Lawrence Strickland's death had nothing to do with me…"
Connor waved his right hand gently, and an aura directly cut off one of Channer's arms.
"Ah…"
Channer hugged his arm and screamed in pain.
"I'm asking you one last time. Did you have anything to do with Lawrence Strickland's death?" Connor asked expressionlessly.
"The death of the Strickland family really has nothing to do with me. You've found the wrong person…"
Channer said with a trembling voice.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Rachel. Both of them were sure that Channer was not Lawrence Strickland's murderer. However, Channer was not a good person, so Connor naturally did not spare his life.
A cold light flashed and pierced through Channer's forehead.
After dealing with Channer, Connor and Rachel started to look for the second target.
Similar situations were happening in different corners of Solsby.
Connor and Rachel were constantly shuttling back and forth in Solsby. Wherever they passed, people would die.
In less than three hours, Connor had already eliminated six targets.
However, none of the five targets admitted that he had anything to do with the death of the Strickland family.
Connor knew that people would not dare to lie in the face of death threats, so these people should not be the murderers of Rachel's grandfather. However, because these people were not good people, Connor also killed them to prevent future troubles.
Connor took out the last photo. "There's only one target left now. The murderer who killed your grandfather should be this person!"
"Then what if he isn't the murderer?" Rachel asked.
"It's okay. When I return to Yarlford, I'll get someone to refine a pill for your uncle and see if it can wake him up. As long as your uncle wakes up, we'll know who did it!"
Connor softly replied.
"That's the only way!"
Rachel felt that Connor's method was the best method so far.
"Let me find out where this last person is!"
Connor took a deep breath and then released his aura again.
A moment later, Connor retracted his aura and turned to Rachel."I found the last target!"
"Where is it?"
Rachel hurriedly asked.
"In a bar!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
Rachel's expression was a little strange after hearing Connor's words. After all, she and Connor had fought in a relatively private place before, but this time they had to fight in a bar.
There were likely many people in the bar. If these people saw Connor kill someone, the consequences would be unimaginable.
"Then do you still plan to go over there?" Rachel asked.
"Of course. There's only one person left. If we let him go, it won't be so easy to find him again!" Connor said bluntly.
"Alright, let's go over now!"
Rachel gently nodded.
Connor directly pulled Rachel's hand and rushed towards the bar.
A few minutes later, Connor and Rachel came to the door of a bar. This bar was very famous in Solsby, so there were many customers in the bar, and most of them were young people.
Connor hesitated for a moment and didn't choose to go in to look for him. Instead, he pretended to be a couple with Rachel and easily entered the bar.
After entering the bar, Connor found that there were indeed many people inside. All kinds of girls with heavy makeup and sexy clothes were swaying their bodies on the dance floor.
Rachel was very beautiful and had a sexy figure. Even if she didn't dress up today, she became the focus of countless people when she appeared in the bar.
And Connor naturally received the attention of many people; after all, they were all curious that Connor, who looked like an ordinary boy, had found a top-notch beauty like Rachel as his girlfriend.
Connor was not in the mood to look at the beautiful women on the dance floor. Instead, he released his aura and finally locked onto the target's position.
At this moment, the target was drinking on the second floor.
The bar only had two floors. The first floor was very crowded and had many private booths, a dance floor, and a sofa area.
The situation on the second floor was much simpler. Moreover, the customers who could reach the second floor were all the top VIP members of this bar, so the number of people was naturally much smaller.
Connor gave Rachel a look and walked straight towards the second floor.
A few minutes later, Connor and Rachel walked up to a man.
At this moment, the man was drinking while observing the situation on the dance floor, as if he was looking for his next prey.
Connor didn't hesitate at all and immediately sat opposite the man. Rachel sat beside him.
The man noticed that Connor was about to speak when he saw Rachel beside him. He was instantly attracted by her charm and exquisite face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2000: Sammy's Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 2000: Sammy's Master
The man slowly put down the wine glass in his hand, then smiled and asked them, "What do the two of you mean?"
"Your name is Sammy Keegan, right?"
Connor took out the last photo and placed it on the table.
"Who are you?"
After Sammy saw his photo, he looked a little nervous and asked Connor in a low voice.
"I'm looking for you. I just want to ask you something. You just have to answer my questions honestly!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"What do you want to ask?" Sammy hurriedly asked.
"Did you kill the Strickland family?"
When Sammy heard Connor's words, his expression was a little strange. Then, he shook his head and said, "What are you talking about? What Strickland family? I didn't know at all..."
After saying this, Sammy stood up and seemed to be about to leave, but an extremely powerful force pressed down on his body. At that moment, he felt as if a huge mountain was pressing down on his body, making him unable to move.
At this moment, Sammy finally realized that the man in front of him was not an ordinary person, but rather a martial artist. Moreover, his strength was far above his.
"I advise you to answer my question honestly, or I will turn you into meat paste!" Connor said in a low voice.
At this moment, Sammy seemed to be unable to withstand the terrifying aura on his body. His expression was very ugly as he asked Connor with great difficulty, "Who exactly are you?"
"It doesn't matter who I am. Do you have anything to do with the Strickland family?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"What does the death of the Strickland family have to do with me? I don't know what you're talking about!" Sammy shouted.
"You want to do it the hard way!" Connor snorted coldly, then directly increased the aura released on Sammy's body.
Sammy felt as if his body was being compressed by a hydraulic press. This kind of pain was not something an ordinary person could withstand. A few seconds later, Sammy's head was completely pressed against the table, and his body began to gradually bend to a very strange degree.
Sammy knew that if he continued like this, he might really be smashed into meat paste by Connor, so he hurriedly shouted, "Hurry up and stop, I beg you…"
"If you don't tell me the truth, I won't stop…"
"I beg you, please stop. I'll tell you the truth, okay?"
Sammy gritted his teeth and shouted in pain.
Rachel was also very nervous. After all, if Sammy was not the murderer, it might not be easy to find the real murderer.
Connor stopped releasing his aura onto Sammy, who let out a long sigh. He whispered to Connor, "That's right, I was indeed the one who killed him!"
When Rachel heard Sammy's words, her expression grew angry. Then, she shouted at Sammy, "Why did you kill my grandfather? Why?"
Sammy was stunned for a moment and asked nervously.
"…Lawrence Strickland is your grandfather?"
"Tell me why, why did you kill my grandfather?"
Rachel shouted excitedly.
Sammy looked up at Rachel and stuttered, "Actually, I did not want to kill those people from the Strickland family. This was all an order from my master. There was nothing I could do…"
Connor frowned and asked, "Is it your master who wanted to kill the Strickland family?"
"That's right!" Sammy quickly nodded and continued, "I don't know what kind of conflict there is between my master and the Strickland family. At that time, I followed my master's instructions…"
"Then where is he now?" Connor asked.
"I'm not sure where my master is now. Why don't I call him?" Sammy said.
"Okay, go ahead!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Sammy reached out to take out his phone, but the next second, he jumped down to the first floor without thinking.
Sammy was a fighter himself, and he should be a Mystic, so his speed was very fast. When he jumped down, it caused quite a commotion on the first floor.
For a moment, everyone began to scream, and the scene was abnormally chaotic.
Sammy took advantage of the chaos to run out of the bar.
"Connor, what are you still standing there for? Hurry up and chase him!"
It was not easy to find some clues about the cause of Lawrence Strickland's death. Rachel must be very anxious now.
Connor glanced at Rachel indifferently and said softly, "Don't be nervous, he can't escape!"
After saying this, Connor slowly stood up and walked downstairs.
In fact, Sammy's escape was in line with Connor's intentions. After all, there were too many people in the bar. If they really fought, it would be very inconvenient.
Just now, Connor left an aura on Sammy's body, so he could not escape at all today.
A few minutes later, Connor and Rachel walked out of the chaotic bar, and Connor easily found Sammy based on the location of his aura.
At this moment, Sammy's face was filled with fear. He called his master for help while fleeing in all directions.
He knew very clearly how terrifying Connor's strength was. If he was really captured by Connor, then he would definitely die.
At this moment, a voice finally came from Sammy's phone.
"Sammy, why are you calling me so late at night?"
"Master, someone wants to kill me. Quickly, come and save me. This person's strength is extremely terrifying. He probably came after me because of the Strickland family's matter back then!" Sammy shouted excitedly.
"Where are you now?"
The other party could tell that Sammy must have really encountered danger at this moment. Otherwise, he definitely would not have spoken in such a tone.
"I'm near the Charm Bar now…" Sammy stammered.
"Just wait, I'll be there soon!"
The other party hung up the phone.
After hesitating for a moment, Sammy placed his attention on the trash can by the roadside. He did not dare to run too far now, so he planned to hide in the trash can and wait for his master to come.
Unfortunately, before Sammy could enter the trash can, Connor and Rachel appeared in front of him.
Sammy was shocked and sat on the ground. His face was filled with fear as he shouted at Connor with a trembling voice, " Don't kill me. Back then, it was my master who asked me to kill the Strickland family. My master will be here soon. Please don't kill me…"

chapters.title: Chapter 2001: Kane Keegan
chapters.content:
Chapter 2001: Kane Keegan
"Did you just say that your master is coming soon?"
Connor asked Sammy coldly.
"That's right, my master will be here soon!"
Sammy hurriedly nodded and looked at Connor as he continued, "If you want revenge, then go find my master to take revenge. I have nothing to do with this."
"Since you said that your master is coming soon, then we'll wait here. I'll give you ten minutes. If your master doesn't appear, I'll kill you first and then go find him!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
Sammy looked at Connor nervously, but he did not dare to speak anymore.
Time passed by.
About five to six minutes later, an old man walked toward Sammy and Connor.
Connor glanced at the old man indifferently and realized that this old man was actually a martial artist, and he was probably an ancient martial arts grandmaster.
This meant that this old man was probably Sammy's master.
As expected, Sammy looked a little excited when he saw the old man. He shouted, "Master, I'm here. Hurry up and save me!"
"Who has the guts to kill Kane Keegan's disciple?"
The old man roared angrily and then rushed up to Connor.
"Kane Keegan?"
Rachel was stunned when she heard this name. She was also very shocked.
"You know this person?"
Connor felt that Rachel's expression seemed a little off as he asked her softly.
"I... I remember this person's name…"
Rachel gritted her teeth and said.
"Who is he?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"When I was very young, I heard from my mother that my grandfather almost died from poisoning. The name of the person who poisoned him was Kane Keegan, but my grandfather survived. Kane Keegan was also sent to prison. Did he escape from prison and then take revenge on my grandfather and the other members of the Strickland family?"
Rachel seemed to have already guessed the cause of what happened. However, because it happened a long time ago, she was not sure if her guess was correct.
"Then, why did this person poison your grandfather?"
Connor asked.
"I'm not sure…"
Rachel bit her lips and shook her head.
"Who are you two? Why do you want to kill my disciple?"
At this moment, Kane had already walked up to Connor and Rachel.
"Why did you kill my grandfather?"
Rachel asked loudly.
"Your grandfather?"
When Kane heard this, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, "Are you Lawrence Strickland's granddaughter?"
"Yes, I am. What kind of deep hatred does my grandfather have with you that you want to kill everyone in the Strickland family?"
At this moment, Rachel was very agitated.
"The grudge between your grandfather and I can't be explained in a few words. If it weren't for him back then, my wife wouldn't have died, and I wouldn't have thought of using poison on him. I wouldn't have achieved what I have today, so now that I think about it, I would have to thank your grandfather!"
Kane did not cover anything up because in his eyes, Connor and Rachel would die very soon.
"My grandfather killed your wife?"
Rachel was a little puzzled when she heard this.
"That's right. Back then, your grandfather and others were working together to set me up. They plotted against me. My wife could not take the blow and chose to commit suicide. From then on, I made up my mind to kill him with my own hands and let the Strickland family experience the pain that I had endured back then!"
Kane shouted.
Rachel could not help but shake her head upon hearing Kane's words. He said in a low voice, "You're a madman!"
"That's because your grandfather drove me crazy. I didn't plan to take revenge on an outsider like you. After all, you haven't been in contact with the Strickland family for so many years."
Kane shouted and then rushed toward her.
Without any hesitation, Connor stood in front of Rachel because he knew that she was no match for Kane.
Bang!
With a loud bang, Kane's fist landed on Connor's chest.
Connor stood still on the spot, but Kane took a few steps back to steady himself.
Kane stared at Connor in disbelief.
As Kane was a true ancient martial arts grandmaster, his full-strength punch could directly rip through a normal person's body, even a mystic class martial artist wouldn't be able to take it.
However, Connor had received his punch head-on, and Connor was like a rock, not moving at all. On the contrary, Kane was forced back a few steps by the shock. This was really unbelievable.
"I didn't expect you to be so capable despite your young age. You are actually able to withstand my punch. How surprising!"
Kane shouted at Connor and then released his aura.
But now, when facing an opponent like Kane, Connor did not need to use his aura at all. His figure flashed, and he rushed up to Kane.
Kane hurriedly used his aura to form a shield in front of his body, as if he wanted to block Connor's attack.
However, Kane had underestimated Connor's strength.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist pierced through Kane's shield and landed heavily on his chest.
"Pfft…"
Before Kane could react, he was sent flying by Connor's punch and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Kane's body slammed into the ground. He struggled to stand up, but the power of Connor's punch was too terrifying. No matter how hard he struggled, he could not use any strength.
When Sammy saw this scene, he was scared silly. He was very shocked.
He knew very well that Kane was a true beginner heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, but Kane couldn't resist Connor at all and was sent flying by Connor's punch.
This meant that Connor's strength far surpassed Kane's.

chapters.title: Chapter 2002: Dying With Clarity
chapters.content:
Chapter 2002: Dying With Clarity
"Who exactly are you?"
Kane clutched his chest in pain and shouted at Connor.
Connor ignored Kane and turned to look at Rachel behind him. He whispered to her, "I only used 30% of my strength in that punch just now. I wanted to give him a chance to breathe so that you can finish him off!"
Kane almost died of anger when he heard Connor's words.
He had only used 30% of his strength, yet Kane was already in such a state.
If Connor were to use his full strength, Kane would have died with that one punch.
When Rachel heard Connor's words, she took a deep breath and slowly walked up to Kane. She asked Kane in a low voice, "Do you have anything else to say now?"
Kane suddenly looked at Rachel with a fearful expression on his face. He stuttered, "What do you want? If you dare to kill me, my disciples will definitely not let you off…"
"Do you think I'm afraid of them?"
Rachel looked at Kane and sneered.
Kane could feel the infinite killing intent from Rachel's expression. He also knew that he would not be able to escape death today, so after hesitating for a couple of seconds, he asked Connor in a low voice, "Can you tell me your identity before I die so that I can die with some clarity?"
"My name is Connor McDonald!"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
"..."
Kane was stunned for a moment before he said in disbelief, "You are the legendary Soul Eater, Connor McDonald?"
"That's right!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Kane smiled bitterly and slowly closed his eyes, as if he had no intention of continuing to struggle.
Kane never thought that there would be such a terrifying big shot behind the Strickland family. Noel Farlow had already revealed Connor's identity at the banquet yesterday, which led to many people in Solsby knowing the identity of the Soul Eater.
Kane felt that there was nothing shameful about dying in the hands of the Soul Eater. After all, a terrifying figure like the Soul Eater was not someone he could afford to provoke.
Rachel walked up to Kane and said in a low voice, "Even if I kill you today, I won't be able to bring my family back to life. If you knew that this would be the outcome, would you have chosen to let the Strickland family off?"
"No…"
Kane shook his head at Rachel without any hesitation.
"Why?"
When Rachel heard Kane's words, she exclaimed.
"Why?"
Kane smiled coldly and said expressionlessly, "I already told you just now. If it weren't for Lawrence Strickland, my family wouldn't have been destroyed. My family was destroyed by him, so I'm going to destroy the Strickland family!"
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Kane. He could feel that Kane was in a state of madness.
A person's personality would be distorted after experiencing extreme pain. Kane was in such a distorted state.
Rachel looked at Kane's face and seemed to have calmed herself down. After taking a deep breath, she took out a dagger and stabbed it through Kane's heart.
At this moment, Rachel did not want to continue chatting with a lunatic like Kane because she knew that even if she continued chatting, she would not be able to change anything that had happened before.
Kane's body twitched slightly before he lost all signs of life.
Rachel let out a long sigh as if she had been relieved of a heavy burden. Then, she squatted on the ground and cried loudly.
It was obvious that even though she had found the person who killed her grandfather and had taken revenge, the emotions suppressed in her heart had not been released. After all, the dead could not be brought back to life.
Connor looked at Rachel who was squatting on the ground and suddenly had a very strange feeling in his heart.
He couldn't imagine how he would feel if he really helped his parents take revenge one day. Would he be like Rachel, without any excitement or happiness at all? Would he only feel endless pain?
If that was really the case, then what was the meaning of revenge?
Connor couldn't understand these questions. He could only stand there and wait for Rachel.
When Sammy saw that Kane was dead, he was filled with fear. He did not expect that the invincible Kane would be killed so easily by Connor and Rachel.
For a moment, Sammy did not know how to describe his feelings.
However, he knew that he did not have the time to grieve. After all, Connor might make a move on him after getting rid of Kane.
Sammy took a deep breath and wanted to escape while Connor and Rachel's attention was not on him.
However, Sammy had just stood up and ran less than two steps when a cold light pierced through his forehead.
Sammy collapsed onto the ground.
Rachel cried for a long time before she finally stopped crying. She slowly stood up and said to Connor softly, "Let's go!"
"If you feel sad, you can continue crying!"
Connor softly said to Rachel.
"Even if I continue crying, it won't change anything. Let's go back!"
Rachel shook her head and then started walking.
Connor followed closely behind Rachel.
The two of them didn't say a word along the way. Connor knew that Rachel was feeling all sorts of things, so he didn't try to comfort Rachel. There were some things that only she could figure out.
After returning to the villa, Rachel thanked Connor and entered the room.
Connor sat on the sofa in the living room and started cultivating.
When Connor was cultivating, he could still hear Rachel's soft sobs.
Rachel would probably need a very long time to completely walk out of this matter.
The next day, Noel received a piece of shocking news just as the sun rose.
Several famous big shots in the underground world of Solsby had been killed overnight. The interval between each death was short, and the methods used to kill these people were very similar.
The police immediately started investigating, but they couldn't find any evidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2003: That Person is Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 2003: That Person is Back
For a time, this matter caused a storm in the city.
The people of Solsby were also discussing this matter.
Of course, most people still felt that these people's deaths were not worth pitying. After all, these people were all evil people in the underground world. Countless people in Solsby had their families separated because of them.
Now that all these people were dead, it was definitely good news for the citizens of Solsby. Some people even thought that the Soul Eater had appeared and helped them get rid of these evil people.
Noel sat on the sofa and read the report. She was utterly shocked.
Because Noel knew very well who had done these things!
"I just gave these people's information to Mr. McDonald last night. He killed all of them in less than a night. Even Sammy Keegan's master, Kane Keegan, is dead."
Noel couldn't help but sigh to himself. At this moment, he seemed to have a new understanding of Connor's strength, which made him shudder.
In Noel's eyes, if he really offended someone like Connor, he might not even know how he died!
"Sect Leader Farlow, that person is back!"
At this moment, Kali Waterman suddenly rushed into Noel's room and shouted excitedly.
"Who's back?"
Noel could not help but be stunned when he heard Kali's words. She was a little puzzled.
"Taran Saber is back!"
Kali hurriedly replied.
"What is it? Taran Saber actually came back?"
Noel was a little surprised because he already knew that Connor had let Taran go and asked Taran to get evidence.
At that time, Noel felt that Connor was making a mistake by letting Taran go. It was highly likely that Taran would never return.
However, he never expected Taran to keep his promise and actually return.
"I'll inform Mr. McDonald now. You should go and meet Taran!"
Noel knew that Kali had feelings for Taran, so she specially arranged for the two of them to meet alone.
"Thank you, Sect Leader!"
Hearing Noel's words, Kali was very grateful. She quickly turned around and ran out of the room.
Meanwhile, Noel went to Connor's villa to inform him.
Half an hour later, Kali brought Taran to Connor's villa.
"You have really returned…"
Connor said softly.
"I was saved by you, and dealing with Yamino Gomez is something I've always wanted to do. The most important thing is that you trust me and didn't have anyone follow me, so I choose to trust you!"
Taran looked at Connor and responded.
Hearing Taran's words, Connor smiled faintly and asked softly, "Did you get it?"
Taran did not hesitate and handed a hard disk to Connor. He whispered, "All the evidence is in this hard disk…"
Connor turned and glanced at Noel. Noel quickly took out the laptop that he had prepared beforehand and plugged the hard disk into the computer.
A few minutes later, Connor turned off the computer, then looked at Taran and said, "Your evidence should be enough to make Asya lose trust in Yamino. Leave the rest to me!"
Connor knew that Yamino's biggest support was actually Asya. However, if Asya knew what was on the hard drive, not only would Asya not continue to help Yamino, but he would also choose to kill Yamino. After all, anyone who had been used for so many years would be angry if they found out.
"You mean I don't have to go to Yarlford?"
Taran instantly understood what Connor meant.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded his head and continued, "The Gomez family is still looking for you. If you go to Yarlford, you'll be walking into a trap. I have a lot of things to do next, so I can't let you follow me!"
"I have to go to Yarlford!"
Although Taran knew that Connor was doing this for his sake, he still shouted stubbornly.
"Aren't you afraid that you won't be able to come back after going to Yarlford?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"Of course, I'm scared!"
Taran nodded and continued, "However, I hope that I can personally see Yamino Gomez die in front of me. My entire life has been ruined by him…"
Connor looked at Taran and could not help but think of Kane's appearance last night. It was as if Taran and Kane were the same. Their hearts had long been filled with hatred.
"Alright, since you want to go to Yarlford, then come with me. However, I have to remind you that you might not be able to see the moment Yamino dies. If you choose to stay here, you can live the rest of your life in peace!"
Connor whispered to Taran.
When Taran heard Connor's words, he smiled faintly and said softly, "I know you have good intentions, but I have already made up my mind. I must go to Yarlford!"
"..,"
Connor looked at Taran and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He did not continue to persuade him.
"Mr. McDonald, when do you plan to leave?"
Noel asked Connor softly.
"I've been delayed in Solsby for a long time, so I plan to return to Yarlford today to settle the rest of the matters!"
Connor replied lightly, then turned to look at Rachel's room.
Ever since Kane died, Rachel had not left the room. At this moment, Connor was not sure how she was doing.
Taran seemed to have noticed that something was wrong, so he asked Connor softly, "Miss Wallace, what's wrong?"
"Nothing, I'm just in a bad mood!"
Connor replied faintly, then stood up and was about to go to Rachel's room to tell her about his return to Yarlford today.
However, before Connor could enter Rachel's room, Rachel walked out and said to Connor, "I heard your conversation just now. I'm okay with that. I can go back with you!"
"Are you sure?"
Connor could feel that Rachel was still pretty upset, so he asked with a worried tone.
"Yeah…"
Rachel nodded without thinking.
Connor did not continue to ask seeing her persistence.
Noel didn't want Connor to leave so soon because he wanted to publicize what Connor did last night to help the Misty Sect increase its influence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2004: Split into Two Paths
chapters.content:
Chapter 2004: Split into Two Paths
Unfortunately, Connor had already decided to leave.
Noel didn't have the guts to ask Connor to stay. He could only smile and say, "Mr. McDonald, if you leave today, should I hold a farewell party for you?"
Connor turned to look at Noel and asked softly, "Do you think it's necessary?"
"No…"
Noel shook his head without thinking and continued, "Um, Mr. McDonald, I'll book a plane ticket for you now!"
"Alright!"
Connor lightly nodded.
After Noel left, Connor told Taran about his plan.
Taran seemed to think that there was nothing wrong with Connor's plan. As long as he could ensure that every step was completed smoothly, not only would he be able to completely defeat Yamino, but he would also be able to make Rockefeller lose control.
An hour later, Connor, Rachel, and Taran arrived at Solsby Airport under the escort of the Misty Sect's people. They then took a connecting flight to Yarlford.
Originally, Rachel did not plan to return to Yarlford. After all, she was not in the best of states. Even if she returned to Yarlford, she could not go to class. Therefore, she planned to go to York alone for some time.
However, Connor didn't want to let Rachel go to York alone.
Kane Keegan still had many disciples in Solsby, so they weren't sure if anyone would attack Rachel on the plane.
Therefore, Connor felt that it would be safer for Rachel to follow him to Yarlford first and then take a plane to York.
After all, no matter how powerful Kane's disciples were, they could only tamper with the plane in Solsby. It was impossible for them to tamper with the plane in Yarlford.
Rachel felt that what Connor said made sense, so she went along with his plan.
It was past seven in the evening.
Connor, Rachel, and Taran arrived at Yarlford, while Rachel took another flight to York.
Connor handed Taran over to Yama, because he knew that Yama was strong. As long as it wasn't an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, no one would be able to hurt him. As such, having Yama protect Taran was the best choice.
Next, Taran needed to take on the role of a witness, so nothing could happen to him.
After Yama took Taran away, Connor went to the Stormbound Tower alone to discuss the next step with Queta Juve.
After arriving at the Stormbound Tower, Connor realized that Queta was still working overtime in the company.
Although he hadn't seen Queta for a long time, Connor was still amazed when he saw her. At this moment, Queta was carefully studying the details of the contract on the computer. Her delicate face was especially beautiful under the fluorescent light of the screen. She was wearing a coffee-colored professional suit, and her breasts seemed to be bursting through the seams of her top. Her slender legs were covered with black stockings, and she was sexy with a hint of elegance.
"Queta, why are you still at work?"
Connor walked straight into Queta's office and greeted her with a smile.
When Queta heard Connor', she suddenly turned to look at Connor. She was very shocked. She quickly stood up and walked to Connor in her high heels. She said excitedly, "Mr. McDonald, you're back!"
"Yeah…"
Connor nodded and continued, "You must have had a hard time!"
"It's not too bad. Mr. McDonald, how's everything going on your end? Have you found the key witness you mentioned?"
Before Connor left, he told Queta that he was going to find Taran.
"I have, and I also got a very crucial piece of evidence!"
Connor replied softly and handed the hard drive to Queta.
"..."
Queta hesitated for a moment before inserting the hard drive into the computer and opening the contents.
A few minutes later, Queta looked at Connor in shock. Her expression was one of disbelief.
This was because Queta originally thought that the evidence that Connor would be able to obtain this time would at most be some evidence of Yamino's crimes. However, she never expected it to be such important evidence.
"When I found out about this, I was also very surprised!"
Connor whispered.
"If this evidence is released to the public, then this will definitely be the end of Yamino Gomez!"
Queta said excitedly.
"I don't intend to release this evidence now. I want to release it at the most critical moment!"
Connor replied in a low voice.
"..."
Queta was a very smart woman. She looked at Connor and nodded.
"How's the situation in Yarlford and the four big families?"
Connor asked softly.
"The four big families have completely stopped all communications with the Gomez family and have even established a partnership with the Stormbound Corporation. If we look at the market, our Stormbound Corporation is able to replace the Gomez family. However, the Gomez family still has some shady businesses in their hands. These businesses are the core of the Gomez family. However, his foundation is not affected at all!"
Queta answered directly.
"This situation is within my expectations. If the Collier family stops cooperating with the Gomez family, will the Gomez family's business be completely paralyzed?"
Connor asked Queta.
"Of course, the Gomez family is relying on these businesses to support themselves. If they lose these businesses, the Gomez family won't be able to last even a month!"
Queta nodded.
"Then, I will ask the Collier family to stop all cooperation with them. This way, the Gomez family will be paralyzed. When Yamino returns, everything will be settled. Even if Yamino makes a move, he won't be able to save this situation. If the Gomez family has lost control, it will affect Rockefeller's influence in the entire Sommervile. Rockefeller will definitely have Yamino take responsibility and even find someone to replace Yamino. Then, I'll reveal this piece of evidence. At that time, Yamino will be facing enemies on both sides. In the end, there will only be death!"
Connor slowly revealed his next plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 2005: Aida Collier Betrayed Us?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2005: Aida Collier Betrayed Us?
"If this plan can be carried out, then the only path that awaits Yamino is death!"
Queta said excitedly.
"After we get rid of Yamino, the Stormbound Corporation will replace the Gomez family's position, and the Collier family will take over the Gomez family's shady business. Rockefeller's many years of hard work will go down the drain!"
Connor continued.
Actually, the reason why Connor had meticulously planned all of this was actually not as simple as wanting to get rid of Yamino at all.
If Connor merely wanted to get rid of Yamino, then he would just kill Yamino.
Compared to getting rid of Yamino, it was more important to get Rockefeller out of Sommervile.
If Rockefeller lost a huge market like Sommervile, it would be a huge blow to Rockefeller.
"But Mr. McDonald, are you sure you can make the Collier family stop all cooperation with the Gomez family?"
Queta hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
"Aida Collier is working for me. I was the one who agreed to the cooperation between the Collier family and the Gomez family. I was deliberately stalling for time so that the Gomez family would not have any chance!"
Connor said with a smile.
Connor had already considered that the most important core business of the Gomez family was those shady businesses. If Connor didn't agree to the cooperation between Aida and the Gomez family, although it would bring a lot of trouble to the Gomez family for a while, if the Gomez family found a new partner, then there would not be any reason for Connor to get the four big families on his side. After all, this would not hurt the foundation of the Gomez family.
However, if Aida cooperated with the Gomez family, then everything would be under Connor's control.
Whenever Connor wanted Aida to stop working with the Gomez family, he could do so.
"Aida is also working for you?"
Queta looked at Connor. She was utterly shocked.
She felt that there were always all kinds of unbelievable things happening to this man.
"Now, it's finally time to draw in the net!"
Connor sighed softly, then took out his phone and dialed Aida's number.
However, the phone rang for a long time, and Aida did not answer the phone.
Connor had no choice but to call again, but the result was the same. Aida still did not pick up the phone.
A strange look flashed across Connor's face because he felt that something was wrong. If it was under normal circumstances, Aida would definitely answer the phone.
"Has Aida betrayed us?"
A thought suddenly struck him.
After all, Aida was not a simple woman. Moreover, Aida had lied to Connor before, so anything could happen with this woman.
If Aida had really betrayed Connor, then all of Connor's plans might be disrupted.
Queta seemed to have noticed that something was wrong with Connor, so she asked Connor softly, "Mr. McDonald, is there a problem?"
"It's nothing…"
Connor replied in a low voice, then picked up his phone and walked out of the office.
At this time, Connor was ready to find out what's going on with Aida.
However, after leaving Stormbound Tower, Connor was still unsure, so he called Aida again.
"Hello?"
However, Connor didn't expect that someone would pick up the phone this time. However, Connor could hear that the person was not Aida, but another woman's voice.
"Where's Aida Collier?"
Connor asked without hesitation.
"Are... Are you Connor McDonald?"
The other party asked carefully.
"I'm asking you, where's Aida Collier?"
Connor repeated.
"Who are you?"
The other party asked stubbornly.
"I'm Connor McDonald. Where's Aida Collier?"
Connor said speechlessly.
"That's great. You finally called. Hurry up and come to Room 403 of the Aeon Hotel. When you arrive, knock on the door three times, and I'll open the door for you…"
The other party said excitedly.
"Where is Aida? Who are you?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
However, the other party did not answer Connor's questions and hung up the phone right after.
Connor looked at his phone with a helpless expression. He called back, but the other party had already turned off the phone.
Connor had no idea what Aida was up to, but after hesitating for a moment, he decided to take a taxi to Aeon Hotel.
Connor's current strength was already very terrifying. Unless there was really a peak ancient martial artist like what the sect leader had said, ordinary ancient martial arts grandmasters would not be able to defeat Connor. Of course, he was not worried about an ambush in the Aeon Hotel.
After more than half an hour, Connor arrived at the entrance of the Aeon Hotel. Then, he released his aura and enveloped the entire hotel.
Unfortunately, Connor searched the entire hotel but couldn't find Aida at all. This meant that Aida wasn't in the hotel.
Connor entered the hotel and found Room 403 according to the other party's instructions. He reached out and gently knocked on the door three times.
A few seconds later, the door was opened from the inside.
Connor could vaguely see that it was a woman. After the woman opened the door, she reached out and pulled Connor in.
After Connor entered the room, the woman locked the door. Then, she leaned against the door and let out a long breath. She looked at Connor and said, "Connor, you're finally here. Do you know how long I've been waiting for you here?"
"Waiting for me?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard the woman's words. Then, he sized up the woman.
The woman was about the same age as Connor, but she was only wearing a black spaghetti strap dress. However, the woman's figure was very sexy, and her breasts were extremely alluring. She was also very beautiful and charming. Although it could be seen that this woman had not done her makeup for a few days, she was still very charming.
However, Connor was not in the mood to chat with the beauty in front of him. He asked, "Where is Aida now? Who exactly are you? Why are you waiting for me here?"
After hearing Connor's words, the woman was speechless. Then, she said in an annoyed tone, "Why are you suddenly asking me so many questions? I was really nervous just now. Can you let me rest first?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2006: Best Friend
chapters.content:
Chapter 2006: Best Friend
"Alright, then you should rest for a while!"
Connor nodded helplessly.
The woman walked to the sofa and sat down.
Then, she picked up the milk tea on the coffee table and took a sip.
"Can you answer my question now?"
Connor asked softly.
"What was the question you asked me just now?"
The woman turned to look at Connor and blinked.
"Where is Aida?"
Connor repeated helplessly.
"Oh, right…"
The woman nodded gently and continued, "Well, let me tell you who I am first!"
"Alright…"
"I'm Melanie Yamane, Aida's best friend!"
The girl said as she sipped her milk tea.
"And then?"
Connor asked impatiently.
"A while ago, Aida suddenly looked for me and gave me her phone. She told me not to pick up any calls except for a person called Connor McDonald. Aida also said that I was in danger and told me to find a safe place to wait for you to call me. Before I see you, I can't leave. That's why I asked you to come here just like that."
Melanie told Connor seriously.
"Okay…"
Connor nodded helplessly.
"Aida also asked me to tell you that something has happened to her…"
Melanie continued.
"What is it?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I'm not too sure about the specifics, but she said that there's a video on her phone, and she asked me to show it to you!"
After saying that, Melanie handed the phone to Connor.
Connor took the phone and found the video that Aida had left behind. He then pressed the play button.
There was only Aida in the video, and the location it was filmed was probably Aida's home.
"Connor, if you can see this video, it means that I'm missing now. Juan Gomez has a person called Bruce Janco working for him. He suspected that I was working with you, so he warned me that if a third person knew about the information regarding, it would be me who is the mole!
"Juan has already received news of Bruce's death, and someone has proven that Bruce died in your hands. Juan has already begun to suspect me. I think he might do something to me, so I recorded this video!
"If something happens to me, then I might be captured and brought to the Heavenly Sect!"
Aida said intermittently in the video.
Connor slowly put down the phone and began to think about what was going on.
It was obvious that his relationship with Aida had been exposed. Juan was probably planning to get rid of Aida, but Beau Collier did not agree to it. Instead, he brought Aida to Heavenly Sect.
Although Aida did not say why she recorded the video, her recording this video was most probably to get Connor go to Heavenly Sect to save her.
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath. At this moment, he already understood the ins and outs of the entire matter.
"Do you understand what's going on?"
Melanie asked Connor softly.
"Yeah…"
Connor nodded and continued, "Thank you for waiting for me for so long. Yarlford is not safe for you now. Let's leave as soon as possible!"
"Alright…"
Melanie then asked, "Then, are you planning to save Aida?"
"Of course!"
Connor replied without any hesitation and then walked out of the room.
Aida was very important to Connor now. Secondly, Aida's accident had a lot to do with Connor. Therefore, he had to save her no matter what.
Of course, Connor and Beau still had many unsettled scores.
The reason why Connor did not make a move on Beau was because he felt that if Aida was undercover in the Collier family, it would help Connor obtain clues about Taran.
However, now that Connor had found Taran and Aida's identity had been completely exposed, there was no need for her to stay with the Collier family.
Connor was thinking of going to the Heavenly Sect to settle everything, but he didn't know the exact location of the Heavenly Sect, so he took out his phone and dialed Waverly Green's number after leaving the hotel.
The Heavenly Sect and Purple Cloud Sect were both one of the four major sects of Sommervile. As a disciple of Purple Cloud Sect, Waverly naturally knew the location of Heavenly Sect.
Ring, ring, ring…
After a few rings, Waverly picked up the call.
"Waverly, do you know where the Heavenly Sect is?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"Young Sect Leader, why are you asking about the Heavenly Sect?"
Waverly could tell that something was wrong with Connor's tone and hurriedly asked.
"Back then, Beau almost killed Freya. I've always had this grudge in my heart and wanted to find an opportunity to take revenge. Now that the opportunity has come, I plan to get rid of Beau!"
Connor said lightly.
"Young Sect Leader, you must not!"
Waverly shouted excitedly when she heard Connor's words.
"Why not?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Young Sect Leader, firstly, Beau is terrifyingly strong. If you really intend to go alone, not only will you not be able to kill Beau, but you will also be eliminated by him. If you really want revenge, you can wait until the Sect Leader returns before discussing this with him!"
Waverly hurriedly said.
"With my current strength, it shouldn't be difficult for me to get rid of Beau!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"But even if you can kill Beau, you can't act rashly against him!"
Waverly continued to persuade him.
"Why?"
Connor frowned.
"Mr. McDonald, don't forget your identity. You're the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, and Beau is the sect leader of the Heavenly Sect!"
"According to the agreement between the four great sects of Sommervile, the disciples of the four great sects are not allowed to kill each other. If you really attack Beau, it means that the Purple Cloud Sect has violated this agreement. At that time, the Purple Cloud Sect's reputation being ruined is just a small consequence. If the other two great sects join hands with Beau, the Purple Cloud Sect will probably fall into an unprecedented crisis. We simply have no way to compete with the other three major sects!"
Waverly exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2007: Heading to the Heavenly Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 2007: Heading to the Heavenly Sect
"There's actually such a rule between the four great sects?"
After hearing Waverly's words, Connor could not help but frown slightly.
"After all, the four great sects are the ones who jointly maintain the order of the ancient martial arts in Sommervile. Mr. McDonald, you are not only representing yourself, but also the Purple Cloud Sect. Otherwise, why did Beau not choose to do it when he had so many opportunities to get rid of you? He was worried that once he made a move on you, it would cause an even larger battle between the sects!"
Waverly said slowly.
"So you're saying that I can't kill Beau now?"
Connor asked.
"Yes!"
Waverly nodded.
"What if I have to kill him? It's just the three great sects. If they dare to be enemies with the Purple Cloud Sect, then I'll kill them along the way…"
Connor said confidently,
Waverly couldn't help but break out in a cold sweat when she heard Connor's words. After all, even Jorge Yarrell wouldn't dare to say such words.
"Mr. McDonald, once the three sects join forces, their strength will be extremely terrifying!"
Waverly reminded him helplessly.
"Is it more terrifying than the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
Connor asked softly.
"Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
When Waverly heard Connor's words, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. Then, she asked in a low voice, "Young Sect Leader, what... what do you mean by that?"
"The Blood Moon Sect's cult leader died in my hands, and I even devoured a portion of the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader's power. I might be stronger now!"
Connor said lightly.
"Young Sect Leader, you're not joking with me, are you? Are you saying that you were the one who killed the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
Waverly asked in shock.
"That's right, I killed him!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"That means you are the Soul Eater?"
Waverly hurriedly continued.
"Yes!"
Although Connor didn't really like this title, he still acknowledged it.
"..."
Waverly was so shocked by Connor that she didn't know what to say.
Right now, there were many speculations about the identity of the Soul Eater, but only a portion of the people in Solsby knew that Connor was the Soul Eater. No one else knew about this.
Waverly had never expected Connor to be the Soul Eater.
"Now, you believe that I have the ability to defeat Beau, right?"
Connor wasn't in the mood to discuss the matter of the Soul Eater with Waverly. Instead, he continued to talk about Beau.
"Young Sect Leader, even if you have the ability to defeat Beau, you can't do this. After all, the impact is too great. You should wait for Sect Leader to come back and discuss it with him!"
Waverly said helplessly.
"I can't wait until then. Aida is in Beau's hands. I need to save her immediately!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"Uh…"
Waverly didn't know what to say after hearing Connor's words. After all, she understood him very well. Once he had made a decision, no one could change it.
"Young Sect Leader, if you really intend to go to Heavenly Sect to get rid of Beau, then there is only one way to fulfill your request and not violate the agreement between the four sects!"
Waverly suddenly said.
"What is it?"
Connor was stunned for a moment before he hurriedly asked.
"If you issue a challenge to Beau as the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, this is not considered a violation of the agreement. Moreover, as a senior, Beau has no reason to reject!"
Waverly said slowly.
"Alright, then we'll do as you say. I'll leave the matter of issuing the challenge to you. Tell me the location of the Heavenly Sect. I'll go there now!"
Connor said lightly.
"Why are you in such a hurry?"
Waverly said in surprise.
"Aida is in their hands. Also, she is very important to my plan. I have to resolve this matter as soon as possible!"
Connor explained.
"Alright, then!"
Waverly helplessly agreed and then told Connor the location of the Heavenly Sect.
When Connor found out the exact location of the Heavenly Sect, he asked Queta to book a ticket to Masonville for him.
The Heavenly Sect was located on the Heavenly Mountain in Masonville.
When Connor boarded the plane, Waverly also discussed this matter with the few guardians of the Purple Cloud Sect. Although most of them did not agree with Connor's actions, they also knew that his personality was the same as Jorge's. No one could change their minds. Even if they did not agree to it, Connor would still do it.
Therefore, the grand guardian of the Purple Cloud Sect wrote a letter of challenge on behalf of Connor and stamped it with the seal representing the sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect and sent it to the Heavenly Sect as soon as possible.
After all, if the letter of challenge was sent a little later and Connor attacked the Heavenly Sect first, then the Purple Cloud Sect would be violating the agreement between the sects. This was not a small matter in the eyes of the guardians!
Waverly took the initiative to accept the mission of delivering the letter of challenge and went down the mountain overnight.
"What luck does the Purple Cloud Sect have to be able to meet two sect leaders with such a personality!"
The grand guardian watched Waverly leave with a helpless expression.
Jorge's personality was already strange enough, but they realized that Connor, the future sect leader, might be even stranger than Jorge.
"If it weren't for the money that the young sect leader gave the Purple Cloud Sect, how could our lives be so easy…"
The third guardian chuckled.
"That's true. I'm just a little worried about what will happen if the Purple Cloud Sect is under Young Sect Leader in the future!"
The grand guardian said slowly.
"Maybe there won't be any big four sects in Sommervile in the future, and only the Purple Cloud Sect will be left!"
The third guardian said softly.
A strange look flashed across the grand guardian's face when he heard this. After smiling bitterly, he turned around and returned to the hall.
...
The distance between the Purple Cloud Sect and the Heavenly Sect was much shorter than the distance between Yarlford and the Purple Cloud Sect, so Waverly only took a day to reach the Heavenly Sect.
Connor was still on the plane.
Waverly represented the entire Purple Cloud Sect, so even though Beau and Connor had some grudges, Beau still chose to personally welcome her to show his respect for the Purple Cloud Sect.
Albert Collier, the core members of the Collier family, and the guardians of the Heavenly Sect followed behind Beau.

chapters.title: Chapter 2008: A Letter of Challenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 2008: A Letter of Challenge
These people didn't know why Waverly was here.
Albert had a frown on his face. He could vaguely feel that Waverly's visit this time was very likely related to Connor.
A moment later, Beau and the others finally saw Waverly, who had been waiting outside the sect's main hall.
Today, Waverly was wearing a long robe with the words "Purple Cloud" written on the back. This robe was the symbol of the Purple Cloud Sect's disciple status.
Waverly was very beautiful. After wearing this long robe, she gave off an immortal aura, like a fairy descending upon the mortal world.
Even many disciples of the Heavenly Sect could not help but reveal admiring looks when they looked at her Waverly.
"Junior Waverly Green greets Sect Leader Collier!"
Waverly was a disciple of the Purple Cloud Sect, so her status was naturally lower than Beau's. Hence, when Waverly saw Beau, she took the initiative to greet him.
"Waverly, you've really changed. I remember that the last time I saw you, you were still a child. Now, you've actually grown into such a beautiful lady!"
Beau smiled before continuing, "Please come in!"
At this moment, Beau was displaying the etiquette of a great sect. His words and tone were natural, as if the grudge between him and Connor did not affect the relationship between the Purple Cloud Sect and the Heavenly Sect.
"There is no need for that…"
Waverly replied indifferently. Then, her eyes changed, and she slowly said, "I'm here to deliver a letter of challenge to you. I'll leave once the letter of challenge has been delivered!"
"A letter of challenge?"
When the people from the Heavenly Sect heard Waverly's words, they were all stunned. They were in disbelief.
They had been wondering why Waverly was here, but they had never expected her to be here to deliver a letter of challenge!
Even Beau's expression changed slightly.
"The Heavenly Sect has been on good terms with the Purple Cloud Sect for many years. I wonder why Sect Leader Yarrell issued a challenge to me."
Beau asked Waverly softly after a moment of hesitation.
It was obvious that Beau felt that Jorge was the one who had issued him a challenge.
However, Beau knew that he was no match for Jorge, so he deliberately asked this question. If Waverly couldn't find a reasonable excuse, then this letter of challenge would be useless. Beau could reject it right away.
"Yeah, I don't think there's any conflict between the Heavenly Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect. What's with Sect Leader Yarrell suddenly issuing a challenge?"
"Does Sect Leader Yarrell have other intentions?"
"You can issue a challenge, but there must be a suitable reason!"
The other guardians of the Heavenly Sect shouted at the top of their lungs.
Waverly couldn't help but smile when she heard what these people said. Then, she said softly, "This time, the person who issued the challenge letter from the Purple Cloud Sect was not Sect Leader Yarrell!"
"If it's not Sect Leader Yarrell, then who is it?"
Beau hurriedly asked.
"This time, the person who issued the letter of is Young Sect Leader McDonald, Connor McDonald!"
Waverly said slowly.
As soon as she finished speaking, everyone was shocked once again. They were dumbstruck.
No one had expected Connor to challenge Beau.
Even Beau himself was shocked.
"And the reason why our Young Sect Leader McDonald challenged Sect Leader Collier is a simple one. Young Sect Leader has many doubts regarding cultivation recently, so he hopes to fight with Sect Leader Collier and get some guidance from you."
Waverly said expressionlessly.
Beau looked at Waverly with an extremely ugly expression.
First of all, not to mention the letter of challenge, just the fact that Connor, as a junior, had taken the initiative to issue a letter of challenge to a senior like Beau was already enough to make him feel embarrassed.
Moreover, Beau had so many grudges with Connor.
"Connor has finally made his move…"
Albert couldn't help but take a deep breath. He was feeling vexed.
"What is the meaning of this? How can the Purple Cloud Sect let a junior challenge our Sect Leader? Such disrespect!"
"That's right. The Purple Cloud Sect's Young Sect Leader doesn't have the right to issue a challenge to Sect Leader Collier, right?"
"Isn't he clearly humiliating Sect Leader Collier?"
The people from the Heavenly Sect were very upset as they shouted at Waverly.
Waverly smiled faintly when she heard what everyone said. It was as if she had already known that these people from the Heavenly Sect would react like this, so she smiled and said,"I've already made it very clear just now. The Young Sect Leader just wants Sect Leader Collier to give him some pointers. He doesn't have any other intentions. If Sect Leader Collier doesn't want to accept the challenge, then it's fine."
After saying that, Waverly turned around and was about to leave.
"Stop right there!"
But at this moment, Beau suddenly shouted.
When Waverly heard Beau's words, she slowly turned and glanced at him. She then asked Beau softly, "Yes, Sect Leader Collier?"
"I accept the challenge from the Purple Cloud Sect's Young Sect Leader!"
Beau said in a low voice.
"Sect Leader, you must not!"
"That's right, Sect Leader. This Purple Cloud Sect is obviously deliberately humiliating us. You must not accept it!"
"Sect Leader, you have to think carefully. If this matter gets out, the Purple Cloud Sect will probably become a laughingstock in the eyes of others!"
Everyone from the Heavenly Sect shouted.
Beau did not pay any attention to these people. Instead, he walked straight to Waverly and accepted the challenge.
When Waverly saw that Beau had accepted the challenge, she let out a long sigh of relief. After all, if Beau did not accept the challenge and Connor still attacked Beau, things would get troublesome.
"Since Sect Leader Collier has already accepted the challenge, then this junior will take her leave now!"
Waverly bowed to Beau, then turned around and walked out of the Heavenly Sect.
After Waverly left, everyone gathered around Beau.
"Father, you clearly know that the Purple Cloud Sect is deliberately trying to humiliate you. Why did you accept this challenge?"
Albert hesitated for a moment before asking Beau in a low voice.
"You can also see that Connor is deliberately trying to humiliate me. If I didn't accept Connor's challenge today, wouldn't it be even more embarrassing if word got out?"
Beau gritted his teeth and replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 2009: The Battle of the Heavenly Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 2009: The Battle of the Heavenly Mountain
Everyone was stunned when they heard Beau's words.
Because Beau was right.
Being challenged by a junior was a very embarrassing thing.
However, if Beau did not dare to accept the challenge, it would be even more embarrassing.
"Father, Connor's strength cannot be underestimated!"
Albert said in a low voice.
"I know…"
Beau nodded his head lightly and continued, "Connor is probably here for Aida. Since he wants to end things with the Collier family, then I will give him this chance. I want him to come here alive, but not return alive!"
Albert's expression turned doubtful when he heard Beau's words. He could not understand why Beau was so confident.
After all, Beau was hiding on the Heavenly Mountain because he was worried about Connor's revenge. However, Beau did not seem to be afraid of Connor at all.
"Did the ancestor come out of seclusion?"
Albert was a little shocked. He could not help but sigh in his heart.
"Sect Leader, if you really accept Connor's challenge, then according to the rules of the Sommervile sects, we need to inform the other sects about this and invite the Sect Leaders of the other sects to come and watch!"
At this moment, a guardian of the Heavenly Sect reminded him softly.
"Then inform them. It just so happens that I haven't seen those old things for a long time. I'll use this opportunity to meet them!"
Beau said calmly.
"Alright, I'll get someone to write an invitation letter now!"
The guardian nodded.
Beau narrowed his eyes and looked at the scenery in the distance. He sighed softly and said, "Connor, oh Connor, I didn't kill you because of Jorge Yarrell. I didn't expect you to come to my door this time. Don't blame me for what's to come…"
On the other side, after Waverly left the Heavenly Sect, she went straight to the airport to wait for Connor to get off the plane.
Waverly waited at the airport for an entire morning. Connor finally walked out slowly.
When Waverly saw Connor, she was somewhat helpless. After all, if it wasn't because he wanted to deal with Beau, she would not have been tormented to such an extent.
"Why are you here? And why are you wearing this outfit?"
Connor asked in surprise when he saw Waverly.
"It's all because of you!"
Waverly replied speechlessly, then continued with a pout, "I'm here to deliver the letter of challenge to the Heavenly Sect. Now that the letter of challenge has been delivered and Beau has accepted it, you and Beau will have a showdown on the Heavenly Mountain in three days!"
"Thank you!"
Connor replied with a smile.
"It's nothing. I'm just worried that you might not be Beau's match. After all, no one will show mercy in this kind of battle. The loser might die on the Heavenly Mountain!"
Waverly said worriedly.
"Beau doesn't have the ability to kill me, but the Heavenly Sect seems pretty tough to deal with!"
Connor slowly turned to look at the Heavenly Mountain and sighed softly.
"Pretty tough?"
Waverly couldn't help but frown when she heard this. She didn't understand what Connor meant.
Connor had already used his divine sense on the plane. What surprised him was that there was not only Beau on the Heavenly Mountain, but there seemed to be an even more powerful existence. However, because that person had been concealing his aura, Connor could not be sure of that person's strength. In addition, he was not very familiar with the use of divine sense, so he did not know if he had sensed it wrongly.
Therefore, Connor did not tell Waverly about this.
"Young Sect Leader, I have already booked a room for you. Do you want to cultivate now?"
Waverly asked.
"Cultivate?"
When Connor heard Waverly's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he said indifferently," I just finished dealing with the Blood Moon Sect some time ago. After returning to Yarlford, I took a plane here in less than half a day. I didn't have any time to rest at all. I plan to get a good rest in the next three days. You should be tired, right? Let's go relax…"
"Relax?"
Waverly was speechless when she heard Connor's words. She said loudly, "Young Sect Leader, your battle with Beau is about to begin, yet you still have the mood to relax?"
"I've already told you earlier that Beau is nothing to me…"
Connor replied lightly, then continued to ask, "I heard that the hot springs here are quite good. Do you have any recommendations for a good place to soak in the hot springs?"
"You're actually planning to go to the hot springs?"
Waverly looked at Connor, not knowing what to say.
After more than an hour, Waverly reluctantly followed Connor to a very famous hot spring resort in Masonville. Then, under Connor's threat as the young sect leader, she accompanied Connor to soak in the hot spring.
Waverly's figure was pretty good, especially after she put on the swimsuit. Her perfect figure was exposed and attracted the attention of countless people. Some people even initiated conversation with Waverly.
However, these people were mercilessly scolded by Waverly and ran away.
After all, she was in a very bad mood.
However, Connor indeed had a relaxed expression, as if he did not take the battle three days later seriously at all.
...
The news of the Purple Cloud Sect's young sect leader challenging the Heavenly Sect's sect leader spread throughout the entire Sommervile in less than half a day.
The ancient martial arts practitioners all got very excited.
"What? The young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect has actually challenged Beau Collier?"
"I didn't expect Connor McDonald to be so bold. He even dares to challenge Mr. Zadra!"
"I think that he really doesn't know the immensity of heaven and earth. He's so arrogant just because his master is Jorge Yarrell!"
"Yeah. Even if he has some talent, he's definitely no match for Beau Collier!"
"Not necessarily. I heard that Draco Felton died in Connor McDonald's hands!"
"How do you know if Draco Felton died in Connor McDonald's hands or Mr. Yarrell's hands? We didn't even see it with our own eyes."
"But since Connor McDonald has the guts to issue a challenge to Beau Collier, it means that he has the confidence…"
"Last time, I didn't have the chance to watch the battle between Connor McDonald and Wadi Jimenez. This time, I must see it with my own eyes just how strong he is!"
"That's right. I heard that this battle will be on the Heavenly Mountain. I want to go and take a look!"
Similar discussions were taking place in various places in Sommervile. It was as if all the cultivators of Sommervile were very interested in this battle.
The four great sects working together was something that had lasted for many years. There had never been a contest between sects.
Therefore, many people were very interested in the battle between the Purple Cloud Sect and the Heavenly Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 2010: The Four Great Sects' Reaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 2010: The Four Great Sects' Reaction
With the gradual decline of the ancient martial arts of Sommervile, the number of martial artists had decreased.
This also led to the peaceful co-existence between the various sects. One would never see the sects fighting each other.
Connor's challenge to Beau had broken the peace that had been maintained for many years.
Right now, there was a split in the judgment of Connor's strength. Some people believed that Connor was only so arrogant because he was relying on Jorge, while some people believed that Connor really had the strength to challenge Beau.
But no matter what, there was incessant discussion regarding the upcoming challenge. Some people even came to Masonville to witness this battle with their own eyes.
For a time, the number of martial artists in Masonville soared. At the same time, it could also slightly boost the economic development of Masonville. Even the mayor of Masonville also provided many privileges for the arrival of these martial artists. There was even a residence specially provided for martial artists.
The last time something like this happened in Sommervile was during the battle between Connor and Wadi.
However, the impact this time might be even more terrifying. After all, the battle between Connor and Wadi was just a competition between the younger generation of ancient martial arts. This time was different. Connor was not only challenging as a junior, but it was also a competition between sects. This battle was very likely to affect the future of Sommervile's ancient martial arts. Therefore, it naturally received more attention.
...
Since most of the cultivators in Sommervile had already received the news, the other two great sects had naturally received the news as well.
Within the Snow Moon Sect.
A white-haired old man sat quietly on a chair and looked at the invitation letter in his hand.
This old man was the Snow Moon Sect's sect leader, Haiven Zurita.
The Snow Moon Sect's presence in Sommervile was not particularly strong, and the number of disciples in the Snow Moon Sect was not as many as the Purple Cloud Sect and the Heavenly Sect.
However, because the Snow Moon Sect seemed to have some relationship with the royal family from hundreds of years ago, this also led to the Snow Moon Sect's foundation being very terrifying. Even if the Snow Moon Sect had not appeared in front of cultivators for a long time, no one would look down on this sect.
Moreover, Haiven was also an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Just this alone was enough to support the entire sect.
A moment later, Haiven suddenly smiled and sighed, "I didn't expect that Beau would be reduced to such a state. A junior has actually issued a letter of challenge. How interesting!"
"Sect Leader, I heard that Jorge's disciple is quite strong. Draco Felton died in his hands!"
The person beside Haiven hurriedly replied.
"To be able to kill an ancient martial arts grandmaster at such a young age is indeed terrifying!"
Haiven put down the invitation letter in his hand and sighed softly.
"Then, do you still want to watch the battle?"
"Of course, I have to go…"
Haiven didn't even think before replying, "I'm afraid that this battle will affect the future of the ancient martial arts of Sommervile. If I don't go, I'm afraid that the cultivators of Sommervile will forget that the Snow Moon Sect is also one of the four great sects."
"They won't dare…"
Everyone hurriedly said.
"Alright, hurry up and get ready. I want to see just how capable this disciple of Jorge is. He's actually so arrogant that we are nothing to him!"
Haiven shouted expressionlessly.
Obviously, Haiven was in support of Beau.
After all, Connor represented the younger generation of martial artists, while Beau represented the elders who had lived in seclusion for many years.
Within the Profound Sect.
The Profound Sect was a very special existence among the four great sects. This was because the disciples of the Profound Sect were all women. There were no men in the entire sect.
Even though the entire Profound Sect was made up of women, the strength of the Profound Sect was extremely terrifying. The sect leader of the Profound Sect, Xandra Yates, was also an earth-rank ancient martial artist.
Xandra's identity was very mysterious. No one had even seen Xandra's true appearance. No matter where Xandra went, she would be covered with a white veil. This had left countless martial artists with endless fantasies.
However, Xandra was almost 50 years old. Compared to Beau and the others, she was much younger. However, for a woman, she was already past her prime.
However, Xandra was never married. This was also a rule of the Profound Sect. As long as they were disciples of the Profound Sect, they were not allowed to get married or fall in love. If they did, they would be locked in the dungeon and never see the light of day!
Xandra sat quietly on the chair and carefully looked at the invitation letter in his hand.
Even in front of the people from the Profound Sect, her face was still covered with a white veil. Although she was almost 50 years old, Xandra was an ancient martial arts grandmaster, so her figure and skin were no different from a 20-year-old girl. Her delicate face seemed to be the same as when she was young.
"Sect Leader, do you plan to watch this battle?"
At this moment, a guardian asked Xandra.
"Yes!"
Xandra nodded lightly and continued, "Back then, Mr. Yarrell was a benefactor to the Profound Sect. The Snow Moon Sect and the Heavenly Sect have many interactions. If I don't go, Connor won't have anyone to help him. Although I can't make a move, I can't let Mr. Yarrell's disciple be bullied either!"
No one refuted Xandra's words.
They all knew that Xandra and Jorge had a good personal relationship, so Xandra couldn't possibly not go.
"Since I'm able to meet Mr. Yarrell's disciple this time, go and prepare some gifts for me. We'll use it as a meeting gift I've prepared for this junior!"
Xandra spoke again.
"Yes, mam!"
Everyone hurriedly nodded, then turned around and walked out of the hall.
After everyone left, Xandra said softly, "Yolanda, come out!"
A moment later, a young woman in a long white dress slowly walked out. She was very beautiful, had a graceful figure, and had an elegant and noble temperament. This woman was Xandra's only disciple, Yolanda Yates.
He was also the future successor of the Profound Sect.
Yolanda walked up to Xandra and bowed slightly. She said gently, "Master, you called?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2011: The Eve of the Great Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 2011: The Eve of the Great Battle
"Yolanda, come with me to the Heavenly Mountain this time!"
Xandra said.
"Alright!"
Yolanda Yates nodded without hesitation.
"Do you know why I want you to come with?"
Xandra asked.
"No…"
Yolanda shook her head.
"If Connor can defeat Beau this time, then I will personally be the matchmaker and betroth you to Connor. If Connor dies in Beau's hands, then perhaps our Profound Sect 'fate has come to an end."
Xandra whispered.
Yolanda was shocked when she heard Xandra's words. She whispered, "Master, aren't we not allowed to marry?"
"..."
Xandra couldn't help but sigh when he heard this. Then, she said expressionlessly, "Those were the rules of the past. Furthermore, rules are set by humans. As the leader of the Profound Sect, I naturally have the right to change them!"
"However, many senior sisters have already been locked up in the dungeon because of this. If you change the sect rules now, they will definitely be unhappy…"
Yolanda quickly added.
"That's the least of my concerns now…"
Xandra shook his head and asked Yolanda, "Are you telling me that you're not willing to marry Connor?"
"I don't even know him. Of course, I'm not willing to marry him! However, if Master insists on me marrying this person, then I will do it!"
Yolanda whispered.
