"Oh, you. You've always been like this. It really makes my heart ache!"
Xandra couldn't help but laugh bitterly. Then, she said calmly, "Yolanda, I don't want you to be with Connor either. However, the current situation of the Profound Sect isn't that good. Although the guardians seem to be doing their part, that's because I'm still alive. If I were to pass away, it would be difficult for you to support the entire Profound Sect alone. The guardians will definitely try their best to divide the Profound Sect. I have to pave the way for you, so that you can safely take over my position…"
"Connor is the path Master chose, right?"
Yolanda asked softly.
"Yes, Connor is the path I chose. Connor is the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect. As long as Connor can kill Beau this time, the Purple Cloud Sect will be the biggest ancient martial arts sect in Sommervile. After you marry Connor, you will have Connor and the Purple Cloud Sect as your backing. Those guardians will naturally not dare to have any bad intentions!"
Xandra responded.
"..."
Yolanda looked at Xandra and hesitated for a couple of seconds before whispering, "Master, it's all my fault that I am weak. If I were stronger, you wouldn't have to worry so much!"
"Child, I don't blame you for this. After so many years, I've always put my energy into my cultivation, but I haven't been able to take a step forward and have neglected you. I am the one who has let you down!"
Xandra hurriedly said.
"Master, I'm willing to marry Connor!"
Yolanda said sensibly.
"There's no rush to say this. After all, the battle between Connor and Beau has yet to begin. If Connor can defeat Beau, it won't be too late to talk about what will happen next. I'm telling you today because I want you to be mentally prepared!"
Xandra whispered.
"I understand…"
Yolanda bit her lip and nodded.
...
At the same time, it wasn't just the Snow Moon Sect and the Profound Sect that reacted to the challenge. Many ancient martial arts sects in Sommervile had already received invitations. Even some ancient martial arts grandmasters who hadn't appeared for many years were attracted by this battle and came to Masonville.
In an instant, 80% of Sommervile's martial artists were gathered in Masonville, and even the weakest was a black rank.
Some of the weaker martial artists did not have the courage to come to Masonville at all.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
Finally, it was the day that Connor and Beau had agreed upon. The battle that everyone had been waiting for was about to begin.
At this time, the Heavenly Mountain was already filled with people. Countless black rank martial artists had already arrived at the Heavenly Mountain, waiting for the start of the battle. Some people even came to Heavenly Mountain a day early to get a better position. From this point, it could be seen how much the martial artists of Sommervile were looking forward to the battle.
In order to maintain order, the Heavenly Sect had all the disciples of the sect gather on the Heavenly Mountain.
These disciples were all wearing the same clothes and stood quietly on both sides of the mountain road leading to the Heavenly Mountain to ensure that nothing unexpected would happen.
At this moment, the martial artists who came to watch the battle finally realized why the Heavenly Sect could become one of the four great sects. Putting aside Beau's strength, just from the disciples of the Heavenly Sect, one could see how terrifying the strength of the Heavenly Sect was.
Any one of these disciples was a black rank, and their strength couldn't be underestimated.
If all these disciples were to attack, it would be a very terrifying combat power. It would even be enough to destroy a slightly weaker region.
Perhaps this was the legendary power that could rival an entire nation!
Everyone was secretly amazed by the strength of the Heavenly Sect as they walked up the mountain.
However, most of the martial artists could not reach the peak of the mountain. Only those who had received an invitation letter or the big shots from various places could go to the top of the mountain and watch the battle up close.
The ordinary cultivators stopped in their tracks after arriving at the designated viewing spot and began to wait for the battle to begin.
There weren't many martial artists in Sommervile, so almost all the slightly famous martial artists knew each other. This also led to many people chatting in groups of three to five. Of course, the content of their conversations was related to Connor and Beau.
"Mr. Wise, who do you think will win today's battle?"
At this moment, a bespectacled middle-aged martial artist who had specially rushed over asked the old man beside him.
"I think that Mr. Collier is stronger. Although I've heard a lot about Mr. McDonald's deeds, it's just a rumor. Some things are not true. Moreover, Mr. McDonald is still young. How could he have the power to defeat a grandmaster at such a young age? If he were ten years older, I might have chosen Mr. McDonald!"
The old man analyzed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2012: Gathering
chapters.content:
Chapter 2012: Gathering
"I also think that Mr. Collier will win. After all, Mr. Collier is an ancient martial arts grandmaster. Connor McDonald can't be an ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
"That's right, this Connor guy is really bold. He even dares to challenge Mr. Collier. Isn't he clearly courting death?"
The other supporters of Beau also chimed in.
"If Mr. McDonald doesn't have the ability to defeat Mr. Collier, why would he challenge Mr. Collier?"
At this moment, a martial artist from Porthampton suddenly asked.
"He's overestimating himself!"
"Isn't it normal for young people to be ignorant?"
Everyone retorted.
"From what I know, Mr. McDonald is not an arrogant person. So, I think that since he has the courage to challenge Mr. Collier, he must have the confidence to defeat Mr. Collier!"
The martial artists of Porthampton obviously supported Connor, so they shouted expressionlessly.
"Isn't Connor just relying on his master being Mr. Yarrell? Even if he loses, Mr. Collier won't kill him. Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to challenge him!"
"Yes, and Connor is a junior. Even if he loses, there's nothing to be ashamed of. But if he wins, it's a bloody profit. Why wouldn't he dare challenge Mr. Collier!"
Everyone retorted again.
Conversations similar to this were happening in every corner.
However, the number of people supporting Beau was obviously much higher than the number of people supporting Connor. After all, Beau had been famous for many years. Most martial artists were very familiar with Beau's strength, but they did not understand Connor's strength very well.
However, if these people knew that Connor was actually the Soul Eater, then everyone would probably choose to stand on Connor's side.
Just as everyone was discussing who would win this battle, a commotion suddenly came from the crowd not far away.
When everyone heard the commotion, they turned their heads.
A white-haired old man slowly walked over with two people.
"It's the Snow Moon Sect's sect leader, Haiven Zurita!"
Someone shouted excitedly upon recognizing Haiven.
"Sect Leader Zurita has actually come personally this time around…"
"Yeah. How long has it been since Sect Leader Zurita has shown himself? I didn't expect him to come…"
Everyone was very excited. They hurriedly went forward to greet Haiven.
Haiven nodded and then walked up to the peak.
Everyone looked at Haiven's back, their faces filled with respect and admiration. They were secretly thinking about when they could become an existence that everyone admired.
However, just as Haiven walked up the mountain, Xandra brought Yolanda over.
Xandra and Yolanda were dressed the same way. Their faces were covered with white veils, making people fantasize about their appearances.
Everyone took the initiative to greet Xandra when they saw her. However, Xandra was obviously much colder than Haiven. She did not even look at these people and walked straight up the mountain.
Although Xandra's actions were very rude, they knew in their hearts that Xandra had the capability to do that. Even if it was rude, they did not dare to say anything.
"I didn't expect that the sect leaders of the Snow Moon Sect and the Profound Sect would turn up. I wonder if Mr. Yarrell will come over?"
"Mr. Yarrell will probably come. After all, the main character of this battle is his disciple!"
"That's right, I heard that Mr. Yarrell treats Connor very well. He will definitely come!"
Everyone discussed in low voices.
Following that, there were many famous figures in the Sommervile ancient martial arts world. These people were naturally not as famous as Haiven and Xandra, so they were much friendlier.
The last to appear were the grand guardian and the third guardian of the Purple Cloud Sect.
When everyone realized that Jorge wasn't here, they were a little disappointed.
Although Jorge's status in the ancient martial arts world was about the same as Haiven, Beau, and Xandra, it was obvious that there were more martial artists who worshipped Jorge. This was because in the eyes of many people, Jorge was a legend, a faith in their hearts.
When Connor first got to know Jorge, he only thought of Jorge as a greedy old man. How would he have known that Jorge had such terrifying influence in the ancient martial arts world in Sommervile?
As the big shots of the ancient martial arts world of Sommervile arrived, everyone became excited. They knew that the real battle was about to begin.
However, Beau and Connor, the main characters of today's battle, had yet to appear.
"I didn't expect the influence of this battle to be so terrifying!"
"Yeah, if this Connor were to wait a few more years, I reckon that even Sect Leader Zadra and the others would have to give way."
"What a pity. Connor is still a little too young and impetuous!"
Everyone sighed softly.
On the peak of the mountain.
Haiven turned to look at Xandra, who was sitting beside him, and said with a smile, "I didn't expect that Sect Leader Yates would be interested in this kind of thing!"
"Since Sect Leader Zurita is here, I will naturally come as well…"
Xandra replied.
"Then, I wonder who Sect Leader Yates thinks will win today."
Haiven continued to ask.
"Connor McDonald, of course. He's Mr. Yarrell's disciple!"
Xandra was very upfront about her support for Connor.
"Haha…"
Haiven laughed out loud when he heard this. He then said indifferently, "I have the opposite opinion from Sect Leader Yates. I think that Beau will win…"
"I think it's more apt to say that you hope he will win. After all, if Beau loses, then the Snow Moon Sect might be in danger!"
Xandra spoke without mercy.
"Sect Leader Yates, what are you saying? Why is the matter between the Purple Cloud Sect and the Heavenly Sect related to me?"
Haiven didn't seem to be angry and just smiled awkwardly.
"Sect Leader Zurita, Sect Leader Yates, you two are here?"
However, at this moment, a voice sounded.
Everyone raised their heads when they heard the voice. Beau had already appeared on the peak.
When everyone saw Beau, they were extremely excited. They knew that since Beau had already arrived, Connor should be appearing soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 2013: The Protagonist Who's Late
chapters.content:
Chapter 2013: The Protagonist Who's Late
When Haiven saw Beau, he quickly stood up and walked over to him.
"Sect Leader Collier, we haven't seen each other for more than ten years, right?"
"Yes, it has been more than ten years…"
Beau nodded lightly.
Meanwhile, Xandra and Yolanda were sitting quietly on the spot, as if they had no intention of talking to Beau.
From this, it could be seen that there was some kind of grudge between Xandra and Beau.
"Beau, you're right. It's just a challenge from a junior. A child doesn't know any better, but why did you accept his challenge?"
Haiven laughed.
"This child isn't an ordinary junior. Previously, I had a lot of grudges with Connor. I did not make a move on him because of Mr. Yarrell. But I didn't expect him to become even more vicious and take the initiative to issue a challenge to me. I had no choice but to agree!"
Beau chuckled as he explained.
"Some juniors really should be taught a good lesson. Otherwise, they will never learn!"
Haiven looked at Beau and nodded.
"Exactly!"
Beau smiled and walked up to Xandra. He said softly, "I didn't expect Sect Leader Yates to actually show up for me!"
"I didn't come for you. I'm here today for Connor!"
Xandra said calmly.
"Hahaha, I see!"
Beau couldn't help but laugh when he heard Xandra's words. He didn't say anything else.
He knew Xandra's temper very well. If he provoked Xandra now, he would only make things worse for himself.
Beau sat quietly on the spot, waiting for Connor's arrival.
At the same time, Albert Collier brought everyone from the Collier family to the top of the mountain.
Aida Collier and Cielo Collier were among them.
At this moment, Aida's expression was very ugly. Although she knew that Connor did not issue a challenge to Beau just to save her, she did not expect Connor to be so reckless.
Even though Aida knew that Connor was terrifyingly strong, she did not believe that Connor would be able to defeat Beau.
If Connor lost to Beau, then Aida's life would be ruined, and she would never be able to escape the Collier family's shackles.
Apart from Aida, everyone else in the Collier family hoped that Beau would kill Connor with his own hands, especially Cielo.
Cielo had yet to fully recover. He still needed to sit in a wheelchair, but he was much better than before.
"Dad, can Grandpa really kill Connor today?"
Cielo whispered to Albert.
"Definitely!"
Albert nodded without hesitation.
Cielo became excited when he heard that. He gritted his teeth and said, "I've waited for so long, and this day has finally come. I must see Connor kneel and beg for mercy. I want to torture him to death!"
"Your grandfather said that after defeating Connor, he will hand Connor over to you. At that time, you can torture him however you want!"
Albert said in a low voice.
"That's great…"
Cielo became even more excited when he heard that.
The crowd might not know that Connor, who they had been anxiously waiting for, was actually eating breakfast quietly in a restaurant in Masonville.
Waverly Green, who was sitting opposite Connor, was speechless. After all, the time on the letter of challenge was 9 AM, but it was already past 8:30 AM, and Connor was still happily having breakfast as if he was not in a hurry at all!
"Have you heard? Mr. Collier of the Heavenly Sect is going to fight the young sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect!"
"How can I not know about such a big matter? The location of this big battle is on the Heavenly Mountain, not far from where we are. Unfortunately, there are too many people on the mountain. We won't be able to go up even if we go over now…"
"How is that important? I heard that this kind of battle between big shots can destroy the world with a single move. Who knows how many people will be injured by accident? Let's not go up and just wait for the result!"
"You're right. Also, it's too late to go over now. The battle is about to begin!"
At this moment, the two martial artists sitting next to Connor and Waverly began to discuss in a low voice.
Waverly became even more helpless when she heard the conversation between the two of them. She whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, when do you plan to leave? Now, even outsiders know that it's almost time for the battle, yet you're still wasting time having breakfast!"
"Let them wait. They have to wait for me for there to be a battle!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"The time of the battle is already written on the letter of challenge. Isn't it a little inappropriate if you aren't there on time?"
Waverly said helplessly.
"There's nothing wrong with that. I'm just kind enough to let Beau live a little longer!"
Connor continued to eat his breakfast.
"Young Sect Leader, please do this for my sake. Who knows how many people are waiting for you right now."
Waverly felt as if she was coaxing a child as she whispered to Connor.
In the past three days, Connor really did not spend any time on cultivation. He practically went around eating, drinking, and having fun. He did not prepare himself at all.
Waverly had no choice but to follow Connor's wishes and accompany him on sightseeing trips.
At this moment, Waverly felt that Connor had no intention of accepting the challenge. If that was really the case, then the purple Cloud Sect would probably become a joke to others.
"Alright, I'm full. We can set off now!"
But at this moment, Connor suddenly put down his chopsticks and whispered to Waverly.
"Really?"
Waverly was a little excited when she heard Connor's words.
"Of course!"
Connor nodded lightly and walked out of the restaurant.
On the other side, the martial artists on the Heavenly Mountain waited until nine o'clock.
However, they still didn't see Connor head up the mountain. They were starting to get anxious.
"What's going on with this Connor guy?"
"Yeah, how long have we been waiting here? Why isn't he here yet?"
"Is he just fooling around?"
"So he's making a fool out of everyone?"
Everyone started discussing in low voices.

chapters.title: Chapter 2014: The Battle Begins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2014: The Battle Begins!
At this moment, the expression of the Purple Cloud Sect's Grand Guardian was also very ugly.
People around him started to ask him what was going on with Connor.
However, the Grand Guardian was helpless. He did not know what was going on.
"Third Brother, go and call Waverly now and ask what's going on with Young Sect Leader!"
The grand guardian said to the third guardian anxiously.
"Alright!"
The third guardian hurriedly stood up to call Waverly.
"Mr. McDonald is here!"
"Mr. McDonald is finally here!"
At this moment, a burst of cheers suddenly came from below the mountain peak. The martial artists who had seen Connor in Porthampton began to shout excitedly one after another.
The grand guardian hurriedly looked down the mountain and realized that it was really Connor and Waverly who were slowly walking up the mountain.
"He's finally here!"
When the grand guardian saw this scene, he heaved a long sigh of relief. He had been worried that if Connor really did not come, how would he explain himself to these martial artists, Beau, and the others?
Beau looked at Connor. His expression was a little strange, and he immediately released his aura.
Buzz!
In an instant, Beau's aura charged straight at Connor.
Although the battle had not officially started, Beau was already planning to embarrass Connor.
He used all his aura on Connor, wanting to make it difficult for Connor to move at the foot of the mountain.
If it was a black rank, they wouldn't even be able to stand under Beau's aura, let alone walk.
After the grand guardian sensed Beau's aura, he couldn't help but break out in a cold sweat for Connor. If Connor couldn't even withstand this aura, then he would really become a joke. Beau deliberately wanted to embarrass Connor.
Xandra noticed Beau's actions and could not help but sneer, "As an elder, you're actually using such a trick to make things difficult for a junior. How laughable!"
"Beau just wants to teach Connor a lesson. There's nothing wrong with that!"
Haiven replied.
Xandra smiled disdainfully and did not continue speaking.
At this moment, Connor seemed to have sensed Beau's aura. However, he did not take Beau's little trick seriously at all. It was as if nothing had happened. He forcefully endured Beau's aura and walked up the mountain.
When Beau, Xandra, and Haiven saw this scene, they were stunned. They were in disbelief.
"This guy is actually so strong?"
Haiven exclaimed in shock when he saw Connor walking up despite Beau's aura enveloping him.
Even Beau's expression changed.
A few minutes later, Connor brought Waverly to the top of the mountain.
The battle between Connor and Beau was about to begin. Almost everyone was staring excitedly at the peak of the mountain.
Connor glanced at Beau indifferently. Beau was also sizing up Connor.
"Long time no see. Your strength has indeed improved a lot!"
Beau took the initiative to speak to Connor.
"My fiancée almost died in your hands, and I was framed by you and nearly died in the Crimson Peak. These grudges can finally be settled today!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"You beat my grandson into a cripple, so I want to settle that with you as well!"
Beau said in a low voice.
"Haha…"
Connor could not help but sneer. After which, he slowly turned to look at the people below the mountain peak. After which, he softly said, "Beau, not only am I going to kill you today, but I'm also going to erase all the glory you've painstakingly accumulated in your life. I'll make you the greatest disgrace of the ancient martial arts world of Sommervile!"
Haiven, Xandra, Yolanda, and the others were all stunned when they heard Connor's words. They were dumbstruck because they never thought that Connor would be so arrogant!
Connor had only arrived for less than a minute, but his words had already shocked everyone present.
No one could understand why Connor was so confident.
Aida looked at Connor with a very nervous expression. She could not even breathe properly.
"Then, I want to see if you have the ability today!"
Beau suddenly shouted and raised his right hand.
In an instant, an extremely terrifying aura filled the area within a radius of several kilometers.
Almost everyone could feel that the aura between heaven and earth had begun to change at this moment. It began to circulate wildly and then surged into Beau's body.
Beau stood in the middle of the auras. His clothes and white hair fluttered in the wind, and his expression was extremely ferocious.
"It's a formation!"
Xandra quickly shouted with a frown.
"That's right, it's a formation. Beau is using a formation to devour the spiritual Qi between heaven and earth!"
Haiven said.
"No wonder Beau chose this place for the final battle. It turns out that he had already set up a formation. How shameless!"
Xandra shouted.
"Sect leader Yates, there are no rules that forbid the use of formations, right?"
Haiven turned to look at Xandra.
"Is there a need to set rules for this kind of thing?"
Xandra was speechless.
"This is a personal grudge between Sect Leader Collier and Connor. It has nothing to do with the two of us. Let's just watch the show!"
Haiven laughed.
Xandra was furious, but she couldn't find any words to refute Haiven, so she could only stop arguing with him.
On the other side.
Connor looked at Beau expressionlessly and said in disdain, "Do you think you can defeat me with a formation? What a joke…"
After saying that, Connor's figure flashed, and he charged straight toward Beau.
This time, Connor did not make any preparations at all. He wanted to use the simplest and most direct way to end this battle!
The long-awaited battle finally began!
The aura between heaven and earth roared non-stop, the wind and clouds stirred, and lightning flashed!
It was as if no one present had expected the battle between Connor and Beau to start so suddenly. The atmosphere instantly reached its climax.

chapters.title: Chapter 2015: Creating a Miracle!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2015: Creating a Miracle!
After all, there were too many grudges between Beau and Connor.
Moreover, both sides knew each other very well, so no more words were needed.
Both of them had the determination to kill each other before starting this battle.
Haiven and Xandra both supported different sides. Haiven naturally supported Beau, while Xandra supported Connor.
However, there were rules for the duel between ancient martial artists. Once a challenge was issued, it would be determined by their own abilities. No one could interfere.
Therefore, Haiven and Xandra could only argue with each other. They had no right to interfere in this battle.
Beau used his strongest move as soon as he made his move, crazily devouring the aura between heaven and earth. Although in the eyes of ordinary martial artists, this was the first time Beau and Connor were fighting, Beau must have tested Connor's strength when he went up the mountain.
Connor was actually able to walk up the mountain with Beau's aura. This was enough to prove that Connor's strength was extremely terrifying. This was also the reason why Beau used his strongest move from the beginning.
On the other hand, Connor did not seem as charged up. Although Connor had also made a move, he had done it way too casually.
The grand guardian, Waverly, and the others also had nervous expressions on their faces. They could not help but sigh, thinking that Connor might have underestimated the enemy!
In a split second, Connor had already arrived in front of Beau as he said coldly, "This punch is for my fiancée, Freya Phillips!"
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist burst out with a blinding light as it smashed into Beau's body.
When everyone saw Connor's punch, without exception, all of them revealed an incredulous expression.
Because Connor's punch was way too fast, even Beau himself could not react in time.
When the fist collided with Beau's body, an incomparably terrifying energy shockwave rippled across the Heavenly Mountain. Almost everyone present could clearly feel how powerful this power was.
When Haiven and Xandra saw Connor's punch, they both stood up and stared at Connor.
"How... How is this possible?"
Haiven and Xandra exclaimed at the same time. They were utterly shocked.
The two of them were genuine earth-rank ancient martial art grandmasters, but the astonishing power that Connor's punch had just unleashed was something that neither of them could do. From this point, it could be seen that Connor's strength was above the two of them.
However, if Connor's strength was really above the two, then wouldn't that mean that Connor was a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?
"Impossible. Connor is so young. He can't be a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
Haiven seemed to have gone mad as he shouted.
It was as if he could not accept the goal that he had painstakingly pursued his entire life. Connor could actually achieve it so easily, and at such an age!
"..."
Xandra's beautiful eyes flashed with a strange light. She stared at Connor. It was unknown what she was thinking.
Beau was very shocked. After all, the others had only analyzed how terrifying Connor's strength was through his aura and everything he had seen. Beau could feel it clearly.
The power of Connor's punch was something that he could not describe with words. If he had not set up the formation in advance and relied on the power of the formation to barely block this punch, he would have been sent flying by Connor's punch.
'Why is he so strong?'
This was the only thought in Beau's mind.
At this moment, Beau was using the power of the array formation to continuously absorb the spiritual Qi of heaven and earth, transforming it into aura to protect his body. Meanwhile, Connor's fist ruthlessly smashed into the aura around Beau's body.
However, in the eyes of most people, Connor's punch had landed on Beau's body.
Actually, Connor's fist was still a breath away from Beau's body.
Now, it all depended on whether Connor could break through this aura. If he did, Beau would be at a disadvantage.
At this moment, it was as if time had stopped.
Beau did not expect Connor's strength to be so terrifying. The expression on his face began to turn ferocious as he began to crazily circulate the array formation to devour the spiritual Qi of heaven and earth.
Meanwhile, Connor's power was also gathering on his fist, trying to break through the protective aura around Beau's body.
"No... This is absolutely impossible!"
The other martial artists with slightly lower realms might not be able to see the current situation clearly, nor could they sense the extent of the battle between Connor and Beau.
But Haiven knew that Connor's strength had already far exceeded his imagination.
"Beau is going to lose today!"
Xandra knew as well.
Xandra's words shocked Haiven again.
He realized that he wasn't the only one who had such thoughts. Xandra could also tell that Beau was going to lose to Connor today.
"Break!"
Sure enough, at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted.
In an instant, the aura surrounding Beau's body was shattered by Connor's fist, which then smashed into Beau's body.
"Pfft!"
A scene that almost no one had expected happened.
Beau spat out a mouthful of blood from Connor's punch, and his body flew backward.
In the eyes of those ordinary martial artists, Connor and Beau had only exchanged blows once. The battle had only started for less than five minutes, and Beau had actually been beaten up by Connor with a single punch, causing him to vomit blood.
If these people hadn't seen it with their own eyes, who would believe that it was true!
Almost all the members of the Collier family widened their eyes, and they were in disbelief.
Aida was the only one with a different reaction, because at this moment, she seemed to see hope in Connor again.
Aida couldn't help but recall all the things she had experienced with Connor. It was only then that she suddenly remembered that this man had never disappointed her.
'I hope you can create a miracle today!'
Aida prayed in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 2016: Under His Feet
chapters.content:
Chapter 2016: Under His Feet
The guardians of the Heavenly Sect also stood up; shock written on their faces.
No one had expected such an outcome.
"How... How was this possible? The sect leader vomited blood from just one punch?"
A guardian of the Heavenly Sect shouted in disbelief.
"What is going on?"
It was as if no one could accept that the strongest expert of the Heavenly Sect would be in such a state. After all, before the battle began, they had all been determined to win.
At this moment, Connor's punch shattered everyone's fantasies. They might not even be able to accept Beau's loss, so how could they accept Beau losing in such a manner?
Those martial artists who had been supporting Beau seemed to have sunk into a deep shock. For a moment, they did not know how to describe their feelings.
In stark contrast to these people, the Purple Cloud Sect and those martial artists who supported Connor looked very excited. Some of them even began to shout.
Haiven took two steps back in a daze and sat down on the chair. He looked extremely devastated.
Although the battle was not over yet, Haiven could already see the result.
"..."
Xandra naturally knew the result, and she was surprised and happy.
Yolanda Yates stared at Connor with her big, watery eyes. Her beautiful eyes were filled with shock.
After spitting out a mouthful of blood, Beau was sent flying.
Connor didn't give Beau any chance to react. His figure flashed, and he appeared in front of Beau.
Beau had yet to adjust his body, and his entire body was gliding in the air. Connor's sudden appearance made Beau a little frightened.
"This punch is for me!"
Connor bellowed in rage, and then, from the top, he threw another punch at Beau's body.
Beau, who was still in mid-air, was smashed into the ground by Connor's punch. A huge pit appeared where Beau landed.
Beau, who was in the deep pit, was in great pain. He seemed to be struggling to stand up, but Connor's punch had broken all his meridians. He could not move at all!
'This is impossible… This is absolutely impossible!'
Beau screamed in his heart, as if he could not accept this outcome.
However, his body was telling him that he had already lost!
Moreover, it was an utter and complete loss.
Facing Beau's formation, Connor ended the battle with just two punches.
If Beau had not set up an array in advance, he would have probably not even been able to withstand Connor's punch!
At this moment, Connor slowly landed on the ground and looked at Beau expressionlessly. The calmness on his face was terrifying.
"What's going on?"
"That's right. Sect Leader Collier won't lose just like that, right?"
"How is that possible? Even if he were to lose, he wouldn't lose so quickly, right?"
"Sect Leader Collier hasn't lost!"
The martial artists who supported Beau could not believe that Beau would lose to Connor so quickly, so they shouted out loud.
Everyone from the Heavenly Sect and the Collier family looked at Haiven as if they were asking for his opinion.
"It's over!"
Haiven said to the crowd solemnly.
After hesitating for a couple of seconds, Xandra slowly sat down on the chair. She was so shocked that she could not calm down for a long time.
For a moment, everyone present fell silent, staring in the direction of the mountain peak.
The Collier family members were also dumbfounded.
No one had expected that the battle that they had been anticipating for so long would end so quickly!
"Young Sect Leader actually defeated Beau?"
"Isn't this way too unbelievable?"
The grand guardian of the Purple Cloud Sect, Waverly Green, and the other guardians looked at each other as if they did not understand what was going on.
Thud. Thud.
At this moment, footsteps sounded.
Connor was walking toward Beau.
For a moment, the crowd fell silent once more as they looked at Beau, who was lying on the ground.
Some of them seemed to be waiting for Beau to stand up and continue fighting Connor.
Cielo's face was filled with endless anger and confusion. He really couldn't understand how Connor's strength had become so terrifying in just a few months. After all, Connor was almost killed by Saif Song back then.
At that time, Connor had been struggling against a martial artist of Saif's level. However, in the blink of an eye, a few months had passed, and Connor had actually defeated an ancient martial arts grandmaster like Beau with two punches. Cielo was in disbelief.
He even suspected that the person in front of him was not Connor.
Aida's beautiful eyes were fixed on Connor. She knew that Connor did not disappoint her this time.
Her choice was the right one!
"Sect Leader, stand up!"
"Sect Leader Collier, quickly stand up!"
"You can't lose like this!"
Everyone from the Heavenly Sect shouted at Beau.
After all, this battle was not only related to Beau's life and death, but also the life and death of the Heavenly Sect. If Beau really lost like this, then the Heavenly Sect would probably never be able to raise their heads in Sommervile.
When Beau heard what the crowd said, he became a little angry. He gritted his teeth, wanting to move his body. However, all he could do was lift his arm.
"Sect Leader!"
When everyone saw that Beau had moved, they hurriedly continued to shout.
Bang!
But at this moment, Connor suddenly lifted his leg and stomped on Beau's face, instantly causing everyone to fall silent.
Connor had utterly humiliated Beau with that foot of his.
The sect leader of the Heavenly Sect, the head of the York Collier family, was actually trampled under the feet of a young man!
Such a scene was shocking, but it was more of a helpless one.
The Collier family was angry, but they did not dare to say anything because they knew that if they angered Connor, he would very likely kill them.

chapters.title: Chapter 2017: Making an Enemy out of the Martial Artists of Sommervile
chapters.content:
Chapter 2017: Making an Enemy out of the Martial Artists of Sommervile
"It's over, it's over. If the sect leader loses, there's no more hope for us!"
A guardian from the Heavenly Sect sighed with a trembling voice. Then, he closed his eyes and fainted.
Connor stepped on Beau's face with his right foot, his expression somewhat disdainful. He asked Beau softly, "Have you ever thought that you would have this day?"
"..."
Beau looked at Connor with an extremely angry gaze. He could not help but think of what Connor had said earlier!
"Not only will I kill you today, but I will also erase all the glory that you have painstakingly accumulated in your life. I will make you the greatest disgrace of the Sommervile!"
Connor's two punches were enough to pin Beau on the pillar of shame of the ancient martial arts world. And just as Connor had said, this battle would completely wipe out all the glory of Beau's life, because there was no other situation that could be more embarrassing than Beau's current situation.
Facing a junior's challenge, it was one thing to set up a formation in advance and cheat, but he was actually pummeled into such a state by the other party. Even if Beau could survive today, he would probably be too ashamed to face others in the future.
"Is there anything else you want to say?"
Connor continued to ask seeing that Beau was silent.
"Connor, how did you become so strong? Even your master isn't as strong as you. How did you do it?"
Beau finally spoke.
"All of this is thanks to you!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Thanks to me?"
When Beau heard Connor's words, he was a little puzzled, as if he did not understand what Connor meant.
"You don't have much time left. If you have anything to say, hurry up and say it!"
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to explain this to Beau, so he replied coldly.
"I admit defeat!"
Beau suddenly shouted at the top of his lungs.
When everyone heard this, they were all stunned.
They had not expected Beau to admit defeat!
Although everyone knew that Beau had lost, if Beau admitted defeat himself, it would be a different story. This meant that Beau had already given up his last bit of dignity and chose to surrender.
Under normal circumstances, no one would admit defeat in such a battle. This was because most martial artists felt that even if they admitted defeat and survived, they would become a laughing stock in the eyes of others. It was better to die with dignity.
The way everyone looked at Connor had changed drastically. They knew that after this battle, Connor's name would resound throughout the entire country.
In the future, when discussing Connor, they would no longer use the words 'Jorge Yarrell's disciple' or 'Sommervile ancient martial arts genius' to describe Connor.
They knew that since Connor was able to defeat Beau so easily, the other grandmasters of Sommervile would not be a match for him.
After all, just like Beau said, Jorge would never be able to defeat him in such a way.
Therefore, many people felt that Connor had already surpassed his master, Jorge!
"I'm afraid that the ancient martial arts world is going to change in Sommervile!"
At this moment, an old man could not help but look up at the sky and sigh.
"You admit defeat?"
Connor couldn't help but smile after hearing Beau's words. He then said softly, "You don't think I'll let you go just because you admit defeat, do you?"
"It's not up to you to decide whether you'd let me go or not. According to the rules of Sommervile ancient martial arts, if one party admits defeat, you can't attack anymore!"
Beau hurriedly shouted.
"That's right. The Sommervile ancient martial arts has its own rules. Since my father has already admitted defeat, you should let him go!"
Albert Collier also hurriedly shouted.
After all, Beau losing to Connor was much better than Beau dying in Connor's hands. If Beau really died, then the Collier family and the Heavenly Sect would probably be in chaos.
"I don't care about your bullsh*t rules. I'm going to kill you today!"
Connor shouted expressionlessly.
When everyone heard this, they were all stunned. They were also very shocked. It was as if no one had expected Connor to be so domineering. He didn't even care about the rules of the Sommervile ancient martial arts.
If Connor really broke the rules and killed Beau, it would be equivalent to making an enemy out of the entire Sommervile ancient martial arts!
"Why you…"
Albert did not expect Connor to say that. He hurriedly turned his head to look at Haiven, seeking his help.
"Mr. McDonald, I'm afraid that what you're doing is a little inappropriate. After all, Sect Leader Collier has already admitted defeat. If you continue to attack, not only will you violate the rules set by the Sommervile ancient martial arts seniors many years ago, but you will also be looking down on us!"
Haiven had a close relationship with Beau, so he naturally didn't want to watch Connor kill Beau, so he hurriedly stood up and shouted.
Connor turned and looked at Haiven indifferently, then said expressionlessly, "Who do you think you are? It's not your turn to speak here!"
"Why you…"
Haiven was stunned. He was also very shocked because he did not expect Connor to not put him in his eyes at all.
"If you keep talking nonsense, I'll kill you first, then kill him!"
At this moment, Connor continued.
Haiven stood rooted to the ground in a daze, he was in an awkward position. However, he didn't dare to continue speaking. This was because Haiven's strength was about the same as Beau's. If Connor could defeat Beau so easily, then he could easily kill him.
Moreover, Haiven could feel that Connor was very serious when he said that.
He felt that if he said another word, he would die tragically in Connor's hands.
Xandra glanced at Haiven and said softly, "You're just asking to be humiliated. How could Jorge's disciple be threatened by you!"
"This Connor is exactly the same as Jorge. He doesn't care about rules at all!"
Haiven gritted his teeth.
"That's because they are both capable people!"
Xandra said slowly.
"Is this how the Purple Cloud Sect does things? You can ignore the rules just because you're strong?"
"That's right. Isn't the Purple Cloud Sect too unreasonable? Sect Master Collier has already admitted defeat. What else do you want to do?"
"If this person kills Sect Master Collier today, he will be making an enemy out of all of Sommervile's martial artists!"
At this moment, the martial artists who had been supporting Beau stood up and shouted at Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2018: The Old Sect Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 2018: The Old Sect Leader
Hearing everyone's words, the grand guardian was in an awkward position.
He instinctively wanted to open his mouth to persuade Connor, but after hesitating for a moment, he chose to remain silent.
Because he knew in his heart that even if he persuaded Connor now, it would be useless.
Connor slowly turned to look at those who spoke, then said expressionlessly, "No matter who stops me today, I will kill them. If you are not happy, then come out now. I will make you die with Beau!"
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
No one expected Connor to say such words. It was obvious that he planned to get rid of everyone who was against him.
The people who had shouted the loudest immediately shut their mouths and looked at Connor with trepidation, not daring to speak.
Seeing that everyone was silent, Connor slowly turned to look at Beau, who was lying on the ground.
"Connor, you… you can't kill me…"
It was obvious that Beau was panicking as he stammered.
"I can't kill you?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "There is no one in this world that I cannot kill!"
After saying that, Connor raised his fist and smashed it toward Beau's chest.
For a moment, everyone in the Collier family, except for Aida, showed a look of despair.
They really wanted to rush up and stop Connor, but they didn't have the courage. They knew that if they rushed up, they would be courting death.
Beau stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. His expression was one of disbelief. He had never thought that he would really die in Connor's hands.
Bang!
However, just as Connor's fist was about to land on Beau's body, a hand suddenly stretched out and helped Beau block the fist.
Connor raised his head to take a look and realized that the person standing in front of him was a white-haired old man.
The old man was wearing a white robe, and he didn't look young.
But what surprised Connor the most was that this old man could actually block his punch with one hand.
Connor had used all his strength in that punch just now.
An ordinary earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster would not be able to block his punch so easily.
"Who are you?"
Connor raised his head and asked the old man expressionlessly.
"Didn't your master teach you the rules of the Sommervile ancient martial arts?"
The old man said slowly.
Everyone raised their heads to look at the old man. Some of the martial artists had very puzzled expressions on their faces, as if they did not know this old man. However, many people had shocked expressions on their faces.
Especially Haiven and Xandra.
"Why is he still alive?"
Haiven stuttered.
"Isn't he already dead? What is going on?"
Xandra quickly added.
It was obvious that Haiven and Xandra both knew this old man. From their reactions, it could be seen that this old man had disappeared for a long time.
"Great-grandfather…"
At this moment, Aida said with a shocked expression.
When the other members of the Collier family saw this old man, they were also shocked. It was obvious that they did not expect this old man to appear.
"Old Sect Leader!"
"Thank heavens! The Heavenly Sect is saved. The old sect leader has actually returned…"
"The old sect leader is actually not dead. The old sect leader is still alive!"
"That's great!"
For a moment, everyone from the Heavenly Sect became excited and shouted.
"Old sect leader? Great-grandfather?"
When Connor heard what everyone said, a strange look flashed across his face.
"Father, you've come out of seclusion!"
Beau said in a low voice.
"Useless thing. If I didn't, the family business that our ancestors painstakingly left behind would be ruined by you. You can't even defeat a little kid."
The old man frowned and berated Beau.
Beau was a little helpless when he heard the old man's words, but he did not refute him.
"Are you Beau Collier's father?"
Connor learned the identity of the old man through their conversation.
"That's right. I'm the previous sect leader of the Heavenly Sect, and also the father of the trash you just defeated, Walter Collier!"
The old man didn't hide anything from Connor and admitted his identity.
"What? This person is actually Walter Collier?"
"How is that possible? I heard that he is already dead."
"Yeah, it's said that Walter Collier passed away more than 20 years ago. Why is he still alive?"
When everyone found out Walter's identity, they instantly exploded with disbelief.
"It's actually the previous sect leader of the Heavenly Sect!"
The grand guardian could not help but take a deep breath.
Walter was Beau's father and the previous sect leader of the Heavenly Sect. However, it was said that Walter had passed away more than twenty years ago, and Beau had taken over his position.
However, Walter was still alive. He had been in seclusion in the Heavenly Sect for many years. The reason why he told the public that he was dead was to prevent anyone from disturbing him while he was in seclusion.
There were not many people who knew about this. Albert was one of them, Beau was another, and the rest, whether it was the people of the Heavenly Sect or the Collier family, did not know about this.
"Walter was already at the peak of the earth realm twenty years ago. He has been in seclusion for so many years and now he has suddenly appeared. Has he already broken through to the heaven realm?"
Xandra suddenly said.
"Hahaha…"
Haiven looked at Xandra and laughed. Then, he said lightly, "Today's battle is really interesting. I didn't expect that an old senior like Mr. Collier Sr. to show himself..."
"So what if Mr. Collier Sr. is here? Don't forget, this is a battle between Connor and Beau. If Mr. Collier Sr. were to make a move, it would be against the rules!"
Xandra replied.
"Sect Leader Yates, now you remember the word 'rules'? First of all, the person who broke the rules wasn't the Heavenly Sect, but Connor himself!"
Haiven retorted.
When Xandra heard Haiven's words, she was stunned, and she frowned in response.
Because she had forgotten that Connor had broken the rules first!
If Walter really interfered in this matter, it was because Connor broke the rules first, and Walter showed up because of that.

chapters.title: Chapter 2019: A Change in Things
chapters.content:
Chapter 2019: A Change in Things
"What should we do?"
At this moment, the expression of the grand guardian of the Purple Cloud Sect was also very ugly.
He had thought that this matter would end here.
However, he didn't expect that the Heavenly Sect would bring out a big shot like Walter.
The current situation had already undergone a huge reversal. Connor, who had already won, instantly fell into danger.
Moreover, what worried the grand guardian the most was that Connor would surely not make any concessions even though he knew Walter's identity.
Aida's expression was also very ugly. After all, she had heard a lot about her great-grandfather. However, she did not expect Walter to still be alive.
"Brat, you fought with my son today. My son is not your match. The Heavenly Sect has lost wholeheartedly. However, he clearly admitted defeat just now, but you still want to kill him."
At this moment, Walter suddenly said.
Connor glanced at Walter indifferently and did not say anything.
"You're a junior. As your elder, it's not appropriate for me to attack you. If word gets out, people will say that I'm bullying the young!"
Walter paused for a moment before continuing, "Why don't we do this? The Heavenly Sect will admit defeat, but it's still wrong for you to deliberately humiliate the Heavenly Sect. Apologize to the Heavenly Sect in front of everyone, and I will let this matter go."
The grand guardian of the Purple Cloud Sect was a little happy when he heard Walter's words because things did not develop in the direction he had imagined. Walter had taken into account the relationship between the Heavenly Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect, as well as his own face, so he did not choose to attack Connor. Instead, he proposed a solution that sounded acceptable to everyone.
Everyone looked at Walter and could not help but sigh deep down. Walter's magnanimity was very impressive. After all, if it were anyone else, they would have already made a move on Connor.
Walter had taken the initiative to propose a way of reconciliation, which was considered giving the Purple Cloud Sect enough face.
"I've already said that no matter who stops me today, I'll kill them. You'd better get out of the way, or I'll kill you too!"
But at this moment, Connor's words instantly broke the silence.
No one had expected that Connor would still be so arrogant even at this moment. He did not even put Walter in his eyes.
Xandra couldn't sit still after hearing Connor's words. She hurriedly stood up and shouted, "Mr. McDonald, the conditions that Mr. Collier Sr. gave you just now are very reasonable. If you continue to cause trouble like this, it will not benefit anyone!"
"That's right, Young Sect Leader, let's do as Mr. Collier Sr. says. We're indeed in the wrong in this matter!"
The grand guardian also mustered up his courage to persuade Connor.
"Connor, my great-grandfather is terrifyingly strong. You're no match for my great-grandfather at all."
Aida also hurriedly shouted.
However, Connor did not seem to hear what the three of them said. He said to Walter expressionlessly, "Move aside!"
Walter looked at Connor indifferently and said softly to Connor, "Do you know that even if your master were standing in front of me, he wouldn't dare to speak to me in such a tone!"
"My master is my master, and I am me. I have nothing against you, so I don't want to kill you."
Connor said expressionlessly.
"Alright, I was going to let you live, but I didn't expect you to be so stubborn. Then, I'll teach you a lesson on behalf of your master today. I'll let you know what seniority is and what the rules of the ancient martial arts world are!"
Walter finally couldn't take it anymore when faced with Connor's continuous provocations. He roared in a low voice.
When Xandra heard this, she frowned. She knew that Connor had gone too far. The situation was out of control.
"Today is indeed the day when the ancient martial arts of Sommervile will change. However, I don't know if the Purple Cloud Sect or the Heavenly Sect will be the one left standing!"
Haiven sighed expressionlessly.
Xandra turned to look at Haiven but didn't say anything. At this moment, she wasn't in the mood to argue with Haiven.
However, the martial artists below the mountain peak were excited. After all, they were all here to watch the show. Of course, those who watched the show would not mind if things went out of hand. Moreover, many of these people had heard of the legend of Walter, but they had never seen Walter fight.
The battle between Connor and Beau was boring and did not meet everyone's expectations.
Therefore, when they found out that Walter was planning to take action, they were naturally very excited.
"I wonder if Walter is a match for Mr. McDonald?"
"Big brother, are you crazy? What level was Walter Collier? Even Jorge was no match for him, let alone Connor!"
"That's true. I heard that Walter was already at the peak of the earth rank a few decades ago. After so many years, he must be even stronger now!"
Everyone looked at Connor and Walter and discussed softly.
Walter didn't waste his breath and walked up to Connor. He said softly to Connor, "I didn't plan to attack you today, but you asked for it!"
Connor glanced at Walter indifferently and did not say anything.
"Rise!"
Walter waved his right hand lightly, and an extremely powerful aura burst forth.
When Xandra and Haiven sensed Walter's terrifying aura, they were stunned.
Both of them could feel that Walter's aura was so terrifying that it was not something an earth-rank ancient martial artist could possess!
"It seems that Mr. Collier Sr. has really broken through to the heaven realm!"
Haiven's voice trembled as he sighed.
"I didn't expect that there would really be someone in this world who could break through to the heaven realm. How unbelievable!"
Xandra had been stuck at the earth realm for decades. If she hadn't seen it with her own eyes, she wouldn't have believed that there was a heaven realm ancient martial artist in this world.
This was also the reason why Walter did not plan to attack Connor earlier.
He did not want to expose his strength. However, Connor was really too arrogant. Even with Walter's temperament, he could not tolerate it anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 2020: Ancient Martial Arts Genius
chapters.content:
Chapter 2020: Ancient Martial Arts Genius
Rumble!
At this moment, a loud noise suddenly sounded out of thin air.
Everyone looked up and saw a terrifying aura gathering between heaven and earth, finally forming a tornado.
At this moment, the tornado was still moving non-stop. In the end, it actually condensed in Walter's palm.
When everyone saw this scene, they all revealed shocked expressions because they could not understand how Walter did it!
"This might be the power of a heaven rank ancient martial artist!"
Haiven looked at Walter and sighed with envy.
Connor stood in front of Walter with a calm expression.
"Young Sect Leader is in danger…"
The grand guardian said solemnly.
"Go!"
At this moment, Walter suddenly swung his hand.
The tornado rushed toward Connor with a destructive aura.
At this moment, even the martial artists below the mountain peak could clearly feel how terrifying the energy contained in this tornado was. If it was not Connor standing in front of Walter, but them, they would probably have been scared silly.
After all, Walter's strength had indeed surpassed the understanding of these martial artists.
In their eyes, Walter was like a God.
Walter was very calm when he used the heaven and earth spiritual energy. Connor even felt that Walter's control over the heaven and earth spiritual energy seemed to be more skillful than his.
If Connor hadn't devoured the cult master's soul power, then he definitely wouldn't be Walter's match. However, Connor was now a heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, which was why he was so arrogant when facing Walter.
"Connor, you're dead!"
Cielo Collier shouted in a crazed manner.
Connor smiled faintly and then said expressionlessly, "If you rely on this little trick, I'm afraid it's impossible for you to kill me!"
After saying that, Connor waved his hand.
A golden aura rushed toward the tornado, and the two instantly collided.
When the two collided, a thunderous sound was emitted. The surrounding flowers and trees seemed to be unable to withstand the terrifying energy and instantly turned into ashes. All the martial artists present could clearly feel the terrifying energy impact. Some who were slightly lower in realm were sent flying by this powerful energy.
This time, everyone saw the shocking battle they wanted to see.
Connor's aura intertwined with Walter's tornado, as if they were engaging in an extremely intense collision.
Haiven and Xandra stood up almost at the same time, looking at Connor in disbelief.
This was because the two of them could feel from the aura that Connor had just released that he was also a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster.
"Is Connor also a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
Haiven asked in disbelief.
"How is that possible? How old is Connor? How can he be a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
Xandra hurriedly replied.
If Walter was a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, Xandra wouldn't doubt it. After all, Walter was already very old, and he was already at the peak of the earth rank twenty years ago. It was very likely that he had broken through to the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster after twenty years of seclusion.
But if Connor was also a heaven-rank ancient martial artist, Xandra couldn't accept this fact.
After all, ancient martial arts cultivation was a process that would accumulate over time. It was already unbelievable that Connor could become an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster at such a young age. If Connor was really a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, then it would be too terrifying.
No matter what, Xandra did not believe that such a genius existed in this world.
"Master, but his strength doesn't seem to be weaker than that person's!"
Yolanda Yates suddenly said.
Xandra only reacted when he heard Yolanda's words. She quickly looked up at the situation on the battlefield.
Connor's aura and Walter's tornado had already completely canceled each other out, so the first time the two of them exchanged hands, they were actually in a state of equal strength.
This was something that no one had expected. Connor was actually able to achieve a tie with Walter.
Xandra finally lost her composure. She looked at Connor and didn't know how to describe her feelings.
Since the exchange just now was a draw, it was enough to show that Connor's strength was not weaker than Walter's!
"Is Connor really a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
Xandra could not help but sigh softly.
"Although the two of them were even just now, Mr. Collier Sr. used the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, while Connor used the aura in his body. Therefore, I think Connor has the upper hand in this battle!"
Haiven suddenly said.
"..."
Xandra seemed to have realized this as well. She looked at Connor with even more shock.
One had to know that under normal circumstances, a martial artist's aura could not be comparable to the heaven and earth spiritual energy unless the aura in the martial artist's body had already reached a certain level. Only then could it be comparable to the heaven and earth spiritual energy.
If it was really like what Haiven said, then Connor's strength was probably even more terrifying than Walter's.
At this moment, Walter was very shocked. He asked Connor in a low voice, "Kid, who are you?"
"Who am I?"
When Connor heard Walter's words, he smiled faintly and said softly, "Don't you know what kind of person I am?"
"How can you be at such a terrifying realm at such a young age?"
Walter had lived in this world for nearly a hundred years. In the hundred years, he had seen countless amazing ancient martial arts geniuses. Moreover, he felt that he was quite talented.
However, if those so-called geniuses were compared to Connor, it was simply a world of difference.
Walter was merely testing Connor's strength in the previous exchange.
However, he had never imagined that Connor's strength would be so terrifying. He could even be on par with him. Walter felt that this was way too unbelievable. Even the top geniuses of the ancient martial arts of Sommervile could not have such a terrifying realm at such a young age.
Therefore, Walter could not help but suspect that Connor was a resurrected ancient martial arts expert from a hundred years ago.
This was also the reason why he asked that question just now.

chapters.title: Chapter 2021: A Pinnacle Existence
chapters.content:
Chapter 2021: A Pinnacle Existence
Walter knew that in ancient times, martial artists were able to control the power of the soul.
Furthermore, some especially powerful martial artists could even make their souls immortal and use other people's bodies to revive themselves, just like the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader that Connor killed back then.
Although Walter had never seen someone who could really live forever, after he advanced to the heaven rank, he felt that such a situation definitely existed.
If Connor was really resurrected by some expert, then everything could be explained clearly.
"Why do I have such strength? Do I need to explain to you?"
Connor replied with disdain.
Walter took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, "I don't care who you are. I have to kill you today. Otherwise, Sommervile ancient martial arts will be in chaos!"
After saying that, everyone could feel that Walter's aura seemed to have become even more terrifying.
"The old sect leader is finally serious…"
When the people of the Heavenly Sect felt Walter's aura become stronger, they became excited.
"Connor will definitely die today!"
"That's right. Let's make this Connor pay the price. Let's see who dares to bully the Heavenly Sect in the future!"
At this moment, these people did not realize how terrifying Connor's strength was. In their eyes, since a big shot like Walter had already personally made a move, Connor had no chance of winning at all.
Haiven was extremely solemn, because he knew very well that even if Walter personally made a move, it wouldn't be so easy to defeat Connor.
Rumble…
At this moment, another loud sound came from the sky.
When everyone heard the sound, they looked up at Walter. It was obvious that Walter was going to continue attacking Connor.
Moreover, everyone could clearly feel that Walter's attack this time was clearly many times stronger than the previous one.
"The old sect leader is really serious this time!"
A guardian of the Heavenly Sect could not help but sigh softly.
Walter looked at Connor expressionlessly and whispered to Connor, "Today, I will let you know how powerful I am!"
Connor glanced at Walter indifferently and ignored him.
Walter stomped his foot, causing the Heavenly Mountain to shake even more violently.
Everyone could clearly feel the tremors of Heavenly Mountain. It felt like an earthquake. Some of the weaker cultivators had fearful expressions on their faces because they were worried that they might die on the Heavenly Mountain at any time. It was not worth it to sacrifice their lives just to watch the show.
Rumble…
However, at this moment, the trembling of Heavenly Mountain seemed to become even more intense, as if it could really collapse at any time.
"What's going on?"
"Yeah, what's going on?"
"Will the Heavenly Mountain collapse?"
Everyone had nervous expressions on their faces. They were also filled with panic, not knowing what to do.
Haiven hesitated for a moment before he slowly stood up and shouted at the crowd, "Everyone, don't panic. Mr. Collier Sr. is using the power of the array formation. The Heavenly Mountain won't collapse, and you won't be in any danger!"
When everyone heard Haiven's words, they were at ease.
"What kind of array formation is this? It actually has such terrifying power!"
"That's right. Mr. Collier Sr. is really powerful. Even if we work hard for our entire lives, it's probably very difficult for us to be compared to an expert like Mr. Collier Sr.!"
"And that Connor is able to face Mr. Collier Sr. head on at such a young age. I have to say that I'm already somewhat impressed by him!"
Everyone started discussing again.
Boom!
At this moment, a loud sound suddenly came from the Heavenly Mountain. Then, an extremely dazzling light erupted.
Walter stood in the light like a God.
Beau seemed to have used the same array formation before. However, compared to Walter's array formation, Beau's array formation was not worth mentioning.
Beau's array formation could only use a certain range of heaven and earth spiritual energy, but Walter's array formation was different. He could use the entire mountain's spiritual energy with the help of this array formation.
"Father's strength has actually reached such a terrifying level!"
Beau looked at Walter in the light and couldn't help but sigh.
At the same time, countless auras slowly flowed into Walter's body in a form visible to the naked eye.
Walter turned to look at Connor and whispered to him, "I used twenty years to complete this array. I was going to use it to deal with those martial artists who shouldn't exist in this world, but I didn't expect to use it on you today. What a waste!"
When Walter said this, he seemed a little reluctant.
"Martial artists that shouldn't exist in this world?"
Haiven's expression changed when he heard this. He turned to Xandra and whispered, "Do those legendary martial artists really exist?"
"Mr. Collier Sr. and Connor might be heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. Since heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters exist, then those people probably also exist!"
Xandra said seriously.
"..."
Haiven could not help but gasp when he heard this.
"You're talking about the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts realm, right?"
Connor suddenly asked Walter.
Haiven and Xandra raised their heads and looked at Connor, because Connor's words had confirmed their guesses.
There were indeed martial artists in this world who were at a higher realm than ancient martial arts grandmasters!
This was not a rumor!
The other martial artists were puzzled because they had never heard of the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts. Naturally, they did not know what Connor and Walter were talking about.
Some of the slightly smarter martial artists seemed to have vaguely guessed something, but these things were not the focus of their attention, so they did not discuss it.
"How do you know about the existence of the pinnacle of ancient martial arts?"
Walter hurriedly asked Connor.
"I heard it from someone else!"
Connor lightly replied.
"Jorge Yarrell told you?"
Walter continued to ask.
"No, the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader told me!"
Connor shook his head.
"Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
Walter was stunned for a moment before he laughed out loud and said lightly, "Kid, even if you want to brag, it has to make some sense. The Blood Moon Sect's cult leader has long been killed by the people from the four great sects. How could you know the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader at such a young age?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2022: A Powerful Aura
chapters.content:
Chapter 2022: A Powerful Aura
Back then, the four great sects had joined forces to annihilate the Blood Moon Sect.
Walter was one of the sect leaders of these four sects.
Therefore, he was very sure that the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader was dead unless a new cult leader had appeared in the Blood Moon Sect.
"Back then, the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader didn't die. On the contrary, he fled to Willborough and recovered to his peak condition within a few short decades. I killed the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader personally some time ago, and he told me about the existence of the pinnacle of ancient martial arts before he died!"
Connor explained calmly.
Upon hearing Connor's words, everyone once again fell into a deep shock. They were in disbelief.
"The Blood Moon Sect's cult leader was actually killed by Connor?"
"Is Connor the legendary Soul Eater?"
"Connor is actually a Soul Eater?"
For a moment, everyone was dumbfounded. How could they have imagined that Connor had such a terrifying identity?
Even Haiven and Xandra were shocked.
The two of them knew how strong Connor was, so even if Connor said that he was the Soul Eater, the two of them would not doubt it.
Too many unbelievable things had happened in today's battle. Everyone felt like they were on a roller-coaster ride. Before they could recover from the shock of one incident, something even more shocking happened.
However, the martial artists all liked this feeling very much. After all, they had traveled thousands of miles just to see these things!
"That's impossible! The Blood Moon Sect's cult leader can't be alive!"
Walter said expressionlessly.
Beau slowly raised his head to look at Walter and said in a low voice, "Father, Connor isn't lying. The cult leader of the Blood Moon Sect did not die back then. He was killed by a person called the Soul Eater on Sutie Mountain a few days ago…"
Walter was stunned when he heard Beau's words. He then asked Connor expressionlessly, "You're the one who killed the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader?"
"That's right!"
Connor nodded.
Walter took a deep breath and continued, "Then what else do you know?"
"I know a lot of things, but I don't think I need to answer your questions!"
Connor said lightly.
"Since you don't want to tell me now, I'll ask you later!"
Walter sneered.
Connor could feel that Walter didn't know much about the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts. He wanted to ask Connor about the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts.
"Nirvana Tower!"
Walter suddenly shouted.
In the next second, everyone saw the spiritual energy between heaven and earth condense once more. It slowly formed a pagoda that emitted golden light in Walter's hand.
The light of the pagoda was very dazzling, and it contained infinitely powerful energy. If it really struck him, Connor would probably die.
A moment later, Walter was somewhat excited, and the pagoda in his hand had already taken shape.
Walter looked at Connor expressionlessly and whispered to Connor, "I want to see if you can take my second move!"
After saying that, Walter threw the pagoda in his hand with all his might. The pagoda smashed toward Connor.
When Walter released the Nirvana Tower, it was as if the entire space was being distorted. The pagoda kept growing larger and larger. In the end, it became a five-meter-tall tower. Its aura was extremely shocking.
When everyone saw this scene, they all revealed shocked expressions because they had never seen such a move before.
The Nirvana Tower, which was only the size of a palm, had now become a real tower that was more than five meters tall and weighed more than a thousand tons. It was really unbelievable.
"Mr. Collier Sr. is like a God!"
"Yeah! How terrifying is he?!"
Everyone on the scene was terrified because they knew that if they were hit by the Nirvana Tower, there would be no chance of survival.
"The Heavenly Mountain is the territory of the Heavenly Sect. Moreover, Mr. Collier has set up such a terrifying array in advance. Even if Connor is really strong, he might not be able to escape death today…"
Haiven couldn't help but whisper.
"So what if the people of the Heavenly Sect win? Mr. Collier relied on arrays to defeat Connor. It is an unfair victory!"
Xandra replied.
Haiven smiled helplessly and said, "So what if it's unfair? In this situation, no one cares how he won. They only care about who the winner is!"
"..."
Xandra took a deep breath and didn't refute Haiven, because what Haiven said made sense.
Connor looked at the Nirvana Tower flying toward him with a disdainful expression and said indifferently, "I thought that you would use some other moves. I didn't expect it to be such a trivial trick. Aren't you underestimating me a little too much?"
"Break my move first!"
Walter said coldly.
Rumble…
As the Nirvana Tower got closer and closer to Connor, the power emitted by the Nirvana Tower became more and more shocking.
Connor didn't show any fear when facing the Nirvana Tower. On the contrary, he was very calm, so calm that it was surreal.
Just when the Nirvana Tower was less than ten meters away from Connor, he suddenly waved his right hand.
In an instant, an extremely dazzling light erupted.
When everyone saw the golden aura released by Connor, they all revealed shocked expressions. Even Haiven and Xandra were very incredulous.
"How can a martial artist's aura be so powerful?"
Haiven couldn't help but exclaim because he had never seen such a powerful aura before. Even the aura that Walter had just released couldn't be compared to Connor's aura.
"No wonder Connor was able to kill the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader. He really is strong!"
Xandra hurriedly added.
When everyone heard Haiven and Xandra's words, their expressions changed slightly.
After all, they had no way to feel the true terror of Connor's aura.
However, to be able to make two earth-rank ancient martial art grandmasters exclaim in such a way, it was enough to prove that Connor's aura was terrifying indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2023: Chi of All Creations
chapters.content:
Chapter 2023: Chi of All Creations
Actually, Haiven and Xandra couldn't be blamed for having such a reaction.
After all, even Connor himself probably did not know how terrifying his aura was now.
The reason why Connor's aura became so terrifying was because a large portion of his strength came from Carl Benjamin's remnant soul. Therefore, the aura that Connor was releasing now was Carl's aura.
Carl was a Soul Formation Realm powerhouse back then, that was why Connor's aura was terrifying.
Connor's golden aura rippled out from the peak of the mountain, crashing toward the Nirvana Tower with incomparable ferocity.
Bang!
When Connor's aura collided with the Nirvana Tower, a terrifying sound erupted.
Walter's expression changed slightly because he could feel the Nirvana Tower trembling slightly at this moment.
Immediately after, Connor's aura was like a sharp knife, resulting in a crack on the Nirvana Tower. Moreover, this crack continued to expand, and the Nirvana Tower trembled even more violently.
"He can really break my move?"
Walter was also shocked, but he did not immediately panic. He had already begun to plan how to deal with Connor.
To put it bluntly, the Nirvana Tower was not Walter's full-strength attack. He still had many trump cards that he had not shown. He believed that he would definitely be able to kill Connor today, but he might waste some energy doing so.
Boom!
At this moment, the Nirvana Tower slashed Connor's aura into two halves, then ruthlessly smashed into the ground, creating two huge deep pits.
Everyone felt as if two bombs had landed in front of them. The loud sound made many people's ears buzz.
Upon seeing this scene, the Purple Cloud Sect members were a little excited. This was because the Nirvana Tower, which seemed unstoppable in their eyes, was actually broken by Connor so easily. This made everyone's confidence soar.
When Walter appeared, these people were worried for Connor. They were worried that Connor would die in Walter's hands. But now, they knew that Connor definitely had the power to fight Walter.
However, Walter did not let everyone be happy for too long. After all, he had long expected Connor to be able to counter his move. Therefore, at this moment, Walter was still crazily devouring the spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
Previously, when everyone came to the Heavenly Mountain, the flowers and trees were green and tall. However, the Heavenly Mountain was about to become a withered mountain. Countless flowers and trees had already withered.
This had a lot to do with Walter's crazy absorption of heaven and earth spiritual energy.
"Zen Eight Trigrams, Myriad Star Transposition!"
Walter suddenly shouted.
Then, everyone saw Walter condense a black and white aura ball in his hands. At this moment, the ball seemed to contain extremely terrifying energy. Even the Nirvana Tower just now could not compare to it.
This powerful aura contained infinite heaven and earth spiritual energy. The different colors represented the two extremes of the Chi of All Creations. It was only because it was compressed by Walter's power that it turned out like this.
Once this aura exploded, its power would not be comparable to that of ordinary missiles. Not a single blade of grass would grow within a ten-mile radius.
"It's the Chi of All Creations!"
"It really is the Chi of All Creations. The old sect leader is actually using this move!"
"This is truly unbelievable…"
When the people of the Heavenly Sect saw Walter use this move, they were extremely excited.
This was because they had heard that a master in the sect had used this move hundreds of years ago, but they had never seen anyone use it with their own eyes.
It was very difficult for ordinary people to absorb the spiritual energy between heaven and earth, let alone control the spiritual energy between heaven and earth in their palms. This was a very big challenge for a martial artist's body.
Even at Walter's realm, he looked somewhat strained. There were even fine beads of sweat on his forehead.
"Connor, I want to see how you will counter this move!"
Walter growled and pushed with both hands.
When the Chi of All Creations left Walter's palm, he seemed even more strained. There was no sign of him relaxing at all.
This was because the heaven and earth spiritual energy was very violent, which was why ordinary warriors couldn't absorb it. Walter's control of the heaven and earth spiritual energy in his palm was just the beginning, and now was the most crucial step, which was to control the heaven and earth spiritual energy, guiding it toward Connor.
The speed of the Chi of All Creations was not very fast, but wherever it passed, it would leave deep gullies on the ground, and the ground trembled violently.
"I didn't expect such a terrifying martial artist to exist in this world!"
Xandra couldn't help but whisper.
"This is the epitome of godly strength. Even if the two of us join forces, we might not be a match for Mr. Collier Sr.!"
Haiven said.
"Join hands with you?"
Xandra's expression was one of disdain.
On the other side, Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Walter. He knew very well that there was no way for him to dodge the attack of the Chi of All Creations, so he chose to use other methods to deal with Walter's move.
"I admit that you are the strongest opponent I have ever met, but it is still impossible for you to kill me!"
At this moment, Connor suddenly spoke.
"Break this move of mine first before you talk big!"
Walter whispered back to Connor.
"That's easy!"
Connor replied indifferently and then did something that everyone did not expect.
Connor did not choose to dodge but rushed toward the Chi of All Creations.
In just a moment, Connor rushed up to the Chi of All Creations, then raised his fist and smashed it toward the Chi of All Creations.
"Is he crazy? How could he…"
Before Haiven could finish his sentence, Connor's fist smashed onto the Chi of All Creations.
When Connor's fist collided with the Chi of All Creations, the energy contained within was finally released and exploded.
Boom!
There was a loud bang.
Everyone felt as if a huge bomb had been detonated.
An extremely terrifying aura burst forth. All the martial artists there hurriedly used all their strength to resist the terrifying aura.
