With Connor as the center, all the flowers, trees, and stones within a radius of ten miles instantly levitated. It was as if a huge sandstorm had been raised, and the trembling of the Heavenly Mountain became more and more intense.

chapters.title: Chapter 2024: Quasi-Celestial Artifact!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2024: Quasi-Celestial Artifact!
After this powerful aura dissipated, everyone discovered that a huge deep pit had actually appeared where Connor was standing just now.
This was because the pit was very deep and was emitting a strong aura.
Therefore, everyone had no way to see the situation inside the pit at all. They also did not know if Connor was dead or alive!
"Is it over?"
"Is Connor dead or not?"
"That aura earlier was so powerful. He can't have survived it…"
"Old Sect Leader really won?"
Everyone from the Heavenly Sect looked at the deep pit with excitement on their faces. After all, the explosion just now was very terrifying. Even if Connor was stronger, he definitely wouldn't be able to survive the explosion just now.
Even Xandra, Haiven, and the others were looking at the deep pit with solemn eyes. They could no longer sense Connor's aura, so they did not know if Connor was dead or alive!
"Young Sect Leader wouldn't die just like that, right?"
"No way! Young Sect Leader is the Soul Eater!"
"Yeah, how could he die so easily?"
At this moment, the people of the Purple Cloud Sect were naturally unwilling to accept the possibility that Connor had already died in Walter's hands. They all felt that Connor was still alive.
"Is it really over?"
Aida Collier felt a little helpless, and she felt vexed.
As time passed, the terrifying aura in the deep pit still did not dissipate, and Connor still had not appeared in front of everyone.
Even those who were unwilling to believe that Connor had already died in Walter's hands began to waver.
"It's rare for a genius like you to appear in the ancient martial arts world of Sommervile. Unfortunately, you're way to arrogant. If you were given another ten years, even I wouldn't be your match!"
Walter seemed to think that Connor was dead, so his words were obviously the final verdict for this battle.
Haiven and Xandra sat down on the chairs at the same time, but they did not say anything because they did not know how to describe their feelings.
"Connor is dead. Great-grandfather won!"
Cielo Collier, who was sitting in the wheelchair, suddenly shouted. He was unusually excited. After all, there were so many people there, and no one wanted to see Connor die more than him.
"The old sect leader is really much too powerful…"
"The old sect leader is a god-like existence!"
The disciples of the Heavenly Sect shouted in excitement.
After all, this battle would not only determine the life and death of Beau Collier and Connor, but it would also determine the future position of the Heavenly Sect in the ancient martial arts world of Sommervile. If Walter really won, then the status of the Heavenly Sect would probably go one step further. It might even surpass the other three sects and become the most powerful force in Sommervile.
"What are you all so happy about?"
Just as the disciples of the Heavenly Sect were about to celebrate, a voice sounded in their ears.
When everyone heard this voice, almost everyone was stunned, and they were in disbelief.
Walter quickly looked up and saw that Connor was not dead. Instead, he was looking down at everyone on the ground from about a hundred meters away.
"Connor isn't dead?"
When Xandra saw Connor, she suddenly stood up, her face filled with shock.
"Not only did he not die, but he isn't even injured!"
Haiven replied expressionlessly.
"How did he do it?"
Xandra looked at Connor in the sky, his face filled with shock.
No one had expected Connor to appear in front of them unscathed after such a terrifying explosion. Even Walter's face was filled with shock.
Connor didn't give these people much time to be surprised. His figure flashed, and he rushed toward Haiven.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Sonic Break!"
Connor growled.
When the grand guardian saw Connor use the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, he was a little shocked. He sighed softly, "I didn't expect Young Sect Leader's Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist to be even more terrifying than Sect Leader's. How unbelievable!"
Connor had practically used up all of his energy in this punch. After all, he did not dare to relax in the slightest when facing an enemy like Walter.
At this moment, everyone could also feel how shocking the power of Connor's punch was. It was as if even the dark clouds in the sky were affected by the aura of Connor's punch as they dispersed in the sky. A trace of golden sunlight just happened to shine on Connor's body.
Everyone felt that Connor was like a god descending upon the mortal world.
This punch was Connor's first attack. Walter did not dare to be careless and waved his right hand.
A five-colored jade bracelet flew out, followed by five rays of light that surrounded Walter's body.
These five rays of light were like the strongest barrier in the world. Walter wanted to use this jade bracelet to block Connor's attack.
" It's actually the Zen Five Elements Jade!"
At this moment, an old man suddenly shouted excitedly.
"That's right, it's the legendary Zen Five Elements Jade!"
Haiven said.
For a moment, everyone was even more shocked. This was because they all knew about the existence of the Zen Five Elements Jade, but no one had ever seen anyone use it with their own eyes. Of course, what shocked them even more was that it was said that the Zen Five Elements Jade could only be used once. Walter had actually used it just like that. How could everyone not be shocked?
"Master, what is the Zen Five Elements Jade? Is it very precious?"
Yolanda Yates asked Xandra softly after hearing the crowd's discussion. She looked confused.
"It is said that this Zen Five Elements Jade is a divine artifact that a martial artist made hundreds of years ago. After using it, it can form five very strong barriers around the user's body. The hardness of this barrier could still hold even if five ancient martial arts grandmasters use all their strength. Moreover, there are five such barriers, so whoever uses this divine artifact in battle will be invincible!"
Xandra explained expressionlessly.
Yolanda was shocked when she heard Xandra's words. She whispered, "I didn't expect such a powerful divine artifact to exist in this world!"
"The Zen Five Elements Jade is no longer a divine artifact. It should now be a quasi-celestial artifact!"
Xandra replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 2025: The Power of One Punch
chapters.content:
Chapter 2025: The Power of One Punch
"Quasi-Celestial Artifact?"
When Yolanda heard this, she took a deep breath and said softly, "I didn't expect Celestial Artifacts to exist in this world. I thought that they only exist in legends!"
"Although the Zen Five Elements Jade is very powerful, it can only be used once. If you want to use it again, you have to wait 50 years. Now that Mr. Collier Sr. has used the Zen Five Elements Jade, it means that he places great value on this battle!"
Haiven said at this moment.
"That's right. Mr. Collier Sr. used a Quasi-Celestial Artifact to deal with a junior. Even if he can win today, it will still be disgraceful!"
Xandra could not help but sigh.
Haiven did not refute Xandra's words this time. Instead, he nodded gently.
Connor also knew that the light barrier around Walter's body was extraordinary, but he did not choose to give up on attacking.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist smashed fiercely onto the first red light barrier.
However, what everyone did not expect was that this red light only lasted for less than half a minute under Connor's fist before it actually shattered.
Everyone was terrified. Those who knew the power of the Zen Five Elements Jade were even more terrified.
After all, even if Xandra and Haiven joined forces, they would not be able to easily shatter the red barrier of the five elements in a short period of time.
However, at this moment, the barrier was actually like a mirror in front of Connor. It was easily shattered by him.
"What…"
Yolanda was shocked. She turned to look at Xandra. At this moment, she was beginning to doubt whether what Xandra had said was true.
After Connor easily shattered the first red barrier, his fist was like a hot knife slicing through butter. Immediately after, he continuously shattered the second orange barrier and the third green barrier.
The Zen Five Elements Jade only had five layers of barriers, but these five layers of barriers were abnormally strong, and the more they were, the stronger they became. It seemed that no one had ever been able to break through the five layers of barriers. This was also why everyone was so shocked when Walter used the Zen Five Elements Jade.
However, who would have thought that Connor would actually easily shatter three barriers.
"Has the energy of the Zen Five Elements Jade been exhausted with time?"
Haiven sighed with a puzzled expression.
"That's impossible!"
Xandra shook her head without thinking.
"Why do you say so?"
Haiven hurriedly asked.
"If the energy in the Zen Five Elements Jade has been exhausted, then Mr. Collier Sr. must have known. He definitely wouldn't have used the Zen Five Elements Jade, so there must be no problems with the Zen Five Elements Jade. It's just that Connor's punch is too powerful."
Xandra responded.
Haiven couldn't help but take a deep breath after hearing Xandra's words. He said in a low voice, "If there's really nothing wrong with the Zen Five Elements Jade, then how terrifying is Connor's punch?"
"Why don't you test it yourself now?"
Xandra said calmly.
"Forget it. I don't want to get involved in such a fight between immortals…"
Haiven smiled awkwardly and shook his head.
On the other side, Connor had shattered three barriers in front of Walter in a row, so his energy had almost been exhausted. When his fist landed on the fourth barrier, it only made the blue barrier tremble slightly and did not completely shatter it.
"You're the first martial artist I've ever seen who can shatter three barriers!"
Walter said to Connor expressionlessly.
"..."
Connor looked at Walter and took a deep breath. Then, he rushed toward Walter' again.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Sky Splitter!"
Connor shouted. Lightning flashed and thunder rumbled in the sky.
Connor's fist once again smashed fiercely on the blue barrier in front of Walter. Although the barrier did not shatter immediately, fine cracks began to appear.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, City Crusher!"
Connor didn't hesitate at all and immediately followed up with a second punch.
This punch instantly shattered the blue barrier that was already covered in cracks.
At this moment, there was only the last black barrier left in front of Walter. Once Connor broke the barrier, then Walter's Zen Five Elements Jade would be useless.
Walter looked at Connor, and a trace of surprise flashed across his face. He did not expect Connor to be able to shatter the four barriers so quickly.
After shattering the blue barrier, Connor's fist did not stop. He continued to attack the black barrier in front of Walter crazily.
However, the hardness of this last black barrier was far from what Connor had imagined. The previous barriers were as fragile as a mirror to Connor. Only this fourth barrier was able to bring some trouble to Connor.
At this moment, the last black barrier was like a huge rock. No matter how hard Connor used his strength, his fist could not affect this barrier at all.
When the people of the Heavenly Sect saw this scene, their initial nervousness eased a little. After all, they were really worried that Connor would shatter the last barrier with his punches like before. That would be a little troublesome.
Bang! Bang!
Connor punched the barrier in front of Walter one punch after another. The power of each punch was very shocking, but the barrier did not budge.
"How long are you going to do that for?"
Walter looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he waved his right hand gently and a huge palm slapped down on Connor.
Connor hurriedly dodged to the side.
The huge palm smashed a huge pit on the ground.
"The Zen Five Elements Jade is indeed worthy of its reputation. Mr. Collier Sr. is now invincible. If Connor can't get rid of the barrier in front of Mr. Collier Sr. as soon as possible, Connor will definitely lose today!"
Haiven looked at Connor and said softly.
"Why are you supporting Connor now? Shouldn't you be supporting Mr. Collier Sr.?"
Xandra was stunned for a moment and asked Haiven softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2026: The Power of the Celestial Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 2026: The Power of the Celestial Artifact
"I was indeed on Beau's side before, but the situation has changed. If Connor can win today, things will become even more interesting…"
Haiven said with a smile.
"No matter who wins today, it will be a huge loss for Sommervile's ancient martial arts world. I'm afraid we won't be able to reach their current heights in our lifetime!"
Xandra whispered.
"Yeah, this height is simply not something that we can imagine!"
Haiven seemed to agree with Xandra.
On the other side, the faces of the Purple Cloud Sect's people were dark because they were all worried for Connor. The barrier in front of Walter was way too terrifying. If Connor could not break through the barrier, Walter would be invincible.
"Young Sect Leader won't lose just like that, right?"
"How is that possible? Young Sect Leader is the Soul Eater. How could he lose so easily?"
"The main thing is that Walter Collier is way too shameless. He is already so old, but he still used a Celestial Artifact to deal with Young Sect Leader. Isn't he afraid of being laughed at by others?"
"At this point, surviving is the only thing that matters. If Walter did not use the Celestial Artifact, he might have already lost…"
Everyone from the Purple Cloud Sect began to discuss in a low voice.
"I know how to break the barrier in front of you!"
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly said to Walter.
"Is that so?"
Walter could not help but sneer when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said indifferently, "I'll be waiting. Although you being able to break the first four barriers is astonishing enough, I've never seen anyone break the last barrier. If you can really do it, then that's truly worth admiring!"
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Walter. He rushed toward Walter.
At this moment, Walter seemed to be a little curious about whether Connor could really break the barrier in front of him. Therefore, he did not attack Connor. Instead, he stood on the spot and waited for Connor's attack.
Bang!
At this moment, Connor's fist had already smashed fiercely onto the black barrier.
Although the barrier did not shatter immediately, Connor's punch made the black barrier tremble slightly.
"How did you do that?"
Walter asked Connor in disbelief.
Connor did not explain to Walter how he did it. Instead, he raised his fist and punched at the barrier again and again.
After only ten punches, a very obvious crack had appeared on the black barrier.
When everyone saw this scene, they seemed to be even more shocked. No one had thought that Connor could really do it.
"Shatter!"
At this moment, Connor suddenly roared.
Connor's fist once again smashed onto the barrier with an extremely ferocious aura.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
The black barrier that was originally indestructible in everyone's eyes was smashed open by Connor.
When the black barrier exploded, Walter seemed to have suffered a backlash from the Celestial Artifact. He took two steps back with a solemn expression on his face.
"Young Sect Leader has succeeded…"
"Yeah, Young Sect Leader has succeeded!"
"Awesome…"
When the people of the Purple Cloud Sect saw this scene, they all revealed excited expressions.
Haiven and Xandra seemed to be used to such things, so they were not shocked. On the contrary, they were even a little helpless.
Because now, in their eyes, no matter what Connor did, they wouldn't find it strange.
"I didn't expect you to really do it!"
Walter looked at Connor and sighed softly.
"The most important reason why the barrier is so strong is that it contains a very terrifying Negative Chi. Therefore, when I punched out just now, I used the Positive Chi between heaven and earth and attached it to my fist. Positive and negative restrain each other, so it was much easier to break through the barrier!"
Connor looked at Walter and explained.
Walter smiled faintly and said softly, "Looks like I have underestimated you…"
Connor didn't continue talking nonsense with Walter and attacked again.
In an instant, Connor rushed up to Walter and raised his fist to smash down on Walter.
A strange look flashed across Walter's face. His figure flashed, and he narrowly dodged Connor's punch.
"The Zen Five Elements Jade I used just now was just a Quasi-Celestial Artifact. Now, I'll show you what a real Celestial Artifact is!"
Walter looked at Connor and shouted.
"Does Mr. Collier Sr. really have a Celestial Artifact?"
Haiven was a little excited when he heard Walter's words.
Of course, he wasn't the only one who was excited. The others were also very excited.
Because they had only heard of Celestial Artifacts, but no one had ever seen one. Even Quasi-Celestial Artifacts like the Zen Five Elements Jade were extremely rare.
At this moment, Walter was going to take out a Celestial Artifact, which was considered a feast for everyone's eyes.
Walter took a deep breath. Then, a black light suddenly erupted around his body. This light formed a totem shape that no one had ever seen before in the sky.
For a moment, everyone focused their attention on the totem.
"Today, I'll let you see what a real Celestial Artifact is!"
Walter shouted at Connor.
A long black blade slowly fell from the sky and finally landed in front of Walter.
Walter slowly picked up the black long blade in front of him. An incomparably terrifying aura was released from his body, causing the world to tremble.
When Haiven and Xandra saw this scene, they were extremely shocked.
"I didn't expect Celestial Artifacts to really exist in this world!"
Haiven sighed in a low voice.
"If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn't have believed that Celestial Artifacts really existed in this world!"
Xandra quickly added.
"I've only heard of Celestial Artifacts, but I've never seen one with my own eyes. Today, I've seen the power of Celestial Artifacts!"
Haiven said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2027: Is It Over?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2027: Is It Over?
"Where did Mr. Collier Sr. get his Celestial Artifact?"
Xandra had been thinking about this question.
"The two of us are too inexperienced. There are many things in this world that martial artists of our level can't pry into. If it weren't for this battle, we might not even know that there are heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters in this world!"
Haiven said.
Xandra turned to Haiven and said nothing.
"Connor, this long blade is called the Green Dragon Blade. It's a Celestial Artifact left behind from ancient times. Today, you forced me to use the Zen Five Elements Jade and this Green Dragon Blade, which is enough to prove your capabilities!"
Walter looked at Connor and sighed softly. Then, he continued, "However, no matter how capable you are, you will die in my hands today. I won't allow people like you to continue living in this world!"
"It's actually the legendary ancient Celestial Artifact, the Green Dragon Blade!"
Haiven was dumbfounded when he heard Walter's words.
This was because he had once read about the Green Dragon Blade in an ancient book. Although the Green Dragon Blade was not the strongest artifact in ancient times, it was still ranked in the top 20. Needless to say, it was powerful. However, the Green Dragon Blade had disappeared in history for more than a hundred years.
In this hundred years, there was no record of the Green Dragon Blade at all. Of course, other Celestial Artifacts also disappeared during this period.
Haiven didn't think that Walter would take out such a famous artifact in the history of Sommervile.
"Connor is in danger!"
Haiven could only let out such a sigh to express his current mood.
At this moment, Walter charged straight at Connor with the Green Dragon Blade in his hand.
The aura between heaven and earth was ignited at this moment. Waves of terrifying and sinister sounds came from the sky, as if something was about to break through the shackles of the sky. This feeling made everyone feel extremely afraid.
This time, Walter's aura had undergone a huge change, and the power contained in the long blade was also very shocking. After all, Celestial Artifacts were rare. Many people had never even seen a Celestial Artifact before.
Therefore, Walter's strength had soared with the help of the Celestial Artifact. At this moment, the battle had also undergone a huge reversal.
Walter charged straight at Connor with the Green Dragon Blade in his hand. At this moment, the Green Dragon Blade in Walter's hand was emitting waves of strange light.
Earlier, Connor was still able to gain some advantage when facing Walter. However, at this moment, Connor was completely at a disadvantage. Every time the two of them fought, Connor would take a few steps back. In just a few minutes, Connor had already retreated nearly a few hundred meters.
Moreover, behind Connor was a bottomless abyss, so he was in a state where he could not retreat.
Everyone looked at Connor and was very worried because they didn't know if he would be able to find a chance to counterattack.
"It's over!"
Walter suddenly shouted at Connor. Then, the Green Dragon Blade in his hand was headed straight for Connor.
The moment Walter attacked, everyone could clearly see a black aura bursting out from the Green Dragon Blade. Moreover, the aura transformed into countless Green Dragon Blades in the air, as if it was trying to lock down on Connor's position so that he would not be able to dodge Walter's attack.
Walter's attack once again shocked everyone. Although the Green Dragon Blade had yet to reach Connor, a huge crack had already appeared on the mountain behind Connor, and it was still growing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Boom!
When the Green Dragon Blade was less than 100 meters away from Connor, the mountain behind him had already shattered.
From this point, everyone could feel how terrifying the pressure was. This kind of pressure was already beyond their imagination.
Everyone's attention was on Connor. They were thinking about how he should deal with Walter's move.
When the Green Dragon Blade was less than 50 meters away from Connor, he finally moved!
Connor took a step forward, and the aura in his body was instantly released.
Although Connor's aura was already very terrifying at this moment, there was still a huge gap between it and the aura of the Green Dragon Blade.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dharma World!"
Connor roared in a low voice. In the next second, a dazzling light enveloped Connor's body.
Connor rushed straight for the Green Dragon Blade.
Bang!
With a loud sound, Connor's fist collided with the Green Dragon Blade.
However, what everyone did not expect was that this time, Connor was actually not at a disadvantage. On the contrary, the two of them seemed to have stopped moving. The punch and the blade were fixed in everyone's sight.
However, everyone knew that this was the most powerful battle between Connor and Walter. It was also a battle between Connor's fist and the Green Dragon Blade. Once the winner of this battle was determined, this battle would probably end very quickly.
The Green Dragon Blade's continuous magical power was trying to break through Connor's fist, while Connor's fist was also constantly blocking the advance of the Green Dragon Blade. Both of them were now stationary, and it was difficult to tell who was stronger!
Walter stood in the distance and squinted at Connor. He could feel Connor's burning fighting spirit. He knew that Connor was using his life for this strike. If the Green Dragon Blade lost to Connor, it would definitely be damaged. Moreover, he would be in a very dangerous situation.
At this moment, Walter finally felt the pressure.
He had never thought that Connor would still be so tenacious even after he had already taken out the Green Dragon Blade. Connor's strength was far more terrifying than he had imagined.
"Huff…"
Walter took a deep breath and waved his right hand.
The Green Dragon Blade stopped attacking Connor and returned to Walter's hand.
When Walter held the Green Dragon Blade, he realized that it was actually trembling. If he had not stopped in time, the Green Dragon Blade might have really been damaged by Connor.
Everyone knew that Walter had chosen to give up in advance during the battle between the Green Dragon Blade and Connor's punch. He was worried that Green Dragon Blade might not be able to survive unscathed, so he chose to withdraw the Green Dragon Blade.
Although Walter wanted to defeat Connor, he didn't want to lose a Celestial Artifact to defeat Connor. Moreover, if the Green Dragon Blade was really damaged, he might not be able to defeat Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2028: Walter Collier Lost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2028: Walter Collier Lost!
Connor could not help but sneer when he saw Walter retract his Green Dragon Blade. Then, he rushed toward Walter again.
In a flash, Connor had already thrown out several sets of punches, each of which smashed onto the Green Dragon Blade.
Walter was worried that the Green Dragon Blade in his hand would be damaged, so he did not dare to continue to fight Connor head-on. This also caused him to be a little passive in the battle. He was repeatedly beaten back by Connor, and the Green Dragon Blade in his hand trembled even more violently.
"This is so exciting…"
"Yeah, I thought the battle was about to end. I didn't expect Mr. McDonald to be able to regain the advantage!"
"Mr. McDonald's strength is way too terrifying. Even though Walter used a Celestial Artifact, he is still not Mr. McDonald's match!"
When everyone saw that Connor had regained the upper hand, they all exclaimed with excitement.
The disciples of the Heavenly Sect had ugly expressions on their faces. The didn't think that Connor would be so tenacious.
Connor became fiercer and fiercer as he fought. He absorbed the heaven and earth spiritual energy while crazily attacking Walter.
Walter seemed to be a little careless. After dodging Connor's punches, he exposed a fatal flaw.
Naturally, Connor would not let go of such a good opportunity. He punched Walter in the chest.
"Pfft…"
Walter had been worried about the Green Dragon Blade in his hand, so he did not manage to react in time. After being hit by Connor's punch, he spat out a mouthful of blood, and his body flew backward.
Walter's body smashed a huge hole in the mountain peak.
Everyone looked at the hole, but they did not see Walter. This was because Connor's punch was much too powerful. At this moment, the hole was at least a hundred meters deep, and it almost pierced through the mountain peak.
"Mr. Collier Sr. lost?"
Haiven suddenly stood up, somewhat surprised.
"Impossible! Mr. Collier Sr. wouldn't lose to Connor so easily!"
Although Xandra hoped that Connor would win, she knew that Walter would not die so easily.
Sure enough, just as she finished speaking, a figure flew out of the hole and headed straight for Connor.
This figure was Walter.
Walter was in a sorry state, but he had not given up on the battle.
However, because Walter had just taken Connor's punch, the aura in Walter's body had become very unstable.
Connor seized this opportunity to attack Walter crazily. He punched Walter's body one punch after another.
Walter did not want to be outdone. He held the Green Dragon Blade and blocked Connor's attack while looking for an opportunity to counterattack.
At this moment, Connor and Walter's speed had already exceeded the limit that the naked eye could see. Therefore, martial artists with lower realms could only see two afterimages flashing in the sky. They could not see how Connor and Walter were attacking.
Only Haiven and Xandra could see what was happening.
Connor's fist smashed onto Walter's Green Dragon Blade. At this moment, the Green Dragon Blade had already suffered too many blows from Connor, so it was already in a sorry state.
When Connor's fist smashed into the Green Dragon Blade, the blade was broken into two in Walter's hand!
"You destroyed my Green Dragon Blade?"
When Walter saw the Green Dragon Blade in his hand break, he was stunned.
The others also had an incredulous look on their faces, because no one had thought that Connor would actually be able to break the Green Dragon Blade.
For a moment, everyone fell silent.
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Walter. He then rushed toward Walter again.
At this moment, Walter was focused on the Green Dragon Blade that was already broken into two in his hand. He did not notice that Connor had already made his move.
After all, this Green Dragon Blade was something that Walter had painstakingly obtained. To be broken by Connor's punch just like that, he must feel really heartbroken about it.
"Father, be careful!"
Beau Collier was the first to react. When he saw Connor attack, he hurriedly shouted.
However, it was too late. Connor had already rushed up to Walter. He raised his fist and smashed it directly at Walter's chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Walter was instantly sent flying.
This time, Connor didn't give Walter any chance and chased after him.
Boom!
Connor's fists rained down on Walter's body.
Beau's expression was filled with despair when he saw this scene. He knew that Walter had lost the upper hand. Connor had completely gained the upper hand. If Walter could withstand the attacks, the situation might be slightly better. However, if Walter could not withstand it, he might be defeated.
Connor's movements were really fast. Everyone did not even know how many punches Connor had already thrown out.
Rumble…
At this moment, a loud rumble suddenly came from the Heavenly Mountain.
This loud noise shattered everyone's guesses about the battle situation.
Walter's body crashed onto the ground, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.
At this moment, Walter looked unusually miserable and even a little bloody because Connor had crushed Walter's chest. Everyone could even vaguely see Walter's heart beating continuously.
Although Walter didn't die, this scene told everyone that Connor had won!
Walter had been defeated!
Walter had been in seclusion for decades, yet he actually lost his first battle after reemerging. Moreover, he had lost to Connor, who was considered a junior in the ancient martial arts world.
For a moment, it was as if everyone could not accept this reality.
Beau looked at Walter who was lying on the ground motionlessly. He was filled with regret. He regretted provoking Connor, this monster, in the first place. Or perhaps, he should have gotten rid of Connor immediately after he came into contact with him.
If he hadn't been afraid of Jorge Yarrell and hadn't chosen to attack Connor, perhaps none of this would have happened!
There were also some people who could not accept this fact because to them, Walter was an invincible existence. Walter would definitely not lose. Even though he had already been beaten to such a state, there were still some people who believed that Walter had not lost.
"The old sect leader won't lose. There's no way he would lose. He is already a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. How can a heaven rank lose?"
At this moment, a guardian of the Heavenly Sect shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 2029: Peerless Expert
chapters.content:
Chapter 2029: Peerless Expert
Everyone from the Collier family and the disciples of the Heavenly Sect turned to look at Walter.
They seemed to be waiting for Walter to stand up again.
Walter was a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, so even though he was seriously injured, he was still not dead. The scene of his battle with Connor began to repeat itself in his mind.
Walter also tried to stand up, but his body was no longer under his control. His aura was also gradually dissipating. He knew that his soul would soon be extracted from his body and completely disappear from this world.
Everyone was looking forward to Walter standing up, but as time passed, Walter just lay there quietly, as if he could stand up at any moment.
"Grandpa!"
Albert Collier couldn't help but shout.
"I lost…"
Walter shook his head lightly at Albert.
For a moment, everyone was in an endless state of shock. This was because Walter's words had already drawn an end to the battle between him and Connor.
A legendary figure had actually been defeated just like that.
In the end, Walter and Beau were defeated by Connor!
Countless disciples of the Heavenly Sect could not help but cry.
"Mr. Collier Sr. really lost to Connor?"
Haiven said in a low voice after a long silence.
"Mr. Collier Sr. is already a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Moreover, in this battle just now, he used the Zen Five Elements Jade and the Green Dragon Blade, but in the end, he still lost to Connor. How is Connor so terrifyingly strong?"
Xandra was filled with shock.
"It seems that the Sommervile ancient martial arts world is really going to change. Why is the Purple Cloud Sect so lucky? First, there's Jorge Yarrell, and now there's Connor. It seems that the heavens really care for the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Haiven said enviously.
Xandra ignored Haiven and turned to look at Yolanda Yates behind him. She said softly, "Yolanda, do you still remember what I told you before?"
"Yes, Master!"
Yolanda replied calmly.
"This might be the last chance for the Profound Sect. You must seize it!"
Xandra said in a trembling voice.
"Master, I will do my best!"
Yolanda nodded again, but her beautiful eyes were filled with unwillingness.
Although Connor had just displayed a very terrifying combat strength, if it was an ordinary woman, she would definitely have long fallen in love with Connor.
However, Yolanda still seemed to be a little unwilling. After all, in her eyes, such a man would definitely have many women by his side. If she married such a man, she would be no different from a widow in the future. Moreover, Connor's strength was so terrifying that Yolanda had no way to control him.
However, for the future of the Profound Sect, she could only choose to compromise.
As for the people from the Purple Cloud Sect, they were very excited. Some of them could not help but shout loudly.
The emotions that had been suppressed for so long were finally released at this time.
Aida Collier was naturally very excited because she knew that her choice this time was the right one. Connor had won in the end!
"Grand Guardian, did you see that? Young Sect Leader actually won!"
Waverly Green shouted excitedly at the grand guardian.
"I didn't expect that another peerless expert would appear after the sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect."
The grand guardian's voice trembled as he exclaimed.
"I told you long ago that you have to have confidence in the Young Sect Leader. In the future, there might not be the four great sects in Sommervile. No one will dare to provoke the Purple Cloud Sect anymore!"
The third guardian chuckled.
"Unfortunately, the sect leader is not here. If the sect leader were here, he would definitely be very happy…"
The grand guardian said slowly.
"Right, Grand Guardian, where did the sect leader go? Why didn't he show up for such a huge battle? A normal sect leader would not ignore Young Sect Leader when he is in danger!"
Waverly hurriedly asked the grand guardian.
"Well…"
The expression on the grand guardian's face was a little strange.
"I think we should tell Young Sect Leader about the sect leader. We didn't tell Young Sect Leader because we were worried that Young Sect Leader's isn't strong enough to do anything, but now that we've seen Young Sect Leader's strength, we should tell him!"
The third guardian suddenly said.
"Young Sect Master has just experienced such a big battle. Although he won, he is surely injured. I think it's better to wait for now."
The grand guardian said softly after hesitating for a moment.
"Alright, then!"
The third guardian nodded and did not say anything else.
"Grand Guardian, Third Guardian, what's wrong with the sect leader?"
Waverly asked with a puzzled expression after hearing their conversation.
"There are some things that are better left unsaid!"
The grand guardian replied calmly.
"What exactly happened? Why are you being so mysterious…"
Waverly opened her mouth and was about to continue asking when a figure slowly landed.
Everyone hurriedly looked up and saw that Connor had descended from the peak.
At this moment, everyone looked at Connor as if they were looking at a god.
Connor walked toward Walter.
"Do you admit defeat?"
Connor arrived in front of Walter and asked softly.
"Just kill me. I will never admit defeat!"
Walter was obviously more courageous than Beau. He would rather die than admit defeat.
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Walter's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Previously, you mentioned the existence of the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts. How much do you know about the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts?"
Walter looked at Connor without saying anything.
"I know you want to die, but don't forget that the disciples of the Heavenly Sect are still here. The descendants of the Collier family are also here."
Connor said softly.
Walter was stunned when he heard Connor's words. He gritted his teeth and said, "If you kill these ordinary people, aren't you afraid that you will be ridiculed by the martial artists of Sommervile?"
"Ridiculed?"
Connor sneered and then said indifferently, "You might not know me very well. In the first 20 years of my life, I suffered a lot of disdain, ridicule, and humiliation from many people, so I don't care about all that!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2030: Hunting Ancient Martial Arts Grandmasters
chapters.content:
Chapter 2030: Hunting Ancient Martial Arts Grandmasters
"Why you…"
Hearing this, Walter was instantly speechless.
An ancient martial arts grandmaster like him cared a lot about his reputation.
However, he did not expect Connor to actually play by the rules.
"Besides, who dares to ridicule me now? If anyone dares to ridicule me, I'll kill them all!"
Connor continued.
"..."
Walter turned and looked at the Collier family members who were trembling in fear. He took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "What can I do to make you let these people go?"
"Tell me everything you know about the pinnacle of ancient martial arts and where you got those Celestial Artifacts!"
Connor said softly.
"..."
Walter hesitated for a couple of seconds when he heard Connor's words. Then, he said in a low voice, "As long as I tell you all this, you will let these people go, right?"
"Yes!"
Connor nodded and continued, "Of course, Beau and I have some personal grudges, so I will kill him today no matter what!"
"..."
Walter turned to look at Beau. He knew that he no longer had the right to bargain with Connor. As long as he could save most of the people, he would be satisfied.
"I'll tell you everything I know now. I hope you can do what you say!"
Walter said in a low voice.
Connor looked at Walter and said nothing.
"Actually, before I went into seclusion, I had already broken through to the realm of a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
Walter's words shocked everyone.
This was because these people thought that Walter was able to advance to the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster realm because he had been in seclusion for many years. However, no one expected Walter to be a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster before he went into seclusion.
"Since Mr. Collier Sr. had already broken through to the heaven realm, why did he choose to go into seclusion?"
Haiven was somewhat puzzled because he felt that Walter's words were somewhat illogical.
"In the Sommervile ancient martial arts world, there has always been a saying, that the highest realm of a martial artist is the peak of the earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Back then, I was also convinced that it was true, because after I broke through to the peak of the earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, I still couldn't break through to the heaven rank, so I believed that the limit of a martial artist was the peak of the earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
Walter paused for a moment before continuing, "But I accidentally barged into a hundred-year-old martial artist's tomb. That tomb was filled with heaven and earth spiritual energy, and I relied on that spiritual energy to advance to the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!"
"..."
Haiven and Xandra were shocked when they heard Walter's words.
The two of them had never thought that breaking through from the earth rank to the heaven rank would require them to absorb heaven and earth spiritual energy.
"Mr. Collier Sr., I tried to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, but why didn't it feel like it was helping my cultivation?"
Haiven took a step forward and asked Walter.
"That's because the amount of heaven and earth spiritual energy you've absorbed is too little. The heaven and earth spiritual energy on the entire earth is very thin. If you don't rely on Celestial Artifacts, you won't be able to absorb enough heaven and earth spiritual energy!"
Walter replied.
"I see!"
Haiven nodded thoughtfully.
Walter's words woke up everyone present and revealed a secret that no one knew.
Connor looked at Walter and did not say anything. He knew that Walter was not lying. What he said now was the same as what the Blood Moon Sect cult leader had said back then.
"I found the Zen Five Elements Jade and the Green Dragon Blade in that tomb. Moreover, there were many Celestial Artifacts in that tomb. Unfortunately, I didn't have the chance to take them with me…"
Walter spoke again.
"Why?"
Connor asked.
"Because after I broke through to the heaven-rank, a group of people came to the tomb to kill me. At that time, I relied on the Green Dragon Blade and the Zen Five Elements Jade to escape the calamity. When I returned to the Heavenly Mountain, I released news to the public that I was dead, but in fact, I chose to go into seclusion to avoid those people's pursuit!"
Walter looked at Connor and replied.
"Why are those people chasing after you? Do you know who they are?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"I didn't know who those people are or what they do, but their strength was terrifying. Even the lowest rank was a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. I've been secretly investigating these people for many years, and in the end, I found something!"
Walter took a deep breath and looked at the crowd nearby. He said softly, "What I'm about to say is probably the biggest secret of the ancient martial arts world. I'm a dying person, so I won't lie to you."
"Hurry up and tell us!"
Connor frowned and chided.
"After more than ten years of investigation, I found out that the people who chased after me were all from the same organization, and there were also foreigners. Their most important mission was to find martial artists who had broken through to the heaven rank and then kill them. This way, everyone would think that there are no heaven rank ancient martial artists in this world!"
Walter said expressionlessly.
"What? Someone is actually hunting heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters?"
"How is that possible?"
"Is it true?"
After hearing Walter's words, everyone was shocked. They were in disbelief.
"I've also investigated why these people want to attack heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. Once a martial artist breaks through to the heaven rank, they can control the heaven and earth spiritual energy at will. Moreover, they need to use the heaven and earth spiritual energy to increase their realm. However, earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters do not have this ability. They can only absorb a portion of the heaven and earth spiritual energy. The portion they absorb is very small, even negligible. Only by gathering the spiritual energy of heaven and earth within a hundred miles around his body could he achieve the effect of cultivation!
"Behind these people, there are even more powerful martial artists. These martial artists are called the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts, and the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts is the realm after the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster!
"These so-called pinnacle ancient martial artists are the most selfish people in the world. Not only do they occupy the heaven and earth spiritual energy that should belong to all martial artists, but they also don't allow other martial artists to compete with them for the heaven and earth spiritual energy because it is limited and takes a long time to replenish. This is why most of Sommervile's martial artists can only reach earth rank."

chapters.title: Chapter 2031: Fallen!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2031: Fallen!
Walter's words once again shocked everyone present.
For a moment, it was difficult for them to tell if what Walter said was true or not!
"There are actually such martial artists in this world?"
"How unbelievable!"
"If there really are such martial artists, then aren't they way too selfish?"
Everyone began to discuss in low voices.
Of course, Haiven and Xandra's expressions changed the most.
After all, this matter had the greatest impact on the two of them.
"Then, do you know who those people who are chasing after you are?"
Connor asked Walter.
"I don't. I only know that these people are from the same organization, and there are pinnacle ancient martial arts experts behind them. Moreover, there is probably more than one pinnacle ancient martial arts expert in the world!"
Walter looked at Connor and said.
"..."
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Walter without saying anything.
"You're also a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Why aren't you being chased by those people?"
Walter suddenly asked.
"I'm different from you!"
Connor replied indifferently, as if he did not want to explain too much about himself to Walter.
Connor didn't break through to the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster realm the normal way. He relied on the power of Carl Benjamin's remnant soul to break through to the ancient martial arts grandmaster realm. This might be the reason why those people didn't know about Connor.
"It doesn't matter if you don't want to tell me. Anyway, the news of you defeating me today will spread very quickly. At that time, these people will surely look for you. I admit that you are very strong, but you are not a match for those people!"
Walter said expressionlessly.
"..."
Connor smiled faintly after hearing Walter's words and did not say anything else.
At this moment, Connor had already figured out the ins and outs of the matter. Just like what the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader had told Connor previously, there were indeed pinnacle ancient martial artists in this world, and these people were constantly hunting down martial artists who had broken through to the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster realm.
Upon hearing Walter's words, the martial artists around them began to discuss in low voices.
Some people were not particularly concerned about this matter. After all, their realms were relatively low. They might not have the chance to become an ancient martial arts grandmaster in their lifetime, let alone break through to the heaven rank.
Moreover, they felt that there was nothing wrong with what these people were doing. After all, it had always been like this since ancient times. The strong preyed on the weak, and only the strong could control those precious resources. Even if they did not know about the existence of the pinnacle of ancient martial arts, this was also the situation in today's society.
It was just that what these pinnacle ancient martial artists were doing was straight to the point.
Some of the martial artists looked very worried, especially the earth rank and peak earth rank martial artists. They didn't know that there was a group of people who was hunting for martial artists who could become heaven rank ancient martial artists. They didn't know that breaking through from earth rank to heaven rank required a large amount of heaven and earth spiritual energy.
Haiven and Xandra looked at each other as if they knew what the other was thinking.
Even though the two of them already knew the method to advance to the heaven-tier ancient martial arts grandmaster, they did not dare to try it without giving it some thought because they were worried that those people at the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts would chase after them.
"Is there anything else you want to ask?"
At this moment, Walter asked Connor.
"No…"
Connor lightly shook his head.
"I have already told you everything I know. I hope you can do what you say and not make things difficult for my descendants and these people from the Heavenly Sect!"
Walter whispered to Connor.
"Don't worry, I won't make things difficult for them!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Walter took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "I didn't think that I would still lose to you in the end after escaping the pursuit of a pinnacle ancient martial artist and hiding in the Heavenly Sect for decades in order to survive…"
Connor looked at Walter and said nothing.
Walter smiled helplessly and closed his eyes.
A few seconds later, Walter lost all signs of life.
When Beau sensed that Walter's aura had disappeared, he hurriedly shouted, "Father! Father, wake... wake up!"
However, even after Beau had shouted several times, Walter still did not respond.
Everyone from the Collier family and the Heavenly Sect seemed to know that Walter was dead, so they all burst into tears. They looked devastated.
"I didn't expect a grandmaster to fall just like that!"
Haiven could not help but sigh when he heard the wails of the crowd.
"Even though Mr. Collier Sr. is dead, he deserves the respect of us juniors!"
Xandra whispered.
Yolanda sized up Connor. He already had such terrifying abilities at such a young age. If he was given a few more years, he would probably stand at the top of the world.
If she could really marry such a man, it would not be considered a grievance.
Connor didn't give them too much time to grieve. When he found out that Walter had passed away, he immediately walked toward Beau.
Connor's two punches had severely injured Beau, so even after such a long time, he still could not move.
Beau could only watch helplessly as Connor slowly walked toward him. His face was filled with fear.
"What... What are you doing?"
Beau stuttered as he asked Connor.
"Do you regret it now?"
Connor asked indifferently.
"I do. Connor, my father has already died in your hands. I'm no threat to you at all. Will you please let me go?"
Beau looked at Connor and shouted.
When everyone heard Beau's words, they sighed to themselves. After all, the difference between Beau and his father, Walter, was too great.
If Walter had begged Connor for mercy just now, Connor might have spared his life. However, for the sake of his dignity, Walter was unwilling to surrender and chose to die.
On the other hand, Beau was the total opposite. Even the disciples of the Heavenly Sect felt embarrassed.
Haiven and Xandra were naturally filled with contempt.
"It might be a little too late for regrets…"
Connor said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2032: The Top Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 2032: The Top Person
"Connor, as long as you let me go today, I am willing to submit to you!
"In the future, I will do whatever you ask me to do. If you ask me to go east, I will definitely not dare to go west!
"I'll listen to you!"
In order to survive, Beau seemed to have lost all his dignity. He shouted at Connor.
After hearing Beau's words, Connor smiled faintly and said expressionlessly, "If you hadn't attacked my fiancée back then, I might not have had the thought of killing you. Your mistake was touching someone you shouldn't have!"
"Connor, listen to me. I have a lot of assets under my name. As long as you let me go now, I can promise you whatever you want. As long as you don't kill me, please…"
Beau said nervously.
"If you knew this would happen, you shouldn't have done it in the first place!"
Connor replied in a low voice. With a wave of his right hand, a cold light flashed and pierced through Beau's forehead.
Beau's body slowly fell to the ground. Even as he died, his face was still filled with unwillingness. It was as if he had never thought that he would end up like this.
When the Collier family members saw this scene, their faces were filled with grief and anger. They wanted to charge forward to avenge Beau, but Connor was too strong. Even if they had ten thousand guts, they would never dare to charge forward.
Xandra took a deep breath and said, "Everything is finally over!"
"Yeah, in the future, the number one person in the ancient martial arts world of Sommervile is most probably Connor. Where will we old fellows put our faces?"
Haiven said.
"Don't forget what Mr. Collier Sr. said before he died. There are definitely more powerful cultivators than Connor in this world, but those people are just unwilling to show their faces!"
Xandra said expressionlessly.
"No matter what, in the eyes of ordinary martial artists, Connor is already the number one martial artist in Sommervile!"
Haiven looked at Connor and sighed in a low voice.
"The number one ancient martial artist of Sommervile!"
Xandra took a deep breath and said, "This is a goal that martial artists like you and me can never achieve in our entire lives. I didn't expect that it would be snatched away by a twenty-year-old young man. How ironic!"
"Yeah. Martial artists like us spend our entire lives on ancient martial arts cultivation. Unfortunately, we still can't be compared to those talented geniuses!"
Haiven nodded.
When Xandra and Haiven were talking, many cultivators had gathered around Connor to congratulate him.
After all, after today's battle, Connor was considered unparalleled in the ancient martial arts world of Sommervile. Therefore, these people would definitely think of ways to please Connor.
"Congratulations, Mr. McDonald, for defeating Walter Collier. In the future, the ancient martial artists in Sommervile will have to pay our respects to Mr. McDonald!"
An old man in a black robe walked up to Connor and said with a smile.
This old man was quite famous in Sommervile. He was the leader of an ancient martial arts sect. Although he could not be compared to the existence of the four major sects, it was considered one of the more famous sects in Sommervile. The number of disciples in the sect was also very terrifying.
Therefore, the words of this old man still carried a lot of weight. When everyone heard this old man's words, they all walked up to Connor and shouted, "Congratulations, Mr. McDonald!"
"..."
When Xandra saw this scene, she sighed deep down. If Yolanda could really get together with Connor, it would definitely be a great thing for the Profound Sect.
"Congratulations to Mr. McDonald for defeating Mr. Collier Sr.!"
At this moment, Haiven also walked up to Connor and whispered to him.
Connor looked at Haiven indifferently. He knew that Haiven had come here to support Beau.
"Thank you, Sect Leader Zurita!"
However, there were no grudges between Connor and Haiven. Moreover, Haiven had taken the initiative to come over and congratulate him, so Connor replied very politely.
"In the future, Sommervile's ancient martial arts sects will be led by you and the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Haiven sighed lightly. He didn't say anything else and walked away.
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at Haiven's back. He knew that Haiven had said those words just now to tell Connor where he stood.
The Snow Moon Sect would not oppose the Purple Cloud Sect, and he also hoped that Connor would not make things difficult for the Snow Moon Sect because of today's matter.
Connor did not have such thoughts in his heart. After all, he did not have much ambition. The reason why he had acted against Beau today was only because of some personal grudge. It had nothing to do with the Heavenly Sect.
"Everyone, quiet down!"
Since Haiven had misunderstood his intentions, then the other martial artists present were very likely to have a misunderstanding too. Therefore, in order to not cause unnecessary trouble, Connor planned to explain the situation to everyone.
"..."
After hearing Connor's words, all the martial artists present shut their mouths and looked at Connor.
"The reason why I attacked Beau today was because Beau had severely injured my fiancée and almost killed her a few months ago. I am here to avenge my fiancée. Everything I'm doing now is of my own accord, so it doesn't represent the entire Purple Cloud Sect!
"Also, don't worry. The order of the Sommervile ancient martial arts world will still be jointly managed by the four great sects. I am more of a businessman than a martial artist. I don't know much about Sommervile ancient martial arts, so I won't interfere too much in these matters!"
Connor looked at all the martial artists present and said expressionlessly.
For a moment, everyone present was stunned. They were also very shocked because no one had expected Connor to say such a thing.
Connor had just defeated Beau and Walter. If Connor took advantage of this opportunity to let the Purple Cloud Sect dominate, no one would dare to stand up and oppose it. However, Connor did not do so.
On the contrary, Connor was telling everyone that there was no change in Sommervile. The order of the Sommervile ancient martial arts world would not change because of what happened today.

chapters.title: Chapter 2033: Taking Advantage
chapters.content:
Chapter 2033: Taking Advantage
"Do you all understand what I said just now?"
Seeing that everyone was quiet, Connor could not help but frown and ask.
"Yes…"
"Mr. McDonald, we understand what you mean…"
Everyone did not hesitate and hurriedly replied.
"That's good. If there's nothing else, you can leave now. Next, I have to deal with the grudge between me and the Collier family!"
Connor said slowly.
When everyone heard Connor's words, they did not dare to continue staying here. They hurriedly turned around and descended the mountain.
"Master, are we leaving too?"
Yolanda hesitated for a moment before turning to Xandra.
"Let's wait a little longer!"
Xandra still had one more important thing to do, so of course she wouldn't leave.
"Alright!"
Yolanda nodded gently and stood quietly beside Xandra.
The cultivators who had gathered at the peak of the Heavenly Mountain started to walk down the mountain in groups of three to five.
"Mr. Wise, what did Mr. McDonald mean by what he said just now?"
"That's right. Does Mr. McDonald really not care about the ancient martial arts of Sommervile at all?"
Everyone could not help but start to guess what kind of unknown meaning Connor had behind his words just now.
"Everyone, I don't know what Mr. McDonald meant by what he said just now, but I know that no matter what Mr. McDonald says, in the future, the ancient martial arts in Sommervile will be dominated by the Purple Cloud Sect."
An old man said slowly.
"That's right. Even though Mr. McDonald said that the order would not change, the other major sects no longer have the ability to contend with the Purple Cloud Sect. The Purple Cloud Sect's Jorge Yarrell alone is terrifying enough. Although Jorge hasn't appeared for a long time, there's also the addition of Mr. McDonald. We really can't afford to offend the Purple Cloud Sect!"
A middle-aged man hurriedly said.
"When I go back, I must make my disciples behave. No matter who they provoke now, they must not provoke those people from the Purple Cloud Sect!"
"Yeah. Connor McDonald is an unreasonable person. Whoever provokes such a person is unlucky!"
Another middle-aged man hurriedly chimed in.
At this moment, it seemed that all the martial artists had their own plans. They could not offend the people of the Purple Cloud Sect no matter what. Not only could they not offend them, but they also had to do everything they could to please the Purple Cloud Sect.
It was already a foregone conclusion that the Purple Cloud Sect was the biggest sect in Sommervile. Unless a martial artist stronger than Connor appeared, this situation would not change easily.
"Everyone, you don't have to be too worried. After all, we're from small sects. As long as we don't provoke Mr. McDonald, he wouldn't make things too difficult for us!"
The old man who spoke earlier spoke again.
"That's right. Mr. McDonald won't even bother dealing with us…"
"Let's just be honest. These big shots have nothing to do with us!"
"It's a pity that the Collier family and the Heavenly Sect are in trouble!"
"They asked for it. If they didn't offend Mr. McDonald back then, how could these things have happened?"
Everyone discussed in low voices as they walked down the mountain.
On the other side, when Connor saw that those martial artists had already descended the mountain, he slowly turned to look at the Collier family members.
At this moment, the people of the Collier family were very nervous, because they had no idea how Connor planned to deal with them. Especially those from the side branch of the Collier family, their eyes were filled with fear as they looked at Connor, and their bodies couldn't help but tremble.
"Albert, will he really let us go?"
At this moment, a middle-aged man from the Collier family asked Albert Collier.
After all, Beau and Walter were already dead. Albert was now the backbone of the Collier family.
"How would I know!"
Albert gritted his teeth and replied softly.
Originally, Albert felt that if these martial artists had not left, Connor would not do anything to them. However, now that these martial artists had been chased down the mountain by Connor, no one knew what Connor planned to do next.
Connor walked up to the Collier family and looked at them calmly.
"Are you scared?"
Connor suddenly asked.
For a moment, everyone in the Collier family was stunned. They looked at Connor and trembled.
"Connor, you promised that as long as my grandfather told you all his secrets, you would let us go!"
Albert hesitated for a moment before he stepped forward and shouted at Connor through gritted teeth.
"Did I say I was going to kill you?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"..."
Albert could not help but take a deep breath when he heard Connor's words. The expression on his face seemed to have eased up a lot.
"I promised Walter that I would let you go, so I definitely won't make things difficult for you. However, you have to let Aida Collier come with me…"
Connor looked at Aida and said calmly.
"No problem!"
Albert agreed without hesitation. After all, he already knew about the relationship between Aida and Connor. Moreover, Aida was of no use to the Collier family now. Naturally, he would not keep Aida by his side.
"Also, in the future, all of the Collier family's businesses will be handed over to Aida. To put it bluntly, Aida will be the head of the Collier family in the future!"
Connor looked at Albert and continued.
"What!"
When Albert heard Connor's words, he was instantly stunned.
"You don't agree to it?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"Of course, not!"
Cielo Collier suddenly shouted from his wheelchair.
"If you didn't say anything, I would have forgotten about you!"
Connor slowly turned to look at Cielo and said with a smile.
"Connor, you killed my grandfather and my great-grandfather today. The Collier family can let you go, but why should we hand over our family business to this traitor? What's the difference between giving the Collier family's business to Aida and giving it to you? You're obviously taking advantage of us!"
Cielo glared at Connor and shouted angrily.
"Take advantage of you?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Cielo's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Do you think you still have the right to negotiate with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2034: Aida Collier's Revenge
chapters.content:
Chapter 2034: Aida Collier's Revenge
Cielo was dumbfounded when he heard that. His expression was extremely ugly.
For a moment, he didn't know how to answer Connor's question.
Connor didn't waste any more time with Cielo. He turned to Albert and asked softly, "Do you agree to my condition or not?"
Albert took a deep breath, then gritted his teeth and said to Connor, "Yes!"
"Dad!"
Cielo shouted when he heard this.
"Shut up. If I don't agree now, then everyone in the Collier family will die here. If you want to die, I won't stop you!"
Albert roared.
Cielo froze on the spot. He looked furious, but he did not know what to do.
"I'll leave these people from the Collier family to you!"
Connor looked at Aida and said.
When Aida heard Connor's words, a strange look flashed across her face. Among all the people present, only Aida knew what Connor meant.
Aida slowly walked out of the crowd and looked at Shereen Stevens and Cielo expressionlessly.
She had been waiting for this day for far too long. Now, she could finally avenge her mother.
Aida had dreamt of her revenge countless times, but she never thought it would be like this.
Shereen looked at Aida with a pale face. She seemed to have guessed what Aida would do next.
"Aida, what do you want?"
Albert was stunned for a moment, then asked Aida.
"Shut up!"
Aida scolded.
Albert froze on the spot. He knew that he was no longer the head of the Collier family. He had no right to threaten Aida.
Connor walked to Waverly Green's side and whispered a few words to her.
After that, Waverly took out a long sword and handed it to Aida.
Aida took the sword without hesitation.
At this moment, the Collier family finally realized what Aida was trying to do!
She was ready to take revenge!
"Connor, didn't you say you wanted to let the Collier family go? What... What do you mean by this?"
Albert was stunned for a moment, then he shouted at Connor exasperatedly.
"I've already let you off, right? I'm not the one who wants to take revenge on you!"
Connor said calmly.
"Why you…"
When Albert heard Connor's words, he was dumbfounded. For a moment, he did not know what to say.
After taking a deep breath, Aida looked at Shereen and said expressionlessly, "Did you think that this day would never come?"
"Aida, what… what are you doing? I've been good to you over the years, right? If I've done anything wrong, I'll apologize to you now, okay? Don't be rash..."
Shereen stammered.
"You've been good to me?"
Aida couldn't help but laugh coldly when she heard Shereen's words. Then, she said calmly, "Shereen Steven, you actually have the nerve to say that? Back then, my mother died in your hands, and you're saying that you've been good to me? Do you know that I've been thinking about how to avenge my mother for many years?"
"Aida, it's not what you think. You might have misunderstood the whole thing…"
Albert hurriedly said.
"Shut up!"
Aida shouted at Albert and continued, "Do you think you're any better? Back then, when Shereen Stevens killed my mother, you clearly knew about it, but you never stopped her. You were also involved in my mother's death!"
"..."
Albert was stunned.
He didn't think that Aida already knew about everything that had happened back then. Aida had been planning how to take revenge for so many years!
"Aida, I'm begging you. Can you let me go? I was wrong!"
Shereen kneeled in front of Aida and shouted at her.
"Do you really know what you did wrong?"
Aida sneered and said, "You killed my mother with your own hands, and then you were worried that I would fight with your son for the position of the head of the Collier family, so you hired an assassin to assassinate me. If it weren't for Connor, I might have died long ago."
When everyone heard Aida's words, they were all shocked because they didn't expect such a thing to happen to the famous York family.
"Aida, no matter what, we're family!"
Albert said powerlessly.
"Family?"
Aida smiled disdainfully and said lightly, "When have you ever treated me as family?"
After saying that, Aida lifted the sword and headed straight for Shereen. She had made up her mind that she had to settle things with the Collier family.
When Shereen saw Aida walking over, her face was filled with panic. She hurriedly shouted at the Collier family members beside her, "What are you all doing? Hurry up and stop her!"
After hearing Shereen's words, everyone from the Collier family hesitated. They didn't know if they should interfere in this matter or not.
"If anyone can help me stop this person, I'm willing to take out all my savings!"
Shereen saw that everyone was hesitating and hurriedly shouted.
Shereen was also from a big family, so her savings over the years were a terrifying figure. Otherwise, she wouldn't have given Connor two billion.
Therefore, the Collier family members were obviously tempted. They all stood in front of Aida and tried to persuade her to let Shereen go.
"I'm the head of the Collier family now. If you don't want to be chased out of the Collier family, then step aside!"
Aida was not in the mood, so she frowned and shouted.
When everyone heard Aida's words, they were all stunned. Although Shereen's offer was very tempting, if they could continue to stay in the Collier family's companies, they would definitely choose to stay in the Collier family.
Everyone made way for Aida.
Aida walked straight to Shereen with her sword in hand. Shereen's face was filled with fear as she took two steps back.

chapters.title: Chapter 2035: Go to Hell!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2035: Go to Hell!
"Aida, if you dare to touch my mother today, I won't let you off even if I die!"
Cielo shouted at Aida from his wheelchair.
"Do you think I'm scared of you?"
Aida replied coldly.
Cielo looked at Aida's face with fear. He opened his mouth and was about to speak.
Aida raised the sword in her hand and placed it against Shereen's neck.
Shereen was completely scared out of her wits by Aida. She stammered, "Aida, I was wrong. Please let me go."
"It's too late to realize your mistake now!"
Aida replied expressionlessly. Then, she exerted force on her right hand.
The sharp longsword slashed across Shereen's neck, and blood instantly splattered out. Aida watched as Shereen's body slowly fell to the ground. Her expression was so calm that it was terrifying.
Albert stood rooted to the ground in a daze, as if he could not believe what he was seeing.
Aida had actually killed Shereen!
Aida's movements were crisp and clean. It was as if this was not her first time killing someone. Her movements were so skillful that it was unbelievable.
Who would have thought that a woman like Aida would have the guts to kill someone!
However, they did not know that Aida had already repeated this action countless times in her heart. Moreover, Aida herself was also a martial artist despite her lower rank.
Albert was not the only one who could not accept this fact. Everyone in the Collier family seemed to be unable to accept this fact.
Cielo sat in his wheelchair with great anger written on his face. He shouted at Aida, "Aida, how dare you kill my mother! I'll kill you!"
After saying that, Cielo reached into his clothes and took out a pistol. He then aimed it at Aida's head.
Cielo had actually prepared this pistol for Connor. He planned to wait for Beau to defeat Connor before he personally dealt with Connor.
However, he never expected that the gun would be aimed at Aida's head.
When Aida saw Cielo holding the gun, her expression changed.
"Go to hell!"
Cielo shouted excitedly and pulled the trigger.
The bullet flew out of the barrel and was headed straight for Aida.
All of this happened very suddenly. The Collier family was not able to react to what was going on. They only heard a gunshot.
However, after the gunshot, Aida was still standing in the same place. She was not injured at all.
On the other hand, Cielo, who was sitting in the wheelchair, had his forehead pierced by the bullet he shot. After spitting out a mouthful of blood, he slowly closed his eyes.
Who would have thought that Cielo would die under his own bullet?
When Aida saw that Cielo was already dead, she quickly turned to look at Connor. She knew that in that situation, the only person who could save her and had the ability to save her was Connor.
The Collier family was instantly thrown into chaos. Connor didn't even make a move, but they were dropping like flies.
Albert stood rooted to the ground; devastation written all over his face.
Beau Collier was dead, Walter Collier was dead, Aida had seized all of the Collier family's properties, Shereen was dead, and finally, even his own son, Cielo, was dead. All of these things struck Albert one after another.
He did not even know how to describe his current feelings.
Albert couldn't help but recall the first time he saw Connor. At that time, Connor was just an insignificant person in Albert's eyes.
However, who would have thought that in less than a year, it was this small fry who had destroyed the Collier family?
If Albert was given another chance to choose, he would definitely not choose to deal with Connor.
The Collier family, which had been in Sommervile for decades, had completely fallen.
Albert took a deep breath, then slowly raised his head to look at Aida and said in a low voice, "Are you planning to kill me next?"
"The Collier family is where it is today all because of you. I won't kill you today. I want you to live in pain every day!"
Aida said expressionlessly.
"Why you…"
Alber was enraged. He threw his head back and spat out a mouthful of blood, then fainted.
Even though Albert was unconscious, no one dared to check on him. They knew that the real head of the Collier family was Aida.
"From today onward, I will be the head of the Collier family. What position all of you held in the Collier family before and what position you will hold in the future will not be affected."
Aida shouted expressionlessly.
"Understood…"
Hearing Aida's words, everyone felt much more at ease, and they replied loudly.
After that, Aida walked up to Connor and said softly to him, "Thank you for letting me take revenge!"
"There's no need to thank me!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"..."
Aida hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at the Collier family behind her and said softly, "I've been locked up on the Heavenly Mountain for a long time. There are probably a lot of things waiting for me to do. I'll be leaving now. If you need anything, you can call me!"
"Alright!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Aida didn't say anything else and led the Collier family down the mountain.
After Aida left, the grand guardian of the Heavenly Sect, Felton Carden, walked over to Connor with heavy steps and knelt down on the ground.
When the disciples of the Heavenly Sect saw this scene, they frowned, but no one dared to say anything.
Connor looked at Felton who was kneeling in front of him and said softly, "I have nothing against the people of the Heavenly Sect. I won't vent my anger on you because of what happened, so you don't have to do this!"
"Mr. McDonald, I'm not asking you to let us go. I know that you won't involve ordinary people like us in the grudges between the big shots, but I'm kneeling now because I have something to ask of you!"
Felton whispered to Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2036: Joining The Purple Cloud Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 2036: Joining The Purple Cloud Sect
"You need a favor?"
After hearing these words, Connor couldn't help but pause for a moment. Then he asked softly, "Do you have something to ask of me?"
"Mr. Connor, both of our sect's leaders have passed away, but there are still tens of thousands of disciples in the Heavenly Sect. As the Grand Guardian of the Heavenly Sect, I should take on this responsibility voluntarily and be responsible for these disciples," Felton said, kneeling before Connor and speaking in a very respectful tone.
"This is a matter concerning your Heavenly Sect, and it has nothing to do with me," Connor said indifferently.
"I understand, I understand," Felton hurriedly nodded and continued, "Mr. Connor, you may not know, but in recent years, our Heavenly Sect has offended many ancient martial sects in the Sommervile under the leadership of our sect leaders. I'm afraid that now, with both of our sect leaders gone, no one can deter those ancient martial sects in Sommervile. So, Mr. Connor, could you consider allowing our Heavenly Sect to join your Purple Cloud Sect?"
"Are you suggesting that all the members of your Heavenly Sect join the Purple Cloud Sect?" Connor furrowed his brow after understanding his intention.
"Yes, Mr. Connor, only in this way can we save the disciples of our Heavenly Sect. Otherwise, sooner or later, our Heavenly Sect will be divided up by the other ancient martial sects in Sommervile," Felton said to him.
After listening to his words, Connor was somewhat shocked because he didn't expect Felton to be willing to relinquish control of the Heavenly Sect, such a large family business, and proactively seek to join the Purple Cloud Sect. After all, if it were someone else, they would likely have already taken over the Heavenly Sect for themselves.
The disciples of the Heavenly Sect were also very grateful to Felton at this moment because if Connor agreed, then these people would not be greatly affected.
However, Felton wasn't entirely selfless. Over the years, he had helped the Collier family do many unscrupulous things using the strength of the Heavenly Sect. With Beau, a Grand Martial Master, in the picture, he didn't have to worry much. However, now that the sect no longer had a Grand Martial Master, even some smaller sects in Sommervile might be stronger. He naturally has to find a way to secure his position.
"I'm just the Sect Leader of the Purple Cloud Sect; I can't manage the affairs," Connor said after hesitating for a moment.
"But, Mr. Connor, if you agree, you will be saving all the people of our Heavenly Sect, and it won't cause any loss to your Purple Cloud Sect," Felton pleaded.
After a moment's hesitation, he turned to the Grand Guardian of the Purple Cloud Sect and asked softly, "Third Guardian, you have been managing the affairs of the Purple Cloud Sect from the beginning. What do you think about this?"
"Mr. Connor, if the Heavenly Sect wants to join our Purple Cloud Sect, it is possible, but they would become a branch of our Purple Cloud Sect," the Third Guardian replied. He was willing to accept Felton's proposal because he hoped that the Purple Cloud Sect would grow stronger.
"Alright..." After seeing that the Grand Guardian seemed inclined to accept the proposal, Connor nodded and said to Felton, "Starting today, your Heavenly Sect will be a branch of our Purple Cloud Sect, under our management. You will be responsible for the Heavenly Sect's affairs. If there are any specific issues, you can directly consult with our Grand Guardian."
"Thank you, Mr. Connor, thank you!" Felton was overjoyed and immediately kowtowed to Connor.
Connor looked at Felton with a faint expression, not saying much. He walked towards the members of the Purple Cloud Sect.
At this moment, the expressions on the faces of the Purple Cloud Sect disciples were all filled with excitement. After all, this matter had a significant impact on them. In the future, the Purple Cloud Sect would become the top martial sect in the Sommervile, and they were proud to be a part of it.
