"Third Guardian, why hasn't my master appeared for such a long time?" Connor walked up to him and asked softly.
"Well..." The Third Guardian hesitated when he heard Connor's question and then said in a low voice, "Sect Leader McDonald, I'm not very clear about the situation on the Leader's side."
"Are you not clear, or do you not want to tell me?" Connor could sense the Third Guardian's hesitance and decided to ask directly.
"Sect Leader McDonald, I..." The Grand Guardian began to speak, but before he could finish his sentence...
"Sect Leader McDonald, the Leader has gone on a treasure hunt!" The voice of the Third Guardian interrupted the Grand Guardian's words.
"A treasure hunt?" Connor paused for a moment when he heard this, his expression seeming somewhat puzzled.
"Yes, a treasure hunt," the Third Guardian nodded lightly and continued, "A while ago, the Sect Leader obtained a treasure map by chance, so he took the Deputy Sect Leader and went on a treasure hunt. However, because the journey was quite far, they haven't returned yet..."
"I see," Connor nodded, as if he believed the Grand Guardian's explanation, and didn't ask further.
Besides, he had many things on his plate at the moment, and he simply didn't have the inclination to inquire further about Jorge's situation.
The Third Guardian, observing Connor's somewhat unusual expression, took a deep breath but remained silent.
"Sect Leader McDonald, what are your plans for the future? Would you like to visit our sect internally? After all, you just defeated Beau and Andreas, and the disciples within our sect would surely be very excited to meet you!" the Grand Guardian said with a cheerful tone.
"This matter isn't urgent. There will be opportunities in the future. Right now, I intend to return to Yarlford to handle some personal matters," Connor refused directly.
However, deep down, Connor felt somewhat awkward because, as the Sect Leader McDonald of the Purple Cloud Sect, he had never visited the sect before. The members of the Purple Cloud Sect had gone out of their way to assist him on several occasions, yet he had never personally met them.
"Right, when the opportunity arises, you should prioritize your personal matters," the Grand Guardian agreed and nodded with a smile.
"Waverly, could you please help me book a flight to Yarlford as soon as possible? The sooner, the better!" Connor asked Waverly.
"Is it really that urgent?" she asked in surprise.
"Yes, there are many matters in Yarlford that require my attention. Once I've taken care of them, I'll come to visit your sect," he replied softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2037: Marry Her To Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2037: Marry Her To Me?
Waverly hesitated for a moment but didn't say anything.
Actually, she was still very worried about him.
After all, he had just experienced a terrifying battle.
However, he must have been seriously injured at this time, so she hoped that he could go to the Purple Cloud Sect to recuperate for a period of time.
However, she also knew that even he wouldn't listen, so she might as well not say it.
He hesitated for a moment, then walked down the mountain.
"Mr. Connor, can you stay?"
Xandra suddenly shouted.
Connor turned to her and asked softly, "Sect Leader Xandra, what's the matter?"
In fact, Connor had already noticed Xandra and Yolanda. After all, among the martial artists who came to watch the battle today, the number of female martial artists was still very small. Xandra was able to sit on equal footing with Zhao Hebi and was looked up to by tens of thousands of people, which was even more eye-catching.
Moreover, Xandra and Yolanda were both wearing veils, giving off a very mysterious feeling. People couldn't help but take a second look at them, wondering what kind of beautiful faces were behind the white veils.
"I have something to say to Mr. Connor alone. I wonder if you're willing to spare a few minutes?"
Xandra said calmly.
Hearing her words, he couldn't help but turn to look at Waverly and the others.
"Sect Leader McDonald, we will wait for you at the foot of the mountain!"
The Great Guardian knew that Xandra was no match for Connor, so she probably wouldn't do anything to him.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded.
Waverly, on the other hand, had an unwilling expression on her face. She pursed her lips and followed the crowd down the mountain.
"Boss, why do you think Sect Leader Xandra is looking for Sect Leader McDonald at this time?"
The Third Guardian asked the Great Guardian with a smile.
"I don't know…"
The Great Guardian smiled and shook his head.
"What else could it be? It must be that they want to rely on the Sect Leader McDonald because of his power. What else do the women in the Profound Sect know besides seducing men?"
Waverly pouted.
"Hahaha…"
When the Third Guardian heard her words, he could not help but laugh out loud.
The Great Guardian scolded in a low voice, "Waverly, there are some things that you should not say. Be careful not to let others hear you!""
"So what if I heard it? They don't even mind being embarrassed, so why can't I say it?" she replied directly.
The Great Guardian looked at her helplessly.
..
On the other side, after Connor saw that the people of Purple Cloud Sect had left, he asked Xandra softly, "Sect Leader Xandra, what do you want to tell me?"
She turned to look at him, then reached out and took the white sand in front of him.
He glanced at her indifferently. Although she was not young anymore, she was still very beautiful. Her skin was as delicate as a twenty-year-old girl.
"I haven't shown my true face to anyone for a long time!" she said to him.
"What's the real purpose of you looking for me?"
Although he admitted that she was indeed very beautiful, he was not interested in an old woman who was much older than his mother.
"Mr. Connor, I'm actually looking for you for one thing. The Profound Sect wishes to form a marriage alliance with the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Xandra didn't waste any time and directly stated his purpose.
"Marriage?"
Connor was speechless when he heard Xandra's words. He frowned and said, "I've already said it before. Although I'm the Sect Leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, I'm actually not in charge of tit. If you want a marriage alliance, then you can directly discuss it with the Great Guardian."
"Mr. Connor, I have to tell you this personally!"
Xandra said seriously.
"Why?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Because the person our Profound Sect wants to form the marriage is you, Mr. Connor!"
Xandra replied to Connor without hesitation, then waved at Yolanda behind him.
Yolanda walked up to him and gently lifted the white veil in front of her.
When he saw her appearance, he was instantly stunned.
Yolanda was indeed very beautiful. Her facial features were exquisite to the point of being impeccable. Her beautiful eyes were as bright as the stars, her delicate nose, and her cherry lips that emitted a rosy luster seemed to have been carefully designed. Even the most perfect plastic surgery hospital in the world might not be able to design such a beautiful woman.
Connor had seen too many beautiful women, but when he saw Yolanda, he still couldn't help but feel that she was beautiful. It was as if she was a real fairy standing in front of him.
"Mr. Connor, this is my disciple and the future sect leader of the Profound Sect, Yolanda. I wish to betroth Yolanda to you and complete the marriage between the Profound Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect!"
Xandra was very pleased when he noticed that Connor was looking at Yolanda strangely.
She was very confident in Yolanda because she felt that no man in the world could reject a beauty like Yolanda.
"You want to marry her to me?"
After Connor understood what was going on, his eyes widened in disbelief.
"No, are you kidding me? You actually intend to marry this girl to me?"
Connor pointed at Yolanda and asked in surprise.
"Mr. Connor, do you think there's something wrong?"
Xandra asked.
"It's not that there's anything wrong with it. It's just that I don't know this girl at all. This is the first time we've met. More importantly, I already have a fiancée…"
At this moment, Connor was at a loss. How could he have expected Xandra to tell him these things?
Yolanda was stunned when she saw Connor. She didn't seem to know that Connor already had a fiancée.
"Mr. Connor, you already have a fiancée?"
Xandra was obviously stunned by Connor's words, and his expression was a little strange.
"Yes, I already have a fiancée, and I have a very good relationship with her. Therefore, I can't marry into your sect. If you really want to marry into the Purple Cloud Sect, you can discuss it with the Great Guardian!"
Connor said to Xandra in a serious tone.
Xandra took a deep breath and apologised, "I'm really sorry. I didn't expect Mr. Connor to have a fiancée!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2038: Marriage Alliance
chapters.content:
Chapter 2038: Marriage Alliance
Although Xandra really wanted Yolanda to marry Connor, she didn't want to ruin other people's relationship and let Yolanda be the homewrecker.
Not only would Yolanda not be able to accept it, but even she would not be able to accept it.
"It's okay. If there's nothing else, I'll leave first!"
Connor did not expect Xandra to not pester him, so he turned around and prepared to leave.
She looked at his back with a look of despair.
"It seems like our sect really has no chance…" she sighed softly.
Yolanda bit her lip and shouted at Connor, "Mr. Connor, please wait a moment!"
This was the first time Yolanda had spoken. Her voice was ethereal but cold.
"Is there anything else?"
Connor turned to look at Yolanda and asked softly.
She took a deep breath, then stepped forward and said to Connor, "It doesn't matter if you have a fiancée. I can be your lover. A man like you should have a lot of women by your side. It doesn't matter if you have me, as long as you can protect the Profound Sect!"
He stared at her and was stunned as he didn't expect her to say such a thing.
Not to mention Connor, even Xandra, who knew Yolanda the best, found it unbelievable. In her impression, Yolanda was very arrogant. Logically speaking, she would not have made such a choice.
"Yolanda, since Mr. Connor already has a fiancée, there's no need for you to embarrass yourself like this!"
Xandra said, her heart breaking.
"Master, I understand what you mean. However, if sacrificing me can allow our sect to continue existing, I am willing to make the sacrifice!"
Yolanda said seriously.
Xandra stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to say.
"I don't need a title. As long as you can protect the Profound Sect, I will do anything you want!"
She looked at Connor and said.
"I think you might have misunderstood. I'm not the kind of person you think I am, and I'm not interested in you!"
Connor knew that Yolanda and Xandra wanted to use him, so his tone was obviously much more serious.
Yolanda was instantly stunned on the spot. She never thought that he would reject her here. She had clearly made a great sacrifice.
"I've already made things very clear to the two of you. I already have a fiancée and I'm not interested in other women. Also, I don't like people using me. If you didn't say that, I might have helped you if you were in danger on account of the good relationship between the Profound Sect and the Purple Cloud Sect. Then don't blame me for being heartless. In the future, the Purple Cloud Sect will have nothing to do with the Profound Sect!"
Connor looked at Xandra and said seriously.
"Mr. Connor, you might have misunderstood…"
Yolanda seemed to realize that she had said something wrong and hurriedly tried to explain.
"I didn't misunderstand, and you don't need to explain!" he replied expressionlessly, then directly walked down the mountain.
Yolanda saw that Connor was about to leave and quickly chased after him. However, Xandra reached out to stop her and said softly, "There is no need to chase after him…"
"Master, I said something wrong just now!"
Yolanda said with a guilty expression.
"This matter has nothing to do with you. I didn't investigate the situation properly before. If I had known that Connor already had a fiancée, I wouldn't have said those words to him just now!" Xandra said.
"That's because I said something wrong just now!"
Yolanda took a deep breath and continued, "I was too emotional just now, so I accidentally said those words. The tie between Profound Sect and Purple Cloud Sect was on a tight rope before. However, after I said those words just now, I have directly angered him…"
Xandra looked at Yolanda helplessly. At this moment, she had no intention of blaming Yolanda at all.
After all, she knew her personality very well. She knew that it was too difficult for Yolanda to do such a thing. It was normal for her to be agitated just now.
"Master, I will definitely think of a way to fix this!"
Yolanda said firmly to Xandra.
"Things have already come to this. How can you fix it?"
Xandra smiled bitterly.
"There will definitely be a way…"
Yolanda looked down the mountain, deep in thought.
..
Connor went down the mountain after parting ways with Yolanda and Xandra. The Grand Guardian, the Third Guardian, Waverly, and the others were also waiting for Connor at the foot of the mountain.
"Sect Leader McDonald, you're here."
The Grand Guardian took a step forward and said.
"Yes!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Sect Leader McDonald, why are the people from the Profound Sect looking for you?"
The Grand Guardian looked at him and continued to ask.
"For a marriage alliance!"
Connor didn't hide anything and directly replied.
"Marriage alliance?"
Everyone was stunned when they heard his words. Their expressions were filled with disbelief because they did not expect the Profound Sect to find him for this reason.
"I've already said it before. The people from the Profound Sect only know how to seduce men."
Waverly pouted and shouted.
The Grand Guardian turned to look at Waverly and said in a low voice, "Waverly, there are some things that you shouldn't casually say…"
"Sect Leader McDonald, since the people from the Profound Sect want to have a marriage alliance with the Purple Cloud Sect, will you agree?"
She looked up at Connor and asked softly.
"I already have a fiancée. How can I agree?"
He replied indifferently and then continued, "However, if the people from the Profound Sect still want to form a marriage alliance with our Purple Cloud Sect, I will let them discuss this with the Grand Guardian. After all, the Profound Sect is not weak. If the two sects can really come together, it can be considered a good thing. However, I will not participate in the marriage!"
"Sect Leader McDonald, I understand what you mean…"
The Grand Guardian hurriedly nodded at Connor.
"Is there anything else? If there's nothing else, send me to the airport!"
Connor did not talk too much about this matter with everyone. After all, it was better to leave the Purple Cloud Sect's matters to the Grand Guardian and the others to manage.

chapters.title: Chapter 2039: Yolanda's Difficulties
chapters.content:
Chapter 2039: Yolanda's Difficulties
"Are you really going back, Sect Leader McDonald? Aren't you going to take a few days off?"
Waverly was concerned about Connor as she questioned him quietly.
"I've already taken a few days off. There are still many things in Yarlford that I need to deal with!" he said.
"Alright, then!"
She didn't say anything further and nodded gently when she noticed that his stance remained steadfast.
The pupil of the Heavenly Sect sent him to the airport. Waverly had intended to accompany Connor to Yarlford, but he believed that his present condition was not dire and that there should be no risk, so he declined.
He entered the departure lounge alone after arriving at the airport.
He closed his eyes and relaxed after entering the departure lounge. Although he claimed that his physique was alright, he was exhausted after such an intensive combat.
It had been more than an hour since he had last opened his eyes.
Connor checked the time. There was roughly a ten-minute wait before boarding.
"Are you awake, Sir?"
At this point, a really attractive waitress in uniform approached Connor and murmured quietly to him.
"Yes!"
Connor nodded as he glanced at the waitress.
"Then I'll take you to the airport to board the plane!"
The waiter proceeded quickly.
"Good!"
Connor agreed and proceeded to the boarding gate with the hostess.
The ticket was purchased by Waverly. The Purple Cloud Sect was now very wealthy, thus they would never reserve an economy class ticket for Connor. Instead, they booked him a first-class ticket.
After entering the first-class cabin, he discovered that this flight's first-class cabin was unlike any other since his seat was in an exclusive private compartment with just two chairs.
"Mr. Connor, someone has already helped you complete the upgrade and paid the fee, so this is your seat!"
The flying stewardess approached Connor and whispered to him.
"Someone upgraded for me?"
When he heard the stewardess' comments, he couldn't help but be taken aback.
"That's exactly right!"
The flight stewardess nodded and stared at him.
He knew nothing about flying. He just knew that upgrading meant changing from economy to first class, so he assumed Waverly had booked incorrectly and then upgraded herself, so he didn't continue to inquire.
"Mr. Connor, if you have any orders, you can call me at any time!"
The stewardess went on.
"Alright!"
Connor agreed and took his seat.
He sat down, closed his eyes, and prepared to begin cultivating.
However, before he could reach the cultivation stage, he heard the sound of high heels striking the ground, followed by the scent of flowers.
"Miss Yolanda, your seat is here!"
The voice of the flight stewardess who had previously greeted Connor rang out.
"Miss Yolanda?"
He couldn't help but be taken aback when he heard the nme. Then, unconsciously, he turned his head to look, and he saw a stunningly attractive lady standing near the flight attendant. Connor recognized this attractive lady as Yolanda from the Profound Sect even though she was wearing sunglasses.
She had already changed into her regular clothes. She was dressed in a long white gown, with her black hair loosely thrown over her shoulders. Her lovely face was hidden by sunglasses, yet it couldn't disguise her attractiveness.
"Why are you here?"
With a bewildered expression on his face, Connor inquired.
She didn't haste to respond to his query. Instead, she turned to face the hostess and quietly stated, "There's nothing else for you to do here. You can go now!"
"Alright, Miss Yolanda!"
The stewardess turned to depart after nodding to Yolanda.
"Do you mind if I sit next to you, Mr. Connor?"
Yolanda approached him and asked him respectfully.
"If this is your seat, then sit down!" he said flatly.
"Thank you!"
She smiled and seated elegantly next him.
"Why are you here?" he inquired.
"I'm here to see you, Mr. Connor!"
She didn't seem to be trying to conceal anything from him and responded frankly.
"Looking for me?"
When Connor heard Yolanda's remarks, he was taken aback. Then, nonchalantly, he remarked, "I've already made it clear to your master about the marriage alliance. Because I have a fiancée, I am unable to marry into the Profound Sect. More significantly, I despise being exploited by others. If you're here for this, I recommend you return!"
Yolanda shifted her gaze into the cabin. After ensuring that no one else was there, she removed her sunglasses and remarked to him solemnly, "Mr. Connor, I said something wrong before. I sincerely apologize to you!"
"This is not a problem of saying the wrong thing!"
"Mr. Connor, I will agree to any conditions you propose as long as you can protect the Profound Sect." I am available to be your lover. I don't care about your rank as long as you safeguard the Profound Sect!"
She pleaded him with her eyes.
He couldn't help but be taken aback when he heard her comments. Then he scowled and said, "For the sake of the Profound Sect, you are willing to make such a huge sacrifice?"
"Yes, as long as Mr. Connor can protect the Profound Sect, I will do anything!" she firmly proclaimed.
Connor appeared perplexed by the expression on her face. He couldn't comprehend why someone would prioritize their sect's existence above their own innocence.
Furthermore, he had the impression that Yolanda had made up her mind when she stated these words. She doesn't seem to be the kind of lady who would willingly sell her body.
"The Profound Sect is my master's blood and sweat." My master, on the other hand, is becoming old. In the future, I shall take over the Profound Sect from her. Regrettably, I am not an expert in old martial arts. My ability in ancient martial arts is not even equivalent to that of many of the sect's students. As a result, once I am appointed Sect Leader of the Profound Sect, the Guardian Disciples of the Profound Sect will be quite upset. Our Profound Sect will be shattered by then. Mr. Connor, please help me safeguard my master's life's work. I'm pleading with you."
Yolanda seemed to be becoming more distraught as she talked. She nearly sobbed at the end.

chapters.title: Chapter 2040: Follow Me Around?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2040: Follow Me Around?
Connor received the impression that Yolanda must have felt she had no option but to sell her body.
"No matter how difficult some things are, as an adult, you still have to rely on yourself to solve them," he sympathized. What's the point of pleading with me now? Your master isn't that old, and you should have plenty of time ahead of you. You may utilize this time to build yourself up."
"It is too late..."
"I don't have your talent in ancient martial arts, Mr. Connor," she said, shaking her head in despair. Even if I were given 50 years, it is possible that I would take a long time to become an old martial arts grandmaster. Furthermore, the Profound Sect is now dealing with both internal and external issues. Even if I fix those difficulties inside the group, others outside will still be coveting us!"
"Given your lack of aptitude, why did your master choose you as the next Sect Leader of the Profound Sect?" She had enough time to train a new applicant!"
Connor frowned and inquired, a little perplexed.
Yolanda softly bit her lower lip after hearing her comments. Her face was a bit apprehensive.
"It's fine if you don't want to answer my question!" he murmured quietly, sensing her hesitancy.
She took a big breath and stared at him. Then she said quietly, "Mr. Connor, if I tell you why, I hope you won't tell anyone!"
"Don't be alarmed; I'm not as bored as you think. Furthermore, I am unfamiliar with the situation in the Profound Sect. Even if I wanted to tell someone, I don't know who to tell!" he said flatly.
"Actually, I'm the master's daughter!"
Yolanda turned to face Connor and said.
"So, that's how it is!"
He nodded slightly, but he showed no surprise. On the contrary, his demeanor was serene.
"Mr. Connor, aren't you surprised?" she inquired, perplexed.
"I had previously predicted that this would happen. Furthermore, there's nothing to be astonished about, is there?" he stated it softly.
"You... You don't feel surprised at all?"
Yolanda fixed her huge, tearful eyes on Connor. Her face was filled with astonishment.
"What's there to be surprised about?"
He questioned, looking at her.
She was dumbfounded this time. She wasn't expecting such a response from him.
"Mr. Connor, you may be unaware that disciples of the Profound Sect are not permitted to marry or have children." If they are found, they will be imprisoned in the dungeon for the rest of their life..." she stated pathetically to him.
"I see!"
Connor stared at her, nodded, and quietly said, "So you can't tell anyone you're your master's daughter, right?" Otherwise, your master will suffer the consequences!"
"Yes! Mr. Connor, I've told you this secret so please keep this a secret!"
"Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about this!"
He gave her a small grin before assessing her. He understood that, despite her appearance as a chilly and sophisticated fairy, her thoughts were really incredibly basic and naïve. This might be why she said that she wanted to marry him!
"That's good to hear..."
Yolanda gave Connor a kind grin.
"Since the Profound Sect disciples are not permitted to marry or have children, why did your master allow you to be with me?" he inquired.
"Because you are the marriage partner, Mr. Connor." As long as my master informs the others in our sect that you made the initiative to propose the marriage, they will be scared to say anything because they are terrified of your might!"
"Moreover, if you truly agree to the marriage, then I will be your woman," Yolanda said after a little pause. Even if they had the courage, they would not put me in the dungeon!"
Connor glanced at her hopelessly and grinned. He was at a loss for words.
Xandra was a cunning lady meanwhile Yolanda was too ignorant to see the solution she had devised. Yolanda had previously told him all she knew, and all he did was just inquire lightly on the situation.
This might have anything to do with her surroundings. She had been at Xandra's side since she was a child, and she had seldom socialized with others, so she was naturally quite naive.
"What are you laughing about, Mr. Connor? Did I say something incorrectly just now?" She wondered.
"No…"
He shook his head and added, "I believe you're a good person. We may be friends, but I will not be with you, and I will not allow you to be my lover. You should call it quits on the marriage as soon as feasible!"
"I just can't give up!"
Yolanda gave Connor a determined look.
"It's not a question of whether or not you want to give up. It's simply that I won't agree no matter what you do. You can't possibly tie me up and let me be with you," he answered flatly.
"I'm not Mr. Connor's match. Of course, I wouldn't dare to do so, but I also won't give up. My master said that you are the only one capable of saving the Profound Sect!"
"You may not agree now, but it doesn't matter," Yolanda said after a little pause. "I'll just follow you around! I believe you'll agree sooner or later."
"You'll be following me around?"
When Connor heard Yolanda's remarks, he was dumbfounded.
"That's correct. I don't intend to return this time. I'll follow you wherever you go. I'll always be there for you," she said solemnly.
He couldn't say anything as he looked at her exquisite face.
"Aren't you afraid I'll kill you out of rage?" he inquired quietly.
"I'm sorry if I offended you, Mr. Connor. Despite the fact that I am following you, I will not interfere with whatever you do. If you truly want to murder me, do it!"
Yolanda even placed her neck in front of Connor while she talked, as if she was at his mercy.

chapters.title: Chapter 2041: Pure Lotus Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 2041: Pure Lotus Sect
"You…"
Connor was speechless when he heard this.
Of course, he wouldn't really murder Yolanda. Furthermore, he was confronted with such a lovely, charming, and simple-minded young lady.
He was certain that no one could hurt her.
He also held no resentment towards her or the Profound Sect. Of certainly, he would not murder an innocent person.
"Come along if you want to follow me. Anyway, whatever you do, I'm not going to agree!"
He hurled this phrase at her, leaving her stunned. He then closed his eyes and was ready to start farming.
She stopped bothering him when she saw he was going to farm. She put on her headphones and listened to music instead.
..
On the other hand, just as Connor was enmeshed with Yolanda, word of Connor's victory against Beau and Walter traveled like wildfire across Sommervile.
After all, this may be the first actual combat between Celestial Ancient Martial Masters, and the victor would immediately become Sommervile's number one ancient martial artist.
After so many years, the debate over who was the greatest ancient martial artist had never ended. This was due to the fact that there were still numerous Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Masters. Most people, though, thought Connor's master, Jorge, was the best.
However, following this combat, practically everyone felt that Connor was Sommervile's genuine number one martial artist.
For a while, Sommervile's old martial arts factions started to gather precise knowledge about this conflict. Some others even started looking into Connor's identity.
This struggle had far-reaching consequences that Connor could not have predicted.
"Connor actually defeated Walter?"
"Wasn't Walter already gone? How come he's still alive?"
"It is said that Walter made his death public in order to avoid being pursued by a more powerful cultivator. He has spent so many years in isolation at Heavenly Mountain. Walter would not have made a move this time if Beau wasn't about to be murdered by Connor!"
"What a shame. He'd just emerged from his isolation and had been defeated by Connor. Furthermore, he failed badly..."
"I never imagined there would be a Celestial Ancient Martial Master in this world." It's very incredible..."
"A Celestial Ancient Martial Master is worthless. I heard that there is an even higher title following the Celestial Ancient Martial Master, the Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts!"
Similar opponents arose in a variety of locations. The conclusion of this conflict had clearly astonished the majority of people.
This was due to their perception of a Celestial Ancient Martial Master as an indestructible being. Who could have predicted that Walter would still be defeated by Connor?
"I heard Connor is only 20 years old. How can he be so terrifyingly strong at such an old age?"
"Yeah, this is incredible. We've worked hard for half our lives, yet we're still inferior to a little child. "What exactly is going on?"
"Not only are we inferior to him, but we are probably even inferior to the ants in front of him!"
"Yeah, the gap between us and him is like heaven and earth!"
"In all these years in Sommervile, a genius like him has only appeared once. We ordinary folks can only envy him!"
Everyone let out a quiet sigh.
Despite the fact that everyone was questioning his strength, he was still the victor of this combat. As a result, these guys had long planned to gain favor with him. Even if they couldn't contact him, they needed to gain favor with the Purple Cloud Sect.
In Yarlford.
Yamino had just gotten off the aircraft from an overseas trip and raced directly to Gomez Corporation since he had already heard the company's vice president's latest report on the Gomez family.
The treachery of the four great families, Aida's betrayal, and the big alteration in the Collier family had all left him feeling tremendously uncomfortable. He had no idea so much would happen in less than two months after he had departed.
He seems to have finally comprehended how scary his opponent, Connor, was at this point.
In the office of Gomez Corporation's general manager.
Juan was now conversing with a middle-aged male. His face looked abnormally serious.
This was due to the fact that this middle-aged guy was also a martial artist. Furthermore, he had observed the confrontation between Connor and Walter. He was conveying the matter to Juan at the time.
The office door was pulled open unexpectedly from the outside. Juan seemed irritated. He frowned and yelled, "Didn't I already say that if there's nothing important, don't disturb me!"
"Have you forgotten that this is my office?"
Yamino, who had just entered the room, responded harshly. He was clearly still unsatisfied with Juan's performance during this time period.
"Dad, how come you're back?"
Juan turned to face Yamino, his expression filled with incredulity.
"Connor would have chased the Gomez family out of Yarlford if I hadn't returned soon!"
Yamino said quietly.
Juan was terrified when he heard this. He rose up quickly and moved in front of Yamino. Then he said, "Dad, it's not what you think..."
"OK, you don't have to explain anything to me anymore. The majority of the problem is already clear to me. Despite the fact that the four great families have betrayed us, this is a minor issue."
Yamino was in no mood to waste time just now. He needed to grab the opportunity to comprehend Connor's individual circumstance and respond.
"Dad, this is Pure Lotus Sect Leader Samuel Wonders. During this time, I phoned Sect Leader Samuel to better grasp the situation between the Collier family and Connor!"
Juan presented the office's middle-aged guy.
"Hello, Mr. Yamino!"
Samuel went out of his way to welcome Yamino.
"There's no need for formality, Sect Leader Samuel. I'll have to bother you to tell me everything about the epic fight between Connor and the Colliers..."
Yamino was obviously not in the mood to talk to Samuel at this time. He sat down on the couch and spoke to Samuel.
"Alright…"
Samuel nodded and then detailed the conflict between Connor and Walter over Yamino.
Yamino's demeanor was calm as he realized what was going on, but he was startled in his heart. He had never imagined that Connor could undergo such a terrible transformation in such a short amount of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 2042: Hiding
chapters.content:
Chapter 2042: Hiding
When Yamino left Yarlford, Connor was still just an ordinary warrior.
He didn't pay any attention to Connor because their Gomez family also had many ancient martial arts masters. Even Jorge didn't dare to easily take action against the Gomez family.
But he never thought that Connor's current strength had reached such a terrifying level.
"Sect Leader Samuel, thank you!" Yamino said softly to Samuel.
"You're welcome, if there's nothing else, I'll take my leave..." Samuel understood Yamino's meaning and quickly stood up.
"Juan, see Sect Leader Samuel off!" Yamino said expressionlessly.
"Alright..." Juan agreed and then escorted Samuel out of the office.
Yamino sat alone on the sofa, contemplating a strategy.
A few minutes later, Juan returned to the office and said anxiously to Yamino, "Dad, things are not looking good. Aida is working for Connor. Now, all the people from the Collier family have been killed by Connor, and Aida has taken control of the Collier family's assets. I think Aida will definitely stop cooperating with us. What should we do about our business?"
"Do you still have the heart to think about business at a time like this?" Yamino responded coldly.
"What else can we do?" Juan hesitated for a moment, looking puzzled.
"Now it's not about business at all!" Yamino sighed deeply and then said in a low voice, "The point is that Connor has become the number one martial artist in Sommervile. Our situation is extremely dangerous!"
"But he's just the number one martial artist in Sommervile, right? Don't we have many ancient martial arts masters in the Gomez family? Even if he's formidable, can he really take on both of us?" Juan said casually.
"You, you've been with me for so many years, and you still haven't improved at all?" Yamino, already quite irritated, responded.
Juan was about the same age as Connor, but the difference between them was like night and day.
"Do you think our Gomez family's ancient martial arts masters can't handle Connor?" Juan finally realized the seriousness of the situation. He had previously believed that Connor's greatest skill was causing the four major families to betray the Gomez family. He had never imagined that it was just the beginning.
"The entire Heaven Sect couldn't fight Connor. Do you think our family's warriors can stand against him?" Yamino directly retorted.
"Well..." Juan was stunned, his expression filled with disbelief. He had never imagined that Connor's strength had already reached such terrifying levels.
"And it's said that he is also a Soul Eater. If that information is true, even the Blood Moon Cult can't compete with him. What do we have to play with against Connor?" Yamino continued.
"So, Dad, what should we do now?" Juan asked anxiously.
At this moment, Juan finally understood the severity of the situation. Previously, he had focused most of his attention on business, but now he realized that the more critical issue was Connor's terrifying strength, which could directly threaten their lives.
"If Connor returns to Yarlford and directly targets our family, we could be in serious danger," Yamino said emotionlessly.
"Dad, what should we do now? Should you hide, while I stay here so at least you'll be safe?" Juan hurriedly suggested.
"Hide?" Yamino couldn't help but chuckle at his words, then said calmly, "In this situation, where do you think I can hide? Besides, I can't hide forever. Once I leave Yarlford now, it might not be so easy to return."
"Dad, we'll definitely have a chance to deal with Connor. Your hiding would only be temporary!" Juan persuaded in a hushed tone.
"Even if I agree to hide for a while, the people from Rockefeller won't likely consent!" Yamino shook his head again without hesitation, his expression showing a sense of helplessness.
Juan took a deep breath, unsure of what to say. After all, no one could have anticipated that Connor would grow so rapidly in such a short time.
Initially, he thought Connor's main motive was merely causing the four major families to betray the Gomez family. He had never imagined it was just the beginning.
"Dad, since you don't agree to hide for a while, should we consider how to deal with Connor? After all, he's very likely to come after us once he's done with the Collier family!" Juan suggested in a low voice.
Yamino took a deep breath and then said in a low voice, "His current strength is extremely terrifying. He might even be considered the number one martial artist in Sommervile. So if we were to seek help from Sommervile's martial artists, they wouldn't be a match for him, and they might not even dare to come."
"What should we do then?" Juan asked anxiously.
"You should go out for now. I'll make a phone call," Yamino said in a low voice.
"Are you planning to call Asya?" Juan asked hurriedly.
"Yes," Yamino confirmed.
"In this situation, we can only seek Asya's help. Hopefully, he'll intervene for the sake of Grandfather," Juan said, then left the office.
Seeing Juan leave, Yamino walked to the safe, opened it, and took out a very old-looking mobile phone.
This phone was used by Yamino to contact some high-ranking members of Asya and Rockefeller. Although it looked outdated, its security was top-notch. It used a foreign SIM card, so there was no need to worry about wiretapping.
Yamino skillfully dialed a number and then waited expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2043: Going to Stormbound Tower
chapters.content:
Chapter 2043: Going to Stormbound Tower
"Hello?"
Before long, a voice filled with age and experience came from the other end of the phone.
"Asya, I need your help right now. I've run into a tricky situation," Yamino got straight to the point.
"What exactly happened?" Asya asked calmly.
Yamino briefly organized his thoughts and proceeded to explain everything about Connor.
"You just mentioned that this Connor is Paxton's son. Why didn't you tell me this right away?" Asya asked with a furrowed brow.
"I thought I could handle Connor on my own at first, but I never expected him to grow so rapidly in less than two years, to the point where I can't deal with him," Yamino replied directly.
"You were too ambitious," Asya remarked.
"I know I made a mistake," Yamino admitted.
"It's good that you realize it. We've known each other for many years, and I know your character well," Asya said. "You mentioned earlier that this Connor defeated a Heaven-Ranked Ancient Martial Grandmaster. Is that correct?"
"Yes, not only a Celestial Ancient Martial master, but he also killed the leader of the Blood Moon Sect," Yamino quickly confirmed.
"That indicates his strength is indeed terrifying," Asya acknowledged.
"Asya, I know it's against our Rockefeller's rules to ask for help like this, but his power is truly terrifying, and I can't handle him. Please, for the sake of my father, help me," Yamino said with a deep breath.
"I'll explain the situation to Mr. Long. If Connor is indeed a Heaven-Ranked Ancient Martial Grandmaster and Paxton's son, Mr. Long won't allow him to live in this world. Besides, he would have a reason to eliminate Connor. Be cautious during this time," Asya advised in a hushed tone.
"When can Mr. Long send someone?" Yamino inquired urgently.
"Within a week," Asya replied.
"Asya, thank you so much. I'm truly grateful," Yamino expressed his gratitude.
"Don't be so formal," Asya replied calmly and hung up the phone.
Yamino took a deep breath as he looked at his phone. He knew that with Mr. Long's intervention, Connor's days might be numbered. However, it would take some time for Mr. Long's people to arrive, and if Connor decided to come after him during this period, his situation could still be very dangerous.
"Juan, come in!" Yamino called out in a low voice.
"Dad, what's going on?" Juan walked into the office.
"I just spoke with Asya on the phone. Mr. Long's men will arrive in about a week. During this time, I need to go into hiding. Do you plan to leave Yarlford with me, or do you want to stay here and manage the company?" Yamino asked.
"Dad, I think Connor's main target is you, not me. I don't need to go into hiding, I'll stay here," he replied, wanting to show his determination to make amends.
"Alright, then you stay in Yarlford," Yamino nodded, then picked up his phone to call his driver, preparing to leave Yarlford as soon as possible.
Meanwhile, on the other side, Connor and Yolanda had spent a full day and night on the plane and finally arrived at Yarlford Airport.
During the entire journey, Yolanda behaved as if she didn't exist. Unless Connor initiated a conversation, she wouldn't disturb him. She quietly listened to music, slept when she felt tired, and asked the flight attendants to bring food, offering some to him each time, even though he hadn't eaten.
Once they landed, Connor noticed that she was really planning to follow him. He couldn't take it anymore and stopped, looking at her. "What are you trying to do? Even if you follow me like this, I'll never agree."
"If you don't agree, I'll just keep following you. I'll return to the Profound Sect only when you agree," she replied calmly.
"If you insist on doing that, don't blame me for being rude!" he exclaimed in frustration.
"If you want to kill me, go ahead. Since I can't fulfill the task my master gave me, I might as well die!" Her expression remained calm.
"Is your master forcing you to do this?" he asked, furrowing his brow.
"No, this is my own idea," she replied naively.
"I knew it. Your master, who is so smart, would never use such a foolish method..." he muttered under his breath, then looked at Yolanda. "I'll tell you the truth; I won't agree to this. Stop wasting your time on me."
"If you don't agree, I won't leave," she replied firmly.
"You..." Connor was at a loss, then he raised his hand to hail a taxi.
Seeing him get into a taxi, she immediately followed suit.
"Where to, handsome?" The taxi driver, who had been staring at Yolanda's ethereal beauty, asked with a grin.
"To Stormbound Tower," Connor replied softly.
"Alright!" The driver started the car and initiated a conversation. "You must be working at Stormbound Corporation, right?"
"Something like that." He replied with a nod.
Yolanda, however, seemed uninterested in their conversation and continued to look out of the window, taking in the scenery. She had spent most of her life within the Profound Sect and rarely ventured into bustling cities like Yarlford. The outside world fascinated her.
"You know, you don't look like an ordinary person," the driver continued, glancing at Connor.
"How so?" Connor asked.
"Your girlfriend is so beautiful; you must be special!" the driver said with a chuckle.
"She's not my girlfriend..." Connor began.
"Not your girlfriend?!" The driver paused, then continued, "Well, if you can work at Stormbound Corporation, you must be someone extraordinary. Regular folks can't get into that company..."

chapters.title: Chapter 2044: Following Closely
chapters.content:
Chapter 2044: Following Closely
"Is that so?" Connor replied calmly.
"Of course! You must be new to Yarlford, right? Stormbound Corporation is currently the largest company in our city. I've heard that even the famous Gomez family can't compete with them now. Stormbound Corporation has been in Yarlford for less than two years, and they already have such formidable power. I believe the owner behind this company must be an extraordinary figure," the driver spoke excitedly as he drove.
Connor listened to the driver's words but only smiled and didn't say much.
After about half an hour, the taxi driver brought them to the entrance of Stormbound Tower.
Connor paid the fare and got out of the car, but he realized that Stormbound Tower was closed at this hour, and there seemed to be no one inside.
Helpless, Connor took out his phone, intending to call Queta. However, he noticed that it was already past 1 AM, and she might have already gone to bed.
"Do you have any business here?" Yolanda asked him softly when she saw him hesitating.
"Nothing," he replied casually and prepared to leave.
"Mr. Connor?" Just as Connor turned around, a voice suddenly sounded.
Connor instinctively looked back and saw Queta driving out from the underground parking lot.
"It's so her, and you haven't gone home yet?" he asked Queta.
"I just finished handling some documents and was about to go home. I didn't expect to run into you here!" She smiled and then took a glance at Yolanda.
"That's perfect. I was planning to take a taxi home, so can you give me a ride and we can talk about something on the way?" He didn't hesitate to ask her for a favor.
Without hesitation, he opened the car door and got in. Naturally, Yolanda followed and sat in the car alongside him.
In her heart, Queta understood that a man like him probably had many women around him. Moreover, he didn't seem to intend to introduce Yolanda to her, so she wisely refrained from asking about Yolanda's identity.
However, she could sense that Yolanda exuded an extraordinary aura, giving off a unique feeling.
"Queta, has anything happened in the company during my absence?" he proactively asked.
"Nothing much." She shook her head directly and continued, "The recent period has probably been the calmest since we arrived in Yarlford. There have been no movements from the Gomez family. They should be dealing with the mess left by the Four Great Families. The members of the Four Great Families are also behaving well. Combined with the benefits I've brought them, they're much more loyal to me than to the Gomez family."
"That's good." He nodded.
In fact, Connor had discussed the issue of the Four Great Families with Queta before. The Four Great Families had been oppressed by the Gomez family for many years, and their cooperation had always been unequal. In essence, the Four Great Families had been working for the Gomez family, while they barely got anything in return. Queta's way of working with them, although still taking most of the benefits, was not as exploitative as the Gomez family's approach. This had led to the loyalty of the Four Great Families towards her.
"By the way, Mr. Connor, Yamino has already returned!" she said.
"He has returned?" Connor's expression showed excitement upon hearing this.
"Yes, my people have been monitoring the airport. They saw Yamino return to Yarlford, but then he disappeared. We don't know where he went," she explained.
"He probably knows about my killing of Beau and Walter, so he's hiding and waiting for Rockefeller's reinforcements. But don't worry, he won't hide forever," he said with a calm tone.
"What are your plans for the next steps, Mr. Connor?" she asked softly.
"You don't need to worry about that. Just focus on developing the company's business. Strive to drive Gomez Corporation out of Yarlford as quickly as possible. Currently, the Gomez family is putting all their energy into dealing with me, so they shouldn't have the time to manage the company," Connor replied.
"Understood, Mr. Connor." Queta nodded.
He continued to inquire about other company matters from her, while Yolanda remained quiet, observing the passing scenery.
Half an hour later, Queta dropped them off at the entrance of Connor's villa.
"Queta, if you have time, please help me find a room..." Connor suddenly turned to her as he got out of the car.
She was momentarily surprised by his request. "Mr. Connor, are you planning to change your place of residence?"
"No, I want to find a room for her," Connor pointed at Yolanda, who was standing next to him.
"I'll stay wherever you stay. There's no need to waste money finding a separate place for me," Yolanda refused his offer.
"I don't have a spare room at my house," he explained helplessly.
"It's okay; I can even sleep on the couch. After all, I have to stay by your side," she said resolutely.
Hearing this, he was speechless.
Right now, Connor had no idea about the effects of the battle between him and Beau.. However, what he can feel at the moment was that he suddenly had a constant shadow by his side, and it was the type of shadow that no matter what he did, he couldn't get rid of.
"Mr. Connor," Queta softly asked, 'Do you still need me to find you a place to stay?'
"No need." He knew that even if Queta found a place for Yolanda to stay, she definitely wouldn't go. She would continue to follow him.
"Then I'll take my leave." Queta smiled at him and got back into her car.
After she left, Connor looked at Yolanda with a helpless expression and furrowed his brows as he asked, "Do you really plan to follow me like this all the time?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2045: Aida's Phone Call
chapters.content:
Chapter 2045: Aida's Phone Call
"Yes, as long as you make me your woman, I will obey you. Whatever you ask me to do, I will do it," Yolanda said with a serious expression.
"So, if I make you my woman, you won't follow me anymore?" Connor asked Yolanda.
"Yes, as long as you promise to make me your woman, you can make me do anything, including not following you." She nodded quickly.
He took a deep breath and then said in a low voice, "Alright, well, you're my woman now, is that okay?"
"Is what you're saying true?" She hesitated for a moment and then asked softly.
"Of course it's true!" he replied, gritting his teeth.
"In that case, if I'm your woman, shouldn't you do something for me?" She seemed a bit shy as she asked him.
"What should I do for you?" He was taken aback by her question and furrowed his brows. "What are you planning?"
"I mean, things that a man should do for a woman..." she whispered.
"No, even though I admit that you're my woman now, I don't have any feelings for you. If there are no feelings, some things shouldn't be done. Do you understand what I mean?" he said with frustration.
"But my master told me that if you really liked me, you would take the initiative to kiss me. But it seems like you're not willing to do that now, which means you don't actually like me, so I haven't become your woman!" she said earnestly.
"Never mind, forget it. If you want to leave, you can leave. If you want to stay, you can stay!" he exclaimed in frustration.
Connor, exasperated by the situation, shouted and walked into the villa. Due to the death of Rachel's grandfather, she decided to stay in York for some time to be with her grandfather.
At this moment, Rachel hadn't returned yet, which made Connor feel relieved. He didn't know how to explain the presence of Yolanda if Rachel saw her. Moreover, the thought of living together with two peculiar women gave him a headache.
His villa was quite spacious, with two guest rooms in addition to the rooms for Connor and Rachel. He intended to arrange for Yolanda to stay in one of the guest rooms.
"The environment here might not be as good as the others, but it's still clean. Do you have any problems staying in this room?" he asked Yolanda softly after leading her to the guest room.
"Where are you staying?" She blinked her eyes and asked Connor.
"I'll be staying in the room next to yours," he replied, feeling somewhat exasperated.
"In that case, I want to stay in your room!" She turned and headed towards his room.
He looked at her, who had entered his room, with a speechless expression and said softly, "If you want to stay in my room, that's fine. I'll stay in the guest room. Besides, I don't really need sleep now. So, you don't have to worry about staying close to me, unless you can also stay awake all the time!"
"I see..." Yolanda seemed a bit hesitant after hearing Connor's words. "Well, since you don't sleep, it doesn't matter where I stay. I'll go to the guest room then!"
With that, she turned and left his room.
Seeing her leave, he breathed a sigh of relief and sat on the bed with a tired expression. He had never expected that his trip would bring back such a big trouble.
While Yolanda might be inexperienced when it came to matters of love, she was quite normal in other aspects.
After returning to her guest room, she decided to take a shower. Once she finished, she greeted Connor and then lay down on the bed to rest.
After all the commotion, she felt a bit tired.
Upon seeing Yolanda closing her room door to sleep, let out a long sigh. He then sat on the bed and entered a state of meditation and cultivation.
Following the intense battle with Walter, he didn't fall into unconsciousness as he had previously, but his internal energy remained highly unstable. It would take at least a week to fully stabilize his inner energy.
Unbeknownst to him, a whole morning had passed while he was in meditation.
At 8 AM, Yolanda, dressed neatly, entered Connor's room. She noticed that he was in the middle of meditation but didn't disturb him. Instead, she sat quietly by his side and waited.
She waited for the entire morning.
If it weren't for his ringing phone, he might not have realized that she had been waiting for him.
Answering the call, Connor heard Aida's voice. "Connor, I've already taken care of things on the Collier family's side. Do you have anything you need me to do now?"
"So quick?" He was surprised.
"I've been managing the Collier family's businesses for a while now, and they should have heard about you killing Walter, so they're cooperating," she explained.
"Alright, what I need you to do now is to completely cut off all business dealings with the Gomez family. I want to push the Gomez family into a desperate situation," he said after a moment of thought.
"Understood, I'll give the order," she replied.
"If possible, I hope you can take control of the Gomez family's illicit businesses, the ones that are kept secret. I want the Collier family to take over," he continued.
"This might be a bit challenging, but I'll give it a try," she responded.
She understood very well that the clients who had been cooperating with the Gomez gamily were the ones who had been connected by Rockefeller. Moreover, after years of collaboration, both sides had developed a strong mutual trust. It would indeed be difficult to lure these clients away from them.
However, facing a challenge didn't mean it couldn't be overcome. As long as she could show enough sincerity and offer favorable terms, there was a chance to persuade some of them to switch alliances.

chapters.title: Chapter 2046: Witnesses
chapters.content:
Chapter 2046: Witnesses
"Good!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"If there's nothing else, I'll hang up first!"
Aida said.
He didn't waste any more time and hung up the phone then threw it aside.
Although Aida had never thanked him, she was still very grateful to him. However, these feelings could not be expressed with just a word of thanks.
If it wasn't for him, she would never have been able to complete her revenge. She knew this very well.
"When did you get here?"
Connor put down his phone and found Yolanda sitting beside him.
"I came long ago, but I saw that you had been cultivating, so I didn't disturb you!"
Yolanda replied calmly, as if she was not angry at all because she had waited for Connor for so long.
"Then why didn't you call me?"
He didn't know that she had been waiting for him, so when he heard her words, he felt a little embarrassed.
He had forgotten that she was not Rachel. She didn't know anyone in Yarlford and didn't know much about the surrounding environment, so she had nothing to do here.
"I didn't have anything to do anyway, so I didn't bother you," she replied calmly.
Connor then checked the time and noticed it was already 1 PM. He asked, "Are you hungry? Do you want me to take you to eat something?"
"Sure." She nodded immediately.
Seeing her excitement, he sighed and got up, heading out of the room. Yolanda followed him.
He spent some time introducing her to the surroundings. This way, if she ever got hungry or needed to buy something, she wouldn't have to wait for him to accompany her.
Although Yolanda's martial arts level couldn't compare to Connor's, she was indeed a Black-rank martial artist, just one step away from becoming a Martial Master. He knew that under normal circumstances, she wouldn't be in any danger. Moreover, the Profound Sect had significant resources, so she shouldn't have any financial issues.
He took her to a nearby restaurant for lunch and then went shopping with her at a mall for some clothes and daily necessities. She had particular tastes when it came to her belongings, mostly favoring international luxury brands, which came with hefty price tags. He knew that he didn't need to pay for these items, so he didn't object to her choices.
After spending the afternoon shopping, they returned to the villa. He originally intended to let her rest while he met with Yama and Taran.
However, she insisted on following him, so he had no choice but to bring her along.
...
They arrived at Yama's home. Yama greeted Connor casually, just as usual. He exchanged brief pleasantries with him and then sat on the couch, sipping on his drink.
"Mr. Connor, you're back," Taran greeted warmly, getting up to shake hands with him.
"Yes, I've taken care of everything concerning the Collier family." He nodded and then walked into the room.
Taran subconsciously glanced at Yolanda beside Connor. His expression appeared somewhat puzzled as he softly asked Connor, "Mr. Connor, who is this?"
"Disciple of the Sect Leader of Profound Sect, she insists on following me, and there's no way to shake her off," Connor replied nonchalantly.
"A disciple of the Sect Master of Profound Sect?" Taran was left in utter disbelief after hearing Connor's words. His facial expression seemed to indicate how formidable and terrifying the Profound Sect was, even though Connor might not consider it a significant matter. In the eyes of ordinary people like Taran, the Profound Sect was undoubtedly an immensely powerful existence.
Meanwhile, Yolanda appeared unfazed by how Connor introduced her, showing no intention of disputing his statement. She simply walked into the room and took a seat on the sofa.
Seeing the perplexed expression on Taran's face, Connor advised him, "Just pretend she doesn't exist. Let's focus on the important matters."
"Alright," Taran agreed with a nod, then sat down with Connor on the couch.
"Now that the Collier family has severed all ties with the Gomez family, about 90% of the business that Gomez family had is on hold," Connor began discussing the issue at hand.
"I'm sure the Rockefeller family isn't happy about it. However, it won't completely erode their trust in Yamino. I plan to submit the evidence we have to make Rockefellers aware of the truth."
Taran looked hesitant upon hearing Connor's plan and softly asked, "Mr. Connor, I agree with your approach, but we're not part of the Rockefeller family. The problem is that we don't have access to the higher-level members of their organization."
"We don't need direct access to the Rockefellers," Connor replied calmly. "We just need to make the evidence we have public. If someone in a high enough position within the Rockefeller family sees it, it will serve our purpose."
"Mr. Connor, what if Rockefeller thinks the evidence is fake?" Taran inquired.
"That depends on how he receives the information," Connor said with a smile. "If even the higher-ups believe that Madeline and Tatum were killed by Yamino and initiate an investigation, do you think Rockefeller will doubt the authenticity of our evidence?"
"Mr. Connor, your plan is feasible," Taran conceded, still having some reservations. "However, Yamino has accumulated a formidable network of contacts over the years. Relying solely on evidence may not be enough to initiate an investigation against him."
"That's why I came to you today," Connor said in a low voice.
"What do you mean?" Taran looked puzzled.
"If evidence alone isn't enough to prompt an investigation," Connor explained, "we can add your testimony as a witness. If that's not sufficient, I can also leverage my connections. Together, these three elements should be enough to prompt an inquiry into Yamino. Whether he can be convicted in the end is uncertain, but it will be enough to make Rockefeller lose trust in him."
"Mr. Connor, I understand your point," Taran said, finally grasping Connor's strategy.

chapters.title: Chapter 2047: The Winston Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 2047: The Winston Family
"This...," Taran looked at Connor, wearing a somewhat conflicted expression on his face.
"You don't need to worry. Since I've asked you to be a witness, I'll ensure your safety. I can guarantee that this won't have any adverse effects on you," Connor reassured him, noticing his concerns.
"Mr. Connor, you saved my life, so even if you ask me to go to jail, I wouldn't mind. After all, I want to seek revenge on Yamino. Right now, my main concern is that even if we present the evidence and I become a witness, we still might not be able to bring a case against him. What should we do then?" Taran asked in a low voice.
Connor smiled faintly, understanding his doubts. He whispered, "Are you worried that my connections won't be effective?"
"I'm not questioning your abilities, Mr. Connor. It's just that I know Yamino very well. He's skilled at using his network of relationships. Over the years, he has likely gathered a lot of compromising information on others. In essence, they share mutual benefits and risks with Yamino. So, I'm genuinely concerned about whether our plan can proceed as intended," Taran explained.
"Rest assured, the person I'm going to contact can definitely help us bring a case against Yamino, and no matter what connections he tries to use, it won't work!" Connor said confidently.
Taran hesitated for a moment upon hearing Connor's assurance, and then he asked in a soft voice, "Mr. Connor, would it be possible for you to reveal who this person is that you're contacting?"
"Her surname is Winston," Connor replied softly.
"Winston?" Taran paused for a moment and quickly realized who Connor was talking about. Although he had been imprisoned in the Blood Moon Sect for many years, he had already heard of the influential figure surnamed Winston before he left Yarlford. Additionally, during this period, he had gained some knowledge of the outside world, allowing him to deduce who Connor was referring to.
"Mr. Connor, if you can truly get in touch with someone like her to help us, then I think your plan is nearly perfect!" he said excitedly.
"If you think there are no issues, I will arrange a meeting with you and the person I'm contacting as soon as possible. You can explain the situation to her," Connor told him.
"Alright, no problem!" He eagerly agreed, still amazed that Connor had connections with the Winston family.
"If there's nothing else, I'll take my leave now!"
"Very well, I'll see you off!" Taran stood up to escort him, but he declined.
Afterward, Connor briefly inquired about Yama's recent situation, although the memories were fragmented and not particularly useful for his current situation. He left a bank card with Yama and then departed with Yolanda.
...
Once they were in the car, Connor dialed Yuna Winston's number.
Because Yamino's network of connections was truly formidable, if Connor tried to involve someone else, it was likely that the evidence in his possession would quickly be suppressed, rendering it ineffective. Moreover, in Yarlford, Connor was cautious about using excessive force. After all, there was a significant gap between Yarlford and the Winam, and if Connor took things too far, even with his immense abilities, he might ultimately face dire consequences.
Therefore, Connor was currently focused on dealing with Yamino through legal and conventional means.
He contacted Yuna without prior contact with Chelsea as this was a matter of urgency.
Ring...
After a prolonged ring, Yuna finally answered the call.
"Who is this?" Her voice was somewhat unclear.
"It's me, Connor," he replied with a cheerful tone.
"Connor? Why are you calling me so late? What's going on?" Her attitude became somewhat warmer upon recognizing his voice.
He glanced at his phone and realized that it was only a little past 10 PM, not particularly late.
"Yuna, are you going to bed so early?" he teased.
"I'm not as busy as you, and you have so much to do. I've heard you've become quite famous in Yarlford, defeating Beau and Walter. I can't believe it's only been a few months since we last met, and now you're so accomplished..." she commented.
"They're just spreading rumors. I'm not as skilled as they say," he replied modestly.
"Alright, why don't you tell me why you called? How can I help you this time?" she asked.
"I understand, you're a busy person. I haven't heard from Chelsea for a long time; I suppose she's busy too," he replied.
"I don't know what she's up to. She hasn't contacted me either," Yuna sighed softly before continuing, "So, why did you call me? Is there something you need my help with?"
Knowing her straightforward personality, he didn't beat around the bush. He explained the situation with Yamino in detail to her.
"I see. You want me to help you deal with Yamino, right?" she asked in a hushed tone.
"That's the idea, but I don't need you to do anything specific. I already have both evidence and witnesses. What I need now is to find someone reliable," he clarified.
"Although I'm not in Yarlford right now, I do know a bit about Yamino. He has a formidable network of connections, and there are even more terrifying forces behind him. Dealing with him won't be easy. Finding someone capable of helping you is also a challenge," she cautioned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2048: Promise Me Something
chapters.content:
Chapter 2048: Promise Me Something
"If this matter were so simple, I wouldn't have come to you, right?" Connor said with a smile.
"Well, that's true," Yuna chuckled and continued, "If you were looking for someone else, this might not be achievable. But if you're looking for me, I can help you. However, I need you to promise me something."
"What is it?" he asked excitedly after seeing that she was willing to help.
"There's someone who wants to meet you. If you go meet this person with me, I'll help you with this favor. How does that sound?" she asked.
"Who is this person?" he hesitated.
"I can't tell you who this person is right now. You'll find out when you meet them," she said slowly.
Connor, trusting Yuna, hesitated for a moment and then said softly, "Alright, I promise. When should we meet this person?"
"They're currently not in Yarlford, and they have other matters to attend to. When they return, I'll take you to meet them. For now, let's focus on dealing with Yamino," she said softly.
"Are you planning for me to bring the witness to meet you, or will you come to Yarlford?" he asked excitedly.
"I'll come over. I should be able to make it in a couple of days. I'll also bring someone to handle this case. When the time comes, you can hand over the evidence and the witness to him. You won't need to worry about the rest," she said.
"That's great. Thank you so much, Yuna," he said with relief.
"Don't be so polite, Connor. When I arrive in Yarlford, remember to treat me to some good food!" she said with a smile.
"Sure, no problem!" He agreed.
"Alright, if there's nothing else, I'll hang up now. I'm quite tired," Yuna said and then ended the call.
Connor was filled with excitement because he knew that he was now only one step away from completing his plan. Once Yuna brought the reinforcements, Yamino would have nowhere to hide.
Yolanda, who had been silently listening to their conversation, turned her head to look at him. Her expression was filled with curiosity, wondering why he was so happy.
"Aren't you curious about what I'm doing right now?" he asked her.
"No, not at all," she replied with a shake of her head. "Everything you're doing has nothing to do with me. I just want to be your woman and help you protect our Profound Sect."
"Alright," Connor said somewhat helplessly and continued driving quietly.
On the other side, in the villa where Yamino was hiding.
Because he was worried that Connor might seek revenge, he had intentionally hidden in a villa in the outskirts of Yarlford. Except for himself, no one else knew of his location. Even his son, Juan, believed that his father had already left Yarlford.
Yamino knew that he was no match for Connor at this point. If he showed himself, it would undoubtedly lead to his death. Therefore, he could only wait here for Rockefeller's reinforcements.
At this moment, his phone suddenly rang. He picked it up and saw that it was a call from Juan. He answered the call and asked, "How's the situation at the company?"
"Dad, it's really bad. Aida, that treacherous woman, has actually ceased all cooperation with our company," Juan said in a highly agitated tone.
"I already suspected that would happen. Since the Collier family has stopped cooperation, just consider giving the company a break. Let the employees take some time off. When the reinforcements arrive, I'll deal with these matters," he said. He was in a situation where he couldn't even protect himself, let alone the company.
"Dad, it's not just about stopping cooperation. Aida used this opportunity to contact our clients. She's currently trying to snatch away most of our clients. If we continue to halt operations, the remaining clients might also be taken by her," Juan explained anxiously.
"What did you say?" Yamino's face turned furious upon hearing this.
"She is stealing our clients, and she has already taken away a large portion of them. If we continue to suspend operations, the remaining clients may also be taken by her," Juan said in a hushed voice.
"How could she have the contact information of these clients?" Yamino asked through gritted teeth.
"I gave her the client information," Juan admitted reluctantly.
"You..." Yamino was so angry that he almost spat out blood. "How could you give her that confidential information?!"
"That period when you were not in Yarlford, the Four Great Families betrayed us, and I had too much on my plate. I was busy with numerous matters every day, and I didn't have the time to handle these affairs. So, I asked Aida to help me. Who would have thought that she's also one of Connor's people?" he explained with frustration.
"How could you be so careless? These client details are highly confidential. How could you give them to Aida?" Yamino gnashed his teeth in anger.
"I know it was a mistake, Dad. I didn't expect her to be one of Connor's people," Juan stuttered.
"What should I say to you?" Yamino took a deep breath and continued, "You go and try to retain those clients. I'll think of a way to minimize the losses. Do you understand what I mean?"
"I understand," Juan replied nervously.
With that, Yamino immediately hung up.
After putting down his phone, he sat on the sofa with an expression full of anger. He hadn't expected that Juan's carelessness would lead to such a catastrophe. Giving away the confidential client information to Aida was like handing those clients directly into her hands.
If those businesses were solely owned by the Gomez family, he might not have been so agitated, as he believed that once Connor was eliminated, the rest of the issues could be resolved.

chapters.title: Chapter 2049: Yuna Arrives
chapters.content:
Chapter 2049: Yuna Arrives
However, what left Yamino helpless was that all of these businesses belonged to Rockefeller.
Now, the real loss was not his, but Rockefeller's!
This was what he was most worried about.
After all, causing losses to Rockefeller would be far more terrifying than causing them to himself.
He sat on the sofa, pondering how to handle this issue.
But before he could come up with a result, his other phone rang.
When he heard the ringing of his phone, he couldn't help but take a deep breath and picked up the call.
"Hello?"
It was Asya's voice.
"Why are you calling me, Asya?" he asked cautiously.
"No need for small talk. Mr. Long just received news that a large number of your clients have been mysteriously taken away by someone else. He is quite angry about this, so you must resolve this matter quickly," Asya said directly.
"Asya, please listen to my explanation. The person who took away my clients is one of Connor's people. I've been waiting for reinforcements from headquarters. You should also be aware of Connor's strength; I'm no match for him right now!" Yamino hurriedly explained.
"How did he find out the contact information of these clients?" Asya seemed puzzled.
After all, their security measures at Rockefeller were top-notch, and it was impossible for anyone to know the contact information of Rockefeller's clients under normal circumstances.
"It was leaked by an employee of my company. I've already taken care of that person. Asya, please rest assured. As long as Connor dies, the rest of the problems will be easy to solve. The only trouble now is him!" Yamino said in a low voice.
"Are you sure that dealing with him will solve these problems?" Asya asked.
"I guarantee it will, as long as he is eliminated!" Yamino said confidently.
"Very well, I will explain this to Mr. Long for you. Headquarters has already sent an expert, and they will probably arrive in Yarlford soon. You can deal with Connor when they arrive," Asya said calmly.
"Thank you so much. I'm really grateful!" Yamino was relieved when he learned that reinforcements were on their way from headquarters.
"Handle the matters in your hands. If this situation isn't resolved well, even my support might not be able to save you. After all, Mr. Long has always attached great importance to the summer business," Asya said slowly.
"As long as he dies, the rest won't be a problem!" Yamino stated with great confidence.
"Good," Asya replied calmly and then hung up the phone.
Seeing the call end, Yamino let out a long sigh of relief. His face noticeably relaxed. In his eyes, once the people from Rockefeller arrived, the remaining issues would be easily resolved.
...
Since Yuna hadn't yet arrived in Yarlford, Connor had nothing to do at the moment. The affairs of the Stormbound Corporation were being handled by Queta, and he neither had the mood nor the time to manage them.
So, he spent two full days cultivating at home, with Yolanda accompanying him.
Two days later, Yuna finally called him and informed him that she had arrived in Yarlford.
He knew that she was coming to visit, so he immediately drove to the villa where Yama lived, with Yolanda accompanying him.
While driving, Connor called Taran and briefly explained his situation.
Taran was naturally willing to cooperate.
About half an hour later, Connor, accompanied by Taran and Yolanda, arrived at the hotel where Yuna was staying.
Upon arrival at the hotel, he found her room and knocked on the door.
"I'm here..."
A few seconds later, the door opened, and Yuna's exquisite face appeared in Connor's sight.
"Yuna, you look even more beautiful!" He complimented her as he looked her up and down.
He wasn't just trying to flatter her; he genuinely admired her beauty. She was perfect in terms of both her figure and her looks. However, what was even more important was her temperament, which was not something that everyone possessed. One's upbringing played a significant role in determining their temperament.
"Don't butter me up. If I'm so beautiful, why didn't you contact me more often? You only contact me when you need something!" she said with a wry smile.
"I didn't want to disturb you since you seemed so busy. Aren't you always bored and lonely? I was just being considerate!" He smiled.
"Cut it out!" He gave Connor a playful eye roll and continued, "So, is this your girlfriend?"
"No, just friends!" Connor shook his head.
Yuna nodded thoughtfully as she observed Yuna. She then continued, "Alright, don't just stand by the door. Come inside!"
Upon hearing Yuna's invitation, they walked into the room. To Connor's surprise, there was a middle-aged man inside.
The middle-aged man had a very handsome appearance, although his age had left some marks of experience on his face. However, his aura and demeanor indicated that he was not an ordinary person.
Yuna took the initiative to introduce the middle-aged man. His name was Benjamin Zenfold, and he held a high-ranking position in the organization. Yuna didn't delve into the details but assured him that as long as he handed over the evidence he had to Benjamin, everything would be fine.
There had been some conflicts between Benjamin and Yamino over the years, but despite his investigations, he hadn't managed to find enough evidence to bring Yamino down.

chapters.title: Chapter 2050: Important Evidence
chapters.content:
Chapter 2050: Important Evidence
After Connor understood Yuna's intentions, he didn't beat around the bush. Instead, he directly explained his situation to Benjamin. He also handed over the evidence he had and introduced Benjamin to Taran.
Benjamin received the evidence with great caution. As he reviewed the contents on the hard drive, his expression turned extremely shocked. Finally, he understood why she had become involved in this matter. She had assured him that this evidence would be sufficient to bring Yamino down.
"Mr. Benjamin, can this evidence be used to file charges against Yamino?" Connor asked in a hushed voice.
"Mr. Connor, if we only have this evidence, it might be a bit challenging. However, thankfully, we also have a crucial witness who can testify in this case. With the witness's testimony and my involvement, it should be enough to file charges against Yamino," Benjamin replied politely, given his connection with Yuna.
"That's all I need." Connor nodded in agreement.
He didn't place his hopes in the police; his main goal was to ensure that Yamino was charged. Once the police filed charges, it would lead to a loss of trust between Yamino and Asya. That would make it easier for Connor to take action against Yamino.
"Mr. Connor, I need to take the witness with me," Benjamin said at this moment.
"Can you ensure the witness's safety?" He looked at Benjamin and asked.
"Mr. Connor, you don't need to worry about that. I will make sure the witness is safe and minimize any possible complications. After all, this witness might be even more critical than the evidence I hold," Benjamin assured with a smile.
"Alright, please make sure the witness's safety," he reminded Benjamin.
"Miss Yuna has already explained everything clearly to me. You can trust me. I'll ensure the witness's safety and minimize any risks," Benjamin replied, understanding his underlying message.
"Good, then take the person with you," Connor agreed.
Benjamin went to speak with Yuna, and after their conversation, he left the room with Taran. After Benjamin had left, Yuna approached Connor.
