"Connor, I've helped you resolve your matter. How do you plan to thank me?" she asked with a playful smile.
"Didn't I promise to do something for you earlier?" he replied with a wry smile.
"That's not the same thing. Anyway, you have to thank me properly for this!" she said, playfully.
"Alright, how do you want me to thank you?" he asked, slightly surprised.
"Let's just have a meal together," she suggested.
"Just a meal?" He seemed surprised.
"What else did you expect?" She raised an eyebrow and asked.
"Okay, I'll treat you to a meal. Where do you want to go?" He agreed.
"Great! Take your beautiful friend with you," Yuna said, glancing at Yolanda.
Connor didn't expect that Yuna would actually take Yolanda along, but this actually saved him a lot of trouble because if he had said he didn't want to bring her, she probably wouldn't have agreed either.
Yuna had frequently visited Yarlford before, so her knowledge of the city was definitely better than Connor's, especially when it came to places for dining and entertainment, she knew them like the back of her hand. So, in the end, she chose a restaurant that didn't look very big but served exceptionally delicious food.
Perhaps because Yolanda was present, during the meal, Yuna only inquired about Connor's recent situation and didn't say much else to him.
Two hours later, Connor, Yuna, and Yolanda had all finished their meal.
Afterward, he dropped Yuna off at her hotel and returned to the villa with Yolanda.
Later, Yuna called someone on her phone.
"Ding-ling-ling..."
It took a while for the call to be answered.
"Yuna, what's up?" The voice of the person on the other end of the line sounded.
"What are you doing? Why did it take you so long to answer the call?" Yuna complained.
"I'm in Eigona right now. We have a time difference."
Chelsea was equally helpless.
"Why did you go to Eigona again?" Yuna asked in a puzzled tone after hearing Chelsea's words.
"Don't mention it. I told you before, right? I opened a new company in Eigona a while ago, but the company encountered some problems, so I came over. I've been dealing with company matters during this period, and it's been exhausting," Chelsea complained.
"I see," Yuna nodded gently, then smiled and said, "I was wondering why you've been so quiet lately. I asked Connor, and he didn't know your whereabouts either."
"You met Connor?" Chelsea suddenly became interested when she heard his name.
"Yes, he is planning to take action against Yamino Gomez, so he asked me for help," Yuna replied casually.
"Did you help him?" Chelsea quickly inquired.
"Connor is your nephew, and you specifically told me to take good care of him before. How could I not help him?" Yuna said with a touch of exasperation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2051: Private Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 2051: Private Investigation
"That's good..." Chelsea knew that Yuna had helped Connor, but she didn't inquire about the details because she was aware that whenever Yuna got involved, there was little that couldn't be resolved.
"So, why did you suddenly call me?" Chelsea hesitated for a moment and then asked.
"You won't believe it, but I suspect that Connor might be in a romantic relationship..." Yuna said softly.
Upon hearing her words, Chelsea was momentarily speechless and replied indifferently, "I thought you were going to tell me something important. Is this what you called for?"
"Aren't you surprised?" Yuna asked after a brief pause.
"Why should I be surprised? Connor not only is engaged, but he also has a fiancée. There's no need to make a fuss about it," Chelsea replied casually.
"He's not with his fiancée this time," Yuna explained. "And this girl with him is really beautiful. That's why I called you."
"She's not his fiancée?" Chelsea was briefly taken aback and then said quietly, "Well, I'm just his aunt. His romantic life isn't my concern. Besides, he is wealthy and accomplished now, so having beautiful women around him is normal."
"You're not jealous at all?" Yuna asked.
"Jealous?" Chelsea's expression seemed even more bewildered. She said softly, "What's going on in your head? What does Connor's romantic life have to do with me? Whether he chooses to be with someone is his business. Why should I be jealous?"
"I hope you really aren't jealous. I'm just a bit worried about you," Yuna said softly.
"Alright, you should worry about yourself. You're not getting any younger, and you've never been in a relationship. I worry for you..." Chelsea shifted the topic back to Yuna.
"Ah..." Yuna sighed softly upon hearing her words, then continued to discuss recent developments with Chelsea for over an hour.
Meanwhile, back at Connor's home, he began his training shortly after returning with Yolanda. Since he had done everything within his power, he had to wait for news from Benjamin.
Yolanda, seeing Connor begin his training, chose not to disturb him and went back to her room.
...
In the blink of an eye, two days passed. Perhaps because of Yuna's involvement, Benjamin's efficiency was quite high. It had only taken two days to initiate the case against Yamino. Moreover, this time the authorities attached great importance to the case, given Yamino's prominent status as a business tycoon in Yarlford, with numerous titles and significant influence.
As such, his case generated considerable public interest, and an investigative team was promptly established. They aimed to minimize the potential negative impact by swiftly investigating Yamino.
"You've been staying at my place for almost a week now, right? Are you really planning not to return?" Connor, upon seeing Yolanda bringing him food, couldn't help but exclaim, his expression one of frustration.
"We've already discussed this issue, haven't we? As long as you acknowledge me as your woman, I'll leave. If you refuse to acknowledge it, then I won't go," she said calmly.
"I acknowledged you as my woman a long time ago!" He gritted his teeth.
"You've only acknowledged it verbally, but you haven't done anything yet. I've already called my master, and he said that you need to prove it by sleeping with me before I can consider it a true acknowledgment of my status," she said calmly.
"Sleep with you?" He was at a loss for words upon hearing her words. He didn't know what to say.
"What is your master teaching you all day?" he exclaimed in disbelief.
"You don't need to worry about what my master is teaching me. Anyway, you haven't acknowledged me as your woman, so I won't leave!" she asserted.
"You..." He was about to say something but then heard his phone ringing.
"Hello?" He picked up the phone.
"Connor, I've completed the task I promised you. I'm currently at Yarlford Airport, getting ready to return to York!" Her voice came through the phone.
"You've completed the task I asked you to do?" He was momentarily stunned upon hearing her words, then quickly asked, "Are you saying that they've initiated an investigation into Yamino?"
"Yes!" She nodded on her end.
"Yuna, thank you so much. Why are you in such a hurry to return? How about waiting for me? I'll go to the airport to see you off!" he said as he walked out of the room.
"No need. I'm about to board the plane. I just called to tell you that I've finished this task," shesaid with a smile.
"Then, when you come to Yarlford, let me treat you to a meal!" Connor felt extremely grateful to Yuna. After all, without her intervention, he wouldn't have completed this task so quickly.
"Sure, when I come to Yarlford, you can treat me to a meal!" she replied softly. Then she continued, "By the way, Benjamin just called me. Although they've started the investigation into Yamino, they're concerned about his special status. If this matter escalates, it might have a negative impact. So, they're planning to investigate this privately."
"They can't investigate this privately!" Connor responded immediately. "If they investigate this privately, Yamino could use his connections to cover it up. That won't achieve the result I want."

chapters.title: Chapter 2052: The Fall of the Gomez Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 2052: The Fall of the Gomez Family
"If you don't want to investigate this matter privately, you can gather some other evidence of Yamino's crimes and give it to Benjamin. Benjamin will find a way to make a big deal out of it," Yuna said slowly.
"Alright, I know what to do!" Connor replied in a low voice.
"If there's nothing else, I'll hang up now. We can contact each other later," she said and hung up.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then used his own phone to call Queta. He instructed her to provide all the evidence she had on Yamino to Benjamin. While Queta's evidence consisted of relatively minor offenses, it was enough to be the final straw that broke the camel's back in the current situation.
After she handed over the evidence to Benjamin, it took less than a day for the media to expose all of Yamino's wrongdoings.
The next morning, headlines like these appeared on major news websites.
"Famous Entrepreneur Yamino Under Investigation!"
"The Wealthiest Man in Yarlford, Yamino, Suspected of Matricide and Patricide, an Absolute Monster!"
"Gomez Family Empire Crumbles as Gomez Corporation's Chairman Faces 23 Charges!"
This scandal involving Yamino became the hottest topic of the year. While Connor had made a name for himself in the world of martial arts, most ordinary people were unaware of his activities. In contrast, Yamino's scandal was a real, shocking event happening right around them, so the public was deeply concerned.
The news spread like wildfire and quickly trended on social media platforms. Comments from the public flooded in.
"I can't believe Yamino turned out to be this kind of person!"
"He's even worse than an animal, killing his own father-in-law and wife just for power. What a monster!"
"I used to idolize Yamino. I never expected him to be involved in such a scandal!"
"I've been predicting it all along. Gomez Corporation was bound to collapse sooner or later!"
"That's right, the momentum of the Stormbound Corporation is unstoppable. I think there must be a connection between this and Stormbound Corporation!"
"Yarlford might soon be under the control of Stormbound Corporation!"
Inside Yamino's luxurious mansion, his son Juan was still unaware of the unfolding crisis. He had spent the previous night with his new girlfriend and hadn't woken up yet.
Juan's girlfriend woke up first and stretched lazily, revealing her attractive figure. She bore some resemblance to Aida, and Juan couldn't forget her, even now.
She absentmindedly checked her phone, then opened a social media app.
However, at that moment, a news headline caught her attention. It contained the name "Yamino," so she immediately clicked on it.
A few minutes later, Juan's girlfriend was in complete shock, her face filled with disbelief. She didn't know how to react to the shocking news.
"Juan, wake up." She urgently pushed him.
"Stop bothering me," Juan replied, still half-asleep.
"No, Juan, something really serious has happened." She insisted.
Juan finally opened his eyes and saw the worried expression on his girlfriend's face. He grabbed his phone, checked it, and saw numerous missed calls and messages, all about his father's situation.
"What the hell... Where's my phone?" He suddenly panicked.
"I don't know," his girlfriend replied, fear in her eyes.
"Where's my phone, damn it!" he shouted.
His girlfriend quickly found his phone, and Juan started going through the messages and news articles. His face turned pale as he read the allegations against his father.
"This can't be real," he muttered to himself.
"Juan, what are you going to do?" his girlfriend asked, her voice trembling.
"What am I going to do? I need to go to the company and see what's happening!" he replied, growing more frustrated.
As he hurried to get dressed and left the house, his girlfriend realized the gravity of the situation. She quickly began packing her belongings, knowing that she might be implicated if she stayed.
Meanwhile, on the other side of town, Yamino's son, Juan, continued to make calls as he drove to the company headquarters. He tried to reach his father but received no answer. Frustration and panic gripped him.
"Damn it, why is everyone avoiding me when something like this happens?" he muttered angrily.
Finally, after half an hour, Juan arrived at the Gomez Corporation headquarters. However, when he entered the building, he was met with an eerie silence. The employees had mostly stayed home, afraid of being associated with the scandal. The once-bustling office now felt like a ghost town.
Desperate to find answers, Juan went straight to his father's office. To his shock, the office was empty, and his father was nowhere to be found. He had never seen the company in such disarray.
"Uncle Copper, you're still here?" Juan approached Copper, the vice president of the company.
"Juan, why are you here? You should leave immediately. The authorities are looking for you," Copper said, concern in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2053: Unforgivable
chapters.content:
Chapter 2053: Unforgivable
"The authorities are looking for me?" Juan couldn't help but look puzzled when he heard this.
"Yes, the authorities have already been here once but left when they couldn't find you. They're probably heading to your home now. You should find a place to hide. Yamino's situation is really serious this time," Mr. Copper explained urgently.
"What about you, Mr. Copper? What will you do?" Juan asked after a moment of hesitation.
"You don't need to worry about me. This matter has nothing to do with me, and I'm just a vice president. I doubt the authorities will bother with me," Mr. Copper replied.
"Alright, thank you, Mr. Copper. If the Yamino family can make it through this, I'll definitely show my gratitude," Juan said earnestly.
"Mr. Yamino once did me a great favor, and what I'm doing is to repay that debt. You should leave now!" Mr. Copper insisted with an earnest tone.
After a brief hesitation, Juan didn't say more and turned to run out of the company.
On the other side, Yamino had also seen the news. He never expected to become a wanted fugitive, with authorities searching for him all over the world. Even more surprising was that Asya, who had always been his ally, was now not answering his calls.
After making numerous calls with no response, he gave up on contacting Asya. He sat on the couch, his face filled with despair. He understood that Asya's refusal to answer his calls meant that he had likely believed the news reports.
The relationship between Asya and Yamino's father-in-law was extraordinary. If it weren't for Tatum, he would never have achieved his current status. However, the leaked information would reveal that Yamino had been using Asya all these years. He knew Asya's character well enough to understand that Asya wouldn't easily forgive him, and it was possible that he might even be targeted for elimination.
Originally, Yamino believed he had the upper hand, especially with the plan to have Connor taken out by Rockefeller's people. But now, with his past deeds exposed, he was in a dangerous situation. Neither Connor nor the authorities intended to let him off the hook.
Yamino found himself in a state of isolation and despair.
"It must be Taran. Taran actually joined forces with Connor!" he exclaimed angrily.
He realized that only Taran could have been aware of the incident involving Tatum's death. Most of those who knew about it had been eliminated by Yamino over the years, leaving only Taran. Yamino couldn't have imagined that after all these years, Taran would reappear and target him so directly.
"Connor, I won't rest until I've settled the score with you if I can make it through this! I'll never forgive you!" Yamino gritted his teeth.
However, he also knew that the evidence against him was overwhelming. Even though he suspected Taran's involvement, he couldn't prove it. Yamino had once believed that if he could just wait for Rockefeller's people to eliminate Connor, everything would be resolved. Now, he had lost that opportunity.
"Ring, ring..."
At that moment, his phone rang. He picked it up and saw that it was a call from Juan. He quickly answered.
"Dad, it's a disaster. Our company is in trouble. The authorities have sealed off the company and our house. What's going on with you?" Juan said, sounding very distressed.
"The authorities acted so fast?" Yamino was momentarily surprised.
"Yes, and I heard you're now wanted by the police. Dad, is it true that you killed my grandpa and mom?" Juan asked somewhat naively.
"Are you out of your mind?" Yamino shouted, his expression one of disbelief. "Others might suspect me, but you, too? I've watched over your mother's well-being from the beginning. How could I have killed her? All of this is a setup by Connor. He's trying to frame me, don't you understand?"
"Dad, don't be angry. I didn't mean anything by it. I was just asking..." Juan hastily explained.
Yamino took a deep breath and continued in a low voice, "I don't have the energy to explain these things to you right now. We need to leave Yarlford immediately. If we stay here, we'll likely be discovered in no time."

chapters.title: Chapter 2054: Put An End
chapters.content:
Chapter 2054: Put An End
"Father, what should I do now?" Juan asked.
"You should transfer all the money you can gather to the Swiss bank account I set up for you. I've already deposited five billion US dollars in that account, and if you can gather some more, it should be enough for both of us. Understand?" Yamino outlined his plan.
"I understand. I'll start working on it now. I should be able to gather a few more billion," Juan replied urgently.
"Once you've gathered the money, come to me at 8 PM tonight. I've arranged a helicopter, and we'll leave the country together. It's the only way to stay safe," Yamino continued.
"Okay, I got it," Juan nodded and then hung up the phone to begin collecting the necessary funds.
Yamino placed his phone down with a deep sigh. His face showed a mix of resignation and frustration. He had prepared for this situation a long time ago, even creating new identities for both himself and Juan. With the funds they had amassed, they could live a life that would make others envious, without having to work a day. But this kind of life couldn't satisfy him. After all, he had put in so much effort in Yarlford over the years. Abandoning everything he had was not something he could easily accept.
Now, he was left with no other choice. If he stayed in Yarlford, it was a dead end, and if he didn't leave, he would be discovered. He and Juan had to leave the city to escape the imminent danger.
Meanwhile, at the headquarters of the Stormbound Corporation, Connor arrived and walked into Queta's office. Yama, Taran, and others were also present.
Benjamin had cooperated and provided testimony, so Taran had been released.
"Mr. Connor!" Taran stood up and greeted Connor as he entered.
"Is everything alright?" Connor asked calmly.
"I'm fine. Benjamin and the others treated me well. I gave my statement, telling them everything I knew. I might need to testify again when the authorities find Yamino, but it seems there won't be any issues for now," Taran replied with a smile.
Taran felt gratitude towards Connor. If it weren't for him, he wouldn't have survived this ordeal and had the chance to seek revenge against Yamino.
"The authorities won't find Yamino," Connor said in a hushed tone.
Taran was momentarily surprised when he heard Connor's words. He then asked, "Mr. Connor, are you planning to take action against Yamino?"
"Yes, it's time to put this to an end." He nodded and turned to Queta, asking in a low voice, "Queta, what's the situation with Juan?"
"My people have been following Juan. Today, he visited Rockefeller several times and transferred most of the Gomez family's funds to a foreign account he holds with an M-country bank. It's likely that Yamino will leave Yarlford today," she reported.
"If Yamino plans to leave, he will certainly take Juan with him. So, if we continue to follow him, we'll eventually find Yamino's hiding place," Connor explained.
"Alright, I understand," she replied.
In fact, Connor could completely use his divine sense to search for Yamino. But his divine sense had limitations, and a large city like Yarlford was fundamentally incomparable to Solsby. The two cities' populations differed by a hundredfold.
Finding him in such a vast place as Yarlford was not an easy task, especially considering that Connor couldn't determine whether he was in Yarlford or in another city.
So, at that time, the best approach was to track Juan because this way, they could definitely find Yamino.
Taran looked at Connor and hesitated for two seconds, then said softly, "Mr. Connor, I have another reluctant request."
"You may speak," Connor replied casually.
"I want to go with you. I want to witness Yamino's death before my eyes," Taran said in a low voice.
Connor looked at Taran, and hesitated for two seconds. He wasn't very willing to take Taran with him because he knew that even if Yamino was already in dire straits, he would still have several ancient martial arts masters protecting him. It would be very dangerous for him to go.
But he also knew that this had always been a burden on Taran's heart, so after a moment's hesitation, he nodded at him.
"Thank you, Mr. Connor, thank you!" Taran exclaimed excitedly when he saw Connor's agreement.
"No need to be so polite. You've contributed to this matter as well, so it's only fair to take you with me. But I have to remind you that Yamino will certainly have ancient martial arts masters by his side. If you encounter any emergencies, I might not be able to save you," he said to Taran.
"It doesn't matter!" Taran replied without hesitation and continued, "Mr. Connor, as long as I can see Yamino die with my own eyes, I have no regrets, even if I die."
"Alright then," Connor said.
"Ring, ring..."
Just at that moment, Queta's phone, placed on the table, suddenly rang. She quickly picked up the phone and answered the call. A few seconds later, she put down the phone and whispered to Connor, "Mr. Connor, Juan has gone to Trustar Mansion in the outskirts of Yarlford!"
"Alright, I understand." Connor nodded gently. Then he turned and looked at Yolanda, asking in a low voice, "I have to deal with something very important right now, and it may be dangerous. Do you still want to come with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2055: Breaking into the Mansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 2055: Breaking into the Mansion
"I'm not afraid of danger. Wherever you go, I go!" Yolanda said without hesitation.
Upon hearing her words, Connor's expression appeared somewhat helpless. He turned to Yama and Taran and said, "Let's go. If we wait any longer, Yamino and Juan might leave Yarlford!"
"Alright!" Both of them nodded quickly and started walking towards the office door.
Queta hesitated in her place for a moment and then softly shouted to Connor, "Mr. Connor, please be sure to stay safe!"
"I know!" He replied with a smile and then left the office with Yolanda.
On the other side, Juan had transferred all his movable funds to a foreign account as instructed by Yamino and then drove to Trustar Mansion in the outskirts of Yarlford.
Trustar Mansion was a property purchased by Yamino ten years ago but had never been inhabited. Even Juan didn't know about this property.
Upon entering the mansion, he was immediately stunned by the security setup. Guards were stationed every ten meters, all armed and fully equipped with guns. These guards were not ordinary people; they were mercenaries hired by Yamino at a high cost, each of them a martial master with expertise in various weapons. Anyone attempting to breach the mansion's security would likely be shot before even grasping the situation.
While the guards were aware of Juan's identity, they remained cautious. They conducted a thorough check to ensure he wasn't carrying any tracking devices or listening devices before allowing him to enter.
"Dad!" Juan shouted excitedly upon entering the mansion.
"Have you done everything I asked?" Yamino asked him.
"Dad, don't worry. I've transferred all the money to my account, totaling over a billion. This should be enough for both of us!" he replied hastily.
"That's good, that's good," Yamino said with a relaxed expression after hearing Juan's words. Money was still crucial for him at this moment, and without it, his situation would be even more precarious.
"Dad, what's going on exactly?" Juan asked with a nervous expression as he sat on the sofa.
"What else could it be? It's definitely Taran and Connor teaming up to frame me. Taran knows better than anyone that my most significant support is from Asya. So he pinned the blame for your grandfather and mother's deaths on me. This way, he will lose trust in me. If I lose his help, I won't be a match for Connor," Yamino said without emotion.
"So, does that mean Asya has abandoned us now?" Juan stared wide-eyed.
"Not only has Asya abandoned us, but they might also send someone to eliminate me," Yamino replied.
"What does that mean? Are we left with no choice but to hide?" Juan asked.
"At this point, I can't think of a better solution," Yamino said with a sigh. "Publicly, we have no options left."
"Mr. Yamino, someone has intruded into the mansion!" At that moment, a guard burst into the room, his expression full of excitement.
"What did you say?" Yamino was momentarily stunned upon hearing this, his expression filled with shock.
"Four people forcibly entered, and they seem to be martial artists!" the guard quickly replied.
Yamino hesitated for a moment, then rushed to the control room to check the situation outside. When he saw Connor, he turned around and delivered a fierce slap to Juan's face. Then he glared at him and shouted, "What the hell are you eating? Didn't you realize you were being followed?"
"I... I was extremely cautious the whole way, and I... I didn't know someone was following me!" Juan replied, holding his throbbing cheek, his face filled with frustration.
"You're useless!" Yamino cursed him through gritted teeth and then turned to the guard. "Tell your men that no matter what, they must stop these people for me. If they can't, delay them. Injured guards will receive double their salary plus an additional 500,000 for medical expenses, and those who die will be given a direct compensation of 20 million!"
"Understood!" The guard nodded without hesitation because Yamino's offer was too tempting to resist.
Yamino squinted at the screen showing Connor's image, his face filled with anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 2056: Attack Together!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2056: Attack Together!
"Dad, can these people really stop Connor? I heard that this Connor guy is quite formidable..." Juan asked with fear.
"They can't stop Connor. Can you?" Yamino responded coldly.
Upon hearing this, Juan instantly closed his mouth and didn't dare to say another word.
Yamino took out his phone and dialed a number.
"How much longer until you get here?" he asked in a hushed tone.
"Fifteen minutes!" the person on the other end replied.
"Fifteen minutes is too long. We have a problem here. I'll give you ten minutes. If you can make it within that time, I'll double the money I promised you!" he declared dominantly.
"Alright, I'll do my best!" the person replied briefly and hung up.
Yamino stared at the monitor with an expressionless face, his tension evident. He knew that if these guards couldn't hold off Connor for long, he might be in danger.
On the other side, Connor, Yolanda, and the others walked calmly into Trustar Mansion.
Inside Trustar Mansion, the guards were nervously watching Connor's movements. They had witnessed him easily dispatch several guards moments ago and were hesitant to confront him.
"Stop them at all costs! Mr. Yamino promised that our wages would double if we could hold them off!"
The captain of the guards suddenly rushed out of the villa, his expression filled with excitement.
Upon hearing the promise of doubled wages, the guards seemed to go berserk, their eyes turning red as they charged toward Connor's position.
The number of guards inside the manor was overwhelming. Suddenly, nearly a hundred armed guards rushed toward him, making even Yolanda, who was aware of Connor's strength, somewhat astonished.
Although she knew how formidable he was, the sheer number of opponents was daunting. It seemed like they were being overwhelmed by sheer force.
On the other hand, Yamino remained calm, and Taran asked fearfully, "Mr. Connor, can you handle all these people by yourself?"
"Yamino, protect the two of them!" Connor didn't reply to Taran but instead called out to Yamino.
"Yes, sir," Yamino calmly replied.
"If anyone can kill these people, there's a five-million reward from Mr. Yamino!" the captain of the guards shouted once more.
Hearing this, the guards seemed to go even crazier, charging toward Connor's position.
Connor, seeing these guards approach again, wore an expression of helplessness. He couldn't fathom why these people were so easily manipulated by Yamino.
Knowing that he was using them to buy time, Connor didn't intend to engage in a verbal confrontation. Instead, he released a terrifying aura once again.
In an instant, countless guards were sent flying.
"What kind of person is this?"
"Even if they were ancient martial masters, they wouldn't have such terrifying combat strength, would they?"
"What just happened?"
The guards stood in shock, unable to comprehend what had transpired. Fear and amazement filled their faces. They had no words to describe their current emotions.
The captain of the guards turned to Connor, his voice trembling. "Why are you all just standing there? Fire your guns! I don't believe we can't kill this guy!"
Only then did the guards remember they were armed. They raised their guns and aimed at his position.
"Mr. Connor, be careful!" Taran hurriedly shouted to Connor.
He paid no attention to Taran's warning and continued walking forward.
"Da-da-da..."
The guards, unable to contain themselves any longer, began wildly firing their weapons in his direction. Countless bullets rained down on him.
These guards were equipped with highly specialized weapons, boasting tremendous firepower. Moreover, with so many of them firing simultaneously, the scene was truly terrifying.
Even Yolanda, who was accustomed to Connor's power, couldn't help but reveal a trace of fear, as she had never witnessed anything like this before.

chapters.title: Chapter 2057: Not A Match
chapters.content:
Chapter 2057: Not A Match
The guard captain's furrowed brows seemed to relax slightly because he believed that, in this situation, Connor was undoubtedly doomed.
However, in the next moment, everyone present was stunned, their expressions filled with extreme shock. They realized that the bullets they had fired seemed to have grown eyes; they all missed his position and hit the area around him instead.
"What's going on here?" They wore puzzled expressions.
"Don't just stand there; keep firing!" the guard captain shouted, his eyes wide.
Upon hearing his words, the guards quickly raised their guns and continued to fire at Connor's position.
They knew that even if their bullets couldn't kill him, they had no other choice. If they couldn't stop him now, they might end up dead.
The rifles in the guards' hands spat flames, and countless bullets once again flew towards Connor's position.
Connor's expression remained indifferent. He waved his right hand gently, and a golden light enveloped his body.
As soon as the bullets touched the golden light, it was as if they had encountered an indestructible wall, incapable of harming Connor or those behind him, including Yolanda and Taran.
The scene was surreal. Countless bullets were flying toward Connor, but none of them could penetrate the thin golden barrier.
"I'm out of bullets," one guard suddenly turned to the captain and said.
"What? The bullets are gone?" The guard captain was stunned upon hearing this, his expression filled with disbelief.
"This guy is a monster; bullets have no effect on him!" another guard cautiously said.
The guard captain sighed deeply upon hearing these words. Although he felt helpless, he knew the guards were right. The bullets were useless, and continuing to fire was just a waste of ammunition.
When the guards ceased firing, the scene became chaotic. They didn't know what to do anymore.
Connor continued to walk forward, unfazed by the situation.
"Captain, he's approaching. What should we do?" another guard shouted.
The guard captain stared at Connor, his expression still filled with shock. He muttered to himself, "Who is this guy?"
The guard captain had been a mercenary abroad for many years and had encountered numerous martial artists. However, he had never seen anyone like Connor. His strength was terrifying, and bullets couldn't harm him.
These guards were equipped with real rifles, which had tremendous firepower. Even a normal person would have no chance against such a barrage of gunfire, let alone a martial artist.
"Captain, think of something quickly!" several guards urged.
"Stop wasting time, even if we can't stop this guy with bullets, we still have pistols! Keep firing!" the guard captain shouted.
Hearing the captain's words, the guards reluctantly raised their pistols and fired.
Countless bullets once again flew towards Connor's position.
Taran and Yolanda stood beside Connor, their expressions extremely tense. Despite knowing his strength, they couldn't help but feel anxious in the face of such a scene. The sheer number of bullets was overwhelming, and a slight mistake could be fatal.
However, he remained calm, moving forward amidst the relentless gunfire.
Half a minute later, the guards ceased firing once again. They knew that shooting was futile, and they were only wasting their bullets.
"Why did you all stop? Keep firing! Why are you all just standing there?" the guard captain shouted, his eyes wide with excitement.
"Captain, even if we keep firing, we can't stop this guy. Maybe we should give up!" a guard cautiously suggested.
The guard captain's expression showed a mixture of frustration. He took a deep breath but didn't urge the guards to continue firing. He knew that these guards were right. The bullets couldn't harm him, and continuing to shoot was pointless.
With the guards no longer firing, Connor continued to walk towards the villa. The guards watched him in silence, too afraid to take any action. They didn't dare to provoke him, fearing dire consequences.
The guard captain was still unwilling, but he had no choice. His martial arts level was far too low to be Connor's opponent.
In the surveillance room, Yamino and Juan had observed the situation outside. Their expressions were filled with disbelief, as they had never encountered such a situation before.
"Dad, how can Connor's strength be so terrifying?" Juan turned to Yamino and asked, his voice trembling.

chapters.title: Chapter 2058: Money Isn't a Problem
chapters.content:
Chapter 2058: Money Isn't a Problem
"Who should I ask?!"
Yamino retorted fiercely.
"Dad, Connor is about to enter the villa. Think of a solution quickly!"
Juan pointed at the screen and shouted.
Upon hearing this, Yamino quickly glanced at the screen in front of him. He noticed that the guards had given up resisting, and Connor was advancing unhindered towards the villa.
"These useless fools! I paid them so much money, and they can't even handle this simple task. They're just useless!"
He shouted angrily and picked up a walkie-talkie, dialing a number.
"When will your helicopter arrive?"
After the call was connected, Yamino shouted angrily.
"Mr. Yamino, we're already moving at the fastest speed, but... It will still take at least five minutes!"
The person on the other end stammered.
"Five minutes!"
Yamino's expression turned angry upon hearing this. However, he didn't say anything more and hung up the phone.
"Dad, we might not last five minutes..."
Juan said to Yamino in a low voice.
"We have to hold on..."
Yamino replied expressionlessly and then picked up the walkie-talkie, shouting, "Now, I want your men to hold on for five more minutes. If they can hold on for five minutes, regardless of whether Connor is alive, injured, or dead, each of you will receive an additional ten million US dollars as a reward."
"Mr. Yamino, we really can't hold on. We've tried everything we can, but we can't stop this Connor!"
Although the guard captain also wanted the money, he knew it was impossible for them to stop Connor with just their forces.
Yamino took a deep breath upon hearing the guard captain's words and then whispered, "Alright, twenty million for each person, thirty million for those who die. One billion for you. Just hold on for the last five minutes!"
"Mr. Yamino, that's a lot of money!"
The guard captain was surprised at his generosity.
"Don't waste time. If you can delay Connor for five minutes, money is not a problem. Do you understand what I mean?" he shouted.
"We understand, we understand!"
The guard captain couldn't refuse the temptation of one billion dollars and quickly agreed.
Yamino let out a long breath after hanging up the walkie-talkie. He then turned to Juan and said, "Let's go to the rooftop and wait. Master Warlock should already be on the rooftop."
"Dad, you're only calling Master Warlock to come?"
Juan hesitated before asking.
"I was worried about leaks, so I only informed you and Master Warlock. I didn't expect Connor to come to us in the end."
Yamino continued walking towards the outside of the house, speaking softly.
Upon hearing his words, Juan's expression turned somewhat awkward, and he didn't dare to say much.
...
On the other side, Connor had approached to within a hundred meters of the villa.
"Brothers, we have a chance to change our family's destiny. Just now, Mr. Yamino told me that as long as we can stop this person for five minutes, we'll each receive two million US dollars as a reward. If you die or get injured, the amount doubles, and Mr. Yamino will personally deliver the money to your families!"
The guard captain shouted excitedly.
Upon hearing this, all the guards were stunned, their expressions conflicted.
"Brothers, why did we become mercenaries? To improve our family's lives, right? Our lives have no hope, and since we chose this path, it means we are prepared to risk our lives for money. Now, a tremendous opportunity is before us. As long as we can stop this person for five minutes, you will secure a worry-free life for your wives, children, and parents!"
The guard captain continued, trying to stir their emotions.
"That's right, Captain is right. If we were afraid of death, we wouldn't have become mercenaries. Can't we raise pigs at home instead?"
"You're absolutely right. If I were afraid of death, I wouldn't have become a mercenary. Can't we stay at home and raise pigs?"
Their emotions seemed to be stirred, and they shouted in agreement.
"This is our last chance. If you want to make money, charge with me. If you want to survive, stay in your position. I won't blame you!"
The captain yelled, eager to secure Yamino's promised reward.
The rest of the guards started to move, those with bullets in their guns raised them and started firing at Connor, while those without bullets tried to block Connor's path with their bodies.
Their goal now wasn't to kill or injure Connor. Instead, they wanted to delay him for five minutes. Once the time was up, they would receive their reward.
These guards were genuine desperados, and nothing was more important to them than money. If they had other means to survive in society, they wouldn't have chosen this path.
In other words, money was the most important thing for them once they had chosen to become mercenaries.
If they had another way to survive in this world, they would never have embarked on this path.
Since they had become mercenaries, they had already made peace with life and death.
In simple terms, as long as the money was right, everything else was negotiable.
Moreover, they knew that Connor was here to kill Yamino. If they didn't stop him, no one would pay their salaries. They would have wasted their time, and the injured might not even get medical expenses. This was something they couldn't accept.
In a moment, the guards, who had already calmed down, was instantly fueled up with motivation as they charged at him.
At this point, they had completely put life and death out of their minds. All they thought about was making a little more money for their families, allowing them to live a slightly better life.
Yolanda didn't expect these guards to still dare to attack Connor. Her face showed a hint of confusion.
She couldn't understand why these people, who had just witnessed Connor's strength, were charging towards him.
"Do they really have no fear of death?" she said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2059: The Last Trump Card
chapters.content:
Chapter 2059: The Last Trump Card
"Who isn't afraid of death? But for them, money, this thing, may be more important than life!"
Taran had contact with people in this line of work before, so he understands their mindset very well.
"Money is even more important than life?"
When Yolanda heard this sentence, her expression seemed even more puzzled.
"You, as a young lady from a wealthy family, naturally wouldn't understand this reasoning. After all, you have no idea how ordinary people live. If they were given a choice, they wouldn't want to live like this!" he said in a low voice.
She instinctively turned her head to look at him but remained silent.
As Connor watched the guards rushing towards him, he couldn't help but feel some pity for these people. He knew that these guards were not killers; they were just ordinary people.
After hesitating for a moment, he lightly waved his right hand, and a terrifying aura burst forth, instantly sending the person in front of him flying.
For a moment, cries of pain filled the air. These people were simply too weak in front of him. If they really wanted to stop him, it will be impossible.
However, this time, the guards didn't give up on trying to stop Connor just because they saw their companions injured.
They continued to rush towards him, some of them choosing to stand at a distance and open fire, hoping to suppress him with firepower.
Their goal now was not to kill Connor but to delay him for five minutes. Just five minutes, and they could earn millions of dollars. This amount of money was extremely tempting to them.
However, these people may have underestimated his strength.
In less than half a minute, all the guards had fallen to the ground, completely losing their combat ability. Their faces contorted in pain, but even so, some of them gritted their teeth and tried to stand up to stop him.
Connor looked at these guards with indifference and said, "I didn't use my full strength just now, so you can still hear me talking. But if you continue to block me, don't blame me for being impolite. You have no grievances with me; I don't want to kill you!"
Upon hearing his words, the group of people hesitated.
He didn't pay any more attention to them and continued walking towards the villa.
This time, the guards finally gave up on resisting. They knew that he had not been ruthless just now, and he had been quite merciful to them.
A few seconds later, he entered the villa.
Yolanda and Taran followed closely behind him, while the guards inside the villa froze in place, their expressions filled with tension.
"If you don't want to die, get out of my way!" he said expressionlessly to the guards.
Upon hearing his words, the guards were relieved and quickly turned to run out of the villa.
Once the guards had left, Connor briefly surveyed the interior of the villa. The villa was luxuriously decorated, with multiple floors and numerous rooms. It would take some time to determine which room Yamino was in.
"Mr. Connor, what do we do next?" Taran asked in a low voice.
Connor gave him a glance and then directly enveloped the entire villa with his divine sense.
For an ordinary person, finding Yamino would not be easy, but for Connor, it was not a difficult task at all.
In just a few seconds, he had located Yamino's position and said softly, "He's on the rooftop. Follow me!"
On the villa's rooftop, Yamino and Juan stood anxiously. Their faces were filled with worry as they repeatedly called for the helicopter to arrive.
"Dad, it seems like Connor has already entered the villa!" Juan stammered.
"What did you say?" Yamino's eyes widened upon hearing this.
"The guards were no match for Connor. They couldn't stop him, and now he's inside the villa..."
Juan repeated helplessly.
"These useless people! They couldn't even hold on for five minutes. I've spent so much money training them, and at a critical moment, they can't even handle such a simple task!"
Yamino gritted his teeth in frustration.
"Dad, what's the point of saying this now? When will the helicopter arrive?" Juan asked nervously.
"Who should I ask if not you? If you hadn't lured him here, how could there be so many problems?"
Yamino snapped at him.
"Dad, I know I was wrong. Can you please figure out a solution? You know Connor's strength. If he really charges up here, both of us will die!"
Juan said anxiously.
Yamino took a deep breath, then squinted his eyes as he looked into the distance. His only hope now was for the helicopter to arrive soon.
"Don't need to be too nervous. The villa is so large; he shouldn't find us so quickly!" A middle-aged man standing next to Yamino suddenly spoke.
"Master Warlock, if Connor charges up here, you must protect both of us!" Juan quickly said to the middle-aged man.
"Don't worry..."
Master Warlock replied calmly.
This middle-aged man was named Warlock Zen, and he was Yamino's last resort. He possessed the terrifying strength of a Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master.
In Yarlford, almost anyone who had heard of Yamino also knew about the existence of Warlock. Several years ago, Warlock had helped him resolve many problems.
However, in recent years, it had become rare to see Warlock, and no one had witnessed him take action. Warlock's Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master level of strength, combined with the fact that Yamino had trained many martial artists over the years, meant that ordinary matters didn't require Warlock to personally intervene. Typical issues could be handled by other martial artists.
But the current situation was different. Yamino was well aware of Connor's terrifying strength.
Furthermore, Yamino didn't have complete trust in the other martial artists. However, he had full faith in Warlock, as Warlock was the one person who wouldn't betray him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2060: Deep Hatred
chapters.content:
Chapter 2060: Deep Hatred
Yamino hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at Warlock.
He paused for a moment and then said, "Master Warlock, if Connor catches up with us later, we might need to trouble you to delay him for some time..."
"Mr. Yamino, you don't need to be so polite with me. My life is in your hands. Although I may not be a match for Connor, if I'm willing to risk my life, I should be able to buy you some time to escape..."
Warlock replied in a low voice.
Yamino looked at him, took a deep breath, and said, "I knew I didn't make a mistake in my judgment. In this situation, your willingness to help is truly moving."
"Mr. Yamino, there's no need to be so polite between us," Warlock said with a smile.
"Rest assured, as long as I'm alive, I will take care of your wife and child. At the very least, I can ensure they have a comfortable life..."
Yamino patted his shoulder.
"Thank you, Mr. Yamino!"
He nodded lightly, his expression very calm.
He knew how terrifying Connor's strength was. If Connor really made it to the rooftop, he wouldn't be a match. All he could do was buy time for Yamino and Juan.
Yamino had saved Warlock's life in the past, which was why he was now willing to sacrifice himself to protect him.
Over the years, Yamino had indeed cultivated many loyal subordinates who remained by his side. If it weren't for Connor's overwhelming strength, getting rid of Yamino wouldn't be an easy task.
"Mr. Yamino..."
Warlock began to speak again, but his words were cut off midway.
"Master Warlock, what's wrong?" Yamino hurriedly asked.
"Connor, he should be here..."
Warlock said in a low voice.
"What... What did you say?"
Yamino was astonished upon hearing this, and his expression was one of disbelief.
Juan was also extremely nervous because they hadn't expected Connor to arrive so quickly.
"I sense a very powerful aura approaching our location. I think he should be coming up!"
Warlock's expression remained calm as he whispered to Yamino.
Upon hearing his words, Yamino was momentarily stunned, his expression filled with surprise. He didn't know how to react to the situation.
"But the helicopter hasn't arrived yet. What should we do now?" Juan exclaimed anxiously.
"Don't worry. Although I may not be Connor's match, it won't be so easy for him to kill both of you in my presence. I will do my best to protect you and buy you time. When the helicopter arrives, you two should board it as soon as possible!"
Warlock calmly stated.
Yamino and Juan exchanged glances and didn't refute Warlock's words because they both knew that this might be their only chance to survive.
"The helicopter will arrive in one minute. Master Warlock, can you delay for two minutes?" Yamino hesitated for a moment before asking Warlock.
"No problem," Warlock said confidently.
"That's good, that's good..."
Yamino let out a long sigh.
"Tap, tap, tap..."
At that moment, the sound of footsteps echoed.
Yamino and Juan quickly looked towards the entrance to the rooftop. Yamino had locked the main door after reaching the rooftop, but for Connor, breaking through that door was child's play. With a single wave of his hand, he had already blasted the massive iron door open and was now striding onto the rooftop.
Yamino glared at Connor and then at Taran behind him, his expression filled with anger. He blamed Taran for handing over the evidence, which had led to his loss of trust with the Rockefeller Group. So, at this moment, Yamino's greatest resentment was not towards Connor but towards Taran.
"If it weren't for you handing over the evidence, the Rockefeller wouldn't have lost faith in me, and I wouldn't be in this situation now. I should have eliminated you when you first arrived in Yarlford!" Yamino gritted his teeth and said to Connor.
"Even when I first came to Yarlford, you didn't have the ability to eliminate me," he said calmly.
"Let's not dwell on the past. Let's talk, shall we?" Yamino was clearly deliberately trying to buy time.
"Talk?" Connor heard Yamino's words and couldn't help but sneer. He then said flatly, "Do you think there's a need for us to talk now?"
"Yes." Yamino stared wide-eyed at Connor and continued, "Connor, you've already brought me to this state. I've lost the trust of Rockefeller, and I'm no longer associated with them. The person you should truly deal with is Rockefeller, not me!"
"The person I want to deal with right now is you," Connor said calmly.
"What kind of deep-seated grudge is there between us that made you want to exterminate me?" Yamino asked through clenched teeth.
"Do you really not know the deep-seated grudge between us?" Connor replied expressionlessly, glancing at Taran.
Yamino took a deep breath and then said through gritted teeth, "You're retaliating against me because of your father, right?"
"Yes." Connor nodded without hesitation.
"I don't know how much you truly understand about what happened back then, but I want to tell you that the person who truly wanted to kill your father wasn't me. I was merely following orders. There's no deep-seated enmity between your father and me. Even if you kill me now, you won't be able to avenge your father!"
"Who wanted to kill my father?" Connor asked, looking at him.
"I can't tell you that right now..." he replied in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 2061: Leaving a Way Out
chapters.content:
Chapter 2061: Leaving a Way Out
After Connor heard Yamino's words, he could not help but reveal a playful expression.
He said coldly, "It's okay if you don't want to tell me now. I'll investigate who killed my parents. I'll also find the real culprit behind the scenes."
Yamino pretended to be excited and shouted at Connor. "Why? Does killing me benefit you in any way?"
"You have something to do with my parents, so I won't let you off no matter what!" Connor replied indifferently.
"Hu…"
Yamino took a deep breath, then muttered, "Connor, I hope that you can calm down now. The two of us can have a good chat…"
Yama sensed that something was wrong with Yamino and hurriedly said, "He seems to be deliberately stalling for time!"
"I know that. Since he wants to stall for time, then let's give him this chance. Besides, no matter who comes today, they won't be able to save him!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Yama hesitated for a moment and didn't say anything.
Yolanda subconsciously looked up at Connor with a helpless expression. She couldn't understand why Connor was so confident at all times.
"Connor, tell me your conditions. As long as you let me go, I can agree to any of your conditions!"
Yamino naturally did not know that Connor had already seen through his thoughts and was still continuing to stall for time.
Connor sneered. Then, he said, "If you use this method on others, it might have some effect. However, if you plan to use this method to make me let you go, then I advise you to give up as soon as possible. After all, you can't give me what I want."
After Yamino heard Connor's words, he was instantly speechless, and a trace of helplessness flashed across his face.
He knew in his heart that Connor was right. If he was facing an ordinary person, Yamino could use all kinds of methods to make the other party give up the idea of killing him. There was nothing in this world that he couldn't settle with money.
However, the person standing in front of him was Connor. Whether it was money or status, it was impossible to move Connor.
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly asked, "You should be waiting for reinforcements to come, right?"
"Reinforcements?"
After hearing Connor's words, Yamino pretended to be surprised and asked with a trembling voice, "What reinforcements?"
"Alright, it's already come to this. Don't put on an act with me. If you're waiting for reinforcements to come, I can give you this time. I can also eliminate the weeds and roots without leaving any future troubles!"
Connor did not know what trump cards Yamino still had in his hands. He was only thinking of completely resolving this big trouble of the Gomez family.
Unless it was a true peak ancient martial artist, Connor would not be afraid of anyone now.
Of course, Connor also knew that Yamino did not have the ability to invite a true ancient martial arts expert to help.
Juan gritted his teeth. "Connor, you are too confident…"
"You're not worthy of talking to me!" Connor replied with disdain.
Although Connor was about the same age as Juan, he actually didn't think highly of Juan at all. His true opponent was only Yamino. If Juan begged Connor for mercy, Connor might even let him go. After all, Juan wouldn't pose any threat to Connor, and there was no conflict between them.
Right at this moment, Taran suddenly opened his mouth and shouted at Yamino.
"Yamino, don't you always like to plan ahead? I wonder if you've ever thought that you would have this day?"
"Taran, you actually have the nerve to talk to me?"
Yamino's face was filled with anger after hearing Taran's words.
"Why wouldn't I dare to talk to you?" Taran replied indifferently.
"You are a traitor. If I can survive today, I will never let you off!"
Yamino said through gritted teeth.
"You won't have the chance…"
Taran said.
"The only thing I regret in my life is bringing you by my side. Don't forget that if I didn't bring you along back then, you might still be an accountant in a small company. I, Yamino, have treated you well, but how have you treated me?"
Yamino seemed to have lost control of his emotions as he shouted at Taran.
"How did I treat you?" After Taran heard Yamino's words, he couldn't help but laugh coldly. Then, he said indifferently, "Yamino, have you gotten amnesia? Have you forgotten that without my help back then, there's no way you could've gotten such a firm foothold in Yarlford? How could you have become the person-in-charge of Rockefeller's Sommerville branch? How could you have married Madeline? How could you kill your father-in-law and replace him?"
"You just said that you treated me well, right? I've been by your side for so many years and I've been willing to work for you, but you're always on guard against me. Before I found any evidence, you already had the thought of getting rid of me. Do you really think you don't know anything about these things?"
Yamino was stunned for a moment, and the expression on his face became even angrier.
"You…"
"You what? Did I wrongly accuse you? Many people told me that you planned to get rid of me, but I always thought that the two of us had walked through hard times together, so you wouldn't be so cruel to me. But who would have thought that you would really do it to me!" Taran continued.
"You know very well why I attacked you. If you treated me as a brother back then, why would you spend money to buy that evidence and not tell me?"
Yamino admitted the authenticity of the evidence in a moment of desperation.
"Back then, I bought the evidence from that person. I originally wanted to give it to you, but I was afraid that once I handed over the evidence, you would definitely find a way to get rid of me. So I gave up the idea. If you didn't do anything to me, no one would know about this matter, and no one would know about the existence of this evidence," Taran shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 2062: I Will Kill You
chapters.content:
Chapter 2062: I Will Kill You
"So you left an escape route for yourself?"
When Yamino heard Taran's words, he could not help but sneer. Then, he said with a playful expression, "Taran, do you think I don't know you? You kept the evidence just to threaten me at the right time. You didn't really work for me at all. You were always planning to get rid of me and replace me. I know all these things very well!"
Taran smiled disdainfully."That's just what you think. I've never thought of it that way. I'm not as ambitious as you are, and I definitely wouldn't kill my wife and father-in-law to seek a position. You're just a little too smart!"
"Nonsense! My mother and grandfather were not killed by my father!"
Juan shouted excitedly after hearing Taran's words.
"Hahaha…" Taran looked at Juan and laughed loudly. Then he said lightly, "Oh Yamino, you're so smart. How did you give birth to such a stupid son?"
"Taran, stop spouting nonsense here. My wife has nothing to do with my father-in-law's death…"
Yamino shouted and was about to continue speaking when a loud noise suddenly came from the sky.
Everyone hurriedly looked up and saw a helicopter slowly approaching the rooftop.
Yamino looked a little excited when he saw the helicopter. He had waited for such a long time and finally got a helicopter.
"Connor, my trump card has arrived!" Yamino shouted at Connor with a smug look in his eyes.
"Is that your trump card?"
Connor pointed at the helicopter.
"That's right, that's my trump card!"
Yamino nodded and said to Warlock, "Master Zen, I'll leave the rest to you!"
"Alight!"
Warlock didn't waste any words and nodded.
"Mr. McDonald, Yamino is planning to escape by helicopter!"
Taran hurriedly shouted at Connor after he reacted to what was going on.
"Don't worry, even if an immortal comes today, he won't be able to escape!"
Connor replied indifferently.
The helicopter soon arrived in front of everyone, and Yamino and Juan were not in the mood to continue talking nonsense with Connor. They walked towards the helicopter.
Warlock stood quietly on the spot. As long as Connor made a move, he would immediately attack Connor.
"Yamino, I was wondering what your trump card was. I didn't expect it to be a helicopter. You're too naive!" Connor shouted.
Yamino turned his head and glanced at Connor. He was not in the mood to pay attention to Connor at all as he continued to run towards the helicopter.
However, at this moment, Connor waved his right hand gently, and a light flashed.
The blinding light instantly pierced through the helicopter's propeller, and the helicopter crashed to the ground after losing its power.
At this moment, Yamino was less than five meters away from the helicopter. When he saw the helicopter land, the smile on his face instantly froze!
He thought that he could use the helicopter to leave this place, but he forgot how terrifying Connor's strength was. A mere helicopter was not worth mentioning in Connor's eyes.
This was also the reason why Connor mocked Yamino for being naive when he found out that Yamino's trump card was just a helicopter.
"Do you have any other trump cards? I advise you to take them out quickly. Otherwise, you might not have the chance later!" Connor said to Yamino with a smile.
"Connor, what do you want?"
Yamino turned his head to look at Connor and shouted with an excited expression.
The helicopter was like a lifebuoy for Yamino, but now that the lifebuoy was gone, he was plunged into despair.
"I'll kill you!"
After Connor replied indifferently, he directly strode over to Yamino.
"Master Zen, save me!" Yamino's face was filled with fear as he hurriedly shouted at Warlock.
Warlock took a step forward and stood in front of Connor.
"If you want to kill Mr. Gomez, you'll have to go through me first!"
Warlock said.
"Get lost, you're no match for me!"
Connor replied to Warlock.
…
Warlock's expression was a little angry after hearing Connor's words. Although he knew that he might not be Connor's opponent, Connor's attitude was really too arrogant.
As an ancient martial arts grandmaster, Warlock did not feel any respect from Connor.
"I know I'm not your match, but if you want to kill President Gomez, you have to get past me today!"
Warlock muttered.
Connor looked at Warlock from head to toe, then said, "Do you know what you are doing now?"
"..."
Warlock looked at Connor without saying anything.
"This matter is a personal grudge between me and Yamino, and it has nothing to do with you. I, Connor McDonald, am not someone who indiscriminately kills innocent people, so I will give you a chance to leave now," Connor said calmly.
Warlock looked at Connor from head to toe, then said softly, "I know you're doing this for my own good, but President Gomez's business is mine as well. No matter what you say today, I won't let you go!"
When Yamino and Juan heard Warlock's words, their expressions were a little touched. The two of them did not expect Warlock to be so Asyal. Even at this time, he did not give up on the two of them.
Connor saw that Warlock really had no intention of moving aside, so he directly walked towards him.
When Warlock saw Connor walking towards him, he looked a little nervous. He had heard a lot about Connor recently, so he would be lying if he said that he was not afraid at all.
However, Warlock was still a very Asyal person. Back then, Yamino had saved his life, so he was indebted to him. Therefore, even if Warlock died, he would never leave Yamino alone.
"I have nothing to regret if I am able to die in the hands of a practitioner like you…" Warlock said softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2063: Let's Make a Bet
chapters.content:
Chapter 2063: Let's Make a Bet
Connor looked at Warlock coldly, but he didn't say anything and continued walking forward.
When Yamino and Juan saw that Connor was getting closer and closer to them, their expressions became even more nervous because they had no idea what was going to happen next.
Warlock took a deep breath and took out a long blade from his back. It was nearly one meter long and emitted a green-blue light. This blade was a divine weapon passed down from Warlock's ancestors. Although it couldn't be compared to a Celestial Weapon, a divine weapon of this quality was very rare in the Sommerville ancient martial arts world. It was said that this blade was invincible and its sharpness terrifying. Even an ordinary ancient martial arts grandmaster would find it difficult to block the attack of this blade.
Under normal circumstances, Warlock would not have taken out this knife so easily.
However, this wasn't a normal situation. Warlock knew how terrifying Connor's strength was, so he didn't dare to be careless. He was prepared to use his full strength as soon as he attacked. This way, he might have a chance, although very slim.
However, after Connor saw Warlock take out his knife, his expression was still very calm as he walked forward.
Warlock immediately released the aura in his body, and the long saber in his hand began to emit waves of extremely dazzling light. It gave people the feeling that Warlock was holding a light saber in his hand.
"As expected of Master Zen. If he's powerful enough..."
Juan was a little excited when he saw this scene.
"I wonder if Master Zen can stop Connor?"
Yamino took a deep breath, the expression on his face nervous.
When Connor was talking to Warlock just now, Yamino had already contacted another helicopter to come over. This time, the helicopter he had gotten was a fighter plane. Not only was it bulletproof, but it also had terrifying lethality.
Yamino really thought that as long as Warlock could buy enough time, he still had a high chance of leaving this place.
However, Yamino might not know that with Connor's current strength, even if Warlock could delay Connor until the fighter jets appeared, Connor could still easily destroy them.
Connor's strength had long surpassed the scope of normal people's understanding. Those modern weapons were not worth mentioning to him.
However, at this moment, Connor had already walked to a position less than ten meters away from Warlock and took the initiative to speak.
"How about we make a bet?"
"Bet?"
Warlock couldn't help but feel cold after hearing Connor's words. Then, he frowned and asked, "Over what?"
"It's very simple. As long as you can take a punch from me, I'll let Yamino and Juan go today. What do you think?"
Connor asked softly.
"What?"
When Yamino and Juan heard Connor's words, shocked expressions appeared on their faces at the same time; the two of them had never thought that Connor would actually say such words.
If their hopes were very slim before, then their hopes were very high now.
They were all very aware that Warlock wasn't a match for Connor at all. However, if it was just Warlock blocking Connor's punch, Yamino felt that there shouldn't be too much of a problem.
"What is this Connor trying to do?"
Although Yamino was very happy inwardly, the expression on his face was still somewhat puzzled. He felt that Connor should not let him off so easily!
Warlock frowned. "I only need to take one punch from you, and you will let go of Mr. Gomez and his son?"
"That's right!" Connor nodded.
"You…"
Warlock's expression was a little angry. He glared at her and said, "Connor, I admit that your strength is indeed above mine. I might not be your match, but you don't have to humiliate me like this, right? Do you think I can't even block one punch from you?"
In Warlock's eyes, Connor's words were simply a blatant mockery. He did not put him in his eyes at all.
"You're right. I just feel that you can't even block one punch from me!"
"You…"
Warlock gritted his teeth. He was very angry because he felt that Connor had never treated him as an opponent.
If Connor really treated him as an opponent, how could he possibly say such arrogant words?
"Cut the crap. Are you betting or not?" Connor asked.
"Alright, I want to see how capable you are today to make you so arrogant. I have never been humiliated like this in my life. However, for the safety of President Gomez, I'm willing to bet with you!"
Warlock shouted at Connor.
"Haha…"
Connor smiled faintly. Then, without any hesitation, he directly rushed towards Warlock.
In an instant, an extremely terrifying aura erupted from Connor's body. This aura was abnormally shocking. It was completely incomparable to the aura that Warlock had just released.
Connor's aura surrounded his body, emitting bursts of golden light. It gave people the feeling that a huge dragon had appeared out of thin air and pounced straight at Warlock.
At this moment, the astonishing energy that Connor erupted with was already beyond words. Even if Yamino and Juan were not martial artists, they could still feel how terrifying Connor's move was.
"Connor's strength has actually reached such a terrifying level. This is truly unbelievable…" Yamino said in a low voice.
"What kind of monster is he!" Juan stuttered as his body trembled slightly.
Although Warlock was also shocked by Connor's strength, Connor would not give him too much time to be shocked. After Warlock took a deep breath, he hurriedly placed the long saber across his chest and released all the aura in his body.
In an instant, a green light enveloped Warlock's body.
"Although Connor's strength is terrifying, Master Zen is not an ordinary person. I hope Mhe can block Connor's punch!"
Yamino couldn't help but pray.

chapters.title: Chapter 2064: The Tip Of The Iceberg
chapters.content:
Chapter 2064: The Tip Of The Iceberg
"Bang!"
At this moment, everyone heard a loud bang.
Connor's fist fiercely smashed into the layer of strange light around Warlock's body. Unfortunately, this light was not worth mentioning in front of Connor. He easily shattered the light.
When the light shattered, Warlock's expression grew a little fearful. He also cried out in his heart, because he could feel how terrifying Connor's strength was from that punch just now.
After Connor easily shattered the light, his fist did not stop, but continued to smash toward Warlock.
Warlock placed his long saber horizontally in front of his chest, as if he was planning to use this saber to block Connor's punch.
He felt that although Connor had easily shattered the protective barrier in front of him, the power of Connor's punch should have been greatly weakened, so the long saber should be able to withstand Connor's punch.
However, Warlock might not know that his idea was a little too naive.
"Bang!"
With a loud bang, Connor's fist smashed fiercely on the long saber in front of Warlock's chest.
What no one had expected happened. Warlock's long saber was actually unable to withstand a single blow. It only caused Connor's fist to pause for a moment before snapping into two.
"This... How is this possible?"
After seeing Connor easily break his long saber, Warlock's expression seemed to be even more shocked.
He had never thought that the power of Connor's punch was actually already terrifying to such an extent.
Yamino and Juan were naturally shocked as well.
However, Connor's fist didn't seem to stop. After breaking Warlock's long saber, Connor's fist landed on Warlock's chest.
Warlock spat out a mouthful of blood, and then his entire body flew back.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned on the spot, and their expressions were extremely incredulous, especially Yamino and Juan. They didn't expect Warlock to be so weak in front of Connor. He couldn't even block a punch.
"Just how terrifying is this Connor's strength?"
Juan was in complete despair.
In Juan's eyes, Warlock was already the most terrifying martial artist he knew. Let alone someone who could defeat Warlock, there was no one who could even be compared to him.
However, the current Warlock in front of Connor could no longer be described as unable to withstand a single blow. The strength of the two of them was probably not on the same level at all.
"This... What should we do?"
Juan stood there in a daze, his face full of despair.
He originally thought that Warlock would be able to last a little longer, but who would have thought that Warlock would actually lose to Connor so quickly?
"Master Zen!"
After Yamino recovered from his shock, he quickly ran to Warlock's side.
However, when he saw Warlock lying on the ground, he was dumbfounded. Warlock had completely stopped breathing.
"Master Zen! Warlock!"
Yamino hurriedly knelt on the ground and shook Warlock's body desperately, but Warlock still had no reaction.
"Warlock, wake up!"
Yamino shouted at the top of his lungs as if he had gone crazy.
At this moment, Yamino's expression was extremely sorrowful. This wasn't an act because Warlock was already dead. No matter how sorrowful he looked, Warlock wouldn't be able to see it.
Yamino was devastated because Warlock was his last hope. If Warlock died, then he would definitely die too. Another point was that Warlock had been by Yamino's side for so many years, and the relationship between the two was very good. When seeing his old friend die because of him, even the most cold-hearted person would feel sad.
Juan was not very concerned about Warlock's death, however. All he could think about was how he should live.
Juan was different from Yamino. Yamino had been in the limelight in Yarlford for so many years and had enjoyed everything he needed to enjoy. Juan, on the other hand, was only in his twenties. He did not want to end his life like this.
Yamino hugged Warlock's body and cried loudly.
Connor walked up to Yamino and said to Yamino softly, "Do you still have any trump cards?"
"..."
Yamino only calmed down a little after hearing Connor's words. He hurriedly raised his head and glanced at him.
"Let me ask you, do you still have any trump cards?" Connor repeated indifferently.
"Connor…"
Yamino slowly raised his head and looked at Connor. Then, he stuttered, "Connor, listen to me. I know that there is a misunderstanding between the two of us, but things are really not what you think. Killing me now will not do you any good!"
Connor looked at Yamino without saying anything.
"Connor, it was indeed me who killed your parents back then, but there was no deep hatred between your parents and me. I was instructed to do all these things!" Yamino stuttered.
"My father is Steven Lee's son, right?"
Connor asked Yamino softly.
"Yes!" Yamino nodded, then said, "Your father is Steven Lee's son, and you are Steven's grandson. Back then, your father joined Rockefeller as a spy. Mr. Long discovered your father's identity, so he asked me to get rid of your father. These things actually have nothing to do with me. I'm just the lowest existence in Rockefeller. Everything I do is because of the orders given to me by the people above…"
"Even if you're not the mastermind behind these things, my parents still died at your hands in the end, so I still can't let you off!"
Connor said.
"But killing me now won't do you any good!" Yamino shouted and then continued, "I understand your character. You will never let go of Rockefeller and the others. However, you alone will never be able to deal with the entirety of Rockefeller. What you can see now is only the tip of the iceberg!"
"What does this have to do with whether I kill you or not?" Connor asked softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2065: Making a Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 2065: Making a Move
"You don't know Rockefeller, but I know Rockefeller like the back of my hand! So I can help you deal with them. As long as you are willing to let me go, I will do my best to help you!" Yamino said with a very serious expression.
The current Yamino was not lying to Connor. The words he said came from the bottom of his heart.
He knew very well that Asya already knew he had something to do with Tatum Lee's death, so he had lost his biggest backer in Rockefeller. Asya might even find someone to kill him.
Since he could no longer count on Rockefeller, then the best choice for Yamino now was to cooperate with Connor. In this way, not only could he get rid of Connor's pursuit, but he might even be able to get rid of Rockefeller's pursuit of him as well. This was simply killing two birds with one stone for him.
"You want to cooperate with me, right?" Connor asked coldly.
"It's not a collaboration. I can work for you. I'll do whatever you say in the future!"
Yamino hurriedly replied.
"Haha…"
Connor sneered. Then, he said indifferently, "I admit that you are very smart. Even in this situation, you can still come up with conditions that can move me. What you said just now is indeed very tempting. I do plan to deal with Rockefeller's people after getting rid of you, but I think I can deal with them myself. I don't need your help!"
"You don't understand Rockefeller. You can't deal with them on your own!" Yamino hurriedly shouted.
"Even if I can't deal with those people from Rockefeller, I will definitely not choose to cooperate with someone like you…"
Connor said.
"Why? Working with me is your best choice. Why aren't you willing to work with me?"
Yamino's face was filled with disbelief, because he did not expect that Connor actually still intended to kill him.
"Because I think people like you are unreliable. Now that you can betray even Rockefeller, you will betray me sooner or later. Although it may be much more convenient for me to cooperate with you, it will also bring me some unnecessary trouble in the future. So no matter what you say today, I will kill you!"
Connor knew that Yamino was a cunning person. To be able to become famous in Yarlford for so many years, no one would believe that Yamino was an ordinary person.
Yamino's shrewdness and intelligence were also not something that ordinary people could imagine. If it wasn't because Connor had obtained the power of the remnant soul, he wouldn't dare to guarantee that he would be able to deal with Yamino.
Now, Connor understood one thing. In this world, only true strength could solve all problems. In front of absolute strength, money was insignificant.
Previously, when Connor was just an ordinary martial artist, he was very rich, but there were many things that Connor could not solve.
Now that Connor had enough strength to crush his enemies, many things could be easily solved.
To put it simply, in the eyes of ordinary people, money could settle anything. However, in the world of the truly rich, strength was king.
Yamino looked at Connor with a dull gaze, not knowing what to do for a moment.
He knew very well that no matter what he said now, Connor would not let him off.
"Is there anything else you want to say to Taran?" Connor asked.
Yamino slowly raised his head and looked at Taran. Then, he said in a low voice, "Taran, I ruined your life back then, and now you've ruined everything for me. The two of us can be considered even!"
"..."
Taran looked at Yamino without saying anything.
He didn't know how many times he had dreamt of this. In this world, there was no one who wanted to see Yamino die more than Taran did. However, when this scenario was actually playing out, Taran didn't feel the slightest bit of happiness. On the contrary, the expression on his face was very solemn.
"If you hadn't chosen to hunt me down back then, perhaps none of this would have happened!" Taran muttered to Yamino.
"What if?"
Yamino sneered and said indifferently, "How can there be so many ifs in this world? If I could really go back to the past, I might not have chosen to come to Yarlford, nor would I have joined Rockefeller. No matter where we are, we don't need anyone's help. We could live a life thousands of times better than ordinary people. Unfortunately, I still died from my ambition in the end!"
"Now, you have finally understood this principle. Unfortunately, you have understood it a little too late…" Taran said.
