Yamino looked at Taran and let out a long sigh. He did not continue to say anything.
"Connor, these things have nothing to do with my son. Can you let him off?" Yamino muttered.
"Sure…"
Connor nodded without any hesitation.
After all, these matters did not have much to do with Juan. Moreover, Connor also knew that Juan was a regular run-of-the-mill rich heir. Once Yamino was gone, Juan would not be able to achieve anything. Naturally, he would not be able to pose any threat to Connor.
"Thank you, thank you!"
Yamino did not expect that Connor would actually agree so readily and hurriedly bowed towards him.
Juan had been dumbstruck the entire time. He had never thought that Yamino would actually plead for him at this time.
Juan was only thinking about how he should survive. He didn't even consider Yamino's life or death.
Connor turned to Taran and asked softly, "Do you want to do it, or should I?"
After Taran heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment, then he muttered, "Mr. McDonald, you should do it!"
Although Taran hated Yamino very much, if he really had to make a move to kill Yamino now, he somehow still could not bring himself to do it.
Connor didn't waste any time talking to Taran and slowly raised his right hand.
Yamino had completely given up resisting and closed his eyes, waiting for death to arrive.
Juan's face was full of fear. He stood there trembling. He wanted to say something, but he didn't dare to. He was afraid that he would anger Connor.
"Boom!"
Just as Connor was about to make a move, a huge rock directly smashed towards Connor.
The expression on Connor's face grew a little strange. Then, he waved his right hand suddenly and shattered the stone with his aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 2066: Three Purities Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 2066: Three Purities Sect
"Bang!"
The huge stone instantly turned into ashes and dissipated between heaven and earth.
After the dust dissipated, an old man appeared in Connor's sight.
The old man's appearance was extremely ordinary. If one just looked at his appearance, there was no way to tell how terrifying his strength was. However, Connor could feel that the old man who appeared in front of him was not an ordinary person. His aura far exceeded Warlock's.
The old man floated in the air and looked at Connor.
When Yamino saw this old man, his expression was abnormally fearful. He hurriedly shouted at Connor, "Connor, I beg you, kill me quickly!"
Connor turned his head and looked at Yamino without saying anything.
"Connor, hurry up and do it. This person is one of Asya's people. His strength is very terrifying. If I fall into his hands, I'm afraid I'll be better off dead!"
Yamino's expression was very fearful as he shouted at Connor.
"..."
When Connor heard Yamino's words, he could not help but be stunned for a moment. Because originally, Connor thought that this old man was here to save him, but from Yamino's current reaction, he could tell that wasn't the case at all.
"Connor, hurry up and do it. Haven't you always wanted to kill me?" Yamino shouted after seeing that Connor did not react for a long time.
Connor ignored Yamino and looked at the old man. He asked softly, "Who are you?"
"Hello, Mr. McDonald. My name is Yanni Boston, the butler of Rockefeller!"
The old man replied to Connor.
"Rockefeller?"
Connor sneered when he heard Yanni's words, then continued, "You're here to save Yamino?"
"Yes, and no…"
Yanni shook his head gently and continued, "Yamino is one of Rockefeller's people, and he has done something that is detrimental to Rockefeller's interests, so he cannot die at your hands. I need to bring him back to Asya's side and let Asya deal with him!"
Yamino's expression changed drastically when he heard Yanni's words. His guess was right: Asya would never be so kind as to come and save him.
Even if he didn't die in Connor's hands today and was brought back to Asya, being killed by Connor might be the preferable outcome. He knew Asya's methods too well. At that time, Asya would definitely torture him to death.
This was also the reason why Yamino was so terrified when he saw Yanni.
"Connor, I beg you. Please kill me. Don't hand me over to this person. I beg you…"
Yamino directly knelt on the ground and shouted at Connor with an extremely excited expression.
Connor glanced at Yamino indifferently, then said to Yanni in a low voice, "I don't care who you are, and I don't care what your purpose is. Yamino is the person I want to kill, so no matter who comes today, he must die!"
After hearing Connor's words, Yamino's expression eased up a little.
"Mr. McDonald, I know that you have some conflicts with our Rockefeller, but these conflicts have not reached an irreparable level. Asya has already instructed me to tell you that as long as you are willing to hand Yamino over to me today, then for the next five years, our Rockefeller people will not find trouble with you!" Yanni said slowly.
"You won't find trouble with me for the next five years?" Connor smiled disdainfully.
"Mr. McDonald, if you are not willing to hand over Yamino, that means that you are not willing to coexist peacefully with Rockefeller. Then I can only resort to more drastic methods!" Yanni continued.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Yanni. He knew Rockefeller's style of doing things better than anyone else. Although Yanni said that he wouldn't find trouble with Connor for the next five years, as long as Yanni brought Yamino back to Asya's side, they would immediately turn hostile.
Now that Connor already knew his identity, the blood feud between him and Rockefeller was not something that could be explained in just a few words. If Connor did not know this, then Connor might still consider getting rid of Yamino and peacefully coexist with Rockefeller. However, now that Connor knew that Rockefeller was the mastermind behind all of this, even if their people did not make a move against Connor, he would still think of ways to deal with them.
"Do you think you can snatch this person away from me?"
Connor asked Yanni.
"We shall see!" Yanni said lightly.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer. Then, he opened his mouth and was about to speak, but at that moment, Yolanda suddenly called out.
"Mr. McDonald!"
Connor turned to look at her. "What's wrong?"
"I remember who this person is!" Yolanda shouted excitedly.
"You know this person?"
"I don't really know him, but I've heard my master mention him before. This Yanni Boston seems to be the Sect Leader of the Three Purities Sect!"
Yolanda quickly said.
"Three Purities Sect?"
After Connor heard this name, his expression was a little confused. Although Connor hadn't been in contact with ancient martial arts for a long time, he had heard of most of the famous ancient martial arts grandmasters in Sommerville. However, he had never heard of this Three Purities Sect.
"My master said that 30 years ago, the Three Purities Sect could be considered one of the more famous sects in Sommerville. It could even be compared to the four big sects. However, in order to practice evil techniques, the sect leader of the Three Purities Sect killed many innocent martial artists in Sommerville. The sect leader of the Purple Cloud Sect, Jorge Yarrell, personally fought the sect leader of the Three Purities Sect. In the end, Jorge Yarrell defeated the then sect leader Milo Stilton, who then disappeared!" Yolanda quickly explained.
"So that's how it is!"
Connor nodded.
"Because the whereabouts of the sect leader of the Three Purities Sect were unknown, the Three Purities Sect naturally fell apart and finally disappeared into the Sommerville ancient martial arts!"
Yolanda looked up at Yanni and asked, "You should be the Sect Leader of the Three Purities Sect, right?"
"That's right, the person you're talking about is me!" Yanni didn't refute her words at all. He nodded and then laughed, "I didn't expect that even after so many years, there would still be people from the Summer Ancient Martial Arts who remember me!"
"What do you have to be proud of? People like you have long become the laughing stock of the ancient martial arts world!"
Yolanda shouted coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2067: Crash to the Ground
chapters.content:
Chapter 2067: Crash to the Ground
"A laughing stock?"
Yanni furrowed his brows, but there was no sign of anger on his face.
He smiled faintly and did not look angry at all.
"So what if I become a laughing stock? In the world of martial artists, the winner has always been the king, and the loser is the bandit. Back then, I lost to Jorge Yarrell, and the future generations would definitely think that I, Yanni, was a bad person. But if I had won back then, the outcome would have been different…"
Yanni paused for a moment, then asked him softly, "You should be Jorge Yarrell's disciple, right?"
"That's right!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"I'm actually very grateful to your master. If he hadn't defeated me back then and chased me out of the hot summer, I wouldn't have the achievements I have today!" Yanni said softly.
"Whatever grudge you have with my master has nothing to do with me, but no matter what, you can't take Yamino away today!"
Connor calmly said.
"That depends on whether you have the ability to stop me!" Yanni replied coldly and then released the aura in his body.
"A Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?" Connor said softly after sensing Yanni's aura.
"That's right!"
Yanni gently nodded.
Connor took a deep breath and released his own aura.
After everyone present felt the auras of Connor and Yanni, their expressions became extremely ugly because they found it difficult to withstand such terrifying pressure.
Yamino and Juan were both ordinary people. Therefore, when they sensed the auras of Connor and Yanni, they found it difficult to breathe.
However, this was only the beginning. Connor and Yanni were still releasing their auras.
Yolanda had been using her aura to protect Taran all this time. However, because her realm was a little low, her expression was very strained.
"Boom!"
At this moment, Connor's aura clashed with Yanni's aura.
At this moment, it was a competition of the strength of their auras.
A few seconds later, Yanni seemed to feel that if he continued to compete like this, he wouldn't be a match for Connor. He suddenly waved his right hand, and his aura directly rushed towards Connor like a shocking wave.
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat disdainful as he punched out.
This punch dispersed Yanni's aura, and the golden fist mark continued to fly towards Yanni.
After Yanni saw this scene, the expression on his face grew somewhat strange. He didn't expect Connor's fist technique to have such astonishing power.
"As expected, you live up to your reputation!"
Yanni thought, and then punched out as well.
The two fists collided.
At the moment of the explosion, Connor stood still, while Yanni took half a step back.
Therefore, in this exchange, Connor had a slight advantage, but it was not particularly obvious.
"As expected of the Mr. McDonald who could cause a bloody storm in the ancient martial arts world of Sommerville. You already have such terrifying strength at such a young age. If you were given a few more years, I reckon that there won't be many people in the world who can be compared to you!" Yanni sighed softly.
"You're a heaven-tier ancient martial arts grandmaster, but you weren't chased by those peak ancient martial arts masters. This means that you should be with those people, right?" Connor said.
Yanni didn't hide anything from Connor and nodded his head directly. "That's right. I was one of the people who chased after Walter Collier back then. Not only did I work for Rockefeller, but I also worked for the Land Deities!"
"Land Deities?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Yanni's words. Then, he lightly said, "The Land Deities you mentioned are the peak of the ancient martial arts?"
"Yes, as long as I follow their instructions, I will also be qualified to become a peak ancient martial artist in ten years. When I joined Rockefeller, it was also the arrangement of the Land Deities!" Yanni said slowly.
Connor couldn't help but frown after hearing Yanni's words, because this was what he was most worried about.
If Rockefeller's people were really connected to those peak ancient martial artists, then it would be even more difficult for Connor to deal with Rockefeller.
"Connor, you should already know my identity. I'm not only a man of Rockefeller, but also a man of the Land Deities. In this world, there can be people who provoke Rockefeller, but there is absolutely no martial artist who can disobey the intention of the Land Deities. Today, as long as you hand over Yamino to me, I can let you go. I can even ask the Land Deities to take you in as a disciple," Yanni said in a low voice.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Yanni without saying anything.
At this time, the Land Deities mentioned by Yanni were actually an alliance formed by those peak ancient martial art practitioners. These people controlled all the martial art practitioners on Earth. They selfishly enjoyed the most precious spiritual energy of heaven and earth left by the heavens for the martial art practitioners. Moreover, there were many Heaven Rank ancient martial art grandmasters among their ranks. These Heaven Rank ancient martial art grandmasters obeyed the orders of those peak ancient martial art practitioners. Their goal was to one day obtain the recognition of the Land Deities and become a true peak ancient martial art practitioner.
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Yanni softly, "How many peak ancient martial artists are there in this world?"
"I'm not sure…"
Yanni shook his head and continued, "I only listen to the orders of the Land Deities, but I don't know how many peak ancient martial arts existences there are!"
"..."
Connor looked at Yanni without saying anything.
"Connor, you are indeed very powerful. Even I admire you a little. If you hand Yamino over to me now, your future will be limitless!" Yanni said.
"What if I don't hand him over?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"If you are unwilling to hand over Yamino, then I can only kill you!" Yanni replied.
"You don't have the ability!" Connor gave a cold laugh. Then, he turned his head to look at Yamino, and immediately after, he waved his right hand fiercely.
A dazzling light directly pierced through Yamino's forehead. Yamino did not even have time to react to what was going on before he fell to the ground with a loud thud.
"Dad!"
After Juan saw Yamino fall down, he was shocked. He shouted with an excited expression, then knelt on the ground and hugged Yamino's corpse as he wailed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2068: Avery
chapters.content:
Chapter 2068: Avery
No one had expected that the business tycoon Yamino Gomez, who had awed the entire Yarlford, would die such a tragic death.
It was as if what Connor had just killed was not a person, but an ant. It was extremely easy.
In the eyes of ordinary people, Yamino might be a great figure who could easily change a person's fate with a wave of his finger. However, in the eyes of the truly powerful people like Connor and Yanni, he was no different from ordinary people. He was like an ant.
At this moment, Yamino's face seemed to be smiling, because he knew that he was finally free.
Now, dying in Connor's hands was already the best outcome for him. If he had fallen into Yanni's hands, that would be a fate worse than death.
Yanni stared at Connor with his eyes wide open, his expression unusually angry.
"Connor, you actually killed Yamino?"
Yanni could not believe what he was seeing.
"Didn't you hear what I said to you just now?" Connor replied coldly and continued, "No matter who stops me today, Yamino must die!"
"You…"
Yanni looked at Connor's face with an expression of extreme anger.
This was because snatching Yamino was a mission given to him by Asya. Now that Connor had killed Yamino, it meant that his mission had failed.
Yanni wasn't afraid of Asya, but he was very afraid of the people of the Land Deities. If he were to be held accountable for this matter, his many years of hard work might go down the drain.
"Connor, you actually ruined my plan. Today, I will kill you and take your head back to report my mission!" Yanni shouted with red eyes.
"That depends on whether you have the ability!"
Connor calmly replied.
Yanni was completely enraged by Connor. His body was emitting bursts of red light, and his expression was very angry.
In the next second, Yanni attacked.
Like a bolt of lightning, he rushed towards Connor and grabbed at his chest with his right hand.
The moment Yanni made his move, the sky changed color, lightning flashed, and thunder rumbled. Countless auras surged into Yanni's body, forming a huge blood-red claw, which ferociously grabbed at Connor.
Connor had encountered many ancient martial arts experts, but he had never encountered a martial arts practitioner who used claws.
Such an attack method was very rare.
Furthermore, Connor knew that Yanni's claw attack was extremely terrifying. If he was hit, even an ancient martial arts grandmaster would either die or be injured.
The moment he attacked, Yanni had already used all his strength. From this alone, one could see how angry Yanni was at this moment.
Yolanda stared nervously at Connor. She wasn't sure if Connor could block Yanni's attack.
If Connor lost to Yanni today, the last hope of the Sect of Wonders would be destroyed.
The expression on Taran's face also seemed to be very nervous. Although Yamino was already dead and Taran's revenge had already been taken, no matter what, Connor was Taran's savior, so Taran didn't want to see him in any danger.
Meanwhile, Juan stared at Yanni in a daze. He didn't know who he should hope to win!
If Connor won, then he would be safe.
However, Connor was also Yamino's murderer— his father's murderer, so he was very conflicted.
Moreover, there were many drones in the sky at this time. These drones were monitoring the situation on the rooftop from various angles.
Connor had already noticed these drones, but Connor did not deal with them because there were so many drones. Even if Connor could shoot down some of them, there would be fish that slipped through the net. Therefore, Connor simply ignored these drones. Moreover, Connor was very clear in his heart who was behind these drones.
..
On a small island in the Pacific Ocean.
A private jet slowly landed. After the cabin door opened, a dark-skinned middle-aged man hugged a sexy woman dressed as a secretary. She was also dressed very scantily as they slowly got off the plane.
The middle-aged man's appearance could almost be described as ugly, but the woman in his arms was very beautiful. She was wearing stockings, had long golden hair, and had fair skin. Any man who saw this woman would involuntarily be moved.
When the staff on the island saw the middle-aged man, they took the initiative to greet him.
However, the middle-aged man's face was indeed cold. He did not respond to these people at all and walked straight to the villa in front.
This middle-aged man was Avery, one of the Four Great Vajras of Rockefeller. He controlled all of Rockefeller's businesses in Africa. His status was the same as Asya's. He could be considered the highest-ranking person in charge of Rockefeller other than Master Long.
A moment later, Avery walked into the palace-like castle with his female companion in his arms.
The expressions of the staff members who were in charge of receiving Avery earlier were a little abnormal.
"Didn't you just finish a meeting a while ago? Why are the Four Great Vajras here today?" a staff member said with a very puzzled expression.
"I think something big must have happened. Otherwise, Mr. Long definitely wouldn't be in such a hurry to call all the Four Great Vajras over…" his companion hurriedly replied.
"I heard that something happened in Sommerville. It seems that someone killed the person-in-charge of Rockefeller's branch there…"
"Even still, Mr. Long, you don't have to be so nervous, right?"
"That's right. After so many years, haven't there been many accidents involving the people-in-charge of Rockefeller? We should be used to it by now…"
At this moment, a few staff members who had nothing to do gathered together and started discussing softly.
"But I heard that the guy who killed the person-in-charge of our Rockefeller seems to have something to do with Steven Lee!"
"Are you crazy? This name can't be mentioned. If Mr. Long hears it, we're all dead!"
"Yeah, it's okay if you don't want to live anymore. Can you not pull us along?"
Everyone's expressions changed drastically when they heard the name Steven Lee. It was as if this name was a huge taboo in Rockefeller's headquarters.
"Let's not discuss that for now. I heard that Avery likes to play with women very much. He gets new woman almost every day. Moreover, these women are all born in big families."
At this moment, a staff member said lecherously, "Sigh, when can I be like Avery and play with different women every day…"
"That's right. I'd be so happy if any of Avery's women could be brought out for me to have a good time…"
Everyone seemed to be more interested in this topic.

chapters.title: Chapter 2069: Rockefeller Headquarters
chapters.content:
Chapter 2069: Rockefeller Headquarters
Meanwhile, Avery brought his female companion and strode into the castle.
This castle was the real headquarters of Rockefeller. Almost all the important decisions about Rockefeller were made here, and the real person in charge of Rockefeller, Mr. Long, lived in this castle.
It was said that this castle was built with tens of billions of dollars and was indestructible. Once the defense system was activated, even the most powerful missiles in the world could not break through, let alone pinnacle ancient martial arts grandmasters. Moreover, it was said that the number of ancient martial arts grandmasters in this castle was very terrifying. There was also a guard team of thousands of people. The weapons used by this guard team were all the most modern weapons in the world. And any one of them was a mystic class warrior. From this, one could see how terrifying Rockefeller's strength was.
It wasn't an exaggeration to say that if it were a relatively poor country, even if they used all their strength, they wouldn't be able to break through Rockefeller's castle.
After Avery entered the castle, he arranged for his female companion to stay in the room and then walked into the meeting room alone.
Before entering the meeting room, Avery underwent a very strict inspection.
This was Rockefeller's policy. No matter who it was, they would be checked before entering Mr. Long's room. Moreover, the strictness of the inspection was terrifying.
After about ten minutes, Avery finally entered the meeting room.
The decoration in the conference room could be said to be extremely luxurious, and the other three Vajras were already waiting in the conference room.
A middle-aged Opranian man in a black suit said softly when he saw Avery, "Avery, you're here?"
"Hehe…" Avery grinned when he heard this and continued, "I'm sorry. I was delayed by something just now and came a little late."
"It's not too late. Mr. Long hasn't come yet!" the Opranian man said lightly.
"Asya, I heard that you seem to have encountered some trouble recently. I wonder how you're dealing with it?"
Avery seemed to have a good relationship with Asya, so he chose to sit beside him.
"It should be settled soon!" Asya said expressionlessly.
"Humph!"
At this moment, the golden-haired middle-aged man opposite Asya snorted and said indifferently, "Asya, I've already told you that Yamino isn't a good person. You have to be careful. You insisted on not listening to me. Now, you've caused such a big trouble…"
The blond middle-aged man who spoke was Auro, who was mainly in charge of all of Rockefeller's businesses in Europe.
"Auro, what's the point of saying all this now? The matter has already happened. Mr. Long must have called us here to discuss how to deal with this matter!" the only woman in the meeting room shouted coldly.
This woman was the only woman among the Four Great Vajras, Amelia. Amelia was mainly in charge of Rockefeller's business in the Americas.
Furthermore, Amelia was the youngest of the Four Great Vajras because she had taken over from her mother.
When Amelia took over from her mother, Auro had been a hindrance, so the relationship between the two was not very good. On the contrary, Asya had provided Amelia with a lot of help.
On the surface, Rockefeller's Four Great Guardians all had their own territories, but in fact, they were also competing with each other.
Avery had a good relationship with the other three, and the conflicts weren't particularly obvious. He had the worst relationship with Auro and the best relationship with Asya.
Ame was only twenty-five years old this year, and it was not easy for her to reach his current position. On the one hand, it was because of Amelia's mother's strong recommendation and the fact that she could not find a more suitable candidate in America. On the other hand, Amelia's business acumen and skills were definitely not inferior to the other three people present; Rockefeller's performance in America had always been far superior to the other three continents.
Amelia was also very beautiful. She was a typical western beauty. She had blonde hair and blue eyes, and her body was sexy and hot. She wore a long red dress that revealed her sexy and alluring white legs. Coupled with her wavy golden hair, she exuded waves of alluring charm. Countless men in America fell in love with her.
However, Amelia was not interested in those ordinary men at all.
"I do have a lot of responsibility for Yamino Gomez's incident, but this is my own business, so you don't have to worry about it!" Asya muttered.
"What are you saying? We are all working for Rockefeller. Yamino has not only harmed one person's interests. My business has also been greatly affected, do you know that?" Auro shouted.
"Then what do you mean by that? Do you want me to compensate you?"
Asya asked expressionlessly.
"If you want to compensate, then I have no objections!" Auro said calmly.
"You!"
The expression on Asya's face was a little angry.
Avery felt that Asya and Auro were about to be at loggerheads, so he quickly laughed and shouted, "Alright, alright, stop arguing. Mr. Long will be here soon. If Mr. Long sees us, it won't be good..."
After hearing this, Asya and Auro seemed to have calmed down a little. They glared at each other and didn't say anything.
"Creak!"
However, at this moment, the door of the conference room was suddenly opened.
An old man in a white suit slowly walked into the meeting room with a walking stick.
When everyone saw the old man, they hurriedly stood up and shouted in unison, "Mr. Long!"
That's right, this old man was the real boss of Rockefeller, Mr. Long!
Whether it was Asya, Auro, Avery, or Amelia, these people all had extraordinary auras. Just one look at them made one feel that they were not ordinary people.
However, Mr. Long's appearance and temperament were very ordinary. He gave people the feeling that he was no different from an old man who practiced Tai Chi in the park every day.
If this old man was thrown into the crowd, no one would have thought that he actually controlled a business empire like Rockefeller.
"Sit down!"
Mr. Long waved at everyone.
The four of them hurriedly sat down.
Mr. Long walked to the front seat and said softly, "Actually, there's no other reason why I called you here today. I just want you to watch a battle!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2070: Equal Strength
chapters.content:
Chapter 2070: Equal Strength
"Watch a battle?"
Hearing this, the remaining three people, except for Asya, looked very confused.
They didn't know what Mr. Long meant.
Mr. Long didn't explain anything and waved at his assistant. The assistant hurriedly pressed the remote control, and the big screen in the conference room showed the battle between Connor and Yanni.
He chuckled. "You should all know Yanni Boston. You've met him before, so I won't introduce him to you. However, you may not know the little guy standing opposite Yanni."
"Connor McDonald?"
The expression on Avery's face was somewhat puzzled.
Ame quickly reacted and hurriedly asked, "Mr. Long, could this Connor be the grandson of Steven Lee that you mentioned before?"
"That's right, this little guy is the grandson of my old friend Steven Lee!"
Mr. Long nodded gently.
Everyone looked at each other in shock.
Although Mr. Long had mentioned Connor McDonald to them before, he had only mentioned his name.
Although the people of Rockefeller knew the relationship between Connor, Steven Lee, and Paxton McDonald, they had never taken Connor seriously because in their eyes, Connor would not pose any threat to Rockefeller at all.
However, Mr. Long had actually gathered everyone to watch Connor's battle. This was enough to show that Mr. Long was finally treating Connor as his opponent.
The four people present were all smart people. They vaguely felt that Connor might have already threatened Rockefeller.
"Back then, I investigated this little Connor. I thought he was just an ordinary person, so I didn't choose to get rid of him. After all, it's been so long since the incident between Steven and me. Moreover, Steven is already dead."
Mr. Long paused for a moment before continuing, "But I didn't expect this child to grow so fast. He's really worthy of being Steven Lee's grandson!"
Auro frowned.
"Mr. Long, this Connor is just a child. It shouldn't be difficult to get rid of him, right?"
"If it was really as simple as you said, Asya wouldn't have suffered at Connor's hands!" Mr. Long said calmly.
"That's because Asya was careless!" Auro said without thinking.
"Auro, what do you mean by that? If you think you can deal with Connor, then go ahead!" said Asya in a low voice.
"Some people just don't have to say anything!" Amelia added.
Mr. Long laughed and shouted, "Alright, alright, stop arguing, the two of you. I called you over today to let you take a good look at this little Connor's performance, not to listen to you argue!"
When everyone heard Mr. Long's words, they quickly shut their mouths and watched the situation on the big screen seriously.
…
On the other side, in Yamino's manor.
"Rumble…"
Right at this moment, Yanni's scarlet claw print had already flown less than ten meters away from Connor.
Yolanda, Taran, and Yama looked very nervous because they knew that the battle between Connor and Yanni was about to begin.
Connor took a deep breath, then roared and punched out.
"Seven Star Big Dipper Fist, Heavenly Sign!"
Following Connor's furious roar, a golden fist print directly struck out towards the scarlet claw print.
"Boom!"
Under everyone's shocked gazes, Connor's golden fist print and Yanni's claw print fiercely collided.
At this moment, it was as if the villa was violently trembling. Even the guards in the manor could clearly feel the trembling. It was like an earthquake, but far more terrifying.
In the next second, the collision of the two formed a very terrifying impact. The ground was constantly shaking, and this impact was like a missile that had detonated on the rooftop. In an instant, it swept through the entire manor. Countless innocent guards were affected by the energy impact. Those with slightly higher levels were barely able to withstand it, while those martial artists with lower levels were instantly sent flying, and then smashed fiercely onto the ground.
What kind of terrifying power was this? The two of them were actually able to injure countless bystanders who were hundreds of meters away from them!
Yolanda had been using her aura to protect Taran, preventing the energy shock from hurting him. However, because Yolanda's level was relatively low, the expression on her face was obviously a little strained.
After Connor threw out this punch, he gently waved his right hand, and a golden light barrier enveloped Yolanda and Taran.
Yolanda could feel that the impact of the power on her body was much smaller.
"How terrifying is Mr. McDonald's strength? In such an intense battle, you have the energy to care about me!" Yolanda thought.
After the loud explosion, Connor and Yanni could be considered to be evenly matched, and neither of them caused any damage to the other party.
Yanni was now a high Heaven Rank Ancient Martial Artist, only one step away from being a legendary Pinnacle Ancient Martial Artist. However, Connor didn't show the slightest disadvantage in the exchange just now. This was enough to prove that Connor's level wasn't weaker than Yanni, and might even be higher.
"Could it be that Connor has already broken through to the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts?"
The expression on Yanni's face was somewhat shocked.
"Impossible, this is absolutely impossible…"
However, Yanni quickly rejected this idea, because he felt that Connor was so young, and without the help of the Land Deities, no one could break through to the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts realm.
"Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, Demon Submission!"
Right at this moment, Connor let out a low growl and charged towards Yanni.
The expression on Yanni's face was a little strange, and he immediately struck out with his palm.
"Boom!"
Connor's fist and Yanni's palm collided fiercely, and both of their bodies retreated almost at the same time.
The two of them left huge scratches on the rooftop. Yanni was closer to the edge of the rooftop, so he stomped his foot and directly stepped into the cement floor to stabilize his body.
This time, the two of them were evenly matched.

chapters.title: Chapter 2071: Blood Fiend Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 2071: Blood Fiend Body
The battle was also being watched by the upper echelons of Rockefeller through the drones.
At this moment, Mr. Long's expression was very calm. It was as if this battle had nothing to do with him. He was completely a bystander.
On the contrary, Asya's expression was a little nervous. After all, these things were related to him. He couldn't avoid the responsibility of Yamino's problem. If Yanni could kill Connor today, the situation would be slightly better. If Yanni lost to Connor, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Avery, on the other hand, had a serious expression and sighed softly."I've come into contact with many martial artists over the years, but it's the first time I've seen a martial artist like Connor. He's so young, yet he's able to fight evenly with Yanni."
"Yeah, how can this Connor's strength be so terrifying? This is unbelievable!" Amelia hurriedly added.
Auro glanced at Asya and didn't say anything.
At this moment, he also knew that what he said just now was a little careless. Connor's strength was indeed very terrifying. It was not easy to deal with a person like Connor.
..
On the rooftop.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Yanni, who was opposite him. Although the two exchanges just now were evenly matched, Connor could feel that Yanni's strength was very terrifying, even more terrifying than Walter Collier's.
Moreover, after Connor experienced the great battle with Walter, his current aura was not in a very stable state.
Today's battle was also very troublesome for Connor.
"Where did your power come from?" Yanni muttered to Connor.
"This has nothing to do with you!"
Connor didn't intend to waste time with Yanni and directly attacked again.
After Yanni saw Connor make his move, his expression became a little strange. He immediately activated his technique.
In an instant, a red aura appeared around Yanni's body, and his body also turned into a terrifying scarlet color. His eyes and hair were the same color, which was a terrifying sight to the people watching it.
"This... Is this the Blood Fiend Body?"
Yolanda stuttered.
"What is the Blood Fiend Body?"
Taran was stunned for a moment and asked Yolanda with a puzzled expression.
"My master once told me that Yanni needed to kill a lot of people and drink their blood to cultivate the Blood Fiend Body. Once the Blood Fiend Body is formed, it can be indestructible. Opponents of the same level can't hurt him at all. Moreover, the recovery ability of the Blood Fiend Body is very terrifying."
Yolanda quickly explained.
"So it's effectively an undying body?"
When Taran heard this, he was stunned on the spot, disbelief on his face.
"That's what my master told me, but I don't know how high-level Yanni's Blood Fiend Body is!"
Yolanda replied nervously.
"If Yanni's body is truly immortal, wouldn't Mr. McDonald be in danger?" Taran stuttered.
Yolanda turned her head and looked at Taran with a helpless expression. She knew that even if they knew that Connor might be in danger, the two of them could not do anything now.
At this moment, Connor's body was also surrounded by a golden aura, giving people the feeling that he was a god who had descended to the mortal world.
Although Connor's aura wasn't weak, at least compared to those ancient martial arts grandmasters of the Sommerville ancient martial arts, it was inferior to the Chi around Yanni's body.
Yanni was someone that the Land Deities had taken a fancy to. If he did not have any real ability, how could he be qualified to work for the Land Deities?
For a moment, the two of them exchanged blows in the air.
Because Connor and Yanni were both very fast, Yolanda and Taran couldn't see the details of their fight clearly. It felt like a golden light and a red light were constantly colliding, and from time to time, there would be a sound that made people tremble. This sound was completely beyond the understanding of ordinary people. It gave people the feeling that it was the sound of two steel giants colliding.
The people from Rockefeller had a better view than Yolanda and the others. They played the video in slow motion, but they could only see a rough picture. They couldn't see many details.
"The speed of these two people is also... Wasn't that too fast? I couldn't even see it clearly in slow motion..." Auro stammered.
"Yanni should have the upper hand now!" Amelia said slowly.
"Although Yanni has the upper hand, the advantage is not very obvious. This is the first time I've seen Yanni being forced into such a state!"
Asya frowned and replied with a very serious expression.
"Hehe, interesting!"
Mr. Long smiled faintly as if he did not care about the outcome of this battle. It did not matter who won or lost.
"Bang bang bang!"
At this moment, two loud sounds came from the sky again.
Taran could not help but cover his ears because the sound was too loud, as if it had exceeded the range that ordinary people could withstand.
Ordinary people could not take it just by listening to the sound. If it really hit their bodies, how terrifying would the damage be?
Just like what Amelia had said, in the many exchanges just now, Yanni had actually gained the upper hand by relying on the speed and strength of the Blood Fiend Body. This was also the first time Connor felt that it was strenuous after obtaining the power of the remnant soul.
Yanni was constantly suppressing Connor, trying to find an opportunity.
"Bang!"
After the two of them exchanged blows once again, Connor's body tilted slightly, almost losing his balance.
Of course, Yanni wouldn't let go of such a good opportunity. He waved his right hand and grabbed Connor's shoulder before gripping it hard until there was a wound left on it.
The wound was very deep, and Connor's bones could even be vaguely seen.
Just now, Connor was protected by his aura, but he suffered such terrifying damage. If his level was slightly lower, he would probably be instantly killed by Yanni.
Connor didn't show the slightest panic after he forcefully withstood Yanni's grab. On the contrary, he was very calm. He raised his fist and fiercely smashed it towards Yanni's chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 2072: I Only Have One Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2072: I Only Have One Master!
"Bang!"
Connor's punch was like a bomb, directly exploding on Yanni's chest.
The two of them instantly retreated and landed on the ground one after another.
When Yolanda saw the wound on Connor's shoulder, her beautiful eyes instantly widened, disbelief on her face.
"Mr. McDonald!" Taran called out
Yama's expression was solemn, but he didn't say anything.
"I'm fine!"
Connor turned his head to look at the two of them and replied indifferently.
At this moment, the wound on Connor's shoulder was indeed very horrifying. The white bones were clearly visible, and blood was continuously flowing, directly dyeing his clothes red.
When Connor was facing Walter, he was basically unharmed, so Yolanda had never seen Connor in such a sorry state.
Although Connor was in a sorry state, Yanni wasn't any better; a huge bloody hole had appeared in Yanni's chest. Through this hole, one could even see his internal organs.
Yolanda covered her mouth with her hand when she saw Yanni in this state. She had thought that Connor was already in a bad state, but who would have thought that Yanni would be in an even worse state than Connor?
"Hahaha…"
Yanni laughed loudly. Then, he lightly said, "It's been so many years. After I cultivated the Blood Fiend Body, no one has been able to hurt me, and you're the first!"
"Likewise…"
Connor replied in a low voice. Then, he began to use his aura to control his wound so that it would not bleed.
"Connor, although you can hurt me, you can't beat me today!" Yanni sneered and immediately activated his aura.
The scarlet aura flowed to the wound on his chest. In just a few seconds, Yanni's wound healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After the wound healed, it was as if it had never been hurt.
After Taran saw this scene, he was completely rooted to the ground with shock.
"This... What's going on?" he stuttered.
Yolanda stood rooted to the ground and stuttered, "It seems like my master was right. Once I master the Blood Fiend Body, my body will be immortal. I'm afraid that Mr. McDonald is in big trouble this time…"
When the people from Rockefeller saw this scene through the big screen, they were all shocked.
Although they had come into contact with many martial artists, this was the first time they had encountered a situation like Yanni's.
The expression on Asya's face finally eased up a bit, and he let out a long sigh. If Yanni lost to Connor today, then things would be even more troublesome.
Mr. Long smiled faintly and said softly, "Just Yanni alone is already so terrifying. If those pinnacle ancient martial artists were to attack, how terrifying would they be?"
"Fortunately, Mr. Long, you have foresight and have already cooperated with the Land Deities. Otherwise, if the Land Deities really became our Rockefeller's opponent, the consequences would be unimaginable!" Auro seized the opportunity to suck up to him.
"We're just taking what we need from each other. Although the Land Deities are terrifying, they have weaknesses. They wouldn't dare to easily attack Rockefeller!" Mr. Long said calmly.
"That's true…" Auro replied with an awkward smile.
..
After Yanni finished healing his wounds, he looked at Connor indifferently and said arrogantly, "Connor, I know that you also have the ability to heal wounds, but your recovery speed is like a snail's compared to mine. If you continue to fight like this, you will only suffer more!"
"Is that so?" Connor replied indifferently.
Connor was also trying his best to recover his wounds, but it would take at least a few hours for his wounds to completely recover. It was impossible for him to recover during the battle.
"Your skills are not bad. As long as you admit defeat now, I won't kill you, and I'll hand you over to the Land Deities. I think they will take you as their disciple. In this way, it won't be long before you become the youngest pinnacle ancient martial artist in the world!"
Yanni was thinking of ways to win Connor over because his strength was indeed stunning enough.
"I only have one master. His name is Jorge Yarrell!" Connor said lightly.
"How can Jorge Yarrell be compared to a Land Deity? You're simply stupid!"
Yanni laughed loudly.
".."
Connor looked at Yanni and didn't say anything. He used the surrounding aura to heal his wounds.
Yanni also knew that Connor was stalling for time, so he naturally wouldn't give Connor the chance. He coldly said, "Since you're so stubborn, then go to hell! I'll let you experience what it means to have a bloody aura!"
After saying this, Yanni suddenly opened his mouth, and a scarlet breath shot towards Connor.
This aura was like a flood, as if it wanted to directly devour Connor.
This aura wasn't Yanni's own aura, but rather the blood Chi that he had accumulated over the years by absorbing other people's blood. The power of this blood Chi was extremely terrifying.
"If I kill you today and drink your blood, it will definitely improve my level greatly. Perhaps I can directly break through to the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts level!"
Yanni looked at Connor's face with excitement.
The scarlet aura had already reached Connor.
Connor took a deep breath. He knew how terrifying the power of this aura was, so he didn't dare to confront Yanni head-on at this time. Moreover, he was injured. If he was injured again, the situation would become very dangerous.
Connor held up his right hand, and a golden light appeared in front of him.
This golden light was completely formed by Connor's aura, and its toughness was extremely terrifying. Even a full force attack from a pinnacle heaven-tier ancient martial arts grandmaster would not be able to break it.
At this moment, Connor was also going all out. Before this, he had never thought that this battle would be so intense, nor did he think that Yanni's strength would be so terrifying.
"Boom!"
There was a loud bang.
The scarlet aura fiercely collided with the golden light.
Yolanda looked at Connor frantically.

chapters.title: Chapter 2073: One Less Opponent
chapters.content:
Chapter 2073: One Less Opponent
But the next second, Yolanda was stunned. Her expression was one of disbelief.
Because she discovered that the golden light around Connor was actually trembling violently.
"Could it be that even Mr. McDonald couldn't resist Yanni's blood Chi?"
Yolanda's beautiful eyes were filled with disbelief.
"Crack—"
At this moment, a huge crack actually appeared in the golden light in front of Connor.
Even Connor did not expect such an effect.
"You actually want to rely on your own aura to resist my blood aura? Ridiculous!"
Yanni said disdainfully
Connor was not in the mood to pay attention to Yanni at all. He tried his best to resist the blood Chi, but the cracks on the light grew more and more.
"Bang!"
In the end, the light in front of Connor finally could not withstand the terrifying attack of the blood Chi and instantly exploded.
After the bloody aura broke through the light, it fiercely collided with Connor's body.
Without the protection of the aura, Connor could only choose to use his own body to forcefully resist the blood aura.
"Boom!"
Connor's body was sent flying back, his feet leaving a deep ditch on the ground, and finally stopped at the edge of the rooftop.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, and his face clearly paled a little.
Just now, Connor had used his own aura to block most of the power of the blood Chi. However, even so, he was injured. From this point, one could see how terrifying the power of the blood Chi was.
"He can actually withstand it for a while. He's really amazing!" Yanni praised him from the bottom of his heart.
Connor wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and hurriedly devoured all the spiritual energy around him. He knew that Yanni's next attack was coming!
"Connor, I don't know how much aura you have left in your body for you to use, but my blood Chi is endless. I've absorbed the blood of hundreds of thousands of cultivators for so many years, and the accumulated blood Chi is already inexhaustible. So even if you can withstand my attack just now, so what? You will die at my hands today!"
Yanni shouted proudly at Connor.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Yanni without saying anything. How could he be in the mood to talk now? He had to race against time to absorb the spiritual energy!
"Go to hell!"
Yanni shouted and opened his mouth again. The smell of blood filled the entire manor.
A scarlet aura once again rushed towards Connor. This time, the bloody aura seemed to be many times more terrifying than the previous one.
Connor hurriedly used the last trace of aura in his body to set up a barrier.
However, this barrier was not worth mentioning in front of the blood aura. It was simply like trying to block the impact of a car with a sheet of glass.
The bloody aura shattered the barrier and once again ruthlessly collided with Connor's body.
Connor was instantly sent flying and smashed into the cement floor.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, instantly dyeing the ground red.
At this moment, the aura in Connor's body had completely dissipated.
"Connor!"
Yolanda shouted after seeing this scene and rushed to him.
"No! Don't come over!"
Connor shouted when he saw Yolanda rushing towards him, but she ignored him.
"I told you not to come over, didn't you hear me?"
Connor gritted his teeth and shouted at Yolanda.
"Connor, how are you? Are you alright?"
Yolanda hugged Connor and asked nervously.
"Hurry up and leave this place…"
"I... I can't leave…" Yolanda quickly shook her head and continued, "I haven't become your woman yet. The Profound Sect is counting on you!"
"Ma'am, it's already like this and you still want me to protect your sect!"
Connor said in exasperation. Just now, he had used up all of his aura in order to resist the blood Chi. For a warrior, the most important thing was aura. Aura was the foundation of a battle. If a warrior had no aura, then he was no different from an ordinary person.
"You can't die. You have to protect the Profound Sect!"
Yolanda said stubbornly.
"Don't you understand the current situation?" Connor shouted, then continued, "I have no aura now, and Yanni won't give me a chance to recover, so I can't even protect myself. You should hurry up and leave this place, or else you will die here."
"I... I..."
Yolanda hesitated for a moment. Then, she said in a low voice, "Kiss me now!"
"Kiss you?"
Connor was stunned when he heard Yolanda's words. He was speechless and said in a low voice, "Lady, didn't you hear what I said to you just now? It's not certain whether I'll live or die today. You still want me to kiss you?"
"Come on…"
Yolanda didn't know how to explain it to Connor, so she lowered her head and kissed him.
Connor looked at Yolanda and didn't know what to say. He couldn't understand what was going on in this woman's mind. She had the mood to force a kiss at this time!
On the other side, after seeing Yanni heavily injure Connor through the big screen, the people of Rockefeller all looked excited, especially Asya.
If Connor died, it would remove a big problem in his heart.
"That's it?"
On the other hand, Mr. Long looked disappointed. He shook his head gently and said, "It is really unexpected that this little fellow is actually so weak. I originally thought that he would be able to kill Yanni. It seems that I have overestimated him. Sigh…"
After saying this, Mr. Long stood up and said to everyone, "Alright, I'm tired!"
"Mr. Long!"
Everyone hurriedly stood up.
Mr. Long waved his hand gently and walked out of the meeting room.
They could feel that Mr. Long was indeed very disappointed at this moment.
"What's wrong with Mr. Long? Yanni didn't seem happy that he won!"
Avery said in a puzzled tone after seeing Mr. Long leave.
"Mr. Long is already so old, but he's bored in this castle every day. After he learned that Connor had gotten rid of Yamino, he became interested in Connor. But he didn't expect Connor to lose to Yanni so quickly," Asya explained in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 2074: Good Luck in Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 2074: Good Luck in Love
"Isn't it good to have one less opponent?"
Hearing this, Amelia seemed to be a little confused.
"Having one less opponent might be a good thing for us, but for Mr. Long, it's a loss of fun. The reason why he let Connor go for so many years is because Connor really couldn't threaten our Rockefeller, but at the same time, he was also nurturing his own opponent!" said Asya in a low voice.
"Nurturing his opponent?"
When everyone heard this, they were all stunned, and their expressions were very puzzled.
It was obvious that no one understood what Asya meant when he said that Mr. Long was nurturing his opponent.
Perhaps it was because Asya knew that Connor had no chance of winning today and would soon die at Yanni's hands, so his mood relaxed a lot and he began to chat with everyone.
"Mr. Long is different from us. After so many years, other than Steven Lee, who has been able to oppose Rockefeller? Rockefeller's development has always been smooth sailing. No one has been able to bring Mr. Long any difficulties…"
Asya smiled faintly and continued, "Now that our Rockefeller has developed to this scale, it will be very difficult for us to continue expanding. Our development has long since fallen into a bottleneck period. Besides planting flowers in this castle every day, there's nothing else you can do. This kind of life is not what Mr. Long time..."
After Avery understood what Asya meant, he asked softly, "You mean to say that Mr. Long feels that his current life is too boring, so he wants to train Connor to be his opponent?"
"That's right, that's what I meant!"
Asya nodded and continued, "Although this kind of thing might be very difficult for us to understand, it would be very easy to understand if it were Mr. Long. After all, it has been so many years, and Mr. Long has really been too bored. It's not often that someone can pique his interest. This is also considered a good thing for him. Unfortunately, this Connor is really disappointing. He actually lost to Yanni so quickly…"
"I heard that this Connor is quite powerful, right? How did he lose so quickly?"
Ame's pretty face was filled with doubt because she had investigated Connor's information before. She was under the impression that Connor was very strong.
"Connor is indeed very powerful, but he isn't as invincible as we imagined. The opponents Connor encountered before were at most Heaven rank Ancient Martial Artist Grandmasters, while Yanni's level was at the pinnacle of Heaven-ranked grandmasters. The gap between the two is very big."
Asya had some understanding of Yanni's strength, so he took the initiative to explain.
"Just now, Connor had already forced Yanni to use the blood Chi. You might not know this, but the blood Chi was condensed by Yanni after absorbing the blood of tens of thousands of martial artists. Moreover, it was used only once, yet under such circumstances, Connor withstood it twice. This shows that his strength is really as powerful as the outside world says. It's a pity that Connor met Yanni!"
"So that's how it is!"
Ame nodded thoughtfully, then looked up at the screen and said softly, "Actually, this Connor is also a talent. If he could be used by us, it'd actually be a good thing!"
"Right now, Mr. Long doesn't lack ancient martial arts experts at all. What he lacks is an opponent who can help him regain his passion!" Asya said expressionlessly.
At this moment, Avery looked at the screen and laughed.
"Putting everything else aside, Connor's luck with women is really not shallow!"
When everyone heard Avery's words, they all looked at him with a puzzled expression.
"Look, Connor is already like this, but he has the mood to kiss that little girl. It's too romantic. I like his personality. Even if he dies, he will die in a woman's arms!" Avery said with a smile.
Asya looked at the screen indifferently and didn't say anything. He didn't have the mood to care about these things. As long as Connor died, he would get rid of a worry that had been plaguing him.
Auro, on the other hand, had a cold look on his face. After all, he had planned to see Asya make a fool of himself today. However, looking at the current situation, he might not be able to see that happen.
A hint of envy flashed across Amelia's beautiful eyes. No matter what, she was a woman. She yearned for such love in her heart. However, because of her identity, she might not be able to find such love in her life.
…
On the other side, on the rooftop.
Although Connor was already in danger, he didn't choose to give up. He had been thinking about how to deal with Yanni's blood Chi.
Because he knew very well that Yanni's third attack would arrive soon. If he couldn't block it, he would definitely die.
However, Connor never expected Yolanda to kiss him forcefully at this time.
Connor instinctively wanted to push Yolanda away, but she hugged him tightly. What Connor did not expect was that a Chi was slowly flowing from Yolanda's mouth into Connor's.
This aura was very strange. Connor looked at Yolanda in front of him. He felt that her forced kiss at this time wasn't just a simple kiss, but one with a specific purpose.
Yanni looked at them expressionlessly. He felt that Connor might have given up resisting and was preparing to say goodbye to his beloved one, so he was not in a hurry to attack Connor. After all, Connor was already a dead man in his eyes.
As Connor and Yolanda kissed longer and longer, Connor felt that the aura in his body was recovering at a crazy speed.
The aura that Yolanda was supplying Connor with was very strange. It was not the Worldly Spiritual Chi—the Worldly Chi could never feel so gentle, nor could it be absorbed by Connor so quickly.
A few seconds later, Connor felt a bead slowly flowing into his body.
However, the aura that Yolanda gave Connor just now was emitted by this pearl. This pearl had been emitting an aura, and the intensity of the aura was comparable to the Worldly Spiritual Chi

chapters.title: Chapter 2075: The Green Pearl
chapters.content:
Chapter 2075: The Green Pearl
Yolanda saw that the pearl had already entered Connor's body.
She moved her lips away and looked at Connor shyly.
"What did you give me just now?"
Connor asked with a puzzled expression.
"This is the cornerstone treasure of our Profound Sect, the Green Pearl!"
Yolanda replied to Connor softly, then continued, "I don't know what this bead does either. My master placed it in my body, saying that it could save my life at a critical moment. I think you need this bead more than I do now. Moreover, this bead doesn't seem to have any effects on my body, so I'll give it to you today…"
"Green Pearl?"
When Connor heard Yolanda's words, his expression was a little puzzled. He didn't know what this Green Pearl was.
However, Connor could feel that this bead seemed to be similar to the pendant that Jorge Yarrell had given him, but even more obvious. After this bead entered Connor's body, it continuously transmitted aura to him. In this way, Connor had an inexhaustible aura, which was very helpful for boosting his combat strength.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Yolanda. He knew that he didn't have time to study the pearl now. After thanking her, he stood up.
Relying on the aura transmitted by the Green Pearl, the wounds on Connor's body had already begun to heal, and the aura in his body had also recovered by seventy to eighty percent.
At this moment, Yanni suddenly realized that Connor's Chi had recovered. His expression was a little confused. He frowned and asked, "Brat, how did your aura recover? What did you do just now?"
Connor didn't pay attention to Yanni at all. Instead, his figure flashed and directly rushed towards Yanni.
The expression on Yanni's face was a bit strange, because he knew that Connor was only a Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Although a Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster could absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, the speed of absorption was very slow. Unless he used a formation, it was absolutely impossible to recover his aura so quickly in battle.
And in such a short time just now, it was absolutely impossible for Connor to set up an array.
"What's going on? Did that woman do something to him?"
Yanni quickly turned to look at Yolanda, who was standing at the side.
Meanwhile, Yolanda's expression was solemn. She didn't know if giving the Green Pearl to Connor was the right choice. If Connor still died in the hands of Yanni today, then the Profound Sect might really fall into an unprecedented crisis.
The Green Pearl was the last trump card of the Profound Sect. It was not something that could be used unless the sect was in danger of being destroyed.
This was Yolanda's trump card. But now, she had actually given the Green Pearl to Connor. This meant that she had placed all her hopes on him.
If Connor were to die, then the Profound Sect would have no hope at all.
"Mr. McDonald will definitely win!"
Yolanda said softly.
Just as Yanni was wondering what was going on, Connor had already rushed in front of him.
Yanni did not hesitate and released another stream of blood Chi towards Connor.
Connor was aware that his current strength was not enough to go head-on against the Blood Fiend Body, so he had no choice but to set up a barrier. Because of the existence of the Green Pearl, Connor did not need to consider the use of his own aura at all.
"Bang!"
With a loud bang, the blood aura once again smashed fiercely onto Connor's body.
Connor's body instantly retreated hundreds of meters, but this time, perhaps because of the help of the Green Pearl, Connor only retreated 100 meters and did not suffer any injuries.
After Yanni saw this, the expression on his face became somewhat surprised. He could feel that Connor's strength seemed to have increased a lot.
"I want to see how many more times you can last!" Yanni shouted loudly, and then released another stream of blood Chi.
With the help of the Green Pearl, Connor actually once again withstood his Blood Fiend Body.
For a moment, Yanni's expression was very ugly, because he couldn't understand why Connor's aura recovered so quickly.
In fact, the power of the Blood Fiend Body was not enough to instantly kill Connor at his peak, considering how Connor could completely rely on his own aura to resist it. When Yanni used the Blood Fiend Body, he did not need to consume his own aura. He only needed to consume the blood Chi in his body.
However, Connor's aura was limited. The first time he blocked the blood evil aura, Connor might need to consume 80% of his aura. When it came to the second time, he could only use the remaining 20%, which led to Connor falling into danger just now because Yanni would never give him the chance to recover his aura.
However, Yolanda had given the Green Pearl to Connor just now. The Green Pearl's recovery speed was very terrifying, allowing Connor to recover his aura for a long time. Therefore, Yanni's Blood Fiend Body could no longer pose any threat to him.
Asya and the others originally thought that the battle was over and that Connor would definitely lose.
However, in the face of the sudden reversal, all of them were stunned on the spot. Their expressions were very puzzled. They could not understand what was going on!
Even Yanni couldn't figure out what was going on.
Although Yanni still had the upper hand, his advantage was no longer so obvious. No one dared to be 100% sure that Yanni would definitely defeat Connor.
"What did that woman do to you just now?"
Yanni asked Connor with his eyes wide open.
"You don't need to know this!"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "You should be able to feel that I now have an endless aura, so no matter how many times you use the Blood Fiend Body, you won't be able to completely hurt me. Moreover, the blood Chi in your body is limited."
"I don't believe it!" Yanni shouted. Then, he released another stream of blood aura towards Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2076: Victory and Defeat Revealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 2076: Victory and Defeat Revealed
Once again, Connor relied on his own aura to block Yanni's blood Chi.
Yanni continuously released a few rays of blood Chi, but the final result was the same. They were all blocked by Connor, and there was no way to cause any substantial damage.
Yolanda and Taran were very excited when they saw this because they finally saw a glimmer of hope.
"I've already said that this move of yours won't cause any harm to me. If you continue to fight like this, when your blood essence is exhausted, it will be your death!" Connor used his aura to heal the wound on his shoulder while speaking to Yanni.
Yanni looked at Connor's furious expression and shouted in a low voice, "I didn't expect you to have such ability. It seems that I have underestimated you!"
Connor subconsciously turned his head to look at Yolanda. He knew in his heart that if it wasn't for Yolanda's Green Pearl, he would have died. So, according to Connor's current combat strength, he was no match for Yanni.
Connor had never thought that Yolanda, who had been pestering him all this time, would actually save his life at this time.
"Alright, in that case, I can only use that move!"
Yanni muttered lightly. Then, he took a step forward.
In an instant, Yanni soared into the air and hovered a hundred meters above the ground like a god. Then, he looked down at the people on the ground.
Connor slowly raised his head and glanced at Yanni. He knew in his heart that Yanni should still have some trump card that he had not revealed. The Blood Fiend Body just now was definitely not Yanni's strongest attack.
Yanni floated in the sky and looked down at Connor like a god. He shouted, "Connor, I studied this move for decades before I mastered it. I have never used it on anyone before. Today, you can actually force me to use this move. This is enough to prove that you are a respectable opponent. I will give you one last chance now. As long as you admit defeat now, I can recommend you to join the Land Deities."
Connor glanced at Yanni indifferently without saying anything.
This attitude had already answered Yanni's question.
"Alright, in that case, don't blame me for being rude!"
Yanni laughed loudly. Then, a dazzling red light burst out from his body.
In an instant, countless streams of bloody aura flew out from Yanni's body. However, these bloody auras didn't fly towards Connor. Instead, they all flew towards the sky.
Yolanda and Taran raised their heads to look at Yanni. They were confused, not understanding what Yanni was doing.
A few seconds later, a huge crack suddenly appeared in the dark clouds in the sky.
A blood-red dragon with a world-destroying aura broke through the crack and pounced straight at Connor.
Connor expressionlessly looked at the giant dragon in the sky. He knew in his heart that this giant dragon was formed from the blood aura in Yanni's body. Moreover, it wasn't just one blood aura, but countless blood auras.
Originally, Connor was already struggling to deal with a single strand of blood aura, let alone the blood dragon formed by countless strands of blood aura.
The expression on Yanni's face was also very serious, because it was not easy for him to control this blood dragon. The terrifying energy contained in this blood dragon had long exceeded the scope of Yanni's ability.
However, Yanni was now forced into a desperate situation by Connor, so he had no choice but to use this Blood Dragon Transformation!
"Connor, today I want to see how you can block this move of mine!"
Yanni shouted.
Meanwhile, Connor stood quietly in his original spot, his expression very solemn.
The Blood Dragon was getting closer and closer to him, and the powerful power contained in it became more and more obvious.
The rooftop began to tremble, as if it would collapse at any moment under the pressure of the blood dragon.
"Hurry up and leave!"
Connor turned around and glanced at Yolanda and Taran, then he released a wave of aura.
The aura enveloped Yolanda and Taran, instantly sending the two of them a thousand meters away.
After sending Yolanda and Taran away, Connor had nothing to worry about. He took a deep breath and rushed towards the Blood Dragon.
After Yanni saw this, his expression was somewhat shocked.
Previously, Connor had always been on the defensive. However, this time, Connor actually chose to fight the Blood Dragon head-on. This was indeed something that Yanni had never expected.
Meanwhile, the people in Rockefeller were also staring at the screen in front of them with serious expressions. They knew very well that they had reached the most crucial part of the battle. The outcome of the battle might be decided at this moment.
Mr. Long, who had just left, returned to the meeting room after knowing that Connor had not lost. He then looked at the screen with interest.
"Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist! Void Deity!"
Connor roared.
Perhaps with the help of the Green Pearl, Connor's body was emitting two kinds of light. One was Connor's golden light, and the other was green.
The green and gold colors intertwined and collided fiercely with Yanni's blood dragon.
"Boom!"
In an instant, a large radius was reduced to ashes. The villa collapsed instantly, and countless guards were buried under this terrifying energy impact.
Even Juan Gomez wasn't spared. He was instantly turned into ashes.
The only two people who survived were probably Yolanda and Taran. If it wasn't for Connor sending the two of them out in advance, the two of them would probably have been buried in the ruins of the villa like the guards.
"What happened to Mr. McDonald?"
Taran shouted excitedly.
"I don't know…"
Yolanda looked at the ruins not far away with a very nervous expression.
Yanni was not sure whether Connor was dead or alive. He stared at the ruins expressionlessly, as if he was looking for Connor's aura.
Asya and the others were even more nervous. They stared at the screen in front of them and didn't dare to look away because they were worried that they would miss something.
As time passed, the earth gradually quieted down, and the dust that had been produced by the villa slowly dissipated.
At this moment, there was still a person standing at the center of the explosion!
And this person was Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 2077: Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 2077: Monster
At this moment, Connor looked very miserable.
His clothes were tattered and his body was covered in wounds, but Yolanda and Yanni could clearly feel that Connor's aura was still there!
"Great, Mr. McDonald is still alive!"
Yolanda turned around and shouted at Taran.
"Really... That's great…" Taran stuttered as he replied. At this moment, he did not know how to describe his feelings because he did not expect Connor to be able to survive such a terrifying explosion!
"Mr. McDonald is really a god!"
Taran said in his heart.
When Asya saw that Connor was still standing there, his face was filled with disbelief. He didn't even know how to describe his feelings.
"It's unbelievable. The explosion just now was so terrifying, but this person can still survive!"
Amelia covered his mouth and exclaimed.
At this moment, the only person who was happy was probably Mr. Long.
"Hahaha, this little guy is really interesting. I knew that Steven's descendant was definitely not weak. He didn't disappoint me!" Mr. Long laughed.
Everyone looked at him helplessly. The expressions on their faces were all of exasperation because they couldn't figure out if Mr. Long wanted Connor to live or die.
"Although Connor is still alive, he must have been seriously injured, so he might die at Yanni's hands!" Avery suddenly said.
"I don't think so…"
Mr. Long shook his head.
"I don't think so either!" Auro said without thinking.
Mr. Long looked at Auro indifferently and said in a disdainful tone, "'You don't think so' my ass!"
Auro's expression was extremely awkward. He smiled at Mr. Long and did not dare to continue speaking.
..
On the other side, Yanni looked at Connor who was on the ground, as if he couldn't accept this fact, because that move just now had almost used up all of his blood Chi, but Connor still withstood this move.
Yanni felt that even if Connor was a peak Heaven Realm ancient martial artist, he might not be able to take it ... Unless Connor was at the pinnacle of the ancient martial arts realm.
However, if Connor was really at the pinnacle of ancient martial arts, he might already be a dead man.
Yanni thought of countless possibilities in his mind, but he could not explain what was going on!
At this moment, Connor suddenly raised his head and glanced at Yanni, then asked him in a soft voice, "Did you think that you would win just now?"
"You... How did you do it?"
Yanni said through gritted teeth.
"That has nothing to do with you. Prepare to receive my punch now!" Connor said expressionlessly.
After hearing Connor's words, Yanni was stunned once again. He didn't expect that Connor would still have the strength to attack him.
Just as Yanni was still in shock, Connor's figure flashed and he directly rushed towards Yanni.
Connor's punch did not seem to have any power—it looked like just an ordinary punch.
Yanni stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. His face was filled with shock. Others might not be able to sense the terrifying power of Connor's punch, but Yanni could clearly feel that Connor's seemingly ordinary punch contained power that could even be compared to the Blood Dragon Transformation.
He began to panic. After experiencing such a terrifying explosion, his aura had become very unstable. Although his blood Chi had not been exhausted, there was not much left.
Yanni had accumulated this blood essence for decades. Today, he had used all of it on Connor, but he still couldn't defeat him. What made Yanni even more confused was that Connor still had the strength to throw such a terrifying punch.
Yanni couldn't understand what kind of monster Connor was. Why did Connor's aura suddenly recover so quickly?
"Bang!"
Right at this moment, Connor's fist smashed into Yanni's chest.
Yanni had originally intended to use his blood Chi to block Connor's punch, but he didn't expect that Connor's punch would be able to easily destroy the blood Chi and then smash his body.
The sound was like a bomb exploding.
A huge pit instantly appeared in Yanni's chest. Connor's punch had almost pierced through his chest. Yanni's body was sent flying for nearly a hundred meters in the air before finally landing on the ground.
Yolanda was a little excited when she saw this because she knew that Connor had completely gained the upper hand.
Rockefeller and the others were also dumbfounded when they saw this through the big screen. How could they have expected such a big reversal in the battle? At this moment, it was as if Connor and Yanni had swapped positions.
"Yanni won't lose so easily!" said Asya in a low voice.
"Don't comfort yourself here. Even if Yanni doesn't die today, it will be very difficult for him to kill Connor!" Auro said sarcastically.
Asya turned his head and glared at Auro, but didn't say anything.
Yanni was in a very sorry state. There was a big hole in his chest, and everyone could clearly see the internal organs inside. Connor's punch just now had almost pierced through his body.
"He's already been beaten to this state. Yanni has already lost, right?" Yolanda whispered.
"I think so too…" Taran hurriedly nodded.
However, the next second, the two of them were stunned on the spot.
Yanni stood up again, the wound on his chest healing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In just a few seconds, Yanni had already recovered to his original state. It was impossible to tell that he had been injured at all.
"What kind of monster is this person?" Taran exclaimed.
He felt that Yanni was too terrifying. If that punch had hit any other martial artist, the other party would have been severely injured, if not killed. But now, it seemed as if nothing had happened to Yanni. He was a monster that could not be killed!
Yolanda's expression was also a little nervous. After all, Yolanda was born in an ancient martial arts sect, so she had seen a lot of strong people. However, if those so-called strong people were compared to Yanni, they were really not worth mentioning.

chapters.title: Chapter 2078: You Can't Kill Me!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2078: You Can't Kill Me!
Seeing this, Yolanda finally believed it: in this world, there were indeed many powerful martial artists who far exceeded their understanding.
Just the strength of a Pinnacle Heaven Rank Ancient Martial Artist was already so terrifying. If it was a true Pinnacle Ancient Martial Artist, how terrifying would his strength be?
"The fist technique you used just now was very powerful…"
Yanni said to Connor expressionlessly.
"You're also very powerful. You were beaten to such a state by me and you can still recover!" Connor replied calmly.
Yanni took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "I have lived in this world for decades. In these decades, I have met countless experts, but you're the only one who I have to admire amongst all those pinnacle ancient martial arts experts among the Land Deities. You have such terrifying strength at such a young age. Those so-called geniuses are simply not worth mentioning compared to you!"
Connor looked at the corpses under his feet and replied softly, "Even if you praise me now, I won't let you go. You have to pay for the deaths of these people!"
If it wasn't for Yanni's Evil Blood Dragon Transformation, these people might have been able to survive. However, they had already lost their lives.
Even if Connor had promised Yamino Gomez that he would let Juan off, he could no longer do it now.
"Do you think I'm begging you for mercy now?" Yanni asked softly.
"What else?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"You're too naive. Even if I can't kill you today, you can't kill me either!" Yanni said coldly.
"Your blood essence should be running out soon!" Connor replied indifferently, and rushed towards Yanni again.
Yanni didn't dare to be careless and directly prepared to receive Connor's attack.
However, the current Yanni had used up all of his blood essence, so he was no match for Connor.
Connor's fist smashed into Yanni's palm, causing Yanni's body to instantly retreat.
Connor didn't give Yanni any chance to catch his breath and immediately chased after him, then raised his fist and fiercely smashed it on Yanni's chest.
Yanni crashed into the ground like a meteorite, forming a huge pit.
Although Connor's punch was already very powerful, it also caused enough damage to Yanni. However, after Yanni fell to the ground, he quickly stood up again, and the wounds on his body quickly healed.
"Connor, I told you before, even if I can't kill you today, you can't kill me either!"
Yanni said coldly.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at Yanni without saying anything.
"I know that your aura recovers very quickly, but so what? Your body has already reached a critical point. If you continue to waste your time with me, your body will not be able to withstand it sooner or later. At that time, I can easily kill you!" Yanni said proudly.
Yolanda finally understood what was going on after hearing what Yanni said.
Previously, Yolanda couldn't understand why Yanni didn't choose to run away but continued to fight Connor, especially since he knew that he was no match for Connor.
It turned out that Yanni had already seen through Connor's weakness.
Most of Connor's strength came from the remnant soul, which also led to Connor's body not being trained.
To put it simply, a person's body was like a jar, and a martial artist's aura was the water in the jar.
