Normal martial artists would continuously increase the amount of water through daily training. While increasing the amount of water, they would also continuously strengthen the hardness of the jar. Only in this way could they achieve an increase in strength.
However, Connor was different from these ordinary martial artists. He used some other methods to quickly increase the amount of water. In order to ensure that the jar could hold the water, he even increased the jar.
This also caused the jar to become very fragile.
Therefore, Connor's greatest weakness was his physical body.
This was also the reason why Connor had fallen into a coma after the battle.
Although Connor's body had been strengthened to a certain extent and he rarely fainted, there was still a huge gap between him and a true Heaven Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster.
The Green Pearl could provide Connor with a large amount of aura, but it could not strengthen his body.
At this moment, Connor's body was obviously unable to take it anymore. Connor could also trigger the protective device on his body at any time and fall into a coma.
At that time, it would be very easy for Yanni to kill him.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly shouted, "You talk too much nonsense!"
"Do you still want to continue?" Yanni sneered.
"Hu…"
Connor took a deep breath and stomped his right foot.
"Bang!"
A crater formed in the ground as soon as his foot hit it, and then he rushed straight towards Yanni like a bolt of lightning.
No one knew Connor's body better than him. Yanni was right. Connor's body might not be able to hold on for much longer. Therefore, he had to do his best to get rid of Yanni in the shortest time possible. Otherwise, all of them would die here today.
This time, Connor's speed became many times faster than before.
After seeing this, Yanni's expression was a bit proud. He was actually deliberately provoking Connor just now, because he knew that after he said those words, Connor would definitely be more anxious to kill him. In this way, the burden on Connor's body would also increase exponentially.
After Connor rushed in front of Yanni, he threw a punch. The power of this punch couldn't be described with words.
Yanni hurriedly put his hands in front of his chest, as if he was prepared to use his arms to block Connor's punch.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist fiercely smashed Yanni's arm. Yanni's body was instantly sent flying, and his two arms were immediately broken.
However, this was only the beginning. Connor's figure flashed and appeared in front of Yanni once again, letting loose five consecutive punches at his chest.
The power of each of these five punches was extremely terrifying. Loud sounds rang out in the sky, and lightning flashed and thunder rumbled. It gave people the feeling that bombs had exploded one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 2079: I Lost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2079: I Lost!
Yanni did not have the chance to react at all and spat out a few mouthfuls of blood.
Perhaps it was because Connor's speed was too fast, so before he could recover, all of this had already happened. Everyone could only hear a series of loud bangs.
Even though Rockefeller's people had used technology to slow down the speed by a thousand times, they still couldn't see it clearly. They could only see afterimages.
In the beginning, Yanni could barely use his blood Chi to block Connor's fists, but later on, Connor's speed was too fast, and he couldn't use his blood Chi at all. He could only use his own body to forcefully receive Connor's attacks.
Yanni's body was constantly changing positions in the sky. It wasn't that Yanni was dodging Connor's attacks, but that he was being beaten from one place to another, not giving Yanni any chance to adjust his body or land on the ground.
In just a moment, Connor himself did not know how many punches he had thrown out.
"Seven Stars Big Dipper Fist, Infinite Heavenly Light!"
Just as Connor's body was about to collapse, he roared angrily. Then, an extremely dazzling light erupted around his body.
"Boom!"
This punch landed on Yanni's chest with extreme precision.
Yanni's body smashed into the ground like a missile, creating a huge crater.
Yolanda, Taran, and the others stared at the spot where Yanni landed. They didn't know if the battle was over, so they didn't dare to cheer. They could only look into the distance with solemn expressions.
Rockefeller's team stared at the big screen with bated breath.
Although they were not sure of the result, they could vaguely feel that Yanni would not be able to withstand this punch.
"This Connor is too terrifying!"
Auro sighed in his heart.
Mr. Long had a faint smile on his face as he squinted at the screen.
A few seconds later, Connor slowly landed on the ground.
At this moment, Connor's body was emitting a green-gold light. His body had already reached its limit and could faint at any time. Moreover, this time, Connor would probably be unconscious for a much longer time than the previous time.
But Connor still gritted his teeth and persevered, because he knew that Yanni wasn't dead yet, and the battle wasn't over yet.
He slowly walked towards Yanni.
Yanni was lying on the ground like a dead man, motionless. However, Connor could clearly feel Yanni's aura, which meant that he was still alive.
The words that Yanni said earlier were obviously a gamble. Connor and Yanni were both gambling.
If Connor's body could hold on, then he would win.
If Connor's body couldn't take it anymore, then Yanni would win.
The result was obvious.
After a while, Connor walked to Yanni. At this time, Yanni looked very embarrassed. His whole body was covered with wounds. Any one of these wounds could be fatal to an ordinary person because Yanni's internal organs had all been shattered. However, he still relied on his blood essence to maintain his life. More importantly, Yanni was still using his blood essence to recover his body.
Unfortunately, after a few seconds, Yanni's blood essence was completely exhausted.
Once the blood essence was exhausted, it meant that Yanni's body would never be able to recover.
How could Yanni have imagined that his injuries would be so severe?
Connor had already walked in front of him, sizing him up calmly.
"Cough cough, your strength is indeed very terrifying. I lost today!"
At this moment, Yanni took the initiative to speak to Connor.
"You're the strongest opponent I've ever met. If it weren't for Yolanda's help, I wouldn't have been able to defeat you today!"
Connor indifferently replied to Yanni.
After hearing Connor's words, Yanni couldn't help but laugh coldly, "So what if you beat me today? You can't kill me!"
"You still think I can't kill you at this time?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Yanni's words.
"Although my body can't recover, my soul..."
Yanni spat out a mouthful of blood after saying this. Then, he said weakly, "My soul is still here. I will not die…"
When Connor heard Yanni's words, the expression on his face grew strange. He could faintly feel that Yanni might know how to adapt to the power of the soul.
Sure enough, in the next second, Connor saw Yanni's body become a little wretched, and the blood in his body began to flow crazily.
Yanni was burning his own blood essence to provide power to his soul, allowing his soul to be extracted from his body.
If Connor hadn't met Carl, he might not know what Yanni was doing now, but at this moment, he knew that Yanni was sacrificing his body to protect his soul.
"Stop him from burning his blood essence!"
Right at this time, Carl's voice sounded in Connor's divine sense.
"How?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Kill him before his aura completely disappears!" Carl replied.
..
Yanni didn't know what the real power of the soul was. At this moment, he was just burning his own blood essence to provide energy for his soul. Only then could he have enough energy to let his soul get rid of his body and give him the power to let his soul exist in this world.
Therefore, as long as Connor could kill Yanni before his soul leaves his body and stop him from continuing to supply energy to his soul, he would be able to kill him completely.
"Carl!"
Connor shouted in his heart.
However, Carl did not respond to Connor because his consciousness was already very weak. Unless Connor encountered something related to him to activate his consciousness, Carl would not be able to continue talking to Connor.
Connor originally planned to ask Carl to help him devour Yanni's soul. After all, Yanni's strength was still very terrifying. If he could really get Carl to devour Yanni's soul, then it would be of great help to increasing Connor's strength.
Unfortunately, there was no way for Carl to control Connor's body in this situation, so he could only choose to give up on this idea.
Yanni was still crazily burning his blood essence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2080: Franco George
chapters.content:
Chapter 2080: Franco George
Yolanda was very surprised to see this. She also looked a little confused.
Because as a warrior, once his blood essence was exhausted, he would die without a doubt. She couldn't understand why Yanni would do this!
Connor took a deep breath and slowly raised his right hand, preparing to end Yanni's life.
When Yanni saw Connor raise his right hand, his face was filled with fear. He didn't expect Connor to still attack at this time. What was even more unexpected was that Connor still had the strength to attack!
In the battle just now, Connor's body was already in a high-load state, especially after he threw those few punches, Connor's body had already reached a limit.
Therefore, even if Connor could quickly recover his aura with the help of the Green Pearl, his body could not take it anymore.
When Connor was gathering his aura, his expression was twisted with pain. Usually, he could casually send out an aura, but now it had become extremely difficult.
However, Connor didn't give up. He still gritted his teeth and persevered because he knew very well that this was the most critical moment. He had to kill Yanni before his soul left his body. Otherwise, there would be endless trouble.
The aura slowly condensed in Connor's body. This was a feeling that Connor had never experienced before. His body was also slightly trembling, and fine beads of sweat hung on his forehead.
Yolanda looked at Connor's face with confusion. She couldn't understand why Connor would still attack when Yanni had already chosen to commit suicide!
Yanni and Connor's speed had slowed down by more than a hundred times. No one knew what they were doing.
"Go to hell!"
Right at this time, Connor finally condensed enough aura to kill Yanni.
"No!"
Yanni did not expect Connor to be able to condense such a terrifying aura at this time. He shouted at Connor with a ferocious expression.
However, Connor did not hesitate and thrust his right hand out.
A stream of energy flew directly towards Yanni.
When the aura flew out, Connor let out a long breath. The expression on his face was obviously much more relaxed because he knew that everything was finally over.
"Bang!"
Connor suddenly raised his head and found an old man standing in front of Yanni. This old man had just helped Yanni block Connor's last attack.
When Yanni saw the old man, his expression became a little excited. He shouted, "Master!"
The old man didn't pay attention to Yanni, but said to Connor in a soft voice, "Little friend, when will your revenge stop? Yanni is my disciple. How about you give me some face and let him go today?"
"A remnant soul?"
Connor frowned and asked with a strange expression on his face.
"That's right!"
The old man nodded and continued, "Although this is only a remnant of my soul, according to your current state, you shouldn't be a match for me, and I might not be able to kill you. So let's end this battle today!"
Connor expressionlessly looked at the old man, unwilling to let Yanni go like this.
However, he had no other choice, because he knew that the old man was right. According to Connor's current condition, it was impossible for him to defeat the old man's remnant soul. Even if Connor could win, Yanni's soul might have already left his body. At that time, Connor could only kill the old man's remnant soul.
At this moment, Connor was only a remnant soul. It was impossible to rely on the power of the remnant soul to kill Connor. After all, not everyone's remnant soul was as abnormal as Carl.
Connor could feel that the strength of this old man's main body was likely at the legendary pinnacle of ancient martial arts.
The old man saw that Connor didn't say anything and asked, "Little friend, have you thought about what I said just now?"
"Who are you?"
Connor didn't have the strength to continue attacking, so even if he wanted to kill Yanni in his heart, he couldn't continue condensing his aura.
That blast just now was already Connor's last move.
"It's not good for you to know who I am. I told you just now that revenge will never end. You beat my disciple up like this today. It's already good enough that I won't find trouble with you in the future. If you want to take revenge on me, I advise you to give up this idea as soon as possible," the old man said slowly.
"Let me ask you, who are you?"
Connor gritted his teeth and asked in a low voice.
"My name is Franco George!"
the old man said indifferently.
"Franco George!"
When Yolanda heard the name, her delicate body trembled slightly. She looked at the old man in disbelief.
Obviously, Yolanda knew the old man's identity.
Yolanda was worried that Connor would attack the old man, so she hurriedly shouted, "Mr. McDonald, let them go!"
Connor turned his head and looked at Yolanda indifferently. Then, he said to the old man, "Alright, I'll remember your name. I'll find you sooner or later!"
The old man Franco couldn't help but laugh after hearing Connor's words. Then he shook his head and said, "When will revenge end? I'm already showing you mercy by not killing you. Why can't you let go of the hatred in your heart?"
Connor said in a low voice, "Take your disciple and get lost. Stop talking nonsense here!"
Franco could feel the killing intent from Connor's expression. If it wasn't for the fact that Connor was completely unable to move, he would never have let Yanni go so easily.
Although Franco said it very casually, Connor had encountered countless opponents over the years. He was very aware that neither Yanni nor Franco would ever let him go. Even now, they only let him go because they couldn't do anything to him.
These two people would be a huge hidden danger to Connor in the future, so he naturally wouldn't let these two people go.
Yanni's soul had already left his body by now
Franco said, "Young man, I advise you not to investigate me. It won't do you any good!"
Connor looked at Franco without saying anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 2081: Defeating Yanni Boston!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2081: Defeating Yanni Boston!
Franco knew that Connor did not take his words to heart at all. He shook his head helplessly and slowly disappeared.
Yanni was naturally very unconvinced, but he did not say anything because his soul had just left his body. If he spoke, it would consume a lot of energy, so he disappeared with Franco.
When Yolanda saw this, her eyes widened. She had no idea that souls existed in this world. If she hadn't seen it with her own eyes, she wouldn't have believed it at all.
On the other hand, Taran's expression was slightly better. After all, he had interacted with the Blood Moon Sect's Sect Master before, so he already knew that there were souls in this world.
Meanwhile, Connor stood expressionlessly on the spot. His body had already reached its limit. He did not know when he would fall unconscious.
Fortunately, the battle was over. Although Connor didn't kill Yanni completely in the end, the final victor was still him. Moreover, he had killed Yamino Gomez, so he'd completed the purpose of his trip.
After Yolanda reacted, she quickly ran to Connor's side and asked softly, "Mr. McDonald, are you alright?"
"Do you know Franco George?" Connor asked in return.
Yolanda looked at him, hesitant. "I... I've heard my master mention this person before, but... But..."
"But what?"
"But this person should have died a long time ago. My master said that Franco was an expert from a hundred years ago. Moreover, Franco was also called the Blood Fiend by martial artists. The Blood Fiend Chi and Blood Dragon Transformation techniques that Yanni used just now were both created by Franco. I don't understand why he still exists. He should have died a long time ago. If he is really still alive, he would be almost three hundred years old now!" Yolanda explained in a low voice.
"Three hundred years old?"
Connor sneered and then said indifferently, "If this Franco is at the pinnacle of the Ancient Martial Arts realm, it's not strange for him to be over 300 years old. After all, I've seen people who can survive for more than a thousand years in this world…"
"The pinnacle of ancient martial arts really exists in this world?"
Yolanda looked incredulous.
"Nothing is impossible in this world!" Connor said in a low voice. "How much do you know about this Franco George?"
Yolanda couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she shook her head gently and said, "I only heard my master mention it once, but I'm not very knowledgeable about Franco's specific situation. Connor, you're not really planning to take revenge on Franco, are you?"
"Of course!" Connor lightly nodded.
Yolanda took a deep breath and whispered, "But you just said that this Franco is at the pinnacle of Ancient Martial Arts!"
"So what if he's at the pinnacle? I must kill Yanni and Franco, because even if I don't take revenge on them, then when Yanni recovers, he will definitely find a way to kill me!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
He knew that if he really waited until Yanni made a move on him, then the people around him might be put in extreme danger, so he had to find a way to understand all of this.
"You should think about revenge in the future. After all, you are not a match for Franco at all…"
Yolanda whispered.
"That's right, Mr. McDonald. Let's talk about revenge in the future…" Taran added.
Connor looked at Yolanda and Taran, then up at the drone in the sky.
Taran seemed to have noticed the drones in the sky. He was worried that there would be others coming, so he suggested, "Mr. McDonald, it's not safe here. Why don't we leave first?"
If another martial artist appeared at this time, then Connor would not be able to deal with it in his current state. The three of them would be in great danger.
"Let's go!"
Connor replied in a low voice and then walked forward.
Yolanda followed him with a nervous expression.
After walking less than ten meters, Connor suddenly felt his vision go black, and then he spat out a mouthful of blood.
"Mr. McDonald, are you alright?" Taran hurriedly shouted.
"Connor, what's wrong?"
Yolanda reached out to help Connor up.
Connor turned to look at Yolanda and whispered, "My body might not be able to hold on any longer. Let's hurry up and leave this place!"
"Connor…"
Yolanda opened her mouth to speak, but Connor's body suddenly tipped over and he fainted.
After Yolanda saw that Connor had fainted, her expression became even more flustered. She hurriedly asked Taran, "The two of us now…What should we do now?"
"Miss Yates, come and help me. I'll carry Mr. McDonald!"
Taran knew that these drones belonged to Rockefeller, so there were always people monitoring them. He had to take Connor away from here immediately, or Rockefeller's people could make a move at any time.
Yolanda placed Connor on Taran's back, and the both of them ran out of the manor.
At this moment, the manor was already in a mess. There were corpses and ruins everywhere, and there was no sign of life at all.
…
Rockefeller's players were all staring at the big screen in front of them. They had never expected such an ending.
Although Connor was heavily injured, he was still the victor of today's battle.
Connor had defeated Yanni!
The expression on Asya's face was as ugly as it could be. After all, if Connor didn't die, it was very likely that he would attack him.
As for Avery, Amelia, and Auro, they were immersed in the shock that Connor had given them. After all, the outcome of this battle was not very important to them. Even if Connor might take revenge, no matter what, Connor's strength had indeed deeply shocked the three of them.
If they did not see it with their own eyes, they would never have thought that Connor, this young man's strength, would actually be terrifying to such an extent.
Mr. Long seemed to be very satisfied with this result. With a faint smile on his face, he said softly, "This little fellow is indeed a little interesting. He is becoming more and more fun…"
After hearing Mr. Long's words, Asya's expression grew a little helpless. Mr. Long was having fun, but he might be in trouble. After all, Yanni was a person by Asya's side. Now that Yanni's situation was unknown, there was one less layer of protection by Asya's side. If Connor found him, he might die.

chapters.title: Chapter 2082: Explosives
chapters.content:
Chapter 2082: Explosives
"Mr. Long!"
Seeing Taran and Yolanda preparing to leave the manor with Connor, Asya quickly stood up and shouted.
Mr. Long glanced at Asya indifferently and asked softly, "Was there something you need?"
"Mr. Long, we can't let this Connor leave alive. If he leaves alive today, he will definitely become a big problem in the future. I have already gotten people to arrange explosives nearby. Now is Connor's weakest time," Asya said with a very serious expression.
"You actually planted explosives there?"
Mr. Long's expression was a little strange.
"I did it just in case…"
Asya hurriedly explained.
"Didn't I tell you not to use such lethal weapons in Sommerville? Do you think Sommerville is one of those small countries? Don't you know how much trouble it will bring to Rockefeller if these things are discovered by the government?" Mr. Long shouted angrily.
"Mr. Long, I didn't have a choice either. This Connor is really too terrifying…" Asya said in fear.
"Although Connor's strength is terrifying, he's not invincible. There are many people in this world who can deal with Connor. If you use explosives, it's equivalent to declaring war on Sommerville," Mr. Long said coldly.
Asya was stunned. He didn't know how to respond.
"Connor is a martial artist. If you use a martial artist to kill Connor, even the higher-ups of Sommerville won't pry into our business. However, if you use a weapon, the impact will be different. We are just businessmen. Remember that!" Mr. Long continued to lecture him.
"Mr. Long, you're right. But if we let Connor leave just like that, I'm worried—"
Asya still didn't want to let Connor go.
"What are you worried about Connor for? You're worried that we won't be able to deal with Connor in the future, right?" Mr. Long interrupted.
"I... I do have such concerns!"
Asya said through gritted teeth.
"Asya, do you think you're not strong enough? Or do you think our Rockefeller isn't strong enough? This Connor is nothing more than a little brat. Although he defeated Yanni today, so what? There are many people among the Land Deities who are more powerful than Yanni. If you are really afraid that Connor will kill you, you can leave Rockefeller now. I think there should be many people who are confident in dealing with Connor!" Auro said with a smile.
When Asya heard Auro's words, his expression was a little angry. He quickly said to Mr. Long, "Mr. Long, you... Please don't misunderstand, I didn't mean it that way!"
"I understand what you mean, but you don't have to worry too much. Although Yanni may be dead, I will contact the people of the Land Deities as soon as possible and ask them to send an ancient martial arts grandmaster to protect you!" Mr. Long said calmly.
"Then how do you plan to deal with Connor's matter?"
Asya asked softly.
Mr. Long chuckled.
"This little guy is quite interesting. I'm a little curious about how he will deal with me next. Help me keep an eye on Connor's situation. If there's anything, report to me immediately!"
"Alright then…"
Asya agreed helplessly. At this moment, he felt that Mr. Long was really a little too confident. Back then, Yamino Gomez was too confident, so he died in Connor's hands in the end.
However, Asya also knew that since Mr. Long had made up his mind not to attack Connor, it was useless for him to say anything now.
"Alright, the battle is over. You guys can go do what you need to do!"
Mr. Long waved his hand at everyone.
When Asya, Amelia, and the others heard Mr. Long's words, they hurriedly stood up and greeted him. Then, they turned around and walked out of the meeting room.
Mr. Long waited for the four of them to leave before sitting quietly on the spot. He narrowed his eyes and looked at the screen in front of him.
A few seconds later, Mr. Long smiled faintly and said softly, "Interesting. This Connor is really interesting. He has already reached this stage within a short few years. It has somewhat exceeded my expectations…"
Mr. Long might be in a good mood, but Asya was a little unhappy.
After all, if Connor was still alive, he would be the most dangerous person.
Amelia walked to Asya's side and said softly, "Asya, you don't seem to be in a good mood."
"I don't know what Mr. Long is thinking. Why would he let Connor off? We can use this opportunity to kill him once and for all!" said Asya in a low voice.
"Mr. Long naturally has his own thoughts, but I don't think you need to worry too much. Although Connor won this time, he is also seriously injured. I don't think he will find trouble with you for the time being. Moreover, Mr. Long has also said that he will get a new ancient martial arts grandmaster to protect you..." Amelia said indifferently.
Asya turned to look at Amelia and whispered, "All of you have no idea how terrifying Connor's strength is…"
"I've heard you talk about this Connor before, but I thought that Connor was just a regular old rich heir at that time, so I didn't have much interest in him. I didn't expect that in less than two years, Connor had already grown to such a stage. It's really unbelievable!" Amelia said softly.
Asya couldn't help but take a deep breath when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he whispered, "I didn't expect Connor's growth to be so tremendous, either. Previously, I didn't take Connor seriously, but now he has already grown to a point that we can't control…"
"I'm also very curious about him now. I think I should personally contact this Connor when I have the chance to see who he is!"
Amelia revealed a mysterious smile.
"I advise you to stay away from this Connor. He is not as simple as you think. Be careful not to get into trouble!" Asya warned.
"Don't worry. I'm not a pushover to be able to get to where I am today. I'm just a little curious about this person!"
Amelia didn't seem to care much about Asya's warning.
Asya took a deep breath and didn't say anything else. After all, his current situation was very bad. He wasn't in the mood to care about other people's affairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 2083: Celestial Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 2083: Celestial Artifact
After Connor fainted, he was sent back to the villa by Taran and Yolanda.
Because Connor's situation was special, they did not bring him to the hospital.
As Yolanda was worried that Connor's life might be in danger, she asked her master, Xandra, to contact the people of the Purple Cloud Sect.
The Grand Guardian, the Third Guardian, and Waverly rushed to Yarlford immediately.
However, the three of them had never encountered a situation like Connor's. They could only feel that his aura was very chaotic, but they were not very knowledgeable about how to treat him.
This made the people of the Purple Cloud Sect anxious. Jorge Yarrell wasn't around, and they weren't very proficient in medicine, so the Grand Guardian was very busy. He invited over many famous doctors in the ancient martial arts world, but these doctors couldn't confirm what was wrong with Connor after seeing him.
Fortunately, Rachel Wallace got the news. She contacted Queta Juve immediately and told everyone not to do anything to Connor. They just had to wait for Connor to wake up.
Back during the incident with the Blood Moon Sect, Connor had also undergone such a situation, so Rachel knew what to do.
Everyone followed Rachel's instructions and didn't give Connor medicine. Instead, they took turns to watch over him.
In the blink of an eye, two months had passed.
This time, Connor's body seemed to have suffered more terrifying injuries than before, so he was unconscious for two months before he woke up.
Yolanda was very excited when she saw Connor wake up. She was very worried that he might never wake up.
Of course, Yolanda was not only worried about Connor because she hoped that he could protect the Profound Sect. It was also because she had developed some feelings for him during their recent interactions. Although these feelings could not be considered love, there was still some platonic concern between friends.
This was also why Yolanda gave the Orb of Wonders to Connor even though she knew that he might lose to Yanni.
Yolanda had been living in the Profound Sect since she was young. Furthermore, her identity was rather special, so the disciples in the sect only respected her. No one really interacted with her, which resulted in her having very few friends.
Yolanda had only interacted with Connor for a short time, but she could feel that Connor was actually very close to her. These things were reflected in many details.
Waverly's attitude towards Yolanda also softened a little. Previously, Waverly had always thought that the Profound Sect sent Yolanda to seduce Connor. However, after she found out that Yolanda had given the Green Pearl to Connor when he was in danger, she no longer hated Yolanda that much.
If it wasn't for Yolanda's help in the battle between Connor and Yanni, Connor might have died in Yanni's hands.
"Mr. McDonald, you're awake?"
Yolanda was the first to notice that Connor had opened his eyes. She asked Connor excitedly.
"I'm awake…"
Connor nodded his head lightly and continued to ask, "How long was I unconscious this time?"
"Two months…"
Yolanda replied.
"I actually fainted for so long this time?"
Connor sat up straight and stretched his body.
"Mr. McDonald, you just woke up. You should be careful!"
Yolanda quickly chided.
"You don't have to be so nervous. As long as I wake up, nothing will happen…"
Connor smiled faintly and then sized up Yolanda. Perhaps it was because she had been by Connor's side every day, but Yolanda looked a little tired at this moment.
"Thank you for taking care of me these days!"
Connor said.
"I'm not the only one taking care of you. Everyone from the Purple Cloud Sect is here too."
Yolanda quickly replied.
"The Grand Guardian and the others are here too?"
"Yes!"
Yolanda nodded.
"Is my master here?"
Connor continued to ask.
"No…"
Connor looked at Yolanda's expression, puzzled. He had a vague feeling that something was wrong. He hadn't seen Jorge for a long time. Moreover, Jorge didn't appear during the battle between Connor and Walter Collier. This time, Connor had almost died in Yanni Boston's hands, but Jorge still didn't appear. This didn't fit Jorge's personality.
If it was before, Connor wouldn't have worried about Jorge. After all, Jorge could be considered the number one martial artist in Sommerville at that time. Ordinary martial artists couldn't hurt him at all.
However, the situation was different now. Connor knew that there were many martial artists in this world who were more terrifying than Jorge was.
Connor was a little worried that Jorge might have encountered some danger, which was why he hadn't shown up.
"Connor, what are you thinking about?"
Yolanda asked when she saw that he didn't say anything.
"It's nothing…"
Connor shook his head lightly and continued, "Oh right, thank you for using the Green Pearl to save me the last time. It is also thanks to the Green Pearl that has been helping me transmit my aura over the past few days. Otherwise, I would have needed at least half a year to wake up…"
"It's alright…"
Yolanda seemed to have thought of the scene where she forcefully kissed Connor, so her pretty face blushed.
At that time, the situation was very urgent. Yolanda didn't know how to take out the Green Pearl, so she chose the simplest way to give it to Connor.
"Well, this Green Pearl is a Celestial Artifact, and it's the most precious treasure of your sect. I should return it to you!" Connor said after hesitating for a moment.
"No, no, no. There's no need…"
Yolanda quickly waved her hand when she heard Connor's words.
"You don't want such an important treasure?"
"Nope, I don't want it anymore!" Yolanda waved her hand again and continued, "There's no use in giving this to me. I'll give it to you!"
"So generous?"
Connor smiled and said, "But this Green Pearl doesn't seem to be yours, right? If your master finds out, he will definitely blame you. I'll give it back to you!"
After saying this, Connor moved to kiss Yolanda.
Actually, he was teasing Yolanda on purpose. He could already tell that Yolanda was very shy now.
"I already said that you don't have to return it to me. What are you doing?"
Yolanda was shocked and quickly stood up to hide.

chapters.title: Chapter 2084: Company Matters
chapters.content:
Chapter 2084: Company Matters
"Haha…"
Connor smiled helplessly when he saw that Yolanda was frightened by him.
"Didn't you say before that you wanted to be my woman? Why are you still so shy with me?"
"I... I..."
Yolanda didn't seem to know how to answer Connor's question.
"If you really want to be my woman, not only do you have to kiss me, but you also have to give birth to my child. If you can't even overcome these things, how can you be my woman?"
Connor said with a smile.
"How can you be so shameless? I'm ignoring you!"
Yolanda glared at Connor and turned to leave.
"Alright, I won't tease you anymore…"
Connor saw that Yolanda was really angry and quickly reached out to stop her. Then, he said in a serious tone, "You saved me last time, and I am very grateful to you. So, you don't have to become my woman. I will protect the Profound Sect. In the future, if the Profound Sect has any problems, you can come to me anytime. If you can't find me, you can go to the Purple Cloud Sect."
Yolanda blinked. "Is what you said true?"
"Of course it's true. You can be considered my savior!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Yolanda was still a little hesitant. She muttered, "But my master said that a man's words cannot be trusted, unless…"
"Unless what?" Connor asked.
"Unless I become your woman and give birth to a child for you. Only then can I trust that you will protect the Profound Sect!" Yolanda muttered.
"Did your master tell you this?"
Connor asked, exasperated.
"Yes, that's what she said!"
Yolanda quickly nodded.
Connor looked at Yolanda without saying anything.
Connor felt that she was actually a pretty good girl. There was no need to talk about her looks, temperament, and figure. Her heart was also very pure and kind. She was not suitable to survive in the ancient martial arts world. It would definitely be difficult for her to control the Profound Sect. However, Xandra was different—she was very shrewd and even wanted Yolanda to bear him a child to tie him down.
"Your master wants you to bear my child, but you're unwilling. What should I do?"
Connor asked.
"Who said I'm unwilling? I'm just not ready yet. When I'm ready, I'll naturally give birth to your child!" Yolanda quickly said.
"Forget it. I don't have any plans to have children!"
Connor replied exasperatedly, then continued, "This Green Pearl is very important to the Profound Sect. Even if you agree to give it to me, your master will not agree. I will definitely return it to you. If you don't want to kiss me, do you know of any other way to return the Green Pearl to you?"
"I don't know…"
Yolanda shook her head.
"What exactly is this Green Pearl? You actually need to use such a strange method like kissing to give it to someone…"
Connor seemed to be somewhat speechless.
"My master should know how to take out the Green Pearl, but…It's just that I'm not sure…"
Yolanda became even shyer. Her delicate face was like a ripe red apple, making people want to take a bite.
"Alright then. Since that's the case, I'll return the Green Pearl to you after I see your master!"
Connor said lightly.
Yolanda sized Connor up and did not say anything. She felt that his words made sense. After all, the Green Pearl was not hers. Even if she agreed to give it to Connor, her master would not agree. The guardians of the Profound Sect would naturally not agree.
Yolanda seemed to be a little worried about Connor's health as she asked him, "You just woke up and spoke so much. Are you okay?"
"It's nothing. Go and call Queta, Taran, and the Grand Guardian over. I have something to tell them!" Connor said.
"Okay, " Yolanda replied and left Connor's room.
A few minutes later, Queta, the Grand Guardian, Taran, Waverly, and the others arrived at Connor's room.
When everyone saw that Connor had woken up, they heaved a long sigh of relief. After all, Connor had been in a coma for two months. If he continued to be in a coma, they were all worried that he might not wake up.
Connor greeted everyone briefly. They were relieved to know that he was fine. After all, both the Purple Cloud Sect and the Stormbound Corporation were counting on Connor. If Connor really fell, the Stormbound Corporation and the Purple Cloud Sect would be in a huge crisis.
"Queta, how's the company doing?"
Connor asked Queta.
"Mr. McDonald, Yuna used her connections to help you cover up what happened in Yamino Gomez's manor that day. Yamino and Juan were also classified as missing persons. Rockefeller sent a new person in charge, but this new person in charge was far less capable than Yamino. In addition, those people in Yarlford also knew that Yamino had died in your hands, so most of the companies in Yarlford were unwilling to continue working with Rockefeller!"
"I took advantage of this opportunity to expand the scale of our company and set up many new companies. Dominic, Spencer and the others are in charge of the branch company's business, and the four families are now very loyal to us. Basically, 90% of the Gomez family's businesses have been snatched by our company!"
Queta briefly told Connor about the company's recent situation.
"How does our company compare to the Gomez family?"
"Compared to the Gomez family back then, our Stormbound Corporation is larger and has a wider range of business. Most importantly, the conditions I offer to the other companies in Yarlford far exceed the conditions offered by the Gomez family, so they are very willing to cooperate with us!" Queta said seriously.
"That's good!"
Connor nodded.
It could be said that the Stormbound Corporation had completely replaced the Gomez family's position in Yarlford.
"By the way, Queta, I have something to tell you…"
"Mr. McDonald, please speak!"
"It's like this. There are a lot of disciples in our Purple Cloud Sect. The cultivation of these disciples requires a large amount of funds to support them. Moreover, the Heavenly Sect is also dependent on our Purple Cloud Sect, so the funds needed may be even greater…"
Connor turned to look at the Grand Guardian as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 2085: The Way
chapters.content:
Chapter 2085: The Way
"Mr. McDonald, you don't have to worry about this. Our Stormbound Corporation's capital chain is still very sufficient."
After saying this, Queta turned to the Grand Guardian and said, "Grand Guardian, if you need funds, you can call me at any time!"
"Miss Juve, we're sorry to keep taking money from Stormbound Corporation. Our Purple Cloud Sect can be considered self-sufficient now!" the Grand Guardian hurriedly said.
"It's not enough to be self-sufficient. I want the Heavenly Sect to continue to grow!"
Connor interrupted the Grand Guardian and continued, "The amount of funds needed to strengthen the Purple Cloud Sect is very large. Stormbound Corporation can provide them with financial assistance once or twice. However, if they do it too many times, it will also become a burden for Stormbound Corporation and might even affect its development."
Now that the situation in Yarlford had stabilized, Connor did not intend to get too involved in the management of Stormbound Corporation. Moreover, Connor had promised Queta that he would give her a portion of Stormbound Corporation's shares.
This meant that Stormbound Corporation would not only belong to Connor, but also Queta. Yuna Winston also had a portion of the shares, but she did not care about these things at all. She only held some shares in name.
However, no matter what, the Stormbound Corporation did not belong to Connor alone. Connor could not keep asking them to help the Purple Cloud Sect.
Therefore, Connor felt that the best way was to let the Purple Cloud Sect coolle with Stormbound Corporation.
"Mr. McDonald, how do you plan to collaborate with them?"
Queta asked in confusion.
"That's right, Sect Leader McDonald. What can our Purple Cloud Sect do?"
The Grand Guardian seemed to have a puzzled expression as he asked Connor.
"The Purple Cloud Sect has a lot of alchemists. The most important thing for these alchemists is to refine pills for the disciples of the Purple Cloud Sect. I think we can let the Stormbound Corporation cooperate with the Purple Cloud Sect to set up a pharmaceutical company. The Purple Cloud Sect will be responsible for refining pills, and the Stormbound Corporation will be responsible for providing the medicinal herbs needed to refine pills and selling them to the outside world."
Connor voiced his thoughts.
"Sect Leader McDonald, your method is indeed good. In this way, our Purple Cloud Sect's financial problem will be solved!"
The three guardians hurriedly said after knowing Connor's intention.
"But…"
The Grand Guardian looked hesitant.
"But what?"
Connor asked the Grand Guardian.
"Sect Leader McDonald, your method is indeed quite good…"
The Grand Guardian hesitated for a moment before continuing, "However, the number of alchemists in our Purple Cloud Sect is not particularly high. Moreover, the process of refining medicinal pills is also very complicated. It may be unrealistic to refine a large number of pills in a short period of time…"
"I have already considered all of your thoughts…"
Connor replied indifferently, then said, "I plan to let your Purple Cloud Sect's alchemists refine some low-level pills. These pills may not have much effect on high-level martial artists, but they are still very effective for low-level martial artists and ordinary people. Moreover, this can greatly increase the number of pills refined, and the requirements for raw materials will be very low!"
After hearing Connor's words, the Grand Guardian's expression grew extremely excited because he felt that Connor's method was very reliable.
In fact, as the number one sect in Sommerville, the Purple Cloud Sect's financial problems had always been the biggest headache for the Grand Guardian.
After all, the Purple Cloud Sect was different from other sects. Some small sects would collect funds by taking in disciples, or the sect leader would stay in a certain city to think of ways to obtain some benefits. However, the Purple Cloud Sect was such a big sect, so it was impossible for them to charge disciples. Jorge naturally disdained to do business like Beau Collier had, which led to the sect's lack of funds. The Grand Guardian was only a martial artist; he couldn't think of a good way to solve this problem.
Until Connor appeared.
Connor had provided a large amount of funds to the Purple Cloud Sect, which had further expanded the scale of their sect. The guardian disciples were also grateful to Connor.
However, the Grand Guardian also knew that this was not a long-term solution because Connor also had his own company and business. He could not always provide funds to the Purple Cloud Sect.
Moreover, the Purple Cloud Sect had also accommodated the Heavenly Sect. The two major sects had merged and lost the support of the Collier family, so the funding issue became even more obvious.
These problems had been troubling the Grand Guardian recently. He was really worried that the Purple Cloud Sect would suddenly stop functioning one day.
However, Connor's idea could solve all the problems of the Purple Cloud Sect.
"Sect Leader McDonald is really far-sighted. This method is really too good!"
After hearing Connor's words, the three guardians were also excited. Their voices trembled as they spoke to Connor.
"I'm the Sect Leader McDonald of the Purple Cloud Sect, so the sect's business is my business. Although martial artists like you may be very disdainful of money, the Purple Cloud Sect still has no way to completely get rid of the trouble of not having money..."
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "There are fewer and fewer alchemists nowadays. No matter where you go, pills are priceless. According to the influence of the Purple Cloud Sect in the ancient martial arts world and the influence of the Stormbound Corporation in Yarlford, no one should dare to compete with you. This market is basically monopolized by you. When the time comes, you can discuss the price of the pills. Don't make them too high."
"Alright…"
Queta was also very interested in the business that Connor was talking about because she knew that this business could definitely make money—terrifying amounts of money.
Queta was a businesswoman, and what she valued most was probably benefits. Moreover, this could help her get rid of the burden of the Purple Cloud Sect, so of course she was willing to agree.
"Sect Leader McDonald, there are usually many things in the sect. The Third Guardian and I might not have the time to manage these things. Why don't we let Waverly be in charge of this matter?" The Grand Guardian asked.
Connor turned to look at Waverly and asked, "Are you willing to take charge of this?"
Waverly blinked. "If I'm in charge, will I be able to come to Yarlford often?"
"Of course…"
Connor nodded.
"Then I'm willing!"
Waverly agreed without any hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2086: Something Happened to Master Yarrell
chapters.content:
Chapter 2086: Something Happened to Master Yarrell
Waverly had lived in the Purple Cloud Sect since she was young and had never left the sect.
Unless she was on a mission, she rarely came into contact with the outside world.
If she was in charge of this business, she would be able to come into contact with more outside matters in the future.
More importantly, she felt that she would have more opportunities to meet Connor.
"Queta, Waverly might not know much about business, so try to take some time to help her!"
Connor said to Queta as if he was a little embarrassed.
In fact, Queta had helped Connor with many things ever since she came to Yarlford. She might even have worked harder than Connor because the entire Stormbound Corporation was managed by her alone. Therefore, Connor felt that he owed Queta a lot.
"No problem, Mr. McDonald!" Queta agreed readily.
"Alright then, the situation in Yarlford has stabilized. If there's nothing else, you can leave!"
Connor knew that after Yamino Gomez's death, there were many things that needed to be done in Yarlford. Queta definitely had a lot of things to do, so her time was still very precious.
"Mr. McDonald, I have something to tell you!" Queta said.
"What is it?"
"Mr. McDonald, do you still remember that Taran you brought back?" Queta asked.
"I remember…"
Connor nodded.
"Well, Taran came to me some time ago. He wants to join our Stormbound Corporation, but I don't know much about this person. Miss Yates also said that she could arrange a job for Taran, so I didn't reject him. I arranged an unimportant position for Taran, but after observing his ability during this period of time, it's indeed very good. Our Stormbound Corporation is also in need of people now, so I want to ask if you think Taran is unsuitable to join our Stormbound Corporation?" Queta asked.
She had always been a meticulous woman. She didn't know Taran's background before, nor did she know what Connor's attitude towards Taran was. However, she didn't want to embarrass Yolanda, so she'd given a less important job to Taran.
But now, Queta could see that Taran was indeed very capable. She wanted to promote him, but she was afraid that Connor would not agree, so she waited until he'd woken up to ask him about this.
"Taran has done me a favor. If he hadn't left behind my back that day, I might have already died, so I think this person can still be trusted. Moreover, Taran shouldn't have the guts to betray me!"
Connor said.
Connor knew that although Taran was very smart, he was still very loyal to him. Back then in Yamino Gomez's manor, even in such a dangerous situation, Taran did not give up on Connor and escape alone. This was enough to show that Taran was still trustworthy.
"Then, Mr. McDonald, what position do you think he should be assigned to?" Queta asked.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then said, "If you think he's capable and won't affect you, you can let him be the vice president. If you think he's not suitable, you can arrange for him to go to a branch company..."
"Then I'll let Taran be the vice president. I don't think there's any problem with his ability!"
Queta said without thinking.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded.
"Mr. McDonald, if there's nothing else, I'll take my leave first!" Queta said.
"You can go do your work!"
Connor waved his hand.
Queta didn't waste any time and turned to leave the room.
After Queta left, Connor looked at the Grand Guardian and muttered, "Grand Guardian, are you hiding something from me?"
"Sect Leader McDonald, you... What do you mean by that?"
The expression on the Grand Guardian's face seemed a little strange as he stammered.
"Don't you know what I mean?"
Connor replied indifferently and then continued, "Previously, you said that my master went to search for treasures, but how long has it been? Why hasn't my master returned yet? Where is he now?"
"This..."
The Grand Guardian did not expect Connor to ask about this matter. The expression on his face seemed to be even more nervous.
"Grand Guardian, I don't want you to lie to me!"
Connor said in a very serious tone.
"Sect Leader McDonald, how would I dare to lie to you? Sect Leader Yarrell really went to search for treasures, but..."
The Grand Guardian seemed to be hesitant.
"Big brother, you better tell the truth to Sect Leader McDonald. Things are already like this, so even if you hide it, it's useless!" The Third Guardian said.
"Sigh…"
The Grand Guardian let out a long breath and then said, "Sect Leader McDonald, I originally planned to wait for a suitable opportunity to tell you about this matter; after all, you have so many things to do. I have never wanted to affect you because of these things…"
"Stop talking nonsense. What exactly happened to my master?" Connor frowned and asked.
"Half a year ago, the Sect Leader accidentally obtained a treasure map. It was said that it was a secret treasure left behind by an ancient martial artist from a hundred years ago. As long as one could find this secret treasure, they could break through to become a Heaven Rank ancient martial artist grandmaster. The Sect Leader's greatest wish for so many years was to become a Heaven Rank ancient martial artist grandmaster, so he set out alone to search for the secret treasure!" the Grand Guardian said.
"And then?"
At this moment, Connor already had a bad feeling in his heart.
"However, a few months have passed, and there has been no news from him. A few of our guardians have also gone out to search for him, but they have not found anything, so... That's why we're worried that the sect master might have been killed!"
The Grand Guardian's voice trembled as he spoke to Connor.
"You... What did you say?"
Connor was stunned on the spot when he heard the Grand Guardian's words. The expression on his face was of disbelief, as if he had been struck by lightning. He simply could not accept this fact.
Although Connor had already expected that Jorge might have encountered some trouble, he did not expect that something would happen to him.
"Master Yarrell is so powerful, so nothing should have happened to him, right?" Yolanda said, as if she couldn't accept this.
"Previously, we also thought that the sect leader's strength was the top in the world. Perhaps someone could defeat him, but it should be impossible to kill him. However, after seeing the battle between the Sect Leader McDonald and Walter Collier last time, we realized that there is always someone better."

chapters.title: Chapter 2087: Treasure Map
chapters.content:
Chapter 2087: Treasure Map
Although the Grand Guardian didn't want anything to happen to Jorge, there was still no news of him after such a long time, so he and the others had already silently accepted the fact that something might have happened to Jorge.
Connor stared at the Grand Guardian and took a deep breath. Then, he said in a low voice, "No, no, no. This is absolutely impossible. Nothing will happen to my master…"
Jorge was a god-like existence in Connor's heart. It could be said that without Jorge, Connor would not have been able to live to this day. It was Jorge who allowed Connor to embark on the path of ancient martial arts cultivation. Jorge could even be said to be the faith in Connor's heart.
Now that someone told Connor that Jorge might have died, Connor naturally couldn't accept it.
"Sect Leader McDonald, we also hope that nothing has happened to him. However, such a long time has passed…"
The Grand Guardian was halfway through his sentence.
"Where's Jabba? Did you guys find Jabba?"
Connor knew that Jabba and Jorge were inseparable. As long as he found Jabba, he would be able to find Jorge.
The Grand Guardian shook his head. "The deputy sect leader has not been found either…"
Connor sat on the chair in a daze. For a moment, he did not know how to describe his feelings.
"No, nothing will happen to my master. He won't die even if he encounters a pinnacle ancient martial artist..."
Connor shook his head.
Everyone knew that Connor might not be able to withstand such a huge blow for a while, so they all quieted down and looked at Connor's seat without saying anything.
Connor couldn't help but think back to the time when he met Jorge and Jorge traveled thousands of miles to Xiangjiang to save him. At this time, Connor might not need Jorge's protection anymore. Perhaps Jorge might not be Connor's opponent, but he still couldn't accept Jorge's death.
"Sect Leader McDonald, you had too many things to do previously. Moreover, we were not sure if something had really happened to Sect Master, so we did not tell you this news!"
The Grand Guardian muttered.
"If I hadn't taken the initiative to ask, how long were you planning to hide it from me? What do you mean? You actually hid such a big matter from me. Do you even take me, the Sect Leader McDonald, seriously?"
Connor replied with red eyes.
".."
The Grand Guardian looked at Connor, not knowing what to say.
"Sect Leader McDonald, now that something has happened to the Sect Leader, everyone in our Sect is very upset. The Grand Guardian only didn't want to affect you, so he didn't tell you."
Waverly said.
When Connor heard Waverly's words, he could not help but take a deep breath. Only now did he realize that he had gone overboard just now. After all, it was not easy for the Grand Guardian.
"Mr. McDonald, calm down. Master Yarrell is blessed. Maybe he just encountered some trouble? The situation might not be as bad as you think!"
Yolanda muttered.
Connor turned his head and glanced at Yolanda. Then, he sorted out his thoughts and muttered to the Grand Guardian, "Grand Guardian, I might have been a little too excited earlier…"
"It's okay, Sect Leader McDonald. I know the relationship between you and the sect leader very well, so it's very normal for you to be a little excited…"
The Grand Guardian hurriedly said.
"I think what Yolanda said just now is very reasonable. No matter what, my master is a pinnacle Earth-class ancient martial arts grandmaster. Even if he encounters a pinnacle ancient martial arts grandmaster, he has a chance of survival. So, the situation might not be as pessimistic as we think. Moreover, if something really happened to my master, Jabba would definitely come back, yet he hasn't appeared for so long. I think my master might have encountered some trouble!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"If that's the case, that's great!"
The Grand Guardian felt that what Connor said made sense and shouted excitedly.
"Do you know where my master went to search for treasures?" Connor asked.
"I don't know the exact location, but I know that the sect master has a treasure map in his hands. Moreover, this treasure map was sent from Winam. I only took a look at it back then and didn't see the exact location of the secret treasure!" The Grand Guardian hurriedly said.
"A hundred-year-old secret treasure! Winam!"
After Connor obtained these two key pieces of information, he felt that it was consistent with the secret treasure that Black Tiger had mentioned back then.
"You said you saw the treasure map, right?" Connor asked.
"Yes, I took a look!"
Connor didn't even think about it and immediately took out the treasure map that Black Tiger gave him in his room.
In order to apologize to Connor, Black Tiger had proposed many compensation methods, but Connor was not very interested in those things. In addition, Connor did not really intend to deal with Winam at that time. After all, he went for Taran and did not want to continue to expand the conflict. In the end, Connor chose a treasure map that Black Tiger had given him.
After returning to Yarlford, Connor had a lot of things to do. He was not in the mood to search for treasures, so he put away the treasure map.
After finding the treasure map, Connor directly handed it to the Grand Guardian and said, "Take a look at the treasure map that my master obtained back then. Is it this treasure map?"
The Grand Guardian hurriedly opened the treasure map and was shocked. He stammered to Connor, "Sect Leader McDonald, that's right. This is the treasure map that Sect Leader obtained back then. However, Sect Leader Yarrell's treasure map might not be as detailed as yours."
"That's right…"
Connor nodded.
Back then, Black Tiger had told Connor that this treasure map had always been hidden in his safe. No one had seen it at all.
Under such circumstances, Black Tiger would definitely not lie to Connor. Therefore, he felt that someone around Black Tiger must have copied a sketch and then sold it to others at a sky-high price.
Jorge had accidentally obtained the treasure map and went to search for it.
Jorge's biggest dream in his life was to become a Heaven Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster. Therefore, this secret treasure was very tempting to Jorge.
After knowing what Jorge was going to do, Connor's mood eased up quite a bit.
Perhaps all of this had been arranged by the heavens. Connor himself did not expect that the treasure map he had unintentionally chosen would have such a huge effect.
"Grand Guardian, I don't understand this treasure map. Can you help me find out where the treasure is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2088: Searching for Jorge Yarrell
chapters.content:
Chapter 2088: Searching for Jorge Yarrell
"Alright, I'll give it a try!"
The Grand Guardian muttered back to Connor.
At this moment, he was also very nervous. After all, this was very likely related to Jorge's life or death.
There were many obscure ancient texts written on the treasure map. Moreover, only martial artists could understand these ancient texts. Ordinary people, even experts who studied ancient texts, might not be able to understand them.
Connor had been in contact with ancient martial arts for a long time, so he naturally knew nothing about these things.
Fortunately, the Grand Guardian liked to study these things in the Purple Cloud Sect. He had always been trying to find a way to break through to the Heaven Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster through ancient books, but had come up empty-handed for so many years.
Jorge often ridiculed the Grand Guardian for not putting his energy into cultivation but instead reading a broken book every day. Who would have thought that these ancient books would be of great help now!
Everyone sat quietly on the spot, waiting for the Grand Guardian to decipher the words on the treasure map. At this time, everyone's expression was very nervous, and they did not even dare to make a sound.
About two hours later, the Grand Guardian wiped the sweat off his forehead.
"Grand Guardian, do you understand the map?"
Connor hurriedly asked.
"Sect Leader McDonald, don't be anxious…" The Grand Guardian replied to Connor in a low voice, and then said to Waverly, "Waverly, go out and buy me a map now. The more detailed it is, the better!"
"Alright…"
Waverly agreed and turned to leave.
After Waverly left, the Grand Guardian continued to study the treasure map.
About half an hour later, Waverly returned to Connor's house with a bunch of maps in hand.
The Grand Guardian began to check the map one by one. His expression seemed to be very nervous. If one map was wrong, he would change to a second one.
In the blink of an eye, the Grand Guardian had already looked through the map that Waverly had bought, but it seemed that he still could not find the location described in the treasure map.
"Waverly, go to the city library now and see if you can find a map dungeon from a hundred years ago!"
The Grand Guardian said.
"Alright…"
Waverly nodded and left Connor's villa again.
Everyone waited from morning until late at night, but there was still no news from the Grand Guardian.
At this moment, Connor was also very anxious, but he could not do anything but wait patiently.
"Sect Leader McDonald, I found it, I finally found it!"
The Grand Guardian held a map of the Light Age and shouted excitedly at Connor.
"Where is it?"
Connor heard the words of the Grand Guardian and quickly rushed to him.
"Sect Leader McDonald, the person who left behind this treasure map should be an ancient martial arts expert from the Light Age. Previously, I had been using modern maps to compare, which is why it took so long…" the Grand Guardian explained happily.
"I see!"
Connor lightly nodded.
One had to know that this secret treasure was left behind by a martial artist from a hundred years ago. Therefore, the map he had referred to when he drew the treasure map must have been a map from his era. Compared to the current map, there was naturally a huge gap.
Fortunately, the Grand Guardian had reacted quickly and was proficient in ancient language, otherwise, it would not be so easy for ordinary people to crack this treasure map.
"Can you stop talking nonsense? Where is the sect master?" the three guardians asked anxiously.
The Grand Guardian took out a modern map and pointed out a small island. He said, "The hidden treasure should be on this island!"
"Bamarre Island?"
Connor looked at the name on the map with a puzzled expression.
This was because this Bamarre Island was not in Sommerville, but in France.
Originally, Connor thought that the secret treasure should be in Sommerville. After all, this secret treasure was left behind by the masters of Sommerville. However, Connor later remembered that France was only a vassal state of Sommerville at that time. It could be considered to be within Sommerville. Moreover, the transportation tools at that time were not developed. Usually, when the masters chose the location of the tomb, they would choose a relatively remote place. This way, it would not be easy to be discovered. Therefore, it was very reasonable for the secret treasure to be hidden in this location.
"Bamarre Island seems to be very big. Grand Guardian, do you know the exact location?"
Waverly asked with a frown.
Although Bamarre Island looked like a small island on the map, it was actually very large. If one only knew the location of Bamarre Island, it would be like looking for a needle in a haystack!
"If I'm not wrong, the hidden treasure should be in the Eight Trigrams Valley of Bamarre Island!"
The Grand Guardian said in a low voice.
"Eight Trigrams Valley of Bamarre Island!"
After knowing these two places, the expression on Connor's face grew excited. After all, the location of the secret treasure had been narrowed down to a very small area. It should not be difficult to find the secret treasure.
"Alright, thank you for your hard work!" Connor said.
"It's no trouble at all!"
The Grand Guardian hurriedly waved his hand.
Connor didn't continue to pay attention to the Grand Guardian. Instead, he said to Waverly, "Waverly, help me book a ticket to France now. I'm going there tonight!"
"Sect Leader McDonald, you... Are you going to France today?"
Waverly was stunned for a moment and asked Connor in surprise.
"Yes, there is no time to lose. My master has already disappeared for so long. I will go today…"
Connor nodded.
Connor didn't want to waste any more time. He wanted to find Jorge as soon as possible.
"But will it be dangerous for you to go alone?"
Waverly said hesitantly.
"What danger can I be in…"
Connor said lightly.
"But you just woke up…"
Waverly still didn't feel at ease letting Connor go to France alone to look for Jorge. She turned to look at Yolanda without saying anything.
Yolanda hesitated for a moment, then said, "I'll accompany Connor. If anything happens, I can let you all know…"
"What are you still standing there for? Hurry up and book the plane tickets!"
Connor said.
Waverly's expression was a little helpless as she turned around and left.
"Sect Leader McDonald, I think you should think about it carefully before going to France. After all, you have just woken up. If you encounter any danger…" the Grand Guardian said.
"I know my own body very well. Besides, Yolanda will be coming with me, so you don't have to worry about anything. Just do your own thing!"
Connor said in a low voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 2089: Heading to France
chapters.content:
Chapter 2089: Heading to France
At this moment, Connor couldn't care less. He had to hurry up and find Jorge.
"Sect Leader Yarrell is very strong, so perhaps he didn't encounter any danger. Sect Leader McDonald, you don't have to be so anxious!" the Grand Guardian muttered.
"How do you know Jorge isn't in danger?" Connor asked.
"Just now, I carefully checked this treasure map and found some words on it. There seems to be some kind of array in this tomb. As long as the array is opened, no one can break in. Moreover, this array will be opened once every ten years, and it will only be opened for ten days. I calculated just now that the last time the array was opened was when the sect master left, so I think it's very likely that the sect master is trapped in the tomb by the array. He wasn't killed!"
The Grand Guardian said very seriously.
"Is what you said true?"
Connor asked.
"Of course it's true. I will definitely not lie to you about this kind of thing. Therefore, I think that it's better for us to wait for ten years. At that time, the sect leader might return…"
The Grand Guardian said slowly.
"I can't wait that long. If my master isn't trapped by the array, but is really in danger, then I might miss the best opportunity to save him. So, no matter what you say now, I have to go to France to take a look!" Connor said firmly.
The Grand Guardian let out a long sigh. The expression on his face seemed to be somewhat helpless.
After all, Jorge's situation was unknown. If Connor encountered any danger in France, it would be a disaster for the Purple Cloud Sect.
However, the Grand Guardian was also very aware that since Connor wanted to go, he would definitely not be able to stop him, so he did not say anything.
"Alright, don't stand here anymore. Go do what you need to do. Leave my master's matters to me!" Connor said.
At this moment, Waverly returned to Connor's side and said, "Mr. McDonald, it's too late now. There's no flight to France at all, so I've booked a flight for you and Miss Yolanda at 8 am tomorrow."
Connor turned to look at Yolanda. "My trip to France this time may be even more dangerous than the last time. Are you sure you want to go with me?"
"I'm worried about you going alone. Let me go with you!" Yolanda replied.
"Alright, since you want to go with me, then take some time to rest. The two of us will set off tomorrow morning!"
Connor muttered.
"Yes!"
Yolanda didn't expect Connor to not stop her from going with him. After agreeing, she walked towards her room.
She hadn't slept much these days, so she was already exhausted. Now that Connor had woken up, she could rest well.
After Yolanda left, Connor also sent the Grand Guardian and the others away. After all, there was no point in keeping them around now.
After everyone left, Connor sat on the sofa alone and began to think about what he should do next.
He knew in his heart that his chances of finding Jorge this time were very slim. After all, Jorge might not have encountered danger while searching for the secret treasure, or Jorge might have died long ago. But as long as there was a glimmer of hope, Connor would not give up.
…
The night passed quickly. The next day, at 8 am, Connor and Yolanda boarded a flight to Franciard.
Although Connor's destination was Bamarre Island, because Bamarre Island was an island and a famous scenic spot in France, there was no direct flight there. Connor and Yolanda had to go to Ladd City first, and then from Ladd City to Bamarre Island.
In the evening, Connor and Yolanda finally arrived at Ladd City.
It was getting late, and Connor wasn't familiar with the situation in Ladd City. He hadn't fully recovered yet, so he didn't go to Bamarre Island directly. Instead, he took Yolanda to the most luxurious hotel in Ladd City and booked a room. They planned to rest for the night before leaving the next day.
After arriving at the hotel room, Yolanda went straight to rest, while Connor sat on the sofa and started cultivating.
Right now, Connor's body had not completely recovered, and the aura in his body was also in a very unstable state. Therefore, Connor had to seize the time to recover so that he could face the next battle in his best state.
Connor knew that the opponent he was going to encounter this time was probably not a regular ancient martial arts grandmaster. It was very likely that he would encounter a true pinnacle expert this time.
The next morning.
After Yolanda woke up, she tidied up and walked to Connor's side to wake him up.
"You're awake?"
Connor opened his eyes and asked Yolanda.
"That's right!"
Yolanda's condition was obviously much better now. She nodded at Connor gently and continued to ask, "What do you plan to do next?"
"Do you know French?"
Connor asked.
"No…" Yolanda shook her head.
Connor knew that not everyone was as talented as Rachel, who was proficient in the languages of various places. However, if Connor and Yolanda could not communicate with the French, it would be very difficult for the two of them to go to Bamarre Island. Even if they reached Bamarre Island, Connor would not be able to find the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Therefore, Connor hesitated for a moment before saying, "We don't know much about the situation in France, so I think we should find a guide first. That way, we can save a lot of time!"
"Alright, I'll listen to you…" Yolanda said with a smile.
Connor took out his phone and searched the internet. Finally, he found a travel agency that specialized in serving the people of Sommerville. He felt that there should be people from Sommerville who knew about the situation in France in this travel agency.
Half an hour later, Connor and Yolanda arrived at a travel agency owned by a local.
Connor was greeted by a middle-aged man in his forties.
"Are the two of you here for a vacation in France?"
The middle-aged man asked Connor with a smile.
"Yes, I'm here for a vacation..."
Connor nodded.
"Our travel agency has been established for more than 20 years. We specialize in serving people from Sommerville. Now, we have several tourism projects. The price is different, and the service is naturally different."
The middle-aged man handed Connor a booklet as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 2090: Bamarre Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 2090: Bamarre Island
Connor didn't take the booklet, but said, "I want to go to Bamarre Island. Help me find a tour guide who is familiar with Bamarre Island!"
"Bamarre Island?"
After the middle-aged man heard Connor's words, his expression became a little strange. Then, he said, "No problem. Bamarre Island is one of the more famous tourist attractions in France. Every year, there are many tourists who go there. We have many tour guides who are familiar with Bamarre Island…"
Bamarre Island indeed receives many guests every year. Moreover, it was said that the island had a large primeval forest, so people often went to the primeval forest to take risks. It was the same as Leah Langlie and the others that Connor had met in Crimson Summit Mountain.
As a result, many travel agencies in France had dedicated staff to bring tourists to Bamarre Island.
"That's good…"
Connor nodded.
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment before asking again, "May I know where the two of you plan to go at Bamarre Island?"
"Eight Trigrams Valley!"
Connor said lightly.
"This…"
The middle-aged man was stunned when he heard Connor's words.
"What's wrong?"
Connor saw that something was wrong with the middle-aged man and asked.
"This place has been sealed off by France. Ordinary people can't enter!" the middle-aged man said in a low voice.
"Sealed off?"
The expression on Connor's face was somewhat strange. He felt that France's blockade of the Eight Trigrams Valley must have something to do with that secret treasure.
"That's right. I don't know what's going on. It was sealed off half a year ago. No one is allowed to enter…" the middle-aged man said in a low voice.
After hearing the middle-aged man's words, Connor was even more certain that France's blockade of the Eight Trigrams Valley must have something to do with the secret tomb there.
"Boss, I don't need your people to bring me into the Eight Trigrams Valley. You just need to help me find the valley," Connor said.
"This…"
The middle-aged man seemed to be hesitant.
Connor knew what the middle-aged man was hesitating about, so he bluntly said "You don't have to worry about money. As long as you can get someone to bring me to the Eight Trigrams Valley, you can name any price!"
"Are you sure?"
The middle-aged man's expression was a little excited when he heard Connor's words.
"Of course I'm sure!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"..."
The middle-aged man thought for a moment and said, " There is indeed someone from our travel agency who has been to the Eight Trigrams Valley, but he has only been there once. It's a pity that the tour guide has already been taken away by someone, but the person who took the tour guide also wants to go to the Eight Trigrams Valley. If you agree to go with them, I'll make a call for you now and ask if the other party agrees…"
"Alright, go ahead and ask!"
Connor nodded.
He knew that it was not easy to find someone who could speak a language he knew as well as know the exact location of the Eight Trigrams Valley. If Connor went to another travel agency to ask for help, it would be a waste of time, so he agreed.
Moreover, Connor only needed to know the approximate location of the Eight Trigrams Valley. Even if there were people traveling with him, it would not cause any trouble for Connor.
After the middle-aged man saw that Connor had agreed, he immediately picked up his phone and started making a call.
A few minutes later, the middle-aged man put down his phone and muttered, "Sir, I communicated with the other party just now. The other party said that he wants to meet you and then consider whether to agree to take you to the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
"No problem!"
Connor smiled faintly.
At this moment, Connor had already thought it through. It would be best if the other party agreed to bring him to the Eight Trigrams Valley. If they did not agree, then Connor would simply snatch him away. He did not have the mood to waste too much time on this kind of thing.
"By the way, sir, I still have to remind you that the other party's identity is very special. The family that this person belongs to is very powerful in France, so when you see that person later, you must be careful and don't say the wrong thing. Otherwise, I'm worried that you will get into trouble!" the middle-aged man muttered.
"Alright, I understand…"
Connor nodded helplessly.
"That person's temper isn't very good either, so you really have to be careful!"
The middle-aged man saw that Connor's attitude was a little casual, so he hurriedly reminded him again.
"Why are you talking so much nonsense? Hurry up and bring us over!"
Yolanda couldn't stand it anymore. Connor was a famous Soul Eater, and now this middle-aged man kept telling Connor to be careful of a French person of unknown status. Yolanda finally couldn't take it anymore.
"Miss, why are you still angry? Isn't this for your own good?"
The middle-aged man smiled awkwardly.
"You don't have to worry about our business. Just do your job and take your money!" Yolanda said coldly.
"Your words reminded me that my mission is to bring you there. As for whether they agree or not, that's their business. So no matter what the outcome is, the two of you need to pay me first!"
The middle-aged man chuckled.
"You!"
Yolanda looked a little angry and said loudly, "You haven't done anything and you're already asking for money…"
Connor reached out to stop Yolanda and said, "How much do you want?"
"One million!"
The middle-aged man demanded an exorbitant price.
"Go swipe this card!"
Originally, the middle-aged man thought that Connor might bargain, but he never expected Connor to be so generous. He directly took out his bank card and handed it to him.
"This…"
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment, then reached out to take Connor's bank card.
But at this moment, Connor suddenly said, "Oh right, I forgot to tell you. I don't like people playing with me. If I find out that you're playing with me, you might die a very miserable death!"
"I don't dare, I don't dare. How can I fool you…"
The middle-aged man replied without thinking.
"Go swipe this card!"
Connor said lightly.
The middle-aged man hurriedly took Connor's card and turned around to leave.
On the other hand, Yolanda's expression was a little angry. She muttered, "This person is asking for an exorbitant price."
"There's no need to bother with such a person. I don't need this one million dollar anyway!" Connor replied calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2091: Wilda Zerbe
chapters.content:
Chapter 2091: Wilda Zerbe
Yolanda looked at Connor and couldn't help but hesitate for a moment, but she didn't say anything.
Half an hour later, Connor and Yolanda followed the middle-aged man to a beach in France.
There weren't many people on the beach at the moment, and only one or two figures could be vaguely seen.
"Why are there so few people on such a beautiful beach?"
Yolanda asked.
"Miss, this is private waters. Normal tourists can't enter!"
The middle-aged man explained.
"Which big shot actually bought such a large sea area!"
Yolanda looked surprised.
"It's the person you're going to see later!"
The middle-aged man said indifferently.
