A moment later, the middle-aged man brought Connor to a young woman. The woman was about the same age as Connor. She was very beautiful and wore a sexy bikini. Her perfect and hot figure was obvious.
At this moment, the woman was sitting on a beach chair and drinking red wine. Behind the woman stood a few burly men, who were most probably the woman's guards.
Connor did not expect that the person who wanted to go to the Eight Trigrams Valley with him was actually a woman.
Connor looked at the woman from head to toe. This woman was most probably from Oprana. Moreover, from the looks of it, this woman probably came from some influential family.
Connor knew that some rich kids liked to explore dangerous places all over the world, as if this was the only way to stimulate their nerves.
The middle-aged man from the travel agency walked to the woman with a flattering attitude and then briefly explained the situation on Connor's side in French.
When the woman found out why Connor was here, she turned and looked at him indifferently. Then, she said softly, "The two of them want to go to Bamarre Island? How ridiculous!"
It was obvious that this woman in a bikini was very disdainful of Connor and Yolanda.
When the woman saw Connor, she didn't look at him again after one glance because she felt that he was just an ordinary young man and there was nothing special about him.
When the woman saw Yolanda, she looked surprised.
Because Yolanda was beautiful. Although the woman was beautiful as well, there was still a gap between her and Yolanda. Therefore, the woman was jealous of Yolanda. She did not expect such a beautiful woman to exist in this world.
"Miss Zerbe! Mr. McDonald also wants to go to Bamarre Island. If you agree to bringing the two of them with you, Mr. McDonald is willing to pay a certain fee…"
At this moment, the boss of the travel agency interrupted the woman's thoughts.
The woman slowly raised her head and looked at Connor. Then, she said in a very cold voice, "I, Wilda Zerbe, am not short of money!"
"Yes, yes. Miss Zerbe, you definitely don't lack money…"
The middle-aged man hurriedly nodded.
The woman named Wilda ignored the middle-aged man. Instead, she turned to look at Connor and asked softly, "Do you know who I am?"
"I don't…"
Connor shook his head without thinking.
"You don't even know me? It seems that you don't know much about the situation in France!"
Wilda seemed even more arrogant now. Then, she continued, "Let's just cut to the chase. This time, we're going to the Eight Trigrams Valley on Bamarre Island. If you don't know this place, let me give you a brief introduction. This Eight Trigrams Valley is considered the most dangerous place in France. Last year, more than a thousand people died in the Eight Trigrams Valley, and France has now sealed off the valley. The two of you are just ordinary people, so you'd better go back and stop wasting time here. If you're not careful, you will lose your life there…"
When Connor heard Wilda's words, he hesitated for a moment. He knew that the location of the secret treasure was in the Eight Trigrams Valley, so there would definitely be many martial artists there looking for the secret treasure. As such, it wasn't peculiar for many people to have died there. In order to prevent the situation from worsening, sealing off the Eight Trigrams Valley was the right thing to do.
"We are not afraid of danger, as long as you can lead us to the Eight Trigrams Valley, if you have any conditions, you can state them!"
Connor knew that Wilda had some influence in France, so he didn't want to have any conflict with Wilda now. Finding Jorge Yarrell was the most important thing.
"Conditions?"
Wilda smiled faintly when she heard Connor's words. Then, she turned to look at the guard behind her and said in a cold and arrogant tone, "I've already said that I don't lack money. The Eight Trigrams Valley is a very dangerous place. I don't want the two of you to drag down my team. If the two of you want to follow me, as long as one of you can defeat my guards, I'll agree to bring the two of you with me…"
After Wilda had finished speaking, a dark-skinned and muscular young man walked up to her.
Connor looked at this brawny man with a faint smile. This brawny man was most probably in the martial artist realm. If he was placed among ordinary people, he would be considered strong. However, in front of Connor, he was nothing. Connor was even worried that he would kill this brawny man with a single punch.
"This is my personal guard, Declan Howell. He is a martial artist. Although he is not the strongest among my guards, he should be able to deal with the two of you without any problems!"
Wilda paused for a moment and then continued, "Oh right, if the two of you want to deal with him together, you may go ahead!"
The boss of the travel agency was a little nervous when he heard Wilda's words. He sort of had an idea who Declan was. He knew that Declan was very powerful. If they really were to fight, Connor would definitely be killed or injured.
Of course, the boss of the travel agency didn't want to make a big deal out of this matter. If someone really died, it would be troublesome, so he quickly walked up to Connor and whispered to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, why not forget about it? I'll help you contact other travel agencies and see if they are going to the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
"He's right. You'd better leave now!"
Wilda said disdainfully.
"There's no need for that…"
Connor replied, then took a step forward and was ready to attack.
However, Yolanda reached out to stop Connor and said softly, "Mr. McDonald, you just woke up. Let me."

chapters.title: Chapter 2092: Quite Capable
chapters.content:
Chapter 2092: Quite Capable
Yolanda was weaker than Connor's. She was only a black rank and hadn't even broken through to grandmaster realm yet.
However, it was not a problem for Yolanda to deal with Declan.
Connor hesitated for a moment before nodding.
Connor didn't need to personally take action for a small fry like Declan.
Yolanda walked up to Declan.
When Wilda saw Yolanda volunteer, a strange look flashed across her face. She said to Connor with disdain, "Are you a man or not? How can you let women fight?"
It was obvious that Wilda felt that Connor was weak. He actually let a woman fight in his stead and did not even dare to fight.
"I will do. There's no need for Mr. McDonald to do it himself!"
Yolanda replied lightly.
Wilda sized Yolanda up and said in a low voice, "You'll regret this. Declan, show them what you've got…"
"Alright, Miss Zerbe!"
Declan nodded and walked up to Yolanda with a casual expression. He said with a smile, "You're a woman. I know how to be gentle with women. I'll let you make the first three moves!"
"You go first!"
Yolanda said expressionlessly.
A strange look flashed across Declan's face when he heard Yolanda's words. He could feel that Yolanda was looking down on him.
"Since you're so arrogant, I'll show you how powerful I am!"
Declan growled and rushed toward Yolanda.
Although Declan felt that he was facing an ordinary woman, in order to show off in front of Wilda, Declan used all his strength in the first move. Moreover, Declan was using a tricky fist move. Ordinary martial artists might not be able to block Declan's punch.
Connor looked at Declan expressionlessly. He now knew why Wilda was so confident before. Declan was indeed capable.
However, compared to Yolanda, who came from an ancient martial arts sect, Declan was far inferior.
When Declan rushed up to Yolanda, she nimbly dodged his punch.
Declan was shocked because he didn't expect Yolanda to react so quickly.
"You're quite capable!"
Declan smiled faintly, then raised his fist and wanted to punch Yolanda in the chest.
Yolanda reached out and grabbed Declan's arm, then twisted it hard!
No one expected Yolanda's slender and fair arm to be able to exert such terrifying strength. Declan screamed in pain, and then everyone heard a cracking sound. Declan's arm was broken by Yolanda.
Then, Yolanda raised her leg and kicked Declan in the stomach.
Declan's body was sent flying and smashed onto the beach. His face was twisted in pain as he hugged his arm and moaned in pain.
However, Declan did not give up. He struggled to stand up, but he felt as if he had been hit by a truck. He could not stand up at all.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all stunned. Their faces were filled with disbelief. No one expected Declan to be so vulnerable in front of Yolanda. In less than half a minute, Declan had been beaten up by Yolanda!
"Isn't this woman way too scary?"
"Yeah, this woman is terrifyingly strong!"
"Who is this woman?"
The guards behind Wilda began to discuss in low voices. The way they looked at Yolanda changed drastically.
"Shut up!"
When Wilda heard the guards' words, she stood up and scolded them coldly.
When everyone heard Wilda's words, they shut their mouths and stood rooted to the ground, not daring to speak.
Yolanda looked at Wilda expressionlessly and asked her softly, "Should we continue fighting?"
"..."
When Wilda heard this, her expression was very ugly. She opened her mouth and wanted to say something.
However, at this moment, a middle-aged man walked up to Wilda and said softly to her, "Miss, this woman is strong; she's probably a black rank!"
"So what if she's a black rank? They are much too arrogant!"
Wilda was very unconvinced and replied with a frown.
"Black rank isn't scary, but I think that the young man's skills are even more terrifying. Our trip to the Eight Trigrams Valley is perilous, and if they are there, they might be able to help us!"
The middle-aged man said softly.
Wilda hesitated for a couple of seconds when she heard that. Then, she looked at Yolanda and said, "Alright, I'll bring the two of you to the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
Connor glanced at the middle-aged man beside Wilda. He could feel that this middle-aged man was an ancient martial arts grandmaster, so the middle-aged man could tell that Yolanda was strong.
However, Connor had nothing to worry about. After all, he was just an ancient martial arts grandmaster. In Connor's eyes, it was not even worth nothing.
After Wilda had agreed to Connor and Yolanda joining their team, she then ignored them. Instead, she sat on the beach chair and continued to bask in the sun.
Connor and Yolanda were not in the mood to talk to Wilda, so they found a random seat and sat down, waiting quietly.
Half an hour later, another group of people arrived at the beach.
Some of these people were from Sommervile, and some were locals of France. Moreover, from the way they were dressed and talked, these people were either rich or noble. Their families were most probably very powerful in France.
These rich kids had known each other since they were young, and they all liked to explore all kinds of dangerous places.
"Miss Zerbe, is everyone here?"
At this moment, a middle-aged French man walked up to Wilda and asked her softly.
From the conversation just now, Connor learned that this middle-aged man from France was called Anthony and was the leader of this trip to Bamarre Island.
Anthony had lived on Bamarre Island for many years, so he was very familiar with the island. He also had a lot of experience in surviving in the wild.
"Yes, everyone is here!"
Wilda nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2093: Intimidating Everyone
chapters.content:
Chapter 2093: Intimidating Everyone
"Then, let's hurry up and set off!"
Anthony shouted at everyone.
Although Wilda and the others were from wealthy families, they were very obedient as they listened to Anthony.
Therefore, at this moment, they began to pack their things.
This was not the first time these people had gone out on an adventure. They were already familiar with this kind of thing and had already made various preparations in advance. Basically, as long as it was something that could be used in the wild, they had already prepared it. Moreover, Wilda had brought a large group of guards with her. These guards also played the role of coolies, carrying bags of equipment.
In stark contrast to these people, Yolanda and Connor did not bring anything with them. It was as if they were there to watch a show.
Anthony glanced at Connor and didn't say anything. They had brought enough for everyone, so even with the addition of Connor and Yolanda, it wouldn't affect them too much.
"What are you two still standing there for? Hurry up and get on the plane!"
Wilda shouted at Connor and Yolanda with disdain.
Connor slowly stood up and walked toward the helicopter in the distance.
Wilda was indeed very rich.
If ordinary people wanted to go to Bamarre Island, they would usually choose to go by boat because the cost of going by boat was relatively low. However, Wilda was going by plane this time, and it was a private plane worth more than 100 million dollars.
Flying from Connor's current location to Bamarre Island would cost at least a few million. This amount of money was considered an astronomical figure for ordinary people. It was simply not something that ordinary people could afford.
Connor and Yolanda followed Wilda onto the plane.
After boarding the plane, Connor saw that the insides of the plane were very luxurious. Basically, everything you could think of was available inside.
It was obviously not the first time Wilda and the others had taken this plane. They were very familiar with the plane and began to look for their seats. They even opened red wine and started having fun.
Connor didn't know these rich second-generation heirs, nor was he in the mood to entertain anyone, so he casually found a remote seat and sat down.
Yolanda sat beside Connor.
After sitting down, Connor immediately started cultivating. Yolanda also closed her eyes to get some rest.
Wilda's friends also noticed Connor and Yolanda. They did not pay too much attention to Connor. After all, he looked like an ordinary person. However, some men were very curious about Yolanda because she was very beautiful.
"Wilda, who are these two? Why haven't I seen them before?"
At this moment, a tall and burly young man walked to Wilda's side and asked her softly.
"The two of them want to go to the Eight Trigrams Valley. Since it's on the way, I brought the two of them along…"
Wilda explained casually.
When the young man heard Wilda's words, he was obviously stunned for a moment. He frowned and said, "So they're just two strangers. I thought they were your friends!"
"Yeah, Wilda. This isn't like you. You're not that generous, are you?"
At this moment, a beautiful red-haired girl said with a smile.
Wilda elegantly took a sip of red wine and said softly, "Both of them are from Sommervile, and it's not easy to find a guide to the Eight Trigrams Valley. I guess we're destined to meet. Anyway, it's just the two of them!"
"It's not just about the number of people…"
A handsome boy with a deep voice said.
"What do you mean?"
Wilda turned and glanced at the boy.
"Wilda, if we were going to an ordinary place to explore this time, it might not affect us much if we bring two strangers. However, the Eight Trigrams Valley is very dangerous. If we really encounter any trouble, these two people might drag us down!"
The handsome boy said seriously.
"You worry too much…"
Wilda replied expressionlessly and continued, "Do you see that pretty girl?"
"Yeah…"
"She's so beautiful. Why is she with that person?"
"Yeah, the two of them don't look compatible at all!"
Everyone stared at Yolanda and started discussing in low voices.
"You better be careful with what you say. Don't let that girl hear you. That girl just broke Declan's arm. Declan didn't have a chance to fight back at all!"
Wilda said expressionlessly.
"Wilda, what… what did you just say?"
When everyone heard Wilda's words, they were all stunned. They were in disbelief.
"This girl broke Declan's hand? How is that possible?"
"Yeah, Declan is so strong!"
Everyone seemed to think that Wilda was joking with them.
These people had known Wilda for many years, and they knew how capable Declan was. Therefore, they did not believe that Yolanda could defeat Declan at all.
"I'm not joking with you. If you don't believe me, you can ask Uncle Cardenas!"
Wilda said impatiently.
Everyone turned to look at Uncle Cardenas. Uncle Cardenas was Wilda's personal guard. He was very strong, and he was also very prestigious. They knew that Uncle Cardenas would definitely not joke about something like this.
"Miss Zerbe is telling the truth. That girl is most probably a black rank, or she wouldn't have been able to handle Declan so easily. As for that guy, I can't tell just yet, but he's definitely not an ordinary person!"
Uncle Cardenas said to the crowd without any hesitation.
When everyone heard Uncle Cardenas's words, they were all stunned on the spot. They were in utter disbelief. Who would have thought that a thin and weak woman like Yolanda would have such terrifying strength?
"Who are they?"
"Yeah. Why do the two of them have such terrifying strength at such a young age?"
"How unbelievable…"
The way everyone looked at Yolanda had changed drastically.
"These two people are probably from an ancient martial arts sect in Sommervile. Otherwise, there's no way they would be in such a high realm!"
Uncle Cardenas said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2094: The Aura of a Martial Artist
chapters.content:
Chapter 2094: The Aura of a Martial Artist
"They are definitely strong. It's best if we don't provoke them!"
"Yeah. I heard that the ancient martial arts sects in Sommervile are all very powerful. If we make them mad, we'll be in trouble!"
"Isn't it just an ancient martial arts sect? They aren't important people of the sect, just some unranked disciples. You don't have to be so nervous!"
"Yeah. This isn't Sommervile. If they don't provoke us, we definitely won't provoke them!"
Everyone had different attitudes toward Connor and Yolanda.
Some of those from more influential families did not take Connor seriously.
Those who were slightly weaker were unwilling to cause trouble.
Wilda, on the other hand, had been looking at the scenery outside without saying a word. No one knew what she was thinking at the moment.
Three hours later, the plane finally landed on Bamarre Island.
Bamarre Island was now considered one of the more important tourist attractions in France. A large number of tourists came almost every day, which led to a huge development of Bamarre Island. The progress was even faster than the capital of France. The place where the plane landed was not as backward as Connor had imagined. On the contrary, it was very luxurious, and there was an endless stream of traffic.
Moreover, there were specialized staff members to welcome Wilda and the others. There were even some other staff members. From this point, it could be seen that Wilda was indeed very influential in France.
Everyone followed the receptionist to a hotel. The hotel could be compared to a five-star hotel in Sommervile.
Connor wanted to go directly to the Eight Trigrams Valley, but Wilda and the others wanted to rest, so he could only follow them to the hotel. After all, without a guide, it would be very difficult for Connor to find the Eight Trigrams Valley. He might waste more time without them.
After resting for a night, they left the hotel at six in the morning the next day and set off to find the Eight Trigrams Valley.
In the beginning, Connor saw that there were a lot of tourists on the road, but as they drove further and further in, the number of tourists decreased.
In the end, the car stopped in front of a primitive forest. The primitive forest had a complex structure, so it was difficult for these off-road vehicles to navigate. Everyone could only choose to walk.
As the car could not enter, the things they had prepared in advance could only be carried in by manpower. There were not a lot of people, but there was a lot of equipment and the guards could not carry so many things, so all the boys took the initiative to help.
Apart from the girls, everyone else was carrying a big bag.
Connor and Yolanda did not take anything, as if they were planning to enter the forest empty-handed.
Therefore, everyone looked at Connor and Yolanda strangely.
"There are still some supplies in the car. We've taken what we will use later. We won't take extra, so if the two of you need anything, you can go to the car to get it now!"
Wilda said to Connor expressionlessly.
They had brought a large amount of supplies when they set off, but they could not bring all of them in right now, so a portion of them was in the car. Wilda told Connor to take a portion of it for himself. After all, they did not have that many people helping to carry stuff, so no one would help the two of them carry anything.
"I don't need these things!"
However, Connor replied without hesitation.
Wilda couldn't help but be stunned when she heard Connor's words. Then, she frowned and said, "Are you kidding me? Do you know how dangerous it is inside? Besides, we don't know when we'll be able to find the Eight Trigrams Valley. Are you sure you don't need to bring anything? What will you eat then?"
This was not the first time Wilda had entered this forest. She knew how dangerous the forest was, so she was reminding Connor out of kindness.
"Do you need anything?"
Connor didn't need to eat, but Yolanda did, so he turned and asked Yolanda.
"I brought some sunscreen and insect repellent spray!"
Yolanda replied.
Wilda looked at Yolanda and was speechless. For a moment, she didn't know what to say.
In such a dangerous environment, Yolanda had only brought sunscreen and insect repellent spray. Was this a joke?
However, Wilda was not in the mood to deal with Connor and Yolanda. She was thinking that the two of them might not have been to such a primitive forest before and did not know how dangerous it was inside. She was too lazy to continue talking and just started walking.
However, after taking a few steps, Wilda turned and shouted at Connor, "It's fine if you don't want to bring anything else, but the two of you should at least bring a tent, right? Otherwise, where are you two going to sleep tonight?"
"It's fine!"
Connor shook his head again.
In fact, Connor had already thought about it. Connor could use his aura to form a barrier. This barrier could not only protect him and Yolanda, but it could also keep them warm. This was much more useful than any tent.
"Why you…"
Wilda was so angered by Connor that she did not know what to say. She could only continue working.
After everyone entered the forest, they saw that the condition inside was indeed very harsh. All kinds of insects, snakes, and spiders could be seen everywhere. Wilda and the others were not afraid of these things, but they were very careful. If they were injured by these poisonous creatures, they might not even have the chance to save themselves.
What they couldn't understand was that those poisonous creatures didn't seem to be interested in Connor and Yolanda at all. They didn't even approach them.
Connor and Yolanda were in a very relaxed state throughout the whole journey.
Only Uncle Cardenas knew that there was a protective aura around the two of them, so the poisonous creatures did not dare to approach them.
However, Uncle Cardenas couldn't understand how terrifying Connor's strength was. He could actually make his aura last for so long. If it was Uncle Cardenas himself, it would only take a few hours at most before the aura in his body would be exhausted. Even an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster would definitely not be able to last so long because the aura of a martial artist was limited.
He didn't know that Connor had the Profound Bead in his body. The Profound Bead could continuously provide aura to Connor.
Otherwise, Connor wouldn't have been able to persist for so long.

chapters.title: Chapter 2095: Work
chapters.content:
Chapter 2095: Work
"These two must have some kind of treasure on them!"
Uncle Cardenas thought about it for a long time. In the end, he could only think of this reason. Otherwise, it would not make sense.
The group walked in the forest for almost seven hours. Wilda and the others finally couldn't hold on any longer and wanted to rest for a while.
Everyone set up their tents and took out the food they had prepared in advance.
Uncle Cardenas wanted to ask Connor and Yolanda to join them, but Wilda recalled Connor's attitude before entering the mountain and stopped Uncle Cardenas. At this moment, Wilda wanted to see how Connor was going to persist in finding the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Of course, Connor didn't need to eat anything. Even if he didn't eat anything for a month or two, it wouldn't affect him.
However, Connor knew that Yolanda needed to eat. Otherwise, she wouldn't be able to carry on with the journey.
"Wait for me here!"
Connor whispered to Yolanda.
"What are you going to do?"
Yolanda hurriedly asked.
"I'll get you something to eat!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"I'm not very hungry now. It's fine!"
Yolanda reached out and tugged at Connor.
"We need to wait for them here. We have nothing to do anyway…"
Connor smiled faintly and then walked into the forest.
Yolanda hesitated for a moment before leaving with Connor.
When Wilda saw Connor leave with Yolanda, she was a little puzzled because she couldn't figure out what these two people were doing.
"Miss Zerbe, the food is ready. Come and eat!"
At this moment, a guard walked up to Wilda and whispered to her.
"Alright…"
Wilda nodded and then started eating with everyone.
On the other side, Connor and Yolanda disappeared for a few minutes before reappearing in front of everyone. Moreover, Connor had a pheasant in his hand.
Connor cleaned up the pheasant and then put it on the fire to roast it.
Yolanda followed Connor with anticipation.
"I didn't expect you to know how to roast pheasants!"
Yolanda said with a smile.
"I used to work in a restaurant, so I learned some barbecue techniques from a chef. However, the ingredients are limited now, so it might not taste that good."
Connor whispered to Yolanda.
"You worked in a restaurant?"
Yolanda was stunned when she heard Connor's words. She was very surprised because she could not imagine why a person like Connor would work in a restaurant.
"I used to work a lot!"
Connor replied indifferently.
A few minutes later, the pheasant was almost ready. Connor handed it to Yolanda.
Yolanda, on the other hand, started eating happily.
Everyone looked at the pheasant in Yolanda's hand with envy. After all, they were eating canned food. It could not compare to the steaming hot pheasant in Yolanda's hand.
"Why is this person so lucky? How did he catch pheasants so quickly?"
Wilda asked with a puzzled look.
"It's not that he's lucky, but that he's capable. Catching pheasants is a piece of cake for him!"
Uncle Cardenas said lightly.
"Uncle Cardenas, what do you mean by that?"
Wilda asked Uncle Cardenas softly after hesitating for a moment.
Uncle Cardenas told Wilda that Connor might be hiding some treasure.
"No wonder this person said that he doesn't need anything. It turns out that he has a treasure on him!" Wilda sighed softly after she realized what was going on.
"Miss, these two people might have other motives for going with us!"
Uncle Cardenas reminded in a low voice.
"So what if he has other motives? Anyway, you're here. At most, you can just kill the two of them!"
Wilda said indifferently.
Uncle Cardenas sighed softly. He felt that it would not be easy for him to kill Connor and Yolanda.
After eating, everyone walked into the forest again.
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed. In these two days, Connor, Wilda, and the others did not communicate much. They just followed behind these people.
Yolanda didn't have a big appetite, so she only ate one meal a day.
Wilda and the others were obviously unable to take it anymore because they did not expect to not find the Eight Trigrams Valley after having walked for two days. They were only left with some bread and compressed food. There was not even canned food left.
Connor went around looking for wild animals for Yolanda. Sometimes it was rabbits, sometimes it was birds, and sometimes it was fish.
At this moment, Connor was roasting fish for Yolanda over the fire.
Although Connor did not have any condiments, Yolanda was not very picky. In addition, to be able to eat such food in such an environment was more than enough. Therefore, Wilda and the others were very envious of Connor's grilled fish.
One of the boys, Weston Yohe, hesitated for a moment before he walked up to Connor and said softly, "Friend, we're all on the same boat. Since Wilda is kind enough to bring you along, do you think it's only right that you offer us some of your food?"
"What?"
Connor raised his head and glanced at Weston as he asked indifferently.
"We don't have much food left, and we can't be eating dry food every day. How about this? I'll give you money, and you help us catch some game."
Weston politely discussed with Connor.
"No, thanks!"
Connor shook his head and refused without thinking.
"Why you!"
Weston didn't expect Connor to be so unreasonable. He was a little angry, and then he gritted his teeth and said, "I can give you a check for 100,000 dollars now. You'll be in charge of catching wild game for us for the next few days!"
100,000 dollars was not a small amount, so Weston felt that Connor did not have any reason to turn him down.
"Didn't you hear me?"
Connor turned to look at Weston and said softly to him.
"What about one million dollars?"
Weston figured that 100,000 wasn't enough, so he increased the amount.
"Forget it. One million is nothing to Mr. McDonald. If you offer five billion dollars, he might consider it!"
Yolanda said coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2096: From the Zerbe Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 2096: From the Zerbe Family
Yolanda knew how capable Connor was. A mere one million dollars was nothing in Connor's eyes.
"Don't forget that we are a team. This forest is very dangerous. If you really encounter any trouble, you will need our help!"
At this moment, Weston was very angry, but he knew that Connor and Yolanda were not to be trifled with, so he did not dare to go too far.
"I highly doubt that! It will be the other way round."
Connor whispered to Weston.
"Alright, I'll remember what you said. Even if you die in this mountain, no one will care about you!"
Weston shouted and turned to leave.
Connor looked at Weston indifferently and didn't say anything.
Yolanda understood Connor's character. Weston and Wilda did not have any conflicts with Connor. As long as Weston humbled himself and had a proper discussion with Connor, Connor might still help them.
But Weston had a haughty attitude and even wanted to use money to bribe Connor. Naturally, Connor would not agree.
To put it bluntly, Weston had not figured out Connor's identity. If he knew Connor's true identity, he would definitely not speak to Connor like this.
Because of this incident, Weston and the others treated Connor even worse. They ignored Connor and Yolanda altogether.
However, this was also a good thing for Connor. After all, Connor really had no use for these people. He only needed a guide to help them find the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Moreover, Connor had also thought things through. If Wilda and the others continued to harass him, he would leave with the guide.
After all, Wilda's guards could not stop Connor.
Fortunately, these people were sensible enough and did not continue to provoke Connor.
Another two days passed.
At this time, Wilda and the others were already very tired. After all, they had already lived in this primeval forest for a full five days.
Even Yolanda couldn't take it anymore.
"I can already feel the formation. We should be able to reach the Eight Trigrams Valley soon!"
Connor turned his head and said to Yolanda.
"Isn't the Eight Trigrams Valley very dangerous?"
Yolanda hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
"I'm not too sure about that. The Eight Trigrams Valley seems to be very big according to the map. It's not easy to find the exact location of the secret treasure in the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
Connor said lightly.
"Then, what should we do?"
Yolanda hurriedly asked.
"It doesn't matter. As long as we can find the Eight Trigrams Valley, we've already narrowed down the area by a lot. At that time, I should be able to use my divine sense to find the exact location of the secret treasure!"
Connor said in a low voice.
"What is divine sense?"
Yolanda blinked and asked with a puzzled expression.
"You will know when the time comes…"
Connor smiled faintly. Then, the smile on his face disappeared instantly. He raised his head and looked ahead.
At this moment, Connor could feel an aura approaching them. The owner of this aura was probably an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster.
This meant that Connor had come to the right place. This ancient martial arts grandmaster was very likely to be here to find the secret treasure.
Uncle Cardenas also seemed to have noticed this aura and hurriedly stopped everyone.
Sure enough, a few seconds later, an old man in linen clothes slowly walked up to everyone.
The old man was thin and weak. He was only about 1.5 meters tall, but his eyes were very sharp.
When Uncle Cardenas saw the old man, he quickly stepped forward and exclaimed, "Junior Cain Cardenas greets Mr. Winters!"
"Oh, it's you. Who are these people behind you?"
The old man seemed to recognize Cain as he replied indifferently.
"Mr. Winters, I'm Wilda Zerbe from the Zerbe family. You've met my grandfather before. I wonder if you still remember!"
Wilda hurriedly explained.
The people behind Wilda looked very nervous. They didn't even dare to look at Mr. Winters.
"So you're from the Zerbe family!"
Mr. Winters nodded thoughtfully. Then, he turned around and left without saying anything else.
After the old man left, everyone eased up a little, and they all let out a long sigh.
"Uncle Cardenas, was that the poison master, Felipe Winters, one of the four great experts of France?"
Weston walked to Uncle Cardenas's side and asked carefully.
"That's right. That person just now was Mr. Winters, the poison master!"
Uncle Cardenas nodded.
"Why is he here?"
"Yeah. Didn't he disappear for many years?"
Everyone seemed to have heard of Mr. Winters before, and they were all confused.
"He isn't a nobody. It's been so many years, and countless people in France have died at his hands. I've heard that the Eight Trigrams Valley holds a secret treasure, but I'm not sure if it's true. However, since he has already appeared, this legend is most likely true…"
After saying that, Uncle Cardenas turned to Wilda and said, "Miss Zerbe, there is surely more danger ahead. Do you want to continue on?"
"Of course, we have to continue. We're all here, and the Eight Trigrams Valley is so close to us now. It would be a shame if we were to leave now!"
Wilda said without thinking.
Seeing that Wilda still wanted to continue moving forward, Uncle Cardenas did not say anything else and led the group forward.
However, after that, they encountered all kinds of experts one after another, making the situation even more peculiar.
It was as if all the masters of France had gathered in this place.
In fact, the development of ancient martial arts in France was very different from that in the Sommervile. Therefore, most of the French ancient martial arts masters came from Sommervile, or their elders came from Sommervile. As such, most of whom they met in the forest were from Sommervile. Moreover, everyone was proficient in the English Language.
Almost all the famous martial artists in France had come to this forest.
At first, they had thought that it was a coincidence that they had encountered Mr. Winters. However, they had encountered so many experts after that. This meant that it was definitely not a coincidence. Moreover, the closer they got to the Eight Trigrams Valley, the more experts there were.

chapters.title: Chapter 2097: The Strange Eight Trigrams Valley
chapters.content:
Chapter 2097: The Strange Eight Trigrams Valley
In France, as long as one was a famous martial artist, they would all come to this forest.
When they encountered Felipe Winters earlier, everyone felt that it was just a coincidence.
But then, they encountered so many experts after that. This meant that this was definitely not a coincidence.
Moreover, as they got closer to the Eight Trigrams Valley, the number of experts also increased.
These people were all above the realm of ancient martial arts grandmasters. In France, where ancient martial arts were not very developed, they were considered a local overlord. Moreover, not only did the masters of France appear, but the ancient martial arts masters of the surrounding countries were also here. Any one of these masters was enough to kill all of Wilda's guards. This also caused Wilda's friends to have a change of perspective.
Although Wilda's family had some influence, and with the existence of Uncle Cardenas, these experts did not attack them when they met them, they were still a little afraid with so many experts appearing around them. They felt that something big must have happened, which was why so many experts were gathered here.
Weston seemed to be a little worried, so he stepped forward and whispered to Wilda, "Wilda, is this a bad timing for us?"
"What do you mean?"
Wilda replied indifferently.
"I feel that something is not quite right with Bamarre Island today. Under normal circumstances, there's no way so many experts would come together. Moreover, the closer we are to the Eight Trigrams Valley, the more experts there seem to be. Something might have happened at the Eight Trigrams Valley…"
Weston said tactfully.
"What do you mean?"
Wilda asked impatiently.
"I just think that this place is a little dangerous. Why don't we go back and come back when we have the chance in the future…"
Weston said helplessly.
"Go back?"
Wilda could not help but sneer when she heard this. Then, she said indifferently, "We've been walking in this forest for five days. If we go back now, won't our previous efforts be in vain?"
"The point is that the Eight Trigrams Valley might really be very dangerous…"
Weston hurriedly said.
"If the Eight Trigrams Valley is dangerous, we won't go in. At the very least, we have to find the Eight Trigrams Valley. Moreover, the Zerbe family has some influence in France. Those experts more or less have to give my grandfather some face."
Wilda paused for a moment and then continued, "Of course, if you want to leave now, I won't stop you. But don't come with me to explore in the future!"
Everyone looked at Wilda with a helpless expression on their faces, but no one really dared to leave.
"Alright, let's not waste any more time. Let's continue walking!"
Seeing that no one was going to leave, she continued walking forward.
Uncle Cardenas didn't want Wilda to continue, but he realized that Wilda seemed to have made up her mind, so he didn't say anything.
At this moment, Connor was also very puzzled. The fact that there was a secret treasure in the Eight Trigrams Valley should not be a secret. After all, the array had long been opened. Many people would have heard this news.
However, what Connor could not understand was that the array formation of the Eight Trigrams Valley's secret treasure should already be closed. Why were there still so many experts here?
'Are these people not here for the secret treasure?'
Connor could not help but wonder.
...
In the blink of an eye, another two days passed. Connor, Wilda, and the others finally found the legendary Eight Trigrams Valley.
In fact, if Connor and Yolanda were to walk this distance, they would have been able to find it in a day at most.
However, Wilda and the others had already been walking in the forest for several days. Their physical strength had long been exhausted, so their speed was very slow.
No matter what, everyone still found the Eight Trigrams Valley in the end.
Connor stood at the entrance of the Eight Trigrams Valley, squinting to observe the situation ahead.
At this moment, Connor and the others were in a large open space. In front of the open space was a valley. The altitude of the valley was very high. Everyone could even see white clouds floating around the valley.
However, Connor was in disbelief because he realized that the aura in the Eight Trigrams Valley was very strange. Moreover, he could also feel that there was indeed a very terrifying array in the Eight Trigrams Valley, but it was difficult for Connor to lock onto the exact location of the array.
The place where the array was should be where the secret treasure was.
Moreover, Connor also realized that the heaven and earth spiritual energy in the Eight Trigrams Valley was very thin, which meant that this array was being maintained by the heaven and earth spiritual energy. Although Connor had not come into contact with this array, he knew that if he wanted to forcefully destroy the array, it would not be possible because this array was a scary thing.
"An array formation from hundreds of years ago still has such terrifying energy. If it was a hundred years ago, how terrifying would it have been?"
Connor could not help but sigh deep down.
"This place is so strange!"
Yolanda seemed to have noticed that the array in the Eight Trigrams Valley was very unusual, so she whispered to Connor.
"It's indeed strange, but what I find strange is that the array has clearly been closed, so why are there so many experts here?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Yeah, does it have something to do with Mr. Yarrell?"
Yolanda said after a moment of hesitation.
"..."
Connor turned and glanced at Yolanda without saying anything.
Just as Connor was talking to Yolanda, Wilda, Weston, and the others were also observing the Eight Trigrams Valley in front of them.
"I didn't expect the Eight Trigrams Valley to be like this!"
Wilda said excitedly.
"Miss Zerbe, we've already seen the Eight Trigrams Valley. We should hurry back!"
Anthony said to Wilda.
"Yeah, Wilda, let's leave now!"
Weston hurriedly added.
"Miss, I feel that there's something wrong with this Eight Trigrams Valley. I suggest that we leave this place!"
Uncle Cardenas, who had been silent all this while, also spoke up.
The most important task for Uncle Cardenas was to protect Wilda. Uncle Cardenas was also an ancient martial arts grandmaster. Although he did not know what happened in the Eight Trigrams Valley, he could feel that the aura in the Eight Trigrams Valley was very strange. This meant that there was danger inside. In addition, they had encountered those ancient martial arts masters along the way, so the best thing to do now was to leave this place as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 2098: The Number One Grandmaster
chapters.content:
Chapter 2098: The Number One Grandmaster
"Even you, Uncle Cardenas?"
When Wilda heard Uncle Cardenas's words, she looked a little helpless.
"It's really dangerous. Wilda, let's go back!"
Weston also advised.
"It wasn't easy for us to find the Eight Trigrams Valley. It would be a shame if we were to go back now. Why don't we go in and take a look? I've always been curious about what's going on in the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
Wilda turned and said to Uncle Cardenas.
"Miss, now is not the time for you to be stubborn!"
Uncle Cardenas said helplessly.
"It took us so much time and effort to get here. Let's go in and take a look. We're just going in to take a look. We're not going to do anything…"
Wilda said coquettishly.
"..."
Uncle Cardenas looked at Wilda and felt a little helpless. He did not know what to say.
"Let's go in!"
Wilda exclaimed and then walked straight into the Eight Trigrams Valley.
However, Wilda suddenly stopped after taking two steps. She turned and looked behind her. She was a little puzzled.
A few seconds later, a middle-aged man in a black robe walked over. The man's aura was very shocking, and he looked tough. Beside the middle-aged man was a young man who looked very handsome and somewhat similar to the middle-aged man.
When Wilda saw the middle-aged man, she became a little excited. Then, she hurriedly shouted, "Uncle Whalen, why are you here? Trevor, you're here too?"
Obviously, Wilda knew this middle-aged man and the handsome young man.
When the middle-aged man saw Wilda, he could not help but be stunned. Then, he said softly, "Wilda? Why are you here?"
"I came here with my friends. We're here to explore!"
Wilda explained softly.
"Explore?"
When the middle-aged man heard this, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. Then, he frowned and said, "Does your father know about this? Aren't you just messing around? This place is very dangerous now, and there are many ancient martial arts masters here. You should leave right away!"
"My father knows about this…"
Wilda whispered.
"Even if your father knows, it won't do. Hurry up and leave!"
The middle-aged man said in a low voice.
"If I hadn't met you, I might have turned back. But since you're here, I definitely won't go back. Uncle Whalen, bring me in to take a look. We've been walking for a few days before we found this place…"
Actually, Wilda was also a little worried before, but when she saw this middle-aged man, she instantly relaxed. This was because she knew that with this middle-aged man protecting her, even a powerful expert would not be able to hurt her.
The middle-aged man was called Stanley Whalen. He was the leader of the four ancient martial arts grandmasters in France. He was even stronger than the poison master, Felipe Winters, they had encountered before.
Stanley and Wilda's father had a very good relationship. The two families had been friends for generations, so Wilda and Stanley were familiar with each other.
"I won't bring you in!"
Stanley said expressionlessly.
"Uncle Whalen, you are the number one grandmaster in France. You are so powerful. With you by my side, what danger can I be in?"
Wilda walked to Stanley's side and gently shook his arm.
"This won't do!"
Stanley shook his head.
Seeing that Stanley refused to bring her in with him, Wilda could only turn and give the handsome young man beside Stanley a look.
"Dad, Wilda must have gone through a lot to get here. If she leaves now, it might be even more dangerous, so we might as well bring her with us. That way, she'll be safer!"
The handsome young man said softly.
"..."
Stanley turned and looked at Wilda. He felt that what the young man said just now was very reasonable. There were many masters outside the Eight Trigrams Valley now. If Wilda was seen by the enemies of the Zerbe family, she would probably be killed. Therefore, it was safer to bring Wilda with him.
"Alright, then follow me!"
Stanley whispered to Wilda.
Hearing Stanley's words, Wilda got a little excited. She quickly said, "Uncle Whalen, you're the best!"
Weston and the others were also very excited. After all, if they had a grandmaster like Stanley by their side, they would have nothing to worry about.
"Although I can bring you in with me, no matter who you meet or what you see, don't talk or walk around casually. Do you understand what I mean?"
At this moment, Stanley suddenly reminded everyone.
After hearing Stanley's words, Wilda was a little puzzled. She said softly, "Uncle Whalen, you're already the number one grandmaster in France. Is there anyone who dares to provoke you?"
"Number one grandmaster of France? It means nothing."
Stanley smiled bitterly after hearing Wilda's words and said lightly, "Right now, there are many experts gathered in the Eight Trigrams Valley. Moreover, these people may be stronger than me. If you really provoke these people, they might not even give me face!"
At this time, Stanley was very serious when he said this. It didn't seem like he was joking at all.
Everyone looked at Stanley and couldn't help but take a deep breath. They didn't expect that there would be a master who was even more powerful than Stanley in the Eight Trigrams Valley.
"Uncle Whalen, what happened in the Eight Trigrams Valley?"
Wilda asked Stanley with a puzzled expression.
"You don't need to know what exactly happened. This is a matter of the ancient martial arts world. It has nothing to do with you."
Stanley said in a low voice.
"Alright, then!"
Wilda nodded very sensibly, then turned and exclaimed, "Alright, you heard what Uncle Whalen said. Keep to yourself in there, understand?"
"Got it!"
"Don't worry, we'll sure keep to ourselves!"
Everyone replied.
Wilda subconsciously glanced at Connor, then pursed her lips and said, "Didn't you hear what I said just now?"
Connor acted as if he did not hear Wilda's words and ignored her.
"Hey, I'm talking to you. Didn't you hear me?"
Wilda shouted at Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2099: Lich
chapters.content:
Chapter 2099: Lich
Connor had already found the entrance to the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Wilda and the others were no longer of any use to Connor.
Therefore, Connor brought Yolanda Yates directly into the Eight Trigrams Valley.
"Hey, what are you doing?"
Wilda shouted.
However, Connor still ignored Wilda.
Stanley looked at Connor up and down, and his expression was a little strange. He frowned and asked Wilda, "Wilda, are these two your friends?"
"No, I just bumped into them by accident!"
Wilda said angrily.
"Oh!"
Stanley nodded lightly and didn't think much about it. After all, his mind was in the Eight Trigrams Valley, and he didn't have the mood to care about anything else.
"Let's go in too!"
Stanley shouted and then walked toward the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Wilda and the others followed closely behind Stanley.
Uncle Cardenas took the initiative to chat with Stanley. Although Uncle Cardenas's realm was not as high as Stanley's, it could be seen that the two of them knew each other, and their relationship was quite good.
Connor, Wilda, and the others walked into the Eight Trigrams Valley one after another.
After entering the Eight Trigrams Valley, everyone continued to walk forward along the narrow mountain road.
About half an hour later, everyone arrived at a large open space. At this time, there were many martial artists gathered in the open space.
These martial artists came alone. At this time, these people seemed to be resting. Everyone had their own territory and did not disturb each other, but they would chat from time to time.
At this moment, these people were very vigilant. They were constantly observing the situation around them because most of them did not know each other, but they had more or less heard of each other's names. Moreover, these people came from different places, and some of them even had grudges between them. However, these people did not come for revenge today, so they did not plan to attack anyone.
"I didn't think that France would be so lively. I heard that the Eight Trigrams Valley is very dangerous. We haven't entered the Eight Trigrams Valley yet, so it isn't too late to regret!"
At this moment, the poison master, Felipe Winters, who had met Connor and the others before, spoke.
"Winters, who are you fooling? We know how dangerous the Eight Trigrams Valley is, but who doesn't know why everyone is here?"
An old man who was about the same age as Felipe, wearing a red robe, and with red hair, beard, and eyebrows, replied coldly.
This old man was also one of the four grandmasters of France. He was known as Martian Lord, but no one knew his real name.
"You're not young anymore, you old Martian. Why are you here?"
Felipe pursed his lips.
"You can come, but I can't?"
Martian Lord said, unwilling to lose to Felipe.
"Alright, stop quarreling. Aren't you tired after having quarreled for so many years? I heard that the Eight Trigrams Valley has a secret treasure left behind by an expert from a hundred years ago. I wonder if this is true?"
However, at this moment, another burly middle-aged man spoke.
This middle-aged man was the last of the four grandmasters of France. He was known as the boxing champion, and his real name was Hugues Klein.
Hugues was the only Frenchman among the four grandmasters of France. The other three, Felipe, Martian Lord, and Stanley, were all from Sommervile.
"It seems that all of you have heard the news!"
Felipe said expressionlessly.
"If we didn't receive the news, why would we come to this lousy place?"
The Martian Lord retorted.
"Everyone must have received the news before coming here, but I've always been curious about one thing. How did this news spread? After all, it's such a big secret treasure. Logically speaking, its location shouldn't have spread so widely. If someone really knew the location of the secret treasure, they would have immediately come to look for it!"
Hugues asked in a puzzled tone.
Such a large-scale secret treasure was very attractive to martial artists. As long as they could obtain some benefits from the secret treasure, it would be very terrifying for their realm advancement. Therefore, even if someone had really discovered the secret treasure, they would come alone to look for it. No one would foolishly release this piece of news and let everyone come and compete with him for this secret treasure.
"I'm also thinking about that…"
Felipe's expression became more serious.
"You can't even figure that out? How ridiculous!"
However, at this moment, a person's voice sounded.
When everyone heard this, they looked at the entrance of the Eight Trigrams Valley and saw a white-haired old man walking over with a young man.
"Here I was thinking who it is. It's Winam's very own Lich!"
When Felipe saw the old man, he couldn't help but sneer. Then he said lightly, "I heard that the Blood Moon Sect in Winam has been wiped out by the Soul Eater. You are considered the number one ancient martial arts expert in Winam now, right?"
"I've never cared about those false reputations!"
Lich replied coldly.
"You don't care?"
Felipe smiled disdainfully.
The others present also revealed looks of disdain.
They did not know Lich's real name, but before the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader went to Winam, Lich had already existed. Furthermore, the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader had fought with Lich the moment he arrived at Winam.
After all, at that time, Winam was still the territory of Lich. He would not allow anyone to compete with him for territory.
But in the end, Lich was defeated, and he disappeared from the ancient martial arts world. No one had ever heard of Lich again.
Now that the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader had been killed by Connor, Lich naturally returned to the martial arts world.
This was also the reason why the experts in France looked down on Lich. However, even if they did, they did not dare to say anything. Even though Lich was not a match for the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader, he was still terrifyingly strong. He was most probably an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster by now.
"Just now, you said that we can't figure this out. Then, have you figured out what's going on?"
Hugues asked Lich.
"Of course!"
Lich nodded and said, "Someone deliberately released this piece of news to attract us!"
"Are you saying that there's a trap here?"
The expression on Felipe's face changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2100: Experts from Everywhere
chapters.content:
Chapter 2100: Experts from Everywhere
"Of course, that's not what I meant…"
Lich waved his hand and said with a smile, "This news is indeed true because Winam also has a treasure map, and the location of the secret treasure marked on the treasure map is in this Eight Trigrams Valley, so the news naturally can't be wrong!"
"Then, why would someone deliberately release this piece of news?"
Martian Lord asked.
"My guess is that this secret treasure is protected by an array formation. The person who released the news couldn't crack the array formation on his own, so he released this piece of news and gathered all of us together to crack the array formation!"
Lich analyzed.
"Isn't he using us, then? When we break the array, he will reap the benefits!"
Felipe said excitedly.
"This is the only explanation that makes sense. However, even if we know that someone is deliberately using us, will anyone want to leave?"
Lich asked with a smile.
Everyone fell silent after hearing Lich's words. What Lich said made sense.
Although they all knew that someone might be using them, under such circumstances, no one was willing to leave this place. Even if most of the treasures in the secret treasure were taken away by experts, they would more or less be able to gain some benefits. Even then, it was worth it.
"Lich, we don't know the purpose of the person who released this piece of news, but since this secret is hidden in the Eight Trigrams Valley of France, we must act according to our French methods!"
Felipe reminded Lich.
"What kind of method does France have?"
Lich asked with a smile.
"The French martial artists have already had a discussion. After three hours, we will enter the Eight Trigrams Valley together, and then everyone will rely on their own strength to find the secret treasure. This way, it is fair for everyone, and we can also avoid unnecessary battles. If you agree to this method, then you can wait here like us until the time is up. If you don't agree to it, then don't blame us for being rude!"
Hugues said in a low voice.
It was no secret that there was a secret treasure in the Eight Trigrams Valley. However, because there were too many martial artists looking for the secret treasure, if these martial artists were allowed to enter the Eight Trigrams Valley, it would definitely be very chaotic.
Therefore, the several grandmasters of France thought of this method after discussing it for a bit.
It was the fairest way for everyone to enter the valley at the same time to search for the hidden treasure.
They couldn't make a move before entering the valley, but as long as they entered the valley, life and death were determined by fate.
This was also the reason why so many experts from all over the world were waiting here. Of course, there were also some who did not follow the rules and were expelled by the crowd.
After all, one person facing so many grandmasters at the same time, unless one was at the pinnacle realm of the ancient martial arts, it was impossible to defeat them.
"I didn't know there's actually such a rule!"
Lich smiled faintly and said softly, "Alright, since this is a rule that everyone has set together, then I can't break it. I'll wait here with you!"
After saying that, Lich found a place to sit down.
The pale-faced and thin young man also sat down with Lich.
"Stanley is finally here!"
At this moment, Hugues looked into the distance and saw Stanley walking toward them with Connor, Wilda, and the others.
Stanley, Hugues, and the others were among the four grandmasters of France. Stanley was also the strongest, but he had the worst relationship with the others. Because of his upright personality, it was difficult for him to become friends with Felipe, Martian Lord, and the others.
After seeing Stanley, no one took the initiative to talk to him.
"Stanley should have already received the news. He knows what to do and won't enter the valley ahead of time, so we don't have to worry about him!"
Martian Lord said softly.
"Stanley actually brought that woman from the Zerbe family here, and there are several ordinary people with him too. What is he up to?"
Hugues was confused when he saw Wilda.
"I met that girl in the forest before. I didn't expect Stanley to bring her along!"
Felipe said lightly.
"The Zerbe family is very influential in France. Moreover, that girl is just an ordinary person. Let's not hurt this little girl!"
Martian Lord said softly.
Everyone nodded in agreement when they heard Martian Lord's words. They then closed their eyes and waited.
At this moment, there were only three hours left before the agreed time to enter the valley. Therefore, everyone seized the time to cultivate and strive to enter the valley in the best state. After all, once they entered the valley, it would definitely be a massacre.
A few martial artists who had a good relationship with Stanley took the initiative to greet him.
Connor and Yolanda were walking at the front, but he suddenly stopped for some reason, so Wilda and the others walked ahead of him.
When Wilda passed by Connor, she seemed to be a little disdainful. She was thinking that Connor had seen so many experts just now and was so scared that he did not dare to walk forward.
But in fact, Connor was using his divine sense to search for the location of the array formation.
A few seconds later, they arrived near the group of ancient martial arts experts.
"Stanley, you know the rules, right?"
Martian Lord said softly to Stanley.
Stanley didn't even look at Martian Lord. He found a secluded spot and sat down, then waited quietly.
At this time, Stanley was very calm, but Uncle Cardenas, Wilda, and Weston Yohe were very afraid.
This was because they did not expect so many French ancient martial arts grandmasters to be here.
'Felipe, Martian Lord, Hugues, and Lich from Winam... What's going on here? Why are they all gathered here?'
Uncle Cardenas looked at these legendary martial artists and could not help but take a deep breath.
Any one of these people was an existence that could shake an area. However, all of them were here today. This meant that something big was about to happen. Otherwise, it was absolutely impossible for these people to appear here at the same time.
"What exactly happened?"
Uncle Cardenas was somewhat famous in the ancient martial arts world and knew a lot of things. However, he had never encountered such a big scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 2101: Is There Something Wrong With His Head?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2101: Is There Something Wrong With His Head?
However, at this moment, Uncle Cardenas was still relatively calm.
As for Wilda, Weston, and the others, they were already completely scared silly at this moment.
They were all stunned, and their faces revealed shocked expressions. They did not know what to do. Previously, they had encountered many experts in the forest, but now that all these experts had gathered, they did not know how to describe their feelings.
Especially after seeing those bizarre-shaped martial artists, they had a newfound fear.
"What... What are these people doing? Why... Why are they all gathered here?"
Weston stammered.
Weston's family was also very influential in France. It was a very powerful family.
However, compared to these people, he was nothing. If these people wanted to kill him, it was as easy as ABC. Moreover, his family could not do anything to these people.
Wilda turned and glanced at Weston. She was speechless.
Wilda was not as scared as Weston.
Since Weston was already in such a state, there was naturally no need to say anything about the others. As for the guards, they were all scared silly at this moment. Each and every one of them stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
"Wilda, let's go over there and rest!"
Trevor Whalen said to Wilda.
"Alright…"
Wilda hurriedly nodded in agreement. It could be seen that Wilda was very nervous too.
"Wilda, you don't have to be so afraid. My father is right there. These people won't dare to do anything to you!"
Trevor said with a gentle gaze.
"Trevor, do you know why these people are gathered here?"
Wilda asked Trevor softly after a moment of hesitation.
"I'm not very sure either. Let's not ask what we shouldn't ask. Let's go to my father!"
Trevor said softly.
"Alright, then…"
Wilda nodded helplessly and followed Trevor to where Stanley was sitting.
When Weston saw that Wilda was about to leave, he carefully followed behind Wilda. When he was walking, he did not dare to make any sound, afraid of angering those martial artists.
When Wilda saw Weston's cowardice, she became even more speechless. For a moment, she did not know what to say.
A moment later, everyone walked to Stanley's side.
However, just as Wilda was about to sit down, she suddenly thought of Connor and hurriedly looked up into the distance.
At this moment, Yolanda and Connor were still standing there motionlessly.
"I thought that he's very capable. Looks like he's just a coward. He's just standing there, not daring to move!"
Wilda sighed in her heart. When she thought of Connor's arrogance from before, she looked down on him even more.
After Connor had used his divine sense to probe for a while, he slowly opened his eyes.
"Mr. McDonald, have you found the exact location of the array formation?"
Yolanda hurriedly asked Connor.
"No…"
Connor shook his head lightly and said in a low voice, "My divine sense is still a little weak. This array is very powerful, so my divine sense can't cover the entire Eight Trigrams Valley. I can't find the exact location of the array!"
"I see!"
Yolanda didn't know what Connor was talking about, but she didn't ask anymore because she knew it wasn't the time to ask.
"Then, what should we do next?"
Yolanda asked Connor.
"We can only enter the valley to look for the array formation!"
Connor replied indifferently and then walked into the valley.
Yolanda followed closely behind Connor.
Although Felipe and the others were people that Wilda and Weston couldn't afford to offend, they weren't worth mentioning in Connor's eyes. Connor chose to ignore them and walked straight ahead.
Wilda also noticed that Connor was planning to enter the Eight Trigrams Valley, and she was a little puzzled.
"Wilda, what is your friend doing?"
Trevor asked with a frown.
"I don't know what he wants to do either…"
Wilda replied helplessly.
"These experts have already discussed it beforehand. They will enter the valley together in three hours. He's not planning to enter early, right? If he really dares to enter the Eight Trigrams Valley, these people will definitely not let him off."
Trevor hurriedly said.
Wilda finally understood why these experts were gathered here when she heard Trevor's words. It turned out that everyone was planning to enter together. Connor entering early would mean that he was provoking these people, and he would definitely be attacked by them.
However, Connor was quite a distance away from the entrance. Moreover, those martial artists did not notice Connor. They were all cultivating with their eyes closed, preparing for the upcoming battle.
Therefore, Wilda hurriedly walked toward Connor and reached out to stop him.
"You can't go in. If you go in, these people will kill you!"
Wilda whispered to Connor.
"Them killing me? How ridiculous!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"How are you still so arrogant…"
Before Wilda could finish her sentence, Connor continued to walk forward. Yolanda followed behind Connor expressionlessly.
"Wilda, is there something wrong with this person's head?"
Trevor said hurriedly when he saw Connor walking forward still.
"I've already stopped him once but he didn't take it seriously. Since he wants to die so badly, then let him die!"
Wilda looked at Connor's back and said angrily.
"But you can't let him go in. He will implicate us if he does this…"
Trevor said through gritted teeth.
Wilda was stunned for a moment. She wanted to catch up with Connor. After all, she did not want to watch Connor die.
However, at this moment, Martian Lord suddenly opened his eyes. He realized that Connor had already walked to a position less than ten meters away from the valley's entrance. He said softly, "Stanley, can you control these kids? What does this person want to do?"
Stanley opened his eyes upon hearing this and saw that Connor was still approaching the entrance of the valley.
"Stop right there. That's no place for you to enter!"
Stanley suddenly stood up and shouted.

chapters.title: Chapter 2102: It's Him?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2102: It's Him?
When Wilda saw this scene, she looked exasperated.
She could not understand why Connor would do this!
As for Connor, it was as if he hadn't heard what Stanley and the others had said. He continued to move forward.
At this moment, Connor's back was facing everyone. Everyone could not see Connor's face clearly at all.
Lich sneered and said, "Looks like someone wants to break the rules you've set. This child is so courageous! His courage is commendable!"
"Stanley, you brought this person here with you. I didn't stop him before, but it seems that he's just an arrogant brat."
Martian Lord shouted coldly.
"Uncle Whalen, hurry up and save Connor!"
Although Wilda didn't like Connor, she still didn't want to see him die in vain. She shouted anxiously.
"How am I supposed to save him now?"
Stanley saw that Connor was only five meters away from the entrance and exclaimed.
If Stanley saved Connor now, he would be making an enemy out of everyone.
"But…"
Wilda was a little helpless when she heard this. For a moment, she did not know what to do.
Stanley brought these people in because of Wilda. If the person who was in trouble was Wilda, Stanley would naturally help her. However, Stanley didn't know Connor. If he was in danger because of Connor, it was obviously not worth it.
Moreover, if Stanley really made a move, those people would think that Connor was provoking everyone under Stanley's orders, which would only make things more complicated.
"Uncle Whalen, can you help me just this once?"
Wilda seemed unwilling to give up on Connor and whispered to Stanley.
"Wilda, it's useless for you to say anything now!"
Stanley said coldly.
It was as if Stanley had already made up his mind not to care about Connor's life or death.
Wilda bit her lip and did not know what to say. She felt very bad for Connor.
"Miss, this person obviously doesn't care about anyone else. There are so many people standing here waiting to enter, but he's insisting on entering early. You tried to stop him, but he doesn't seem bothered, so you don't have to care about him!"
Uncle Cardenas whispered to Wilda.
Wilda turned and glanced at Uncle Cardenas without saying anything.
"If he wants to die, it has nothing to do with us!"
Weston said indifferently.
"Stanley, do you really not care about this kid?"
Martian Lord shouted at Stanley.
"This person has nothing to do with me. What do you want me to do?"
Stanley said expressionlessly.
"Since this person has nothing to do with you, then it's easy to handle. Little Flame, attack them. Leave their corpses intact!"
Martian Lord turned and said to the young man beside him.
"Yes, Father!"
The young man beside Martian Lord nodded lightly.
At this moment, Connor was about to enter the valley. Everyone looked at Connor with disdain, as if Yolanda and Connor were as good as dead in their eyes.
"What a pity. That girl beside that kid is so beautiful!"
"Yeah, this chick looks really good!"
Everyone started to feel sorry for Yolanda.
The young man waved his right hand and a ball of red flames flew toward Connor.
This martial artist was Martian Lord's son, and he was also proficient in the art of fire. He was currently a beginner heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster.
The fireball flew toward Connor at a terrifying speed.
Wilda looked at the fireball that appeared out of thin air, and she looked scared. She secretly marveled at the strength of these martial artists. It was really too terrifying.
Although Wilda wanted to save Connor's life, there was nothing she could do now because there were some things that she could not change.
Just when everyone thought that Connor and Yolanda would be burned to ashes by the fireball, something unexpected happened.
The fireball actually stopped in mid-air when it was about to hit Connor.
For a moment, everyone was stunned.
"What's going on?"
"Yeah, why did the fireball stop?"
"Does the Martian Lord's son not want to kill this person?"
The martial artists there had very puzzled expressions on their faces. Most of them thought that Martian Lord's son wanted to keep Connor alive, so he did not continue to attack.
"What…"
Meanwhile, Little Flame had a puzzled expression on his face. He had no intention of letting Connor off. He did not know why the fireball would suddenly stop in front of Connor!
"Little Flame, what are you doing?"
Martian Lord asked the young man with a frown.
The young man had a helpless look on his face as he said in a low voice, "Father, I don't know what's going on either. It seems that someone has blocked my attack!"
Martian Lord suddenly raised his head and looked at Stanley, then said in a low voice, "Stanley, didn't you say that you didn't care about this person's life or death? Why are you attacking?"
"Since I said that I don't care, it means exactly that. This matter has nothing to do with me!"
Stanley said coldly.
"Then… Then what's going on?"
For a moment, almost everyone was stunned. Confusion was written all over their faces.
Since the young man didn't stop himself, and Stanley didn't do it, did Connor block the fireball attack himself?
"You actually want to kill me with such a mediocre martial arts technique? What a joke!"
However, at this moment, Connor suddenly turned around and looked at everyone expressionlessly.
As everyone was cultivating previously, they did not see how Connor looked.
However, when Connor turned around, everyone saw Connor's true appearance.
Most of the people didn't know Connor, and they were somewhat puzzled.
Meanwhile, Lich was shocked, and his face was filled with disbelief.
"How… How was this possible? It's him?"
Lich shouted with his eyes wide open, his face filled with fear!
"Lich, do you know this person?"
"Yeah, Lich. You know this kid?"
Upon hearing Lich's words, everyone started asking him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2103: Reversal
chapters.content:
Chapter 2103: Reversal
However, Lich was not in the mood to answer these questions.
He hurriedly ran over to Connor and knelt down in front of Connor with a thud. He exclaimed fervently, "Greetings, Lord Soul Eater!"
"Soul Eater?"
"This person is the Soul Eater?"
"How is that possible?"
"Is Lich crazy? How old is this person? How could he be the Soul Eater!"
For a moment, everyone was dumbfounded again. When they heard Lich call Connor the Soul Eater, they were even more puzzled.
Wilda stared at Connor with her big watery eyes. She could not understand what was going on. She could not understand why Lich would suddenly kneel in front of Connor when he was about to die and call him Soul Eater!
"It's really the Soul Eater. I've seen a photo of Lord Soul Eater before!"
At this moment, another martial artist from Winam shouted and hurriedly knelt down in front of Connor.
The name of the Soul Eater had spread far and wide. As long as there was a martial artist, there was no one who did not know of the existence of the Soul Eater. However, very few people had seen the Soul Eater before.
Back then, Connor had caused such a huge commotion in Winam that even Black Tiger had personally apologized to Connor. Because of this, most of the martial artists in Winam had seen Connor's photo and knew that this ordinary-looking young man was the famous Soul Eater.
This was also the reason why Lich could recognize Connor immediately.
Lich had always felt that the Soul Eater was still Winam, so he had long drilled into his memory how Connor looked. He was worried that he would encounter the Soul Eater one day but not recognize him and cause trouble.
However, he had never thought that his first meeting with the Soul Eater would be like this.
Meanwhile, the other martial artists of Winam treated the Soul Eater as a God in their hearts. After all, if Connor had not killed the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader, the martial artists of Winam might still be living under the control of the Blood Moon Sect!
From a certain point of view, Connor was the great benefactor of Lich and the others.
As long as the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader was alive, they would never be able to make a name for themselves.
The martial artists of Winam all knelt in front of Connor. They appeared very pious, as if they had seen a God.
Stanley looked at Connor and suddenly realized something. When he saw Connor before, he felt that he looked familiar because he had seen the photo of the Soul Eater before. However, there were more people back then, and there were many people who looked similar in this world, so Stanley didn't think too much about it.
"I didn't expect this person to really be the Soul Eater!"
For a moment, Stanley didn't know how to describe his feelings. He stood there in a daze.
Although the other martial artists present had never seen Connor's photo, Lich was kneeling down right before their eyes. Connor was definitely the Soul Eater, so they all knelt down.
"This person is actually the Soul Eater. What a close call!"
Felipe Winters couldn't help but gasp. Then he said to Connor, "Lord Soul Eater, I failed to recognize you before. I hope you will forgive me!"
"Lord Soul Eater, please forgive us!"
Hugues Klein naturally realized what was going on and hurriedly chimed in.
Connor looked at the two of them indifferently without saying anything.
After hesitating for a moment, Stanley quickly walked up to Connor and said respectfully, "Lord Soul Eater, I was blind before and didn't recognize you. I hope you will give me another chance!"
No one expected that even Stanley would have such an attitude when facing Connor.
When Wilda saw this happening, she was even more puzzled. She could not understand what was going on. Why did everyone's attitude towardConnor change so much?
"Lord Soul Eater, I was wrong. Please forgive me!"
However, an even more dramatic scene appeared.
The previously arrogant Martian Lord was now kneeling in front of Connor like those ordinary martial artists. He kowtowed to Connor while shouting loudly.
The others didn't offend Connor, but Martian Lord had just asked his son to attack Connor. If Connor were to make a fuss about it, he might die.
Connor looked at Martian Lord calmly.
At this moment, Martian Lord no longer dared to speak. He could only kowtow to Connor like a madman, begging for his forgiveness.
Who would have thought that one of the four great grandmasters of France, Martian Lord, would actually have such a day? From this, one could see how terrifying Connor's identity was.
After Martian Lord kowtowed more than ten times, his forehead was already covered in blood. However, he still had no intention of stopping. He continued to kowtow to Connor.
"What... What is going on?"
Wilda stared at Martian Lord kneeling on the ground with her beautiful eyes, unable to understand why.
"Wilda, shush!"
Uncle Cardenas hurriedly said.
"Uncle Cardenas, who is Connor? Why are these people so afraid of him?"
Wilda hurriedly asked Uncle Cardenas.
Uncle Cardenas took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Miss, this guy is an existence beyond our imagination. Why didn't it occur to me that Connor is the Soul Eater? If I had known Connor's identity earlier, I would have tried to have a good relationship with him no matter what!"
"Who exactly is the Soul Eater?"
Wilda looked very anxious.
After all, Wilda was not a martial artist, so she had never heard of the Soul Eater.
"Miss, I told you some time ago that a very powerful ancient martial arts expert appeared in Winam. This person almost wiped out the entire Blood Moon Sect by himself. Do you still remember?"
Uncle Cardenas said in a low voice.
"Yeah, I guess…"
Wilda nodded.
"That person is the Soul Eater, Connor McDonald!"
Uncle Cardenas continued.
Wilda couldn't help but gasp when she heard Uncle Cardenas's words. She didn't know how to describe her feelings.
"How is that possible? He's actually that expert?"
Wilda still could not believe it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2104: I Won't Blame Those Who Didn't Know
chapters.content:
Chapter 2104: I Won't Blame Those Who Didn't Know
"Since so many people recognize him, it can't be wrong. If it were one person claiming he is the Soul Eater, then it may be an error, but now so many people are saying the same thing!"
