Uncle Cardenas said expressionlessly.
"Even if Connor is the Soul Eater, these people don't need to be so afraid of him, right? No matter how powerful he was, he's no match for Uncle Whalen. Uncle Whalen is an invincible existence!"
Wilda said indignantly.
"How can my father be a match for the Soul Eater?"
Trevor Whalen could not help but laugh bitterly when he heard Wilda's words.
"Trevor, what… what do you mean?"
Wilda was stunned.
"Wilda, you don't understand many things about ancient martial arts. The Soul Eater is terrifyingly strong. He's already at the peak of the heaven rank!"
Trevor said helplessly.
"Is a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster very powerful?"
Wilda blinked.
"My father and Martian Lord are only at the peak of the earth rank. The gap between them and the Soul Eater is very large!"
Trevor explained.
"Even if Connor's realm is higher than Uncle Whalen and the others, they shouldn't be this scared! If they attack together to deal with Connor, then no matter how powerful he is, he will definitely not be their match!"
Wilda was still a little unconvinced and said softly.
"Even if all the martial artists here join forces, they still won't be a match for the Soul Eater. Back then, when the Soul Eater was dealing with the Blood Moon Sect, he faced five earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters by himself. In the end, Connor won, and now, Connor's strength is probably even more terrifying than it was before!"
Trevor paused for a moment before continuing, "I also heard from my father that after the Soul Eater returned to Sommervile, he defeated two heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters in a row. Now, the Soul Eater is considered the number one person in the world of ancient martial arts."
Trevor did not know about the existence of the Land Deities, nor did he know that there were experts at the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts among the Land Deities, in their eyes, the peak of the heaven rank was already the highest realm. That was why they believed that Connor was the world's number one ancient martial artist.
Currently, there were very few martial artists who knew about the secret of the Land Deities.
Most of them were still stuck at the realm of earth rank.
"He's really that powerful?!"
At this moment, Wilda finally could not find any words to refute Trevor.
"He's more than just powerful. He's an invincible existence. Otherwise, why would my father be so polite to him?"
Trevor said softly.
Wilda did not know what to say for a moment.
Weston Yohe and the others were also dumbfounded. They had been looking down on Connor the past few days. Who would have thought that he actually had such a powerful background? Even Stanley was no match for him.
In the eyes of these people, both Martian Lord and Felipe were existences that shook France.
Even the big families they were from were not worth mentioning in front of these grandmasters.
But now, they knew that there was always someone better than them. It was truly remarkable that Connor held such great power, not to mention that he was completely above these people.
Even though Trevor had already made Connor's identity very clear, Wilda and the others still could not accept this fact.
However, the scene in front of them told them that what Trevor had said was most probably true.
"Since he's so powerful, will he take revenge on us?"
Weston stammered.
"Why are you so useless? These people are probably wrong. Connor is definitely not the Soul Eater. If he were the Soul Eater, why would he have entered the forest with us?"
Wilda believed that all of this was a misunderstanding. Connor was definitely not the Soul Eater.
"..."
Uncle Cardenas turned and glanced at Wilda. He sighed softly and did not say anything because he knew that Wilda just could not accept this fact.
"You wanted to kill me just now, right?"
At this moment, Connor finally spoke.
When Martian Lord heard Connor's words, he was so frightened that his entire body trembled. He kowtowed to Connor like a madman.
"Lord Soul Eater, I didn't know your identity before. I've made a dire mistake. Please let me go!"
Martian Lord shouted with a terrified expression.
"I won't blame those who didn't know!"
Connor said lightly.
Martian Lord was stunned when he heard Connor's words. He was a little surprised. He didn't expect Connor to be so easy to talk to.
"But this person attacked me just now, so I have to teach him a lesson!"
Connor slowly raised his head to look at the young man behind Martian Lord.
A strange look flashed across Martian Lord's face. He opened his mouth and was about to speak.
Connor waved his right hand gently, and the fireball that had halted in mid-air in front of Connor flew toward the young man.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
The fireball smashed into the young man's chest.
The young man let out a blood-curdling scream before he was sent flying backward. A huge hole had been smashed open in his chest.
However, the young man was still breathing because Connor had no intention of killing him.
Wilda was unwilling to believe that Connor was the Soul Eater. However, when she saw this scene, she was scared silly. Even if she didn't want to acknowledge it, she knew in her heart that Connor was definitely the Soul Eater.
Those who had questioned Connor's identity before also knew that they had not mistaken him for someone else.
After all, this young man was also an ancient martial arts grandmaster, but he was so vulnerable in front of Connor. From this, one could see how terrifying Connor's strength was.
"This person wanted to kill me just now, so I taught him a small lesson. You don't have any objections, right?"
Connor asked Martian Lord softly.
Martian Lord took a deep breath and hurriedly said, "My Lord, you are a magnanimous person and have even spared my son's life. I don't dare to have any resentment in my heart. Thank you for showing mercy!"
Originally, Martian Lord thought that Connor would kill his son. However, Connor didn't. Therefore, he was grateful.
"You're quite sensible!"
Connor said lightly.
"Thank you, Lord Soul Eater!"
Martian Lord kowtowed to Connor once again, and the expression on his face softened slightly.
Although his son was seriously injured, this was the best possible outcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 2105: Colton Walther
chapters.content:
Chapter 2105: Colton Walther
"Can I enter the Eight Trigrams Valley now?"
Connor ignored Martian Lord and asked the others expressionlessly.
"Of course!"
"We have no objections!"
"Lord Soul Eater, you can enter whenever you want!"
The experts there hurriedly shouted.
"Since Lord Soul Eater is here for the secret treasure, then we won't go in and cause trouble. You have the right to take the secret treasure. No one will fight for it with you!"
Stanley also hurriedly said.
Upon hearing Stanley's words, Wilda was very upset, but there was nothing she could do. After all, even Stanley was afraid of Connor. What could she do to Connor?
"That's right! This secret treasure belongs to you, Lord Soul Eater. After you're done exploring the area, it won't be too late for us to go in and take a look!"
Felipe quickly followed suit.
Although the secret treasure in the Eight Trigrams Valley was very tempting to these people, they also knew that staying alive was the most important thing. If anyone were to say that they wanted to compete with Connor for this secret treasure, it was no different from asking to die.
Therefore, everyone could only let Connor enter the Eight Trigrams Valley first and wait for him to leave before they entered.
This way, they could avoid conflict with Connor.
"How did you know about the secret treasure?"
Connor asked everyone softly.
If one or two martial artists knew about this, Connor wouldn't find it strange. After all, Jorge Yarrell had come because he had received the news. But now, there were so many people here. Something didn't feel right.
"Actually, the news of the secret treasure in the Eight Trigrams Valley has spread throughout the entire ancient martial arts world. Most people have received the news. We were all curious, so we came to see if there were any secret treasure here!"
Felipe explained with a smile.
"Then, do you know where this news came from?"
Connor asked softly.
"No…"
Everyone shook their heads.
Connor looked at the expressions on everyone's faces and seemed to be even more puzzled.
This was because he knew that the hidden array was opened long ago. This meant that even if someone could find the hidden array, they would not be able to enter because the array was now closed.
However, someone had purposely spread the news about it. Connor felt that the person who had done it had certain motives.
"..."
Even if he asked them, it would probably be very difficult to get anything out of these people. It was better to go in and investigate!
Connor walked toward the entrance of the Eight Trigrams Valley.
However, at this moment, an extremely powerful aura flew toward Connor.
Connor suddenly turned to take a look. Then, he gently waved his right hand and negated the attack.
"What... What's going on?"
When everyone saw this scene, they all revealed puzzled expressions. Because they did not attack, and they did not know where this aura came from.
Of course, Connor also knew that it wasn't the martial artists present who did it, because the aura just now was very terrifying. The person was most probably a heaven-rank ancient martial artist grandmaster, and the strongest among these people was only an earth rank.
"Come out, stop hiding!"
Connor shouted in a low voice.
"Hahaha, I've finally found you!"
A loud laugh came from the sky.
Everyone looked up and saw a black dot flying toward them at a terrifying speed.
In the blink of an eye, a white-haired old man in a white robe appeared in front of everyone.
The white-haired old man stood a hundred meters above the ground and looked down at everyone. He gave off the feeling that he was like a God.
When Wilda saw the white-haired old man, her beautiful eyes were filled with disbelief. This was because it was her first time seeing someone fly in the sky.
"Heaven rank… A Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
When Stanley saw the old man, he was a little shocked.
This was because he could feel that the old man's aura was clearly many times stronger than his own. This meant that the old man's strength was phenomenal. Stanley himself was a peak earth-rank ancient martial artist, so this old man was definitely a heaven-rank ancient martial artist.
"Why is there another heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster?"
Martian Lord asked with a puzzled expression.
Before Connor appeared in the ancient martial arts world, many people thought that heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters did not exist. No one could break through to the heaven rank.
However, at this moment, there were now two heaven ranks here. It was really unbelievable.
"It's the Undying Sun Sect's Senior Colton Walther!"
Someone recognized the white-haired old man in the sky.
"How is that possible? Mr. Walther has disappeared for decades. How is he still alive?"
"Yeah. Isn't Mr. Walther already dead?"
Everyone seemed to be surprised by the old man's identity.
"I'm sure of it. It's Senior Walther!"
Lich said with a trembling voice.
"It really is Mr. Walther!"
Stanley took a deep breath. He didn't expect this secret treasure to be so attractive that it had even attracted Colton, who had disappeared for many years.
Colton was very famous in the ancient martial arts world back then. He had terrifying strength and even founded the Undying Sun Sect. The influence of the Undying Sun Sect in Winam back then could even be compared to the Blood Moon Sect. The sect that Lich belonged to was a branch of the Undying Sun Sect.
However, Colton had disappeared for many years. Most people thought that he was dead, and the Undying Sun Sect had gradually fallen into desolation because of his disappearance. In the end, it was replaced by the Blood Moon Sect.
Yet here he was alive and kicking!
"Colton Walther?"
Connor's eyes narrowed, and he looked at the old man in the sky. He had never heard of this name. There should not be any conflict between him and Colton.
Connor could feel that Colton was a genuine heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster.
"Are you from the Land Deity?"
Connor asked Colton softly.
"Yes!"
Colton looked at Connor and nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2106: Immortal Wind Sect's Sect Leader
chapters.content:
Chapter 2106: Immortal Wind Sect's Sect Leader
Hearing this, Connor instantly knew what was going on.
Colton was not here for the treasure. He was here to kill him.
"Connor, you gravely injured the experts of the Land Deities. I've been ordered to take your life!"
Colton whispered.
When everyone heard Colton's words, they all revealed puzzled expressions because they thought that Colton was here for the secret treasure, but they didn't expect Colton to actually have a personal grudge with Connor.
"Stanley, it seems that there will be a big battle between the Soul Eater and Mr. Walther today. Who should we choose?"
Martian Lord knew that Stanley was the strongest among them. Although he had never liked Stanley, they had to make a choice.
"I'm more optimistic about the Soul Eater winning!"
Stanley said lightly.
"I think so too. If we can use this opportunity to close the gap between us and the Soul Eater, it might be more useful than finding the secret treasure!"
Hugues Klein nodded lightly.
"Since you all think so, then I have no objections!"
Martian Lord said in a low voice.
It was obvious that they were discussing who they should help if they were to really fight.
Although they could choose not to help anyone, this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to get on the good side of a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Of course, they were not willing to miss out.
After a simple discussion, everyone felt that helping Connor was the best choice.
This was because they were not sure about Colton's strength, but they knew how strong Connor was.
Since Connor was able to kill Walter Collier and defeat Yanni Boston, this was enough to prove how terrifying Connor's strength was.
Of course, Lich wanted to help Colton, but everyone wanted to stand on Connor's side, so he was too embarrassed to say anything. At most, he would just watch the show and not participate in today's battle.
Wilda, Weston Yohe, and the others weren't sure what was going on because it was difficult for ordinary people to understand these things between martial artists. They were still immersed in the fact that Colton could fly in the sky.
"You've been ordered to kill me?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Colton's words. Then, he sized up Colton and said softly, "Since you're a member of the Land Deities, you should know how strong I am. Do you think you can kill me alone?"
Seeing Connor's confidence, Stanley was even more certain that his speculations were right.
Connor's strength was definitely above Colton's.
"Hahaha…"
Colton laughed loudly and said indifferently, "I didn't expect that after so many years, a genius like you would appear in Sommervile. You're already a heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster at such a young age. Your strength is above Yanni Boston's, and now you have the help of the Profound Bead. I admit that I'm definitely not your match if I fight alone, but what if I have assistance?"
"What? Mr. Walther actually has assistance from someone else?"
Stanley gasped.
"Looks like he came prepared this time!"
Martian Lord hurriedly added.
"If the person helping him is an earth-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, then it doesn't change anything. After all, the few of us here can handle him. However, if there's another heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, then things will get sticky!"
Hugues said in a low voice.
"Don't joke around. Do you think that heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters can be found just anywhere? Having three to five heaven ranks in this world is already something that's remarkable. How could there be so many heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters? If everyone can advance to heaven rank so easily, what about my hard work over the years?"
Felipe pursed his lips.
"Yeah. Heaven ranks are still very rare. There's no way the person helping Mr. Walther is a heaven rank!"
Stanley said lightly.
However, at this moment, a helicopter appeared in the sky.
Everyone knew that Colton's assistance had arrived, so they all looked up at the sky.
A moment later, the door of the helicopter slowly opened, and a middle-aged man in a black suit appeared in everyone's sight.
"Who is he?"
"I don't think I've seen him before."
"He seems like a big shot!"
Everyone started discussing in low voices.
"Sect Leader Wilcox, you're late!"
Colton said lightly after seeing the middle-aged man.
"My apologies. I haven't returned to France for so many years. I just went to see a few friends and got delayed."
The middle-aged man replied softly and jumped down from the helicopter.
When everyone saw this scene, they were a little shocked. After all, he had jumped from so high up. If it were them, they would have already fallen to their deaths.
However, to everyone's surprise, the middle-aged man landed steadily on the ground without making a sound.
Colton also slowly landed on the ground like an immortal.
At this moment, the two of them were standing in front of Connor.
Everyone could finally see how the middle-aged man looked. However, when they saw the middle-aged man, they were all dumbfounded. They stood rooted to the ground, not knowing how to describe their feelings.
"It's Soloman Wilcox!"
"It's really Soloman Wilcox!"
"Oh my God, why is he back?"
"How unbelievable…"
Everyone started discussing in low voices.
Wilda's eyes were even more puzzled. She whispered to Uncle Cardenas who was beside her, "Uncle Cardenas, why does this name sound so familiar? Who is Soloman Wilcox?"
"Miss, this person is the famous Immortal Wind Sect's sect leader, Soloman Wilcox!"
Uncle Cardenas said helplessly.
"He... He's the Immortal Wind Sect's sect leader?"
Wilda was stunned. She was utterly shocked.
"He's the Immortal Wind Sect's sect leader?"
Weston seemed to know this person as well. He could not help but gasp.
Colton's influence in Winam might be terrifying, but not many people in France knew him.
However, Soloman was different. Back then, the sphere of influence of the Immortal Wind Sect in France was rather terrifying. France had lived under the rule of the Immortal Wind Sect. However, for some unknown reason, Soloman left France with the people of the Immortal Wind Sect and went to other countries to develop.

chapters.title: Chapter 2107: The Lunsford Family
chapters.content:
Chapter 2107: The Lunsford Family
Even so, the Immortal Wind Sect had a terrifying influence in France.
Moreover, it was a top-tier organization. It was a very famous assassin organization. Countless people died at the hands of the sect every year.
This was also why Wilda was so shocked when she found out about Soloman's identity.
In many people's eyes, Soloman was a legendary figure. Many people had heard about him, but no one had seen him before.
"Sect Leader Wilcox is also a heaven rank, right?"
Martian Lord said in a low voice.
"I didn't expect two heaven ranks to come. Things are not looking good for Mr. McDonald!"
Hugues was clearly wavering.
"Why don't we just stay out of this? Although this opportunity is rare, if Mr. McDonald loses, we might also be implicated!"
Felipe said with a frown.
"Don't be anxious. We can observe the situation before making a decision!"
Stanley said expressionlessly.
When everyone heard Stanley's words, they took a deep breath and looked at Connor. No one continued talking.
Meanwhile, Connor was very calm. Although he didn't know Soloman, he knew that this person was a member of the Land Deities, and he was also a heaven rank.
Yolanda Yates seemed to be a little nervous because she knew that Connor had just woken up. If he fought with these people, Connor's body might have to bear a greater burden. Therefore, Yolanda wanted to persuade Connor to leave, but she couldn't find a suitable opportunity to tell him.
"If the two of you were standing in front of me a month ago, I might not have been a match for the two of you. But now, it's still impossible for the two of you to kill me!"
At this moment, Connor spoke again.
"Ah, such confidence. If it were an ordinary person who encountered the two of us, they would probably be scared out of their wits."
Soloman chuckled.
"I know that there's one more person. Come on out!"
Connor replied indifferently.
When everyone heard Connor's words, they were dumbfounded. After all, heaven ranks were such rare beings. Yet now there was a third one!
"What is going on here?"
"Tell me about it. When did the martial arts world change so much?"
"It's over. The Soul Eater might be in danger this time. There are three heaven ranks going up against him. What a terrifying lineup!"
"But the Soul Eater doesn't seem very nervous now!"
"What's the use of him being nervous now? It's not like he can kneel down and beg for mercy, right?"
"Today, we can finally watch a good show…"
These martial artists all thought that Connor would win today, but when they found out that there were three heaven ranks, they were no longer sure.
Stanley was frowning at this point. He knew that if there were really three heaven ranks, then Connor would definitely lose. If he continued to meddle in other people's business, he would be implicated.
"Let's just watch the show in peace!"
Martian Lord said in a low voice.
"That's right, it's better not to be a busybody right now!"
Hugues nodded.
Just as everyone was talking, another middle-aged man walked over.
Compared to Colton and Soloman, this middle-aged man looked the weakest. However, he was the strongest among the three of them.
The middle-aged man was carrying a long sword on his back. When everyone saw this middle-aged man, they were somewhat puzzled.
This middle-aged man was not as famous as Colton and Soloman, so many people did not know this middle-aged man.
"And who are you?"
Connor asked the middle-aged man softly.
"I am Yago Lunsford!"
The middle-aged man replied.
Everyone was confused when they heard Yago's name. It was as if they had never heard of this person before.
"The Lunsford family that uses swords!"
Stanley gasped.
"Is he a descendant of the Lunsford family?"
Martian Lord quickly added.
"I think so. Only the Lunsford family can produce such an expert!"
Felipe said.
Ordinary martial artists might not know about the Lunsford family. They could not even find any experts in the ancient martial arts world with the Lunsford name.
However, Stanley, Felipe, and the others knew that there had always been a hidden ancient martial arts family in Sommervile, and the family head of this family was surnamed Lunsford.
Stanley and the others had only heard some rumors about the Lunsford family. They had never come into contact with the Lunsford family, but they knew that the family existed. Moreover, the middle-aged man who had appeared was very likely from the Lunsford family.
"I didn't expect that even a large family like the Lunsford family, which has been in seclusion for a hundred years, would make a move. What kind of trouble did the Soul Eater cause?"
"I don't know what trouble the Soul Eater has caused, but the Soul Eater might really die today!"
Hugues sighed softly.
There were three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters standing in front of Connor!
For so many years, the ultimate dream of countless powerhouses was to become a heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. From this point, one could see how terrifyingly strong a heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster was. Some people even thought that heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters did not exist.
However, three of them appeared in succession.
If Connor was included, that would be four.
The battle between four heaven ranks was simply unprecedented. Once this got out, it would definitely cause an uproar in the entire ancient martial arts world.
"I didn't expect that the Land Deities to think so highly of me. There are actually three of you here to deal with me!"
Connor looked at the three people in front of him and said slowly.
"We have to be careful when dealing with people like you!"
Colton replied with a smile.
"Aren't you Land Deities always worried about being discovered by ordinary martial artists? But today, you sent three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters to deal with me. Even if the three of you kill me, the secret of the Land Deities will probably be announced to the world. Aren't you worried anymore?"
Connor asked in confusion.
For so many years, the Land Deities had been hiding its existence because they were worried that ordinary martial artists would find out about the secret of the pinnacle of ancient martial arts.
But today, the Land Deities was causing such a huge commotion. Even if Connor died, this secret would still be leaked.
This was clearly not the style of the Land Deities!

chapters.title: Chapter 2108: Hope
chapters.content:
Chapter 2108: Hope
"You don't have to worry about that. After killing you, we will kill everyone here. This way, no one will know our secret!"
Soloman said calmly.
It was as if the lives of the martial artists there were not lives at all.
"Kill us all?"
Stanley was stunned.
"The three of them do seem to have the capability to do so!"
Martian Lord gritted his teeth.
One of the martial artists realized that something was wrong and turned around to run out of the valley.
Colton waved his right hand lightly, and the martial artist's body exploded instantly. Fresh blood spurted out, and his arms, legs, and internal organs were scattered all over the ground.
When everyone saw this scene, they were all scared silly. They stood rooted to the ground, not knowing what to do.
Wilda and the others didn't even think that they would be in danger.
"What are these people doing? How... How can you kill people just like that?"
Wilda looked at the blood on the ground. Her delicate body trembled slightly, but she held back the urge to throw up. Her legs were weak.
She was just a rich young lady. When had she ever seen such a scene?
"It's over for us. We will die here today! It's over..."
Weston Yohe sat on the ground, paralyzed. He was extremely terrified.
The others reacted the same way. After all, they could not face death head on, let alone accept the fact that they were about to be killed.
"Wilda, think of something!"
Weston pulled Wilda and said.
"What can I do?"
Wilda replied speechlessly.
"Don't we have Mr. Whalen? He will definitely protect us, right?"
Weston looked at Trevor Whalen as he spoke.
Trevor was also scared silly. He took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "My father can't even protect himself now. Do you think he can protect us?"
Everyone fell into despair when they heard Trevor's words.
No one had expected that today's situation would involve all of them.
"Wilda, I told you not to come in here, but you insisted. What should we do now?"
Weston shouted at Wilda.
When Wilda heard that, she looked a little helpless and said in a low voice, "What's the point in blaming me now? We're all going to die soon!"
"Knowing you is the worst thing that has ever happened to me!"
Weston shouted at the top of his voice and then continued, "If it weren't for your family's wealth, I wouldn't have come on an adventure with you!"
When Wilda heard Weston's words, she was instantly stunned. She was shocked. If it wasn't for what happened today, Wilda might not have heard these words ever.
Only under such circumstances would Weston have the courage to say those words just now. Otherwise, he would definitely not dare to speak to Wilda like that.
Wilda's family was considered one of the top families in France. This also led to Wilda being a princess from the moment she was born. No matter where she was, she was always the center of attention.
That was why she was so shocked when she heard Weston's words just now.
The others present also started blaming Wilda. In their eyes, if it were not for Wilda, they would not be in such a dangerous situation. Moreover, Wilda had bullied them many times over the years, so these people wanted to take this opportunity to vent their anger.
"..."
Wilda stood rooted to the ground in a daze as she listened to what those people were saying to her. She never expected that these people would actually show their true colors like that.
"Alright! Shut up!"
However, Uncle Cardenas couldn't stand it anymore. He frowned and scolded everyone.
When everyone heard Uncle Cardenas's words, they were all stunned, but they did not dare to speak.
The reason was very simple. After all, under such circumstances, these people were definitely not afraid of Wilda because there was a high possibility that they would die here. Therefore, Wilda could no longer pose any threat to them, but Uncle Cardenas was different.
Although Uncle Cardenas's strength could not be compared to Connor and the others, if Uncle Cardenas wanted to kill ordinary people like them, it would be very easy.
Therefore, when Weston heard Uncle Cardenas's words, he clearly calmed down a lot. Then, he looked at Connor.
At this moment, Weston suddenly thought of something. How terrifying was Connor's strength to be able to attract so many experts to surround and attack him alone?
It wasn't just Weston who was thinking about that. Everyone seemed to be thinking about the same question!
Soloman, Colton, Yago!
Everyone knew how terrifying the strength of these three people was. Let alone three heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters, even three earth ranks were enough to make people shudder. Moreover, these people had previously thought that heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters did not exist.
If the three of them really attacked together, they might really have the ability to destroy the world.
This was the most terrifying part!
Other than Yago, the three of them were all really influential!
"Stanley, what should we do now?"
"Yeah, Stanley. Figure something out!"
Previously, the martial artists there were indifferent to the situation. After all, Connor's matter did not have much to do with them.
However, these people did not expect that they would accidentally hear a shocking secret, and this secret would bring them a fatal disaster. Therefore, everyone was very nervous.
Previously, when the person tried to escape, he was almost instantly killed.
And that person was a beginner heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Compared to many of the people present, he was considered to be above average.
A beginner heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster could be killed so easily. If it were a lower rank martial artist, they wouldn't even have the chance to escape.
Therefore, at this time, everyone could only pin their hopes on Stanley. After all, Stanley had the highest realm among these people. They hoped that Stanley could think of a way.

chapters.title: Chapter 2109: A Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 2109: A Request
However, at this time, Stanley's face was dark.
He too had no other choice. The only option was to place his hopes on Connor.
If Connor could defeat these three people today, they might still have a chance to escape. However, if Connor were to lose, then they would all die.
However, everyone present knew that it was simply a fool's dream to rely on Connor's strength alone to defeat these three people.
No matter how powerful Connor was, he could not possibly be a match for these three people!
If it was under normal circumstances, these people would just be watching the show. They would not be worried about Connor's safety at all because they did not have much connection with Connor.
But now, Connor's life and death might affect their lives, so everyone was nervous.
"I have a conflict with Yanni Boston from the Land Deities, but you don't have to mobilize so many people to surround me, right?"
At this moment, Connor suddenly asked Soloman, Colton and Yago.
Connor knew that although Yanni was also a member of the Land Deities, it was obviously unreasonable for the pinnacle ancient martial arts experts of the Land Deities to mobilize so many people just because of this matter.
Moreover, the Land Deities had to bear the risk of exposing their secrets.
"You're right. If it was just because of Yanni, we wouldn't have made such a big fuss. After all, Yanni is only a heaven rank. There are many heaven ranks among us Land Deities."
Soloman looked at Connor and nodded.
When everyone heard Soloman's words, they were all shocked. Their eyes were filled with disbelief. A heaven rank was so insignificant in Soloman's eyes. It was even common among the Land Deities.
Everyone could not help but secretly guess how terrifying this so-called Land Deities was.
"There are actually two reasons why the three of us came to kill you today. The first reason is that we were entrusted by someone to kill you. The second reason is that you are a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, so we can't let you live in this world!"
Colton didn't hide anything from Connor and said very frankly.
When Connor heard Colton's words, he couldn't help but smile lightly. Because he already knew what Colton meant by his words. He also knew that the three people attacking him today had a great deal to do with Rockefeller.
Life would not go according to all of our whims and fancies.
Although Connor had no intention of attacking Rockefeller, they would definitely not allow Connor to continue living in this world.
The battle between Connor and Rockefeller would never end unless one of them died.
"But we can give you a chance now!"
Soloman looked at Connor and said.
"Give me a chance?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Soloman's words. Then, he asked with a smile, "What chance?"
"It's very simple. As long as you can win and join us, we will not only provide you with the best, but we can also let go of our past grudges and spare your life. We can even help you resolve the conflict between you and Rockefeller!"
Soloman responded.
"Connor, the Land Deities has never proposed such a condition. You are the first person to enjoy such treatment. Moreover, the Old Immortal is very interested in your talent. If you really join us, I guarantee that your future will be limitless!"
Colton said.
Everyone appeared to be a little nervous after hearing Colton's words. This was because they also knew that the conditions that the Land Deities had given Connor were indeed difficult to turn down. Moreover, the Land Deities was the largest martial artist organization in the world. If Connor turned them down, he would die. However, if he agreed to it, he would rise to the top. No one would turn down such conditions.
However, if Connor agreed, then they might be in trouble today. They would lose their last trace of hope.
Wilda looked at Connor with a nervous expression on her face. She had never thought that her fate would be in the hands of this man.
If it was someone else, Wilda might be able to accept it however unwilling. However, this man was Connor, whom Wilda hated a lot. At this moment, she was feeling very complicated.
"You want me to join the Land Deities?"
Connor looked at Soloman with a faint smile and said expressionlessly, "I can join the Land Deities, but I have a request!"
"What request? Tell us now. As long as it's not too much, we can agree to it!"
Yago, who had been silent all this while, suddenly spoke up.
Connor could tell that among the three of them, Yago, who was the least famous, had the most terrifying strength and the most authority.
This time, the mission of the three of them was to kill Connor, but if they could get Connor to join the Land Deities, that would be even better.
Therefore, the three of them sincerely wanted to negotiate with Connor. They wanted Connor to join the Land Deities.
"Actually, my request is very simple. As long as you help me get rid of Rockefeller, I'll join you!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
Soloman, Colton, and Yago were stunned when they heard Connor's words. The three of them looked at each other.
"That's too big a request. We can't agree to it!"
Yago shook his head at Connor.
"If that's the case, then let's stop talking nonsense!"
Connor said coldly.
Everyone looked at Connor with a shocked expression because they didn't expect him to be so unyielding. The other party had clearly made a very tempting offer, but Connor didn't seem to have any intention of surrendering. It was rather inconceivable.
"He really plans to deal with these three people alone? Is he crazy?"
Wilda's big, watery eyes widened, as if she couldn't understand Connor's decision.
"Fortunately, Connor is a madman. If he wasn't an arrogant madman, we would have had to die!"
Uncle Cardenas said expressionlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2110: Blessing
chapters.content:
Chapter 2110: Blessing
When everyone heard Uncle Cardenas's words, they were all stunned. No one dared to say anything else.
"Connor, we have already given you a chance. If you choose to turn us down, don't blame us for what's about to happen…"
Soloman said expressionlessly.
"You talk too much nonsense. If you want to make a move, then hurry up and make a move!"
Connor replied softly.
"Haha…"
Soloman looked at Connor and sneered. Then, he released the aura in his body.
After sensing the aura in Soloman's body, everyone revealed a terrified expression because Soloman's strength was way too terrifying.
At this moment, Colton and Yago released their auras as well.
The aura of the three filled the entire valley.
The three of them had already erupted with such a terrifying aura before they even made a move. If they were to fight later, how terrifying would their power be!
Therefore, everyone could not help but look at Connor, feeling bad for him.
"Three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters working together, this is something that has never happened before in Sommervile!"
"Yeah, we used to think that heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters didn't exist!"
"Connor is the Soul Eater. Although he has the ability to defeat the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader, he's facing three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters alone. The Soul Eater is doomed this time!"
"If the Soul Eater dies, we might all be in danger!"
Everyone could not help but discuss softly.
Stanley, Lich, Martian Lord also had ugly expressions on their faces. They didn't know what to do.
"Stanley, should we attack?"
Martian Lord asked Stanley in a low voice.
"They have three heaven ranks, and we are earth ranks. Even if we attack, I'm afraid we won't be of much help!"
Stanley said dejectedly.
Only now did he realize how weak he was!
If they were in France, Stanley and the others were great existences. A simple stomp of their feet could cause an earthquake in France. However, in front of Connor and the others, they were no different from ordinary martial artists. They were like ants. If Soloman and the others wanted to kill them, they could do it with a flick of their fingers.
When Connor sensed the aura of Soloman and the others, he sneered and said indifferently, "If it was a month ago, I might not have been a match for the three of you. But now, even if the three of you join forces, you're not a match for me!"
"Connor, you're way too arrogant!"
Colton shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
"Today, I'll use the heads of the three of you to warn the people of the Land Deities. I'll let them know that I am not someone to be trifled with."
Connor said in a low voice.
"I want to see if you have the ability to do so today!"
Yago said coldly.
Yago charged toward Connor with a white sword in his hand.
Soloman and Colton didn't waste any more time and attacked together.
Previously, the aura released by these three people was already unbearable for the martial artists present. Now that these three people were attacking at the same time, the aura that erupted was even more terrifying. Many martial artists could not withstand the pressure of the aura of the three people.
The aura of the three people filled the valley at the same time. It was an indescribable feeling.
Wilda, Weston, and the others were pale, and their bodies were trembling.
"Wilda, are you alright?"
Stanley turned and asked Wilda.
"Uncle Whalen, I feel like a huge mountain is pressing down on me!"
Wilda said these words with great difficulty.
"The aura of a heaven rank is indeed not something that ordinary people like you can withstand…"
Stanley replied in a low voice, then turned to look at the Eight Trigrams Valley and said in a low voice, "The Eight Trigrams Valley is protected by an array formation. Follow me into the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
Stanley knew that Soloman and the others had been watching them. If they were to leave now, they would definitely be killed by Soloman and the others. Therefore, they could only choose to hide in the Eight Trigrams Valley and seek the protection of the array in the Eight Trigrams Valley.
"Alright…"
Wilda nodded gently and followed Stanley and the others into the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Weston and the others did not dare to stay there. They hurriedly followed Wilda to the valley.
However, Wilda suddenly stopped when she was about to enter the valley. Then, she turned to look at Connor with a very worried expression.
"Uncle Whalen, do you think Connor is a match for these people?"
Wilda whispered to Stanley.
"Connor is the famous Soul Eater, and he is terrifyingly strong. Even the strongest martial artists in France are no match for him. Unfortunately, Soloman and the others are all heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters, so unless Connor is at the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts, he is no match for these three people today!"
Stanley analyzed calmly.
Upon hearing Stanley's words, Wilda seemed to be even more worried, and her delicate body trembled slightly.
Stanley turned to look at Wilda and whispered to her, "Wilda, you don't have to be too nervous. After the battle, I will help you plead for mercy. Soloman and the others might give me some face. It shouldn't be a big problem for them to let us go!"
The Zerbe family was quite influential in France. In addition, Stanley had some interactions with these people. At most, he would just have Soloman and the others erase their memories today.
"I'm not worried about my own safety!"
Wilda said in a low voice.
"If you aren't worried about your safety, then are you worried about the Soul Eater?"
Stanley was stunned for a moment before asking.
Wilda turned and looked at Stanley without saying anything.
Stanley was confused because he thought that Connor and Wilda didn't have a good relationship. He didn't expect Wilda to be worried about Connor.
"Alright, it's useless for you to worry now. We can't help him. It's better to enter the Eight Trigrams Valley with me. Otherwise, if they really fight, we might all be in danger!"
Stanley was not in the mood to talk nonsense with Wilda. He then dragged Wilda into the Eight Trigrams Valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 2111: Three People Attacking
chapters.content:
Chapter 2111: Three People Attacking
After entering the Eight Trigrams Valley, Wilda subconsciously turned her head to look at Connor.
She silently prayed for Connor.
After seeing Stanley enter the Eight Trigrams Valley, the other martial artists also ran into the valley.
Because they knew that if Connor really fought with these three people, then they would definitely be instantly killed by the aftershock of the battle.
All the martial artists then entered the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Only Connor, Yolanda Yates, Soloman, Colton, and Yago were left in the open space in front of the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Connor hesitated for a moment before he whispered to Yolanda, "Follow them into the Eight Trigrams Valley!"
"Are you alright?"
Yolanda asked Connor worriedly.
"I'm alright. Don't worry!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Alright, then!"
Yolanda nodded and walked into the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Soloman, Colton, and the rest saw Wilda, Stanley, and Yolanda walking into the Eight Trigrams Valley. However, they did not stop them because they knew that these people would not be able to escape. They would be able to deal with these people after they had dealt with Connor.
In the eyes of Soloman and the others, Wilda, Stanley, and the others were like ants. There was no way they could escape.
A moment later, Yolanda and the others had already entered the Eight Trigrams Valley.
At this moment, only Connor, Soloman, Colton, and Yago were left on the empty ground.
Yago was the first to rush up to Connor. He held a white sword in his hand and slashed at Connor's head.
A sword strike!
Yago had used all his strength in the first move. The power of this sword was extremely shocking, as if it had the power to split the heavens and earth.
After all, Yago knew very well that Connor was extremely strong. Hence, he had to use all his strength when he attacked. He couldn't give his opponent any chance to counterattack. If they could rely on this sword to kill Connor instantly, the three of them could save a lot of energy.
At this moment, it was as if a mountain could be easily split apart by Yago's sword, let alone a person.
Connor stood on the spot with a very calm expression, as if he was not intimidated by the aura of this sword at all.
A trace of doubt flashed through Yago's heart when he saw Connor demeanor. He couldn't understand why Connor was so calm.
Bang!
At this moment, a loud bang sounded between heaven and earth.
Yago's sword slashed at the aura surrounding Connor's body.
However, Yago didn't expect the aura around Connor to be so strong. He felt as if he had struck a hard rock. Connor didn't budge at all, but the sword in his hand was trembling.
"How... How is this possible?"
Yago's expression was one of shock.
He was very clear about how terrifying the power of that sword was. If it was an ordinary heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster standing in front of him, he might not be able to block his sword at all. Even if he could, he would at least be seriously injured.
But at this moment, Connor was standing where he was without budging, as if he was not affected at all.
"Yago, he is stronger than we think. Let's attack him together!"
Soloman shouted expressionlessly.
"Alright!"
Yago nodded lightly.
Connor looked at the three of them indifferently and didn't say anything.
Soloman, Yago, and Colton each occupied three spots. Then, without any hesitation, three different colored auras flew toward Connor.
The power of these three auras was extremely terrifying. It gave people the feeling that three hurricanes were engulfing Connor at the same time, wanting to tear him into pieces.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The three auras fell on Connor's body at the same time. If it were anyone else, they would have succumbed under the pressure. However, Connor still stood where he was as he looked at the three people around him expressionlessly.
Connor could feel that the auras of these three people contained heaven and earth spiritual energy, which caused their auras to be very violent. Therefore, when these three people released these three auras, they also had to suffer terrifying damage.
However, the damage was not worth mentioning compared to the pressure that Connor was facing.
Connor stood quietly in the middle of the three people and endured the attacks. Although Connor could not move an inch, Connor was still very calm, as if he was not affected at all.
Yago's expression turned ugly.
Although he knew that Connor's strength was extraordinary before he came, and although his realm was the same as theirs, Connor was able to proficiently use the power of the soul. In addition, Connor had devoured the soul of the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader, which caused the aura in Connor's body to be extremely terrifying. It was not something that ordinary heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters like them could compare to.
"Increase your powers; we must restrain him!"
Yago shouted after realizing that something was wrong.
"Alright!"
Colton and Soloman nodded at the same time.
After the three of them increased the power of their auras, Connor frowned a little, and the expression on his face also changed a little.
The strength of these three people was indeed remarkable. Even Connor felt that it was very strenuous for him.
"Connor, you are the only martial artist who can make the three of us attack at the same time. You should feel very honored!"
Colton deliberately talked to Connor, wanting to distract him.
"So what if the three of you join forces? Today, the three of you will die in my hands!"
Connor replied indifferently.
Hearing Connor's words, Colton couldn't help but sneer. Then, he said indifferently, "Looks like you are still in the mood to brag about your abilities!"
"You'll know soon enough whether I'm bragging or not!"
Connor replied indifferently and then took a step forward.
Colton, Soloman and Yago were all stunned when they saw him take a step forward. They were filled with disbelief.
"How... How can he still move?"
Colton could not help but exclaim.
"His aura is so powerful!"
Soloman was also shocked.
Under normal circumstances, a martial artist would not be able to move at all if they were suppressed by the aura of the three of them. They would probably not be able to stand, let alone walk. However, at this moment, not only was Connor fine, but he was also able to walk. This was really incomprehensible.
"Is he at the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts?"
A bold idea flashed across Soloman's mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 2112: Killing Move
chapters.content:
Chapter 2112: Killing Move
"Impossible, the strength of a pinnacle ancient martial artist is extremely terrifying. I've fought with them before. Connor can't be at this level!"
Yago replied.
"Since he is not at the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts, then why is he so terrifyingly strong?"
Colton's face was dark as well.
"Now, I'll show you my aura!"
Connor shouted expressionlessly, then released the aura in his body.
Boom!
The aura in Connor's body split into three and went against the auras of Soloman, Colton, and Yago.
Soloman, Colton and Yago could feel the pressure that Connor's aura exerted on their bodies.
At this moment, their auras were competing with Connor's aura. Although Connor was in a one-on-three situation, he was not at a disadvantage at all.
The martial artists in the Eight Trigrams Valley were all stunned when they saw this scene. They were in disbelief because they thought that the battle would be one-sided. After all, Connor was only one person. It was impossible for him to deal with three heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters.
However, Connor was still not at a disadvantage while fighting one against three.
This also caused everyone to once again reignite their hope for Connor.
"The Soul Eater is really a God!"
"Yeah. He's still not at a disadvantage under such circumstances!"
"If it were any other martial artist, they would have died in the hands of these three people, right?"
Everyone could not help but discuss softly.
Only now did they understand how terrifying Connor's strength was.
Connor's aura was contending with the auras of Soloman, Yago, and Colton. Although it seemed that the auras of the two sides were evenly matched, Connor would definitely be at a disadvantage if this continued on.
Connor had to find a breakthrough point. As long as he could find a breakthrough point, Connor could gain the upper hand.
Very soon, Connor discovered that the weakest person among them was Colton, so Connor increased the pressure of his aura on Colton.
Sure enough, in less than five seconds, the expression on Colton's face changed. He knew that Connor was using him as a breakthrough point.
If Connor broke through him first, then the other two would also be affected.
"We can't go on like this. Otherwise, the three of us might be in danger!"
Colton hurriedly shouted.
"I didn't expect that Connor's aura could actually fight one against three. No wonder Yanni Boston lost to him!"
Soloman said in a low voice with a surprised expression.
"So what if his strength is terrifying? The three of us must kill him today. Otherwise, the consequences will be unimaginable!"
Yago shouted coldly.
"I'll go first!"
Colton immediately retracted his aura, and then his figure flashed and disappeared from everyone's sight.
Yago and Soloman retracted their own auras as well.
When everyone in the Eight Trigrams Valley saw this scene, they were all puzzled. They did not expect that Soloman, Colton and Yago would be the first to give up.
Logically speaking, the three of them dealing with Connor alone would have been a huge advantage!
"What's going on? Are they really not a match for the Soul Eater alone?"
Uncle Cardenas asked in confusion.
"No…"
Stanley shook his head and said expressionlessly, "The Soul Eater's strength is indeed terrifying, but it's impossible for him to fight against three people alone. However, the auras of Colton, Soloman, and Yago were tied together. If one of them were injured, the other two would be injured as well. They stopped now not because they were afraid of Connor, but to avoid being implicated by the weakest person!"
"I see!"
Uncle Cardenas nodded thoughtfully.
It was clear what Stanley meant. Although Colton was the one who stopped first, it didn't mean that Connor's strength was really above these three people.
"It's already unbelievable that the Soul Eater can still do this even though he's fighting three people alone!"
Lich said in a low voice.
"That's right. If it were anyone else in the same situation, they would have been killed in an instant!"
Martian Lord hurriedly nodded as well.
However, at this moment, Colton, who had just disappeared, reappeared again. Moreover, he was accompanied by a huge black palm that slapped toward Connor!
At the beginning, this palm was only the size of a normal human palm. However, as the palm got closer and closer to Connor, the palm also kept growing in size. In just a short time, the palm was already the size of a house.
"Negative Ghost Palm!"
Stanley was shocked when he saw the black palm.
"Is this the legendary Negative Ghost Palm?"
Uncle Cardenas said with his eyes wide open.
"It is. This is definitely the Negative Ghost Palm!"
Stanley nodded seriously.
"I didn't expect Mr. Walther to use his own killing move as soon as he attacked!"
Uncle Cardenas's body trembled as he sighed. The surrounding martial artists were also shocked.
They had all heard of the power of the Ghost Palm.
This move was definitely considered Colton's famous ultimate skill. Moreover, it was said that the power of the Ghost Palm was very terrifying. Even a mountain peak could be easily flattened. As long as a martial artist came into contact with the Ghost Palm, he would be swallowed by the powerful Negative Chi contained in it. The Negative Chi would devour the body and kill him on the spot!
This was also the reason why Uncle Cardenas was so surprised when he found out that Colton had used the Ghost Palm.
Moreover, it was said that the martial artists who used the Negative Ghost Palm would also suffer the backlash of the powerful Negative Chi contained in the Negative Ghost Palm, which would also have a very large impact on their own bodies. However, Colton was the first to use this move. From this point, it could be seen that Colton and the others were afraid of Connor.
However, no one knew that Colton's Ghost Palm was just the beginning.
Seeing that Colton had already made his move, Soloman naturally did not dare to waste any more time. He waved his right hand lightly.
A black zither appeared in front of Soloman.
When everyone saw the zither, their expressions changed again.

chapters.title: Chapter 2113: Immortal Zither
chapters.content:
Chapter 2113: Immortal Zither
"That's actually the Celestial Artifact, the Immortal Zither!"
Martian Lord exclaimed.
"I didn't expect the Immortal Zither to end up in Soloman's hands!"
Lich said.
"The Immortal Zither appeared once in France and caused a bloody storm. Countless people lost their lives for this Immortal Zither, but unfortunately, no one managed to obtain it in the end! Who would have thought that the Immortal Zither was in Soloman's hands!"
Felipe Winters couldn't help but sigh.
"Yeah. If we had known earlier that Soloman had the Immortal Zither, there wouldn't have been so many people fighting each other for it!"
Stanley sighed softly.
When Wilda heard what these people said, she was very puzzled. She subconsciously turned to look at Stanley, who was beside her, and asked softly, "Uncle Whalen, what exactly is the Immortal Zither you're talking about?"
"I don't know much about this Immortal Zither. I heard someone say that this Immortal Zither is a Celestial Artifact left behind from ancient times. It has extremely terrifying power."
Stanley explained.
"Celestial Artifact?"
Hearing Stanley's words, Wilda seemed to be even more confused.
"The weapons used by us martial artists are generally Divine Artifacts, and only the treasures used by immortals can be called Celestial Artifacts. Do you understand now?"
Stanley explained in a low voice.
Hearing Stanley's words, Wilda nodded thoughtfully and whispered, "Although I still don't understand what a Celestial Artifact is, I know that it is a very powerful weapon!"
"Well, you can see it that way!"
Stanley nodded.
When Soloman took out the Immortal Zither, he gently stroked the strings. In the next second, countless sound waves flew straight toward Connor like flying swords. The power of these sound waves was astonishing, and the number was terrifying. They locked onto Connor from all directions, leaving him no chance to dodge.
Connor's expression was a little strange when he saw the sound waves flying toward him.
During this period of time, Connor had seen quite a number of ancient martial arts experts. He had even fought with ghosts like the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader, but this was the first time he had encountered someone who could use sound wave attacks. This was indeed an eye-opener for Connor.
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, no one would have believed that a single sound wave had such terrifying power.
Wherever these sound waves passed by, not even a single blade of grass was spared. Countless flowers and trees were instantly cut into two by the sound waves.
It was also the first time for many martial artists to witness the power of the Immortal Zither, and their faces were filled with disbelief.
Yago was the last to attack Connor. He had already attacked Connor before, so he had a rough understanding of Connor's strength.
Yago's sword was like a bolt of lightning. In the blink of an eye, he had already arrived in front of Connor. Then, he slashed at Connor's throat. His speed and strength were shocking. Everyone present was shocked.
Even though Yago's attack was the weakest among the three of them, Connor knew that Yago's sword was the most terrifying. If he was not careful, Yago's sword might cut his head.
The three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters attacked together. Moreover, the three of them did not have the intention to fight Connor. They used their full strength as soon as they attacked, using their strongest moves. They clearly wanted to end the battle quickly to prevent any more trouble.
After all, no one knew if Connor had reinforcements!
It was as if the entire Eight Trigrams Valley had been affected by the auras of the three of them and was trembling violently. From this, one could see how terrifying this battle was.
The faces of the martial artists in the Eight Trigrams Valley turned pale because they were extremely strong. It was so terrifying that it was beyond their imagination. In the eyes of these people, Stanley and the others were already extremely strong figures.
However, when they saw the scene in front of them, they felt that Stanley and the others were much weaker. These people were considered true masters, as if their every move could make the world lose its color.
"I didn't expect the strength of a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster to be so terrifying! When will we be able to compare to these people!"
A middle-aged martial artist looked at the scene in front of him and could not help but sigh.
"These people are merely heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. If pinnacle ancient martial arts grandmasters really exist, how terrifying would their strength be!"
Another martial artist added.
"Yeah. If we didn't see it with our own eyes today, no one would believe that such a terrifying power exists in this world!"
"I'm looking at it, yet I still can't believe it. They're way too strong!"
Everyone looked at Soloman, Yago, and the Colton. They were filled with fear and anticipation.
After all, these people had never come into contact with a martial artist of such a rank. Even before today's events, these people thought that the strongest martial artist in the world was only an earth rank. Who would have thought that there was an even stronger existence above the earth rank!
"Lord Soul Eater's strength is also very terrifying. But he might not be able to win today!"
"Yeah. If the Soul Eater were to face one of the three of them alone, he would have a very high chance of winning. Unfortunately, the three of them are working together now."
Everyone looked at Connor and could not help but feel sorry for him.
Yolanda Yates was also very nervous. She was not sure if Connor was a match for these three people.
Yolanda instinctively looked at Connor. Connor was still very calm in the face of these three people's attacks, as if he didn't care about these three people at all.
'Mr. McDonald will be fine, right?'
Yolanda couldn't help but comfort herself.
However, Wilda was also worried about Connor. Wilda did not know why she was worried about him. After all, Connor's life and death had nothing to do with her. However, she still instinctively hoped that he could defeat these three people and survive.

chapters.title: Chapter 2114: A Disorganized Bunch
chapters.content:
Chapter 2114: A Disorganized Bunch
Thump thump…
At this moment, Connor, who had been standing still, suddenly took a step forward.
"The Soul Eater is moving!"
"Yeah, the Soul Eater is moving!"
Everyone became excited, because they knew that Connor had not given up.
Yago, who was the fastest among them, charged toward Connor with his white sword.
Connor's expression was somewhat disdainful as he said softly, "If your sword wants to kill me, it must be dreaming!"
After Connor finished speaking, he suddenly raised his right hand.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor chose to block Yago's sword with his bare hands!
Under everyone's incredulous gazes, Connor grabbed Yago's sword with his right hand!
When Yago saw this scene, his face was filled with shock. He didn't expect Connor's body to be so strong that he could block his sword with his bare hands!
In the next second, Connor's right hand forcefully twisted!
Bang!
The incomparably hard longsword was broken into two by Connor.
This scene was way too shocking. Connor was facing a martial artist of the same realm as him. Even though the sword in Yago's hand wasn't a Celestial Artifact, it was considered a Quasi-Celestial Artifact. Who would have thought that Connor could break Yago's sword so easily?
"How is that possible?"
Even Yago himself found it unbelievable. His face was filled with shock as if he couldn't accept this outcome at all.
"I've said it before, so what if the three of you join hands? You're so disorganized!"
Connor said calmly.
Yago was a little angry when he heard Connor's words.
However, Connor didn't give Yago the chance to speak. He raised his fist and smashed it toward Yago's chest!
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Yago didn't seem to have realized what was going on. His body flew out and smashed onto the ground, creating a huge crater.
Everyone in the Eight Trigrams Valley widened their eyes when they saw this scene, as if they did not know how to describe their current feelings.
Not only did Connor easily break the sword in Yago's hand, but he also sent Yago flying with a single punch.
"Is there really hope?"
Martian Lord looked in Connor's direction and shouted.
However, at this moment, Colton's Ghost Palm also rushed up to Connor.
The palm that was only the size of a house earlier was now smashing down toward Connor like a mountain.
At this moment, this palm looked extremely terrifying. If it hit its target, not a single blade of grass would grow within a ten-mile radius.
Although Connor's easy defeat of Yago had given everyone a glimmer of hope, their expressions sank into despair once again when they saw the Ghost Palm.
At this moment, Connor didn't just need to face Yago alone!
Connor raised his head and looked at the palm that was smashing down on him. He looked somewhat disdainful, and then he made another unexpected move.
Connor's body was like a rocket, rushing toward the palm!
"Is the Soul Eater planning to use his own body to withstand this palm strike?"
"Won't that kill him?"
"Yeah. Why is he doing that?"
For a moment, everyone couldn't help but feel that it was a shame. With Connor's strength, he could have used other methods to resist this move, but at this moment, everyone felt that there was no hope.
Connor's speed was very fast, giving people the feeling that he was a ray of light flying across the sky.
In just a moment, Connor's body broke through the palm. However, what no one expected was that the huge Negative Ghost Palm then exploded like a bomb, and the entire Eight Trigrams Valley fell into a violent tremor.
Colton's expression was a little smug when he saw this scene. He sighed softly, "Connor, oh Connor, I admit that you are extremely strong. However, you don't seem that bright. You actually want to fight head-on with my Negative Ghost Palm? You're simply an idiot…"
However, before Colton could finish his sentence, the smile on his face froze.
Because he saw a golden light fly out from the location of the explosion!
"No... That's impossible!"
Colton stuttered.
In the next moment, Connor appeared in front of him.
No one had expected that Connor would actually come back unscathed after breaking the Negative Ghost Palm.
Colton stared at Conno with his eyes wide open, as if he couldn't believe what he was witnessing.
Connor slowly raised his right hand and said expressionlessly, "Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Heaven Breaking!"
After saying that, Connor placed his hand on Colton's chest.
Colton was stunned.
In the next second, a golden light flashed.
With a loud bang, Colton's body was sent flying backward. Then, she smashed into the mountain wall in the distance, creating a human-shaped deep pit.
Soloman didn't expect Colton and Yago to be defeated by Connor so quickly. He was a little nervous as he quickly plucked the strings of the Immortal Zither.
Countless sound waves flew toward Connor.
It was impossible for Soloman's sound waves to defeat Connor. He wanted to buy as much time as possible for Yago and Colton to recover.
However, Connor didn't give Soloman the chance to do so. He dodged all the sound wave attacks!
"He's so fast!"
Soloman looked shocked.
However, in the next second, something even more unbelievable happened. Connor used the aura in his body to control all the sound waves.
The sound waves instantly changed directions and flew toward Soloman.
Soloman's face was filled with fear. He quickly put away his Immortal Zither and used his aura to block the sound wave attack.
Just as Soloman was dealing with the sound waves, Connor rushed behind him and threw another punch.
Bang!
With a loud bang, Soloman was sent flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 2115: How Ungrateful!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2115: How Ungrateful!
Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned.
Their eyes were wide open as they looked at Connor with an incredulous expression.
No one had expected such an outcome.
Connor easily neutralized the attacks of Yago, Colton, and Soloman by himself. He looked very relaxed, as if he didn't even have any signs of exhaustion!
Wilda stared in Connor's direction with her mouth agape. She did not know how to express her emotions. She had not expected such a situation!
"How terrifying is he?"
"Yeah. I didn't expect the Soul Eater to be able to fight against three people alone."
"Did the Soul Eater already break through to the pinnacle realm?"
"If the Soul Eater is really at the pinnacle realm, that's way too terrifying!"
Everyone could not help but discuss softly.
Before the battle started, everyone felt that the battle was definitely one-sided. No matter how powerful Connor was, he could not be a match for three heaven ranks!
But who could have guessed that Connor could still gain the upper hand in a one-versus-three battle!
"If the Soul Eater can win today, then we can leave this place alive!"
Stanely said in a low voice.
"Yeah. If the Soul Eater really defeats these three people, that will be great!"
Martian Lord added.
Although Connor had the upper hand just now, he didn't dare to be careless. He knew that although his attack looked powerful, these people were still heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. They couldn't be defeated so quickly!
A few seconds later, Soloman, Colton, and Yago appeared in front of Connor again.
At this moment, they looked very solemn, because the three of them did not expect Connor's strength to be so terrifying. Although Connor's punch just now did not seriously injure them, it had a very big impact on them, especially Colton.
Colton was the weakest among the three of them, so he was also affected the most. He could clearly feel that the aura in his body had become very unstable, and from time to time, there would be a feeling of blood and Chi surging.
"We have underestimated you. I didn't expect you to be so strong!"
Yago said softly.
"I think I overestimated the three of you!"
Connor replied indifferently.
"Why you!"
Yago was a little angry when he heard Connor's words. He gritted his teeth and said, "Connor, if you surrender now, the conditions we promised you before will still be valid!"
"I'm good…"
Connor replied without thinking.
"How ungrateful!"
Yago gritted his teeth.
Connor was not bothered with Yago. Instead, he started circulating his aura in his body.
In an instant, everyone clearly felt the aura between heaven and earth begin to circulate crazily. Connor's body was like a vortex that began to continuously devour all the surrounding heaven and earth spiritual energy.
After the battle just now, Connor knew that if he really wanted to defeat these three people, he had to defeat them in one move. Otherwise, if he continued to delay the battle, the situation would only become more and more disadvantageous to Connor.
Yago and the rest had strange expressions on their faces when they saw Connor begin to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth!
Because they thought that Connor would continue to attack!
No one expected him to do that instead. He was actually giving Yago and the others a chance to counterattack!
A few seconds later, a dazzling light erupted around Connor's body. This light was extremely terrifying as if it had the energy to devour everything in the world.
"You already know how terrifying Connor's strength is. From now on, give it your all!"
Yago said softly.
"Alright…"
Soloman and Colton hurriedly nodded.
Yago took a deep breath and rushed toward Connor.
Soloman and Colton were extremely nervous because the three of them had never encountered such an opponent. Connor's strength was far beyond their imagination.
For a moment, the three of them attacked Connor from three different directions. Moreover, these three people had already used their special skills.
At this moment, Connor was still devouring the surrounding spiritual energy. Yago knew very well that once Connor had devoured enough spiritual energy, the power of his attack would definitely be astonishing. Therefore, the three of them only had one thought in their minds, and that was to kill Connor before he devoured enough spiritual energy. Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Countless attacks crazily smashed toward Connor.
Connor's body also began to sway. The attacks Connor's body was enduring at this time were not ordinary attacks. It was the full power attack of a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. If it were someone else, they might not even be able to withstand a single attack.
In just a short time, Connor had forcefully withstood more than ten attacks.
Everyone present was also very puzzled because they could not understand what was going on!
In the battle just now, Connor clearly had the upper hand. Why would he allow them to attack him like that? Why was he willingly being beaten up?
Although Connor had the upper hand just now, if he really wanted to rely on this slight advantage to defeat these three people, it was impossible!
To put it bluntly, if it was an attack similar to Connor's just now, even if he threw a hundred or a thousand punches, it might not be able to kill these three people or even seriously injure them!
Moreover, Connor's own body would not be able to withstand it. At that time, Connor would be in an even more dangerous situation.
Soloman and the others were all genuine heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. It would not be easy for Connor to defeat these three!
Connor had to use his strongest move. Only then could he have a slight chance of winning!
That was why Connor chose to give up on attacking at this moment. He used the power of the Profound Bead to crazily devour all the surrounding heaven and earth spiritual energy.
The other martial artists didn't know what Connor was doing, but Yago and the rest knew. This was why the three of them were racing against time.
All kinds of dazzling moves fiercely smashed onto Connor's body. For a moment, everyone felt as if the end of the world was coming. These moves were something they had never seen before.
Connor's body was also trembling non-stop, as if he could not hold on any longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 2116: Terrifying Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 2116: Terrifying Power
"What is the Soul Eater doing?"
"Yeah. He was fine just now. Why isn't he moving now?"
"If this continues, the Soul Eater might really be in danger!"
The martial artists present began to discuss in low voices, their expressions very nervous.
As for Yolanda Yates and Wilda, they didn't even understand what was going on.
Colton and Soloman were attacking at the same time. Their power was not something they could imagine. Dark clouds covered the sky, lightning flashed, and thunder rumbled. All kinds of strange phenomena appeared.
And Connor had been enduring these attacks all along, as if he had no intention of retaliating at all!
After an unknown period of time, Connor suddenly opened his eyes.
"Looks like I've really overestimated the three of you. I gave the three of you such a long time, but you still couldn't kill me!"
Connor said slowly.
Yago's expression changed when he heard Connor's words. He knew that since Connor had spoken, it meant that Connor had successfully accumulated his strength!
"This is bad!"
Yago suddenly shouted.
However, in the next second, an extremely dazzling golden light erupted from Connor's body. This light was not something that the previous light could compare to.
Wilda and the others could not even look at the light around Connor's body.
Soloman, Colton, and the others were also shocked. They knew very well how powerful the light around Connor was!
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dharma World!"
At this moment, Connor roared.
Immediately after, the golden light around his body began to spread in all directions at an extremely terrifying speed. The energy contained in this light seemed to be able to devour everything in the world. This was also Connor's strongest attack.
If Yago and the other two could block this attack, Connor would definitely lose!
Yago took a deep breath and rushed toward the source of the light. Colton and Soloman knew that the three of them were in the same boat, so they had to work together.
Therefore, the two of them followed closely behind.
A few seconds later, the three of them collided with the light, and a loud explosion sounded.
In an instant, lightning flashed and thunder rumbled, and the world shook.
Everyone in the Eight Trigrams Valley stood rooted to the ground in a daze. There was fear written on their faces because Connor's attack was way too terrifying. It had already exceeded their understanding of the martial artists of this world!
Yago, who was the first to rush into the light, had a ferocious expression on his face. The power of the light was extremely terrifying. At the beginning, he could barely hold on for a while. However, as the energy of the light increased, the pressure he endured became more and more terrifying.
Although Soloman and Colton joined the battle in time, it was still of no help.
"Pfft!"
Yago spat out a mouthful of blood before his entire body was engulfed by the light.
Soloman and Colton realized that something was wrong. They turned around and wanted to run, but they didn't have the chance to do so. With their screams, the light engulfed them.
Rumble…
A loud bang resounded through the sky.
A dazzling light rippled between heaven and earth!
After an unknown period of time, the light slowly dissipated.
Everyone looked at Connor, who was suspended in the sky like a God, with their mouths agape. They did not even know how to describe their feelings.
Who would have thought that Connor would face three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters alone and defeat them in the end!
At this moment, the entire valley fell into silence.
After an unknown period of time, they could faintly hear the sounds of discussion.
"Isn't the Soul Eater's move just now way too terrifying?"
"Yeah, it's truly unbelievable!"
"How powerful is he?!"
"Soloman and the other two lost just like that?"
"They're all genuine heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. It's impossible for them to lose just like this, right?"
Connor's punch just now displayed a very powerful power, and almost everyone present had a new understanding of the strength of martial artists.
However, there were still some people who believed that Soloman, Yago, and Colton weren't dead. This was because these three people were all heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. In the eyes of many people, heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters were already invincible existences. Therefore, they didn't believe that Connor could really defeat these three people so easily.
However, Soloman and the others did not appear for a long time after disappearing into the light. This made everyone present secretly suspect that these three people were really dead.
Connor quietly floated in the air, squinting his eyes as he looked into the distance. He was very calm.
The others might not know whether Soloman, Yago, and Colton were dead or alive, but Connor knew because he could still feel the aura of these three people.
This meant that Connor's punch just now did not successfully kill them.
Connor's current realm was at the peak of the heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, only one step away from the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts. However, to put it bluntly, Connor was still a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, so there was still a huge gap between his strength and the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts.
"Sigh…"
Thinking of that, Connor could not help but shake his head gently.
