This was because Connor had used all his strength in executing the Dharma World, but he still could not kill Soloman and the other two. If Connor was at the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts, that punch just now would have been enough to kill the three of them in an instant.
However, Connor knew that even if his punch just now did not instantly kill these three people, it would still have heavily injured them!
In this case, Connor still had a huge advantage in the battle.
As time passed, everyone was waiting for the outcome of the battle.
However, Connor had been standing on the spot without moving at all. From this point, everyone could see that this battle was not over yet.
"Kid, what fist technique did you use just now?"
As expected, an extremely cold voice sounded in the sky.
Everyone looked up at the sky.
Yago, Soloman and Colton were indeed not dead. However, they looked a little pathetic at the moment. There were still traces of blood at the corner of Yago's mouth. Colton, who was slightly weaker, was even worse off. He probably didn't have the ability to even utter a complete sentence. No one could have imagined that Connor's punch would have such terrifying power.

chapters.title: Chapter 2117: A Dire Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 2117: A Dire Situation
When everyone saw Yago, Soloman and Colton, they were all stunned with shocked expressions on their faces.
Although they didn't think that Soloman and the others would die so easily, the fact that the three of them could still appear in front of them after the terrifying explosion was remarkable.
"What kind of terrifying power is this? The explosion just now was of another level, but they are still alive!"
"Yeah, as expected of a heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. How terrifying!"
"If it were me, I would have died a hundred times!"
The martial artists watching began to discuss in low voices, they were in utter disbelief.
"Why do I need to tell you what fish technique I used?"
Connor said to Soloman expressionlessly.
Soloman sized up Connor and said in a low voice, "Who taught you the fist technique you used just now?"
"It has nothing to do with you!"
Connor said softly.
Soloman still wanted to say something, but Yago stopped him and said expressionlessly, "Alright, now is not the time to talk about this. We must kill him today. Otherwise, we might die…"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment when he heard Yago's words. Then, he sighed softly. "Looks like these three people still have some trump cards that they haven't used yet!"
"Looks like I have to use that move!"
Yago said expressionlessly.
"Colton, are you alright?"
Soloman turned and asked.
"Yes… I'm alright!"
Colton nodded lightly.
"That's good!"
Soloman took a deep breath and started to circulate his aura.
In an instant, Soloman's aura surged like a tsunami. It was not only Soloman as Colton and Yago's aura also started to change. It was obvious that the three of them were using their full strength!
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the three people in front of him. He was obviously much more serious now.
After all, Connor could feel that there was a huge change in their aura. He did not know what kind of attack would be waiting for him next, so Connor had to make all preparations to receive the attacks of these three people.
…
Rumble…
A few seconds later, lightning flashed and thunder rumbled in the sky, and the ground trembled violently once more.
The martial artists hiding in the Eight Trigrams Valley seemed to have felt the aura of the apocalypse again, and they were very nervous.
"These three people have already been seriously injured by the Soul Eater to such an extent. Now, they are still able to exhibit such otherworldly strength. How remarkable…"
Felipe Winters said with a trembling voice.
"Yeah, that's what it means to be a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Compared to them, we are simply worlds apart!"
Martian Lord added.
"Right now, the three of them are burning their blood essence. This is a battle method that results in phenomenal damage to others but also causes great damage to oneself!"
Stanley Whalen said expressionlessly.
"What did you say?"
Hearing Stanley's words, everyone was stunned. They were in utter disbelief
"The three of them are burning their blood essence now. I've seen someone use this move before!"
Stanley replied in a low voice.
Everyone looked at each other in disbelief.
After all, blood essence was the foundation of a martial artist, and blood essence was different from aura.
After the aura had been consumed, it could be recovered through various methods, but there was no way to recover the blood essence. Once it was consumed, the impact on the body was terrifying, and there was no way to recover forever. If it was not the last resort, no warrior would choose to sacrifice his blood essence to fight. Because even if he could win the battle, he would be seriously injured, and there was no way to completely recover.
"I didn't expect the Soul Eater to force the three of them into such a situation!"
"Yeah, they have resorted to burning their blood essence. How unbelievable!"
"The Soul Eater is only twenty years old. Even if he loses to these people today, there's nothing to regret. After all, how many people in the entire world can do that?"
Everyone looked at Connor' and began to discuss in a low voice.
"Stanley, this is actually a good thing for us!"
Martian Lord suddenly grinned and whispered to Stanley.
"Yes. Them choosing to burn their blood essence to fight the Soul Eater is indeed a good thing for us. After all, even if they can defeat the Soul Eater, they will still be seriously injured. Then, as long as we work together, it should be enough to deal with the three of them!"
Stanley nodded lightly.
Hearing Stanley's words, everyone became excited. After all, in their eyes, the outcome of this battle was not that important. After all, no matter who won in the end, it had nothing to do with them.
Previously, they could only survive if Connor won.
However at this point, regardless of the outcome, they could survive, so they were very happy.
"Then… What about Connor?"
Wilda asked Stanley after hearing what he said.
"I'm afraid the Soul Eater is doomed!"
Stanley replied in a low voice.
Wilda was stunned when she heard Stanley's words. She couldn't accept this fact because she thought that he could defeat these three people!
"Everyone, look!"
However, at this moment, a martial artist suddenly shouted.
Everyone raised their heads to look over after hearing the martial artist's words.
The auras of Soloman, Yago, and Colton had slowly condensed into one. This aura affected the three of them. Moreover, this aura was very powerful, as if it was several times stronger than their individual auras.
When this aura appeared, it was as if the spiritual Chi in the entire world had changed.
"Why did their auras fuse together?"
"Yeah, what's going on?"
"Does… does that magical spell really exist?"
Felipe shouted excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2118: Immortal Fusion Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 2118: Immortal Fusion Technique
"You are talking about the Immortal Fusion Technique, right?"
Stanley turned to look at Felipe Winters and couldn't help but ask.
"Stanley, have you heard of the Immortal Fusion Technique?"
Felipe asked.
"Of course, I have!"
Stanley nodded.
The other martial artists present were puzzled after hearing their conversation, as if they did not understand what they were talking about.
"What is the Immortal Fusion Technique that the two of you are talking about?"
"Yeah, what are you two talking about?"
Everyone asked Felipe and Stanley with confusion.
"Back then, I read about the Immortal Fusion Technique in an ancient book. It was said that it's a technique that could fuse the auras of many people and increase the auras of these three people by several times."
Felipe looked at everyone and explained softly.
"If you really want to use the Immortal Fusion Technique, the most important requirement is to burn your blood essence!"
Stanley added expressionlessly.
Upon hearing Stanley's words, everyone finally understood what was going on. They could not comprehend why the three of them were burning their blood essence, but now they knew that they were doing it in order to use the Immortal Fusion Technique!
"These three people are already heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. If their auras can be combined and their powers increased by several times, how terrifying would their combat strength be!"
At this moment, a middle-aged martial artist could not help but sigh with a trembling voice.
There were already three heaven ranks standing in front of Connor. If the three of them used the Immortal Fusion Technique, it would be equivalent to six heaven ranks standing in front of Connor at the same time. Not to mention that Connor was only a peak heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster. Even a true pinnacle ancient martial artist would find this situation very troublesome.
"The situation is not as dire as that!"
Stanley said in a low voice.
"What do you mean, Mr. Whalen?"
The middle-aged man was stunned for a moment before asking.
"If the three of them had used the Immortal Fusion Technique at the beginning of the battle, it might have been equivalent to six heaven rank ancient martial arts grandmasters attacking the Soul Eater at the same time. However, the Soul Eater has already seriously injured the three of them, and the three of them have lost at least 50% of their combat strength. So, even though they used the Immortal Fusion Technique, they can only be on par with the three of them at their peak!"
Stanley explained objectively.
After hearing Stanley's explanation, everyone let out a long sigh of relief. They knew that if Soloman and the others had used the Immortal Fusion Technique at their peak, Connor would have died today!
The current situation might not be that bad for Connor!
However, the advantage that Connor had previously created had already disappeared!
Such a situation was actually very disadvantageous to Connor!
Everyone thought that the battle was over. Although the other party were three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters, they were still not a match for Connor alone.
However, Yago, Soloman and Colton were now erupting with shocking combat power. The current situation on the battlefield was considered very disadvantageous for Connor. Everyone thought that they could survive the disaster, but they were now panicking once more. After all, today's battle was not only related to Connor's life and death, but also to the life and death of everyone present.
"Our lives depend on you Lord Soul Eater!"
"Yeah, Lord Soul Eater, you must not lose!"
"Relax, Lord Soul Eater will definitely not lose…"
The martial artists present began to discuss in low voices, and they were very nervous.
Just as everyone was worried about Connor, he seemed to have realized that something was wrong. He knew that although Soloman and Colton were not at their peak state, if they were to use the Immortal Fusion Technique, it would be very dangerous for Connor.
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath and chose to attack.
Connor's speed was astonishing. He appeared in front of Yago in an instant, raised his fist, and smashed it toward Yago's chest.
At this moment, Yago, Colton, and Soloman were all using the Immortal Fusion Technique, so this was also the time when their defense was at its weakest. If Connor could seize this opportunity to successfully kill one person, then the remaining two people would not be able to pose much of a threat to Connor.
Connor's fist shone with a golden light, and the aura of heaven and earth gradually surged along with his fist.
When everyone saw Connor's punch, they all revealed shocked expressions. They could feel that the power of Connor's punch was probably thousands of times more terrifying than Connor's previous punch!
"This is probably the true power of the Soul Eater!"
Stanley looked up at the sky at Connor and sighed with a trembling voice.
"Yeah. If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn't have believed that there was such a powerful martial artist in this world!"
Felipe couldn't help but sigh.
Yago couldn't help but laugh coldly when he saw Connor attacking him. He said calmly, "Looks like your reaction speed is still a little slow!"
After saying that, Yago waved his right hand, and a three-colored aura rushed toward Connor.
"We're done for!"
Stanley was in despair when he saw the aura released by Yago. He knew very well that this aura was formed by the auras of Yago, Colton, and Soloman. This meant that the three of them had completed the Immortal Fusion Technique. Connor was in a very dangerous situation.
Bang!
At this moment, Connor's fist collided with Yago's aura.
At this moment, the entire Eight Trigrams Valley fell into a violent tremor. Everyone there felt as if there was an earthquake.
Wilda stood rooted to the ground in a daze. At this moment, she did not know how to describe her feelings because the scene before her eyes was too shocking.

chapters.title: Chapter 2119: Give Me A Hand!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2119: Give Me A Hand!
Wilda felt that everything in front of her was unreal, as if she was dreaming.
No one had expected that Connor, this seemingly thin and weak youth, would actually erupt with such terrifying combat strength.
When Connor's fist collided with Yago's aura, it was as if a bomb had exploded. A huge mushroom cloud formed in the sky. Lightning flashed and thunder rumbled in the sky, and the earth shook violently.
"Looks like I'm still a step too slow!"
Connor took two steps back and narrowed his eyes at Yago, Soloman and Colton.
Originally, Connor planned to kill one person before the three of them completed the Immortal Fusion Technique. This way, the three of them would not be able to complete the Immortal Fusion Technique. However, Connor never expected that the three of them would be so skilled in using the Immortal Fusion Technique that they could fuse their auras into one in so quickly.
On the other side, Yago, Soloman and Colton had to take three steps back to steady themselves.
Yago couldn't help but cough lightly as his right hand trembled.
Soloman and Colton noticed this, and they were filled with disbelief. The three of them did not expect Connor to have such terrifying combat strength against the three of them who had already used the Immortal Fusion Technique.
Colton took a deep breath and whispered to Connor, "As expected of the Soul Eater! Your strength is far beyond our imagination. If you can join the Land Deities, your future will be limitless!"
"That's right. The three of us have used this Immortal Fusion Technique to defeat many powerhouses. Now, the three of us are already comparable to three peak heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. However, just now, you were actually able to withstand one of our auras and even had the upper hand. This is really beyond my expectations!"
Soloman added.
"Why are the three of you talking so much nonsense?"
Connor looked at the three people in front of him and sneered. Then, without any hesitation, his figure flashed and rushed up to the three people.
Connor's fighting spirit was at its peak. He waved his fists and smashed them toward Colton and Soloman.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Loud bangs sounded between heaven and earth. Connor had already unleashed the power of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist to the highest possible limit.
Yolanda stood quietly in the distance and looked at Connor. It would be a lie if she said that she was not worried about Connor at all. Putting aside the relationship between Yolanda and Connor, he was still the hope of the Profound Sect. Hence, Yolanda did not want anything to happen to Connor.
Although Soloman, Colton and Yago had used the Immortal Fusion Technique, which was of great help to the three of them in terms of combat strength, the three of them seemed to be unable to withstand Connor's ferocious attacks. Connor was always in a state of superiority.
"The Soul Eater is way too strong!"
Felipe's voice trembled.
"Yeah. I was still worried about the Soul Eater just now. I didn't expect the Soul Eater's strength to be so terrifying. He's able to gain the upper hand against three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters alone."
Stanley also sighed.
Wilda raised her delicate chin and looked at Connor. Her beautiful eyes were filled with shock.
"How can this person's strength be so terrifying? Is he really at the pinnacle realm?"
Colton couldn't help but exclaim.
"Impossible! He can't be at the pinnacle realm of ancient martial arts. If he's really at the pinnacle realm, the three of us would have died in his hands long ago!"
Yago said expressionlessly.
"Then, why does the aura in his body seem endless? It's impossible for a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster to have such a terrifying aura!"
Soloman asked with a frown.
"Perhaps…"
Just as Yago was about to speak, Connor's fist was already aimed at his head.
Yago hurriedly raised his right hand to block the attack.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor's fist landed heavily on Yago's arm. Yago took two steps back and almost spat out a mouthful of blood.
"How can he be so powerful?"
Yago looked at his arm in shock.
At this moment, he was no longer sure whether Connor was truly a heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster.
In the battle just now, Yago, Soloman and Colton had already consumed most of the aura in their bodies, but Connor seemed to be unaffected and was still attacking the three of them.
In just a moment, Connor had punched the three of them more than ten times.
Even though Yago had Colton and Soloman's help, he still couldn't withstand Connor's terrifying attack. His body flew out and smashed onto the ground.
Everyone was stunned when they saw Yago flying backward. They had a look of disbelief on their faces because they didn't expect this to happen.
"Three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters can't even stop the Soul Eater?"
"Yeah. These are three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters who have used the Immortal Fusion Technique. How terrifying is the Soul Eater's strength?"
"It's really beyond imagination. I didn't expect a martial artist's strength to reach such an extent. I have truly witnessed something remarkable!"
All the martial artists present revealed shocked expressions. For a moment, they did not know how to describe their feelings.
Yago spat out a mouthful of blood as he stood up slowly.
"Are you alright?"
Soloman turned to look at Yago and asked softly.
Yago shook his head gently and wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
Even though Yago was sent flying by Connor's punch and looked like he was in a sorry state, he wasn't seriously injured.
Connor knew that as well. Therefore, after taking a deep breath, he began to circulate the aura in his body.
"This is bad. We might not be able to block his next punch. Yago, think of something quickly!"
Colton could feel that Connor's next move was going to be extremely powerful. It might even kill the three of them. Hence, he shouted at Yago anxiously.
Yago was a little helpless upon hearing Colton's words. He said expressionlessly, "The two of you, give me a hand!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2120: Obsidian Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 2120: Obsidian Sword
"Alright!"
Colton and Soloman hurriedly nodded. Then, they channeled the energy in their bodies into Yago's body.
A few seconds later, Yago's body began to change continuously. His aura also became strange.
"With my blood, Sword Chi will fill the sky!"
Yago growled.
At this moment, Yago's body was emitting waves of red aura. Furthermore, Yago's hair was also gradually turning scarlet. At this moment, Yago's aura was also constantly rising. It was far from what Yago's aura was like before.
"Brother Yun's aura is already close to the pinnacle of ancient martial arts. If you can't kill Connor even with this, then the three of us might be in danger today!"
Colton said expressionlessly.
"Yeah, I didn't expect Connor to be so difficult to deal with!"
Soloman added.
"Obsidian Sword Art!"
At this moment, Yago had finally absorbed enough energy. He roared and slowly took out a black sword.
The sword aura on the longsword was very shocking, constantly emitting a black aura.
As Soloman and Colton's aura continued to enter Yago's body, the black sword aura around the Obsidian Sword also continued to grow.
As time passed, the black Sword Chi was nearly ten feet tall, as if it could break through the clouds at any time.
"This sword contains everything I've learned in my life. If I still can't kill you, then I can die without regrets!"
Yago said to Connor expressionlessly.
"I guess you will only regret when you are about to die!"
Connor replied.
Even though Yago's sword was indeed very powerful, Connor knew that it was impossible for it to kill him with its current power!
"Pfft!"
However, Yago spat out a mouthful of blood onto the Obsidian Sword.
The moment the blood touched the sword, the Sword Chi it was emitting increased by several times. It felt as if it was piercing through the clouds, and its power was self-evident.
When everyone present saw the Sword Chi that had erupted from the Obsidian Sword, they all revealed terrifying expressions. Their eyes were filled with disbelief.
"What…"
Stanley couldn't help but gasp and stutter, "What a shocking Sword Chi!"
"Yeah, I didn't expect Yago to be able to use such an amazing move!"
Felipe said.
"I wonder if the Soul Eater can block Yago's sword!"
Martian Lord said with a grave expression.
For a moment, the atmosphere in the Eight Trigrams Valley became very strange. It was as if the entire Eight Trigrams Valley was filled with Sword Chi.
"Go to hell!"
Yago bellowed as he brandished the Obsidian Sword in his hand!
In an instant, an incomparably terrifying Sword Chi shot straight at Connor. It gave people the feeling that a black dragon had descended from the sky, and its power was extremely shocking.
Everyone was at least a few hundred meters away from the battlefield, but they could still clearly feel the terrifying aura contained in this Sword Chi.
"..."
Connor narrowed his eyes as he looked at the terrifying Sword Chi that was heading straight for him. He could feel that the power of this Sword Chi was indeed very terrifying. He had never seen such a terrifying move!
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Vital Flow!"
Connor roared angrily, and an extremely terrifying aura erupted from his body.
In the next second, Connor rushed straight toward the location of the Sword Chi like a bolt of lightning.
Connor's speed was extremely fast, giving people the feeling that he was like a ray of light. It was even difficult for everyone to see Connor's movements clearly.
When Yago saw Connor make his move, he was shocked!
The moment the Sword Chi was released, Yago felt that all the energy in his body had been sucked dry. Furthermore, he seemed to be unable to withstand the terrifying power of the sword. Hence, after the Sword Chi was released, Yago's body kept trembling, and he was in great pain.
From this, one could see how terrifying Yago's sword was.
If it was a normal person, they would definitely choose to dodge the Sword Chi or think of a way to block Yago's Sword Chi.
However, what Yago didn't expect was that Connor didn't choose to dodge. Instead, he charged toward his position, wanting to use his fist to fight against the Sword Chi.
"What does he want to do? He didn't even dodge?"
Colton was a little shocked upon seeing this scene. He was in utter disbelief.
"Yeah. What is he trying to do? Is he crazy?"
Soloman seemed to find it unbelievable as well, and he hurriedly exclaimed.
Stanley, Wilda, and the others were also shocked when they saw this scene. They couldn't understand why Connor would do this.
Yago narrowed his eyes as he looked at Connor. Even though his face was expressionless, he was still very shocked because he felt that Connor's decision was a little too crazy.
Bang!
At this moment, a loud bang sounded between heaven and earth.
The Sword Chi fiercely collided with Connor's body. The Sword Chi left a shocking wound on Connor's chest, and blood instantly flowed out.
However, the Sword Chi didn't affect Connor's movements. Connor roared and broke through the Sword Chi to appear in front of Yago.
Yago looked at Connor in disbelief.
"How... How did you do it?"
Yago stared at Connor with wide eyes, shock written all over his face.
Connor didn't answer Yago's question. Instead, he punched Yago in the chest.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Yago was sent flying.
"Yago!"
When Colton saw this scene, he couldn't help but shout out loud. He knew very well that Connor's punch was different from the previous one.
Previously, Yago was still able to use the aura in his body to block most of the power of Connor's punch. However, after releasing the Sword Chi, the aura in Yago's body had long been exhausted. There was no aura in his body to block Connor's punch.
Hence, Connor's punch could cause terrifying damage to Yago.
As expected, Yago's body flew several hundred meters in the air before crashing into the mountain peak, creating a huge hole in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2121: Celestial Artifact Protection
chapters.content:
Chapter 2121: Celestial Artifact Protection
"It's over…"
When Soloman saw the hole not far away, his face was filled with despair.
"Huff…"
Connor took a deep breath and looked down at his chest.
He had to admit that the Sword Chi that Yago released was indeed terrifying. Even Connor's body couldn't withstand the power of the Sword Chi.
Blood slowly flowed out of Connor's chest.
Connor didn't have Yanni Boston's terrifying self-healing ability, so he couldn't heal his wounds within a short time. He could only use his breathing to suppress the blood in his body, not letting the blood flow out.
Yago wasn't completely dead after he was sent flying by Connor's punch. However, the power of Connor's punch was way too terrifying. Yago had already become a cripple. He couldn't even stand up. He could only lie there with empty eyes, as if he was no different from a dead man.
After Connor used his aura to suppress his wounds, he appeared in front of Yago in a flash.
"Who exactly are you? How did you block my Sword Chi just now?"
Yago shouted in a trembling voice, his face filled with anger.
"Why are you even asking questions like that now?"
Connor replied expressionlessly.
"Even if you want to kill me, you have to let me die with clarity!"
Yago replied through gritted teeth.
"Dead people don't need to know too much!"
Connor replied indifferently and then raised his right hand.
Yago looked at Connor, who was in front of him, and didn't say anything. At this moment, Yago was still in a state of shock. Everyone knew how terrifying the Sword Chi was, but Connor was still able to use his own body to block his Sword Chi. This was something that Yago had never expected.
"I didn't expect your strength to be so terrifying. I admit defeat!"
Yago closed his eyes slowly after he said that.
Connor waved his right hand after Yago closed his eyes.
An aura flew toward Yago's body.
At this moment, Connor didn't have any sympathy for people like Yago. If Connor was merciful and let Yago go, he would most likely be the one to die. Therefore, Connor had no other choice but to get rid of Yago first.
However, just as Connor's aura was about to hit Yago's body, a black light suddenly erupted around Yago's body.
The power of this black light was abnormally shocking. Moreover, it erupted when Connor was unprepared.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor was sent flying, and then he ruthlessly smashed into the mountain peak in the distance.
Everyone was stunned when they saw Connor who was sent flying. They were in disbelief because they thought that everything was over. No one expected Yago to be able to counterattack.
"Uncle Whalen, what's going on? That person had already been beaten up by Connor. Why was Connor still sent flying?"
Wilda asked Stanley anxiously.
"Yago wasn't the one who attacked the Soul Eater!"
Stanley said solemnly.
"The one who attacked Connor wasn't Yago?"
When Wilda heard this, she could not help but be stunned for a moment. She was very puzzled. She frowned and asked, "Uncle Whalen, what do you mean by that? If it wasn't Yago who attacked Connor, then who else could have attacked him?"
Wilda had been observing Connor just now. She did not see anyone else attack Connor.
"I didn't expect Yago to have a hidden card up his sleeve!"
Martian Lord couldn't help but sigh.
"That's right, a Celestial Artifact Protection!"
Felipe said.
Hearing the conversation between the two men, Wilda became even more puzzled. She turned to Stanley and asked, "Uncle Whalen, what are you guys talking about?"
"It wasn't Yago who attacked the Soul Eater, but Yago's Obsidian Sword!"
Stanley said to Wilda expressionlessly.
Wilda was in disbelief after hearing Stanley's words. She never thought that a sword would attack a martial artist on its own volition, and it could even produce such amazing power.
"I've only heard of the concept of a Celestial Artifact protecting one's body. Today is the first time I've seen it with my own eyes!"
Stanley looked at Wilda and explained, then he continued, "It is said that some high-level Celestial Artifacts can be connected to their master's bloodline. Once the master is fatally injured, the Celestial Artifact will sacrifice itself by projecting a very powerful attack to protect its master!"
"What?!"
Wilda took a deep breath, as if she did not know how to describe her feelings.
"There are many, many unbelievable things in the world of martial artists. I don't even know much, much less you!"
Stanley said expressionlessly.
At this moment, everyone was very solemn because they knew that once the Obsidian Sword really erupted with its strongest power, even a cultivator like Connor would find it difficult to handle the attack. Therefore, at this moment, everyone was worried about Connor.
Today's battle was full of twists and turns. Connor had made everyone regain their confidence again and again. Yago, Soloman, and Colton were not to be trifled with either. Even if the three of them lost today, they would still make people admire them from the bottom of their hearts because they had also displayed extremely terrifying combat strength today.
After Connor was sent flying by the Obsidian Sword, he smashed open a huge pit on the mountain peak. Moreover, Connor had already been seriously injured, so he was in a tattered state.
Yolanda's beautiful eyes were also filled with nervousness because she did not know what Connor's current situation was, nor did she know what she could do for Connor now.
In fact, a large part of the reason why Connor was able to fight against Yago, Soloman and Colton today was because Yolanda had given him the Profound Bead.
If Connor didn't have the help of the Profound Bead, he definitely wouldn't have been a match for the three of them today.
Colton and Soloman had been keeping an eye on Connor's position. Actually, they knew what was going to happen next. Yago was planning to trade his life for Connor's because he would only trigger the protection of the Obsidian Sword when he was in the most dangerous situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2122: Suicide
chapters.content:
Chapter 2122: Suicide
Soloman and Colton knew what would happen next.
However, they didn't seem to have any intention of stopping Yago. This was because they knew very well that if Yago didn't use this move, the three of them might die here today. Therefore, sacrificing Yago to kill Connor was the best choice.
However, Soloman and Colton were still very nervous. They knew that this was Yago's strongest move. If they couldn't kill Connor with this move, they would be in real danger.
At this moment, everyone's attention was focused on Connor.
In the blink of an eye, more than ten minutes had passed, but there was still no movement from Connor's side.
Yago couldn't help but laugh coldly seeing that there were no movements. "Looks like I've overestimated you, Connor. You couldn't even withstand a single strike from the Obsidian Sword."
Even though Yago knew that he had a narrow escape today, he didn't have any regrets. To be able to defeat a powerhouse like Connor, even if he had to sacrifice his life, he felt that it was worth it.
"I'm afraid this sword of yours won't be able to kill me!"
However, at this moment, a voice suddenly sounded in everyone's ears.
When everyone present heard this, they suddenly turned to look into the distance.
A figure emitting golden light was flying toward Yago at an astonishing speed.
"He's alive?"
Colton was a little shocked, while Soloman was obviously very solemn.
"The Soul Eater is still alive! That's great!"
"Yeah. The Soul Eater is still alive!"
"How is he still alive? How terrifying is the strength of the Soul Eater?"
For a moment, everyone present was excited.
The cultivators present supported Connor not only because of their own life and death. Some people were hoping that Connor could defeat Yago, Colton, and Soloman.
A few minutes later, Connor arrived in front of Yago.
Yago stared at Connor with his eyes wide open. He took a deep breath and gritted his teeth. "Connor, you surely didn't disappoint me. That sword really didn't kill you!"
"I am tough. I won't die so easily!"
Connor replied.
Everyone could not help but look at Connor. Although Connor was not dead, he looked very miserable. His body was covered in wounds, and blood was continuously flowing out of them.
"How strong is he? He's still alive after what he's gone through!"
Colton looked at Connor and sighed softly.
"Yeah, I can't believe it. He is way too strong!"
Soloman sighed.
Yolanda, Wilda, and the others heaved a long sigh of relief when they saw this scene. They then eased up a lot.
"..."
Yago glared at Connor with a furious expression.
"Do you still have any trump cards that you haven't shown?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"Trump card?"
Yago laughed coldly and closed his eyes.
Connor thought that Yago had given up on resisting, so he walked toward Yago.
"Connor, one day, I will personally kill you!"
However, Yago suddenly roared.
Everyone was confused when they heard Yago's words. After all, Yago was already dead in their eyes. Furthermore, with Connor's personality, he would never let Yago off. Yago was going to die today. There was no chance for revenge.
"Do you think you still have the chance to do so?"
Connor said lightly.
"Hehe, do you really think you can kill me today?"
As soon as Yago finished his sentence, everyone heard a loud bang.
Bang!
Yago's body exploded like a bomb, and a cloud of blood flew in all directions.
"Suicide?"
Wilda was stunned when she saw this scene.
The other martial artists present were also confused. They couldn't understand what was going on. After all, Yago had just said that he wanted to take revenge on Connor. Now, he had actually committed suicide. It was really confusing.
"..."
However, Connor's expression turned grave when he saw Yago's body explode.
Others might not know what was going on, but Connor was very familiar with such a move. He knew that Yago didn't commit suicide. Instead, he had given up on his physical body and allowed his soul to escape.
As expected, a soul flew out of the blood mist and flew into the sky like lightning.
"What... What's going on?"
Seeing Yago's soul, Wilda was in utter disbelief. She had never seen such a situation before.
"The thing that flew out just now… What was it?"
Wilda turned to look at Stanley and stuttered.
"It was probably his soul!"
Stanley explained.
"Soul?"
When Wilda heard that, her eyes instantly widened. She was dumbfounded because she had never seen a real soul before. This was the first time she had seen something as legendary as a soul.
"I didn't expect souls to really exist in this world!"
Wilda could not help but sigh.
Ever since the start of this battle, too many things had happened that Wilda found remarkable. Therefore, even if it was a soul she had seen, Wilda was no longer all that surprised.
Stanley narrowed his eyes and looked at Connor without saying anything.
At this moment, Stanley was extremely curious about how Connor planned to deal with Yago's soul. After all, the soul was different from the physical body. Ordinary attacks wouldn't cause any damage to the soul.
When Soloman and Colton saw that Yago was planning to leave, they hesitated for a moment. After exchanging glances, Soloman said softly, "We should run. Otherwise, we might not have the chance later!"
"Alright!"
Colton seemed to have the same intention. Therefore, after hearing Soloman's words, he did not hesitate at all and nodded in agreement.
After Soloman and Colton finished talking, they flew away.

chapters.title: Chapter 2123: Such an Ending
chapters.content:
Chapter 2123: Such an Ending
"It's a little too late to escape now, don't you think?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he saw that they were planning to escape.
After saying that, Connor's figure flashed and appeared in front of Yago before throwing a punch.
When Yago saw Connor, he couldn't help but sneer. He said in a disdainful tone, "Do you think you can still hurt me now?"
Connor was not perturbed at all. He used his fist to smash into Yago's soul.
"Ahh!"
Yago let out a horrifying scream before his soul started to dissipate.
"How... How was this possible? How do you know how to use the power of the soul?"
Yago didn't expect Connor's punch to contain so much soul power. An ordinary martial artist's attack wouldn't be able to harm Yago's soul unless they knew how to use the power of the soul. However, this was very rare because there were barely any martial artists who truly understood the power of the soul.
However, Yago didn't know that Connor already knew how to use the power of the soul because of Carl Benjamin. Hence, it was very easy for Connor to completely wipe out Yago's soul.
In the end, Yago had missed this point. He thought that he could use the protection of the Obsidian Sword to heavily injure Connor and then use his soul power to sacrifice his physical body to escape. However, he didn't expect Connor to be proficient in the power of the soul as well.
If Connor was proficient in the power of the soul, it would be very easy for him to completely wipe out Yago's soul.
Sure enough, in less than two seconds, Yago's soul disappeared from the world.
When everyone saw Yago's soul completely dissipate, they were filled with disbelief. This was because they felt that everything that they had seen today was way too fictional. If they hadn't seen this scene with their own eyes, who would have thought that Connor could still unleash such terrifying combat power when facing three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters!
"As expected of the Soul Eater!"
"Yeah, this is unbelievable. I can't believe Yago died just like that…"
"The Soul Eater is probably the strongest martial artist in the world right now!"
Everyone began to discuss in a low voice, and each of them looked at Connor with admiration.
Soloman and Colton became even more nervous when they found out that Yago had been killed by Connor. They knew that Connor would make a move on them immediately after he killed Yago. Hence, they could only try their best to escape. That way, they might still have a chance of survival. Otherwise, they might end up worse than Yago.
After Connor killed Yago, he turned to look at Colton and waved his right hand.
A golden aura flew toward Colton like a bolt of lightning.
"What kind of monster is this person? Why is his aura still so dense right now?"
Colton looked at the golden aura that was coming toward him, and a trace of shock flashed in his eyes. He hurriedly raised his right hand, trying to use his aura to block Connor's attack.
However, although Connor was seriously injured, his aura was still at its peak due to the existence of the Profound Bead. Colton had already consumed most of his aura after using the Immortal Fusion Technique, so he was unable to block Connor's attack.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Colton's body smashed into the ground, creating a huge crater.
Moreover, Connor did not give Colton any chance to react. His figure flashed and appeared in front of Colton again.
"No, no, no. Don't kill me…"
When Colton saw Connor appear in front of her, he was a little afraid. He stammered and wanted to beg Connor for mercy.
However, Connor didn't give Colton the chance at all. He waved his right hand gently, and a stream of aura penetrated Colton's body.
Colton's body trembled slightly twice, and he immediately lost his vitality.
"Another one died?"
Seeing this scene, Stanley's eyes instantly widened, and he was very shocked.
The others present were also shocked speechless. They stood rooted to the ground with their eyes wide open, not knowing how to describe their feelings.
This was because the current scene was way too shocking in their eyes.
The heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters that were like immortals in their eyes were now like ordinary people in front of Connor, easily killed by him.
Two of the three heaven-rank martial arts grandmasters had already died in Connor's hands, and the last one, Soloman, was probably going to die soon.
Soloman looked extremely nervous. He could not help but speed up, wanting to leave this place.
When Soloman first learned that he was coming to kill Connor, he didn't take it to heart. After all, Yago, Colton, and Soloman had killed countless heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters over the years. Therefore, when the three of them learned that they were coming to kill Connor, they saw it as an ordinary mission. They didn't expect that they would end up like this.
Just as Soloman was thinking about his life choices, Connor had already rushed up to him.
Soloman raised his head and looked at Connor. His face was filled with fear, and he opened his mouth to speak.
However, before Soloman could finish his sentence, Connor waved his right hand and sent a stream of energy toward Soloman.
When Soloman faced Connor's attack, his face was filled with despair. He knew very well that it was impossible to block Connor's attack in his current state because most of the aura in his body had been exhausted!
Bang!
However, at this moment, a loud bang suddenly sounded.
An aura blocked Soloman's path and helped him resolve the crisis.

chapters.title: Chapter 2124: Zidane Quinton
chapters.content:
Chapter 2124: Zidane Quinton
"I didn't expect you to have more help."
Seeing that someone had helped Soloman block his attack, his expression changed.
Soloman himself was surprised. After all, there were only Colton, Yago, and himself who came to besiege Connor. The Land Deities did not send any other people, so Soloman did not know who helped him.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor slowly raised his head and looked behind him.
A middle-aged man in a green robe slowly walked out of the valley.
Connor sized up the middle-aged man from head to toe. He could feel that this middle-aged man was probably a heaven-rank ancient martial grandmaster. If Connor was at his peak, he wouldn't be afraid of this middle-aged man. However, Connor had just experienced a huge battle with Yago and the others, so he wasn't in good condition. He would reach his limit at any time.
"Who are you?"
Connor asked the middle-aged man.
"I am Zidane Quinton!"
The middle-aged man replied calmly.
"What? This person is the Hall Master of Origin Hall, Zidane Quinton!"
"How is that possible? Isn't he a martial artist from a few hundred years ago? How is he still alive?"
"Yeah, how many years has Zidane been dead? This person can't possibly be Zidane, and Zidane definitely can't be so young!"
When everyone found out the identity of the middle-aged man, they began to discuss in low voices. It was obvious that these people were very surprised by the identity of this middle-aged man.
"Uncle Whalen, who is this person?"
Wilda Zerbe was confused after hearing everyone's discussion. She couldn't help but ask Stanley Whalen softly.
"Zidane was an ancient martial arts expert from a hundred years ago in Sommervile. I don't know much about this person. I've only heard of his name!"
Stanley explained in a low voice.
"How could a martial artist from a few hundred years ago still be alive?"
Wilda asked with her big watery eyes.
"If Zidane had broken through to the heaven realm a hundred years ago, this could explain why!"
Stanley said expressionlessly.
Wilda looked at Stanley with a shocked expression because too many things had happened today that she couldn't understand.
"Mr. Quinton!"
When Soloman saw Zidane, his face was filled with excitement as he hurriedly shouted.
He had never thought that Zidane would save him in such a situation. Soloman had already lost all hope.
Zidane merely glanced at Soloman indifferently, as if he had no intention of responding to Soloman.
"Are you here to save this person?"
Connor asked Zidane expressionlessly.
"You are Jorge Yarrell's disciple, right?"
Zidane didn't answer Connor's question but asked him a question instead.
"You know my master?"
When Connor heard this, his eyes revealed a trace of excitement. After all, the most important thing for Connor in coming to France this time was to find Jorge's whereabouts.
"I do. Your master and I are old acquaintances, and this person's master is also an old friend of mine. So, what do you think about making a deal today?"
Zidane said slowly.
"Deal?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Zidane's words. He then frowned and asked, "What kind of deal do you want to make?"
"Your purpose in coming to the Eight Trigrams Valley this time is to find your master's whereabouts, right? I know where your master is. As long as you let this person go, I'll tell you where your master is!"
Zidane said calmly.
"Do you know where my master is?"
When Connor heard Zidane's words, he seemed to become even more excited.
"Of course, I do!"
Zidane nodded.
Connor looked at Zidane and hesitated for a couple of seconds. He knew that Zidane was not lying to him. Zidane might really know where Jorge was.
Connor and Soloman didn't have any personal grudges, so killing Soloman wasn't important to Connor.
"Alright, I agree to your conditions. I'll spare this person today!"
Connor said to Soloman.
"Alright!"
Zidane smiled faintly and said to Soloman expressionlessly, "What are you still standing there for? Hurry up and get lost!"
"Mr. Quinton, thank you for saving me today. I will repay you a hundredfold in the future!"
Soloman shouted excitedly upon knowing that he was safe. Then, he turned around and flew away without thinking.
After Soloman left, Connor said expressionlessly, "I've already let this person go. Can you tell me where my master is?"
"Follow me!"
Zidane did not waste any time. He turned around and turned into a green light as he flew into the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Connor turned and looked at Yolanda. He knew that the Eight Trigrams Valley was filled with danger. There might be traps set by Zidane. After all, Connor did not know this person. He could not trust this person 100%.
If Connor brought Yolanda into the Eight Trigrams Valley, it would put Yolanda in danger. Therefore, the best choice now was for Connor to enter the Eight Trigrams Valley alone.
Yolanda hesitated for a moment. She opened her mouth and wanted to say something, but she also knew that Jorge was very important to Connor. Connor would definitely not miss this opportunity, so even if she tried to persuade Connor, he would probably not listen to her.
After Connor left with Zidane, only the experts from France, Wilda, Stanley, and Yolanda were left in front of the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Everyone looked at the mess in front of the Eight Trigrams Valley, and their faces were filled with shock and fear. Today's battle had opened their eyes, and now they understood how terrifying a true heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmaster was.
"Facing three heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters alone and killing two of them in a row… Just how terrifyingly strong is he?!"
Stanley couldn't help but sigh softly.
"..."
Felipe Winters took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Back then, the Soul Eater killed the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader and was already famous in the ancient martial arts world. If this matter were to spread out today, it would probably cause another huge commotion in the ancient martial arts world!"
"Yeah. Back then, killing the Blood Moon Sect's cult leader caused such a huge commotion. Today, he killed two heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. This will set off a huge wave in the ancient martial arts world!"
Martian Lord added.

chapters.title: Chapter 2125: The Ancestral Master
chapters.content:
Chapter 2125: The Ancestral Master
When everyone heard that, they looked at each other with solemn expressions.
At this moment, they did not know what to say.
Of course, there was another important thing for these martial artists—they now knew that heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters existed in this world. This news was very important to those martial artists in the ancient martial arts world.
At the same time.
On a small island in the Pacific Ocean.
An old man in a white robe narrowed his eyes as he looked at the screen in front of him. Beside him were a few other old men who had extraordinary auras.
These people were the pinnacle ancient martial artists of the Land Deities. They could be considered the strongest martial artists in the world.
The screen in front of them was playing the battle between Connor, Yago, Colton and Soloman.
"I didn't expect this child's strength to be so terrifying. Even Yago, Colton and Soloman weren't his match!"
The white-robed old man said expressionlessly.
"Yes, it's been so many years since a genius like this has appeared in Sommervile!"
Another old man said.
"Old Immortal, Colton and Yago are both dead, and Soloman is seriously injured. What should we do next?"
At this moment, a middle-aged man asked the white-robed old man.
"..."
Upon hearing this, the old man in white hesitated for a couple of seconds and said in a low voice, "What do you think we should do?"
"We can't let Connor live. A few heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters of the Land Deities have already died in Connor's hands..."
A guardian said.
"Guardian Weldon is right!"
"Yes, I agree. Otherwise, there will be endless trouble in the future!"
Everyone chimed in.
"Of course, we can't let Connor live!"
The white-robed old man nodded gently.
"I have already arranged for people to set up explosives near the Eight Trigrams Valley. Old Immortal, as long as you give the green light, the entire Eight Trigrams Valley will be razed to the ground!"
The middle-aged man said excitedly.
"..."
The old man in white hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he shook his head gently and said expressionlessly, "That won't do…"
"Why?"
Guardian Weldon hurriedly asked.
"There are many ordinary people in the Eight Trigrams Valley now. If we set up explosives in the Eight Trigrams Valley, these ordinary people will also die in the valley. This will probably cause a great turmoil in France."
The white-robed old man said calmly.
"But Old Immortal, if we let these people leave the Eight Trigrams Valley, the secret of the Land Deities might also be exposed!"
Guardian Weldon said in a low voice.
"Does it matter? I've been guarding this secret for so many years. Since someone already knows about this secret, then let them be!"
Old Immortal said indifferently.
Everyone looked at the expression on Old Immortal's face and seemed a little puzzled. They did not seem to understand his decision.
After all, now was the best opportunity to kill Connor. It would not be so easy to find such an opportunity in the future.
However, these people also knew the strength of Old Immortal. They did not dare to disobey Old Immortal's orders. Anyone who disobeyed his orders would die.
…
On the other side, Connor followed Zidane into the Eight Trigrams Valley.
Boom!
When Connor entered the Eight Trigrams Valley, he could clearly feel the existence of the array. Moreover, the power of this array was very terrifying. It was different from all the arrays that Connor had come into contact with before.
"I didn't expect such a terrifying array to exist in this world!"
Connor could not help but sigh softly.
"If this array was placed a hundred years ago, it wouldn't be considered a top-notch array at all. It's just that ancient martial arts have fallen into a decline now, so there are very few martial arts practitioners who can set up such an array!"
Zidane whispered to Connor.
"..."
Connor looked at Zidane indifferently and said in a low voice, "You said that you know where my master is. You'd better not lie to me, or I'll kill you right here!"
"Hahaha!"
When Zidane heard Connor's words, he couldn't help but laugh out loud. Then, he said indifferently, "Your personality is exactly the same as your master's. The two of you are really similar!"
"I'm not in the mood to listen to your nonsense. Where is my master?"
Connor frowned and asked Zidane.
"Your master is in this array!"
Zidane narrowed his eyes and said.
"My master is in this array formation?"
Connor could not help but be stunned when he heard Zidane's words. He was very puzzled.
"That's right, your master is in this array!"
Zidane looked at Connor and nodded.
"How do you know that?"
Connor asked Zidane cautiously.
It was obvious that Connor did not believe Zidane's words 100%. After all, Connor did not know who Zidane was and what his relationship with his master was. If Zidane had Connor enter the array and then kill him, it would be troublesome.
"It's a long story…"
Zidane sighed softly and continued, "Actually, if we're talking about seniority, you should call me Ancestral Master!"
"Ancestral Master?"
Connor frowned, not understanding what Zidane meant.
"I have lived in this world for nearly 200 years, and I am from the same sect as your master's master. However, I later established the Origin Sect, and your ancestor was in the Purple Cloud Sect. My personality is somewhat similar to your master's, and I don't pay much attention to the matters of the sect. This also led to the Origin Sect being annexed by the Purple Cloud Sect."
Zidane looked at Connor and explained.
When Connor heard Zidane's words, he was in disbelief. He didn't think that Zidane would have such a connection with Jorge and himself.
"How can you prove that what you said is true? Why should I believe you?"
Connor asked.
Zidane wasn't angry at Connor's questions. After all, Connor had too many enemies. If he didn't give Connor some evidence, Connor would naturally not believe Zidane.

chapters.title: Chapter 2126: Let's Talk About Serious Matters
chapters.content:
Chapter 2126: Let's Talk About Serious Matters
"Do you recognize this jade pendant?" Zidane said as he took out a jade pendant from his clothes and handed it to Connor.
After hesitating for a moment, Connor accepted the jade pendant, and his expression appeared somewhat shocked. This was because he noticed that Zidane 's jade pendant was identical to the one given to him by Jorge. However, Jorge's pendant had a dragon carving, while Connor also possessed a phoenix pendant. Zidane 's pendant had a tiger-shaped pattern.
"Do you remember that my master had four disciples? One of them was me, and the other was your Ancestral Master. Your Ancestral Master passed the dragon pendant to your Master, who then passed it on to you. Now, you should be able to believe what I'm saying, right?" Zidane said with an expressionless face.
Connor scrutinized Zidane for a moment, then handed the jade pendant back to him and said earnestly, "I pay my respects to you, Ancestral Master."
"Hahaha, there's no need for such formality between us," Zidane waved his hand and continued, "Let's get to the point."
"Alright." Connor nodded.
"Back then, your master accidentally obtained a treasure map and came to the Eight Trigrams Valley to search for hidden treasures, hoping to find a way to break through to the Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster. I also obtained this treasure map and came here," Zidane explained. "When your master saw me, he was quite surprised, as I had been pursued by the Land Deities for a long time after breaking through to the Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster. I spent most of my time hiding in the wilderness and mountains, never revealing myself. This led many to believe that I had died, including your master."
"I see," Connor nodded quietly, waiting for Zidane to continue.
"After meeting your master, I informed him of the secrets of the Land Deities. The main reason your master couldn't break through to the Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster for so many years was the influence of the inner demon. The Land Deities had been spreading rumors that there were no Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmasters in the world, planting seeds of doubt in the minds of many martial artists, which led to the emergence of inner demons during their breakthroughs," he continued to explain.
"I never realized that the influence of the inner demon could be so significant for a martial artist," Connor couldn't help but sigh.
"Most martial artists in this world haven't been as fortunate as you. They have achieved their current status through perseverance and hard work," Zidane said thoughtfully, eyeing Connor. "With my assistance, your master successfully broke through to the Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster. We planned to enter the hidden treasure together after this formation is opened. After all, several Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmasters from the Land Deities also arrived, so our chances would be higher if we teamed up."
"Then, did you encounter the Land Deities' people?" Connor seemed to have guessed what happened next.
"Yes, before we entered the formation, we were ambushed by those people. There were four Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmasters and four Earth Rank Ancient Martial Grandmasters among them. Your master and I fought them for two days and two nights, but the battle ended in a draw. The time for the formation to close was limited, and if we missed that window, we would have to wait a long time for it to reopen. I thought your master needed the treasures inside more than I did, so I forcibly sent him into the hidden treasure," Zidane explained.
"Why hasn't my master come out then?" Connor anxiously asked.
"I initially thought that your master and I were the first to arrive here, so I believed no one had entered the hidden treasure yet. However, I didn't expect that there were already two people inside the formation when we arrived. I could sense their weakened aura, indicating they had just experienced a fierce battle. But your master hasn't come out," Zidane finally revealed the entire story.
Now Connor understood the situation better. Jorge had indeed come for the hidden treasure, but he had been besieged by two individuals inside the formation, preventing him from leaving.
"Do you mean to say my master is trapped inside the hidden treasure and can't get out?" Connor asked in a low voice.
"Yes," Zidane nodded.
"That's a relief," Connor sighed deeply. As long as Jorge was alive inside, there was still hope.
"To be honest, it's partially my fault. If I hadn't sent your master into the formation, these events might not have occurred," Zidane sighed softly, then continued, "After the formation closed, I remained in the Eight Trigrams Valley trying to decipher the formation. However, my strength alone is limited, and breaking the formation requires a significant amount of energy. I couldn't do it alone."
"So, you released the message that there's a hidden treasure here, and those French martial artists came to help you break the formation?" Connor realized that Zidane had spread the rumor to attract help.
"Exactly." He nodded, then explained further, "My original plan was to bring these martial artists into the valley and use their collective strength to break the formation. But I didn't expect you to come as well, and you encountered the Land Deities' people. However, this may work out even better. I assume you have some kind of immortal tool that can provide you with a significant amount of energy, which will allow us to break the formation together."
"Why did you let me spare Soloman Wilcox earlier? Do you really know that person?" Connor asked with some doubt.
"Soloman?" Zidane couldn't help but sneer when he heard this, then continued, "He is just a junior. How could I possibly know him?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2127: Breaking the Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 2127: Breaking the Formation
"Since you don't know him, why did you help him and ask me to spare him?" Connor furrowed his brows and asked.
"You may not know this, but Soloman's master is one of the Land Deities' protectors, ranking just below the elder immortals. If you were to kill him today, they would never let you go. Our top priority now is to find a way to rescue your master, so I asked you to spare him. This way, we won't completely enrage the Land Deities," Zidane explained calmly.
"I see," Connor nodded, understanding that his actions were correct.
Soloman, unlike Colton and Yago, had a lower status among the Land Deities, and even if Connor killed him, it wouldn't have a significant impact. However, if he killed Soloman, the Land Deities would go to great lengths to seek revenge, potentially jeopardizing his mission to rescue Jorge.
"Although your master still has some vitality left, his aura is extremely weak. So, we must act quickly to break the formation and save him," Zidane said, looking at Connor.
"How should we break this formation?" Connor asked hastily.
"Since you don't understand the art of formations, you wouldn't know how to break it. Fortunately, I learned some formation techniques from my master. This formation isn't too difficult, but it requires a substantial amount of energy to break," Zidane explained. "Now, you have two choices."
"What are the two choices?" Connor inquired.
"You can follow me into the formation to provide me with energy while I break it, or you can lend me your Celestial Artifact, and I'll enter alone to break the formation," Zidane paused for a moment, then continued, "This formation is very dangerous, so if you enter, there may be risks."
"I'll go with you. The Profound Bead was a gift from someone else, and I don't know how to take it out at the moment," Connor replied calmly.
In truth, he still had some reservations and mistrust towards Zidane, so he wasn't willing to easily give him the Profound Bead.
"Alright." Zidane nodded in agreement.
"When do we start?" Connor asked while examining the formation.
Zidane glanced at him, then took out a pill from his clothing and handed it to Connor. He whispered, "You have injuries on your body. Let's heal those first."
Connor hesitated for a moment before accepting the pill. He seemed unsure whether to consume it or not.
"Don't worry; it's not poison. If I wanted to kill you, I would have done it already, and I wouldn't be talking to you like this," Zidane said softly.
Taking a deep breath, Connor placed the pill in his mouth and felt a mysterious energy entering his body. His wounds visibly began to heal at an astonishing rate.
"This pill is truly remarkable," he said in amazement as he observed his wounds rapidly healing.
"This is a top-grade pill. If it weren't for needing your help to break the formation, I wouldn't have given it to you for free," Zidane replied calmly. Then, he stepped into the formation without hesitation.
In less than half a minute, all of Connor's wounds had completely healed.
Taking a deep breath, he followed Zidane into the formation.
Upon entering the formation, Connor could sense the formation reacting. Countless black mists rushed towards him, but he quickly used his energy to protect himself.
"Although this formation is a maze, once someone enters, it's incredibly challenging to leave. Furthermore, it's a killing formation, and even a Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Grandmaster can die within it with a slight misstep," Zidane said, turning to Connor as he explained.
"I understand," Connor nodded.
"This formation has a total of nine layers. I've already broken the first layer. Now, you just need to follow me and provide me with energy as we proceed," Zidane said.
"I understand," Connor agreed.
After breaking the second layer of the formation, Zidane stopped and turned to Connor, saying, "I spent a full seven days breaking this layer, but due to the lack of energy, I couldn't completely break it. Now, you just need to follow behind me and provide energy."
"I understand," Connor replied.
The two continued to work together, with Connor providing energy while Zidane used his knowledge to decipher the formation. Three days passed as they advanced through the layers of the formation.
Once they broke the eighth layer of the formation, Connor found himself in a vast open space with various flowers, plants, and trees, creating a beautiful scene, as if it were a painting.

chapters.title: Chapter 2128: Meeting Jorge Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 2128: Meeting Jorge Again
"Didn't you say this formation has nine layers?" Connor asked with some confusion.
"You're right; this is the ninth layer of the formation," Zidane replied calmly.
"This... this is the ninth layer of the formation?" Connor was astonished when he heard Zidane's words, freezing in place with a surprised expression on his face.
"All of this is just an illusion you see. The ninth layer of this formation is the most dangerous, and I don't know how many people have died in it," Zidane explained with an expressionless face.
After hearing his explanation, Connor hesitated for two seconds and then asked softly, "So what should we do next?"
"There's no way to break this formation; we'll have to force our way through," he replied in a low voice, then stepped into the formation.
After a moment's hesitation, Connor followed him into the formation.
As they entered, the ground began to shake violently.
"Be careful; this formation is extremely dangerous," Zidane warned in a hushed tone as they walked further into the formation.
"I understand," Connor replied.
However, just as he spoke, countless fireballs began flying toward their position at a terrifying speed.
Zidane quickly raised a white barrier in front of them, and the fireballs disappeared upon impact.
"These fireballs seem quite powerful," Connor whispered to him.
"This is just the beginning; the real challenge is yet to come," Zidane replied with an expressionless face, continuing forward through the formation.
With Zidane leading the way, Connor had a relatively easier time navigating the formation.
But then, numerous ice spikes flew toward them, followed by a roaring flood.
He knew that while Zidane could handle the ice spikes, stopping the flood would be challenging.
He swiftly waved his hand, creating another barrier in front of them to block the flood and ice spikes.
After several minutes, the flood and ice spikes subsided.
Taking a deep breath, Zidane continued forward, with Connor following closely behind.
As they progressed deeper into the formation, its power became increasingly terrifying. The formation's attacks were unconventional, and their frequency was relentless. Initially, they managed to cope, but as time went on, even Connor found it challenging.
The situation was no better for Zidane.
The attacks from the formation were not particularly powerful, but their frequency was overwhelming.
"It should be over soon; just hold on!" Zidane said, looking back at Connor and gritting his teeth as he continued forward.
"I understand," Connor replied in a low voice.
After walking through the formation for nearly 100 meters, the attacks finally ceased.
"Is it over?" Connor asked Zidane when he saw an opening.
"Not yet." Zidane shook his head.
Suddenly, there was a loud noise that shook the heavens and the earth, and a black mist rushed toward them.
Without hesitation, Connor rushed towards the mist, ready to strike it with his fist.
"Be careful!" Zidane shouted, grabbing Connor.
Connor turned to look at him, his expression puzzled.
"That black mist is full of malevolent energy. Even if you survive, you'll be severely injured," Zidane explained in a hushed tone.
"So, what should we do now?" Connor asked, with the black mist only a short distance away.
Zidane hesitated for a moment, then waved his hand, sending a golden light towards the mist.
A loud collision echoed through the area as the golden light clashed with the black mist.
After the black mist dissipated completely, Connor realized that everything they had encountered was just an illusion. The flowers, plants, trees, and attacks were all products of his imagination. The most crucial aspect of the formation was overcoming their inner obstacles.
Zidane had finally succeeded in breaking the last layer of the formation.
When the last layer of the formation was broken, an entrance to a hidden chamber appeared before them.
"Did we succeed?" Connor asked excitedly when he saw the entrance.
"It should be," Zidane replied cautiously, squinting as he examined the entrance.
"What are we waiting for? Let's go in!" Connor didn't want to waste any more time and rushed into the hidden chamber.
Once inside, Connor felt that the spiritual energy was even denser than outside. The chamber was filled with various immortal treasures, artifacts, and secret manuals. However, Connor was too focused on finding Jorge to pay much attention to these items. He called out for Jorge as he moved from room to room, searching for him.
Zidane had split up from Connor to search for Jorge as well.
"Connor, I found him!" Zidane's voice echoed through the chamber.
Connor hurriedly rushed to the room where Zidane was. When he entered the room, he saw Jorge sitting on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 2129: Ghostly Spirit Curse
chapters.content:
Chapter 2129: Ghostly Spirit Curse
However, Jorge's current condition was extremely terrible. He sat on the ground motionless, his eyes tightly shut. Although there was still a faint breath in his body, it was extremely weak. What was even more perplexing was that his skin had lost all its luster, giving the impression of a lifeless body. His heart rate was also incredibly slow.
"Old man!" Connor's body trembled slightly as he almost gritted his teeth to call out these three words. But Jorge showed no response and continued to sit quietly.
"Old man, can you hear me? I'm calling you; can you hear me?" He shouted with bloodshot eyes, as if he had gone mad, yelling with all his might. "Old man, you like money, right? How much money do you want? I'll give it to you right now. Can you say something to me?"
Connor tried to hold back his tears, but his voice gradually choked up. Since the death of his parents, he had no relatives left, and he had long forgotten the taste of family bonds. However, upon meeting Jorge, he had felt a sense of kinship from him. Although he had never expressed it, this feeling had always been deeply hidden in his heart. In his eyes, Jorge was an invincible figure, and he had never worried about his safety, nor had he ever imagined such a situation.
"Try to calm down a bit now," Zidane reminded him in a low voice.
"What happened to my master? He was perfectly fine, so why did he become like this?" Connor shouted in great agitation.
"I don't know what's happening right now..." Zidane shook his head as he walked to Jorge's side and placed his hand on Jorge's shoulder.
Connor's body continued to tremble incessantly, and he couldn't bring himself to look at Jorge. In his eyes, Jorge had always been an invincible existence. Therefore, he had never worried about his safety, and he had never thought such a thing could happen.
A few minutes later, Zidane finally removed his hand from Jorge's body.
"What's going on?" Connor asked him as soon as he saw him remove his hand.
"It's Ghostly Spirit Curse," Zidane gritted his teeth and replied.
"Ghostly Spirit Curse?" Connor paused for a moment upon hearing his words, his expression filled with confusion.
"The Ghostly Spirit Curse has disappeared for nearly a hundred years. I never expected that someone in this world would still be capable of using such a curse. It's truly incredible..." Zidane said in a low voice.
"So, what exactly is this curse?" Connor asked.
"The Ghostly Spirit Curse is one of the oldest and cruelest curses in this world. I once saw a person who was cursed with it; he only lived for three days before being tortured to death. Initially, the Ghostly Spirit Curse continuously consumes the blood in your body, turning it into toxins that flow within you. Once someone is cursed with the Ghostly Spirit Curse, even a supreme martial master would find it nearly impossible to survive!" Zidane explained.
Upon hearing this, Connor took a deep breath and asked through gritted teeth, "Is it the person you mentioned who cursed my master?"
"This is just my speculation; I can't be sure. At that time, I didn't pay attention to those two individuals who escaped from the formation, as my focus was on the land immortals' group. I don't know who those two people were," Zidane said in a low voice.
"I understand what you mean," Connor nodded.
"Although I can't confirm if it was the King of Shadows who cursed your master, perhaps he knows how to break this formation. Your master is a Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Master. If we can break the curse on him, he might still have a chance," Zidane said, looking at Jorge.
"I understand," Connor said resolutely. "How long can my master hold on?"
"He should be able to last about a month at most. After that, the dense spiritual energy in this treasure trove will likely dissipate. If we can't break the Ghostly Spirit Curse by then, even if immortals come, it might be too late to save your master," Zidane said.
"Alright, please take care of my master during this time. I'm leaving now to find the King of Shadows!" Connor didn't want to waste a single moment and headed towards the exit of the treasure trove.
"Wait!" Just at that moment, Zidane suddenly reached out to stop Connor.
Connor turned to look at Zidane, his expression puzzled, and asked in a low voice, "Is there anything else?"
"I know that the headquarters of the Shadow Guild is in Risu. If you want to find the King of Shadows, you can inquire there for information," Zidane suggested.
"Alright, I understand." Connor nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2130: Finding Wilda Zerba
chapters.content:
Chapter 2130: Finding Wilda Zerba
"You're not familiar with the King of Shadows. In fact, he is a genuine Celestial-ranked ancient martial master, and he could break through to the pinnacle of ancient martial arts at any time. So, going there now might be dangerous. Take my sword with you; it might save your life when the time is critical."
While speaking, Zidane handed a jade pendant to Connor.
Without hesitation, Connor accepted the jade pendant. He knew that immortal weapons could transform into various shapes, and in today's society, carrying a sword openly would draw attention. To avoid unnecessary trouble, Zidane had transformed his sword into a jade pendant and wore it.
Connor had no time to exchange further words with Zidane. After taking the jade pendant, he walked directly towards the exit of the treasure trove.
Once outside the treasure trove, he leaped into the sky.
Originally, he had planned to fly to the airport and take a flight to Risu. Despite his ability to fly, the Eight Trigrams Valley was still hundreds of thousands of kilometers away from the Risu, making it impossible for him to fly there directly. Taking a plane was the most practical option.
However, as he flew to the entrance of the Eight Trigrams Valley, he noticed that Wilda, Stanley, and the others had already left, leaving only Yolanda waiting quietly at the entrance.
Connor went directly to Yolanda.
Upon seeing him, her expression appeared somewhat excited, and she hurriedly asked, "Connor, you're out? Did you find Master Jorge?"
"I found him." Connor replied with a nod.
"Why didn't you come out with Master Jorge?" Yolanda asked, looking behind Connor but not finding Jorge.
"I don't have time to explain everything right now. I'm heading to the Risu for something urgent. It's not safe for you to accompany me. I'll take you to the airport, and you can take a flight back to Sommervile on your own. Do you understand what I mean?" Connor said seriously to Yolanda.
She hesitated for a moment and then nodded in agreement. She could sense that something was amiss with his emotions at the moment. His tone was very serious. She desperately wanted to know what had happened, but she also realized that he might not have the time or mood to explain it to her.
Without any hesitation, he reached out and embraced her slender waist, then took off into the sky.
Yolanda was held in Connor's arms, feeling somewhat embarrassed. However, when she saw the serious expression on his face, she calmed down. She really wanted to know what had happened, but she also understood that now might not be the time for him to share it with her. So, she quietly leaned against his chest.
After about ten minutes, Connor arrived at the airport in France. However, he soon realized that there were very few flights from France to the Risu, and the earliest flight to the Risu wouldn't be until the following afternoon. The flight to Sommervile was scheduled for the next morning.
Given the current situation, he couldn't afford to waste any time waiting until the next afternoon. He had no intention of waiting here.
Originally, he had considered flying to a neighboring country of France to check for flights. But after inquiring, he realized that even if he flew to the neighboring country, it would be nighttime, and there would be no flights to the Risu.
He stood in the airport, feeling increasingly anxious about what to do.
"Connor, why are you in such a hurry to go to the Risu? What's going on?" Yolanda asked in a hesitant tone after a moment of contemplation.
He turned to look at her, and after giving it some thought, he briefly explained the situation to her.
"A curse like this exists? It's truly unbelievable," she said, her expression filled with anger upon hearing what had happened.
"My master has at most one month left, so I need to find a way to break the Ghostly Spirit Curse as soon as possible," he said in a low voice.
Yolanda hesitated for a moment and then whispered, "Connor, I have a way to help you get to the Risu faster."
"What way?" Connor asked eagerly.
"Well, do you remember Wilda, who accompanied us to the Eight Trigrams Valley before? Her family has a plane. You could use their plane to get to the Risu, which might be faster than taking a commercial flight," she suggested.
"That's indeed a good idea!" Connor nodded. Commercial flights had fixed schedules, required waiting for all passengers, and often made stopovers in other cities, which could waste a lot of time.
"But with a country as large as Koswa, won't it be difficult to find Wilda?" Connor wasn't worried that Wilda wouldn't help. After all, Wilda was now well aware of his capabilities. If necessary, he could simply threaten her.
"I have her business card." Yolanda took out a business card and handed it to him, explaining, "When we left the valley, Wilda gave me her business card and told me that if I needed anything in France, I could call her.
