At the time, I didn't pay much attention, but I didn't expect the business card to come in handy."
"That's great," he said, excited by the idea. He dialed Wilda's number.
"Ring... ring..." After a few rings, Wilda answered the call.
"Who is this?" Her voice came through the phone.
"I'm Connor, and I need your help with something urgent," he said directly.
"Connor?" She was momentarily stunned upon hearing the name.
"Where are you right now? I'll come find you!" Connor continued.
"I'm at the Gral Manor. Why are you looking for me? What's going on?" she stuttered as she mentioned her current location.
He didn't bother answering her question. He simply hung up the phone and flew toward the Gral Manor's location with Yolanda.
A few minutes later, Connor and Yolanda arrived at the Gral Manor.
Wilda had been waiting at the manor's entrance for some time.
Upon seeing him, Wilda couldn't help but recall the events that had taken place in the Eight Trigrams Valley. Uncle Cardenas, in the presence of Connor, became even more respectful, and he respectfully greeted Connor, "Junior pays respects to Lord Soul Devourer!"
Connor paid no attention to Uncle Cardenas's greetings. He walked toward Wilda.

chapters.title: Chapter 2131: What Request?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2131: What Request?
Seeing this situation, Wilda's face was filled with nervousness. At this moment, she had no idea why Connor had come, and she was worried that he might be seeking revenge.
"It's so late, why did you come to find me?" Wilda cautiously asked Connor.
"I'm about to go to Risu. You have a helicopter at your house, right? I need to use it!" His tone was not one of negotiation but of command.
"You came for this?" She blinked, her voice showing surprise.
"Yes, that's why I'm here." He nodded.
"Why do you need to go to Risu?" she continued to ask.
"That's none of your concern. Hurry and have your people prepare the helicopter; I'm about to depart," he replied with a cold tone.
"What's with your attitude?" she lowered her voice after recalling the events in the valley. She realized that he was not someone to be trifled with, or she would have slapped someone else by now.
"You can borrow the helicopter, but I have one condition," she said softly.
"What condition?" he asked impatiently.
"My family has only one helicopter, and I need to go to Risu in a few days as well. I want to go with you!" Wilda looked at Connor and stated her condition.
"Fine," he replied indifferently.
"I'll have them prepare it now!" She felt his urgency and knew better than to provoke him. She picked up her phone and made the necessary arrangements.
About ten minutes later, Connor, Wilda, and her guards boarded the helicopter.
Yolanda, on the other hand, stayed at Wilda's home and planned to take a commercial flight back to Sommervile the next day.
Once onboard, Connor found a seat and sat down. Wilda opened a bottle of red wine. Originally, she had considered having a drink with him, but after seeing his serious expression, she gave up on that idea and drank alone.
He knew very little about the situation with Blood Shadow, and it was the first time he had heard the name. If he were to go to Risu like this, finding Blood Shadow and the King of Shadows would not be an easy task.
After hesitating for a long time, Connor finally took out his phone and dialed a number, contacting Chelsea.
After a few rings, she answered the call.
"Why are you calling me today? Did something happen?" Her seductive voice sounded on the phone.
"Can you help me investigate information about Blood Shadow? I have something very important to deal with now," he said with a serious tone.
"Blood Shadow?" She sounded somewhat puzzled upon hearing his words because she was not familiar with Blood Shadow.
"Yes, Blood Shadow. If you don't know about them, that's fine. Just have your friend gather information about Blood Shadow. Any leads or connections will do, and I don't care how much it costs," he said straightforwardly.
"Why are you suddenly interested in investigating Blood Shadow? Did something happen?" she asked softly.
"This matter might be related to my master's life and death. Can you understand what I mean?" he said in a low voice.
"I understand. I'll make a call right away to have someone collect information about Blood Shadow for you," she replied after realizing the seriousness of the situation. She promptly ended the call.
Meanwhile, Wilda had overheard Connor's conversation with Chelsea. She blinked and approached Connor, asking, "Hey, why are you inquiring about Blood Shadow? Did something happen?"
"This has nothing to do with you!" he replied coldly.
"What's with your attitude? Do you think I enjoy talking to you?" She was infuriated by his response, and she turned to leave.
"Have you heard of Blood Shadow?" Connor asked as he saw her about to leave.
"Hmph!" Wilda couldn't help but snort and replied, "If it weren't for the fact that you saved my life that day, I wouldn't bother with you. Let me tell you, Blood Shadow is the largest assassins' organization in the West. I've heard that Blood Shadow has connections with many financial conglomerates in the West, and their influence is quite terrifying. I admit that you have formidable strength, but no matter how powerful you are, Risu is Blood Shadow's territory. If you really intend to deal with them, I advise you to give up as soon as possible!"
"Where did you learn about these things?" His expression showed some confusion because he hadn't expected her to know about Blood Shadow's existence.
"My father told me about these things!" she replied directly.
"I see." Connor nodded and continued, "Can you help me gather some information about Blood Shadow or find out the location of one of their high-ranking members?"
"What do you take me for? I already said that I'm telling you this because you saved my life that day. I don't think I'm obliged to help you with anything. I'm already doing you a favor by lending you my family's helicopter!" Wilda retorted, pouting her lips.
"If you can help me find information about one of Blood Shadow's high-ranking members, consider it a favor from me. In the future, if you ever need help with anything, you can always come to me. You know my strength, and there's nothing in this world that I can't handle!" Connor said calmly.
Wilda heard Connor's words and couldn't help but pout again. She then said lightly, "You act as if I want to ask you for help!"
"You can consider whether you want to cooperate or not," Connor said softly to Wilda.

chapters.title: Chapter 2132: Blood Shadow
chapters.content:
Chapter 2132: Blood Shadow
Upon hearing this, Wilda looked at Connor and hesitated for a few seconds.
Shortly after, she took out her phone, found a phone number, and dialed it.
After speaking a few words into the phone, she hung up and then sat quietly at her seat, sipping on her red wine.
About ten minutes later, she walked up to Connor with a laptop in hand. She casually placed it on the table in front of him and whispered, "This is the information you wanted."
"Good." Connor nodded lightly.
"I don't need you to owe me any favors. My uncle died at the hands of this person. I provided you with his information because I hope you can kill him and help me avenge my uncle. So, we're even," she said straightforwardly.
"I understand." He seemed entirely focused on the laptop in front of him, not paying much attention to Wilda's words.
The laptop displayed detailed information about a person named William, a tall and muscular man with a killer's expression.
William seemed to hold a significant position within Blood Shadow and was the nephew of the King of Shadows. He was currently at the peak of Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master, hailing from a humble background. He became a martial artist and joined Blood Shadow due to his relationship with the King of Shadows. It was rumored that William was highly skilled in assassination techniques and was a renowned assassin in Risu. He was also wanted by law enforcement, but this was mostly for show, as William had terrifying connections in Risu.
Wilda had provided him with a very detailed dossier, documenting many important details about William. The most crucial point was that William was the nephew of the King of Shadows. Finding William would lead him to the King of Shadows, which would save him a lot of trouble.
"How about this information? Is it useful to you?" Wilda asked softly.
"It's useful." Connor nodded earnestly.
"That's good. I hope you can eliminate him. In doing so, I'll consider it revenge for my uncle," she said calmly.
"Is there a grudge between your family and Blood Shadow?" he asked curiously.
"There's no personal grudge, but my uncle's enemies found Blood Shadow and had them assassinate my uncle. While our family has some influence in France, we can't compare to a large organization like Blood Shadow. Even though everyone in our family knows that William killed my uncle, no one dares to seek revenge for him," she explained.
"I see." Connor nodded thoughtfully, not saying much more.
"While I really hope you can take care of this matter, I want to remind you that Blood Shadow is not easy to deal with. You must be mentally prepared," Wilda cautioned.
"There's no one in this world I can't handle," Connor said calmly.
If Wilda had heard this statement from Connor just five days ago, she would have likely scoffed. However, she now knew that his words were not a joke; he indeed had the capability.
In less than a day, they arrived in Risu and landed in the city closest to William's location.
After the plane landed, he decided to part ways with her and began searching for William on his own.
She understood how dangerous what he was doing was, so she chose not to accompany him in finding William.
Blood Shadow's influence in Risu was still considerable, and, more importantly, Connor was now famous in the world of martial arts. His feat of defeating three Celestial Ancient Martial Master on his own had spread worldwide, making him a legendary figure in many people's eyes.
William was one of the two individuals who had entered the Hidden Treasury, and he had been cursed by the King of Shadows himself. So when he learned that Connor had come to Risu, he naturally assumed that Connor was here for a confrontation with the King of Shadows. This made William very nervous.
However, William chose not to run. He knew of Connor's terrifying strength, but in Risu, Blood Shadow's influence was even more formidable. He had already set up a network within his own sphere of influence. As long as Connor entered his territory, he would face grave danger, and even if Connor didn't die, he would leave with significant injuries.
As expected, when he followed Wilda's information and sought out William's location, he was attacked by a group of masked individuals. They relentlessly fired guns at him. It was evident that these people were not martial artists; they were merely motivated by the enormous bounty on Connor's head.
Initially, Connor didn't want to harm innocent people, so he didn't retaliate against these attackers and instead continued on his way to find William.
Connor was exceptionally fast, and shaking off these people in the city was quite easy.
However, to his surprise, when he reached the outskirts of the city, the number of people chasing him increased, and they were all driving armored vehicles directly toward him.
He didn't want to waste too much time dealing with these people, and the most straightforward and effective solution was to eliminate them. So, he discarded his previous concerns and went on a killing spree.
In less than an hour, more than a hundred people met gruesome ends at his hands.
From this, he concluded that the ones who had placed the curse on Jorge were likely affiliated with Blood Shadow.

chapters.title: Chapter 2133: Huge Reward
chapters.content:
Chapter 2133: Huge Reward
Originally, Connor thought that once the assassins chasing him knew his strength, they would stop targeting him. However, he never expected these individuals to be so relentless to an unbelievable degree. Moreover, they were not all part of the same group; they were assassins from all over the world, and their communication was not well-coordinated. This led to a situation where as soon as he eliminated one group of pursuers, another would quickly appear.
This situation greatly frustrated him.
However, it seemed that William was also monitoring the situation on Connor's end. The Risu law enforcement agencies had also noticed these developments, but they chose not to intervene since they knew this was related to Blood Shadow and turned a blind eye to it.
Initially, William had hired relatively unknown criminals as assassins, true desperados who would do anything for money. However, these individuals had limited combat capabilities, and they had no personal connection with William. As more and more of them died at Connor's hands, some of them heard rumors about his true strength and chose to abandon their mission.
When he learned that these assassins had abandoned the mission, he reluctantly sent members of Blood Shadow to engage Connor.
Although the Blood Shadow assassins were also quite fearful of Connor, they had no choice but to follow William's orders since he was the Shadow King's nephew. They didn't charge blindly at him like the desperados did; instead, they used a patient approach, waiting for him to appear.
Connor sighed softly when he realized that there hadn't been any assassins for a long time. He then took out his phone to check the map. He knew he was still about a thousand kilometers away from William's location, and he had to cross a mountain.
To expedite the process of healing Jorge, he had no choice but to run, as no mode of transportation in this world could match his speed.
Inside a large mountain in Risu,
A small team of Blood Shadow assassins had set up an ambush here. They knew that Connor was heading towards William's location, and according to his current position, if he wanted to reach William's location, he had to pass through this mountain.
The terrain in the mountains was complex, making it an ideal place for an ambush.
"Captain, isn't our target just a martial artist? Do we need to be this cautious?" At this moment, a young man with blond hair nonchalantly approached a middle-aged white man, carrying a rifle. He was smoking a cigarette and asked casually.
There were more than ten people around the young man, all heavily armed and carrying weapons. They seemed relaxed, as if they didn't take this mission seriously.
This team consisted of only fifteen people, but each one of them was elite. They held a high position within Blood Shadow, often receiving high-level missions. Their success rate was astonishing, and most importantly, they possessed advanced weaponry. They had access to the most cutting-edge weapons available in this world.
They had accepted missions to kill martial artists before, even those at the level of Earth-tier Martial Grandmasters, so they didn't consider Connor's mission to be a big deal.
"I advise all of you to be careful. I have a feeling this mission might not be as simple as it seems. I heard that many people have already died at the hands of that martial artist," the middle-aged man said, lowing his head to take a drag from his cigarette, his expression unchanging.
"Can those people even compare to us? They have nothing compared to our equipment!" Another young man chimed in.
"Our mission this time is not to kill this person but to delay him as much as possible. If we can hold him off for half an hour, there will be a reward of fifty million dollars for each of us!" the middle-aged man explained calmly.
"Fifty million? That doesn't seem like much!" The young man shrugged, seemingly unimpressed.
After all, they had previously accepted a mission worth two billion.
"That's fifty million for each of us!" the middle-aged man clarified.
"My God, that's seven and a half billion in total! I've been in Blood Shadow for so many years, and I've only saved a few million. If this is true, I won't have to work for the rest of my life!" a slightly older man chuckled.
"Don't think it's that simple. Do you know William? If he's willing to offer such a high price, it means this guy is no pushover. So, I'm not expecting us to kill him. We just need to get that fifty million!" the middle-aged man said, keeping his cool.
"I think you're right. If this martial artist were as easy to kill as you say, William wouldn't be offering such a high price. Let's just take the fifty million!" many of them nodded in agreement.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Suddenly, from a position less than five hundred meters away, several loud explosions rang out.
The captain's expression immediately turned wary when he heard the explosions. He quickly said in a low voice, "Take cover, everyone. It seems the target has entered our trap. Those were the landmines we set up ahead and were just triggered by the target!"
"Captain, are you using the latest landmines?" one young man asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2134: Complete Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 2134: Complete Defeat
"Of course!" The captain nodded.
"The power of these new landmines is ten times greater than the ones we used before. I don't believe that after triggering so many landmines, he can escape without serious injuries!" a young man grinned confidently.
The captain glanced at the young man but didn't say anything, as he felt that the situation wasn't that simple.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Just then, several more explosions rang out, getting closer and closer. This indicated that the target was approaching them, and what was even more important was that it seemed the target was completely unaffected by the landmines. The target continued to advance towards them.
"How many explosions did we hear just now?" the captain asked seriously.
"It sounded like nineteen!" one young man hurriedly replied.
Upon hearing this, the captain's expression grew even more serious, and he furrowed his brows. "This isn't right! I placed twenty landmines. According to that, if he triggered nineteen of them, even if he's invincible, he should be heavily injured by now. How is he walking unharmed?"
"Yeah, could this guy be invulnerable?"
"I can't believe anyone could pass through those landmines unscathed. If he had avoided them, it might make sense, but those landmines clearly detonated. You guys should—"
"Boom!"
Before the man could finish his sentence, another explosion sounded right next to them, indicating that the last landmine had been triggered.
At that moment, everyone stared ahead attentively. With the violent explosion, thick smoke filled the air. From within the smoke, a figure slowly emerged.
"How... how is this even possible?" The captain was left dumbfounded when he saw Connor completely unharmed. He stood there in shock, not knowing how to describe his feelings. It was as if he had seen a ghost – someone who could walk unscathed through those landmines.
"No wonder this guy is worth so much!" a young man stammered.
"Are you all just standing there? Open fire and don't let him get any closer!" The captain finally realized that something was terribly wrong and shouted urgently.
The team quickly raised their rifles and began firing at him. However, what happened next was even more unbelievable. There seemed to have no effect on Connor as bullets hit him; they simply bounced off him. Bullets pelted the ground around him as he continued to approach.
"What kind of person is he? Why are the bullets not affecting him?" one young man asked, his eyes wide with disbelief.
"Is this guy a human or a ghost?"
Another young man pulled out a grenade and threw it toward Connor. They watched the grenade explode right in front of him, but when the smoke cleared, he remained unharmed.
These people had tried every method they could think of, but they couldn't inflict any harm on him. In fact, the explosion from the grenade would have been enough to turn a car into ashes, yet Connor emerged unscathed. It was a sight that left them feeling utterly hopeless.
"Captain, what should we do now?" a young man stuttered.
"What else can we do? We're no match for him. Retreat quickly!" the captain said in resignation.
The team members didn't waste any time and turned to run. However, Connor knew they were Blood Shadow operatives, and he wasn't about to let them go. He simply waved his hand, and a golden light shot out.
Wherever the light passed, whether it was vegetation or the Blood Shadow operatives, they were all instantly cut in half. These people had no chance to beg for mercy or cry out – they died on the spot.
In less than half a minute, the entire Blood Shadow team had been eliminated by Connor.
After dealing with them, Connor didn't hesitate and continued his journey into the mountains. This battle had only been the beginning, and many more Blood Shadow teams lay in wait for him. They were all enticed by William's generous bounty, thinking that even if they couldn't defeat him, they could at least delay him for some time. However, they had no idea about his true identity. If they knew they were facing the infamous Soul Eater, even with a thousand times more courage, they wouldn't dare to confront him.
As Connor drew closer to William's location, the teams sent to intercept him would become stronger, their equipment more terrifying, and their numbers greater. But even so, these teams couldn't stop Connor.
In less than an hour, countless Blood Shadow operatives had fallen to his hands.
This time, he was truly on a killing spree.
Meanwhile, William remained in Blood Shadow's command center. Many advised him to retreat, as Connor was headed his way. If he left the command center, the other Blood Shadow members might have a chance to escape safely.
However, for some reason, he refused to leave.
"Mr. William, something terrible has happened. Our seventh, eighth, and ninth teams have all been completely wiped out. This Connor's power is terrifying!" a middle-aged man rushed to William's side, his expression full of panic.
"What did you say?" William's eyes widened in disbelief upon hearing this news. His face expressed a level of astonishment he had never felt before.
"Mr. William, the sixth team has also been wiped out!" Another voice chimed in.
At that moment, it seemed like everything was falling apart for William.
"All of you, what are you eating? How can so many of you fail to stop one Connor?" he shouted angrily, unable to comprehend how Connor had overwhelmed them so easily.
However, what he didn't know was that, with the assistance of the Profound Bead, Connor's battle power far exceeded what anyone could have imagined. The operatives' attacks had barely made a dent in his formidable defenses.

chapters.title: Chapter 2135: Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 2135: Mission
"Mr. William, Connor is coming for you. Perhaps you should consider retreating!" the middle-aged man said urgently.
"I can't leave this place!" William replied stubbornly. He continued, "It's fine. We still have five teams, and those five teams represent the most significant fighting force of Blood Shadow. I refuse to believe that he can break through these final five defenses!"
Upon hearing his words, the middle-aged man appeared somewhat helpless. He sighed softly and didn't press the matter further because he knew William wouldn't listen.
As William saw the hesitation on the middle-aged man's face for a couple of seconds, he reached for his phone and dialed a number.
"Ring, ring..."
After several rings, the call was finally answered on the other end.
"Uncle, Connor is about to reach the Blood Shadow Command Center. Our people might not be able to hold him off!" Although he was reluctant to admit it, he had only one option at this moment – seeking the help of the King of Shadows.
"I understand. Lead your people to retreat to Iceland. I will handle the rest," the King of Shadows replied in a low voice.
"Alright, I got it!" William nodded reluctantly and hung up the phone.
"Mr. William, what did the Dark Lord say?" the middle-aged man asked nervously as he saw William end the call.
"Retreat to Iceland!" William replied in a subdued tone.
"Very well, I'll arrange the retreat immediately. Let the remaining five teams help us buy some time!" The middle-aged man, upon hearing William's decision, displayed a sense of excitement. He then took out his phone and began making calls to coordinate the retreat.
Meanwhile, on the other side, after successfully breaking through the fifth defense line, Connor went on a rampage. Anyone who dared to stand in his way met a grim fate.
At this moment, he had no time or inclination to waste on these people. His sole objective was to locate the King of Shadows as quickly as possible and heal Jorge. He didn't consider these other matters.
What he might not have realized, however, was that as he wreaked havoc, Risu had descended into chaos. News of the Soul Eater's appearance had spread through various channels, causing widespread panic and speculation.
"What? The Soul Eater has come to Risu?"
"The Soul Eater not only came to Risu but is also on a killing spree. It's clear he doesn't hold our country in high regard!"
"Yes, this Soul Eater is indeed formidable, but no matter how powerful he is, he doesn't have the right to defy our nation!"
"He's blatantly disregarding our country!"
Discussions like these were taking place everywhere.
Risu, unlike France and the small countries Connor had previously visited, possessed military power that was considered top-tier worldwide. This made most martial artists hesitant to engage in any unlawful activities within its borders. Even figures like Rockefeller and Land Deities were cautious when dealing with Risu. If they provoked Risu, the consequences would be unimaginable.
However, Connor, driven solely by his goal of finding the King of Shadows, paid no attention to the consequences or the chaos he was causing.
At this moment, there was also an additional factor at play. The collusion between Risu's high-ranking officials and the King of Shadows. These officials regularly relied on Blood Shadow to eliminate their enemies. Therefore, they couldn't afford to let Blood Shadow be destroyed by Connor.
However, there was a complication. Connor wasn't targeting Risu; his sole focus was Blood Shadow. Thus, the Risu officials couldn't use their official military forces to confront Connor directly. They had to resort to other methods to deal with this situation.
In the midst of the chaos, he was unaware of the turmoil he had caused. His only concern was reaching the King of Shadows as quickly as possible to save Jorge.
Little did he know that, in Risu, the news of his arrival had led to a frenzy. Every mercenary and martial artist, despite knowing Connor's terrifying strength, was tempted by the astronomical bounties on offer.
Anyone who participated in the mission, whether successful or not, would receive a reward of $50 million. If they managed to kill Connor, they would each receive $300 million. The one who killed Connor would be rewarded with $10 billion!
$10 billion!
This amount had never been offered before. No one had ever received such attention and reward from both Blood Shadow and Risu. Connor was undeniably the first.
Moreover, everyone participating in the mission was guaranteed a reward of $50 million, regardless of their contribution. These staggering amounts of money tempted even the most hesitant individuals.
"Goodness, who is this person? Why would someone put up so much money for his life?"
"Yes, if we can really kill him, each of us will get $300 million. It's unbelievable!"
"Who do you think issued this mission? It's hard to believe that someone has such deep pockets!"
"Could it be the high-ranking officials?"
"Definitely. It must be a joint operation between the high-ranking officials and Blood Shadow!"
"But should we participate?"
One by one, these individuals hesitated. They were uncertain if the news was true, and they didn't want to waste their efforts for nothing.
"Should we join the mission?" a middle-aged man asked, unsure.
Upon hearing this question, another middle-aged man chuckled and said, "You don't seriously believe that things are as simple as you imagine, do you? Let me tell you, this mission's target is the Soul Eater!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2136: Iceland
chapters.content:
Chapter 2136: Iceland
"Soul Eater?"
Upon hearing this name, everyone present was left dumbfounded. They widened their eyes, their expressions filled with disbelief.
Though they had anticipated that the target of this mission would be no ordinary individual, they hadn't imagined that their adversary would have such a terrifying reputation.
"The strength of this Soul Eater is indeed fearsome. If you don't know about him, you can inquire to understand more," the middle-aged man said slowly.
"I've heard of this Soul Eater. He's a Celestial-ranked Ancient Martial Grandmaster, indeed incredibly powerful. But what can we do about it? We'll have many strong participants in this mission, and I'm just here to join in the fun and earn a quick $50 million. Isn't that easy money?" a young man said with a smile.
"This mission isn't open to just anyone. The weakest participants must be Earth-ranked Ancient Martial Grandmasters. If you're not a martial artist, you need to possess combat strength equivalent to an Earth-ranked Ancient Martial Grandmaster. Do you think you can handle it?" the middle-aged man retorted with a smirk.
Upon hearing this, all the participants were left dumbfounded. Their expressions revealed their speechlessness because they hadn't expected the requirements to be so demanding.
"It seems I won't be getting that money," the young man sighed softly.
"We definitely won't get that money, but some people will," the middle-aged man replied coolly.
The middle-aged man's words were accurate. Although the number of martial artists within the Risu wasn't particularly high, many powerful individuals from around the world had gathered, all heading to Connor's location. They couldn't resist the temptation of the colossal bounties offered.
Moreover, there was a critical point to consider. The Risu's high-ranking officials and Blood Shadow had concealed Connor's identity as the Soul Eater from the participants. Many weren't aware of his true strength; at most, they had some vague guesses.
Initially, the Risu' high-ranking officials and Blood Shadow had revealed his identity to the public. However, the title of Soul Eater was too terrifying, causing people to hesitate, and no one dared to accept the mission.
Thus, they had to resort to concealing his identity to attract more participants from around the world.
At this moment, the Risu had gathered a vast assembly of powerful individuals, including martial artists and mercenaries, all waiting for Connor's appearance.
Iceland, with its perpetual sub-zero temperatures, was not a suitable place for normal human habitation. It was desolate and devoid of residents.
The King of Shadows had instructed William to come to Iceland as a contingency plan. If their people couldn't handle Connor, they could use the military's explosives to obliterate him. Iceland's remote location made it the ideal spot for such an operation. Using such large-scale, devastating weapons within the Risu's mainland was out of the question.
Today was perhaps the liveliest day in Iceland's history. Over ten thousand people had gathered there, including martial artists and mercenaries. Each group had its own motive, but they all had one shared goal: to await Connor's arrival.
Connor, unaware of the growing assembly on Iceland, had just located William's position after two hours of searching.
William had recently arrived at Iceland, and Connor was astonished by how quickly he had retreated. The distance between them was easily over a thousand kilometers, yet it took him less than two hours to cover it.
After resting for about half an hour in the command center, Connor continued his journey. However, he didn't know that Iceland had already become a gathering place for multiple factions, all united by a single purpose: awaiting his arrival.
As he approached Iceland, the tension among the gathered individuals reached its peak. These people were confident that, with so many experts present, it would be easy to eliminate their target. It was just a matter of luck to claim the $10 billion bounty.
"Has the target appeared?"
"Not yet."
A few mercenary leaders were chatting as they relaxed. They could sense that everyone was in good spirits.
"By the way, do any of you know who our target is? Why are the Risu's high-ranking officials making such a big fuss?" asked one of them, a black man carrying a heavy machine gun, in a carefree manner.
"I don't have the specific information about the target. Based on what I know, it's said to be just one person, and he's after Blood Shadow's William. The most important point is that this person has broken through all of Blood Shadow's defenses, indicating that he's not ordinary!" a red-haired young man replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 2137: Killed the Target?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2137: Killed the Target?
"The opponent's strength must be extraordinary. Otherwise, the high-ranking officials of Risu wouldn't have gathered all of us here. Do any of you know where this person is from?" the strongman asked.
"He should be from the Sommervile region," another middle-aged man with a cigarette in his mouth replied.
"Sommervile?!" The strongman's expression became somewhat peculiar upon hearing this. He whispered, "When did Sommervile produce such a formidable expert? Daring to oppose Risu is akin to seeking death."
"I think so too..."
At this moment, everyone was exchanging information and remained curious about the target of this mission.
However, they were not fools; they realized that there were already many powerful individuals on the island. Their combat abilities had reached terrifying levels, and it was even possible that the target might not appear at all.
If the target did appear, it indicated that they likely weren't afraid of them. These individuals were calculating the best moment to act, ensuring they secured the maximum benefit for themselves.
In essence, they weren't here to die for Risu' high-ranking officials. Their sole purpose was to earn money.
"Have you heard? Risu' top boxer is here too. I heard this boxer is quite impressive, able to knock out an armored vehicle with a single punch. Is it true?" a young man exclaimed with excitement.
"Not only the boxer, but England's top mage has also arrived. I've heard that this mage can control the elements!" another person chimed in.
"The hermit from the volcanic region, who has lived in seclusion for years, seems to have come too. My goodness, who is the target this time? They've managed to attract so many experts!" someone else added.
"I think there's more to this mission than meets the eye. If the target is truly just one person, it wouldn't require so many experts," another voice pondered.
At this moment, numerous Ancient Martial Grandmasters gathered on Icefang Island, and any one of them could be a renowned figure capable of shaking the world. Their presence stirred quite a commotion.
"It's true, money can move mountains. If it weren't for the astronomical bounty on this mission, I wouldn't believe that Risu's high-ranking officials could summon so many experts," an elderly man said, squinting his eyes as he looked into the distance.
"That's right, these people are all here for the money. A ten-billion-dollar bounty is no joke. I've never seen such a generous offer in my life," someone else agreed.
"We've got so many experts here. If the target does appear, it's unlikely they'll escape death. So, I think we can just sit tight and wait for the money!" a burly man exclaimed with a grin.
"If we can really get the money this easily, that would be the best outcome. I'm just worried that if the target doesn't show up, we'll have worked for nothing," another person voiced their concern.
"Yes, if the target doesn't appear, we may have worked for nothing..."
Others shared this concern, not about Connor's arrival but the possibility that he might not show up at all.
"Captain!"
At that moment, a young man rushed into the tent.
"What's wrong? Is there a situation?" the black strongman asked urgently.
"Yes, Captain, our drone spotted someone on the sea's surface, approximately twenty years old, and it seems the target has noticed us. What should we do now?" the young man reported.
But before he could finish speaking, the voice on the other end of the communication cut off.
The middle-aged man repeatedly called into the communication device, but there was no response from the other side.
"Sigh..."
The middle-aged man couldn't help but take a deep breath, then he put down the communication device, squinting as he pondered something.
The faces of the people present became very ugly. They looked at each other in bewilderment, not sure how to react.
"My team should have encountered the target. They should be dead..."
"Achieving this so quickly means that our team has likely been killed," the strongman said in shock.
"Yeah, Big Bear, you can't joke about something like this. Even though your team isn't large, your members are all Ancient Martial Grandmasters, and they're equipped with powerful weapons. How could they be eliminated so quickly by the target?" others questioned in disbelief.
"If they weren't dead, they would have continued to contact me. It's been several minutes now, and they haven't contacted me, which likely means they've been killed," Big Bear said, his expression devoid of emotion.
The others were familiar with the abilities of Big Bear's team members to some extent. They understood that if the target had eliminated them so quickly, it indicated the target's horrifying strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 2138: I'll Give You Half
chapters.content:
Chapter 2138: I'll Give You Half
"It looks like the target's strength is truly exceptional!" someone exclaimed.
"We were prepared for this. If the opponent were just an ordinary person, the high-ranking officials of Risu wouldn't have caused such a commotion. Regardless, we have a large number of people here, and this person, no matter how powerful, can't possibly be our match!" a captain declared without emotion.
"Exactly, we're all professionals in this line of work. We've faced all kinds of challenges, and as long as we work together, I believe that even if a deity were to come, they would be no match for us. Besides, there are so many Ancient Martial Masters on the island!" others responded.
"Everyone, don't stand idle. Get your people into battle mode!" a middle-aged man with a beard ordered through his communication device.
These people might seem unreliable at first glance, but they had formidable combat abilities. In less than half an hour since Connor's appearance, over ten thousand people had gathered on the coastline, waiting for him.
They formed a long line, each armed with weapons. If he were to appear, they planned to concentrate their firepower and eliminate him as quickly as possible, not giving him any chance to retaliate.
These mercenary captains sat in the tents, commanding their forces. Everyone's expressions were tense, as they didn't know what would happen next.
"Captain, the third team encountered the enemy and was completely wiped out!"
"Captain, all thirteen members of the Black Sand team are dead!"
"Report, we've suffered heavy casualties!"
"The enemy's strength is terrifying, and our bullets seem to have no effect on him. He's about to land!"
In a moment, such messages were flooding in, and the expressions on their faces grew more somber. They hadn't expected this turn of events. The enemy's combat power was far beyond their imagination.
From the moment the target appeared, in less than half an hour, three hundred people had been killed. What was even more terrifying was that their weapons appeared to be useless against him. Connor moved unhindered, and his actions seemed inexplicable.
These people had some psychological preparation for his strength, but they didn't expect it to be so overwhelming.
"Don't panic, this is just the beginning. We have over ten thousand people, and we're equipped with the best weapons. It's just the start, and we're prepared for the main event. Don't get flustered over this minor setback!" a handsome young man said coldly.
"Yes, our weapons are top-notch, and this is just the beginning. The real challenge is yet to come. We can't lose our composure over this!" another person added.
"Indeed, no matter how formidable the enemy is, I don't believe he can withstand a rocket-propelled grenade. Besides, Risu has provided us with tanks, which should be more than enough to deal with this guy!" The group started to calm down after hearing these words.
They had numerous weapons and a significant numerical advantage. They were willing to endure losses to secure the substantial bounty. Even if their entire force was wiped out, it didn't matter.
An hour had passed in the blink of an eye.
By this point, everyone was busily engaged, but Connor's advance was simply too fast.
"Report, the target has now reached the last defensive line!"
At that moment, Big Bear's communication device came to life.
Upon hearing this, he subconsciously licked his lips and whispered, "It's too fast, he's already reached the last defensive line I set up..."
"Big Bear, do you need assistance from my team on your end?" the middle-aged man beside Big Bear kindly asked.
"Haha, of course not. I've been waiting for him to reach the last defensive line!" He laughed heartily and continued, "I had my men bury thirty tons of explosives underground. The destructive power of thirty tons of explosives is something you understand. I just detonated it, which means that kid has been caught in my blast. I can't guarantee he'll die, but he's at least seriously injured. The rest is up to all of you!"
"That's why you were so relaxed earlier!"
"Big Bear, if I manage to kill the target, I'll make sure to share half of my reward with you!" The group's faces lit up with excitement upon hearing Big Bear's words.
After all, it was a whopping thirty tons of explosives! Even if they couldn't kill Connor outright, it would be easy to seriously injure him. Once he was seriously injured, their opportunity would arise.

chapters.title: Chapter 2139: An Intense Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 2139: An Intense Battle
In the eyes of those observing, even though a martial artist's strength was terrifying, they were still human, with flesh and blood bodies. They couldn't possibly withstand weapons like explosives.
Big Bear squinted at the screen in front of him as if he wanted to witness what had become of Connor after the explosion. But the next moment, he froze in place, and his smile disappeared.
A young man emerged slowly, appearing as if nothing had happened.
"What... what is going on?" Big Bear stared at the screen in disbelief, struggling to accept the fact that someone could survive such a massive explosion.
"Is this guy human or a ghost?" His voice trembled as he gazed at the screen.
Others seemed equally shocked, their eyes wide and unable to find words to describe what they were seeing.
"Why does this person look so familiar?" a middle-aged man asked with confusion in his voice.
"Yes, he seems strangely familiar. I feel like I've seen him somewhere before," another person added.
"I've seen him too..."
The group gathered around the screen, discussing with puzzled expressions.
"This person looks like... like the infamous Soul Eater!" suddenly, someone spoke up.
At that moment, everyone was left dumbfounded, standing in place with no idea of what to say. No one had anticipated that their target this time was none other than the notorious Soul Eater.
"What on earth are the higher-ups in Risu planning?" Big Bear couldn't help but wryly smile.
On the other side, Connor, who had already set foot on Iceland, wore an expression mixed with determination. He had initially hoped to teach these people a lesson and make them realize the gap in their strength. However, he had not expected them to launch such a relentless attack.
While Connor could easily handle the enemies head-on, their unconventional tactics and ambushes were posing a challenge. Furthermore, hidden snipers made the situation even more complicated. His greatest weakness was his physical body, which, despite his incredible power, remained vulnerable.
Therefore, he had to exercise caution, as any lapse in judgment could lead to disaster.
"I didn't want to kill you all, but since you are so stubborn, don't blame me for not being merciful..."
Connor took a deep breath, then turned into a streak of lightning, charging into the crowd. Despite their well-equipped arsenal, their speed was no match for him. In the blink of an eye, hundreds of people were sent flying, and this time, he showed no mercy. The wails and screams echoed across Iceland.
Meanwhile, inside the tents, the captains had only just realized the truth about Connor being the Soul Eater.
For a moment, the expressions on their faces turned extremely grim. They gritted their teeth and stared at the screen, their expressions filled with anger.
"It really is the Soul Eater!"
Big Bear sat on his chair, his expression filled with despair.
"The higher-ups in Risu are despicable. They knew our target was the Soul Eater, but they didn't inform us. Are they playing us for fools?"
Another person shouted angrily.
"Yes, if I had known we were dealing with the Soul Eater, I wouldn't have come, even if they offered a hundred billion dollars, or even a trillion! Aren't they basically using us as cannon fodder?"
A young man with blonde hair muttered bitterly.
These people had heard about Connor in recent times. He had single-handedly defeated three Grandmasters of Ancient Martial Arts in France, and now, they had picked a fight with the Soul Eater. It seemed like the higher-ups were getting impatient.
"There's no use talking about this now. Iceland is too dangerous. I'll have my men retreat as soon as possible. I don't need this money!"
"That's right, let's get out of this mess. What does the struggle between these big shots have to do with us? Staying here means we're just cannon fodder!"
It was evident that many were ready to throw in the towel. They weren't willing to stay and wait for death.
"What about retreating?"
Big Bear sneered when he heard their words and continued, "Aren't you a bit too naive? Is there even time for a retreat now?"
"What if we surrender?"
The young man with blonde hair asked.
"How can you guarantee that everyone will surrender? If someone continues to attack the Soul Eater, we'll still face certain death!"
Big Bear replied in a low voice before continuing, "There's only one option before us now: to do our utmost to kill the Soul Eater. This is no longer about the bounty but about our lives!"
The group looked towards Big Bear, their expressions helpless, as they realized they had no other choice but to fight.
On the other side of the conflict, Connor engaged in a fierce battle with these people on Iceland. He seemed like a god of death, moving freely among the crowd. To him, these people were like ants, hardly worth his attention. His attacks were merciless.
Meanwhile, William remained hidden deep within Iceland. Blood Shadow had a secret base on the island, and it was said that the security was incredibly tight. Even when explosives were detonated on the island, they wouldn't harm the personnel within the secret base.
Therefore, William was currently safe. He watched the screen in disbelief as Connor appeared to be an unstoppable force, his strength far beyond what anyone could have imagined.

chapters.title: Chapter 2140: A Terrifying Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 2140: A Terrifying Person
"It seems we're in big trouble this time. If I had known earlier that the person was the Soul Eater's master, I would have killed him outright!" William clenched his teeth and muttered.
"Mr. William, I think those mercenaries might not hold on for much longer. We should think of another way!" At that moment, a middle-aged man approached him and whispered.
"What else can I do? There are plenty of Ancient Martial Arts Grandmasters on this island now. Let them take action! What are they eating for if not this?" William shouted angrily.
The middle-aged man wore a helpless expression upon hearing his words. The current situation left them with no other option but to place their hopes on the King of Shadows. If the King of Shadows could return, things would become much simpler. However, if he couldn't, it would be problematic.
Meanwhile, Connor had been engaged in a fierce battle with the mercenaries on Iceland for nearly several hours, and the outcome had surprised everyone. Nearly a hundred mercenaries had been defeated by him. Iceland had turned into a living hell, with the blood of thousands staining the ground. Such a situation had never occurred before.
If news of this were to spread, the name 'Soul Eater' would strike even greater fear into people's hearts.
Connor had never gone on such a killing spree before, but this time, he had no choice but to expedite things. He couldn't afford to waste any time.
As he approached the area where William's secret base was, there were fewer enemies to face. These people had been thoroughly intimidated, and some had even found hiding spots.
He was aware of their hiding places, but he had no intention of pursuing them. Instead, he continued towards his objective.
However, when Connor was less than a few kilometers away from William's location, six figures suddenly appeared in front of him, including both men and women.
They appeared to be of varying ages, hailing from different backgrounds, with two of them being of Eastern martial descent and the others bearing Western features. Connor could sense that among these six individuals, two were at the level of Celestial Rank Ancient Martial Masters, while the remaining four had reached the pinnacle of Earth Rank Ancient Martial Masters.
Their formidable lineup was even more terrifying than the trio of Soloman, Yago, and Colton that Connor had encountered back in the Eight Trigrams Valley.
"Soul Eater," the old man in black robes smiled as he addressed Connor.
After a brief hesitation, Connor decided not to say much, as he was curious about who these six people really were.
"I am known as Samuel Conney. Originally, I hailed from Sommervile region but later settled in Risu." the old man in black robes said with a smile.
Connor glanced at Samuel, who exuded an air of otherworldly elegance with his snowy white hair.
Despite knowing that he was now facing the notorious Soul Eater, he remained calm and displayed no emotional fluctuations.
He appeared to be the strongest among these six, likely at the Heavenly Rank Ancient Martial Master's pinnacle, rivaling Yago's strength.
"I am George Yoshida. My younger brother, Yago, died at your hands not long ago." a middle-aged man stepped forward and calmly informed Connor. Despite knowing that Connor was the killer of his brother, George's tone remained composed. He seemed to be highly proficient in the power of thunder and lightning, with sparks crackling around his body, making him resemble a living thunder god.
"I am Cordon Moonshine." A middle-aged man in samurai attire approached Connor and introduced himself in fluent Sommervile dialect while wielding a long sword.
"I am Rachel, a Saintess of Risu's Sun God Sect." A seductive blonde woman with captivating blue eyes stepped forward and called out to Connor.
Connor cast a faint glance at Rachel, sensing an unusual aura emanating from her. She seemed to exude an air of sanctity, evoking reverence in even the most ordinary of people.
"And this is Mr. Edward." Rachel introduced the handsome young man standing beside her.
The young man had a typical appearance, exuding exceptional charm. He wore a white suit, but his aura was highly unusual. Connor even detected a hint of a bloodthirsty scent from him. Given his appearance, Connor couldn't help but consider the possibility that Edward might be one of the legendary vampires.
In the past, Connor would have found it hard to believe in the existence of vampires, but now, there was hardly anything he couldn't accept.
"Finally, let me introduce this gentleman." Samuel, the old man in black robes, gestured towards the elderly figure behind the group. "This venerable master is Shuri, a reincarnated God with unparalleled strength. There's hardly anyone who doesn't know the name Master Shuri."
Connor cast a casual glance at Master Shuri. Despite his frail stature, this man exuded an aura as steady as a mountain. Throughout the encounter, he had never once opened his eyes, remaining in a perpetual state of deep meditation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2141: Heavenly Lightning
chapters.content:
Chapter 2141: Heavenly Lightning
At this moment, all six of them have introduced themselves. Connor doesn't know much about these people in the world of martial arts.
Naturally, he wouldn't know that the six people standing in front of him have such terrifying influence in the world of martial arts.
"All six of them have actually come?"
"The high-level officials of Risu are really making a big move this time. These six people are known as the Grand Six of Risu. Now, all six of them are taking action together. What kind of conflict does the Soul Eater have with Risu?"
"Yeah, I only heard about these six people before, and I never thought they actually existed!"
Originally, the people hiding on Iceberg Island were all stunned when they saw the six people in front of Connor. The expressions on their faces were filled with disbelief.
It's important to note that Risu was established much later than countries like Sommervile, which meant that the number of native martial artists in Risu wasn't very high. In fact, the total number of martial artists in Risu was even less than that of a single province in Sommervile.
But the high-level officials of Risu understood the terrifying power of martial artists, so they expended significant resources to invite people like Samuel to settle in Risu. These six people in front of Connor were responsible for maintaining peace in Risu martial arts world, and they hold the highest position.
Furthermore, most of the martial artists in Risu referred to these six people as the Grand Six of Risu.
Many people had heard of them, but never seen them in person.
No one had expected that the high-level officials of Risu would invite all six of them to deal with Connor.
It was truly unbelievable.
"Samuel, George, Cordon, Rachel, Edward, and Master Shuri!"
The onlookers didn't know what to say when they looked at the six people on the screen.
"What a grand lineup it must be to be able to invite all six of them!"
"Yes, I never expected the high-level officials of Risu to attach so much importance to this matter!"
At this moment, everyone couldn't help but discuss quietly.
This battle was no longer just a showdown between Connor and Blood Shadow; it had become a battle between Connor and the entire Risu.
If these six people were to lose to him, it would mean the defeat of Risu martial arts world.
"Soul Eater, we six are aware of your strength, and we also know how terrifying your power can be. But no matter what, as the guardians of Risu martial arts world, we cannot allow you to act recklessly within the borders of Risu. We hope you can give us face and leave quickly. I can assure you that the higher-ups in Risu will not hold you responsible!" Samuel spoke to Connor in a polite tone.
Because Samuel was well aware of Connor's terrifying strength. If they were to engage in a battle, they would not easily defeat him, and there was a possibility that they might even die at his hands.
So his idea was that if they could persuade Connor to leave Risu without a fight, it would be the best outcome.
"Soul Eater, I know that your strength is terrifying, but as far as I know, you recently experienced a major battle. You probably haven't fully recovered yet, have you? If we really fight, the outcome is uncertain!" Rachel said softly, assessing Connor with her beautiful eyes.
"This is not your concern," Connor replied in a cold tone. He had no intention of leaving, and he had no plans to negotiate with these people.
"Soul Eater, if you are unwilling to leave, then don't blame us for being impolite!" Samuel said in a low voice.
"What can you do if you're not polite?" Connor smiled disdainfully.
In the eyes of ordinary martial artists, the Grand Six of Risu might be like immortals, but in Connor's eyes, they were not significant figures. The only true enemies he considered were the peak martial artists among the Land Deities. Unless a true peak martial artist appeared today, Connor had no intention of retreating.
"Well, we've said enough. Continuing to talk is meaningless. Let's get to it!" George was the only one among the six who wanted to start the fight. After all, Yago had died at Connor's hands, and he wanted to avenge his brother.
Unfortunately, Samuel, who was the strongest among them, advocated avoiding a fight if possible.
So George seized this opportunity without any hesitation. He drew a long sword emitting thunderous light and swung it towards Connor's position.
"Boom!"
A deafening roar echoed through the heavens and earth.
A tremendous thunderbolt struck directly at the spot where Connor had been standing just moments ago. At that moment, it felt as if the entire Iceberg Island was trembling violently.
Not far away, on the helicopter, a woman in a purple dress quietly sipped her wine and watched the location where George and the others were. Faced with the thunderbolt just now, if it were an ordinary person, they would have been too scared to speak, but this woman remained calm. Not even a drop of wine spilled from her glass.

chapters.title: Chapter 2142: Supreme-Grade Celestial Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 2142: Supreme-Grade Celestial Artifact
The woman as none other than Amelia, the head of Rockefeller in Rafrea.
Since Risu was part of Rafrea, the news of the significant events in Risu had naturally reached her ears.
At first, she had been somewhat surprised by the audacity of the person behind these major disturbances in Risu. However, when she learned that the mastermind behind it all was Connor, she felt more at ease. She had taken a helicopter to Iceland to see if he could survive.
She had never personally interacted with him, but she had heard quite a bit about him. This made her quite curious about him.
"Just this little ability, and you want to kill me?" Connor faced the thunderous power of George without any reaction, standing motionless.
When lightning struck, a golden light enveloped Connor's body. The thunderous power couldn't even make the slightest impact on the light around him.
George was momentarily stunned when he saw this scene. His expression became somewhat strange. He had never expected that his thunderbolt wouldn't have any effect on Connor.
Raphael and Edward also had changed expressions on their faces. Master Shuri finally opened his eyes slowly.
Samuel turned to give George a fierce look, feeling angry but helpless. He had already made a move, and there was no turning back now.
Previously, these people had heard about Connor, but now, facing him in person, they could truly understand the extent of his terrifying power.
They never thought that such a young and seemingly ordinary young man could wield such astonishing power.
Originally, Connor had intended to deal with George, but his expression appeared somewhat strange. Previously, using his divine sense, he had located William and could sense that William was attempting to escape from Iceland.
He knew that he couldn't waste time with these six people. If they were to fight, he wouldn't be able to defeat all six of them in a short amount of time.
Therefore, after a brief hesitation, he spoke slowly, "You can't kill me today. I'll give you one last chance. If you leave now, I might spare your lives. Otherwise, all six of you will die here today!"
His tone carried a hint of menace.
Samuel's expression was hesitant, but he gritted his teeth and said, "Soul Eater, if you don't leave Risu, then we won't be able to leave either!"
"Ignorant fools!"
Connor snorted coldly and then directly released his own aura.
In an instant, the sky was covered with dark clouds, lightning flashed, thunder roared, and the coastline of Iceberg Island stirred up monstrous waves, giving the feeling of an impending doomsday.
The people on Iceberg Island, upon witnessing this scene, all wore expressions of fear. They now realized that he hadn't exerted his full power when facing them earlier. This was him giving it his all.
Connor fervently manipulated the energies between heaven and earth because, after the previous battle with Yago and others, he had become increasingly skilled in controlling the energies of the world.
"Today, I will avenge my little brother!" George shouted loudly and then swung his Thunderous Sword.
"Boom!"
Once again, a deafening sound echoed in the sky as a black thunderbolt shot across the sky, heading straight for Connor.
It was clear that George was finally taking the situation seriously. This thunderbolt was much more powerful than the previous one, both in terms of its momentum and overall strength. This strike could even instantly kill an ancient grandmaster.
The expressions of the other five people also turned incredibly incredulous when they saw this thunderbolt.
"Who would have thought that George's strength had reached this level? He should be just a step away from becoming a Celestial Ancient Martial Master," Samuel couldn't help but sigh.
"Yes, it's been over ten years since I last saw George in action. His rate of improvement is truly terrifying," added Cordon.
Connor looked at the black thunderbolt in the sky, took a deep breath, and sighed inwardly.
He was well aware that, in reality, given George's current strength, he should never have been able to control a thunderbolt of such power. Not to mention a Martial Master, even a Celestial Ancient Martial Master would never be able to control such a formidable thunderbolt.
So the only explanation was George's Thunderous Sword. This sword should be a genuine Celestial Artifact, and its level was extremely high, far surpassing ordinary Celestial Artifacts.
"Today, you six have brought this upon yourselves. Don't blame me for not being polite," Connor took a deep breath and then reached into his waist, taking out the jade pendant that Zidane had given him.
Although he could defeat George and the others without using this sword, time was of the essence. In just a few minutes, William had already escaped over a hundred kilometers away. Therefore, he had to deal with the six individuals in front of him as quickly as possible.
As he took out the jade pendant, a golden light flashed, and a golden longsword appeared in his hand.
"A Celestial Artifact like this exists?"
Samuel was profoundly shocked when he saw the longsword in Connor's hand. Celestial Artifact also had levels of quality. For instance, George and Yago's Obsidian Sword and Thunderous Sword were both top-quality Celestial Artifact, a rarity even in the world. Few people had seen top-quality Celestial Artifact, let alone touched them.
The golden longsword that Connor had now taken out was considered a supreme-grade immortal weapon. That was why Samuel was so astonished.
Soul Eater's power was already terrifying on its own. Adding a supreme-grade Celestial Artificat to the mix made him nearly invincible.
Samuel couldn't help but regret that he shouldn't have confronted Connor, but now, it was too late for regrets.

chapters.title: Chapter 2143: Trying To Do The Impossible
chapters.content:
Chapter 2143: Trying To Do The Impossible
Connor raised the longsword in his hand and swung it vigorously towards the front.
In an instant, a dazzling golden light flew directly towards the thunderbolt in the sky.
Although George's thunderbolt was formidable, Connor's Sword Chi was clearly powerful. Everyone looked up at the sky; this time, Connor was truly unleashing his full power.
"Boom!"
At this moment, the golden Sword Chi collided directly with the black thunderbolt, creating an indescribable deafening noise.
The sensation was like thunder striking right next to your ears, and some people might even be instantly killed by the shock.
Inside the plane, Amelia was also watching the situation outside with rapt attention, her eyes filled with curiosity. She wanted to know if Connor could survive the onslaught of these six people.
"How powerful is this!" she sighed softly as she looked at the highball glass that had fallen on the ground.
It's worth noting that the plane she was in was one of the best in the world, very stable. However, it was still shaking due to the powerful energy impact. Amelia and the others were at least several dozen kilometers away from Connor and his group.
After the collision between the thunderbolt and the Sword Chi, the two forces neutralized each other.
George's face was filled with shock because he hadn't expected his thunderbolt to be easily countered by Connor.
Without giving him a chance to react, Connor swung his golden longsword again, and a golden Sword Chi flew straight towards George.
"George, be careful!" Samuel felt that something was amiss and hastily shouted.
George was well aware that Connor's attack was not ordinary. Even though he had just used a Celestial Artifact to defend against Connor's previous attack, he knew that, with his current level as an Earth-Rank Ancient Martial Master, he wouldn't be able to withstand Connor's Sword Chi without using a Celestial Artifact. He had no choice but to use his body to block the attack, but he knew it would result in severe injuries.
"Shit!" Samuel seemed to realize that something was wrong with George and shouted to Rachel, "Quick, lend a hand!"
Rachel didn't hesitate. She waved his hand, and a purple light flew towards Connor's Sword Chi. Clearly, she intended to help George block some of the attack.
"Boom!"
The purple light collided with the golden Sword Chi, creating a massive sound. To Rachel's astonishment, the Sword Chi easily broke through the purple light and continued towards George.
She had to take several steps back to steady herself. Her expression showed shock, and her body trembled slightly.
"How can this person's strength be so terrifying? My aura couldn't even stop his Sword Chi?" Rachel stared in the direction of Connor. She couldn't describe her feelings at the moment. She had initially thought her aura could at least help George mitigate most of the damage. However, she now realized that her thought was naive. Connor's strength had reached a point where he could completely ignore her aura. It was like trying to stop a tank with a mantis arm.
"This person's strength is not as simple as you imagined. I warned you all not to be careless!" Samuel's expression looked helpless. He then waved his hand, and his aura rushed towards Connor's Sword Chi.
"Boom!"
With a loud noise, Samuel's aura managed to neutralize most of Connor's Sword Chi.
George seized this opportunity and, with his Thunderous Sword in hand, swung it heavily at the Sword Chi.
When the Thunderous Sword clashed with Connor's Sword Chi, a loud noise rang out. Although Samuel had helped George resist most of the force, the remaining power still placed a significant burden on the Thunderous Sword.
George narrowly managed to diffuse Connor's second Sword Chi attack, but his expression was grim. The Thunderous Sword in his hand was trembling continuously.
At this moment, George finally realized just how terrifying Connor's strength was. It had reached a level where one Sword Chi attack alone could easily severely wound him, even if it didn't kill him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2144: Attacking at the Same Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 2144: Attacking at the Same Time
"This person is truly terrifying..." George quickly adjusted his own aura and couldn't help but whisper.
"Now that we know how fearsome he is, we have more people on our side, while he's alone. We still have a great chance..." Samuel understood the terror of Connor's strength, but in this situation, he needed to keep the morale steady. If these people became disheartened, even if they had a chance to defeat him, they might miss it.
In battles between powerful individuals, one's mentality plays a crucial role. If one's mindset becomes unstable, the consequences can be unimaginable.
"Since this person's Sword Chi is so powerful, let me test him with my blade!" Just then, Cordon suddenly rushed towards Connor and swiftly drew her sword in an Iaido style, bringing it down towards Connor.
Cordon's strike was the culmination of her lifelong training. The profoundness of her blade intent couldn't be expressed in words. Unlike Connor's Sword Chi, Cordon's blade was incredibly fast, giving the impression that it was several times faster than lightning.
This strike could be considered the pinnacle of swordsmanship in the entire world. Achieving such an effect with a blade was almost unbelievable.
The formidable blade intent resembled a colossal wave and lightning, constantly changing, and it came down towards Connor at an unimaginable speed.
After Cordon's strike, his expression seemed somewhat smug as he softly exclaimed, "This strike of mine will definitely harm him!"
Hearing his words, the others showed clear signs of concern. After all, they had just witnessed Connor's terrifying strength, so their confidence had waned.
"Do you think you've underestimated me a bit?" Connor sneered towards Cordon's direction, then without hesitation, he threw a powerful punch.
A golden fist imprint sped towards Cordon's blade.
Everyone present could clearly sense the incredible power in Connor's punch.
"Boom!"
Another deafening sound.
Connor's fist imprint clashed once again with Cordon's blade intent, like two ferocious beasts colliding. It was a battle of whose aura was denser.
The answer was obvious.
In the end, Connor's skill prevailed.
After that thunderous clash, he stood still without moving a muscle. Cordon, on the other hand, was in a sorry state. He was instantly sent flying and traveled nearly a hundred meters through the air before finally stabilizing herself.
After regaining his balance, he took a deep breath and tried to control the surging Chi within her body.
"This person is truly terrifying..." He was shocked to his core. He examined Connor from top to bottom. He had never encountered an opponent so powerful.
Although they had only exchanged blows once, it was enough to reveal many things.
On the other side, George finally caught a brief respite while Connor was occupied with Cordon. He quickly swung his Thunderous Sword.
"Ten Thousand Thunders Unleashed!"
George shouted loudly. In an instant, numerous thunderbolts roared towards Connor's position like raindrops.
At that moment, Connor's location had turned into a battlefield of hell, with countless thunderbolts incessantly striking down, and Connor stood silently amidst them.
"I refuse to believe I can't harm you this time!" George gritted his teeth and roared angrily. His expression was filled with fury, as if he could only vent his frustration in this way.
However, a few seconds later, the thunderbolts slowly dissipated.
Connor emerged from the scene without a hint of expression.
For a moment, George stood still, his expression showing disbelief. He couldn't fathom how his "Ten Thousand Thunders Unleashed" hadn't affected Connor at all.
At this point, George finally understood why his younger brother, Yago, had fallen to Connor. Connor indeed possessed the ability to kill Yago.
Cordon seemed to be haunted by the punch she had just received, as he didn't believe the gap between him and Connor could be so immense. He immediately launched another attack with her blade against Connor.
Samuel didn't waste time either. He waved his right hand, and a green long spear shot toward Connor like an arrow released from a bowstring.
Master Shuri, Rachel, and Edward didn't remain idle either; they each used their unique skills to attack Connor simultaneously.
"The Grand Six of Risu, all attacking at once, and their target is only one person, Connor!"
"How exciting! After all these years, it's the first time I've seen the grand six attacking together!"
Amelia, sitting inside the plane, couldn't help but exclaim with a smile.
At this moment, she finally understood why Connor had caused such a huge commotion in the world of martial arts. His strength far exceeded that of ordinary martial artists.

chapters.title: Chapter 2145: The Innumerable Relationship
chapters.content:
Chapter 2145: The Innumerable Relationship
However, it wasn't just Amelia who was watching this battle. The high-ranking officials in Risu, as well as the Land Deities and Mr. Long of Rockefeller, were also observing. It seemed like this battle had attracted the attention of the top organizations in the world.
However, these organizations seemed to have intricate connections with Connor.
Seeing these six people simultaneously attacking him, Connor didn't dare to underestimate them. He released his aura, and in an instant, a golden light enveloped his body.
He swung his longsword, sending a golden Sword Chi directly towards Cordon's blade. The two clashed again, but the result was the same. Cordon was defeated once more, sent flying with blood spraying from his mouth and a pained expression on his face.
After dealing with Cordon's blade intent, Connor swiftly waved his hand, sending a green light towards Samuel's position.
Samuel's expression turned fearful as he released his own aura. At the same time, his long spear had already reached Connor. However, with a single swing of the hand, Connor sent the long spear flying.
The long spear traveled nearly a hundred meters and crashed into an iceberg on Iceland. The entire iceberg collapsed. This showed how terrifying the power of Samuel's spear was. If anyone else had been on the receiving end of that strike, they would likely be severely injured, if not dead.
Connor effortlessly dealt with Samuel's attack, but he had a hard time withstanding his counterattack. Samuel's aura was unstable, and he spewed blood.
The expressions of the onlookers changed dramatically. They hadn't expected Connor's strength to be so terrifying. Even Samuel couldn't match him. The gap was astonishing.
Master Shuri, who excelled in close combat, rushed toward Connor. He believed he could take Connor by surprise while Connor was dealing with Samuel.
However, he had already prepared.
When Master Shuri's fist struck his back, he felt as if he had hit a mountain. Connor remained unmoved, while Master Shuri was sent flying.
Seeing this, William and Edward, who had intended to join the fight, stopped. They knew that joining now would be futile.
"Connor is really incredible. Facing so many experts at once and still gaining the upper hand, it's unbelievable!" Amelia couldn't help but exclaim.
Although she wasn't a martial artist, she had some understanding of martial artists. She knew how terrifying Samuel and the others were.
"Are you four okay?" Rachel asked with a furrowed brow.
"We're fine!" Samuel replied in a low voice.
"I'm okay too!" George added.
Master Shuri continued adjusting his aura and didn't respond.
Although Connor had gained the upper hand earlier, his attacks hadn't caused substantial harm to these people. They were fully aware that in this situation, they had to give it their all. Otherwise, their fate would be grim.
Samuel's spear, George's thunder, and Cordon's blade all came down on Connor.
Master Shuri looked for an opportunity to strike.
Rachel and Edward were biding their time.
Both of them were in a high-alert state because they knew that dealing with an opponent like Connor required their full attention. Any carelessness could lead to their deaths.
Connor moved gracefully in the sky, easily avoiding their attacks.
Edward, who had been waiting for the right moment, finally found an opportunity. Without hesitation, he stepped forward and struck toward Connor's position with a scarlet palm. As he got closer to Connor, his palm grew larger, and Connor could feel the oppressive force it carried.
Although Edward hadn't joined the battle until now, his strength was terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 2146: Stop
chapters.content:
Chapter 2146: Stop
Originally, Connor thought that among these people, Samuel should be the strongest in terms of strength. But now it seemed that Edward's strength was the most formidable, and his strength was definitely not weaker than Samuel's. Connor could sense this just from that one palm.
When the enormous red hand was flying towards Connor, the helicopter Amelia was in once again trembled violently, and the ground started to shake as well, as if it couldn't bear the immense power contained in that palm.
"I didn't expect Edward's strength to be so terrifying," Connor couldn't help but mutter. He knew that the development of Rusia martial arts was far behind that of Sommervile, and most martial arts experts in the world were from Sommervile. Genuine Rusia martial arts experts were rare, and those who could reach Edward's level were even rarer. Connor was surprised when he saw the power of Edward's palm.
Taking a deep breath, he waved his right hand, sending out a golden light. The golden light clashed with Edward's palm print, causing the palm print to disintegrate instantly.
Edward's expression showed surprise. He hadn't expected Connor to break his palm print so effortlessly.
After neutralizing Edward's attack, Connor turned to look at Master Shuri behind him. At that moment, he had intended to strike Connor, thinking that his attention was focused on Edward and hadn't noticed him. However, he didn't know that Connor was fully aware of his presence.
"What are you doing, Master Shuri?" Samuel's face showed a hint of helplessness. He couldn't understand why Master Shuri had made such a foolish choice.
Even Connor's expression appeared astonished. He had never expected Master Shuri to choose to confront him head-on.
"You're too weak. Taste my punch!" Connor sneered at Master Shuri and, without any hesitation, threw a punch directly toward him.
It's worth noting that Connor's understanding of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist had reached a terrifying level. His martial arts could be considered the most terrifying in the world and were beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
When his fist was unleashed, the terrifying punch wind resembled a hurricane, instantly sweeping across the entire Iceland.
Master Shuri, who was renowned for his mastery of martial arts, couldn't help but show an expression of disbelief when he saw Connor's punch. Connor's martial arts were incredibly terrifying, and it felt like the very atmosphere of the world changed with his every punch.
A single punch had a world-shaking impact.
This had always been what Master Shuri had pursued diligently, but he never expected to see it in his opponent.
"Huff..."
He took a deep breath and chose not to evade Connor's punch. Instead, he did something completely unexpected to everyone.
Master Shuri directly struck Connor's fist with his own.
"Boom!"
After their fists collided, they produced a terrifying sound akin to thunder.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
