Following that, everyone heard another explosion from Master Shuri's arm. His body was sent flying, and Samuel, witnessing this, couldn't help but show a helpless expression. He quickly moved and caught Master Shuri.
After Samuel caught Master Shuri, the latter turned to look at Connor, his expression filled with shocked. He shouted at Connor, "What kind of martial art did you just use?"
"Is it any of your concern?" Connor replied calmly.
"Tell me, what martial art did you just use? Why is it so powerful?" Master Shuri stared with wide eyes, filled with excitement.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist," Connor replied indifferently.
"Why have I never heard of this martial art before?" Master Shuri's face was filled with confusion because he had spent his entire life studying martial arts. He knew about many famous martial arts from around the world, but he had never heard of the Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist.
"Master Shuri, it's not the time to discuss this now. Let's focus on getting rid of this person," Samuel said helplessly.
"I understand..." Master Shuri replied in a low voice, then squinted his eyes and looked at Connor.
Clearly, Connor's punch had a significant impact on Master Shuri, as he hadn't expected someone in the world to have a deeper understanding of martial arts than himself, especially from a young person who was not yet twenty years old.
Understanding that the martial art he had diligently practiced for hundreds of years was inferior to that of a young upstart was a bitter pill to swallow, something that would be hard for anyone to accept.
Cordon took a step forward, and once again, with a ruthless swing, aimed her blade at Connor's position.
However, Connor could sense that his inner energy had diminished significantly by now, so his power was far weaker than before.
Hence, Connor easily dodged his blade.
At the same time, Samuel condensed his inner energy into ten spheres resembling cannonballs and directed them straight at Connor's location.
Once again, chaos erupted as everyone fought against him.
In an instant, Iceland shook, and lightning flashed across the sky. Everyone exerted their full strength with the goal of eliminating Connor.
From six different angles, six individuals launched attacks against Connor. If it were a normal martial artist, they would likely be overwhelmed by such terrifying power, no matter how strong they were. However, these attackers had chosen the wrong opponent, as Connor had faced such situations not just once or twice.
He maneuvered through the skies, evading their attacks while searching for an opportunity to strike.
Amelia watched silently, her heart filled with a mixture of surprise and astonishment. She had never witnessed a martial artist with such incredible power before.
More than ten minutes passed, and Samuel and the others finally ceased their attacks.
Once again, Iceland returned to tranquility.

chapters.title: Chapter 2147: Arsenal Tower
chapters.content:
Chapter 2147: Arsenal Tower
Samuel and the others suddenly stopped, not because they had defeated or killed Connor, but because in the recent battle, they had depleted their inner energy too rapidly. They needed a moment to catch their breath.
"Soul Eater, I admit your strength is truly terrifying. However, if the six of us keep attacking you like this, even if you were a god, you'd eventually make a mistake. By then, it might be your end. So, I advise you to leave Risu as soon as possible!" Samuel tried to persuade him, realizing that even if they managed to defeat him today, it would come at a great cost.
"Oh, is that so?" Connor couldn't help but sneer at his words and said calmly, "Shouldn't all of you have depleted your inner energy by now?"
"Isn't that the case for you too?" Samuel replied directly.
Although Samuel and the others had been attacking Connor continuously while he dodged, the truth was that he had consumed even more inner energy than they had, which was why Samuel chose to pause.
"Not me!" Connor chuckled lightly, and like lightning, he rushed directly towards the six people.
In an instant, they dumbfounded. They couldn't have anticipated that Connor still possessed such terrifying inner energy.
"This is impossible!" Rachel said in disbelief.
"Exactly, he should have consumed his inner energy faster than us, considering he faced the attacks of all six of us. But why does he still have such terrifying inner energy?" George's expression was also filled with confusion.
"You've been hitting me for so long, and now it's my turn!" Connor sneered and charged straight toward Edward. He raised his fist and struck Edward's chest.
"Arsenal Tower!" Edward's reaction was fast; he quickly retrieved his Celestial Artifact and threw it into the sky.
In an instant, his body was enveloped by a tower-like magical artifact.
"It's the Arsenal Tower!" Samuel, upon witnessing this, had an excited expression. He murmured, "I never thought that Edward had such a treasure!"
The Arsenal Tower was well-known in the martial arts world for being invincible, capable of withstanding even a full-strength strike from an Earth-ranked martial grandmaster. However, it had not been seen in public for a long time. That was why Samuel was so surprised when Edward summoned it.
"Boom!"
A loud explosion occurred. Connor's fist struck the Arsenal Tower in front of Edward. What happened next took everyone by surprise.
After being hit by Connor's punch, the Arsenal Tower began to show faint cracks, which rapidly expanded.
"This..." Edward's eyes widened in disbelief as he witnessed this scene. His expression showed he found it hard to accept.
"Break for me!" At that moment, Connor roared.
"Boom!"
The Arsenal Tower that had shielded Edward was shattered.
Immediately afterward, Connor's fist hit his chest. His body was sent flying like a broken kite, coughing up blood as he crashed to the ground.
Everyone could sense that, while Connor's punch didn't kill him, his inner energy was severely weakened.
"The power of this person's fist is truly astonishing," Rachel said, staring wide-eyed at Edward's position.
After all, just a while ago, Edward had the protection of the Arsenal Tower, and yet Connor's punch had inflicted such damage. If Edward hadn't had the Arsenal Tower, the punch might have killed him outright.
The expressions on the faces of the others were equally incredulous. After such a fierce battle, most of their inner energy had already been depleted, yet it seemed as if nothing had happened to Connor. This was simply unbelievable.
He didn't give them too much time to be astonished. Time was of the essence to him.
With a swift movement, he turned and looked at the five individuals behind him. He calmly said, "You were able to withstand two of my punches earlier. I wonder how many more you can take?"
Rachel looked at Connor with a fearful expression. At this moment, she finally realized that all the rumors about the Soul Eater in the outside world were true.
"Let's attack together. We must suppress this person!" Samuel, although he wanted to escape, knew that fleeing was no longer an option. They had to fight to the death.
George and the others didn't dare to be careless and immediately continued their attacks on Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2148: Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 2148: Defeat
Just a moment ago, when all six of them attacked together, they could barely suppress Connor.
However, now that their main force, Edward, is dead, it's not an easy task for the remaining five to truly contain Connor.
Connor used almost no effort to break out of the encirclement formed by these five people and approached Rachel.
Rachel's expression was filled with fear.
At this moment, he was in no mood to spare anyone. He abruptly raised his fist and smashed it directly into Rachel's chest.
"Boom!"
A deafening sound.
She was struck directly to the ground, creating a massive crater upon impact. However, what surprised Connor was that she didn't die immediately from his punch.
"How is this possible?" He was puzzled.
Because Rachel was only an Earth-ranked martial grandmaster, theoretically, she shouldn't have been able to withstand his punch.
Suddenly, a purple light formed around her body, though it didn't last long before it dissipated.
"A protective Celestial Artifact!" Connor quickly realized what was happening and sighed softly.
Rachel looked in his direction with a terrified expression. She knew her artifact had shattered, and if Connor continued to attack her, her fate would be the same as Edward's.
"I wonder how many times your artifact can protect you?" Unsurprisingly, he launched a second attack on her.
Rachel stood there trembling, not knowing what to do. She had no idea how to defend herself against his attacks.
However, when his fist was less than ten meters away from her, Master Shuri rushed to her side. He used his own body to help her block Connor's punch.
It wasn't that Master Shuri was exceptionally heroic, but Edward had already died, and the situation was extremely unfavorable for them. If Rachel were to die at Connor's hands as well, the remaining four might truly have no hope.
"Do you think you can block me?" Connor looked at Master Shuri and said calmly.
"Whether I can block you or not, we'll find out." Master Shuri replied calmly.
Connor didn't waste any words and directly launched three punches in a row at Master Shuri.
For the first three punches, Master Shuri did his best to block them. However, by the fourth punch, Master Shuri couldn't hold on any longer. He was sent flying by Connor's fist.
"Pfft!"
Master Shuri coughed up blood and crashed into a distant mountain peak, his life extinguished.
When Samuel felt Master Shuri's aura completely disappear, his expression showed despair. He knew that Master Shuri had died.
"So soon, another one is gone?" On the plane, Amelia finally lost her composure, her expression extremely incredulous as she stared in the direction of Connor.
She hadn't expected Master Shuri to die so quickly at Connor's hands.
Rachel's delicate body continued to tremble. She knew that Master Shuri had just sacrificed himself for her. If it hadn't been for him intervening on her behalf, she would have been the one to die.
Samuel took a deep breath. He had no way out now and had to grit his teeth and rush toward Connor.
It had to be said that Samuel was indeed the strongest among the six. After dozens of consecutive clashes with Connor, Samuel hadn't fallen into a disadvantageous position, which surprised Connor.
However, the situation didn't seem to last long because not everyone had the assistance of the Profound Bead, and Samuel's inner energy was ultimately exhausted.
In less than ten minutes, Connor could sense that Samuel was starting to struggle.
He didn't let this rare opportunity slip by. His figure flashed, disappearing from the sight of the group.
Samuel hesitated for a moment but, by the time he reacted, Connor had already appeared in front of him.
Samuel looked up at him, his expression filled with fear.
"Boom!"
His fist struck Samuel's chest.
"Pfft!"
Samuel spurted out a mouthful of blood and was sent flying.
"Samuel!"
Upon seeing him being sent flying, George shouted, but Samuel could no longer respond.
With this punch, Connor had directly pierced through Samuel's heart, and he died on the spot.
Amelia, on the plane, stared wide-eyed, unable to express her emotions in words. She couldn't believe that Samuel, the strongest among the Grand Six, had been easily killed by Connor.
Now, only Cordon, Rachel, and George remained.
Previously, even when all six of them joined forces, they weren't a match for Connor alone. Now, with only three of them left, they certainly had no chance against Connor.
"I never thought Connor would actually win!" After remaining silent for a long time, Amelia sighed deeply. She now realized just how terrifying Connor was.
As for Rachel, Cordon, and George, after Samuel's death, they had given up attacking Connor. They knew that the three of them were simply not Connor's match. Even if they continued to attack him, it would be a waste of energy.
However, he seemed to have no intention of letting these three go. He took a step and walked toward Rachel's position.
When Rachel saw him approaching, she quickly knelt on the ground, pressing her body to the ground. She softly begged Connor, "Lord Soul Eater, I beg you, spare me!"
"Lord Soul Eater, I beg you, spare me!" Cordon also quickly knelt beside her.
After hesitating for two seconds, George also chose to kneel on the ground and, gritting his teeth, said to Connor, "Lord Soul Eater, I beg you to spare me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2149: Investigating
chapters.content:
Chapter 2149: Investigating
Inside the plane, Amelia's expression appeared somewhat peculiar as she witnessed this scene.
Because, at this moment, the scene before her eyes seemed rather absurd.
The Grand Six of Risu were actually kneeling before Connor, begging for mercy. This was indeed quite ridiculous.
If those ordinary warriors who regarded them as gods saw this scene, one could only imagine how they would feel.
"Let's go!" Amelia now understood the outcome, and whether the remaining three lived or died no longer mattered.
The helicopter pilot, upon hearing these words, also felt relieved. After all, in his eyes, this place was no different from hell. He quickly piloted the helicopter away from Iceland.
On the other side, Connor looked at the three individuals kneeling before him with a disdainful expression. He then said indifferently, "The Grand Six have already lost three members. Even if you three survive, it won't mean anything. You might as well join them in death!"
After saying these words, Connor lightly waved his right hand.
A beam of light flashed.
Rachel, Cordon, and George instantly fell to the ground.
Amelia, who had just left, happened to witness this scene. She couldn't help but whisper, "This Connor is truly ruthless, but I like this kind of man. I'm becoming more interested in this Connor..."
After eliminating Rachel and the others, Connor directly found the secret base of Blood Shadow. However, William had long since departed, and Connor sensed that he seemed to have run hundreds of miles away.
Connor could only continue the pursuit.
...
However, news of Connor defeating over a thousand mercenary squads on Iceland and killing the Grand Six of Risu somehow leaked through unknown channels.
Although the Risu authorities had been trying their best to suppress this news, unfortunately, most people were already aware of the incident!
Once this news spread, it caused a huge uproar in the country.
Because they had never encountered such a situation before, and many ordinary people who were unaware of the details even thought that Connor was provoking the country.
It should be noted that Risu had always built its reputation on military strength, and it had been involved in numerous wars. Some naive individuals even believed that their country was the most powerful in the world. However, now that such a thing had happened, many people couldn't accept it. They were even less tolerant of Connor killing the Grand Six of Risu.
"Who on earth is this Soul Eater, and why does he have such audacity?"
"Yeah, does he think of our country as a pushover?"
"We absolutely cannot let this person go!"
For a moment, everyone in Risu was engulfed in anger, and the country's top officials naturally faced unprecedented pressure.
If the situation continued to escalate, it might reach a point where it couldn't be resolved.
....
The high-level officials of Risu immediately convened a meeting.
After all, the impact of this matter was immense, and they had to come up with a strategy as soon as possible.
"Who is this Soul Eater, and why does he dare to come to our country? Is there any conflict between us and him? Someone explain this to me!"
General Abel, in charge of military affairs, angrily shouted while looking at the information in his hands.
"This Soul Eater doesn't have any conflicts with us..."
A middle-aged man replied helplessly.
"If this person doesn't have any conflicts with us, then why is he going on a killing spree? What does he want?"
Abel slammed the table, his expression filled with agitation.
"It seems like this Soul Eater has some conflict with Blood Shadow, and the Grand Six probably received orders from higher-ups to act. However, no one expected things to escalate like this. Soul Eater's audacity is beyond imagination!"
One of Abel's subordinates reminded him quietly.
Upon hearing this, Abel seemed to understand what was happening and took a deep breath. Then he spoke softly, "Since things have escalated to this point, tell me how we should resolve this!"
"Risu is not a place where he can run wild. I suggest using large-scale weapons to deal with this person. It might also be a good opportunity to remind our competitors not to think they can do as they please in our country just because they have some skills!"
A burly man spoke up directly.
"Exactly, that's what I think too. This Connor must be killed!"
"In the current situation, we can only resort to military force!"
Others seemed to agree with the burly man's opinion.
"The strength of this Soul Eater is indeed terrifying. If we really want to eliminate him, we may have to pay a heavy price. So, I think we should consider it carefully."
At this moment, someone offered a different opinion.
"Rode, are you out of your mind? Even if this Soul Eater's strength is terrifying, can he withstand explosives?"
The burly man stared with widened eyes.
"You should all watch this video first!"
Rode played a video on a large screen, showing scenes of Connor battling the mercenaries.
After seeing the video, everyone was stunned.
After all, most of these people were just ordinary civilians, and they had never witnessed such scenes before. Their expressions clearly showed their shock.
"You've all seen the video. This person's strength is truly beyond our imagination. If we want to completely eliminate him, we may have to pay a significant price. Therefore, I believe we should consider this carefully!"
Rode looked at the expressionless individuals present.
"In that case, what do you suggest we do? We can't just let Connor continue to create chaos, can we?"
The burly man shouted with widened eyes.
"I think we should try negotiating with him, persuade him to leave Risu, and then figure out how to deal with him. If he doesn't leave, we'll have no choice but to eliminate him. But if we do, we'll have a hard time explaining things to the people of Sommervile."
Rode spoke in a low voice.
"You're being too cautious. I think we should just get rid of him. After all, he's the one who invaded us!"
The burly man spoke in a straightforward manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 2150: You Are Really Interesting
chapters.content:
Chapter 2150: You Are Really Interesting
Clearly, these people understood that Rode's approach was the more prudent one, as using large-scale weapons of mass destruction required caution.
The reason the strong man was so determined to eliminate Connor was that there was a complex relationship between the strong man and Blood Shadow. Additionally, the strong man held a high position, so the others refrained from speaking out, fearing they might offend him.
"General Abel, what do you think we should do about this matter?" At this moment, someone took the initiative to speak to Abel.
After hesitating for two seconds, Abel replied in a low voice, "I think Rode's suggestion is correct. We should proceed with caution. I believe we should send someone to communicate with this Soul Eater and try to get him to leave the United States as soon as possible. As for his disputes with Blood Shadow, that's none of our concern. They can handle it however they like, but he cannot remain within our borders. What do you all think?"
"I agree!" Rode immediately nodded without hesitation.
"Count me in!"
"Me too!"
Seeing that Abel had spoken, everyone stepped up to support his suggestion.
The strong man hesitated for a moment but then said in a low voice, "I agree as well, but who will go and meet this Soul Eater? I heard he's a serial killer, and we don't even know where he is, do we?"
Naturally, the strong man disagreed with Abel's approach, but he didn't dare to oppose him.
"I'll take care of this matter," a woman's voice suddenly sounded.
Upon hearing this voice, everyone turned their heads toward the entrance of the room.
"I know where the Soul Eater is right now, and I'll go talk to him."
On the other side, after chasing William for nearly a few hundred miles, Connor began to feel that his body couldn't bear it any longer. In less than a month, he had experienced several major battles, putting a tremendous strain on his body.
He knew that if he continued to push his body like this, he might fall into a coma again at any moment. Once that happened, his situation could become very dangerous.
Currently, he had locked onto William using his divine sense, so no matter where William fled, he could still locate him. Therefore, he didn't need to rush.
He decided to take a night's rest in Littlemere, which was the nearest city to him, and then resume the search for William the next day. This would give his body some time to recover.
Upon entering the city, he entered a hotel without drawing much attention. Many people in the hotel were discussing the Soul Eater, not realizing that he had just passed by them and overheard their insults.
However, he understood that these people were just ordinary civilians and had no knowledge of the true situation. He couldn't afford to waste time explaining to them.
Once he reached his hotel room, Connor immediately entered a state of meditation. At this moment, the most important thing for him was to allow his body to recuperate.
However, in less than an hour, he heard a knock on the door.
He hesitated but concluded that it was likely hotel staff. Since he hadn't provided identification documents to the hotel, he chose not to open the door to avoid unnecessary trouble.
"Lord Soul Eater," the voice from the other side of the door said.
This sentence made Connor open his eyes.
He paused, realizing that if the person outside the door knew his true identity, they were certainly not an ordinary individual.
He hesitated for two seconds and then walked to the door, opening it.
Once the door was open, he saw a sexy woman wearing sunglasses and a long lady's coat standing before him.
Connor observed the woman from top to bottom and realized that he didn't know her. They had never met before.
"May I come in, Soul Eater?" The woman removed her sunglasses, revealing her beautiful face, and smiled at Connor.
The woman removed her sunglasses, revealing her beautiful face, and smiled at him.
Connor hesitated for a moment, then stepped aside, allowing the woman to enter his room.
"Who are you? How did you know?" he asked the woman expressionlessly.
"Let me introduce myself first," the woman said, pausing for a moment before looking at Connor. "I have many names, but I prefer the name Shelley. Of course, my name isn't very important. What matters is my identity."
The woman continued, "I am the head of Rockefeller in Risu. Most people prefer to call me Amelia. You've had contact with Asya, so you should be well aware of my identity!"
He hesitated for a moment. He was surprised by the woman's arrival because he didn't expect her to be affiliated with the Rockefeller, especially as their representative in Risu.
Of course, Connor didn't doubt her identity at this point. Her knowledge of his identity as the Soul Eater indicated a connection with the Rockefellers.
"Since you are from Rockefeller, you should be well aware of my relationship with them. Are you not afraid that I will kill you for revealing your identity so openly?" he asked calmly.
"Do you not doubt my identity at all?" With a hint of surprise, the woman asked him softly.
"No need to doubt. Whether you are 'Amelia' or anyone else, your identity holds no significance to me," he replied, shaking his head lightly.
"You're quite interesting," she said, smiling gently.
"Answer my question!"
"I have no conflicts or grudges with you," she replied calmly. "Your desire for revenge is against Rockefeller, and I have no association with them. If someday you truly take control of the Rockefellers, you would be my next boss. Therefore, I see no reason for you to want to kill me."
Amelia's response was delivered in a composed manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 2151: Substitute
chapters.content:
Chapter 2151: Substitute
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Amelia's words. He then said indifferently, "Your reason is quite convincing. I really don't intend to kill you. Tell me why you came to find me!"
"There are two reasons. The first reason is that on behalf of the higher-ups of Risu, I want to invite you to meet and talk to them. After all, you have caused such a huge commotion here," Amelia said slowly.
"What do they want to talk about?"
Connor asked softly.
"It's very simple. They want you to leave Risu as soon as possible!"
Amelia didn't seem to plan to hide anything from Connor and answered directly.
"What if I don't plan to leave?"
"This matter has nothing to do with me. This is what you discussed with them. The purpose of my visit this time is to invite you to meet them. As long as you go, I will have completed my mission," Amelia said calmly.
"Alright, what about the second thing you mentioned?"
Connor asked.
"The second thing is to meet you personally!"
Amelia said indifferently.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said expressionlessly, "Alright, take me to meet those people now!"
"You actually agreed so easily?"
Amelia asked Connor in shock.
"I just happen to want to meet them and have a chat!"
Connor said lightly.
Amelia blinked. After hesitating for two seconds, she whispered to Connor, "Do you need me to reveal some information to you?"
"About what?"
"It's about the attitude of the higher-ups in Risu towards you!"
Amelia answered directly.
"Haha…"
After Connor heard this, he sneered and said calmly, "I don't think there's a need for that. Even if you don't say it, I know what these people want!"
"Then why are you going?"
Amelia could not help but feel a little puzzled.
"These people are troublesome after all. I originally didn't plan to deal with them, but since they have already taken the initiative to come to my door, I can take this opportunity to teach them a good lesson!" Connor explained softly.
When Amelia heard Connor's words, she was stunned on the spot. Her expression was very helpless. She could not understand why Connor was so confident; even the owner of Rockefeller, Mr. Long, did not seem to have the courage to go against the higher-ups of Risu!
However, Amelia might not be aware of Connor's situation. Jorge was in danger, and Connor had to find the King of Shadows no matter what.
The higher-ups of Risu had always been against Connor. Although they could not directly kill Connor, these people would also bring a lot of resistance to him. That was why Connor wanted to meet these higher-ups as soon as possible.
If they could negotiate, that would naturally be the best. If they could not, then Connor could only resort to more extreme methods to deal with these people.
"Alright, I'm only here to tell you about this. As for what you plan to do, that's your business. However, I'll remind you to be careful!" Amelia stood up as she spoke.
"Bring me to them!"
Connor didn't seem to want to continue talking nonsense with Amelia.
"..."
Amelia hesitated for a moment, then walked out of the room with her slender legs in her high heels.
It had to be said that when Connor first saw Amelia, he was very surprised because he originally thought that she was probably a woman in her fifties. However, he never expected Amelia to be so young and so beautiful.
Connor was a little curious about how this woman became the person in charge of Rockefeller in Risu.
However, Connor was no longer in the mood to care about these problems. He had more important things to do.
After leaving the hotel with Amelia, the two of them got into an Risun military car.
Although the car looked like a luxurious Lincoln sedan, it had been professionally modified. It was very fast and bulletproof and could easily deal with ordinary terrorist attacks.
Connor sat in the car and looked at the scenery outside the window quietly. His expression was very calm.
Amelia was sizing up the man beside her. At this moment, Amelia's curiosity towards Connor had reached a peak.
Just like how Connor was curious about how Amelia could become the person-in-charge of Rockefeller in Risu at such a young age, Amelia was also curious about how Connor could turn from an unknown university student into a Soul Eater that could make the entire world tremble at such a young age.
About 10 minutes later, Connor followed Amelia into a building.
Although Connor didn't know what the building was for, he could feel that the security inside was very tight—soldiers with guns could be seen everywhere, and there were also some small weapons. Drones were also hovering in the sky, monitoring all corners of the surroundings.
"This is the place where the higher-ups of Risu hold an emergency meeting. Ordinary people don't even know about the existence of this place. Moreover, you're the first person from Sommerville to enter this place!"
Amelia said to Connor.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Are you saying that I should feel proud?"
"I didn't mean that!"
Amelia smiled faintly, then showed the staff an ID and brought Connor into the building.
After entering the building, Connor found that the security inside seemed to be even tighter.
However, Connor didn't put these people in his eyes. After all, these people were like ants in Connor's eyes. They wouldn't be an obstacle at all.
A moment later, Amelia stopped in front of a conference room and whispered to Connor, "The higher-ups of Risu are waiting for you inside!"
"Good!"
Connor nodded gently and walked into the meeting room.
At this moment, the conference room was filled with white people. When everyone heard the sound of the door opening, they all looked at the door.
Although these people had already obtained Connor's information, when they saw Connor with their own eyes, they were a little surprised because Connor was really too young. These people even suspected that the young man they saw was a substitute for the Soul Eater.

chapters.title: Chapter 2152: The Price
chapters.content:
Chapter 2152: The Price
However, even if they had such thoughts in their hearts, they did not dare to show it.
However, at this moment, their gazes towards Connor were very vigilant.
A middle-aged man straightened his suit, then stood up and walked towards Connor.
"This is Mr. James. he is the diplomatic ambassador of Risu!"
Amelia said to Connor.
When Connor heard Amelia's words, he couldn't help but be stunned for a moment. He originally thought that the real ruler of Risu would meet him, but he didn't expect that the other party would only send a foreign minister to greet him. This meant that Risu didn't take Connor seriously.
However, Connor didn't know that James had a very high status among the higher-ups in Risu. General Abel and the others wouldn't even meet with Connor because they felt that if they were to personally discuss this matter with Connor, Risu would lose in terms of momentum.
James walked up to Connor and sized him up. He said arrogantly, "Hello, Soul Eater!"
"If you have anything to say, hurry up and say it. I'm not in the mood to waste time on you people!" Connor replied indifferently and then sat on the chair, as if he didn't care about the people in the room at all.
Everyone was furious at Connor's attitude, but they didn't dare to say anything.
James was naturally furious. After hesitating for two seconds, he sorted out his emotions and said in a low voice, "Alright, then let's get down to business!"
"You massacred on a large scale in our country without the permission of our country. This is a violation of our country's laws, so I need you to give us an explanation now!"
James was completely business-like at the moment.
Furthermore, James was very good at negotiating. He had the upper hand the moment he opened his mouth.
If he was facing someone else, his words might have some effect. Unfortunately, the person he was facing now was Connor.
"Give you an explanation?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard James's words.
"That's right!" James nodded.
Everyone else present was also observing Connor's expression. It was obvious that they were all very nervous because they had never thought that James would be so unyielding when negotiating with Connor.
One had to know that James was not facing an ordinary person, but the famous Soul Eater.
"I don't know what kind of explanation you want!"
Connor replied indifferently.
When James heard Connor's words, his expression became a little smug. He felt that since Connor had said this, it meant that this matter could be discussed.
"Soul Eater, the higher-ups of our country have already held a meeting to discuss this matter. Logically speaking, what you're doing now has already seriously violated the law. We have the right to directly kill you. However, we've also considered that what you're doing is not aimed at us, but to resolve the personal grudge between you and Blood Shadow, so we've decided to show mercy!"
James said seriously.
"Decided to show mercy?"
Connor smiled disdainfully.
"That's right. Our higher-ups have already issued an order. As long as you leave our country within a day and don't hurt anyone before you leave, we won't pursue justice!"
James looked up at Connor and continued, "But if you don't leave our country within a day, it means that you're declaring war on us. No matter what the price is, we will get rid of you!"
Connor glanced at James and said softly, "You Risuans are really domineering. Just because you want me to leave, I have to leave?"
Amelia's expression was a little strange after hearing Connor's words; she could feel that Connor's mood was already a little off.
"Connor, let me tell you, this is the decision of the higher-ups of our country. If you continue to be stubborn, you will definitely pay a painful price!"
James shouted excitedly with his eyes wide open.
"What price?"
Connor asked expressionlessly.
"Don't think that we don't have your information. You can ignore us, but what about your friends and family? We have detailed information on everyone around you. Do you want to watch these people pay a painful price because of your stupid actions?"
The expression on Connor's face seemed to have some killing intent. Then, without thinking, he waved his hand.
"Bang!"
Before James could finish his last sentence, he was sent flying and smashed into the wall. He was instantly smashed into meat paste by Connor's palm.
For a moment, everyone in the meeting room was dumbfounded. No one had thought that Connor would actually kill James.
Everyone stared at Connor's position with their eyes wide open, as if they were in disbelief. They felt that everything had happened too suddenly.
The Foreign Affairs Minister of Risu was actually killed just like that!
"Do you really intend to make an enemy out of Risu?" a middle-aged man shouted excitedly at Connor.
Connor glanced at the middle-aged man indifferently. The middle-aged man was so frightened by Connor's gaze that he directly took two steps back and staggered to the ground,
"Lord Soul Eater, you're too impulsive!"
Even Amelia felt that Connor's actions were inappropriate because James's influence in Risu was very large. However, if Connor killed James like this, it would definitely have an even more terrifying impact, and the relationship between Connor and Risu would further deteriorate.
"This person is too stupid. He shouldn't have used my friend to threaten me!"
Connor said to Amelia expressionlessly.
"Then you shouldn't have killed him just like that. Risu is really not as simple as you think!" Amelia said with a frown.
"So what?"
"..."
Amelia was speechless after hearing Connor's words. She smiled bitterly and didn't know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 2153: He Killed James!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2153: He Killed James!
Because at this moment, Amelia finally realized that Connor did not take these Risuans seriously at all.
Therefore, he didn't care what kind of attitude they took towards him.
"Soul Eater, you are openly provoking us!" At this moment, another person in the meeting room stood up and shouted at Connor.
"That's right, I'm provoking you!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Are you really going to make an enemy out of us?"
The middle-aged man continued to shout.
"It's not that I want to be enemies with you, but rather that you want to be enemies with me. I hope you can remember what I'm about to say and pass it on to your superiors!" Connor paused for a moment and then continued, "This matter is a personal grudge between me and Blood Shadow. I don't want anyone else to get involved, but if you insist on sending yourself to your deaths, I don't mind becoming your enemy. As for you asking me to leave Risu, I can agree, but I'll only leave after I've settled my matters!"
"You... You…"
The middle-aged man was so angry by Connor's words that his entire body trembled. For a moment, he actually did not know what to say.
The meaning of Connor's words was very obvious. He didn't care about Risu at all. If he didn't settle his matters, he wouldn't leave.
As for the requests that Risu had made to Connor, he did not care at all!
"Do you understand me?"
Connor asked the middle-aged man softly.
"You will definitely regret this stupid decision of yours!"
The middle-aged man gritted his teeth and shouted angrily at Connor.
"Stupid?" Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "You should be the ones who are really stupid!"
After saying this, Connor walked out of the meeting room without any hesitation.
Everyone looked at Connor's back, their faces filled with anger, but there was nothing they could do. They knew how terrifying Connor's strength was, and they could not stop him at all.
After seeing Connor leave, Amelia hesitated for two seconds before leaving with him.
At this moment, only the higher-ups of Risu were left in the meeting room. Their expressions were very ugly.
After Amelia left the meeting room, she immediately caught up with Connor.
"Soul Eater, do you really intend to start a war with Risu?"
Amelia asked with a puzzled expression.
Connor looked at Amelia indifferently and said calmly, "If they want to start a war, then let's start a war…"
"If we really start a war, it won't benefit you at all!" Amelia said with a frown.
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said softly, "If I remember correctly, you should be one of Rockefeller's men. If I die, the biggest beneficiary will be Rockefeller. Why are you worried about me now?"
"I'm not worried about you!"
Amelia shook her head.
"Then why are you concerned about the matters between me and the higher-ups of Risu?"
"If you really want to start a war with Risu , it will definitely have an impact on Risu's economy. My businesses will also be greatly affected," Amelia didn't hide anything from Connor and spoke bluntly.
"Haha…"
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said indifferently, "You're quite honest!"
"What happens between you and Risu has nothing to do with me. Even what happens between you and Rockefeller has nothing to do with me. I only care about one thing, and that is my business. Even if you really take over Rockefeller one day, you will need someone to help you manage your business in Risu, and I will always be your best choice!" Amelia said seriously.
After hearing this, Connor nodded lightly and said expressionlessly, "Aren't you afraid that Mr. Long will hear what you said just now?"
"So what if he does? The most useless thing in Rockefeller is loyalty. As long as it can bring benefits to Rockefeller, it didn't matter even if everyone knows that I wasn't loyal to Mr. Long!" Amelia said.
Connor looked at Amelia indifferently. Actually, he had heard of Rockefeller's management methods before, so he did not doubt the authenticity of Amelia's words.
However, Connor was a little curious as to what purpose Amelia had for contacting him.
…
A few minutes later, Connor and Amelia left the building. Amelia then asked someone to drive Connor back to the hotel.
What surprised Connor was that Amelia didn't choose to go to the hotel with Connor, but instead left alone.
Connor used his divine sense to lock onto Amelia, wanting to see what secrets this woman was hiding behind her back.
However, Connor realized that he might have overthought the situation. After Amelia separated from Connor, she returned to her home and began to deal with work matters. She did not rest until two in the morning.
"Could it be that she really has no motive for approaching me?"
Connor couldn't help but secretly wonder. Then, he entered a state of cultivation.
At this moment, Connor was not in the mood to focus on Amelia. After all, finding William and the King of Shadows was the most important thing.
…
The news that Connor had killed James reached the higher-ups of Risu in an instant. General Abel and the others were furious.
This was because Connor's behavior was too arrogant. It was obvious that he did not take the higher-ups of Risu seriously.
"This Connor is simply provoking us!"
"Is this person too arrogant? He even killed our Foreign Affairs Minister. What's going on?"
"No matter what, we have to kill this Connor. We can't let this person continue to live. This person is too arrogant!"
The higher-ups of Risu looked at the information in their hands and discussed amongst themselves softly.
General Abel and Rode's expressions turned ugly. After all, they were the ones who suggested this idea.
Originally, the two of them had planned to turn a big matter into a small matter, but who would have thought that Connor would actually outright kill James?

chapters.title: Chapter 2154: Spread Around the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 2154: Spread Around the World
"This Connor is really too arrogant! What does he take us for?"
"Does he think that we're afraid of him just because we didn't do anything to him? All these years, no one has dared to blatantly kill our US Foreign Affairs Minister. I think we have no other choice now. We have to get rid of Connor!"
Roger, who had always advocated using weapons against Connor, slammed the table and shouted.
"Roger, you're too emotional!"
Rode couldn't help but advise softly.
"James is already dead. How can I not be emotional?"
Roger replied with widened eyes.
In fact, everyone present knew very well that James and Roger didn't have a particularly good relationship. Roger only wanted to use this excuse to start a war with Connor.
Everyone knew the relationship between Roger and Blood Shadow, so he would definitely think of a way to get rid of Connor.
"That's right, Connor did kill James, but James used Connor's friend to threaten him. This method is obviously not appropriate. After all, Connor's methods are very cruel."
Rode paused for a moment and continued, "Besides, I've already reminded him to be careful with his words, but I didn't expect him to be so..."
"Rode, what do you mean? Are you related to Connor? Why is it that every time I want to use military power to deal with Connor, you always try to stop me?"
Roger couldn't hold it in anymore and shouted at Rode.
Rode seemed to be a little excited and said loudly, "Roger, what do you mean? What connection can there be between me and Connor? You're obviously slandering me!"
"Alright, how long are you two going to argue? Did I call you here today to listen to you guys quarrel?"
General Abel knocked on the table and called out.
Rode and Roger quieted down after hearing Abel's words.
"General Abel, what do you think we should do about this? The news of James's death will soon spread throughout Risu . If we don't do anything, our country might really become a laughing stock!"
Roger asked Abel expressionlessly.
Abel hesitated for two seconds before saying, "You are right. This Connor is really too arrogant. No matter what, we must teach him a lesson…"
"General…"
Rode opened his mouth to speak.
"You don't have to say anything…"
Abel waved at Rode and said expressionlessly, "The impact of this matter is too great, so we can only attack Connor! Do you have any different opinions?"
Rode looked at Abel helplessly. He knew that there was no point in him speaking now, so he decided to keep his mouth shut.
The others naturally wouldn't stand out to oppose it.
"Since none of you have any objections, then this matter is settled!"
Abel said expressionlessly.
"I'll arrange for people to attack Connor now!"
Roger's expression was a little excited. He quickly got up and was about to leave.
"Don't be so anxious!"
However, Abel reached out to stop Roger and said calmly, "Although I have already agreed to use force against Connor, I didn't say that I would attack him immediately. I plan to give Connor one last chance. If Connor doesn't leave our country within a day, or if he continues to attack our people, it won't be too late to attack him!"
Abel said expressionlessly.
"Then shouldn't we be prepared first?"
Roger hurriedly asked.
"En, I'll leave this matter to you. I hope you can resolve this matter perfectly!"
Abel nodded.
"I know!"
Roger looked a little excited. He stood up and walked out of the conference room.
After Roger left, Rode took a deep breath and whispered to Abel, "General, why did you give this order? You should be very clear about Connor's strength. If we really fight, it's fine if we can kill Connor, but if we can't kill him, the consequences will be unimaginable!"
Abel turned to Rode and said, " I know very well what you're thinking. I also know very well what Roger is thinking. However, Connor's actions are too arrogant. If we don't react soon, the pressure of public opinion may directly crush us. Moreover, the election is about to take place. We can't have any problems at this time…"
Rode couldn't help but sigh. He didn't say anything else.
Roger's response was very fast. In less than two hours, countless helicopters were hovering above the city, and various fighter jets were constantly shuttling back and forth. The closest military base Las Vegas had already prepared explosives.
Obviously, these things were prepared for Connor.
As long as Connor did not leave Risu territory after a day, Roger would attack Connor.
Moreover, the entire city had been monitored, so Connor's every move was under the surveillance of these people.
The ordinary Risuans looked at the fighter jets in the sky with excitement on their faces. They knew that the Risu counterattack was finally about to begin.
"This Connor is really too arrogant. Isn't he just a small martial artist? They actually want to go against our country. This is simply courting death!"
"That's right. Is there something wrong with this person's brain? Is our country someone he can mess with?"
"This is going to be a good show!"
"I heard that this Connor seems to have killed one of our Foreign Affairs Ministers. The higher-ups are very angry about this matter!"
It was as if all the Risuans were concerned about this war. Such discussions could be heard everywhere.
Moreover, it was not only the Risuans who were concerned about this matter. Almost the entire world was concerned about this matter.
After Chelsea found out about Connor's incident through the news, she was so shocked that she did not know what to say. She did not expect Connor to cause such a big commotion when he went to Risu.

chapters.title: Chapter 2155: Intelligent Man
chapters.content:
Chapter 2155: Intelligent Man
Those who knew Connor in the country also knew about this matter.
Everyone was secretly sweating for Connor.
After all, this time, Connor was not facing any ordinary enemy, but a behemoth like Risu!
It was as if the entire world was shocked by this news.
Connor had no idea what was going on outside, however. He rested in the hotel for an entire day.
When he felt that his body had almost recovered, he left the hotel and flew towards William.
Connor had just left the hotel when the higher-ups of Risu received the news.
"Report, the target has left the hotel and is heading southwest!"
"Keep an eye on the target at all times. If you find something wrong with the target, fire immediately. There's no need to report!"
"Roger!"
"Report, the target is approaching Mixas!"
"Continue following!"
At this moment, the command center had already entered a state of high alert. Because they knew that the real war would start at any time, these people did not dare to relax at all.
..
At the same time.
After William left Iceland, he had planned to leave Risu.
However, he later received news that the higher-ups of Risu had intervened in this matter. Therefore, Risu had become the safest place for William.
This was because their troops would only attack Connor within the borders of Risu. However, if William left Risu, Connor would definitely leave Risu with him. At that time, William would be in great danger.
At this moment, William was enjoying delicious red wine in his manor. His expression was one of satisfaction. There were a few people sitting beside William. These people had high positions among the high-ranking officials of Risu.
Of course, Roger had the highest status amongst them.
Roger gently swirled the goblet in his hand and smiled. "William, I have already done what I promised you. As long as Connor dares to attack you, I guarantee that he will become a corpse in less than three minutes!"
"Roger, thank you so much for this. Don't worry. Since you've done what you promised me, I'll definitely do what I promised you!"
William said to Roger with a smile.
"Then let's celebrate our happy collaboration first!"
Roger couldn't help but laugh. Then, he clinked glasses with William.
After Roger drank the red wine, his expression became murderous. He said in a low voice, "That Abel is too cunning. If it wasn't for James, he probably wouldn't have agreed to help. So after Connor's matter is settled, you have to hurry up and get rid of Abel for me. That way, if you run into any trouble in the future, I can easily help you solve it!"
"There shouldn't be any trouble. Actually, if it weren't for my uncle being unable to come over because of some matters, I wouldn't have needed your help at all!"
William said in a low voice.
"That's true…"
Roger nodded.
"Right, I'm a little worried. Connor's strength is extremely terrifying. Even the six gods aren't his match. Can your subordinates really finish off Connor?"
After a moment of hesitation, William asked Roger softly,
After all, William had seen Connor fight, so he had some understanding of Connor's strength. He was very worried that Roger's men would not be a match for Connor. What should he do then?
"Hahaha…"
Roger laughed out loud when he heard William's words. He patted William's shoulder and said, "William, are you out of your mind? No matter how powerful Connor is, he's just one person. How could he compete with so many modern weapons?"
"The weapons in the hands of the mercenaries I found back then were also very advanced!" William replied expressionlessly and continued, "And you shouldn't be able to use weapons of mass destruction here, right?"
"It's just dealing with Connor. There's no need for any weapons of mass destruction!"
Roger shook his head. He took out his phone, looked up a video, and handed it to William. He said softly, "You'd better watch this video first!"
William's expression was a little puzzled. He did not seem to understand what William meant, but he played the video suspiciously.
At this moment, a black-armored A.I. appeared in the video. The A.I.'s movement speed was very shocking. In almost an instant, it had rushed over a thousand meters. There were countless people firing at the A.I., but the bullets did not seem to have any reaction when they hit its body. They only caused sparks.
Moreover, this A.I. was able to survive the violent explosion, and even heavy armored vehicles could not hurt this A.I..
The strength of this A.I. was also very terrifying. It could even send a heavy armored vehicle flying with one punch.
When William saw the video, he was stunned. His expression was one of disbelief.
As William was an Earth-ranked ancient martial arts grandmaster, he was very familiar with the power of a martial artist.
However, when William saw the A.I. in the video, he realized that the A.I.'s power was on par with a Heaven class ancient martial arts grandmaster.
"What is this?"
William put down his phone and asked Roger in a low voice.
"How is it? Isn't it very powerful?"
Roger smiled proudly.
"It's indeed very powerful!"
William nodded gently.
"This is our newest combat A.I.. Let me tell you, this A.I.'s strength is very terrifying, and its combat power is also very shocking. Moreover, it's very sturdy. We've tested it before, and even an Earth Realm ancient martial arts grandmaster can't easily take care of an A.I. in a short period of time!"
Roger said with a smile.
"So that's how it is!"
William let out a long sigh and looked at Roger."Then how many of these intelligent humans do you have?"
"A thousand!"
Roger replied indifferently.
"A thousand?"
When William heard this, he was stunned. His expression was one of disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 2156: You Can Help?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2156: You Can Help?
He had never expected Roger to have so many A.I.s.
If there were really so many A.I.s, even a Heaven Rank Ancient Martial Artist would have a headache if they encountered them.
"The production of these A.I.s requires a very precious metal to make. This material is very rare on Earth and can only be found on Mars. Therefore, we have only produced 1,000 of them. However, in the future, there will be more and more of these A.I.s..." Roger said proudly.
"This is really too powerful…"
William was so shocked that he did not know what to say.
"Let me show you a few more weapons we've produced. After you're done, you'll know why I'm so confident!"
As Roger spoke, he looked for a few other videos on his phone and showed them to William.
After William saw the power of these weapons, he was even more shocked. Initially, William did not think much of the military strength of Risu because he felt that rifles and tanks were nothing compared to martial artists.
But today, his horizons were broadened.
"Actually, we have already started researching these weapons a long time ago. After all, we have also noticed the strength of you martial artists. If we can't deal with it, then sooner or later, this world will become the world of martial artists!"
Roger paused for a moment and then continued, "Even if an ordinary person uses the weapons we have produced, the combat power of this ordinary person can be compared to your ancient martial arts grandmaster. Moreover, this is only the initial stage. In the future, the power of the weapons we have developed may be even more terrifying. At that time, you martial artists will not pose any threat to us at all!"
"And the weapons I've come into contact with aren't even our strongest weapons. Only old Abel has access to the information on the strongest weapons!"
"Don't worry, I'll get rid of Abel for you as soon as possible!" William quickly said.
"As long as Abel dies, the two of us will join forces and the entirety of Risu will be ours!" Roger said excitedly to William.
"..."
William looked at Roger and smiled without saying anything. He was much more relaxed now.
Previously, he was worried that Roger's people would be a match for Connor. Now, he realized that his worry was obviously unnecessary. If he really had these smart people and those weapons, then Connor would definitely die today.
"Connor, as long as you dare to show up I will make sure that you never leave alive!"
…
Meanwhile, Connor arrived at the desert in front of Mixas in less than half a day.
Connor knew that he only needed to cross this desert to find William.
However, Connor had just arrived at the desert when he met an acquaintance.
Amelia was wearing a sexy black tight-fitting shirt. She descended the rope ladder and landed in front of Connor.
"Why are you here?"
Connor sized up Amelia.
Amelia tidied her messy hair and said to Connor expressionlessly, "Soul Eater, I advise you not to go to Mixas!"
"Why?"
Connor asked.
"I just received news that Risu is ready to use their military forces to attack you. This time, they are using the most advanced weapons. The desert in front of you is deserted and is their ideal battlefield. As long as you enter this desert, they will attack you!" she said very seriously.
"I said that if they want to fight, then let them. I have to find William no matter what!"
Connor said expressionlessly.
"What's the conflict between you and Blood Shadow? I can act as a middleman to communicate between the two of you!" Amelia said helplessly.
"Blood Shadow's men cast a Ghostly Spirit Curse on my master. Only the King of Shadows can break this curse. I have to find the King of Shadows!" Connor said lightly.
"I can help with this!" Amelia hurriedly said.
"You'll help?"
Connor faintly smiled after hearing Amelia's words, and then said softly, "I said I want to kill the King of Shadows. Can you help me with this?"
"You…"
Amelia was instantly stunned on the spot, and the expression on his face was extremely incredulous.
It was only then that she realized that Connor's true target was not William, but the King of Shadows!
"Soul Eater, the King of Shadows is not only in contact with many important figures in Risu, but he is also very influential in Europe. If you really intend to deal with him, I advise you..."
Amelia opened her mouth to speak, but Connor interrupted her words.
"You don't have to persuade me otherwise. Blood Shadow's men injured my master. I will never let them off. Whether it's William or the King of Shadows, they must die!"
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the vast desert in front of him. His tone was calm, but firm.
Amelia took a deep breath. She knew that it was useless to say anything now. She had no way to change Connor's mind.
"Since you've made up your mind, I won't say anything more. However, I want to remind you that you must be careful. According to the information I have now, Risu is using the most advanced military weapons this time. The power of these weapons is very shocking. Although I know that your strength is also very terrifying, you have to be careful!" she said.
"Thank you for your reminder!"
Although Connor didn't know what purpose Amelia had for getting close to him, no matter what, Amelia's words just now were kind, so Connor thanked her.
After saying this, Connor did not waste any more time and directly walked into the desert.
Connor had just entered the desert when the drone in the sky received the signal and sent the video to the command center.
For a moment, everyone entered battle mode.
"Warning: please leave Risu. Otherwise, we will attack you in three minutes!"
"Warning: please leave Risu…"
The drone in the sky began to use the language of the summer to warn Connor.
"Noisy!"
Connor waved his right hand gently, and a ray of light pierced through the drone.

chapters.title: Chapter 2157: Confrontation
chapters.content:
Chapter 2157: Confrontation
When Amelia saw this scene, she quickly followed the rope ladder back to the plane.
Then, she immediately urged the pilot to leave this troublesome place!
Amelia knew that this place would soon become a battlefield. At that time, she might be dragged into it.
After the plane took off, Amelia took out her phone and made a call.
"Jess, immediately stop all the projects our company is carrying out in Risu. Also, go to Rockefeller and take out some cash. The more the better. I have great use for this money…"
"Don't ask so many questions now. Do whatever I tell you to do. During this period of time, don't come to work for the company's employees…"
"Yes, yes. Do as I say. Immediately!" Amelia said quickly into the phone.
Although Amelia was young, she was very good at managing the company and doing business. Otherwise, she would never have become one of the Four Vajras of Rockefeller.
Amelia knew that once the war between Connor and Risu started, no matter who won or lost, the economy of Risu would be greatly affected, and Rockefeller's business in Risu would naturally be affected. Therefore, it was obviously the best choice to stop work now so that she could minimize her losses.
She had also prepared a large amount of funds to buy stocks.
This was because she could foresee that after this war ended, Risu's stock market would definitely be greatly affected.
If she could buy a large number of stocks at this time, she would definitely make a fortune.
..
On the other hand, after Roger received the news that Connor had entered the desert, he was not in a hurry to attack Connor.
The reason was simple: Abel had told them that they could only counterattack after Connor made the first move.
Now that Connor did not attack them yet, Roger naturally did not dare to attack.
However, Roger didn't seem to plan to wait forever. He knew that as long as his people appeared, Connor would definitely make a move.
Connor had just advanced less than ten kilometers in the desert when he saw a large group of people charging towards him with loaded guns.
Connor narrowed his eyes and looked at the few people in front of him. The expression on his face seemed a little helpless.
The person at the front shouted, "Please leave immediately, or we will fire at you!"
"..."
Connor looked at that person indifferently. Then, without any hesitation, he directly sent out an aura.
In an instant, those people who were originally blocking Connor were all sent flying, wailing endlessly.
Roger, who had already arrived at the command center, was a little excited when he saw this scene. He shouted, "I knew you would definitely make a move. Attack the target immediately!"
After Roger shouted this sentence, countless explosives flew towards Connor.
Deafening sounds also came from the sky.
These explosives could accurately locate Connor's position and also had tracking functions. Moreover, the number of them was very shocking. If Connor was really hit, even if he was a Heaven Rank ancient martial arts grandmaster, he would be seriously injured.
Roger looked at Connor on the screen, licked his lips and said in a low voice, "Now, I'll let you know the consequences of offending us!"
As the position where the explosives were launched was hundreds of kilometers away from Connor, it would take some time for them to reach Connor. Connor looked at the explosives in the sky for 2 seconds before slashing out with his sword.
The golden sword chi flew towards the explosives.
Connor was also very aware about the power of these explosives. Moreover, Connor did not want to waste too much energy here, so he chose the simplest way to deal with these explosives.
In just a moment, loud sounds came from the sky like thunder.
Those explosives did not even get close to Connor before they were detonated by his sword chi in the sky.
The moment the explosives exploded, it was as if the earth was trembling. If not for the fact that there were no residents within a hundred miles of the desert, it would have caused quite a bit of panic.
Roger's expression was a little strange when he saw Connor detonate the explosives.
"Looks like this Connor really has some skills. No wonder even the six gods are not his match!" Roger sighed softly, but his expression was very confident because he knew that this was just the beginning. The real show had yet to come.
After the explosives exploded, dozens of fighter jets appeared in the sky.
The fighter jet flew towards Connor with a deafening sound.
However, these fighter jets seemed to be very afraid of Connor's strength, so they did not dare to get too close to Connor. They could only attack him from afar.
Countless bullets flew towards Connor like raindrops.
Connor waved his right hand, and a golden light directly enveloped his body.
After the bullets hit the barrier around Connor's body, their deadliness became like raindrops—they could not cause any damage to Connor at all.
When the fighter pilot saw this scene, he could not help but wonder if he was facing a person!
Although these people had heard some things about the Soul Eaters before, they all felt that the rumors outside might be a little exaggerated. After all, how could a human be so powerful?
Now that these people finally faced Connor, they knew that the rumors in the outside world might not be exaggerated.
Connor's strength might be even more terrifying than the rumors!
At this moment, another sword chi flew across the sky towards the fighter jet.
All of this happened too suddenly. The pilot of the fighter jet did not even have time to react before the fighter jet exploded.
After the other pilots realized that something was wrong, they hurriedly increased their speed, wanting to escape from Connor's attack range. However, they might have underestimated him.
Connor waved the golden sword in his hand continuously, and more than ten sword auras directly soared into the sky, heading towards the location of those fighter jets.
One had to know that the power of Connor's sword chi was even more terrifying than the power of those explosives.

chapters.title: Chapter 2158: The Second Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 2158: The Second Attack
In just a few moments, all the fighter jets in the sky exploded.
One had to know that these fighter jets were one of the most advanced weapons in the world.
Moreover, the price of each fighter jet could be more than hundreds of millions of dollars, and it was a priceless existence.
If other regions wanted to spend money to buy it, Risu might not necessarily sell it to them!
But now, in less than five minutes, Connor had easily destroyed more than ten fighter jets.
When everyone in the command room saw this scene, they were all stunned, especially Roger's expression.
They had just started, yet their losses were already so painful. If they did not kill Connor in the end, then Roger would definitely have to bear the main responsibility, and this responsibility was something he could not bear.
"Who is this Soul Eater? How could he shoot down our fighter jets so easily?" Roger couldn't help but shout.
After all, these fighter jets were made of very precious metals, and their hardness was terrifying.
However, in front of Connor, it was like paper mache.
"We haven't analyzed the enemy's attack method yet!"
A young man sitting in front of the computer replied with trepidation.
"What a bunch of good-for-nothings!" Roger couldn't help but shout.
"According to the information we have now, the enemy's attack method is called 'Sword Chi' in the martial arts world!"
Someone suddenly said to Roger.
"What the hell is Sword Chi?"
Roger replied through gritted teeth.
"This... I don't quite understand…"
"Then do we have any way to deal with this thing now? We can't keep going like this, right?" Roger said with his eyes wide open.
"Right now, there is no good way to deal with the enemy's attack, but I feel that his attack range is limited. We can stay out of his attack range," The young man analyzed while staring at the image on the computer screen.
"Alright…"
Roger nodded slightly and continued, "Give the order now. Everyone, don't get close to him anymore. Attack him from a distance. If long-range attacks are ineffective, then we can only use weapons of mass destruction!"
"Roger!"
"Roger!"
Soon, a response came from Roger's walkie-talkie.
After putting down the walkie-talkie, Roger let out a long sigh. At this moment, the expression on his face was no longer as confident as before. It was only then that he realized that the enemy he was facing was not as simple as he had imagined.
..
On the other side, Connor continued to move forward after dealing with the fighter jets.
However, the opponent's second attack was already in place. This time, they did not choose to get close to Connor, but attacked Connor from a distance.
It had to be said that Roger's method was very effective.
Because these fighter jets were quite far away from Connor, Connor had no way to lock onto their positions. Naturally, he had no way to attack them.
Of course, Connor still had another choice, which was to use his divine sense to lock onto these fighter jets.
However, Connor didn't want to waste his aura too much. Using his spiritual sense to lock onto the fighter jet would only bring a greater burden to Connor's body, so he gave up on this choice.
After Roger saw that Connor could not make a move, he looked a little proud and directly ordered to increase the firepower.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Loud noises continued in the sky as countless bullets and explosives flew towards Connor's position.
If this scene were to spread online, it would definitely cause a huge panic.
It was too cruel. The scene was as terrifying as hell on earth.
However, Roger had already made preparations in advance. He had already cordoned off the surroundings of the desert. No one was allowed to approach, so at this moment, there was only Connor in the desert.
This was also the reason why Roger dared to attack Connor so boldly.
Connor had no way to lock onto the position of those fighter jets, so he only had one choice, which was to face these attacks and charge forward.
Connor used his aura to form a protective barrier around his body, then continued to walk forward.
Roger was so angry that he smashed the table twice. He did not expect Connor to be fine even though his firepower was already so terrifying!
"What kind of monster is this person?"
Roger couldn't help but shout.
"There's no other way now. We can only use the nuclear bomb!"
The person beside Roger reminded him softly.
"If we use the atomic bomb, this desert will be reduced to ruins. The damage caused by the radiation is beyond our imagination. The price is too high. The people above will never agree, and neither will Abel!"
Roger said through gritted teeth.
"But other than using elemental bombs, we don't have any better ideas!" the subordinate hurriedly said.
"How about this? Use Explosive 73 to buy some time. I'll contact Abel!" Roger said after thinking for a moment.
"Understood!"
The subordinate nodded and picked up the walkie-talkie.
Although the so-called Explosive 73 they were using was not as powerful as the elemental bombs, their lethality was still very terrifying. However, the damage caused by these explosives to the ground was very small, unlike the elemental bombs. Once used, it would be difficult to recover for decades.
A few minutes later, five Explosive 73s flew toward Connor.
Connor could feel that this kind of explosive was different from the previous ones, terrifying in both flying speed and power.
"..."
Connor hesitated for a moment before waving his right hand.
A golden sword Chi flew towards the location of the explosives.
"Bang!"
The explosives detonated, but what Connor never expected was that the explosive would turn into countless small bombs after detonating.
For a moment, Connor was enveloped by the flames that blotted out the sky and covered the earth.
Although Connor's body was protected by the aura, when so many bombs exploded at the same time, it also brought a lot of burden to his body.
Moreover, this was only the beginning. Following that, four more similar explosives flew towards Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2159: Hit the Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 2159: Hit the Target
Helpless, Connor could only stop and focus on resisting the explosives in the sky.
For a moment, a series of explosions rang out.
It was as if the world had exploded. If one did not see it with their own eyes, no one would be able to imagine how spectacular this scene was!
In the distance, Amelia was watching the battle through her phone.
Her expression was very ugly because she could feel that Connor's current situation was not very optimistic. Although Connor was not in any danger for the time being, these attacks had already brought enough threat to Connor.
"I wonder if Connor can survive this time!"
Amelia sighed softly, then narrowed her eyes and looked out of the window.
Although Amelia was now more than a hundred kilometers away from the desert, she could still clearly hear the sound of the explosions. From this, she could already tell the intensity of the battle.
..
On the other side, Connor used almost ten minutes to finally block the attack of the explosives.
Roger's call with Abel finally ended. Under the immense pressure, Abel had no choice but to agree to Roger's request to use elemental bombs.
They had no choice. Things had already gotten to this point. If they couldn't kill Connor, they would become the laughing stock of the world. Abel had no choice but to kill Connor at all costs.
In this way, they could still preserve their reputation. If they let Connor leave just like that, the impact would definitely not be as simple as using an elemental bomb.
Roger looked excited when Abel agreed to his request. He picked up the walkie-talkie and shouted, "Prepare the elemental bombs. Attack the target in one minute!"
"Roger!"
"Roger!"
One had to know that the launching process of elemental bombs was very complicated. It was not something that could be used just because one wanted to use it. It required some time to prepare.
Roger felt that one minute was exceptionally long. He stared at Connor on the screen with a murderous expression because he knew that this person would soon become a dead man.
"We will now proceed to the final stage of the test!"
"Test complete. There are no errors!"
"Counting down!"
"Three!"
"Two!"
"One!"
Rumble!
There was a loud bang.
A huge elemental bomb directly soared into the sky and then flew towards Connor's position.
Connor felt that something was wrong, so he suddenly raised his head to take a look, only to see the elemental bullet flying towards his current location at an extremely shocking speed.
Without giving Connor any time to react, the elemental bomb directly exploded, forming a huge mushroom cloud.
Amelia watched the entire scene through the video and could not help but tremble slightly. She said with an incredulous expression, "Have the higher-ups in Risu gone crazy? They're actually using elemental bombs!"
One had to know that such a thing had never happened before, because it was absolutely impossible for a person to be so terrifying that they needed to use elemental bombs to deal with him.
Connor was the first person so far!
However, Amelia knew that one elemental bomb could be worth hundreds of billions. Even a country like Risu had a very limited number of elemental bombs stored.
In order to kill Connor, they were actually willing to use elemental bombs.
Amelia didn't know how to describe her feelings. She looked at the tablet in her hand with a strange expression on her face because she didn't expect Connor to end in such a way.
…
On the other side, in the command center.
"Report! we've hit the target!"
Roger was extremely excited when he heard that.
The others also burst into cheers.
After all, they were all very aware about the power of this elemental bomb. Not even an aircraft carrier could withstand the attack of an elemental bomb, let alone a human.
Moreover, the location where the elemental bomb exploded was very close to Connor. Under such circumstances, Connor had no chance of survival at all.
This was also the reason why these people were so excited.
"Connor McDonald, I didn't expect you to die so easily!"
Roger could not help but sigh softly.
William had also seen the explosion of the elemental bomb. His face was filled with disbelief. He felt like he was dreaming.
Connor actually died in such a way in the end?
William could not believe it.
…
Rockefeller headquarters.
Mr. Long was also watching the battle. Asya, Avery, and Auro were also in the meeting room.
Asya hesitated for a moment, then said softly, "I originally thought that Connor would win, but I didn't expect him to die in the end!"
"Things are not as simple as you think!"
However, at this moment, Mr. Long shook his head gently.
Asya looked up at Mr. Long and couldn't help but frown."Mr. Long, what do you mean by that?"
"I feel that Connor is not dead yet…" Mr. Long chuckled.
Asya hesitated for a moment and didn't say anything because he had a hunch that Connor might not be dead.
However, that was an elemental bomb. Asya couldn't believe that a person could survive the explosion of an elemental bomb.
At this moment, it wasn't just the people of Rockefeller who were paying attention to Connor's situation. There were also many people who could watch this battle through various channels.
It was as if everyone was quietly waiting for the result. They did not believe that Connor would die like this.
As time passed, everyone's patience seemed to be wearing down bit by bit.
A minute passed, but Connor still did not appear.
Two minutes passed, but Connor still did not appear.
At this moment, everyone thought that Connor might really have died.
Roger's expression became more and more smug.
However, at this moment, a figure suddenly rushed out from the huge flames.
This person was none other than Connor.
Amelia looked at the tablet in her hand with an incredulous expression.
She originally thought that Connor was already dead!
However, who could have imagined that Connor could actually survive after experiencing such a terrifying explosion!
For a moment, countless people were stunned, as if they could not believe what they had seen was real.
Mr. Long turned to look at Asya and said with a smile, "Look at what I'm saying. This child is very hardy. It's impossible for him to die so easily!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2160: A Terrifying Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 2160: A Terrifying Person
When Asya heard Mr. Long's words, he was instantly stunned on the spot.
He was speechless and didn't know what to say.
After all, Connor could be considered as Rockefeller's biggest enemy. If Connor died, it would definitely be a great thing for Rockefeller.
However, after Mr. Long saw that Connor wasn't dead, he was still able to laugh. This was really hard to understand.
Avery also couldn't understand what was going on. Logically speaking, Mr. Long should have hoped that Connor would die!
…
Roger was in the command room at this time.
He looked at the screen in front of him in disbelief.
"This... How was this possible? How can Connor still be alive?"
"What kind of monster is he?"
"That's right. The bomb clearly hit him just now. How can he still be alive?"
"Am I hallucinating?"
The people who were still celebrating were all dumbfounded at this moment. They widened their eyes and did not know what to do.
"Not good, the enemy is attacking us!"
However, at this moment, a scream suddenly came from Roger's walkie-talkie.
Roger quickly looked up at the screen.
Connor directly rushed into the clouds, and then the fighter jets exploded one after another.
"Get everyone's fighter jets to retreat!"
Roger hurriedly shouted.
However, it was already too late. In less than half a minute, all their fighter jets had been completely destroyed by Connor.
Roger felt like his heart was bleeding after seeing so many fighter jets destroyed by Connor. After all, that was all money!
