Moreover, Roger had used explosives before, and now he had lost so many fighter jets. If the higher-ups investigated this, Roger would probably lose his head.
"Not good, the enemy is approaching us!"
However, at this moment, someone suddenly shouted.
Roger couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he stuttered, "It's okay, we still have the AI. The bomb hit Connor just now. Even if Connor didn't die, he was seriously injured."
At this moment, someone suddenly asked, "What if we can't stop this person even if we use artificial intelligence?"
"What should we do? Are you going to watch Connor rush in and kill us?"
Roger shouted excitedly.
".."
For a time, everyone was caught up in Connor's performance.
A few seconds later, over a thousand Terminator A.Is directly rushed towards Connor's position.
At this moment, Connor's condition was not very good. Just now, when the bomb exploded, it was Zidane Quinton's sword that saved Connor, but Connor was also injured. If it wasn't for the sword that Zidane had given Connor, he might really be dead now.
"I didn't expect the power of the bomb to be so terrifying!"
Connor could not help but sigh softly. Previously, Connor had never taken the bomb seriously. After all, he felt that his current strength was already sufficient and should be able to deal with the power produced by the explosion of the bomb.
But now Connor knew that with his current combat strength, he still had no way to compete with the bomb.
Unless one was a true peak ancient martial artist, no one would be able to survive the attack of the bombs.
"I don't have time to fool around with you guys!"
Previously, Connor had not used his full strength in order to conserve his stamina.
However, the situation was different now. When the bomb exploded just now, Connor realized that he might have underestimated the military strength of Risu, so he had to end the battle immediately. Otherwise, he did not know what terrifying weapons they would use next. If Risu continued to use bombs on him, he would definitely die.
Connor's figure flashed and directly rushed into the midst of those artificial intelligence humans. Then, he began to attack them non-stop.
Although the combat strength of these smart humans was highly advanced, it was still not worth mentioning in front of Connor.
In just half an hour, all the AIs were wiped out.
Roger sat on the chair in a daze. His expression was very ugly because he did not expect such an outcome.
They used almost all the power they could use now, but they still could not stop Connor.
"This person is too terrifying!" Roger stammered.
"What should we do now?"
"That's right, the enemy is about to attack…"
The people around Roger hurriedly asked.
"What else can we do? Retreat quickly!"
Roger shouted and stood up to walk out of the command center.
Now, Roger had no other choice. Connor's strength was not something they could compete with. If they continued to stay here, they would definitely die, so the best choice was to retreat.
However, before Roger and the others could walk out of the command center, Connor slowly walked in.
When Roger saw Connor, he was stunned. This was the first time he had seen Connor up close. He had only seen Connor through video before.
"You're the one who threw the bomb at me, right?"
Connor asked calmly as he sized up everyone.
".."
For a moment, everyone fell into a huge panic. They looked at Connor with very nervous expressions.
"You... What do you want? Do you know who we are?"
Roger stammered as he shouted at Connor.
Connor looked at Roger and waved his right hand without hesitation.
A cold light flashed.
Everyone in the command center fell to the ground.
After all, these people all wanted to kill Connor, so Connor naturally would not let these people off.
Moreover, Connor also let the higher-ups of the Risu know what the consequences of offending him were.
After dealing with Roger and the others, Connor did not delay and rushed towards William's current location.
…
The higher-ups of Risu were all gathered in a conference room.
Everyone present watched the scene of Connor killing Roger and the others through the big screen in front of the meeting room. For a moment, the entire meeting room fell silent.
The expression of the Risuan leader was unusually ugly.
"General Abel, what do you think we should do now?" one of them suddenly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2161: I Didn't Lie to You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2161: I Didn't Lie to You!
After all, Roger was Abel's most capable subordinate.
Furthermore, Abel had given his permission to attack Connor with weapons.
If these people wanted a scapegoat, they would definitely go after Abel.
"Actually, General Abel didn't agree to this!" Rode wanted to explain on Abel's behalf, but Able stopped him.
"There's no need to say anymore!" Abel waved at Rode and said expressionlessly, "It's too late to say anything now. After all, it has already happened. Our losses this time are very large. We have suffered thousands of casualties and lost dozens of fighter jets."
Everyone looked at Abel.
"Obviously, this responsibility should be borne by me, so I plan to resign!" Abel said slowly.
"Now is not the time for you to resign. I need you to tell me what we should do next!" the leader said expressionlessly.
"It's obvious that the Soul Eater isn't coming for us. There's no conflict between us, so I think the best thing to do now is to stop immediately and let Connor settle the conflict between him and Blood Shadow. Then, I'll think of a way to communicate with the people on Sommerville's side and see if we can properly resolve this problem. I can also personally apologize to the Soul Eater and admit that these actions are my personal actions and have nothing to do with Risu!"
Abel said slowly.
If Abel had said these words a day ago, everyone would have stood up and objected.
After all, Abel's actions meant that the entirety of Risu was bowing to Connor. How could a great country do such a shameful thing?
However, no one dared to object now, because they knew very well that this might be the best solution at the moment.
After all, if they didn't give in, they could only continue fighting like this.
However, they knew that according to the current situation, even if they used the entire country's strength, they wouldn't be able to do anything to Connor. Moreover, this method might cause even more terrifying losses to them.
The leader hesitated for a moment before saying softly, "Let's do as you say. These were all your personal decisions!"
"Alright, alright…"
Abel quickly nodded.
Everyone looked at Abel, not knowing what to say.
It was obvious that they were planning to sacrifice Abel to protect Risu.
This method was obviously inappropriate, but they were helpless because there was no better way.
At this moment, these people finally understood a principle. If a martial artist's strength was really terrifying to a certain extent, it was simply not something that people like them could contend with.
…
On the other side, Connor arrived in Miami in less than half an hour and found William's current location.
William had planned to escape, but his speed was too slow compared to Connor's. Even though Connor gave him half an hour to escape, he still could not leave Miami.
In a manor.
Connor finally found William.
At this moment, William was hiding under a big tree to rest. He had used up most of his aura to avoid Connor, so he wanted to recover before continuing to run.
However, William never expected Connor to catch up so quickly.
"You must be William?"
Connor's voice sounded in William's ears.
When William heard Connor's words, he suddenly stood up and looked at Connor with an incredulous expression. He stammered, "You... Who are you?"
"I've been looking for you for so long. Don't you know who I am?"
Connor replied indifferently.
"You actually found me so quickly. You... How did you do it?"
William hurriedly asked.
He had started running half an hour ago. At that time, Connor was still in the desert, but in just half an hour, Connor had come to the city and found him. This was really unbelievable.
Moreover, William had set up an array on his body. This array could hide his aura, but Connor was able to lock onto his position so accurately. This meant that he must have used some other method.
William pretended to be calm and asked Connor in a low voice, "Soul Eater, I don't think there's any enmity between us, right? Why did you have to find me? What are you trying to do?"
"Don't you know why I wanted to find you?" Connor replied directly.
"I... I'm not sure..."
William shook his head.
Connor was not in the mood to talk nonsense with William. He bluntly asked, "Since you don't know, then let me remind you. Did you put the Ghostly Spirit Curse on my master?"
"You're talking about the person in the secret treasure, right?"
"Of course!" Connor lightly nodded.
William took a deep breath and whispered, "That curse was cast by my uncle. It has nothing to do with me!"
"Back then, there were two people who entered the secret tomb. One was your uncle, and the other should be you, right?"
Connor asked.
William looked hesitant.
"I suggest you tell me the truth, or else you will end up in a very, very miserable state!"
Connor reminded William softly.
William hesitated for two seconds before he said in a low voice, "That's right, it was me!"
"What happened that day?" Connor asked.
"..."
William took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, "Actually, my uncle and I were the first to find the secret treasure that day. Moreover, the two of us were also the first to enter the tomb. I'm not very sure what happened outside after that. I only know that your master suddenly rushed in. My uncle did not want to split the things in the secret treasure with your master, so he fought with your master…"
"And then?"
"Your master's strength is very terrifying. My uncle and I joined forces and only fought to a standstill with your master! However, we wasted too much time. The array was about to close, so my uncle placed a Ghostly Spirit Curse in your master's body. Then, at the last moment before the array closed, he brought me out of the tomb while your master stayed there…"
William looked up at Connor and whispered, "This is all I know. I'm not lying to you!"
Connor could feel that William was not lying.

chapters.title: Chapter 2162: A Suitable Method
chapters.content:
Chapter 2162: A Suitable Method
"So, how can I undo the Ghostly Spirit Curse?"
Connor asked.
"I don't know either. After all, my uncle was the one who cast the curse, not me. I don't know how to cast the curse at all!" William paused for a moment before continuing, "If you really want to undo the curse in your master's body, you should look for my uncle, not me!"
"Where is your uncle now?"
Connor asked in a low voice.
"My uncle is now…He's in Europe now..."
William replied after a moment of hesitation.
"Europe?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "Call your uncle now and tell him to come and see me immediately!"
Connor knew very well that Europe was far away from here. If Connor really went to Europe to find the King of Shadow, he did not know how long it would take. Therefore, the best way was to use William as a hostage and let the King of Shadow take the initiative to come to him.
"I can't make this call…"
William replied in a low voice.
"Why?"
Connor asked in surprise.
"There's no reason. I just can't make this call..." William said through gritted teeth.
"Since you don't want to make this call, I can only kill you first and then settle the score with your uncle…"
After saying this, Connor waved his right hand without any hesitation.
An aura flew toward William.
William's face was filled with fear. He quickly raised his hands to block Connor's breath.
"Bang!"
There was a loud bang.
William's body was sent flying and smashed into a wall in the distance.
"Cough cough…"
William coughed twice and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Just now, Connor had only used 30% of his strength. If Connor had used all his strength, William would have been a dead man.
Connor only wanted to scare William and let him know the difference in strength between the two of them. William was still useful to Connor. After all, if Connor wanted to find the King of Shadow, he had to make use of William.
William did not expect that he would be able to survive after being hit by Connor's aura. At this moment, he naively thought that Connor was seriously injured by the Risuan government, so his strength was far from before.
Even so, William knew that he was no match for Connor. It would be easy for Connor to kill him.
"I'll give you one last chance now. Are you going to make the call or not?"
Connor walked towards William and asked him calmly.
"You can give up. I will never make this call!"
William shouted at Connor with his eyes wide open.
"Alright, since you're not willing to make this call, then go to hell!"
Connor replied indifferently, then slowly raised his right hand.
William knew that he was lucky enough to withstand Connor's aura. If Connor continued to attack, he would definitely die.
Therefore, William shouted at the top of his lungs, "How long are you three going to hide? If you don't make a move, I'm dead!"
As soon as William finished speaking, a black aura pounced towards Connor's face.
Connor's reaction speed was still very fast. He turned around and punched out.
"Bang!"
Connor's fist print fiercely collided with the black aura, and the aura instantly dissipated between heaven and earth.
After the aura dissipated, the three of them walked towards Connor.
Connor did not expect William to be able to find reinforcements even at this time.
At this moment, the three people who appeared were the three guardians of Blood Shadow.
The status of these three guardians in the Blood Shadow was second only to the King of Shadow. However, because these three guardians had always been in a state of seclusion and rarely showed up, not many people knew about their existence.
"Respected Soul Eater, I am the Great Guardian of the Blood Shadow, Cnut!"
One of the black-robed old men took the initiative to introduce himself to Connor.
"Get lost!"
Connor said directly.
"Lord Soul Eater, I know your strength, but all of this is just a misunderstanding. I think that since things have already come to this, there's no point in continuing to fight. Why don't we discuss a suitable way to resolve this matter!" Cnut asked calmly.
"A suitable method?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Cnut's words.
"This matter is indeed Blood Shadow's fault. Why don't we do this: Blood Shadow is willing to take out 300 billion as compensation, and when the King of Shadow returns, we'll tell you the method to remove the curse," Cnut continued.
William's expression was incredulous when he heard Cnut's words. He did not expect Cnut to take out so much money to compensate Connor.
However, he quickly reacted. This was clearly a delaying tactic, because no one could stop Connor now unless the King of Shadow returned.
However, they did not know when the King of Shadow would arrive, so they could only try their best to stall for time.
"The three of you better get back to where you came from, or the three of you will die with him!"
Connor replied coldly.
After all, even William could guess that all of this was just a delaying tactic. Connor could naturally guess as well.
Even if Cnut really wanted to pay 300 billion as compensation, Connor would never agree.
The reason was very simple. This sum of money was very tempting to anyone, even the richest people in the world. However, money was not very important to Connor now. What he really wanted to do now was to avenge Jorge. Therefore, no matter what conditions the other party proposed, Connor would not agree.
"Don't refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. This is already our greatest concession. I admit that you are indeed very powerful, but you have already suffered serious injuries just now. If we really fight, you might not be a match for the three of us!"
At this moment, a person behind Cnut stepped forward and shouted at Connor.

chapters.title: Chapter 2163: Array Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 2163: Array Formation
"You talk too much nonsense!"
Connor suddenly waved his right hand, and then a stream of aura flew out.
Cnut hurriedly helped that person block Connor's aura.
When Connor saw that Cnut had blocked his attack, he was shocked.
This meant that Cnut wasn't weak at all.
"Set up the formation!"
Cnut knew that there was no need for him to continue negotiating with Connor. No matter what conditions he proposed, Connor would not agree to them, so he could only fight.
The only good news for the three of them was that Connor had just experienced a huge battle, so they all felt that Connor was definitely seriously injured.
Connor was indeed injured, but he wouldn't describe his injuries as "serious.".
The three of them quickly set up an array. A gust of wind blew, followed by countless black auras that gathered together and formed an encirclement, surrounding William, Cnut, and the others.
This black aura was all baleful.
The most important function of this formation was to protect them all.
This layer of aura was abnormally strong. Even a Heaven Realm ancient martial arts grandmaster could not break through this layer of black aura, so the four people standing in the array were still very safe.
Although Cnut knew that Connor was already injured, they were still very afraid of Connor's strength. Therefore, they did not plan to fight Connor head-on. Instead, they wanted to use this array to buy some time.
Connor looked at the black aura in front of Cnut and the others and hesitated for two seconds. Then, without any hesitation, he punched out.
Connor's fist fiercely smashed onto the black aura, but what Connor did not expect was that the black aura only shook slightly. There was no other reaction at all.
"Soul Eater, I think you shouldn't waste your energy. This array is the Black Demon Evil Chi Array, an ancient array. This array is abnormally strong—even a pinnacle level ancient martial artist can't easily break it," Cnut said proudly.
"Is that so?"
Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard Cnut's words.
"If you don't believe me, then you can give it a try!" Cnut replied with a smile.
Connor hesitated for a moment before rushing to the front of the array. Then, he raised his fist and punched at the black aura.
At this moment, Connor seemed to have gone crazy, constantly waving his fists.
The powerful collision attracted the attention of countless people.
After all, this was a city, not a desert. Many people were curious about what was happening here.
When the ordinary people saw the scene in front of them, they were all stunned on the spot. This was because in their eyes, this scene seemed to only appear in movies. No one expected it to really exist in reality.
William, who was in the array, looked a little nervous because he did not know much about the array. He was worried that if Connor really broke through the array, they might die at Connor's hands.
He hesitated for a moment before asking Cnut softly.
"Great Guardian, is this formation really as strong as you said?"
"Of course!"
Cnut nodded without thinking and continued, "Of course, even if it's not as strong as I imagined, you don't have to worry. After all, this array has been constantly consuming the Soul Eater's aura. It doesn't matter even if he can break through this array in the end. He's currently injured. In addition to the large amount of aura he consumed just now, we can definitely defeat him easily!"
"I understand…"
William finally understood what Cnut meant and nodded.
However, at this moment, the array formation actually began to tremble violently.
Cnut suddenly stood up and looked at Connor with an incredulous expression.
He knew in his heart that the array was already starting to become unstable. This also meant that if Connor was given a little more time, this array would definitely shatter.
"I didn't expect this Soul Eater's strength to be so terrifying. He clearly experienced a huge battle before, but he still has such terrifying strength. It's really unbelievable!"
Cnut could not help but sigh softly.
"Then…What should we do now?"
"Everyone, be prepared. The array formation may shatter at any time. At that time, we'll attack together and try to kill this person!"
Cnut whispered.
"Alright, alright…"
When everyone heard this, they hurriedly agreed.
"Bang!"
At this moment, there was a loud bang.
A huge hole appeared in the black aura in front of everyone.
Cnut stared at Connor outside the array with wide eyes. The expression on his face was as shocked as it could be because it was too unbelievable.
He did not expect Connor to be able to break through the array so quickly.
"Do it!"
Cnut shouted.
Everyone rushed towards Connor.
The first to arrive in front of Connor were the three guardians.
The expression on Connor's face seemed to be somewhat disdainful. Then, he suddenly punched directly at the three guardians 'chests.
"Bang!"
There was a loud bang.
The barrier in front of the three guardians was directly shattered by Connor's punch.
The three guardians stared at Connor with wide eyes. Their faces were filled with disbelief because they had never thought that Connor, who was already heavily injured and had consumed so much of his aura, could still unleash such a terrifying punch.
"Third brother, be careful!"
After reminding him, Cnut waved his right hand.
In an instant, countless ghosts pounced towards Connor.
Cnut was most proficient in the art of ghosts, and these ghosts happened to be ones that Cnut had collected for many years. If he had not faced a terrifying enemy like Connor, Cnut would definitely not have used this move. After all, if he wanted to collect so many ghosts again, it would take many years.
For a moment, Connor was surrounded by these ghosts. Moreover, these ghosts used soul power. Their screams brought Connor a lot of trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 2164: Three Punches!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2164: Three Punches!
Of course, this was not the most important thing.
Most importantly, Connor discovered that his attacks had no effect on these souls.
For a moment, Connor did not know what to do.
When William saw that Connor was surrounded by souls, he seemed to ease up quite a bit.
"Looks like Connor isn't invincible. He can't do anything to the guardians' souls!"
William could not help but sigh.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Dharma World!"
But at this moment, Connor suddenly roared.
The souls that were originally surrounding Connor let out waves of mournful wails, and almost instantly turned into black smoke and dissipated into the world.
When William saw this scene, he was dumbfounded. His eyes widened in disbelief.
He thought that the guardians' souls could trap Connor, but he did not expect Connor to deal with them so quickly.
Even Cnut was in disbelief. After all, these souls were the result of his many years of collection. Now, they were actually destroyed by Connor just like that. His heart ached for his loss.
However, Connor did not give these people too much time to be shocked.
Connor's figure flashed, and he rushed in front of the three guardians. Then, he raised his fist and fiercely smashed it toward the third guardian's chest.
"Pfft!"
The third guardian did not manage to react in time. He spat out a mouthful of blood and flew backward.
When the third guardian landed on the ground, his body twitched slightly before he fainted.
After dealing with the third guardian, Connor's figure flashed, and he appeared in front of the second guardian. Then, an aura hit the second guardian's chest. The second guardian screamed and fell to the ground.
At this moment, two of Blood Shadow's three guardians had already been killed by Connor.
The grand guardian's eyes were red as he looked at Connor. There was nothing but anger on his face. After all, he had a very good relationship with the second guardian and the third guardian. They were like blood brothers.
However, the other two had already died in Connor's hands. He must be very sad.
"I'll fight it out with you!"
After the grand guardian roared angrily, he then rushed toward Connor.
When Connor saw the grand guardian was rushing toward him, he appeared somewhat disdainful. Then, he suddenly released a punch.
"Pfft!"
The grand guardian spat out a mouthful of blood, and then he flew backward.
William stood rooted to the ground and looked at Connor in disbelief.
Three punches!
Connor had killed the three guardians of the Blood Shadow with three punches!
What terrifying power!
William was so shocked that he forgot to run for his life. He stood there quietly and looked at Connor.
The other ordinary people who were watching were also scared silly. Some of them shouted for help and ran away. Some of them took out their phones and called the security because this scene was not something ordinary people like them could bear.
However, these ordinary people probably did not know that the young man standing in front of them was the famous Soul Eater in Risu.
Even the highest authorities in their country could not do anything to Connor. What was the point in calling the police now?
After dealing with Cnut and the other two, Connor walked toward William.
"..."
William had just recovered from his shock. He turned around and wanted to escape.
However, it was too late. Connor's figure flashed, and he appeared in front of William.
"I'm giving you one last chance now. Are you going to make the call or not?"
Connor asked William coldly.
"No. No matter what, I won't make this call today!"
William shouted.
"Alright, since you don't want to make this call, I'll kill you first. After killing you, I'll have a way to find the King of Shadows!"
Connor raised his right hand and slapped down on William.
Bang!
But at this moment, someone suddenly helped William block Connor's aura.
Connor could not help but be stunned. He did not expect someone to save William at this time.
"You can't kill this person!"
A voice sounded behind Connor.
When Connor heard this, he turned and looked behind him.
A middle-aged man in a tuxedo slowly walked toward Connor. This middle-aged man looked very handsome, and his temperament was extraordinary. He gave people the feeling that he was not an ordinary person.
In addition, this middle-aged man had easily blocked Connor's aura just now. This meant that this middle-aged man was also a martial artist, and he had extraordinary strength.
"And who are you?"
Connor seemed to be a little impatient as he frowned and asked the middle-aged man.
"Mr. Augustine!"
When William saw the middle-aged man, his face was filled with disbelief. He rubbed his eyes and shouted, "It's really you. Why are you here?"
William did not expect Augustine to save him.
A hint of disappointment flashed across Connor's face, because he thought that this middle-aged man was the King of Shadows!
Augustine ignored William and walked to Connor. He said softly to Connor, "Hello, Mr. Soul Eater. I am Augustine from the Eigona royal family!"
Augustine's speech and actions were very elegant and gentlemanly. He gave off the feeling that he was a noble.
"The Eigona royal family?"
Connor could not help but sneer when he heard Augustine's words. Then, he said indifferently, "I didn't expect the Blood Shadow's influence to be so far-reaching. First, it's Risu, and now, the English royal family is here. Will the other countries in Europe also be part of this matter?"
"Lord Soul Eater, I have come on behalf of the entire European continent…"
Augustine said calmly.
"You're representing the entire continent?"
Connor was stunned.
"You might not know this, but other than being part of the royal family of Eigona, I am also the leader of the European Martial Arts Alliance. Therefore, I represent the entire European continent and the ancient martial arts of Europe!"
Augustine said slowly.
Although Augustine might not be the most powerful martial artist in the entire continent, he was indeed the most prestigious one. This had a lot to do with his identity.

chapters.title: Chapter 2165: Augustine
chapters.content:
Chapter 2165: Augustine
As long as one had lived in Europe for a certain period of time, that person would know Augustine.
And as long as a person had a relationship with Augustine, that person would be able to enjoy the treatment of a true VIP in Europe.
This was Augustine's true influence!
Augustine not only had a terrifying talent in ancient martial arts, but he also had great connections. Knowing Augustine indicated that one could reach great heights. On the other hand, offending Augustine would mean certain death.
"Mr. Augustine, you must help me kill this person. He just killed three of the Blood Shadow's guardians…"
William knew that the King of Shadows must have asked Augustine to come here.
"Shut it!"
Augustine frowned and scolded. Then, he turned to Connor and said, "Lord Soul Eater, I know that you are very strong. Eigona and the other countries in Europe are not willing to be enemies with you!"
"Since you don't want to be my enemy, then you should get lost. I'm not in the mood to listen to your nonsense!"
Connor said impatiently.
"Lord Soul Eater, I can go, but I have to take this person with me!"
Augustine said softly.
"You can go, but this person can't!"
Connor said lightly.
"Lord Soul Eater, this person is the King of Shadows' nephew. The King of Shadows' influence in our continent is far-reaching. If you kill him today, I'm afraid it will bring you a lot of trouble."
Augustine paused for a moment and then continued, "Of course, I won't take this person away for nothing. I have a lot of ancient martial arts manuals and Celestial Artifacts. As long as you are interested, you can choose anything you want!"
"I'm not interested in all that!"
Connor said lightly.
"I know that you are not interested in them, but there is one thing that you will definitely be very interested in!"
Augustine said with a smile.
"What is it?"
Connor was stunned for a moment before asking.
"I know that your biggest enemy is Rockefeller and the Land Deities. I can make all the companies in our continent stop their cooperation with Rockefeller and provide you with detailed information about the Land Deities. I only have one condition, and that is to let this fool go!"
Augustine was very confident when he said this to Connor because he had already obtained information about Connor. He knew very well who Connor wanted to deal with the most, so he felt that Connor would not be able to find any reason to reject him.
"It seems that you know me very well!" Connor looked Augustine up and down and responded softly.
"You're the famous Soul Eater after all. I more or less understand your situation!"
Augustine replied with a smile.
"I can deal with Rockefeller and the Land Deities on my own. I don't need anyone's help. So, you'd better disappear from my sight now. Otherwise, you and William will have the same fate!"
Connor said to Augustine expressionlessly.
"..."
Augustine was stunned when he heard Connor's response. He was surprised because he did not expect Connor to reject his offer.
"Lord Soul Eater, if you feel that what I've offered is not enticing enough, then you can also propose whatever is on your mind. As long as it is within my ability, I will definitely agree to it!"
Augustine said softly.
"I only have one thing on my mind, and that is to kill this person!"
Connor said lightly.
"Why, you…"
Augustine finally couldn't hold it in any longer and whispered, "Lord Soul Eater, let me remind you that the King of Shadows is about to break through to the pinnacle realm. Once the King of Shadows breaks through to the pinnacle realm, you will die. Moreover, you have already offended too many people. I advise you to stop as soon as possible."
"Pinnacle realm?"
A strange look flashed across Connor's face,
At this moment, Connor finally realized why William had not called the King of Shadows. It was because now was the most critical moment for the King of Shadows to break through to the pinnacle realm.
If William had made this call, the King of Shadows would have given up on breaking through to save William. After all, William's mother had died because of the King of Shadows. William's position in the King of Shadows' heart was higher than anyone else.
Otherwise, the King of Shadows would not have brought William to the secret hideout.
"That's right, the pinnacle realm!"
Augustine nodded and continued, "Offending such a powerful enemy is not good for you. As long as you let William go, I will help you solve this problem. I will even help you break the Ghostly Spirit Curse in your master's body!"
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Augustine, then said expressionlessly, "So what if the King of Shadows will break through to the pinnacle realm? I still have to kill him!"
"You…"
Augustine was stunned when he heard this.
He thought that if he told Connor that the King of Shadows was about to break through to the pinnacle realm, Connor would be afraid of the King of Shadows' strength and stop. However, he did not expect Connor to not even be afraid of the pinnacle realm.
"You're way too arrogant!"
Augustine responded.
"So what? No matter who comes today, I will kill him!"
Connor did not intend to continue talking nonsense with Augustine. He waved his right hand, and an extremely ferocious aura flew toward Augustine.
Augustine did not expect Connor to really attack him. He quickly took two steps back, then extended his right hand and released an aura.
Connor's aura and Augustine's aura collided fiercely, as if two explosives had collided.
The surrounding houses, flowers, and trees instantly collapsed. The area within a ten-kilometer radius was in a mess. Howls of pain could be heard endlessly. Countless innocent people had died tragically under the energy impact.
As for Connor and Augustine, both of them stood firmly on the spot, as if they were evenly matched. Neither of them retreated.

chapters.title: Chapter 2166: You Want to Kill Me?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2166: You Want to Kill Me?
At this moment, the two of them were competing on whose aura was denser.
If Connor did not have the help of the Profound Bead, he would have definitely been at a disadvantage. After all, Connor had already experienced several battles, and he was not at his peak state.
The Profound Bead that Yolanda Yates gave to Connor was indeed very helpful to him. Without the bead, Connor would not have been able to survive until now.
At this moment, Augustine seemed to realize that something was off. He gave up on fighting Connor and took two steps back. He said softly, "As expected of the Soul Eater. You are indeed strong!"
"You're not bad either!"
Connor replied indifferently and then rushed toward Augustine again.
Connor and Augustine then started fighting. Because the two of them were too fast, it was impossible to see their movements clearly. It was hard to tell who had the upper hand.
"What are you still standing there for? Run! I'll stall this person!"
William was in a daze when a voice sounded.
William finally came to and tried to escape without hesitation.
"If I want to kill this person, no one can stop me!"
Connor shouted.
A loud bang followed.
Connor gave up his previous upper hand and took Augustine's punch.
However, Augustine did not expect Connor to act as if nothing had happened after receiving his punch. Connor continued charging toward William despite the punch.
"No!"
Augustine could not help but exclaim. He immediately rushed up to Connor to stop him.
Bang!
There was a loud bang.
Connor punched Augustine in the chest.
Augustine's body trembled slightly. He gritted his teeth and said, "If you dare to kill William today, you will definitely die a miserable death. I advise you to stop!"
"Why do you talk so much nonsense!"
Connor felt rather disdainful. Then, he punched Augustine in the chest again.
Augustine was barely able to withstand the first punch, so the second punch was surely too much for him. He was sent flying with the second punch.
After dealing with Augustine, Connor revealed a disdainful smile and said softly, "You want to stop me? How laughable!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Connor rushed toward William.
When Augustine saw this scene, his face was filled with despair. He knew very well what would happen next.
"He's done for!"
Augustine gritted his teeth and shouted.
William instinctively turned around and saw that Connor had already chased after him.
"Connor, if you dare to kill me, my uncle…"
William opened his mouth to speak.
Connor's fist landed on William's chest.
"Pfft!"
A muffled sound.
William spat out a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground. His body twitched twice before he lost his breath.
When Augustine saw this scene, his expression was filled with despair. He thought that he could save William, but he did not expect William to die in Connor's hands.
"It's over. William is dead. The King of Shadows will definitely be furious…"
Augustine muttered nervously. He was clearly not as calm as he was before. There was a hint of killing intent on his face.
"Connor, do you know what you have done?"
Augustine shouted at Connor.
"What I have done?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but smile. Then, he said indifferently, "I just killed one person!"
"Just killed one person?"
Augustine revealed a bitter smile and then whispered, "Do you really think things are as simple as you think? Do you know what the relationship between the person you killed and the King of Shadows is? Once the King of Shadows breaks through to the pinnacle realm, you will be dead. Not only you, but everyone around you will also suffer. You will pay a very heavy price. You will regret your actions today for the rest of your life!"
"The person who died today was William. The next person to die is the King of Shadows!"
Connor responded softly.
"You are truly arrogant!"
Augustine could not help but roar.
Connor looked Augustine and said softly, "Let's make a deal!"
"Deal?"
Augustine heard Connor's words and was stunned. He frowned and asked, "Do you think I'd still want to make a deal with you?"
"Use your life to make a deal!"
Connor said lightly.
"You want to kill me?"
Augustine finally reacted and asked Connor in surprise.
"You know the difference between our abilities. If I want to kill you, I might need to expend some of my energy, but it's not difficult. So, if you want to leave here alive, then make a deal with me!"
Connor said lightly.
"What... what deal do you have in mind?"
Augustine asked Connor nervously.
"Tell me the King of Shadows' current location, then I'll let you go!"
Connor replied.
"What…"
A strange look flashed across Augustine's face. He gritted his teeth and said, "Can we have other deals? I have a lot of Celestial Artifacts. I can give them all to you!"
It was obvious that Augustine did not want to expose the King of Shadows' position. After all, once the King of Shadows broke through to the pinnacle realm, he would be the first pinnacle martial artist in the continent.
The people of the Land Deities had been searching for the King of Shadows. If his location were exposed, it would be very dangerous for him.
"No, only this information can save your life!"
Connor said lightly.
Augustine hesitated for a moment, then walked to Connor and told him the location of the King of Shadows in a very soft voice.
He knew that there were many helicopters around them. He could not let the Land Deities know the true location of the King of Shadows.
"Are you sure you're not lying to me? I need you to swear on the blood of the Eigona royal family!"
Connor said to Augustine with a smile.
"Connor, you're crossing the line here!"
Augustine exclaimed.
"If you're not lying, it shouldn't be a big deal for you to make an oath!"
Connor said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 2167: An Oath!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2167: An Oath!
Augustine hesitated for a couple of seconds.
He knew that his life was now in Connor's hands.
If he did not make an oath, Connor would definitely not let him off easily!
Therefore, Augustine could only use his royal bloodline to make an oath to Connor.
This was probably the most humiliating day of Augustine's life. After all, the royal family valued their bloodline very much. Using bloodline to make an oath was the greatest humiliation to them.
"Can I leave now?"
Augustine gritted his teeth and asked Connor.
"You said that you have a lot of Celestial Artifacts, right? I'm sure you have a lot at home. Why not leave whatever you have on you with me?"
Connor whispered to Augustine.
When Augustine heard Connor's words, his eyes widened, and he was speechless.
How shameless was this guy? He was actually taking advantage of the situation.
However, Augustine did not dare to go against Connor's wishes. All he could was give all his Celestial Artifacts to Connor.
Connor looked at the Celestial Artifacts that Augustine took out and was shocked. Any one of these Celestial Artifacts could be of the same level as the Profound Bead. These Celestial Artifacts were very helpful to Connor's combat strength.
Augustine was devastated. After all, he was here to deal with Connor, so the Celestial Artifacts he brought with him were all top-notch. Any one of them was worth tens of billions.
Now that he had given them to Connor for nothing, he was utterly devastated.
"You can leave now!"
Connor whispered to Augustine.
Augustine was stunned for a moment before he turned around and left.
After Augustine had left, Connor's eyes flashed with fatigue.
In fact, if Augustine had chosen to fight with Connor, Augustine might have been able to kill Connor because Connor's body had already reached its limit. After he killed William, the aura in Connor's body had already started spiraling out of control.
However, Connor still pretended that nothing had happened and continued to threaten Augustine.
Augustine did not know what Connor was going through, so he did not dare to rashly attack Connor.
After Augustine had disappeared, Connor dragged his tired body and left.
Although the security was here, when these people found out who Connor was, they did not choose to attack him. This was because they had already received orders from the higher-ups that they were not allowed to have any conflict with the Soul Eater no matter what.
Connor found a hotel in the city center and booked a room at a very high price.
He had to rest immediately, or else his body might reach its limit at any time, and he would faint.
Risu was considered the most dangerous place for Connor. If Connor were to faint, the consequences would be unimaginable.
After Connor arrived at the hotel, he entered a state of cultivation.
However, when he opened his eyes next, it was three days later. The battle that he had experienced was way too intense, and it had placed a huge burden on his body. If it wasn't for the Profound Bead, Connor wouldn't have been able to last until now.
The battle that Connor had experienced was not an ordinary battle at all. This kind of battle was considered a high-level battle. Moreover, all the enemies in front of Connor were extremely terrifying existences.
How many people had the strength to compete with the powerful forces of Risu, Eigona, and the Blood Shadow?
It did not take long for what happened to spread throughout the world.
It was expected. The commotion Connor had caused was a big one. Even if Risu had been trying to cover up this fact, it couldn't be covered up because there were too many people who had seen this battle.
Risu's use of explosives against Connor was instantly pushed to the forefront.
However, this matter also added a bit of mystery to Connor.
It was a miracle for an ordinary person to survive the explosion of a bomb.
Moreover, most of the videos of the battle between Connor and Risu had been circulated through some unknown channels.
When the ordinary people saw Connor staring at the countless bullets and bombs, they were shocked.
Of course, most of them were afraid of how strong Connor was.
Once a person's strength was terrifying to a certain extent, it would make people fear that person involuntarily.
The current Connor was obviously such a person.
After Augustine returned to Europe, he immediately told everyone that Connor had killed William. This caused the entire Europe to fall into a huge panic.
This was because they knew very well that after Connor left Risu, he would immediately come to Europe. Therefore, they had to prepare in advance, or else Europe might become the second Risu.
For a time, the higher-ups of countless countries gathered together to discuss how to deal with Connor.
"I'm sure everyone has already read the information about the Soul Eater. You should now know how powerful the Soul Eater is. I wonder what you think of the Soul Eater's combat ability?"
At this moment, Lincoln, who represented Eigona at the meeting, asked expressionlessly.
Although Lincoln was almost seventy years old, his status in Eigona was very high. He had real power in his hands, and his influence was terrifying.
Lincoln personally attending this meeting proved how terrifying Connor was. Since Connor had already threatened all of them, they had no other choice but to join forces. Perhaps they might have a chance.
"Sigh…"
However, when everyone heard Lincoln's words, they all sighed softly, and their faces darkened.
"Why are all of you keeping quiet? If you have any thoughts, just share them!"
Lincoln frowned and scolded coldly upon seeing that everyone was silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 2168: Buying Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 2168: Buying Time
"The Soul Eater's abilities are phenomenal. Even the higher-ups in Risu can't do anything to him!"
"Even if all of us work together, we might not be able to fight against the higher-ups of Risu. However, Risu couldn't do anything to the Soul Eater. Moreover, Risu even used explosives and other weapons of mass destruction, but they still couldn't kill Connor. What can we do now?"
At this moment, one of them suddenly spoke.
"That's right. The Soul Eater is so strong. We should not provoke him!"
"Yeah, I think so too. After all, Connor is going for the King of Shadows, and it has nothing to do with us. I think it's better not to provoke this person!"
The others followed suit.
Lincoln was so angry that he was trembling. He was extremely livid.
"All of you are fools!"
Lincoln shouted and continued, "Do you think it's as simple as us not provoking the Soul Eater? Even if we don't provoke him, do you think he won't come to Europe? Do you really think standing idly by and not doing anything is going to help?"
"Then, what do you think we should do?"
A middle-aged man asked Lincoln softly.
"I don't know what to do. That's why I've gathered all of you here."
Lincoln replied with his eyes wide open, then continued, "I didn't ask all of you to come to hear you say that we should surrender, but to discuss how to deal with Connor!"
"If we really want to deal with Connor, then there is only one way, and that is to use weapons of mass destruction. However, if we use such weapons, I'm afraid that innocent people will be hurt!"
An old man said slowly.
Lincoln hesitated for a moment, then said expressionlessly, "We can't use weapons of mass destruction because we can't afford the consequences of using them. Moreover, Risu has already used them, and it didn't bring any results!"
"Then, can we use some other methods to deal with the Soul Eater?"
At this moment, someone suddenly spoke.
"What method?"
Lincoln was stunned for a moment before asking.
"For example, we can use a honey trap and then find an opportunity to poison the Soul Eater. Then, we can take action and finish him off…"
"..."
Upon hearing this, Lincoln felt a little helpless. Then, he said in a low voice, "This method might be effective against other people, but it's completely useless against the Soul Eater. Based on the information we have now, the Soul Eater doesn't like women. Also, this person is very smart. Such a stupid method won't be effective…"
When everyone heard Lincoln's words, they felt very helpless because the Soul Eater was too difficult to deal with. All the methods they could think of now seemed to have no effect on the Soul Eater.
"Sigh…"
At this moment, Lincoln took a deep breath and said expressionlessly, "Actually, there is no need for all of you to be overly dejected. I still have a piece of good news to tell all of you…"
"Good news?"
When everyone heard Lincoln's words, they were all stunned, and they were somewhat puzzled.
"What good news?"
"Yes, General Lincoln, what good news is it?"
Everyone asked Lincoln.
"The King of Shadows is currently in closed-door cultivation. He will soon become the first pinnacle ancient martial artist in our continent. Once the King of Shadows really breaks through to the pinnacle realm, it will be a great thing for everyone!"
Lincoln said slowly.
Everyone was shocked when they heard Lincoln's words.
Although these people were not martial artists, they all knew what it meant to be a pinnacle ancient martial artist.
Connor had yet to break through to the pinnacle realm, but he already had such terrifying combat power. It was self-evident how terrifying the combat power of a pinnacle realm would be.
"What good will it do if the King of Shadows breaks through to the pinnacle realm?"
However, at this moment, someone suddenly spoke.
"That's right. The King of Shadows has always had a good relationship with Eigona, but he barely has any connection with other countries in Europe. So even if he really breaks through to the pinnacle realm, it will only be good news for Eigona."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
"Haha…"
Lincoln looked at everyone and smiled faintly, then sighed softly, "The King of Shadows is at the most crucial moment of his breakthrough. He said that as long as we can buy him a little more time and delay Connor as much as possible, he will definitely return the favor."
"..."
Everyone was stunned when they heard Lincoln's words, and their faces were filled with shock.
"General Lincoln, is what you said true?"
A middle-aged man asked Lincoln excitedly.
"Of course…"
Lincoln nodded lightly.
Previously, these people were not willing to deal with Connor for the sake of common interests. The reason was very simple. It was because Connor only had a conflict with the Blood Shadow, but there was no big conflict between them and Connor. They were naturally unwilling to get involved in this whole mess.
However, the situation was different now.
If they could obtain the protection of a pinnacle ancient martial artist just by putting in a little effort, it would be a great thing for them!
"General Lincoln, I am willing to provide a batch of laser weapons…"
"General Lincoln, I'm willing to bring out our strongest armored force…"
Everyone was instantly excited and exclaimed in response.
Lincoln couldn't help but smile when he heard these people's words. He knew that if he didn't give these people some benefits, they wouldn't be willing to take action.
Risu was indeed the country with the most terrifying military strength in the world. However, if all the countries in Europe joined forces, their combat strength was phenomenal. Although they were not sure that they would be able to successfully kill Connor, it would not be a big problem to delay him to buy the King of Shadows some time.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 2169: Everyone's Reaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 2169: Everyone's Reaction
On the other side.
Europe had been anxiously discussing how to deal with Connor.
Naturally, Sommervile also responded to what was happening.
After all, the impact of what Connor had done was huge, so Sommervile would surely stay quiet about it.
Sommervile was also in the middle of a meeting.
"How is Risu reacting to all this?"
The middle-aged man in charge of managing the martial artists asked expressionlessly.
"Risu has already expressed their position on this. They won't hold the Soul Eater accountable. Furthermore, this was all Abel acting on his own!"
His subordinate hurriedly replied.
"Haha…"
The middle-aged man could not help but sneer when he heard this. Then, he said indifferently, "I didn't expect the Soul Eater to be so powerful. Even the powerful Risu has already taken the initiative to lower its head!"
"That's right. This is indeed difficult to predict…"
"The main reason is that Risu had already used explosives on the Soul Eater, but it had no effect. It's useless even if they don't lower their heads now…"
Everyone laughed.
"Alright, since Risu has already lowered their heads, then let's not continue to make things difficult for them. Let's not make a big thing out of it. What about Europe? What is their reaction to this?"
The middle-aged man continued to ask.
"Right now, there are already several countries in the continent that have joined forces. It seems that they are planning to deal with the Soul Eater!"
The subordinate hurriedly replied.
"I really wonder where their courage comes from. Even Risu has already lowered their heads, but they still plan to continue attacking. They must have no fear!"
The middle-aged man snorted coldly.
"It seems that the King of Shadows is about to break through to the pinnacle realm…"
"Pinnacle realm?"
When the middle-aged man heard this, ha strange look flashed across his face. Then, he said expressionlessly, "I didn't expect that there would already be a pinnacle ancient martial artist in Europe. No wonder the martial artists in Europe have been so quiet during this period of time..."
"What should we do now?"
At this moment, a young woman asked.
"Now, we will start to put pressure on Europe and warn them not to interfere in this matter. If necessary, we will also intervene in this matter!"
The middle-aged man said after a moment of hesitation.
"Alright…"
Everyone in the conference room hurriedly agreed.
...
Now, not only were the higher-ups of various countries very concerned about the Soul Eater, but the discussion of this matter in the ancient martial arts world had never stopped. Some people were even commenting on the Internet, and it was a very heated discussion.
Even some ordinary people were participating in the discussion of this matter.
This was perhaps the first time that a true ancient martial arts expert had appeared in the eyes of ordinary people.
If it were in the past, a battle between martial artists would not have received such great attention.
Of course, this was also thanks to the various forces' publicity of this matter.
"The Soul Eater of Sommervile is way too terrifying. He is actually able to render the powerful Risu helpless…"
"Yeah. Although this Soul Eater is from Sommervile, he's still my idol. He's the first martial artist to fight against an entire country on his own. He's so dashing…"
"The legendary Grand Six of Risu were all killed by the Soul Eater. This is ridiculous…"
"I didn't expect Risu to be so shameless. They even used explosives, but in the end, they still couldn't kill the Soul Eater. How ridiculous…"
At this time, many foreign martial artists had already started to post comments mocking Risu.
When the Risu martial artists saw these posts, they were extremely angry. However, they were helpless because what these people were saying was the truth. Even if they wanted to refute, they could not find any reason to refute.
"However, the Soul Eater's current situation doesn't seem particularly good!"
"Yeah. Although the Soul Eater can disregard Risu, he shouldn't disregard the King of Shadows…"
"I heard that the Soul Eater not only killed the three guardians of the Blood Shadow, but he also killed the nephew of the King of Shadows. The King of Shadows will definitely not let the Soul Eater off!"
It was obvious that some people were worried for Connor.
After all, many people now regarded Connor as their idol. Of course, they did not want anything to happen to their idol.
"Who is the King of Shadows? Is the King of Shadows was more powerful than the Soul Eater?"
At this moment, someone who did not know the King of Shadows asked.
"You don't even know the King of Shadows?"
"Yeah. I didn't expect that there would be someone who doesn't know about the King of Shadows…"
For a moment, many people could not help but mock him.
"The King of Shadows is considered the most powerful martial artist in the entire continent. Of course, this is not the most terrifying thing about the King of Shadows. The truly terrifying thing about the King of Shadows is that he is about to break through to the pinnacle realm of the ancient martial arts world. Although the current King of Shadows may not be a match for the Soul Eater, once the King of Shadows breaks through to the pinnacle realm, the Soul Eater may be in great danger!"
At this moment, someone explained the identity of the King of Shadows.
"What?"
"The King of Shadows is going to break through to the pinnacle realm?"
"How unbelievable is that?"
"I didn't think that there would really be a martial artist at the pinnacle realm in this world!"
Once again, everyone was in a heated discussion. After all, the saying of pinnacle ancient martial artists had always appeared in legends. Who would have thought that there would really be martial artists at the pinnacle realm in this world?
"Of course, there are pinnacle ancient martial art practitioners in this world, and as far as I know, there's more than one!"
The person who spoke before said again.
"Seriously…"
"Yeah. I thought that pinnacles were just a legend!"
Everyone seemed to be boiling with excitement. After all, they were all very interested in such a topic.
"Moreover, the Soul Eater's current situation isn't particularly optimistic. It's said that the King of Shadows still has four people under him, and all four of them are heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters. The Soul Eater killed William this time, so when the King of Shadows really breaks through to the pinnacle realm, he will definitely find the Soul Eater to take revenge. That will be the real shocking battle; the battle between the pinnacles of ancient martial arts!"
At this moment, someone said.

chapters.title: Chapter 2170: What Kind of Situation is This?
chapters.content:
Chapter 2170: What Kind of Situation is This?
"What?"
"The King of Shadows actually has four heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters under him?"
"What is going on?"
"Since when did heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters become so worthless? Why are there so many heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters?"
"These heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters have always existed, but at our level, we have no way of coming into contact with these people. Risu has the Grand Six of Risu to protect the order of the ancient martial arts in Risu, Sommervile has the four major sects in to protect the order of the ancient martial arts in Sommervile, and there are naturally people in Europe to protect the order of the ancient martial arts in Europe. The King of Shadows is one of them, and the remaining four heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters are also the guardians of the ancient martial arts in Europe!"
There were many martial artists around the world, and the strength of these martial artists was not something that ordinary people could imagine. Every country had already realized the problem of martial artists. Once these martial artists really joined forces, their power would be taken away.
Therefore, the government had found some powerful martial artists to cooperate with, allowing these people to maintain order in the ancient martial arts world and also having these people check and balance each other.
This was what Sommervile did, and the other countries like Risu and those in the European Continent did the same.
This was the only way to ensure the stability of martial artists and protect the interests of ordinary people.
The King of Shadows was one of these people protecting the country, and Augustine was also one of the four. No one knew the identity of the remaining three, but they definitely existed.
The military strength of Risu was very terrifying. This was something that almost everyone would agree with. However, because Risu was a relatively younger country, the development of the ancient martial arts world in Risu was not as fast. This was also the reason why the six guardians of Risu were not very strong.
However, Europe was different. Eigona had already established the guardianship a few hundred years ago, and it had continued to this day.
Therefore, the strength of Europe's martial artists could not be underestimated.
"It seems that the Soul Eater might really be in danger this time!"
At this moment, someone could not help but sigh.
"Yeah. I thought that the martial artists of Europe would have no way to deal with the Soul Eater. I didn't expect the martial artists of Europe to be so terrifyingly strong!"
"But this time, we'll have a good show to watch. This might be the true showdown between the pinnacles of ancient martial arts!"
"I wonder if the Soul Eater is at the heaven rank or the pinnacle realm!"
Those who had been optimistic about Connor had changed their perspectives. After all, a pinnacle ancient martial artist and four heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters were terrifyingly strong. It was so terrifying that it was unimaginable.
Before this, ordinary martial artists thought that heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters were terrifying existences. Moreover, there were barely any heaven ranks around. However, no one expected heaven ranks to now be considered worthless. They were now popping up everywhere.
Upon hearing the discussion about Connor, the cultivators of Sommervile felt rather vexed. After all, they probably didn't want to see anything happen to Connor.
However, there was nothing they could do now.
...
On the other side, Connor rested in a luxury hotel in Mixas for three days.
Connor used these three days to refine his body. Although he still couldn't recover to his peak condition, he had recovered about 80% of his full strength.
However, when Connor opened his eyes, he saw that Amelia was sitting on the sofa looking at her phone.
When Connor saw Amelia, he was a little surprised. Then, he asked softly, "Why are you here?"
"This hotel is mine!"
Amelia calmly explained before continuing, "I was the one who informed this hotel in advance to let you stay here. Otherwise, there wouldn't be any hotel in the entire Risu that would dare to accommodate such a dangerous person like you!"
"I see!"
Connor knew that Amelia's influence in Risu was quite large, so he was not entirely surprised.
"Did you rest well?"
Amelia asked softly as he sized up Connor.
"I guess so!"
Connor lightly nodded, then looked at Amelia and asked, "You must have waited for a long time. Do you have something to tell me?"
"Of course!"
Amelia nodded gently and continued, "There's someone who wants to see you now, so I hope you can come with me to the Rockefeller headquarters!"
"Mr. Long?"
Connor instantly asked.
"Yes!"
Amelia smiled.
When Connor heard this, he was a little surprised because he couldn't understand why Mr. Long wanted to meet him. Moreover, Mr. Long knew how strong Connor was now. If Connor really followed Amelia to Rockefeller's headquarters, Mr. Long and the others might die in Connor's hands.
"Why does he want to see me?"
Connor hesitated for a moment before asking Amelia.
"Mr. Long didn't tell me why, but I think he wants to save you!"
Amelia replied.
"Mr. Long wants to save me?"
Connor was stunned for a moment when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Are you kidding me? In this world, Mr. Long is probably the one person who wants to see me die the most. There's no benefit for him if I live. Why would he want to save me? Besides, I seem to be quite safe now, right?"
"I don't know what Mr. Long is thinking, but I know one thing. You are in a very dangerous situation. You just killed William, and with your personality, you are probably preparing to leave for Europe immediately. Once you reach Europe, you will be in danger again!"
Amelia calmly said to Connor.
"I'm not even afraid of these people from Risu. Do you think I'm afraid of those people from Europe?"
Connor said indifferently.
"Soul Eater, the King of Shadows is about to break through to the pinnacle realm. You're no match for the King of Shadows. Also, there are still four heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters waiting for you in Europe. Think about what kind of situation you'll be in once you arrive in Europe!"
Amelia exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2171: Set off Now
chapters.content:
Chapter 2171: Set off Now
"A pinnacle ancient martial artist and four heaven-rank ancient martial arts grandmasters?"
When Connor heard this, he couldn't help but laugh. Then, he said expressionlessly, "I didn't expect so many experts to be waiting for me. I have really underestimated them!"
"So, Soul Eater, your best choice now is to leave Risu with me and go to the Rockefeller headquarters. The martial artists in Europe are definitely afraid of the Land Deities. They won't be able to do anything to you. However, if you insist on going to Europe, then in the end, you will die!"
Amelia looked at Connor and continued.
"When have I ever needed the protection of my enemies? Also, even if I really go to the Rockefeller headquarters, my situation will probably not be much better than it is now, right?"
Connor paused for a moment, then looked at Amelia and said, "If I'm right, Rockefeller and the Land Deities must have already laid down an inescapable net for me."
"It's not what you think!"
Amelia hurriedly shook her head and then said in a very serious tone, "Mr. Long said that he can guarantee your safety. When this is over, you can leave. Meanwhile, no one can hurt you!"
"Do you think I'll believe these words?"
Connor could not help but sneer.
"Well…"
Amelia did not know what to say for a moment. After all, she herself did not seem to believe what she had just said.
After all, Connor was Rockefeller's greatest enemy. Hence, Rockefeller had no reason to save Connor. Even Amelia could not understand what Mr. Long was trying to do.
"Alright, you don't have to worry about this problem now, because regardless of whether Rockefeller really intends to save me or not, I won't go there. I have more important things waiting for me to do now!"
Connor calmly said to Amelia.
When Amelia heard Connor's words, she was somewhat helpless. She said in a low voice, "But if you go to Europe like this now, it will be very dangerous!"
"So what if it's dangerous?"
Connor couldn't help but laugh coldly, and then said indifferently, "I have always been in danger, but I'm still alive, aren't I?"
Amelia looked at Connor and didn't know what to say. She was very helpless because she really couldn't understand why Connor was so confident.
If a normal person were to encounter such a situation, the first think they would think of was definitely to think of a way to survive, but Connor was the direct opposite.
"Since you've already made up your mind to go to Europe, I have nothing else to say. I hope you can come back safely!"
Amelia said to Connor.
"By the way, I need your help with something now. I wonder if you're willing to help me."
Connor asked Amelia softly.
"What favor? If it's not dangerous, I can help!"
Amelia responded.
Connor couldn't help but laugh when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said softly, "The thing is, I want to go to Europe now, but it's a long distance away from here. I need your plane to take me there!"
"I see!"
Amelia looked at Connor and nodded thoughtfully. After hesitating for a moment, she said, "Alright, I can help you with that. When do you want to leave?"
"Let's go now!"
Connor said softly.
"..."
Amelia looked at Connor helplessly because she did not expect him to be so anxious.
However, Amelia didn't mind. She took out her phone and started making a call.
A few seconds later, Amelia put down her phone and whispered to Connor, "My plane will arrive at the rooftop of this hotel in three minutes. Let's go and wait on the rooftop!"
"Alright!"
Connor nodded, then stood up and walked out of the room.
Three minutes later, the plane landed on time. Connor followed Amelia onto the plane.
After entering the plane, Connor was shocked by the luxury inside. This might be the most luxurious plane that Connor had ever taken. There were even several private rooms in the plane. Additionally, the rooms had everything that one would need. It felt like a mobile five-star hotel.
Amelia brought Connor into a room and then said to him in a soft voice, "We will arrive in Eigona in a day, so you can rest on the way!"
"Alright!"
Connor lightly nodded.
"I'll leave you to it then. If you need anything, you can press the bell. There's a dedicated air stewardess at your service 24 hours a day!"
When Amelia said that, she glanced at the air stewardess beside her. The air stewardess was dressed very sexily, so this was probably a special service prepared by Amelia for Connor.
However, Connor was not very interested in this kind of thing. He nodded then entered the room and began to cultivate.
Amelia didn't say anything and returned to her room alone.
A day passed by quickly.
The plane slowly landed at the airport in Eigona.
Because of Amelia, the plane did not need to undergo any inspection. This helped Connor save a lot of time and energy because he perfectly avoided the surveillance of the various countries in the continent.
If Connor had not come to Eigona with Amelia, he would probably have to go through another fierce battle.
The people in Europe would never have thought that the Soul Eater they had been waiting for had already quietly arrived in Eigona.
After Connor and Amelia got off the plane, they took a private car and rushed to the hotel.
Now that Connor already knew where the King of Shadows was hiding, he was not in a hurry to find the King of Shadows immediately. Instead, he planned to wait until he had fully recovered before finding the King of Shadows.
The car slowly drove on the streets of the city. Connor looked at the scenery outside the car window expressionlessly.
This was Connor's first time in this city. He had to admit that it looked pretty good.
"Mr. McDonald, would you like to try the local delicacies?"
Amelia suddenly asked Connor.
"Local delicacies?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said indifferently, "I have no interest in such things!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2172: Meeting Yvette Wendell Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 2172: Meeting Yvette Wendell Again
"Alright, then!"
Amelia nodded helplessly, then turned around and walked into the car.
A few minutes later, the car stopped at a five-star hotel.
"Mr. McDonald, this hotel is also one of the properties of Rockefeller. It's very safe inside, so you can relax here!"
Amelia said to Connor.
"Alright, thank you!"
Connor nodded gently, then pushed open the door and got out of the car.
Amelia also got out of the car and led Connor into the hotel.
"Connor?"
However, before Connor could enter the hotel, he heard someone calling his name from behind.
Connor was stunned for a moment, then turned around to take a look.
It was a beautiful woman in a white dress with a very sexy figure and exquisite appearance. However, because this beautiful woman was wearing sunglasses, Connor could not see her full appearance. Beside this beautiful woman stood a handsome blond man with blue eyes. The two of them stood together and were very compatible.
"Connor, don't you recognize me?"
She took off her sunglasses and shouted at Connor.
"..."
Connor looked at the beautiful woman in front of him and hesitated for a couple of seconds. Then, he said softly, "Yvette?"
"Yeah, what a coincidence. I didn't expect to bump into you here. We haven't seen each other for a long time."
Yvette strode over to Connor's side and sized him up. She then glanced at Amelia.
Connor had a very deep impression of Yvette. Although the two of them were not that close, Yvette was considered one of the more famous celebrities. Her career had always been developing very well. Furthermore, Yvette had attended Connor's opening ceremony back then, and her relationship with Connor was quite good.
Furthermore, Connor had also seen some news about Yvette currently developing in Eigona and was doing quite well.
The two of them had not seen each other for a long time, so they hadn't been in contact with each other.
Connor did not expect to run into Yvette here.
After not meeting for such a long time, Connor felt that Yvette had become much more beautiful. She seemed to have become even sexier, and she appeared to be more dignified.
However, if Yvette were to be compared to Amelia, who was by Connor's side, she was slightly inferior. After all, Amelia's temperament was innate, while a large part of Yvette's temperament was cultivated.
"What a coincidence!"
Connor said to Yvette with a smile.
"What are you doing here? Are you here for a vacation?"
Yvette blinked and asked with a smile.
"Yeah, sort of!"
Connor lightly nodded.
Meanwhile, the handsome man beside Yvette was also sizing up Connor with a disdainful expression on his face. After all, Connor's appearance was rather ordinary, and his attire was nothing to shout about. He gave off the feeling that he was just an ordinary university student. There was nothing special about him at all.
However, Amelia, who was beside Connor, was different. Whether it was her temperament, appearance, or figure, Amelia was considered top-notch. Especially Amelia's cold and arrogant eyes, as if they were constantly telling everyone that this woman was not someone simple.
The handsome man sized up Amelia's sexy and graceful figure and revealed a smile. He walked straight to Yvette's side and said with a chuckle, "Miss Wen, are they your friends? Why don't you make the introductions?"
"I'm sorry, Mr. George. This is my friend, Connor McDonald!"
Yvette hurriedly introduced Connor.
George smiled faintly and then said to Connor with a smile, "Hello!"
"Hello!"
Connor nodded lightly, his tone very calm, as if he did not take George seriously at all.
When George saw Connor's attitude toward him, he was obviously unhappy.
"Connor, Mr. George is the heir of the Brad family in Eigona. The Brad family is considered one of the top ten families in Eigona. They control many large corporations…"
Yvette was worried that Connor would offend George because he did not know of his identity. Hence, she briefly introduced George's background to Connor.
However, when Connor heard that, he was still very calm. There was no change in his emotions at all.
As for Amelia, there was no need to talk about her. The small Brad family was nothing in Amelia's eyes. If the patriarch of the Brad family were here, he would be so scared that he would be speechless. George was just the heir, so he was not worth mentioning.
Seeing that they did not react much to what Amelia said, George was slightly upset, but he did not show it on the surface. On the contrary, he still said with a gentlemanly face, "Since we're all friends, why don't we have a meal together?"
"Alright, let's have a meal together!"
In order to ease the awkward atmosphere, Yvette hurriedly agreed.
Amelia was not in the mood for all this. After looking at Connor indifferently, she turned around and left.
Connor, on the other hand, said to Yvette, "No, thanks. I still have things to do!"
After saying that, Connor also left with Amelia.
George stood rooted to the ground in a daze. His face was dark because he did not expect Connor to reject him. How embarrassing!
George wanted to use this opportunity to get to know Amelia, but now his plan had completely fallen through.
"Mr. George, I'm really sorry. It seems that Connor has something urgent to do!"
Yvette's expression was extremely ugly as she hurriedly explained to George.
"Urgent?"
George could not help but snort coldly.
"It must be important!"
Yvette hurriedly added after sensing that George was upset.
"I hope that's really the case!"
George replied in a low voice. His face was still dark.
After a moment of hesitation, Yvette said softly, "Mr. George, if you have something else to do, please go ahead. I'll go back to the hotel myself!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2173: Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Chapter 2173: Misunderstanding
Recently, Yvette had been thinking of ways to secure the female lead role in a movie.
And George's family, the Brad family, was investing in the movie.
That was why Yvette had been so close to George recently. She wanted to get the female lead role through George.
However, Yvette knew that her role as the female lead had been ruined after what had happened earlier. However, she did not have any intention of blaming Connor. After all, Connor did not know what was going on. Besides, Yvette would not allow Connor to curry favor with George because of her.
At the thought of this, Yvette felt a little sad. After all, she was considered one of the top celebrities in the domestic entertainment industry back then. Now, she had to appease others for a role overseas.
Such a difference was difficult for anyone to accept.
Developing overseas and developing in the country were two different things. Yvette could rely on her family's powerful connections in the country and easily obtain all kinds of resources. However, it was different overseas. Her family's sphere of influence was not that far-reaching.
Therefore, it was a challenge for Yvette now. However, Yvette came overseas precisely because she liked such challenges. Otherwise, she could have chosen to develop her career in the country. It would definitely be much easier than overseas.
However, since Yvette was already here, she was naturally unwilling to return just like that. Hence, Yvette had always wanted to prove herself.
George's expression changed when he realized what Yvette meant by what she said. He suddenly realized that he might have gone a little overboard just now.
Furthermore, he had already missed out on that exquisite beauty, Amelia. If he were to miss out on Yvette now, it would be a loss for him.
"Miss Wendell, I'm sorry. I lost my composure just now!"
George said softly to Yvette.
Yvette was stunned for a moment before she hurriedly said, "Don't say that, Mr. George. My friend was a little unreasonable just now. I hope that you won't take it to heart. Connor is considered a big shot in Sommervile. That's why he seems a little arrogant…"
"He's a big shot?"
George smiled disdainfully.
"Yeah, although I don't know who Connor is, he's indeed very wealthy!"
Yvette nodded gently.
As Yvette had interacted with Connor before, she had a rough understanding of Connor's situation. However, she did not know much about him.
"So what if he is wealthy?"
George snorted and continued, "Oh right, Miss Wendell, there's a banquet tonight. There will be many internationally renowned directors and actors attending. Also, the organizer of this banquet is the Eigona royal family. I received an invitation. I wonder if you would be willing to attend this banquet with me?"
George was sizing up Yvette's sexy figure as he spoke, his expression showing a hint of lust.
Yvette was definitely considered a beauty. Be it her looks or figure, she was considered the best of the best. Furthermore, Yvette was at the age when a woman was the most alluring. Every frown and smile of hers exuded boundless charm. Moreover, this charm was something that no man could resist.
