Ever since George laid eyes on this sexy beauty, he had been deeply attracted to her. Hence, he had been thinking of ways to get Yvette.
However, Yvette was different from the female celebrities in the entertainment industry. Having a meal was fine, but if he were to make any other advances, he would be rejected by Yvette.
That was why George had brought out his biggest trump card, which was the banquet.
The banquet was a great opportunity for any female celebrity. Those who could attend this banquet were all true upper-class people. One could get a lot of opportunities and expand their popularity in the foreign entertainment industry.
The rise in popularity would certainly help one's career advance more smoothly.
The most important reason why Sommervile's female celebrities weren't developing well in Europe was because they couldn't achieve a certain level of fame.
Hearing George's words, Yvette was naturally very excited. She hurriedly said, "Mr. George, are you saying that you're going to bring me with you to the banquet?
"I would be so grateful to you…"
Yvette knew very well what this banquet meant to her, so she was extremely happy.
"Miss Wendell, we're friends. Why are you being so polite to me?"
As George spoke, he reached out his hand and was about to reach for Yvette's slender waist.
However, Yvette avoided his advances and said with a smile, "Mr. George, it's getting late. We still have to attend the banquet tonight. I have to go and get ready!"
"Alright, then!"
George nodded helplessly.
Yvette turned around and left.
George sneered as he watched Yvette's retreating back. To him, since Yvette had already agreed to attend the banquet with him, it meant that he had already succeeded partially. Yvette was just playing hard to get.
"As expected, women from Sommervile are all so reserved!"
George licked his lips and turned to leave.
On the other side, Connor followed Amelia into the hotel and went straight to his room to rest.
However, before Connor could enter his cultivation state, a knock sounded on the door.
"Who is it?"
Connor frowned and asked.
"Lord Soul Eater, the representative of Risu, General Abel, would like to meet you!"
Amelia's voice rang out.
"A representative from Risu?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he said indifferently, "Come in!"
Amelia pushed open the door and led Abel in.
When Abel saw Connor, he was surprised. He didn't expect Connor to be so young.
Who would have thought that such an ordinary-looking young man could actually make the powerful Risu bow its head?
Connor glanced at Abel and said softly, "You're the representative of Risu?"
"Lord Soul Eater, I think there might be some misunderstanding between us. I came here this time in hopes of resolving the misunderstanding between us!"
Abel spoke to Connor in a low voice, being very respectful.

chapters.title: Chapter 2174: International Superstar Yelena Allen
chapters.content:
Chapter 2174: International Superstar Yelena Allen
"Alright, there's no need for so much nonsense. You know very well whether it's a misunderstanding or not. Tell me why you're looking for me!"
Connor said impatiently.
"I came here this time mainly because I hope that Lord Soul Eater can forgive our foolish actions from before!"
Abel said carefully.
"I can forgive you. I didn't want to do anything to you people. You were the one who made things difficult for yourself!"
Connor said lightly.
Abel was stunned when he heard Connor's words. He couldn't believe it, because he didn't expect Connor to be so easy to talk to.
"Lord Soul Eater, do you mean that you have forgiven us?"
Abel quickly asked.
"I said that I can forgive you, but it doesn't mean that I have forgiven you. As for whether I will forgive you or not, that depends on how sincere you are!"
Connor said softly.
"Sincere?"
Abel hesitated for a moment before saying, "Lord Soul Eater, don't worry. I'll discuss a plan with the others when I get back. I guarantee that you'll be satisfied!"
"Alright…"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Lord Soul Eater, if there is nothing else, I will take my leave now…"
Abel said carefully.
Connor waved his hand at Abel, and Abel walked out of the door.
Abel's back was drenched, and his forehead was covered in sweat. After all, this was the first time he had come into contact with the Soul Eater.
Abel had thought that Connor was the kind of person who would kill him without a word, but he didn't think that the legendary Soul Eater would be like this. Connor gave Abel the feeling that he was just an ordinary person. He was very different from the Soul Eater he had imagined.
However, the more Connor was like this, the more afraid Abel was. He knew that people like Connor were the most terrifying.
...
Amelia sent Abel out of the room and returned to Connor's side.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked at Amelia. He asked Amelia softly, "Is there anything else?"
"What you did just now was a little out of my expectations!"
Amelia said to Connor.
"A little out of your expectations?"
Connor was stunned for a moment, and then he said lightly, "What do you mean by that?"
"I thought that you would kill Abel, but you didn't!"
Amelia paused for a moment, then looked at Connor indifferently and continued, "However, what you did was right. Although Risu has already taken the initiative to bow to you this time, it doesn't mean that Risu doesn't have the ability to get rid of you. If you continue to fight with Risu, it won't be beneficial for both of you..."
"I just don't want to waste any more time with them. My enemies aren't them. It's meaningless for me to continue fighting with them!"
Connor said calmly.
"That's true!"
Amelia nodded and continued, "There will be a banquet tonight. I have an invitation card. Do you want to attend?"
"Banquet?"
Connor couldn't help but be stunned for a moment when he heard Amelia's words. Then, he smiled and said, "Are you kidding me? Do you think I'm in the mood to attend a banquet now?"
"If it were just an ordinary banquet, you definitely wouldn't want to attend it. But this banquet is different!"
Amelia said with a smile.
"Different?"
Connor turned to look at Amelia and asked softly, "How is it different? What's the difference?"
"This banquet is organized by the Eigona royal family, and they have even invited the international superstar Yelena Allen to sing during the banquet!"
Amelia said slowly.
Yelena!
When Connor heard this name, he was stunned because he had not heard this name for a long time.
Ever since Connor rescued Yelena from Japan, Yelena had never appeared in Connor's life again. Moreover, Connor had never contacted Yelena.
"I didn't expect you to know about my relationship with Yelena!"
Connor said softly.
"Of course, I know a lot about you. I know all the women who have interacted with you!"
Amelia said indifferently.
"As expected of Rockefeller!"
Connor could not help but sigh.
"Then, are you going to attend this banquet or not?"
Amelia asked with a smile.
Connor hesitated for a couple of seconds, then whispered, "I don't have anything to do tonight anyway, so let's go and take a look!"
"Alright!"
Amelia laughed and turned to leave.
After Amelia had left, Connor's mind flashed with the things that happened when he was with Yelena.
In fact, Connor felt that the woman he owed the most was probably Yelena, because the most sensible woman was also Yelena.
When Connor broke up with Yelena, she did not complain and disappeared from his world.
Even after Connor rescued Yelena from Japan, she quietly left Sommervile after she woke up and didn't bother Connor.
It was past seven in the evening.
Connor followed Amelia to the hotel where the banquet was held.
The interior of the hotel was luxuriously decorated, like a palace. Not only were many internationally famous superstars invited to this banquet, but the business and political circles of Eigona and even the royal family were also here.
Amelia's status was not simple, so she would definitely receive special treatment at a banquet like this, such as a special lounge.
After Connor and Amelia entered the banquet hall, he saw that there were already many people here. However, these people probably had slightly lower status. There was no way the real big shots would come so early.
Therefore, the people present were basically all small celebrities. These celebrities were all dressed up beautifully and were wearing expensive gowns. They had polite smiles on their faces, hoping that they would be lucky enough to be taken a fancy to by a certain big shot today. That way, they would be able to reach the top very quickly.
Connor walked around the hall and then whispered to Amelia, "Didn't you say that Yelena would also attend today's banquet? Why don't I see her?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2175: Unspoken Rules
chapters.content:
Chapter 2175: Unspoken Rules
"Yelena Allen is quite famous now. She's famous internationally, so she won't be here so early!
"And as far as I know, she is only here as a special guest. She will sing a song at the end of the banquet, so if you want to see her, you might have to wait a little longer!"
Amelia explained softly.
"I see…"
Connor lightly nodded.
"Lord Soul Eater, why don't we go to the private room to rest for now?"
Amelia hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly.
"Alright!"
Connor nodded and walked out of the hall.
After all, Connor was here for Yelena today. Connor did not want to disrupt Yelena's life. He just wanted to see Yelena.
Since Yelena hadn't arrived yet, Connor naturally didn't want to stay here.
Just as Connor and Amelia left, Yvette Wendell and George walked into the hall.
After entering the hall, Yvette looked at the celebrities in the hall with a shocked expression.
"There are so many international superstars here!"
Yvette sighed softly.
"These people? They are just some small celebrities. The real big celebrities aren't here yet. I heard that Yelena Allen from Sommervile is coming today!"
George replied indifferently.
"Yelena?"
Yvette was even more shocked.
After all, Yelena was now considered the most famous female celebrity in the world. Yvette had always hoped that she could become a celebrity like Yelena.
"Miss Wendell, I happen to have a few director friends. They should be in the private room now. Let me bring you over to meet them!"
George smiled at Yvette.
"Alright!"
Yvette agreed without any hesitation.
"Follow me!"
George smiled smugly before leading Yvette to a private room in the distance.
...
Connor and Amelia waited in the private room for about half an hour.
"Mr. McDonald, the banquet should have already started. Do you want to continue resting here or go to the hall for a walk?"
Amelia hesitated for a moment before speaking to Connor.
"Let's go to the hall and take a look!"
Connor replied indifferently, then stood up and walked out of the private room.
A few minutes later, Connor followed Amelia back to the hall.
However, just as Connor had walked into the hall, he heard a commotion not far away.
Connor subconsciously turned to take a look and realized that it was George and Yvette.
Yvette and Connor had a pretty good relationship. Connor had even pretended to be Yvette's boyfriend before. At this moment, Connor felt that Yvette had encountered some trouble, so he walked over.
Amelia followed Connor and walked over.
"Miss Wendell, I think you might have misunderstood something. Come back with me, or Mr. Anthony might really get angry!"
George tugged at Yvette's arm as he was speaking.
"Let go of me. I'm leaving, do you hear me?"
Yvette was all riled up.
She did not expect George to be so shameless. After the two of them entered the private room, George had introduced Yvette to a director and even promised to let Yvette play the female lead. However, the price was that she had to accompany George for a week and then the director for another week.
No matter what, Yvette was considered an A-list female celebrity in Sommervile. Coupled with her family connections, she had never encountered such a situation before. She had certainly never slept with anyone.
Yvette did not know what to do for a moment and immediately rushed out of the door, wanting to leave.
However, George did not seem to have any intention of letting Yvette off so easily. He immediately chased after her and asked her to go back in with him.
Then, Connor saw what happened next.
"Miss Wendell, we were just joking with you just now. You don't have to take it seriously!"
George explained awkwardly when he saw that there were more people around.
"A joke? Do you think I can't tell what a joke is? I didn't expect you to be such a dirty person. Please let go of your dirty hands. I'm leaving now, do you hear me?"
Yvette shouted at George with her big, watery eyes.
"..."
When George heard Yvette's words, he became furious. He stopped pretending and glared at her, shouting, "You b*tch, don't be so shameless!"
"What did you say?"
Yvette did not expect George to call her a b*tch. She stood rooted to the ground.
"You heard me. I'm telling you; I brought you here with me today. Without my permission, don't even think about leaving!"
George shouted.
Because the banquet had not officially started yet, there were not many big shots present. That was why George had the courage to speak so arrogantly. If all those big shots were present, George would not have such courage at all.
"..."
Yvette was instantly dumbfounded.
It was only then she remembered that this was not Sommervile, but Eigona. This was George's territory. If Yvette really offended George, not only would she not be able to survive in the entertainment industry in England, but she would also end up in a very miserable state.
For a moment, Yvette was in despair. After all, she was in a place she was unfamiliar with, and she did not know who would help her.
"You b*tch, do you think I don't know what's going on with you? Aren't women from Sommervile all like this? You just like to pretend to be pure and innocent. How many men have you slept with? Also, since you've already agreed to attend the banquet with me, that means you've agreed to sleep with me. Why are you playing coy with me?"
George seemed to be getting more and more agitated as he scolded, and his words became more and more unpleasant.
In fact, there was such an unspoken rule in the entertainment industry in Eigona. As long as one agreed to the man's invitation to attend the banquet, it meant that that person had agreed to the unspoken rule.
Of course, this only happened in the entertainment industry. Ordinary people did not know this rule.
Naturally, Yvette did not understand what was going on either, which was why the situation had turned out this way.
If Yvette had known about this earlier, she would never have agreed to attend this banquet.

chapters.title: Chapter 2176: You are Lying!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2176: You are Lying!
At this moment, Yvette was standing alone in her original spot. Her eyes were slightly moist, and she was extremely aggrieved.
She did not know what she should do now.
She didn't even know who would help her at this time.
"Stop talking nonsense and follow me!"
George reached out to grab Yvette and was about to drag her toward the private room.
There were many people watching, but no one interfered because no one would offend George because of someone they didn't know.
Yvette struggled frantically, but she was helpless as a girl. She had very little strength and could not shake off George at all.
"Stop!"
But at this moment, a woman's voice suddenly sounded.
When everyone heard this, they turned to look at Amelia.
It was obvious that the person who had just spoken was none other than Amelia.
Originally, Connor wanted to speak up, but Amelia beat him to it.
It was not that Amelia really wanted to save Yvette, but she was worried that if Connor and George had any conflict, the consequences would be unimaginable. Hence, it was better for her to resolve this problem.
"..."
George instinctively turned to Amelia and said coldly, "This matter has nothing to do with you. You should mind your own business!"
"Let go of this girl now!"
Amelia said with a frown.
"Who are you? Why should I let go just because you want me to? Don't you understand that this has nothing to do with you?"
George shouted at Amelia.
"It's true that what happened between the two of you has nothing to do with me, but I know that she is not willing to go with you now, so you'd better let go of her. Otherwise, you'll regret it for the rest of your life!"
Amelia was very helpless because George was obviously walking himself into trouble.
"What if I don't let go now? What can you do to me?"
George asked Amelia provocatively.
"What can I do to you?"
Amelia was somewhat helpless.
"I advise you to let go of this woman immediately, or you will die a miserable death!"
However, at this moment, Connor's voice sounded.
When Amelia heard Connor's words, she realized that Connor might make a move on George at any time, so she hurriedly said to Connor, "Mr. McDonald, let me handle this. After all, your main focus is to deal with the King of Shadows. If you expose yourself now, it may cause unnecessary trouble!"
Connor looked at Amelia. He felt that Amelia's words were very reasonable, so he didn't say anything else and just nodded lightly.
Connor knew that with Amelia's influence, it would not be very difficult to deal with this matter, so he did not need to do anything.
"I'm warning you for the last time. Let go of her immediately, or I'll make you and your family regret it!"
Amelia took a step forward and said to George in a cold voice.
At this moment, Amelia was also very disgusted with George. However, because this was Auro's territory, Amelia did not want to go too far. However, if George continued to push his luck, Amelia might make a move.
If Amelia were to make a move, it would indeed be something that George's family head would not be able to withstand.
"Who the heck are you? What right do you have to talk to me like that?"
George seemed to be frightened by Amelia's aura and asked her in confusion.
Amelia didn't want to waste any more time talking to George. After all, she could solve this problem with just a phone call.
Amelia took out her phone and was about to make a call.
"What's going on?"
However, at this moment, an elderly voice sounded.
When everyone heard this, they turned and looked behind them. They saw an old man slowly walking over with a walking stick.
"Brandon?"
When Yvette saw the old man, she was completely stunned. Her expression was one of disbelief.
The others present also revealed shocked expressions. It was obvious that the identity of this old man who had appeared at this time was extraordinary.
Amelia also put down his phone and turned to look at the old man.
This old man named Brandon Wood was a very famous director in the European entertainment industry. He had won many awards and had made many superstars famous. Of course, this was not the most important thing. The most important thing was that Brandon was very prestigious in the international entertainment industry. He could even be considered the most famous director ever.
No one had expected that such a big shot like Brandon would be invited to this banquet.
When Yvette saw Brandon, her face was filled with anxiety. She knew very well that Brandon and George had a very special relationship. Furthermore, the female lead role that Yvette had been fighting for was directed by Brandon.
Hence, Brandon's appearance was not good news for Yvette.
Brandon walked up to George and said softly, "George, since she doesn't want to do this, then let go of her. There will be many big shots coming over later."
"Alright!"
George did not refute Brandon. Instead, he let go of Yvette's hand.
Amelia's expression softened a little when he saw George let go of Yvette's hand. After all, to her, if this matter could end like this, it would be a good outcome.
After all, if Amelia wanted to deal with this matter now, she had to call Auro.
However, Amelia and Auro did not have a good relationship. If it were not for Connor, she would not have made this call.
"Alright, now you can tell me what's going on!"
Brandon whispered to George.
George hesitated for a moment before he briefly explained the situation to Brandon. However, what George said was very different from the actual situation.
From what he told Brandon, he was the victim. Yvette had been actively seducing him and using him. Now, George just wanted to talk to her, and Yvette's friend was threatening him.
George was truly lying through his teeth. He was actually able to make up such a story in such a short period of time.
"You're lying!"
Yvette was so angry that her entire body was trembling after hearing George's words. She then shouted in exasperation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2177: You're Not Welcome!
chapters.content:
Chapter 2177: You're Not Welcome!
"How am I lying?"
George replied smugly.
Just as Yvette opened her mouth and was about to explain, Brandon waved his hand at her and said expressionlessly, "Miss Wendell, you don't have to say anything now. I believe I know what happened!"
"Mr. Brandon…"
Yvette wanted to say something.
"Actually, I had a pretty good impression of you. I know that you're very famous in Sommervile, and George has recommended you to me many times. I've been considering whether I should work with you…"
Brandon paused for a moment before he continued, "No matter what's going on between you and George, he really has no reason to keep you here, so you can leave now!"
The moment Brandon said that, everyone was stunned. Their faces were filled with disbelief.
No one would have thought that Brandon would speak up for an outsider.
"I didn't expect Brandon to be so reasonable!"
Amelia could not help but sigh to herself. Then, she slowly put away her phone, as if she felt that everything was over.
"Thank you so much, Mr. Brandon!"
Yvette was naturally very excited as well. She hurriedly bowed to Brandon.
Brandon could not help but laugh coldly when he saw Yvette bowing. He then said calmly, "Miss Wendell, you don't have to do this. After all, I asked you to leave because I don't want George to continue causing trouble. However, I should remind you…"
"What is it?"
Yvette was stunned for a moment before she asked Brandon with a puzzled expression.
"Regardless of whether George's words are true or not, your character is questionable, so I won't work with you in the future because I can't let a problematic person appear on the screen."
Brandon deliberately raised his voice when he said that, as if he was speaking to everyone present.
Brandon was very influential internationally. Hence, his words meant that Yvette would be banned from the entire entertainment industry in Europe.
Furthermore, if this news were to spread, Yvette's reputation in the entertainment industry in Sommervile would most likely be ruined.
Such a decision was fatal to any celebrity.
Yvette stood rooted to the ground and stared at Brandon with her big, watery eyes. Her expression was one of disbelief. She did not expect Brandon to be so ruthless as to directly shut her out.
The reason why Yvette came to Europe was to prove that she did not rely on her family's connections to achieve what she had today. She hoped to be recognized internationally. This was the dignity of an actress.
However, she had never expected reality to be so cruel. Yvette had only been in Eigona for less than two months. Not only had she not participated in any movies, but she had also been banned.
This was simply a huge joke!
Amelia finally realized that Brandon was on George's side. He was even crueler than George.
"Who is this person? He seems so powerful!"
"You don't even know Mr. Brandon Wood?"
"Oh my God, he is Brandon Wood? That girl has such terrible luck."
"Yeah. If Brandon says he's not going to work with this actress, then no one will dare to work with her anymore…"
Everyone could not help but start discussing softly. At this moment, everyone was looking at Yvette pitifully.
George, on the other hand, revealed an extremely smug smile. After sizing Yvette up, he chuckled and said, "Miss Wendell, did you hear what Director Brandon said just now?"
Yvette glared at George angrily without saying a word.
"I'll give you another chance now. As long as you agree to my request, I'll have Mr. Brandon take back what he said just now. More importantly, you'll be the female lead in Mr. Brandon's next movie. I'll make you a big star like Yelena Allen…"
George paused for a moment, then looked at Connor and Amelia, and said expressionlessly, "Besides that, these two people also need to apologize to me!"
Yvette's delicate body trembled slightly, and she was extremely furious.
At this moment, everyone's attention was focused on Yvette. It was as if George's words were not an insult to them but an opportunity for Yvette.
As long as Yvette nodded her head now, she would be able to transform from an ugly duckling into a swan.
No actor would refuse such a good opportunity.
Brandon was also constantly sizing up Yvette. He was secretly impressed by George's good taste. Yvette was outstanding in all aspects. As long as she was obedient, her future would be limitless.
"Yvette, have you thought about what I said just now?"
George asked Yvette with a smile seeing that she was silent.
"Get lost! Even if I'm banned from acting, I won't let you succeed!"
Yvette said firmly to George.
When George heard Yvette's words, he stood rooted to the ground with an incredulous expression on his face. He had never expected Yvette to still reject him at this point.
"Yvette, are you crazy? Are you really willing to be banned from acting like this? Do you know what you're missing out on?"
George gritted his teeth and shouted at Yvette.
"So what if I'm banned from acting? I won't let someone like you succeed!"
Yvette said softly.
"Why, you…"
George was so infuriated by Yvette's words that his entire body was trembling. For a moment, he did not know what to say.
"George, forget it. Since she has already made her decision, don't force her!"
Brandon said expressionlessly.
"Huff…"
George took a deep breath and said in a low voice, "Alright, Yvette, since you've already made up your mind, you can all scram now!"
"You want us to scram?"
Amelia could not help but sneer when he heard George's words. Then, she said indifferently, "Shouldn't you be the one scramming?"
"This banquet is organized by the Eigona royal family. What does it have to do with you? We don't welcome you here. Please leave immediately!"
George shouted with his eyes wide open.

chapters.title: Chapter 2178: Yelena's Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 2178: Yelena's Arrival
"Do you know who I am?" Amelia suppressed her inner anger and gave George a fierce glare. She then said, "Do you even know who he is? You dare to tell us to scram? You must be tired of living!"
"Hahaha..." George burst into loud laughter upon hearing her words, and he was about to respond.
"Miss Yelena is here!" However, at that moment, a voice suddenly came from the entrance.
George's laughter immediately stopped, and he turned to look at the entrance. Everyone fell silent, eagerly waiting for Yelena to make her appearance.
Connor, too, instinctively looked towards the entrance. However, he couldn't help but feel curious about how she had gained such incredible influence in the entertainment industry in just over a year since he last saw her.
"Is Yelena really so powerful in the entertainment industry Europe?" Connor couldn't help but ask Yvette.
"Of course, Yelena is the number one female star in Europe's entertainment industry, like a queen. No one dares to offend her!" Yvette quickly nodded.
"Isn't she from Sommervile? How could she become the top female star in Europe?" Connor was even more puzzled.
He knew that the Europe entertainment industry was somewhat exclusive, and it was already quite challenging for a female star from Sommervile to establish herself there, let alone become the top star.
"I'm not entirely sure about that, but my manager told me that Yelena has a powerful background and tremendous influence. She can effortlessly secure any resources she desires, and the most crucial thing is that anyone who dares to offend her meets an unfortunate fate," Yvette whispered to him.
In reality, Yelena had experienced many legendary events in Europe, but Yvette was preoccupied with her own concerns at the moment and couldn't elaborate.
Amelia, on the other hand, turned to Connor and asked with a faint smile, "Could it be that the person who has been protecting Yelena is you?"
"I'm not sure..." Connor shook his head. Although he had asked Thomas to help take care of Yelena, he hadn't inquired about the details, so he wasn't entirely sure.
Suddenly, the crowd in front of Connor began to part like the ebbing tide, creating a path.
A stunning lady in a turquoise cheongsam, accompanied by her assistant, walked gracefully into the hall. Her tall and sexy figure, exquisite beauty, and charismatic presence made even the other female celebrities in the room pale in comparison. Not even Yvette or Amelia could match her.
As she entered, it was as if a queen had graced them with her presence.
"Miss Yelena, you've arrived!" The event's host quickly approached Yelena, greeting her with a big smile.
"Lord Wilber, greetings!" she responded calmly and gracefully, even when facing the Royal Family of Eigona. She walked past him, heading into the main hall.
Connor remained silent, watching Yelena closely. After all, it had been quite some time since they had last seen each other, and she seemed to have changed significantly. He found her presence somewhat unfamiliar.
However, at that moment, she seemed to notice him from the corner of her eye. Her expression changed, and she turned her head to look at him.
In an instant, she froze in her tracks. Her facial expression finally revealed a familiar warmth that had been suppressed for a long time.
Her sensuous lips quivered slightly, and she seemed like she wanted to speak, to call Connor's name, but she hesitated, fearing it was all just an illusion.
She didn't want to shatter her own illusion.
Her longing for him was indescribable through words. She dreamed of seeing him almost every night, and she had the urge to seek him out countless times. However, she always held back, remembering his words. She didn't want to disrupt his life.
It was as if time had stopped at that moment.
She gazed at him quietly, and he did the same.
Everyone else in the room stood still, as if they had no idea what was happening.
After what seemed like an eternity, she realized that he hadn't disappeared. She finally understood that what she was seeing might not be an illusion but a reality.
After a long period of hesitation, she finally gathered the courage to speak and softly asked, "Is it really you?"
He looked at her and nodded gently.
Upon seeing his nod, her emotions, which she had suppressed for so long, finally found an outlet. Crystal tears welled up in her eyes and streamed down her cheeks.
She rushed towards him, opened her arms wide, and tightly embraced him.
For a moment, everyone present was left in stunned silence.
Yvette, who was standing by Connor's side, stared wide-eyed, her expression full of incredulity.
No one had expected that Yelena would know Connor!

chapters.title: Chapter 2179: Fighting For a Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 2179: Fighting For a Woman
Moreover, judging by Yelena's expression, everyone could tell that her relationship with Connor was not simple.
At this moment, George and Brandon wore incredulous expressions.
They had no idea that Connor knew Yelena.
"What... What's going on? How does that guy know Yelena? And is she even hugged him. What's happening here?" Brandon stammered as he asked George, his expression full of disbelief.
"I... I have no idea what's going on either. Who would have thought this kid knows Yelena?" George appeared dumbfounded.
"If this person really knows Yelena and their relationship is more than ordinary, we're in trouble, you know?" Brandon said through gritted teeth.
"What can we do now that we know?" George replied in frustration.
Brandon glanced at George, his face filled with anger. After taking a deep breath, he didn't say anything more because he knew it was already too late.
"Are you alright?" Yelena, holding Connor, asked with a choked voice.
"What can go wrong with me?" he replied calmly.
"Don't lie to me. I know everything. You're the Soul Eater, and I've seen what you've done..." she whispered softly.
He reached out and gently touched her head, then smiled and said, "You don't need to worry; I won't have any trouble."
"Knowing that you're fine is all that matters!" Yelena didn't mention their breakup because, in her heart, there was only Connor. If he didn't want her around, she wouldn't be there, but she would never forget him, nor could she love anyone else.
"Why are you here?" She seemed somewhat surprised that he had come to this event.
"I'm here in Eigona for some business," he replied.
"Oh..." Yelena nodded lightly. A disappointed expression flashed across her face, and then she instinctively glanced at Yvette and Amelia, wondering what was on their minds.
Standing beside Connor, Amelia smiled faintly and whispered, "But Mr. Connor came to this event today just to see you."
"Really?" Yelena's heart lifted upon hearing this, and she eagerly asked Connor, "Is it true?"
"Yes," Connor nodded.
She was overjoyed to learn that he had come to see her. She hugged him even tighter, now that she knew he had made a special effort to be there for her.
The host of the event, Lord Wilber, realized that the relationship between Connor and Yelena was not ordinary. He had heard a lot about Yelena, including the fact that her boyfriend had a terrifying background.
So, after some hesitation, he walked over to Yelena and softly asked, "Miss Yelena, may I ask who this gentleman is?"
"This is my boyfriend, Connor!" Yelena didn't hesitate at all and replied straightforwardly.
The crowd fell into stunned silence upon hearing Yelena's words. They all stared wide-eyed at Connor's direction, their expressions filled with incredulity.
"What? This person is Yelena's boyfriend?"
"Wow, she already has a boyfriend?"
"This is huge news!"
The crowd couldn't help but start whispering.
George couldn't help but laugh bitterly. "How is this possible? This guy is actually Yelena's boyfriend?"
Brandon also wore a puzzled expression. "It can't be true, right? Yelena already has a boyfriend?"
"It doesn't matter. Even if this person is Yelena's boyfriend, what can he do? Yelena is just a star, and I don't believe she can do anything to us!" George said with a cold tone.
Brandon's expression appeared helpless upon hearing George's words.
Indeed, Yelena might not be able to do anything to George, but she could certainly cause trouble for Brandon.
At this moment, while the crowd was still discussing Connor and Yelena's relationship, another person entered the hall.
When everyone saw this person, their expressions seemed even more shocked.
Everyone fell silent, and they all looked at the man who entered the hall with utmost respect.
The man was none other than Augustine, whom Connor had met once before.
After all, Augustine was a member of the English royal family, so his presence at this event was perfectly normal.
However, Augustine hadn't come for the event; he had come for Yelena.
Ever since Yelena arrived in Eigona, the person who had truly been protecting her was not Thomas. Thomas's abilities were limited, and at most, he could help Yelena find some resources. He couldn't possibly have helped her achieve her current level of success.
Augustine had fallen in love with Yelena the moment he saw her and had been relentlessly pursuing her. However, he had been rejected by her.
He had never been rejected by a woman before, which made her personality even more captivating to him.
Unlike George, Augustine was different. As a member of the royal family, he couldn't resort to force. That's why he had always secretly protected Yelena, enabling her to achieve her current success.
When Augustine saw Yelena, his attention was solely on her. Particularly, when he saw her still hugging another man, his expression turned incredibly furious.
Augustine pushed aside Lord Wilber, who was in front of him, and walked quickly toward Yelena.
"Oh, I almost forgot about this!" George suddenly remembered the rumor that Augustine had a thing for Yelena. However, he had thought it was just a rumor and hadn't taken it seriously.
But when he saw Augustine's furious expression, he realized that the rumor might be true.
If Augustine did have feelings for Yelena, then they were all in for a show today.
After all, who was Augustine?
Not only was he of royal blood, but he was also the guardian of Eigona. If anyone dared to challenge him over a woman, they would be asking for death!

chapters.title: Chapter 2180: An Existence Like Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 2180: An Existence Like Death
Augustine rushed to Yelena and was about to speak when he froze in place. He saw the face he least wanted to see.
"The Soul Eater? How can it be you?" Augustine stammered.
As he uttered these words, the entire hall erupted. Because everyone present could clearly hear the name.
The Soul Eater was possibly the most famous person worldwide at the moment. Even though the people in the room were ordinary, they had all heard about the Soul Eater.
Augustine never expected to see Connor here.
"This person is the Soul Eater?" George, upon hearing these words, felt his legs go weak, and he sat down on the floor in fear, staring with an expression of extreme dread.
Brandon's face turned even more unsightly because neither of them had expected that Connor, whom they had provoked, would turn out to be so terrifying!
In their eyes, the words "Soul Eater" were like a grim reaper's presence!
"It's over, it's really over, we're doomed..." George sat on the floor, staring at Connor's position, stuttering.
If he were only Yelena's boyfriend, George might not have been so frightened. But if he was truly the Soul Eater, George knew he was definitely finished because his family's strength, no matter how terrifying, could never compete with someone like the Soul Eater.
Augustine's expression was also grim, and he didn't know what to do at this moment.
"Do you know Yelena?" Connor asked Augustine in a soft voice.
"I do..." Augustine nodded with clenched teeth.
"In the future, it's best if you stay away from my girlfriend, or I'll make sure you meet a very gruesome end. Do you understand what I mean?" Connor continued.
Everyone looked at him, astonished by his audacity. After all, this was the first time they had seen someone speak to Augustine like this.
But now that they knew he was the Soul Eater, such behavior didn't seem abnormal anymore.
"I understand!" Augustine nodded again.
After that, Connor, without further troubling Augustine, held Yelena's hand and walked out of the hall.
She followed him happily, as if in her eyes, nothing in this world was more important than him.
Augustine, watching their departure, had a furious expression, but he felt helpless because he knew that if he were alone, he wouldn't stand a chance against Connor.
As Connor passed by George, he glanced at him, and George immediately fainted, unable to bear such immense psychological pressure.
Yvette seemed to recover from her shock at this point and quickly left with Connor, Yelena, and Amelia.
...
After Connor and his companions walked out of the hall, Connor glanced briefly at Yvette and spoke softly, "Now you should also know my identity, and these people in Eigona also know about your relationship with me. So, I'm worried you might be in danger. It's best for you to leave Eigona for a while."
At this moment, he didn't want to involve Yvette any further since their relationship was merely that of friends.
"But I don't want to go back home now..." Yvette seemed to have something difficult to express as she whispered to Connor.
"If you don't want to go back home, it's fine. I can arrange for someone to take you to Risu. I can also introduce you to the best directors in Risu. Your career there will definitely be much better than here," Amelia directly spoke up.
There was currently no safer place than Risu. After all, they had already compromised with Connor, and no one in their right mind would harm a friend of the Soul Eater.
"Really?" Yvette's face lit up with excitement upon hearing this.
"Really." Connor nodded gently and continued, "She has many film and television companies in Risu."
"That's amazing..." Yvette hurriedly said.
Amelia turned her head to give Connor a glance, then whispered, "Mr. Connor, I'll arrange for your friend to go to Risu now, so I won't disturb you."
"Alright." He nodded gently.
Amelia, being very considerate, left with Yvette, leaving only Connor and Yelena behind.
He smiled and asked, "Now it's just the two of us. What do you want to do?"
"Come home with me!" Yelena said with a joyful smile.
"Sure, let's go home!" He nodded gently.
...
Ten minutes later, Connor and the others entered a vast estate.
The estate was incredibly large, covering at least thousands of square meters, and was probably worth over a hundred million.
But for Yelena, such an estate was already nothing special.
After entering the room, Connor immediately embraced Yelena and began to kiss her.
After all, they hadn't seen each other for a long time, and their emotions had finally found an outlet.
They went from the living room to the bathroom and then to the bedroom, spending the whole night together until Yelena finally fell asleep at dawn.
Connor, holding Yelena's seductive figure, enjoyed a rare moment of relaxation.
In the days that followed, Connor did not immediately go to meet the King of Shadows.
The reason was simple, which was he needed rest. The battles in Risu had put tremendous pressure on his body, and recovery couldn't happen overnight.
Moreover, he finally had time to spend with Yelena, so for these few days, he focused on being with her.
She had postponed all her work and had been with him all along.
However, such days wouldn't last long.
After the events of that night, Augustine had managed to convince the other three guardians of the Europe continent to come to Eigona. Now, all four guardians were in Eigona, ready to strike at Connor.
Originally, the plan was to wait for the King of Shadows to come out and then strike Connor together. After all, it was one Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts and four Celestial Ancient Martial Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 2181: The Butler
chapters.content:
Chapter 2181: The Butler
With the current lineup, it could be said that they were the top fighting force in Sommervile, and they were very confident in being able to take down Connor.
However, the incident where Connor took Yelena away dealt a significant blow to Augustine. Therefore, he couldn't wait for the King of Shadows to come out of seclusion; he had to act in advance.
Amelia handed over the information about the four guardians to Connor.
After a simple glance at the information, he casually tossed it aside and said disdainfully, "They are just four ants. If they want to come and kill me, they can come. I'll be waiting for them here!"
"They are all four Celestial Ancient Martial Masters, and you are also a Celestial Ancient Martial Master. Are you really confident in taking on all four of them by yourself?" she asked with a hint of helplessness in her expression, frowning at him.
"Who told you I'm a Celestial Ancient Martial Master ?" Connor countered, looking at her.
She instantly froze in place, then her expression became incredulous. She asked, "So, are you at the Pinnacle Ancient Martial Art now?"
"No." Connor shook his head lightly.
"What rank are you?" Amelia was puzzled, furrowing her brows as she asked.
"To be honest, I'm not entirely sure what rank I am right now," Connor said with a faint smile. He continued, "Before going to Risu, I was at Celestial Ancient Martial Master. But after the battles in Risu, I felt that my rank had somehow improved, although I haven't broken through to Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts. So, I'm not quite sure what's going on."
"I'm not very familiar with your martial arts world, but I do know that your current situation is very dangerous. Your best choice is to come with me to the Rockefeller," she said to him.
"You should give up on that idea," he sighed and continued, "But I do have one thing I need your help with."
"What is it?" she asked.
"Help me send Yelena back to Sommervile. The situation in Eigona is very complicated right now, and many people already know about the relationship between Yelena and me. So, I need to send Yelena back to Sommervile first before I can deal with those people," Connor said calmly.
Yelena looked at Connor after hearing his words, hesitated for a moment, and didn't say anything. She knew that even if she stayed by his side, she couldn't help much, so her best choice was to return to Sommervile, which would also spare him some trouble.
"So, are you still not considering my previous suggestion?" Amelia furrowed her brow and asked Connor.
"No, I'm not," Connor replied without hesitation.
Amelia's expression showed her helplessness, and she whispered, "Very well, I'll arrange for Miss Yelena to be sent back to Sommervile this afternoon."
"I hope Yelena can safely reach Sommervile. You better not have any other ideas. You should know my character very well. If anything happens to Yelena, I won't spare you!" Connor said seriously to Amelia.
Amelia, upon hearing his words, sighed in resignation and said softly, "I think I've told you before, I won't offend either of you until a winner is decided between you and Mr. Long. Both of you have a chance to become my future boss."
"So, in your opinion, who has a higher chance of winning between me and Mr. Long?" Connor asked Amelia.
Upon hearing his question, she seemed to freeze for a moment, then she whispered, "Do you want to hear the truth?"
"Of course, I want to hear the truth." He nodded.
"Based on the current situation, your chances are probably less than thirty percent," she said very seriously.
"Since my chances are so low, why did you choose to help me?" Connor asked with some confusion.
"Two years ago, your chances were zero, one year ago, your chances were only two percent, and now your chances are thirty percent. If given more time, your chances might still increase. That's why I'm helping you," she explained seriously.
"Heh..." Connor smiled faintly and didn't say much.
Amelia began to prepare to send Yelena back to Sommervile.
On the other hand, the news of the four guardians of Europe gathering in Eigona had already spread worldwide.
After the intense battle between the Soul Eater and Risu, it seemed like the second war was about to start anytime.
At this point, many people had started speculating about who would win this time.
Although Connor had displayed terrifying combat power in the battle in Risu, there were still many who believed that the four guardians of Europe had a higher chance of winning. The reason was simple: the four guardians' ranks were far higher than those of Risu' Grand Six, and Connor had just experienced such a brutal battle, so many thought that he must be injured and not in his peak condition.
However, there were also many who supported Connor. After all, Connor had already brought about too many miracles.
So, they believed that even if he was facing four Celestial Ancient Martial Masters alone, he might still have a chance to win.
In any case, their speculations were not entirely baseless.
Because the news that the four guardians had gathered in Eigona had long been circulated worldwide, Connor must have received this news. However, he seemed to have no intention of leaving, which could only mean that he was very confident.
The discussion about this matter worldwide was still very intense, and many people were closely following it.
Meanwhile, Connor had spent a full five days resting at Yelena's home. During these five days, everything had been quiet, and Augustine and his group did not seem to be in a hurry to take action. It seemed they were waiting for something.
"Mr. Connor, someone wishes to see you," just as Connor was curious about when Augustine's group would make their move, Amelia once again came to Connor's home.
Behind Amelia was a middle-aged man.
"Are you one of Augustine's people?" Connor asked the middle-aged man in a low voice.
"Hello, Soul Eater. My name is Turner Lawrence, and I am Mr. Augustine's butler," Lawrence replied with a serious expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 2182: Room for Discussion
chapters.content:
Chapter 2182: Room for Discussion
"Augustine's butler?"
After hearing these words, Connor couldn't help but sneer and said expressionlessly, "Augustine doesn't dare to come and see me himself; he actually sent a butler. It's truly laughable. Do you have any business here?"
"According to our Europe customs, the four guardians will notify each other before taking action," Turner replied.
"I see." Connor nodded lightly, not saying much.
He knew that Augustine's actions were similar to the challenge issued in Sommervile's ancient martial arts world. Augustine and his group were influential figures in Europe, so they followed a certain code of conduct in their actions. They had their own rules for everything they did, unlike Connor, who acted completely unpredictably.
"Of course, Mr. Augustine will also propose some conditions. If you can agree to our demands, then the four guardians will not attack you," Turner added at this point.
"What conditions? Go ahead and tell me!" Connor said calmly.
"Firstly, you must leave Eigona immediately and never enter the territory of Eigona for the rest of your life."
"Secondly, you must return all of Mr. Augustine's artifacts."
"Thirdly, you must publicly apologize to Mr. Augustine."
"Fourthly, you must immediately leave Miss Yelena and never approach her again."
"Fifthly..."
Turner listed nearly fifteen conditions in one go, and every condition was something Connor couldn't accept.
Upon hearing these conditions, Amelia's expression showed deep helplessness because she understood that Augustine had no intention of resolving the issue peacefully. Instead, he wanted to attack Connor. However, what surprised her was Connor's reaction. He remained calm throughout, as if he had endless patience.
"Soul Eater, there are a total of fifteen conditions. If you can fulfill all of them, Mr. Augustine will cease his attacks on you," Turner finally finished listing all the conditions and looked at Connor with a serious expression.
"Very well, I've heard your conditions. You can leave now," Connor said calmly to Turner.
However, after hearing his words, Turner hesitated for a moment, then frowned and asked, "Soul Eater, what do you mean by that?"
"I said you can leave now. Can't you understand what I mean?" Connor's tone was extraordinarily calm.
"You..."
He stared at Connor, dumbfounded. He had originally thought that after patiently listening to the conditions, Connor might agree to them. But what he didn't expect was that Connor seemed to have not paid any attention to the conditions at all.
Connor didn't seem to care about Augustine and his group.
"Who do you think you are?" Connor sneered at Turner and continued, "If you don't disappear from my sight within three minutes, I'll crush your head with my bare hands. Do you believe me?"
Turner hesitated for two seconds after hearing Connor's words and then decided to run away outside the estate.
Amelia looked at Turner's retreating figure with a helpless expression and whispered to Connor, "Although Augustine's conditions are indeed very unreasonable, I believe there is still room for negotiation in this matter. You can talk to Augustine."
"There's nothing to talk about. I have no grievances or enmities with Augustine. I've already spared him twice. But if he remains stubborn and has any intentions toward Yelena, I will personally kill him. I've given him opportunities; if he doesn't appreciate them, there's nothing I can do," Connor said emotionlessly.
"If it were just Augustine, there would be nothing to worry about. But this time, there are three other Celestial Ancient Martial Master with him. If these four join forces, even at the Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts, you'll find it very difficult!" Amelia furrowed her brow as she spoke.
"Difficult? So what?" Connor laughed coldly and continued, "These people are a challenge I'll have to face sooner or later. If I wait for the King of Shadows to come out and they join forces at that time, that would be a real problem. Now, if these four act separately, it's actually better for me. Even if they don't act, I'm still looking for an opportunity to take care of all four of them!"
Amelia looked at Connor, unsure of what to say. Sometimes, she couldn't understand why she cared about him when he had no direct connection to her life or fate. It was as if in her heart, he was destined to become her boss in the future.
Meanwhile, Turner, after leaving Connor's home, immediately drove to find Augustine.
"Turner, what was Connor's reaction? Did he agree to the conditions I proposed?" Augustine asked eagerly when he saw Turner.
"Although the Soul Eater listened to all the conditions, he didn't agree," Turner replied.
"Then how did Connor react?" Augustine continued to inquire.
"It seems like he was very calm throughout as if he didn't take this matter to heart at all," Turner said helplessly.
"He didn't take it to heart?" Augustine froze in place upon hearing this, wearing a puzzled expression on his face.
"How is that possible? How could he not take it to heart? We are four Celestial Ancient Martial Master !" Augustine muttered to himself, then turned and walked into the villa.
Inside his villa, there were three more people.
These three people were the remaining three guardians of Europe: John, the God of Fire; Alan, the God of Warrior; and Alice, the Goddess of Light. Together with Augustine, they were known as the Four Guardians of Europe.
Alan was the oldest among them, while John was the youngest. The title of "Guardian" had been passed down through generations in their families.
These four individuals were backed by four powerful family clans.

chapters.title: Chapter 2183: Because of a Woman
chapters.content:
Chapter 2183: Because of a Woman
John couldn't help but ask Augustine when he saw him walk in, "What's the situation with the Soul Eater? Has he surrendered?"
"No," Augustine replied, shaking his head in frustration.
"How is that possible? All four of us are here now, and he still hasn't surrendered? Is the Soul Eater insane?" Alan said, looking surprised.
After all, from a normal person's perspective, these four were extremely formidable figures, and their reputation alone was enough to intimidate many.
"He's always been a madman. I have no idea what's going on in his mind," Augustine muttered under his breath.
"Could it be that the Soul Eater has truly reached the pinnacle of ancient martial arts?" Suddenly, Alice spoke up.
Everyone froze upon hearing her words, and their expressions seemed off.
"It's impossible. Connor could never have reached the pinnacle of ancient martial arts!" Augustine immediately shook his head.
"I find it highly unlikely as well. After all, the Soul Eater is younger than me. How could he have reached the pinnacle of ancient martial arts?" John added.
"Then why hasn't he surrendered? Could it be that he still has some hidden cards?" Alice furrowed her brow, sensing that the situation might not be as simple as they thought.
"He probably still has some hidden cards," Augustine replied softly, then continued, "But I don't think we need to be overly concerned. Even if Connor has some tricks up his sleeve, he's no match for the four of us."
"Augustine, I think we should wait until the King of Shadows emerges before dealing with him. It wouldn't hurt us, the four of us," Alice suggested quietly.
"No!" Augustine shook his head decisively. "I can't wait any longer. Besides, we don't know when the King of Shadows will emerge. I want to kill Connor now!"
"Is it all because of a woman?" John said, very exasperated.
"Yes, it's because of a woman!" Augustine nodded.
"If it's just because of a woman, that's an easy problem to solve. Tell me what kind of woman you want, and I'll find one for you. It's not worth risking everything for a woman," John said helplessly.
"You can't understand my feelings for Yelena. No woman can replace her. I must kill the Soul Eater!" Augustine clenched his teeth.
Indeed, Augustine's feelings for Yelena were extraordinary. Otherwise, he wouldn't have quietly cared for her for so long. While Augustine wasn't as angry when facing Connor previously, after learning of Connor's relationship with Yelena, he couldn't control his emotions any longer.
The other three people looked at Augustine with a sense of helplessness. They didn't know what to say.
"What do you three mean? We had an agreement. You're not having second thoughts now, are you?" Augustine frowned and shouted.
"Of course not. Since you want to eliminate Connor, we will definitely help!" John quickly said.
"Augustine, when do you plan to take action?" Alice asked softly.
"Tonight!" John gritted his teeth.
Upon hearing this, everyone's expressions showed deep helplessness. However, they didn't continue to speak because they could sense that Augustine couldn't wait any longer.
On the other side, Connor and Amelia were chatting in the courtyard of the mansion.
Most of the conversation revolved around Amelia sharing her story, and she also informed Connor about the internal situation within the Rockefeller family.
After chatting with Amelia, Connor realized that Mr. Long was indeed very formidable. The Rockefeller was currently in a state of disarray, with the Four Great Vajras constantly vying for power. Even without taking any action, their infighting had never stopped. Their family was on the brink of collapse, and it would have disintegrated within a year if not for the presence of Mr. Long.
"It's getting late. Aren't you going to rest?" Amelia glanced at her phone and noticed that it was already early morning. She yawned and asked Connor softly.
"I'll wait a little longer. Guests are coming today," Connor replied calmly.
"Guests?" Amelia paused for a moment and then looked surprised as she asked, "Are you saying that Augustine's people might choose to strike tonight?"
"They've already arrived," Connor said expressionlessly.
"They've already arrived?" Amelia was surprised to hear this, her expression showing astonishment. She had known about Augustine's intentions to confront Connor, but she had never expected him to act so hastily.
"Mr. Connor, how are you feeling right now?" Amelia couldn't help but ask Connor with concern in her voice.
"Don't worry, I'm in good shape right now. They've given me enough time to rest," Connor replied softly.
If Connor had just arrived in England, he would have been in a very precarious situation if Augustine and his group had decided to attack him right away. At that time, Connor was already seriously injured, and, more importantly, his body had reached its limits. Engaging in another battle would have been extremely risky.
Unfortunately for Augustine, he missed two opportunities to kill Connor. If he had known that he could have easily defeated Connor when he killed William, he might have thought differently now.
While Connor appeared confident at the moment, Amelia couldn't help but worry about him. After all, this time, four Celestial Ancient Martial Masters were taking action, and their combined strength would be formidable, even for someone at the Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts.

chapters.title: Chapter 2184: It's Not Too Late To Turn Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 2184: It's Not Too Late To Turn Back
"Thud thud thud..."
At this moment, a rapid series of footsteps suddenly echoed.
Connor slowly raised his head and looked towards the entrance of the estate. He saw a large group of heavily armed warriors marching in with precise steps, heading into the estate. These individuals weren't just ordinary warriors; they were equipped with advanced technology weapons, and any one of them could rival a Grandmaster of Ancient Martial Arts in combat.
However, he knew that these people were not the main characters today. The real protagonists had not yet made their appearance.
He calmly continued eating his fruit, his expression very composed, as if he had nothing to do with what was happening.
On the contrary, Amelia, who had nothing to do with these events, seemed quite nervous.
Amelia's current situation was, in fact, very safe. She was part of Rockefeller, and Augustine knew very well how powerful Rockefeller's influence was. Furthermore, she had never been involved in any of these conflicts, so even if Augustine succeeded in killing Connor today, she would not be in any danger.
But she couldn't understand why she was feeling so nervous right now.
"Could it be that I'm feeling nervous for him?" Amelia subconsciously glanced at Connor beside her and sighed silently.
However, she felt that her actions were somewhat unnecessary. After all, Connor himself seemed quite calm about the situation. What significance did her nervousness have?
A few moments later, the soldiers who had rushed into the estate stopped their steps one by one and stood quietly, as if waiting for someone.
Connor calmly looked at the soldiers in front of him, his gaze still very calm.
A few seconds later, four people walked side by side towards him.
Leading the group was Augustine, who had met Connor several times before.
At this moment, Augustine, John, Alan, and Alice were all dressed alike, wearing white robes with a unique pattern on the back that Connor had never seen before. These four individuals now looked like gods.
They were also wearing the insignia of the Guardians.
Since Augustine and the others were wearing these robes, it meant that they were here on behalf of the Guardians to attack Connor, not as individuals.
Augustine didn't expect Connor to remain so calm. After sizing up Connor, he spoke softly, "Soul Eater, greetings. We four are the Guardians of Europe, and today, we are here to punish you on the orders of the Divine."
"The Divine's orders?" Connor couldn't help but chuckle upon hearing Augustine's words, then asked calmly, "Who is this Divine you speak of? What qualifications does he have to punish me?"
"You..." Augustine's expression showed some anger.
"Soul Eater, if you surrender now, we can spare your life. But this is your last chance. Once the four of us take action, you will have to repent in hell today!" It was Alan who spoke next, his voice cold.
At this moment, John, known as the God of Fire, spoke up, "Soul Eater, which is indeed your famous reputation. I like your confidence!"
He was skilled in fire manipulation, and his strength was terrifying as well. However, his personality was more easygoing, and his style of doing things was not as ruthless as Alan's. He could be considered the most beloved among the Guardians.
Alice, the Goddess of Light, also spoke at this moment. Her appearance indeed resembled that of an angel, with remarkable beauty that was on par with Amelia, who was standing beside Connor.
However, Connor dared not underestimate her. He knew that her strength was not inferior to that of Augustine and the others.
"Whether we're your opponents or not, we'll only know for sure after a fight!" Connor said calmly, looking at the four of them.
"Isn't that so?!" Alan replied coldly.
"Soul Eater, the four of us together would be a match even for a Grandmaster of Ancient Martial Arts at the pinnacle. That's the confidence we have as Guardians of Europe. Do you really believe you can take on all four of us?" Alice added.
Connor raised his head slightly to look at Alice. She gave off an angelic aura, but he didn't dare to underestimate her.
"Whether you are our opponents or not, we'll find out after a fight," Connor repeated.
After a brief hesitation, Amelia stepped forward and spoke softly, "I believe there must be a misunderstanding between you. After all, the Soul Eater came here for the King of Shadows. There's no need for you to fight each other!"
"You're the head of the Rockefeller family in Risu, right?" Augustine asked.
"Yes!" Amelia nodded.
"I know you. We have had very close cooperation with Rockefeller. So, I'll give you the face. But I hope you can change your mind now, or else you will die with this man today!" Augustine's voice was icy as he spoke to Amelia.

chapters.title: Chapter 2185: Four People Taking Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 2185: Four People Taking Action
Amelia's expression appeared somewhat helpless upon hearing Augustine's words. She hesitated for a couple of seconds and didn't continue to say much. After all, there was no connection between Connor and Amelia, so she couldn't possibly offend Augustine and the others on behalf of Connor.
"Please take care of yourself!" Amelia whispered to Connor as she approached him.
He glanced at her but remained silent.
"Enough talk, let's get started!" Just at that moment, Alan shouted loudly and released his own energy.
In an instant, a black aura spread throughout the entire estate.
"Go!" Augustine yelled as well, seeing that Alan had made a move.
In an instant, four different forces rushed toward Connor's location simultaneously, as if they intended to devour him.
A golden light erupted around Connor's body. The clash of his aura with Augustine, Alan, and the others was like a collision of sparks between planets.
The real battle was about to begin!
At this moment, many drones appeared once again in the sky above the estate, using high-definition cameras to monitor everything happening inside. After several previous battles, those watching knew that Connor was extremely fast. If only a single camera was used, it wouldn't capture the battle clearly. Therefore, this time, the drones filmed from various angles to provide the clearest and most intuitive view of the battle.
The battle between Connor and Augustine and the others seemed to be even more spectacular than the previous battle between Connor and the Grand Six of Risu.
After all, this time, he was facing even more formidable opponents.
Of course, many warriors were eagerly anticipating this battle. Therefore, these people had gathered outside the estate, waiting for the battle to begin. They understood that even though there was a great danger in spectating such a battle between powerhouses, witnessing such an extraordinary fight was an immense honor for an ordinary warrior.
"Finally, it's starting. I wonder who will win this time!"
Seeing Connor and the others make their moves, the crowd displayed excited expressions.
"Why even discuss it? The Guardians will definitely win. Four Grandmasters of Ancient Martial Arts, how terrifying is that? The Soul Eater can't possibly be a match for the Guardians!"
A middle-aged European warrior said.
"I think it's not so certain. The Soul Eater is very formidable, and if you look, he hasn't fallen behind at all yet. He's taking on all four of them single-handedly!"
Soon, someone expressed a different opinion.
The crowd looked towards Connor's position upon hearing this statement. At this moment, he was single-handedly withstanding the aura attacks from Augustine, Alan, and the others. Even though the battle hadn't officially begun, it was clear to the onlookers that he hadn't fallen behind.
This sight was quite shocking to the ordinary warriors.
"The Soul Eater is indeed the Soul Eater. If he wins today, I'm afraid there won't be anyone in Europe who can stop him!"
"That's right. If the Soul Eater wins today, only true Grandmasters of Ancient Martial Arts from around the world would be able to challenge him!"
"The warriors of Sommervile are truly terrifying to have produced such a genius!"
The crowd began to discuss the situation in hushed tones.
These people were well aware that this battle wasn't just about Connor's life and death; it also concerned the honor of Europe's warriors. After all, there were four Guardians against just one person—Connor.
If Connor couldn't be defeated even in such a scenario, the warriors of Europe would have a difficult time regaining their pride in the world of martial arts.
However, there were also a few Sommervile warriors who secretly supported Connor. But their numbers were small, and the majority around them were Europe warriors, so they didn't dare to express their sentiments openly.
"Just the four of you think you can kill me? How naive!"
At that moment, Connor suddenly shouted and then dramatically intensified his own aura.
"Boom!"
A loud noise echoed through the estate.
His sudden attack caught Alan, Augustine, and the others off guard. They were directly pushed back by his aura, each of them taking a step back almost simultaneously.
Connor's own body was also a bit unsteady, retreating by half a step as well.
So, this round of confrontation was clearly evenly matched.
Augustine's expression appeared somewhat unusual. He sighed softly, "It seems the Soul Eater has already recovered. We must be more careful!"
"I understand!" Alan, John, and the others nodded in response.
Although the previous exchange had ended evenly, Augustine and the others were actually testing Connor. They hadn't exerted their full strength, and they weren't sure if Connor had done so either.
However, Augustine was already aware that this battle would be extremely challenging. There was no room for any complacency.
"If the King of Shadows, who has already reached the Pinnacle Ancient Martial Arts, were to intervene, he might be able to kill me as I am now. Unfortunately, today, it's just the four of you, scoundrels."
Connor's voice was icy as he addressed Augustine and the others.
"You are too arrogant. Today, I'll show you just how formidable the four of us are!"
Alan, who had never been insulted like this before, had an angry expression on his face and shouted, "Formation!"
As Alan's words fell, the soldiers who had been quietly waiting rushed toward Connor's location. These soldiers possessed strength comparable to Grandmasters of Ancient Martial Arts and their numbers were astonishing. If they attacked together, their combat power would be terrifying.
However, Alan chose not to personally join the battle at this moment, allowing his subordinates to take the lead. It was clear that he intended to wear down Connor deliberately.

chapters.title: Chapter 2186: The Formation Has Been Completed
chapters.content:
Chapter 2186: The Formation Has Been Completed
Actually, to put it bluntly, the people who rushed up now were nothing more than cannon fodder in Allen's eyes.
But even as cannon fodder, it still held significant meaning.
Meanwhile, Augustine, John, and Alice just watched the commotion, seemingly with no intention of intervening.
In almost no time at all, Allen's men directly surrounded Connor and began to set up a formation.
Although the origin of this formation was Sommervile, the number of warriors who could truly use formations had become very scarce due to the decline of Sommervile's ancient martial arts. On the contrary, the more recently established European ancient martial artists had delved deeply into the study of formations. Now, there were many formations in Europe that not even Sommervile warriors had seen, and the power of these formations was astonishing. Even several initial-stage Celestial Ancient Martial Masters, after using these formations, could easily defeat a ground-stage ancient martial master.
A few seconds later, the formation was complete.
In an instant, a very powerful force burst out and headed toward Connor's position like a giant python.
"This formation is the Dragon Formation, with terrifying power. Even a Tianjie ancient martial master would need to avoid it to some extent. If it hits Connor, he will definitely be injured. After that, we can intervene more easily!" Allen says with a triumphant expression to Augustine and the others.
"I never expected your subordinates to be so proficient in such a powerful formation!" Augustine can't help but exclaim.
"Hahaha..." Allen can't help but laugh and then says lightly, "Don't think I spend my days just indulging in pleasures. I've never stopped training my subordinates, all in preparation for a day like this. It's just a pity that once I achieve mastery in battle formation, my subordinates will die within seven days. So, after we kill this Soul Devourer, you'd better thank me!"
"Of course!" Augustine quickly nods.
"Isn't it cruel that they will die within seven days?" John furrows his brow.
"No choice. This Dragon Formation requires the blood essence of warriors to fuel it, and other formations are much less powerful, incapable of harming Connor in the slightest," Allen replies calmly.
Alice turns to look at Allen, not saying a word, but she is also very displeased with Allen's actions. After all, they are all revered figures among the Europe warriors, and Allen's actions are no different from a cult. However, given the current situation, Alice can't say much.
"Boom!"
Just at that moment, the black dragon had already reached Connor.
His expression seems somewhat disdainful as he raises his right hand, a golden light turning into a golden dragon and heading straight for the black dragon's position.
The golden dragon collides with the black dragon.
The black dragon is instantly torn apart by the golden dragon. Moreover, the golden dragon doesn't stop there; it continues toward Allen's men.
In an instant, the golden dragon, like a massive killing machine, leaves death and injury in its wake, with cries of agony echoing everywhere.
Almost in an instant, all of Allen's men are crushed under the onslaught of the golden dragon.
"This..." Allen's expression shows shock as he witnesses this scene because he hadn't expected Connor to easily break his formation.
"Allen, it seems your formation wasn't very effective!" John says with a chuckle.
"I underestimated Connor a bit..." Allen grits his teeth and replies softly.
"Be careful!" Just then, Augustine shouts.
Because after killing Allen's men, Connor's golden dragon doesn't stop but charges toward the four of them.
"Leave it to me!" John shouts expressionlessly, then waves his right hand.
"Boom!"
A loud noise rings out.
A giant, nearly three-meter-tall figure covered in flames appears before them.
This giant isn't a real human but a manifestation of John's aura.
The flame giant's eyes emit blue flames, while its body is surrounded by red flames. When this giant appears in the courtyard, the temperature in the area seems to rise significantly.
"The Flame Warden!" Augustine exclaims when he sees the flame giant, his voice low.
"Yes, it's the Flame Warden!" John nods lightly.
"The last time I saw you use this move, your Flame Warden was only the size of a regular human. Now it's over three meters tall. Your progress is impressive!" Augustine can't help but sigh.
"The last time you saw me use the Flame Warden was ten years ago!" John says casually.
"Boom, boom!"
Just then, the flame giant stomps the ground forcefully, creating two massive craters.
The warriors outside the estate feel as if an earthquake has occurred; the earth trembles violently.
"How terrifying is this power!"
"Yeah, a single slap from that giant could probably kill me..."
"It's really scary..."
The crowd whispers in hushed tones.
However, at that moment, Connor's golden dragon had already reached the flame giant.
The flame giant raises its hands as if intending to block the dragon's attack head-on.
"Boom!"
Moments later, the golden dragon collides with the flame giant.
The flame giant exerts its strength, tearing the golden dragon apart.
"Impressive!" Allen turns to John, his expression filled with genuine admiration.
"That dragon had already expended most of its energy. If it were at the beginning, my Flame Warden wouldn't have been able to deal with it so easily!" John calmly explains.
"It's intriguing..." Connor can't help but mutter, then charges toward the flame giant.
The flame giant, in turn, rushes toward Connor.
"Boom, boom!"
The sound of continuous impacts echoes through the estate.
The flame giant keeps attacking Connor, seemingly having the upper hand, but in reality, it isn't causing any substantial harm to him. On the contrary, Connor continues to weaken the flame giant with each collision.
"Goodbye, big guy!" Connor suddenly roars.
The next second, he dashes to the flame giant like lightning and raises his fist, aiming it directly at the giant's chest.
"Seven-Star Big Dipper Fist, Exorcism!" Connor's words barely leave his mouth before his fist smashes into the flame giant's body.
The flame giant retaliates with a punch as well, seemingly trying to counter him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2187: The End
chapters.content:
Chapter 2187: The End
"Boom!"
Suddenly, a deafening noise resounded.
Two incredibly powerful forces collided once again.
For a moment, a powerful shockwave of energy swept through the entire estate.
The houses seemed as though they were swept away by a hurricane, directly flying out.
And some martial artists who were watching the spectacle from outside the estate were also affected by this terrifying energy shockwave and instantly lost their lives.
Augustine and the others stared wide-eyed, looking at the positions of Connor and the Flame Giant, their expressions unbelievably shocked.
Because the outcome at this moment was something none of them had anticipated.
Connor had actually smashed the Flame Giant with a single punch.
The Flame Giant turned into countless flames, dissipating into the heavens and earth.
John's face also filled with astonishment. Although he knew that relying solely on a Flame Giant wouldn't be enough to defeat Connor, he hadn't expected Connor to dispatch the Flame Giant so quickly!
Amelia gazed with wide, watery eyes, finding it difficult to believe everything she was witnessing. Though she had seen Connor in action before, she was still profoundly amazed by his abilities. His calm and composure were truly unsettling.
"Is it my turn now?" At this moment, Connor spoke towards Augustine and the others.
Once he uttered these words, a terrifying aura erupted from his body, instantly permeating the entire estate.
Martial artists who were watching from afar felt discomfort upon sensing Connor's aura. This was just a fraction of his power, yet it held such tremendous destructive potential that, if he were to attack them, their lives would likely be extinguished in an instant.
"Be careful, he's about to make a move!" Augustine hastily shouted.
However, right at this moment, Connor waved his right hand, and a golden sword appeared once more in his grasp.
This sword was a gift from Zidane.
Initially, when Connor was attacked by explosives in Risu, this sword had protected him. He later discovered that this sword was exceptionally sturdy, more so than regular Celestial Artifacts. Despite being subjected to explosive attacks, it hadn't turned into scrap metal. Connor had been dedicating his own energy to repair the sword in recent days, and it had fully recovered by now.
"Sword Chi!" Connor bellowed, then swung his hand vigorously.
A golden Sword Chi shot directly towards Augustine and the others.
Augustine recognized the Sword Chi as the one Connor had used before. He knew of its power. In the past, all Grand Six had fallen beneath the might of Connor's Sword Chi.
