"I'll handle this!" Alice saw the Sword Chi from Connor and shouted. She rushed to the front of the group.
Alice waved her right hand, and a radiant light enveloped her body. Her body donned a set of golden armor, and she held a shield in her left hand and a long sword in her right.
He knew that all three of her items were high-grade Celestial Artifacts.
Alice was originally a Celestial Ancient Martial Master. Now, with these three Celestial Artifacts protecting her, her combat strength was truly terrifying.
"Bang!"
At that moment, Connor's Sword Chi crashed into Alice's shield.
Surprisingly, her shield easily withstood his Sword Chi.
"Alice is indeed the Goddess of Light, being able to block the Soul Eater's Sword Chi!"
"Yes, it's incredible. I heard that the Soul Eater's Sword Chi is truly terrifying!"
"It seems like today, the Soul Eater might truly be in a precarious situation. Even if his strength is terrifying, he's unlikely to be a match for the four Guardians!"
People outside the estate began to murmur quietly. In their eyes, Connor now seemed destined to lose, as they believed Alice alone might be able to deal with him.
However, when they witnessed the next turn of events, they realized how naive and absurd their thoughts had been.
Although Connor had effortlessly countered John and Allen's attacks earlier, they hadn't taken it seriously. These four had never fought together; they had always engaged in one-on-one duels with Connor.
If the four of them truly cooperated, their combined power would be astonishing.
"What a sturdy shield!" Even he couldn't help but exclaim.
However, Alice didn't give Connor much time to think. Wielding her shield in one hand and her sword in the other, she charged toward Connor.
He unleashed another Sword Chi.
Alice's speed was impressive, and with the assistance of her armor, shield, and sword, she managed to reach Connor and launched an attack directly at his head.
Connor quickly raised his sword to block her attack. The two weapons clashed fiercely, causing him to retreat two steps, while Alice was pushed back only one.
Seeing her pressuring him, the onlookers were amazed. It seemed that Connor was at a disadvantage now.
"Never thought the Soul Eater would be defeated so quickly!"
"That's right, I thought this grand battle would last much longer!"
"The four Guardians haven't even joined forces yet. Even if the Soul Eater manages to hold on now, when these four people team up, he'll be in serious trouble!"
People outside the estate started to discuss the situation quietly.
In their eyes, Connor was now almost certain to lose. Despite his terrifying strength, he would probably be overwhelmed when facing all four Guardians.
"Seems like the Soul Eater is nothing special after all!" Augustine looked at Connor's position and sneered with an expression of disdain.
Connor, on the other hand, was too preoccupied to pay attention to Augustine's taunts. He was focused on finding Alice's weaknesses.
Because she was equipped with Celestial Artifacts from head to toe, effectively targeting her was no easy task for Connor.
"You have Celestial Artifacts, but so do I!" It suddenly struck Connor that he possessed Celestial Artifacts he had acquired by extorting Augustine. He waved his right hand, and a black bead flew toward Alice.
"The Soul-Devouring Bead!" Augustine immediately recognized the bead as the one he had reluctantly given to Connor.
While the Soul-Devouring Bead might look like an ordinary treasure, it was, in fact, an extremely precious top-grade Immortal tool.
The Soul-Devouring Bead possessed a terrifying power that could consume human souls. Even Celestial Ancient Martial Master s found it challenging to deal with the Soul-Devouring Bead.
As expected, when the Soul-Devouring Bead reached Alice, a terrifying aura instantly enveloped her.
"Ah!" Alice let out a cry of pain.
She felt as though countless insects were gnawing at her internal organs. It was an indescribable sensation.
Although the Soul Eater could consume human souls, the process was slow. Alice, as a Celestial Ancient Martial Master, could easily break free from the Soul-Devouring Bead's attack.
Connor was well aware that the Soul-Devouring Bead wouldn't be able to repel Alice. However, it served its purpose by giving him a chance to make a move. He dashed toward Alice, who had just managed to shake off the effects of the bead.
Connor's fist struck Alice's chest with brutal force.
Alice had barely managed to recover from the Soul-Devouring Bead's attack when Connor's lightning-fast movement caught her off guard. She couldn't react in time.
"Boom!"
A deafening crash.
Connor's fist brutally struck Alice's chest, sending her flying.
She crashed forcefully into the ground, creating a massive crater.
For a moment, everyone on the scene was left in shock, their expressions filled with disbelief.
Alice, who had seemingly held the upper hand just moments ago, had been sent flying by Connor.
In fact, all the other Guardians were also blasted away by Connor and met a quick demise.
Many martial artists didn't even understand what had happened. Some were speculating that maybe there was no need for anyone else to take action; Alice alone might be enough to deal with Connor.
But when they saw this scene, they realized how naive and laughable their thoughts had been.
The Soul Eater had reached this point not through empty boasts but through one tough battle after another. From the leader of the Blood Moon Cult onwards, Connor had faced opponents who appeared much stronger than him, yet he always emerged victorious.
In the world, there were many martial artists, some even more formidable than Connor, but none of them had the reputation he did.
The story of the Soul Eater was like a legend in many people's eyes, almost too unreal to be true, yet undeniably real.
With this, the situation came to an end!

chapters.title: Chapter 2188: Saving Jorge
chapters.content:
Chapter 2188: Saving Jorge
Today, Connor won, and it can be said that he won brilliantly.
After the battle ended, Amelia felt like she had just experienced a dream. She hurried over to Connor and asked excitedly, "Mr. Connor, are you okay?"
"I'm fine," he replied coldly.
Just as Amelia was about to speak again, she saw several police cars approaching in the distance. A middle-aged man stepped out of one of the cars and walked briskly to Connor. He said with excitement, "Lord Soul Eater, are you okay? We just received news of a terrible attack here, so I brought people here immediately!"
"Is that so?" Connor couldn't help but sneer when he heard the middle-aged man's words. After all, the battle had lasted all night, and he didn't believe that the authorities had just received the news now. He knew that these people had been watching from the sidelines, waiting for the outcome of the battle. If he had lost, they would distance themselves from him and report the result. If he had won, they would change their attitude and try to establish a good relationship with him.
"Lord Soul Eater, whether it's the Guardians or the King of Shadows, their actions have nothing to do with Eigona. These are their private matters, so please don't blame us!" the middle-aged man said nervously.
Connor glanced at the middle-aged man but didn't say anything.
"Of course, Lord Soul Eater, if you have any requests, you can make them. As long as it's something we can fulfill, we will do our best!" the middle-aged man added, sensing Connor's unease.
"I want an aircraft!" Connor said expressionlessly.
"You... you want an aircraft?" The middle-aged man seemed somewhat incredulous, as he couldn't believe that Connor's request was just for an aircraft.
"Just get me an aircraft. Can't you understand that?" Connor frowned and reprimanded.
"As long as you want an aircraft, right?" The middle-aged man still seemed a bit hesitant, unable to believe that Connor's condition was simply an aircraft.
"Mr. Connor told you to prepare an aircraft. Hurry up and go, stop wasting time here!" Amelia said with a furrowed brow.
"Alright, I'll go prepare it right away. Please wait patiently!" The middle-aged man quickly nodded and then turned and ran towards the distance.
About half an hour later, a helicopter landed right in front of Connor and the others. He didn't waste any time talking to the middle-aged man and walked onto the aircraft.
After hesitating for a moment, Amelia also boarded the aircraft with Connor.
Connor informed Amelia of the location of the Eight Trigrams Valley where Jorge was, and then he went into the cabin alone. After all, after such a big battle, Connor needed a good rest.
Two days later, Connor, Amelia, and Zidane finally arrived at Eight Trigrams Valley. By this time, Connor had reached the pinnacle of Ancient Martial Masters, and he knew the exact location of the hidden treasure. So, it took them less than an hour to find it.
Upon entering the hidden treasure, Zidane eagerly approached and asked Connor, "Did you find a way to remove the Yin Spirit Curse?"
"Yeah," Connor nodded gently, then took out the antidote and handed it to Zidane.
Zidane took the antidote, examined it carefully, and then turned to Connor, saying excitedly, "I don't know if this antidote can remove the Yin Spirit Curse, but I do know it's not poison."
"That should be fine then. They probably wouldn't dare to deceive me," Connor said in a low voice.
"Good, I will give this antidote to your master now!" Zidane immediately took the antidote and went into the room where Jorge was.
When Connor saw Zidane enter the room with the antidote, he felt a bit nervous. He knew that this might be their last chance. If this antidote didn't work, Connor would have to find another way to remove the Yin Spirit Curse, and time was running out. Jorge's body was on the brink of death.
Zidane's face also showed signs of tension as he checked Jorge's condition. After a few minutes, Zidane turned to Connor and said excitedly, "It worked! The Yin Spirit Curse in your master's body has disappeared."
"Really?" Connor's expression became somewhat excited when he heard this. He asked eagerly, "When will my master wake up?"
"I'm not sure, but with the abundant spiritual energy here, I don't think it will take much time!" Zidane replied after some thought.
"Alright, I understand," Connor nodded.
As for Amelia, she hesitated for a moment before asking Connor softly, "Did you go on a killing spree in the United States just to save this old man?"
"Yeah," Connor replied calmly.
"..." Amelia stared at Connor with wide, watery eyes, feeling a mix of emotions. She hadn't expected that all of Connor's recent dangerous actions were solely to save his master.
"If your master knew that you had done so much for him, he would be very touched!" Amelia hesitated for a moment and then said softly.
"He won't be touched," Connor shook his head gently and smiled. "He'll just scold me for meddling in his affairs."
Time passed quickly. Connor, Amelia, and Zidane waited here for three whole days. Finally, Jorge, who had been in a coma, slowly began to wake up.
When Zidane saw him waking up, he smiled and said, "You have a good disciple. He went to great lengths to save you."
"Is that so?" Jorge looked at Connor and couldn't help but glance at him. Then, he asked Connor in a low voice, "Did you kill the King of Shadows?"
"Yes," Connor nodded.
"It's a bit of progress," Jorge said indifferently.
"Old man, aren't you going to praise me?" Connor grinned and asked.
"You shouldn't be so complacent. Your current state is due to luck and the opportunities you've encountered. Your foundation is not stable. If it weren't for your good luck, you would have died countless times by now," Jorge said with a stern face.
"Old man, how come you can't say anything good about me?" Connor shook his head and smiled.
"I was thinking of having you be the witness at my wedding when I get married. But seeing your current state, I've changed my mind. A dog's mouth can't speak words of wisdom, and who would want to listen to you?" Jorge replied.
Connor rolled his eyes and said, "I can never hear any good words coming from you."
"Well, it's good to have you back. Now, I'll be able to live a few more years," Jorge said with a faint smile.
After going through so much, Connor finally felt that it was time to settle down. He wanted to give Freya an answer. Previously, he had thought that he couldn't protect her and might die at any moment, so he had postponed their marriage. But now, he believed he could protect Freya, so he decided it was time to plan their wedding.
"You're getting married?" Jorge asked.
"Yes," Connor nodded.
"When?" Jorge inquired.
"Sooner is better. If it weren't for waiting for you to wake up, I would have gone back and gotten married already," Connor replied calmly.
"That's good!" Jorge said with a smile.

Chapter 2189: Bonds of Marriage
The next day, in the early morning.
Connor and Jorge returned to Porthampton by plane.
Connor had originally intended to invite Zidane to attend his wedding and to help him return to the Purple Cloud Sect. However, Zidane seemed to have grown accustomed to a carefree life and preferred not to interact with too many people, so he declined the invitation.
Amelia also did not accompany Connor to Porthampton. After all, as a powerful woman, she had many of her own responsibilities to attend to.
When the plane successfully landed in Porthampton, Freya, Thomas, Kyle, Queta, and the members of the Purple Cloud Sect were waiting eagerly at the airport, their expressions filled with excitement.
After a moment, Connor walked out of the plane.
With one glance, he saw the beautiful woman standing in the waiting area, dressed in a white gown. Freya's attire was the same as the one she wore when they first met.
Countless memories flashed through his mind.
He felt that everything he had experienced over the years was like a dream. Freya, on the other hand, was looking at him with tears in her eyes. She couldn't believe that he was truly standing in front of her once again.
In the next moment, tears welled up in her eyes.
He walked over to her and embraced her tightly.
She held onto him tightly as tears fell from her eyes.
At this moment, she was overwhelmed with excitement, feeling like she was living in a dream.
"Don't cry, let's get married!" He wiped away the tears on her face and said softly.
"What... What did you say?" She looked at him with an expression of disbelief.
"I said... Will you marry me?" he replied with a smile.
"Are you serious?" She found it hard to believe the words she had just heard.
"Of course, are you not willing?" he asked playfully.
"I do!" she exclaimed excitedly.
...
Three days later.
On a beautiful island.
The island enjoyed a spring-like climate year-round and had breathtaking scenery. It was considered a retirement paradise for many wealthy individuals. However, due to its prime location and comfortable environment, the price was extremely high. Even billionaires on the Forbes list would hesitate to make a purchase.
Yet, Connor spared no expense and, through his connections, directly purchased the island to use as the venue for his wedding.
This extravagant gesture was beyond generous.
On the island, preparations for the luxurious wedding were in full swing. Many guests had arrived early, creating a lively atmosphere.
The guests invited to Connor and Freya's wedding included not only close friends and family but also influential figures from around the world.
Originally, he had contemplated having a small, private wedding, but to his surprise, when Thomas learned about it, he immediately spread the news. Before he could send out formal invitations, these prominent figures had already responded, expressing their intention to attend the wedding.
Reluctantly, he had to send out the invitations to accommodate their wishes.
At this moment.
Inside a hotel room.
Freya sat at the dressing table, wearing a wedding gown designed by a renowned foreign designer, her lustrous black hair cascading down.
The bright sunlight outside the window gently illuminated her, making her skin glow as if she were a radiant goddess. She was unbelievably beautiful.
Freya, at this moment, seemed like a celestial being descended to earth, leaving people feeling inadequate in her presence.
In her company were makeup artists and a group of beautiful women dressed as bridesmaids. They included Rachel, Priscilla, Mina, Queta, and Yelena, all close friends of Connor.
Luckily, the guests who had come to attend the wedding were unaware of their identities and assumed they were Freya's close friends, which is why they had been asked to be bridesmaids.
If they knew about the ambiguous relationships between these stunning women and Connor, they would be astounded.
"Freya, you look absolutely stunning today. Even as a woman, I can't help but be enchanted by your beauty," Priscilla said sincerely as she gazed at Freya, admiration evident in her eyes.
The others, including Rachel, nodded in agreement.
Even though they were considered goddesses in their own right, attracting attention wherever they went, they couldn't help but feel inadequate when standing next to Freya.
Hearing their compliments, Freya blushed and said somewhat shyly, "You're all too kind. You look beautiful as well! But having you as my bridesmaids is truly an honor."
"Ha! That guy is getting off easy," Rachel couldn't help but snort.
"Exactly, Freya, you have to take good care of Connor in the future. Don't let him run around everywhere. We've got your back, so don't worry!" Priscilla declared with a determined look.
The others nodded in agreement and couldn't help but laugh.
Inside the room, the goddesses chatted and laughed.
The gentle sea breeze outside the window rustled the white curtains, creating a scene of unparalleled beauty.
This grand wedding was about to begin.
Hand in hand, Connor and Freya walked out of the lobby.
In the presence of the guests, they exchanged rings and made their vows of love, officially entering the bonds of marriage.
This wedding, with its grandeur and magnificence, would become a legendary tale passed down through history.
(End of the novel)
